devebhyaḥ devānāṃ mṛtyuṃ mārayitāraṃ kaṃ svapuruṣam avṛṇīta prārthayate prayuṅkte |
kiṃca prajāyai devavyatiriktāyā manuṣyādikāyāḥ prajāyāḥ amṛtam amarakamavināśakaṃ kaṃ ghā svapuruṣaṃ nāvṛṇīta na prayuṅkte |
havirdhāraṇakriyāyāṃ pravṛttāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ pūrvoktānāṃ sarveṣāṃ sthiteravyaṃbhāvitvācca kaṃcidapi vināśakaṃ svapuruṣaṃ yamo nirūpayatītyarthaḥ |
api ca bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhatāṃ devānāṃ havirdhāraṇe pālakaṃ bṛhatāṃ mantrāṇāṃ svāminaṃ vā ṛṣi sarvasya dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalasya draṣṭāraṃ yajñam akaṇvata ṛtvijamānāḥ kurvanti |
api ca yamaḥ priyāṃ manvam asmadīyamiṣṭaṃ śarīraṃ prārirecīt |

sapta kṣaranti śiśave marutvate pitre putrāso apyavīvatanvatam | ubhe idasyobhayasya rājata ubhe yatete ubhayasya puṣyataḥ || 5 || sapta | kṣaranti | śiśave | marutvate | pitre | putrāsaḥ | api | avīvatanvatam | ṛtam | ubhe | iti | asya | ubhayasya | rājataḥ | ubhe | iti | yatete | ubhayasya | puṣyataḥ ||5||
stutidvāreṇa tadvate pitre ṛtvijāṃ pitṛbhūtāya śiśave saṃsanīya havirdhānaśakaṭayoḥ sukhāsīnabhūtāya somāya sapta cchandāṃsi kṣaranti stutivena gacchanti |

1. ta-bha4-dhanā | 2. ta-mu-padairyuktāṃ | 3. ta-bha-su- kriyā nāsti | 4. tara.2.7-bha1.2. 4.6-yaṃ kaṃ | 5. ta-bha-amārakaṃ vināśakaṃ | 6. ga-nivārayati | prajāyai manuṣyebhyo amṛtaṃ annādṛṇīta kamapi na vārayatītyarthaḥ; ta-nirūpayati; bha1.2.4-na rūpayati | 7. ta-rirecetra; bha-riricaratra |
vputrāsaḥ vapi somasya putrabhūtā ṛtvijo'pi vṛtaṃ satyabhūtaṃ stotram vabīvatan saṃgamayanti |
vubhe vit dve eva havirdhānaśakṭe vasya vubhayasya devajātasya manuṣyajātasya ca vrājataḥ īśāte |
vubhe eva śakaṭe vyatete karmānuṣṭhāne prayatnaṃ kurutaḥ |
'pareyivāṃsam' iti ṣoḍaśarcaṃ caturdaśaṃ sūktaṃ vivasvataḥ putrasya yamasyārṣam |
'aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvāḥ' iti pañcā aṅgiraḥpitṛvadbhṛgulakṣaṇā liṅgoktā devatāḥ |
'ati drava sārameyā~' ityādikastvaḥ saramāputrau yau śvānau paralokamāgarmabhitaḥ sthitau tadevatākaḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ— 'pareyivāṃ soḻaśa yamo yāmaṃ paṣṭhī liṅgoktadevatā parāstisraḥ pitṛvā vā tracaḥ śravyāṃ parā anuṣṭubho bṛhatpyānyā' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdeti dve pareyivāṃ pravato mahīranu' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti ||

pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīranu bṛhabhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam | vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā duvasya || 1 || pareyi'vāṃsam | pravateḥ | mahīḥ | anu | bṛha'bhyaḥ | panthām | anu'paspaśānam | vaivasvatam | sam'gamanam | janānām | yamam | rājānam | haviṣā | duvasya || 1 ||
he madīyāntarātman yajamāna vā tvaṃ vrājānaṃ pitṛṇāṃ svāminaṃ vyamaṃ vhaviṣā puroḍāśādinā vduvasya paricara |

vpravataḥ prakṛṣṭakarmano bhūlokavartibhogasādhanaṃ puṇyamanuṣṭhitavataḥ purupān vmahīḥ tattadgocinabhūpradeśaviśeṣān vanu vpareyivāṃsaṃ krameṇa maraṇādūrdhvaṃ prāpitavantaṃ tathā vbahubhyaḥ svargātithibhyaḥ puṇyakṛdbhyaḥ puṇyakṛtārthe vpanthāṃ svargasyocitaṃ mārgam vanupaspaśānam abādhamānam |
pāpina eva purupān svagemārgabādhena narakaṃ prāpayati na tu puṇyakṛta ityarthaḥ |
vvaivasvataṃ vivasvataḥ sūryasya putraṃ vjanānāṃ pāpināṃ vsaṃgamanaṃ gamanyasthānarūpam ||

yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirpabhartavā u | yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ pareyuryenā jajñānāḥ pṛthyā anu svāḥ || 2 || yamaḥ | naḥ | gātum | prathamaḥ | 'viveda | na | eṣā | gavyūtiḥ | apa'bhartave | ū~ iti | yatra | naḥ | pūrve | pitaraḥ | parā'īyuḥ | enā | jajñānāḥ | pṛthyāḥ | anu | svāḥ || 2 ||
prathamaḥ sarveṣāṃ mukhyaḥ vyamaḥ vnaḥ asmākaṃ prajānāṃ vgātuṃ śubhāśubhanimittaṃ vviveda jānāti |
atiśayajñānayogāt yamasya na kenacidapahartumapanetuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ |
vyatra yasmin mārge vnaḥ asmākaṃ vpūrve vpitaraḥ vpareyuḥ venā anena mārgeṇa gacchantaḥ vjajñānāḥ jātāḥ sarve vsvāḥ svabhūtāḥ vpathyāḥ svakarmamārgabhūtā gatīḥ vanu gacchanti ||
4. ta3-bha1-pustakayoḥ 'pareyuḥ' ityasyānantaraṃ kriyāṃśridavakāśo vidyate; bhara-pareyuḥ pitrādayo gatāḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīda mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhiradīratāmacara usarāsaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 20) iti ||
yāṃśra devā vāṃvṛdhurye ca devānsvāhānye svadhayāndhe madanti ||
mātalī | kavyaiḥ | yamaḥ | aṅgiraḥbhiḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | ṛkbhiḥ | vavṛdhānaḥ | yān | ca | devāḥ | vavṛdhuḥ | ye | ca | devān | svāhā | anye | svadhayā | anye | madanti ||3||
sa ca vkavyaiḥ kavyabhāgabhiḥ vpitṛbhiḥ saha vvavṛdhānaḥ vardhamāno bhavati |
vyamaḥ ca vaṅgirobhiḥ pitṛviśeṣaiḥ saha vardhamāno bhavati |

tatra vdevāḥ indrādayaḥ vyāṃśra kavyabhāgādīn pitṛn vvavṛdhuḥ vardhayanti vye ca kavya- bhāgādayaḥ pitaraḥ vdevān indrādīn vardhayanti teṣāṃ madhye vanye indrādayaḥ vsvāhā vmadanti svāhākāreṇa hṛṣyanti |
mahāpitṛyajñe yamasya 'imaṃ yama' ityādiṃkaṃ dve anuvākye |
'imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdeti dve' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti hi sūtritam |
imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ |
ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājan haviṣā mādayasva ||
imam | yama | pra'staram | ā | hi | sīda | aṅgiraḥbhiḥ | pitṛbhiḥ | sam'vidvānaḥ | ā | tvā | mantrāḥ | kavi'śastāḥ | vahantu | enā | rājan | haviṣā | mādayasva || 4 ||
he vyama vaṅgirobhiḥ etannāmakaiḥ vpitṛbhiḥ vsaṃvidānaḥ aikamatyaṃ gatasavam vimaṃ vprastaraṃ vistīrṇaṃ yajñaviśeṣam vā vsīda āgamyopaviśa |
vhi yasmādevaṃ tasmāt vkaviśastāḥ vidvadbhirṛtvigbhiḥ prayuktāḥ vmantrāḥ vtvā tvām vā vahantu |
he vrājan venā etena vhaviṣā tuṣṭaḥ vmādayasva yajamānaṃ harṣaya ||
vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'smin yajñe barhiṣi niṣadya ||
aṅgiraḥbhiḥ | ā | gahi | yajñiyaiḥbhiḥ | yama | verūpaiḥ | iha | mādayasva | vivasvantam | huve | yaḥ | pitā | te | asmin | yajñe | barhiṣi | ā | ni'sadya || 5 ||
he vyama vvairūpaiḥ vividharūpayuktairvairūpasāmapriyairvā vyajñiyaiḥ yajñayogyaiḥ vaṅgirobhiḥ saha vā vgahi āgaccha |
āgatya ca viha asmin yajñe vmādayasva yajamānaṃ harṣaya |
vyaḥ vivasvān vte tava vpitā asti vasmin vyajñe taṃ vvivasvantaṃ vhuve āhvayāmi |
sa cāstīrṇe vbarhiṣi vā vniṣadya upaviśya yajamānaṃ harṣayatu ||

aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ | teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumato yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma || 6 || aṅgirasaḥ | naḥ | pitaraḥ | navagvāḥ | atharvāṇaḥ | bhṛgavaḥ | somyāsaḥ | teṣām | vayam | su'matau | yajñiyānām | api | bhadre | saumanase | syāma || 6 || ᵥaṅgirasaḥ aṅgironāmakāḥ ᵥatharvāṇaḥ atharvanāmakāḥ ᵥbhṛgavaḥ bhṛgunāmakāśca ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥpitaraḥ ᵥnavagvāḥ abhinavagamanayuktāḥ | sadā¹ nūtanavatprītitanakā ityarthaḥ | te ca ᵥsomyāsaḥ | somamahantīti somyāḥ | ᵥyajñiyānāṃ yajñāhāṇāṃ ᵥteṣāṃ ᵥsumato anugrahayuktāyāṃ buddhau ᵥvayaṃ ᵥsyāma sarvadā tiṣṭhema | ᵥapi ca ᵥsaumanase ᵥbhadre saumanasasya kāraṇe kalyāṇe phale syāma sarvadā tiṣṭhema || satramadhye dīkṣitamaraṇe 'prehi' ityādyāḥ pañcarcastutīyāvarjitā hotrā śaṃsanīyāḥ | sūtritaṃ ca—'prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūvyairbhiriti pañcānāṃ tṛtīyāmuddharet' (āśva. śrau. 6. 10) iti ||

prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūvyairbhiratrā naḥ pūrvaṃ pitaraḥ pareyuḥ | ubhā rājānā svadhayā madantā yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃca devam || 7 || pra | ihi | pra | ihi | pathi'bhiḥ | pūvyaiḥ | atra | naḥ | pūrvam | pitaraḥ | parā'īyuḥ | ubhā | rājānā | svadhayā | madantā | yamam | paśyāsi | varuṇam | ca | devam || 7 || ᵥyatra yasmin sthāne ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥpūrve purātanāḥ ᵥpitaraḥ pitāmahādayaḥ ᵥpareyuḥ ᵥpūvyaiḥ pūrvasmin kāle bhavaḥ | anādikālapravṛttairityarthaḥ | ᵥpathibhiḥ mārgaiḥ he matpitaḥ tasthānaṃ ᵥprehi pragaccha śīghraṃ gaccha | gatvā ca ᵥsvadhayā amṛtānnena ᵥmadantā madantau tṛpyantau ᵥrājānā rājānau ᵥubhā ubhau ᵥyamaṃ ᵥdevaṃ dyotamānaṃ ᵥvaruṇaṃ ᵥca ᵥpaśyāsi paśya ||

saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yamena iṣṭāpūrtena parame vyoman | hitvāyāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchasva tanvā suvarcāḥ || 8 || sam | gacchasva | pitṛ'bhiḥ | sam | yamena | iṣṭāpūrtena | parame | vi'omana | hitvāya | avadyam | punaḥ | astam | ā | ihi | sam | gacchasva | tanvā | su'varcāḥ ||8|| he madīya pitaḥ tatastvaṃ ᵥparame utkṛṣṭe ᵥvyoman vyomani svargasthe sthāne svabhūtaiḥ ᵥpitṛbhiḥ saha ᵥsaṃ ᵥgacchasva | ᵥiṣṭāpūrtena śrautasmārtadānaphalena ᵥsaṃ gacchasva | tata iṣṭāpūrtena sahaprāpya ᵥavadyaṃ pāpaṃ ᵥhitvā parityajya ᵥastaṃ triyamāṇāravyaṃ gṛham ᵥehi āgaccha | tataḥ ᵥsuvarcāḥ5 | tṛtīyārthe prathamā | suvarcā śobhanadīptiyuktena ᵥtanvā svaśarīreṇa ᵥsaṃ gacchasva || paitṛmedhike karmaṇi imaśānāyatanaṃ prokṣati 'aveta vīta' iti | sūtritaṃ ca—'gatodakena śamī- śākhayā6 triḥ prasavyamāyatanaṃ paribrajan prokṣatyeta vīta vi ca sarpatātaḥ' (āśva.gṛ.4.2.10) iti||
1. ta-bha1.2.4-tadā | 2. ga-ta3.4-bha5.6-pareyuḥ paretāḥ | 3. ta3.4-bha1.2.4.5-tatra gatvā; ta5-tāṃ gatvā | 4. ga-tvaṃ; ta-bha-mu-atastvaṃ | 5. ga-ta-bha- 'suvarcāḥ' nāsti | 6. ta-bha -śākhayā |
apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitarau lokamaknan |
apa | ita | vi | ita | vi | ca | sarpata | ataḥ | asmai | etam | pitaraḥ | lokam | aknan | ahaḥ'bhiḥ | adabhiḥ | nakta'bhiḥ | yamaḥ | dadāti | ava'sānam | asmai || 9 ||
imaśāne pūrva sthitā he piśācādayaḥ ataḥ asmāt pramujyamānadahanasthānāt apeta apa- gacchata |
idaṃ sthānaṃ parityajya nānābhāvena dūrataraṃ deśaṃ gacchatetyarthaḥ |
pitaraḥ asmai mṛtayajamānasyārthāya etaṃ lokam idaṃ dahanasthānam aknan |
yamaḥ api ahobhiḥ divasaiḥ adbhiḥ abhyukṣaṇodakaiḥ naktabhiḥ rātribhiḥ vyaktaṃ saṃgatam |
avasānaṃ dahanasthānam asmai mṛtayajamānasyārthāya dadāti dattavān ||
tāvuddhṛtya pretasya hastayornidadhāti ‘ati drava sārameyau’ iti dvābhyām |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘vṛkāvuddhṛtya pāṇyorādadhāti drava sārameyau śvānau’ (āśva. gṛ. 4. 3. 20) iti ||
ati drava sārameyau śvānau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā |
athā pitṛnsuvidatrā~ upehi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti ||
ati | drava | sārameyau | śvānau | catuḥ'akṣau | śabalau | sādhunā | pathā | atha | pitṛn | suvidatrān | upa | ihi | yamena | ye | sadha'mādam | madanti || 10 ||
he agne sādhunā pathā samīcīnena mārgeṇa śvānau ubhau ati drava atikramya gaccha |
yamasambandhinau yau śvānau pretasya bādhakau tau parityajya samīcīnena mārgeṇa pretaṃ nayetyarthaḥ |
tasyāḥ putrau caturakṣau uparibhāge punarapyakṣidvayaṃ yathoktalakṣaṇau |
atha śobhanamārgeṇa gamanānantaraṃ ye pitaraḥ yamena sadhamādaṃ saharṣa madanti prāpnuvanti tān suvidatrān suṣṭhubhijñān pitṛn upehi upagaccha ||
yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasau |
tābhyāmenaṃ pari dehi rājantsvasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi ||
yau | te | śvānau | yama | rakṣitārau | catuḥ'akṣau | pathirakṣī iti pathi'rakṣī | nṛ'cakṣasau | tābhyām | enam | pari | dehi | rājan | svasti | ca | asmai | anamīvam | ca | dhehi || 11 ||
he rājan he yama te tvadīyau yau śvānau vidyete tābhyāṃ śvābhyāṃ he rājan yama enaṃ pretaṃ pari dehi rakṣārtha prayaccha |
rakṣitārau yamagṛhasya rakṣakau caturakṣau akṣicatuṣṭaya- yuktau pathirakṣī mārgasya rakṣakau nṛcakṣasau manuṣyaiḥ vyāpyamānau |
tābhyāṃ śvābhyāṃ datvā asmai pretāya svasti ca kṣemamapi anamīvaṃ ca rogābhāva- mapi dhehi saṃpādaya ||

u॒ru॒ṇa॒sāva̭su॒tṛpau u॒dumba̭lau ya॒masya̭ dū॒tau ca̭rato॒ janā̭n a॒nu | tā a॒smabhya॒ṃ dṛśa̭ye॒ sūryā̭ya॒ puna̭rdātāmasu॒madya॒ bhadra̭m || 12 || u॒ru॒ṇa॒sau | a॒su॒tṛpau | u॒dumba̭lau | ya॒masya̭ | dū॒tau | ca॒rataḥ | janā̭n | a॒nu | tau | a॒smabhya̭m | dṛśa̭ye | sūryā̭ya | puna̭: | dā॒tām | a॒su॒m | a॒dya | i॒ha | bhadra̭m || 12 || yamasya saṃbandhinau dūtau śvānau janān anu prāṇino lakṣīkṛtya sarvatra carataḥ | kīdṛśau | uruṇasau dīrghanāsikāyuktau asutṛpau parakīyān prāṇān svīkṛtya taistṛpyantau udumbalo urubalau vistīrṇabalau | tau ubhau dūtau sūryāya dṛśaye sūryasya darśanāyam adya dine iha karmaṇi bhadram asuṃ samīcīnaṃ prāṇaṃ punaḥ asmabhyaṃ dātām adattām ||

ya॒māya̭ so॒maṃ sṷnuta॒ yamā̭ya juhutā ha॒viḥ | ya॒maṃ ha ya॒jño ga̭cchatya॒gnidṷ̄to a॒raṃkṛ̭taḥ || 13 || ya॒māya̭ | so॒mam | sṷnuta | yamā̭ya | ju॒huta | ha॒viḥ | ya॒mam | ha | ya॒jñaḥ | ga̭cchati | a॒gnidṷ̄taḥ | a॒ram'kṛ̭taḥ || 13 || he ṛtvijaḥ yamāya yamadevatāthaṃ somaṃ sunuta latātmakaṃ somamabhipuṇuta | tathā yamārthaṃ haviḥ juhuta | agnidūto yasmin yajñe so'yam agnidūtaḥ | agnidūtatvamanyatrānātam—' agni- rdevānāṃ dūta āsīt ' (tai. saṃ. 2. 5. 8. 5) iti | araṃkṛtaḥ bahubhirdravyairalaṃkārarūpairyuktaḥ tādṛśaḥ yajñaḥ yamaṃ ha yamameva gacchati ||

ya॒māya̭ ghṛ॒tava̭dvi॒rjuho̭ta pra ca tiṣṭhata | sa no̭ de॒veṣvā ya॒madī̭rghāyuḥ pra jī॒vasai̭ || 14 || ya॒māya̭ | ghṛ॒ta'va̭t | ha॒viḥ | ju॒ho॒ta | pra | ca | ti॒ṣṭhata | saḥ | naḥ | de॒veṣṷ | ā | ya॒mat | dī॒rgha'āyuḥ | pra | jī॒vasai̭ || 14 || he ṛtvijaḥ yūyaṃ yamāya ghṛtavat ājyena saṃyuktaṃ haviḥ puroḍāśādikaṃ juhota juhuta | pra tiṣṭhata ca yamaṃ yūyamupatiṣṭhadhvaṃ ca | deveṣu madhye saḥ yamo devaḥ pra jīvase prakṛṣṭajīvanārthaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ dīrghāyuḥ ā yamat prayacchatu ||

ya॒māya॒ madhṷmattama॒ṃ rājñe॒ havya̭ṃ jṷhotana | i॒daṃ nama̭ ṛ॒ṣibhya̭ḥ pū॒rvajḙbhyaḥ pū॒rvebhya̭ḥ pa॒dhikṛ̭dbhyaḥ || 15 || ya॒māya̭ | madhṷmat'tamam | rājñḙ | ha॒vyam | ju॒ho॒tana | i॒dam | nama̭: | ṛ॒ṣibhya̭ḥ | pū॒rva'jḙbhyaḥ | pū॒rvebhya̭ḥ | pa॒thi'kṛ̭dbhyaḥ || 15 || he ṛtvijaḥ yamāya rājñe madhumattamam atiśayena madhuraṃ havyaṃ puroḍāśādikaṃ haviḥ juhotana juhuta | pūrvebhyaḥ sṛṣṭādāvupajebhyaḥ ata eva pūrvebhyaḥ asmataḥ pūrvabhāvibhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ śobhanamārgakāribhyaḥ ṛṣibhyaḥ idaṃ pratyakṣaṃ yathā bhavati tathā namaḥ astu ||

trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḻvīrekamiddhahat | triṣṭugāyatatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhitā || 16 || trikadrukebhiḥ | patati | ṣaṭ | urvīḥ | ekam | it | bṛhat | triṣṭup | gāyatrī | chandāṃsi | sarvā | tā | yame | ā'hitā || 16 ||
tāścordhvaḥ śākhāntaramantraiḥ samāmnātāḥ—'ṣaṇmorvīrraha- saspāntu dyauśca pṛthivī cāpaścapadhayaścaiṃka ca sūtatā ca' iti |
vekamit ekameva vbṛhat mahat jagat yamaśca pratipālanīyaḥ prāpnoti |
kiṃca yāni triṣṭubagāyatryādīni vchandāṃsi santi vsarvā vtā sarvāṇi tāni cchandāṃsi vyame vāhitā āhitāni ṛtvigbhiḥ stutisvenāvasthitāni ||
atrānukramyate—'udīratāṃ ṣaṭnā śaṅkhaḥ pitryaṃ jagatyekādaśī' iti |
'yāmāyanāḥ pare pañca' (anu.) iti vacanādyamaputraḥ śaṅkhasya ṛṣiḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—'udīratāmavara utparāsa ityabhihutvā' (āśva. gṛ. 2. 4. 6) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pitaro'gniṣvāttā yama udīratāmavara utparāsaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirudīratāmavara utparāsaḥ' (ā. śrau. 5. 20) iti ||

udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ | asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste nau'vantu pitaro haveṣu || 1 || ut | īratām | avare | ut | parāsaḥ | ut | madhyamāḥ | pitaraḥ | somyāsaḥ | asum | ye | īyuḥ | avṛkāḥ | ṛta'jñāḥ | te | naḥ | avantu | pitaraḥ | haveṣu || 1 ||
yathāvidhaṃ śrauta karmānuṣṭhāya pitṛtvaṃ prāptā uttamāḥ |
etadevābhipretya 'ye abhidagdhā ye anagnidagdhāḥ' ityādimantraḥ samāmnātaḥ |
teṣu vavare nikṛṣṭāḥ vudīratām uttamaṃ haviḥ prāpnuvantu |
te sarve'pya- smadviṣaye vsomyāsaḥ somyā anugrahaparāḥ santu |
vavṛkāḥ vṛkavadaraṇyaśvavadasmāsu hiṃsāmakurvantaḥ vṛtajñāḥ asmadanuṣṭhitaṃ yajñaṃ jānantaḥ vasum asmatprāṇam vīyuḥ rakṣituṃ prāptāḥ |
vte vpitaraḥ vhaveṣu asmadīyeṣvāhvāneṣu vnaḥ asmān vavantu rakṣantu ||
mahāpitṛyajñe 'pitaro barhiṣadaḥ' ityasya 'idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ' iti dvitīyānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'āhaṃ pitṛnsuvidatrā~ avislīdaṃ pitṛbhyo namo asavadha svādupkilāyamiti catasraḥ' (āśva. śrau. 5. 20) iti ||
2. śa. brā. 1.5.1.22; ṛ. saṃ. 6,47.3 bhāṣya draṣṭavyam |
idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ|
ye pārthive rajasā nipattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu ||
idam | pitṛ'bhyaḥ | namaḥ | astu | adya | ye | pūrvāsaḥ | ye | uparāsaḥ | īyuḥ | ye | pārthive | rajasi | ā | ni'sattāḥ | ye | vā | nūnam | su'vṛjanāsu | vikṣu || 2 ||
^ye cānye ^uparāsaḥ yajamānajanmana upari utpannāḥ kaniṣṭhabhrātṛsvaputrādaya īyuḥ pitṛlokaṃ prāptāḥ |
^ye anyanye ^pārthive pṛthivīsambandhini ^rajasi rajoguṇakārye'smin karmaṇi ^ā ^nipattāḥ haviḥ svīkartumāgatā upaviṣṭāḥ |
^ye ^vā kecidanye bandhuvargarūpāḥ pitaraḥ ^vikṣu bandhurūpāmu prajāsu ā nipattāḥ śrāddhādisvīkārāyāgatā upaviṣṭāḥ |
atha anantaraṃ naḥ asmabhyaṃ śaṃ sukhaṃ yoḥ duḥkhaviyogam arapa: pāparahitaṃ ca dadhāta datta ||
mahāpitṛyajñe 'pitaraḥ somavantaḥ' ityasya yājyā 'upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ' ityeṣā |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsastvaṃ soma pra cikitī manīṣā' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti ||
ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān ||
upa'hūtāḥ | pitaraḥ | somyāsaḥ | barhiṣdeṣu | ni'dhiṣu | priyeṣu | te | ā | gamantu | te | iha | śruvantu | adhi | bruvantu | te | avantu | asmān || 5 ||

somyāsaḥ somyā asmadanugrahaparāḥ somasaṃpādino vā pitaraḥ barhiṣdeṣu yāgāhreṣu priyeṣu tṛptikareṣu nidhiṣu nidhisadṛśeṣu haviḥpu nimittabhūteṣu satsu upahūtāḥ asmābhirāhūtāḥ te pitaraḥ ā gamantu āgacchantu |
āgatya ca iha asmin karmaṇi asmābhiḥ prayuktāḥ stutīḥ śruvantu śṛṇvantu |
te tādṛśāḥ pitaraḥ asmān avantu rakṣantu ||
ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato nipadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve |
mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinmo yad āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma ||
ā'acya | jānu | dakṣiṇataḥ | nipadya | imam | yajñam | abhi | gṛṇīta | viśve | mā | hiṃsiṣṭa | pitaraḥ | kena | cit | naḥ | yat | vaḥ | āgaḥ | puruṣatā | karāma || 6 ||
pitṛṇāmayaṃ svābhāviko dharmaḥ 'aśainaṃ pitaraḥ prācīnāvītinaḥ sadhyaṃ jānvācya' (śa. brā. 2. 4. 2. 2) iti vacanāt |
he pitaraḥ viśve sarve yūyaṃ jānu ācya bhūmau nipāya dakṣiṇataḥ dakṣiṇapārśve nipadya upaviśya imam asmadīyaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta abhiṣṭuta |
viśiṣṭastutiyogāt parayā prītyā saguṇo'yaṃ yajña iti praśaṃstyetyarthaḥ |
api ca vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ yat kiṃcit karmavaiguṇya- janitam āgaḥ aparādhaṃ puruṣatā manuṣyatvena hetunā karāma kṛtavantaḥ he pitaraḥ tena kena cit apyaparādhena naḥ asmān mā hiṃsiṣṭa ||
āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya |
putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta iha ūrjaṃ dadhāta ||
āsīnāsaḥ | aruṇīnām | upa'sthe | rayim | dhatta | dāśuṣe | martyāya | putrebhyaḥ | pitaraḥ | tasya | vasvaḥ | pra | yacchata | te | iha | ūrjam | dadhāta || 7 ||
aruṇīnām ārohamānānāṃ jvālānāṃ vā devatānāṃ vā upasthe samīpasthāne vedyālaye āsīnāsaḥ upaviṣṭāḥ pitaro yūyaṃ dāśuṣe havirdattavate martyāya manuṣyāya yajamānāya rayiṃ
he pitara: yūyaṃ tasya yajamānasya putrebhya: vasva: vasu dhanaṃ pra yacchata |
te nādṛśā yūyam iha asmin asmadīye karmaṇi ūrjaṃ dhanaṃ dadhāta nidhatta ||
ye na: pūrvai pitara: somyāsau'nūhire saumapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhā: |
ye | na: | pūrvai | pitara: | somyāsa: | anu'ūhire | soma'pītham | vasiṣṭhā: | tebhi: | yama: | mam'rarāṇa: | havīṃṣi | uśana | uśat'bhi: | prati'kāmam | attu || 8 ||
vastutamā: kṛtācchādanā dhanavattamā vā vna: asmākaṃ vye vpūrvai pitara: vsomapīthaṃ somapānam vanūhire ānupūrvyeṇa devebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca prāpnuvantaḥ |

vuśan pitṛbhi: saha saṃbhogaṃ kāmayamāna: vyama: pitṛpati: vuśadbhi: yamena saha saṃbhogaṃ kāmayamānai: vtebhi: tairasmadīyai: pitṛbhi: saha vrarāṇa: ramamāṇa: vhavīṃṣi asmābhirdattāni vpratikāmaṃ kāmakāmaṃ prati vattu |
yāni yāni havīṃṣi kāmayate tāni tāni bhakṣayatvityartha: ||
mahāpitṛyajñe agne: kavyavāhanasya 'ye tātṛpu: ' ityeṣā prathamānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—' ye tātṛpu- devatrā jehamānāstvadagne kāvyā tvanmanīṣā: ' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 19 ) iti ||
ye tātṛpurdaivatrā jehamānā hotrāvida: stomataṣṭāso arkai: |
agne yāhi suvidatraibhirarvāṅ satyai: kuvyai: pitṛbhirgharmasadbhi: ||

ya | tṛpu: | deva'trā | jehamānā: | hotrā'vida: | stoma'taṣṭāsa: | stomānāṃ ca samyaktāra: | vye pitara: vtātṛpu: tṛpyanti he agne tvaṃ tai: vpitṛbhi: varvāṅ asmadabhimukha: vā vyāhi āgaccha | kīdṛśai: | vsuvidatraibhi: suvidatrai: vsatyai: avisaṃvādibhi: vkuvyai: | kavyaṃ nāma pitṛdevatyaṃ havi: | tatsaṃbandhibhi: | yadvā kavyai: kavibhirmedhāvibhi: | svārthiko yat | vgharmasadbhi: yajñasādabhi: ||
ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devai: sarathaṃ dadhānā: |
agne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandai: parai: pūrvai: pitṛbhirgharmasadbhi: ||
vye pitara: vhavirada: bhakṣaṇayogyasya haviṣo'ttāro bhakṣayitāra: vhaviṣpā: pānayogyasya haviṣa: pātāra: vindreṇa vdevai: vsarathaṃ samānamekaṃ tulyaṃ vā rathaṃ vdadhānā: |
gamanāya sadā dhārayanti he agne tai: vpitṛbhi: saha vā vyāhi āgaccha |
vdevavandai: devasaṃbandhibhi: stotrairyukta: vparai: parakālīnai: vpūrvai: pūrvakālīnai: vgharmasadbhi: yajñasādibhirmahāvīrasādibhirādityasādibhirvā ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata ye beha pitaro ye ca neha' (ādha. śrau. 2.19) iti ||

agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ | attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣpathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana || 11 || agni'svāttāḥ | pitaraḥ | ā | iha | gacchata | sadaḥ'sadaḥ | sadata | su'praṇītayaḥ | atta | havīṃṣi | pra'yatāni | barhiṣi | artha | rayim | sarva'vīram | dadhātana || 11 ||
'agniṣvāttāḥ' agninā svāditā etannāmakāḥ 'pitaraḥ' yūyam 'iha asmin pitṛkarmaṇi 'ā 'gacchata |
āgatya ca he 'supraṇītayaḥ abhijñapraṇītayaḥ yūyaṃ 'sadaḥsadaḥ tattatsthānaṃ 'sadata sīdata |
'atha anantaraṃ 'sarvavīraṃ sarvavīraiḥ putrapautrādirupetaṃ 'rayiṃ dhanaṃ 'dadhātana asmabhyaṃ datta ||
mahāpitṛyajñe vaṣaṭkārakriyāyāṃ 'tvamagna īḻitaḥ' ityeṣā sviṣṭakṛto yājyā|
sūtritaṃ ca— 'yo'gniḥ kavyavāhanatvamagna īḻito jātaveda iti saṃyājye' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti ||

tvamagna īḻito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni'surabhīṇi kṛtsvī | prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannadbhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi || 12 || tvam | agne | īḻitaḥ | jāta'vedaḥ | avāṭ | havyāni | surabhīṇi | kṛtsvī | pra | adāḥ | pitṛ'bhyaḥ | svadhayā | te | akṣan | adbhi | tvam | deva | pra'yatā | havīṃṣi || 12 ||
tathāvidha he agne 'īḻitaḥ asmābhiḥ stutaḥ 'tvaṃ 'havyāni asmadīyāni havīṃṣi 'surabhīṇi sugandhīni 'kṛtsvī kṛtvā 'avāṭ vahanaṃ kṛtavānasi |
'te ca pitaraḥ 'svadhayā svadhākāreṇa dattaṃ haviḥ 'akṣan adantu |

ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yāṃśca vidma yā~ u ca na pravidma | tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva || 13 || ye | ca | iha | pitaraḥ | ye | ca | na | iha | yān | ca | vidma | yān | u | ca | na | pra'vidma | tvam | vettha | yati | te | jāta'vedaḥ | svadhābhiḥ | yajñam | su'kṛtam | juṣasva || 13 ||
vye vca vpitara: viha asmatsamīpe vartante vye vca viha vna santi|
vyāṃśca pitṛn vvipra saṃnikṛṣṭvā jānīma: vyā~ vu vca vna api vca na vpravipra viprakṛṣṭatvādvayaṃ na vijānīma:|
vyati vte yāvantaste^3 bhavanti tān sarvān yathoktān he vjātaveda: utpannasarvavastuviṣayajñāne vtvaṃ vvettha jānāsi^4|
vsvadhābhi: havirlakṣaṇai: vsukṛtaṃ sādhu kṛtaṃ vyajñaṃ vjuvasva prītyā gṛhaṇa||
pūrvokta eva yāge 'ye agnidagdhā:' ityeṣā yājyā|
sūtritaṃ ca—'ye agnidagdhā ye anagni- dagdhā imaṃ yama prastaramā hi sīdeti dve' (āśva. śrau. 2. 19) iti||

ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye diva: svadhayā mādayante| tebhi: svarāḻasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayasva || 14 || ye | agnidagdhā: | ye | anagnidagdhā: | madhye | diva: | svadhayā | mādayante | tebhi: | svarāṭ | asunītim | etām | yathāvaśam | tanvam | kalpayasva || 14 ||

vye vca pitara: vanagnidagdhā: imaśānakarma na prāptā: vmadhye vdiva: dyulokasya madhye vsvadhayā havirlakṣaṇenānnena vmādayante tṛpyanti^5 he agne vsvarāṭ svakarmopabhogena dīpyamāna: vtebhi: tai: pitṛbhi: sahita: san vasunītiṃ prāṇānāṃ vipayeṣu netāramasmatpitṛntarātmānam vetāṃ vtanvam etaddevatāśarīraṃ vyathāvaśaṃ yathākāmaṃ vkalpayasva samarthayasva|
'menam' iti caturdaśarcaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ sūktaṃ yamaputrasya damanasyārṣam|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'menaṃ damana āgneyaṃ catuṣṭubhantam' iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—'menamagne vi daho mābhi śoca iti ṣaṭ pūpā havetaṛcāvayatu pra vidvān' (āśva. śrau. 6. 10) iti|

menamagne vi daho mābhi śoco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram| yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'thainaṃ pra hiṇutātpitṛbhya: || 1 || mā | enam | agne | vi | daha | mā | abhi | śoca: | mā | asya | tvacam | cikṣipa: | mā | śarīram | yadā | śṛtam | kṛṇava: | jātaveda: | atha | īm | enam | pra | hiṇutāt | pitṛbhya: || 1 ||
he vagne venaṃ pretaṃ vmā vvi vdaha:|
vmābhi vśoca: abhita: śokena saṃtāpena yuktaṃ mā kuru|
vasya vtvacaṃ vmā vcikṣipa: itastato vikṣiptāṃ mā^7 kuru|
he vjātaveda: agne vyadā vtvaṃ vśrutaṃ pakvaṃ sudagdhaṃ vkṛṇava: kariṣyasi vatha tadānīm vīmenaṃ pretaṃ vpitṛbhya: vpra vhiṇutāt pitṛsamīpe preraya||
śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'thainaṃ pari dattātṛpitṛbhya:|

1. ta-bha6-eṣāṃ; ta3-ma1.2.4-tāṃ| 2. udgītha-yānāpi| 3. ta-bha6-vāyaṃtaste| 4. ta-jānāmi| 5. ga-vṛne vṛthayaṃtu; ta-bha-tṛpyaṃtu| 6. ta-bha6-grāmāyetyartha:; udgītha-gāmayahavetyartha:| 7. tara2.3- 7-ma-'mā kuru' nāsti| 8. ga-bha-tvaṃ yadā|
śutam | yadā | kara̭si | jāta̭vedaḥ | artha | īm | enam | pari̭ | da॒ttāt | pi॒tṛ'bhyaḥ | yadā | ga̭cchati | asṷ'nītim | e॒tām | artha | de॒vānā̭m | vaśa̭'nīḥ | bha̭vāti || 2 ||
he jātavedaḥ yadā pretaśarīraṃ śrutaṃ pakaṃ karasi kariṣyasi atha īm tadānīmeva enaṃ pretaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ pari dattāt prayaccha |
yadā ayaṃ pretaḥ etām agninā kṛtām asunītiṃ prāṇasya nayanaṃ prāṇapreraṇaṃ gacchati prāpnoti atha tadānīmeva devānāṃ vaśanīḥ devānāṃ vaśaṃ prāpito bhavati ||
sūrya̭ṃ cakṣṷrgacchatu vāta̭mātmā dyāṃ ca̭ gaccha pṛthi॒vīṃ ca̭ dha॒rmaṇā̭ |
a॒po vā̭ gaccha yadi tatra̭ te hi॒tamoṣa̭dhīṣu prati̭ tiṣṭhā śarī॒raiḥ ||

sūrya̭m | cakṣṷḥ | ga̭cchatu | vāta̭m | ā॒tmā | dyām | ca̭ | ga̭ccha | pṛthi॒vīm | ca̭ | dha॒rmaṇā̭ | a॒paḥ | vā̭ | ga̭ccha | yadi̭ | tatra̭ | te | hi॒tam | oṣa̭dhīṣu | prati̭ | tiṣṭha | śarī॒raiḥ || 3 ||
he preta tvadīyaṃ cakṣuḥ indriyaṃ sūrya gacchatu prāpnutu |
ātmā prāṇaḥ vātaṃ bāhyaṃ vāyuṃ gacchatu |
api ca tvamapi dharmaṇā sukṛtena tatphalaṃ bhoktuṃ dyāṃ ca |
dyulokaṃ vā pṛthivīṃ ca pṛthivīṃ vā gaccha prāpnuhi |
tatra antarikṣe hitaṃ sthāpitaṃ te tava karmaphalam |
ajo bhāga̭stapa̭sā taṃ tapa̭sva taṃ tḙ śoci̭stapatu taṃ tḙ a॒rciḥ |

ajaḥ | bhāga̭ḥ | tapa̭sā | tam | tapa̭sva | tam | tḙ | śoci̭ḥ | tapa̭tu | tam | tḙ | a॒rciḥ | yāḥ | tḙ | śi॒vāḥ | ta॒nvaḥ | jāta̭vedaḥ | tābhi̭ḥ | vaha̭ | enam | su॒kṛtā̭m | ū~ iti̭ | lo॒kam || 4 ||
ajaḥ jananarahitaḥ śarīrendriyādibhāgavyatirikta'ntarapuruṣalakṣaṇo yaḥ bhāgaḥ asti he agne te tvadīyena tapasā tāpanena taṃ tādṛśaṃ bhāgaṃ tapasva taptaṃ kuru |
tathā te tatra śociḥ śokahetuḥ jvālāviśeṣaḥ taṃ bhāgaṃ tapatu saṃskarotu |
api ca te tava arciḥ bhāsako jvālāviśeṣaḥ taṃ bhāgaṃ tapatu saṃskarotu |
he jātavedaḥ te tava yāḥ tanvaḥ mūrtayaḥ śivāḥ sukhahetavaḥ na tu tāpapradāḥ tābhiḥ enaṃ tanvābhiḥ pretaṃ sukṛtāṃ śobhanakarmakāriṇāṃ lokaṃ sthānaṃ vaha prāpaya |
arva̭ sṛja puna̭ragne pi॒tṛbhyo॒ yasta ā̭hu॒taśca̭rati sva॒dhābhi̭ḥ |
ā॒yurva̭sāna॒ upa̭ vetu॒ śeṣa̭ḥ saṃ ga̭cchatāṃ ta॒nvā jāta̭vedaḥ ||
arva̭ | sṛja | puna̭ḥ | agnḙ | pi॒tṛ'bhya̭ḥ | yaḥ | tḙ | ā॒'huta̭ḥ | ca॒rati̭ | sva॒dhābhi̭ḥ | ā॒yuḥ | va॒sāna̭ḥ | upa̭ | vetu॒ | śeṣa̭ḥ | sam | ga̭cchatām | ta॒nvā | jāta̭vedaḥ || 5 ||

1. ga-ta-bha6.7-gacchati; bha1.2 4-gacchati; su-gacchati gacchati | 2. su-bhavati | 3. ta-bha6-prāpnuhi yāhi | 4. ta-bha-tapanaṃ | 5. ta4-śokahetutvāt ; ta5.6.7-śokahetu | 6. ta-’api ca ... ... saṃskarotu ’ nāsti |
he 'gne 'tha: pretaḥ pumān 'āhutaḥ citau mantreṇa samarpitaḥ san 'svadhābhiḥ svadhākārasamarpitaiḥ udakādibhiḥ saha 'carati taṃ pretaṃ 'pitṛbhyaḥ pitṛprāptyarthaṃ 'punaḥ 'ava 'sṛja bhūyaḥ preraya |

^imaṃ paridṛśyamānaṃ ^yoniṃ sthānabhūtaṃ lokaṃ ^ca ^yaśca asmāt ^pūrvaḥ asti tam ^anu gatavān|

^samānaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ ^yoniṃ dyāvāpṛthivī lakṣaṇaṃ sthānam ^anu ^saṃcarantaṃ samyagacchantaṃ ^drapsaṃ somarasaṃ vimuḍḍhalakṣaṇaṃ ^sapta ^hotrāḥ saptasaṃkhyākā vimuḍḍhomasasya kartāro hotṛprabhṛtayo vayam ^anu ānupūrvyeṇa ^juhomi juhumaḥ|

samyakcarantaṃ taṃ drapsamādityamuddiśya sapta hotrāḥ saptasaṃkhyākā diśaḥ|
yasyāṃ diśi sūryo vartate tadyatiriktāḥ saptasaṃkhyākā diśaḥ|
yatra yatra vartate tāṃ tāṃ diśaṃ dravyatvena prayacchāmi|

atra vājasaneyakam—' asau vā ādityo drapsaḥ ya divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca skandatīmaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaṃ itīmaṃ ca lokamamuṃ ceyatat samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantamiti samānaṃ hyeṣa etaṃ yonimanu saṃcarati' drapsaṃ juhomanu sapta hotrā ityasau vā ādityo drapso diśaḥ sapta hotrā amuṃ tadādityaṃ dikṣu pratiṣṭhāpayati' (śa. brā. 7. 4. 1. 20) iti||

āgatya ca he ‘revatīḥ revatyo dhanavatyo yūyam ‘asmān ‘sipakta sacayata|

ihaivāgne ni dhārayeha tiṣṭhatu yā rayiḥ||

tathā cānukrāntaṃ- ‘sasottaraṇyaindro vigadaḥ prājāpatyo vā vāsukro vasukradā bhadraṃ daśameyaṃ tu gāyatramādyaikapadā pāda eva vā śāntyarthaḥ parānuṣṭubantye virāṭtriṣṭubhau’ iti|

agnimīḻe bhujāṃ yaviṣṭhaṃ śāsā mitraṃ durdharītum | yasya dharmantsvarenīḥ saparyanti mātūradhaḥ || 2 || agnim | īḻe | bhujāṃ | yaviṣṭham | śāsā | mitram | duḥ'dharītum | yasya | dharman | svaḥ | enīḥ | saparyanti | mātuḥ | ūdhaḥ || 2 || ॰bhujāṃ havirbhujāṃ devānāṃ madhye ॰yaviṣṭham ahaṇyahanyagnihotrādikamarthaṃ jāyamānatvādatiśayena yuvānaṃ ॰śāsā anuśāsanena ॰mitram | yasmādidaṃ kartavyamidaṃ na kartavyamiti sarvamanuśāsti tasmātsarvasya mitrabhūtamītyarthaḥ | ॰durdharītuṃ durdharaṇīyaṃ saṃgrāme śatrubhirnirvāraṇīyamevaṃbhūtam ॰agnim ॰īḻe staumi | api ca ॰yasya agneḥ ॰dharman dharmaṇyagnihotrādike karmaṇi ॰svaḥ dyulokādityaṃ sarvaṃ devajātaṃ vā ॰enīḥ eṇyaḥ pratigandhya āhutayaḥ stutayaśca ॰saparyanti paricaranti sevante | yadvā | svaḥ saparyantīyanayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam | atra svaśabdo nipātaḥ | svaḥ sarve devāḥ enīrātmanaḥ pratigantrīrāhutīḥ stutīśca saparyanti sevante | upajīvantītyarthaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | lusopama- metat | ॰mātuḥ goḥ ॰ūdhaḥ kṣīropasaṃhārasthānaṃ prati yathā vatsā upajīvanti tadvat | tamamimīla iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||

yamāsā kṛpanīḻaṃ bhāsāketuṃ vardhayanti | bhrājate śreṇidan || 3 || yam | āmā | kṛpa'nīḻam | bhāsā'ketum | vardhayanti | bhrājate | śreṇidan || 3 || stotāro yaṣṭāraśca ॰āsā stutihavirlakṣaṇenopāsanena ॰yam agniṃ ॰vardhayanti | kīdṛśam | ॰kṛpanīḻaṃ karmasthānam | karmadvāramityarthaḥ | ॰bhāmāketuṃ jvālālakṣaṇajñāpakaṃ dīpteḥ kartāraṃ vā | yacchabdaścaśrutestacchabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | so'gniḥ ॰śreṇidan stotṛbhyo yaṣṭṛbhyo'bhīṣṭaphalasamūhapradaḥ śatrubhyo jvālāpaṅktiprado vā evaṃbhūtaḥ san ॰bhrājate bhāsate ||

aryo viśāṃ gātuṃreti pra yadānaṭ divo antān | kavirbhraṃ dīrghāṃḥ || 4 || aryaḥ | viśām | gātum | eti | pra | yat | ānaṭ | divaḥ | antān | kaviḥ | abhram | dīrghāṃḥ || 4 || ॰viśāṃ yajamānamanuṣyāṇām ॰aryaḥ gantavyaḥ ॰gātuḥ gamanaśīlo'gniḥ ॰dīrghānaḥ dīpyamānaḥ ॰yat yadā ॰eti ūrdhvaṃ gacchati tadā ॰divaḥ dyulokasya ॰antān paryantān ॰kaviḥ medhāvī so'gniḥ ॰pra ॰ānaṭ prakarṣeṇa vyāpnoti | ॰abhraṃ meghopalakṣitamantarikṣaṃ ca vyāpnoti ||
juṣad‌dhavyā mānuṣyordhvastasthāvabhrā yajñe | minvansarvaṃ pura eti || 5 || juṣat | havyā | mānuṣasya | ūrdhvaḥ | tasthau | ṛdhvā | yajñe | minvan | sarvam | puraḥ | eti ||5||
mānuṣasya yajamānasya yajñe yajanīye yāge havyā havyāni havīṃṣi juṣat sevamāno'gniḥ ṛdhvā urubhūto bahujvālopetaḥ ūrdhvastasthau uttiṣṭhati |
api cāyamagniḥ prāgvaṃśādārabhya sanna sadanaṃ saumikīṃ vediṃ minvan paricchandan puraḥ purastāduttaravediśālā- mukhīyāt praṇīyamānaḥ san eti gacchati ||
sa hi kṣemo haviryajñaḥ śruṣṭīdasya gāturiti | agni devā vāśīmantam || 6 || saḥ | hi | kṣemaḥ | haviḥ | yajñaḥ | śruṣṭī | ita | asya | gātuḥ | eti | agnim | devāḥ | vāśī'mantam || 6 ||
haviḥ puroḍāśādikaṃ ca sa eva havipastannimittatvāt |
yajñaḥ yāgo'pi sa eva tasyāpi taddhetutvāt |
kiṃca śruṣṭīn kṣiprameva asya agneḥ gātuḥ gamanaśīlo'dhiṣṭhātrātmā eti devānāmāhvānārthaṃ gacchati |
gatvā ca pratyāgacchannaṃ vāśīmantaṃ stutilakṣaṇayā vācopetam agni prati devāḥ api gacchantīti śeṣaḥ ||
yajñāsāhaṃ durva iṣe'gniṃ pūrvasya śevasya | adraiḥ sunumāyumāhuḥ || 7 || yajña'sāham | durvaḥ | iṣe | agnim | pūrvasya | śevasya | adraiḥ | sunum | āyum | āhuḥ ||7||
āyuṃ devānāmāhvānārtha dūtyena gantāraṃ yam agnim adreḥ sūnumam aṣmanaḥ putram āhuḥ |
naro ye ke cāsmadā viśvette grāma ā syuḥ | agniṃ haviṣā vardhantaḥ || 8 || naraḥ | ye | ke | ca | asmat | ā | viśvāḥ | ita | ne | vāme | ā | syuḥ | iti syuḥ | agnim | haviṣā | vardhantaḥ || 8 ||
naraḥ netāraḥ ye ke ca ye kecit putrapautrādayaḥ asmat asmākaṃ santi |
te putrapautrādayaḥ vāme vananīye saṃbhajanīye viśvet viśvasminneva paścādidhane ā syuḥ ā samantādbhaveyuḥ |
agnim añjanādiguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ devaṃ haviṣā puroḍāśādikena vardhantaḥ vardhayantaḥ ||
kṛṣṇaḥ śveto'ruṣo yāmau asya bhruja ṛja uta śoṇo yaśasvīvān |
kṛṣṇaḥ | śvetaḥ | aruṣaḥ | yāmaḥ | asya | bradhnaḥ | ṛjaḥ | uta | śorṇaḥ | yaśasvān | hiraṇya'rūpam | janitā | jajāna || 9 ||
yāti gacchatyasminniti yāmo rathaḥ prajāpatinā nirmitaḥ |
ᵥkṛṣṇaḥ asitavarṇaḥ ᵥśvetaḥ sitavarṇaḥ ᵥaruṣaḥ ārocamānaḥ ᵥbradhnaḥ mahān ᵥṛjaḥ ṛjugāmī ᵥuta api ca ᵥśorṇaḥ raktavarṇaḥ ᵥyaśasvān kīrtimān |
ᵥhiraṇyarūpaṃ suvarṇasadṛśaṃ taṃ ratham ᵥasya agnerathāya ᵥjanitā sarvasya jagato janayitā prajāpatiḥ ᵥjajāna janayāmāsa |
kathamekasyaiva rathasya kṛṣṇādi- nānārūpatvaṃ saṃbhavatīti cet agneḥ sāmarthyātiśayena saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ |
hiraṇyarūpamiti ratha- vācinā śabdena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyāt kṛṣṇādiśabdā dvitīyāntatvena yojyāḥ |
evā tai agne vimṛdo manīṣājau napādṛmṛtebhiḥ sajoṣaḥ |
gira ā vakṣatsumatīririyāna iṣamūrja sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||
eva | te | agne | vi'madaḥ | manīṣām | ūrjam | napāt | amṛtebhiḥ | sa'joṣaḥ | giraḥ | ā | vakṣat | su'matīḥ | iyānaḥ | iṣam | ūrjam | su'kṣitim | viśvam | ā | ābhaḥ | || 10 ||

evamuktaprakāreṇa he ᵥūrjau ᵥnapāt āprivanaspatitṛpitṛbhūtasyāgnesya pautra he ᵥagne ᵥamṛtebhiḥ amṛterhavirlakṣaṇairannaiḥ ᵥsajoṣaḥ saṃgataḥ ᵥvimadaḥ nāmarṣiḥ ᵥmanīṣāṃ prakṛṣṭāṃ buddhiṃ kāmayamānaḥ san ᵥte tubhyaṃ ᵥgiraḥ stutilakṣaṇā vācaḥ ᵥā ᵥvakṣat ābhimukhyenoktavān |
tatastvametajjñātvā ᵥsumatīririyānaḥ śobhanalakṣaṇā buddhīḥ 1 saṃgamayan ᵥiṣam annam ᵥūrjaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ rasaṃ ca ᵥsukṣitiṃ śobhananivāsam |
śobhanaputrapautrādikaṃ yatkiṃcit deyamasti tat ᵥviśvaṃ dhanaṃ ca ᵥābhāḥ tasmai vimadāyāhara dehi ||
ādyau gāyatrau pādau tato dvau jāgatau sāstārapaṅktiḥ |
pṛṣṭhasya caturthe'hani ‘āgniṃ na svavaktibhirityājyam ’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 11) iti |
mahāvrata ābhimārute yāvatīścvidvicchanda sāma stuvīran tadānīmādistatāvatya ṛco'nurupāthāḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yadīcchandaṃ bhūyasīṣu cet stuvīrannāgniṃ na svavaktibhiriti tāvatīranupaḥ ’ (ai. ā. 5. 3. 2) iti ||
yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase ||
ā | agnim | na | saṃvakti'bhiḥ | hotāram | tvā | vṛṇīmahe | yajñāya | stīrṇa'barhiṣe | vi | vaḥ | made | śīram | pāvaka'śociṣam | vivakṣase || 1 ||
1. ta1.2-buddhīḥ stāgamanay; ta3-buddhīstagamana; ta5-buddhīḥ stāgamanay; ta7-buddhīḥ tā-gamanay; bha1.2.4.7-buddhīstāḥ gamayan; bha6-buddhiḥ agamayat |
he agne ॰ta:1 tava svabhūte ॰vimade etadākhya ṛṣau mayīyaṃ stuti: pravṛttāsti |
ato vayamidānīṃ ॰svavṛttibhi: svayaṃkrutābhirdoṣavarjitābhi: stutibhi: ॰hotāraṃ devānāmāhvātāraṃ homaniṣpādakaṃ vā ॰agni ॰tvā tvām ॰ā ॰vṛṇīmahe ābhimukhyena saṃbhajāmahe |
vimade yajñasya saṃbandhin: somasya pānajanyanirvivamadārthaṃ tvāmāvṛṇīmaha iti yojyam ||
tvāsu te svābhuva: śubhantaścarādhasa: | veti tvāmupasercanī vi vo mada ṛjītiragna āhutirvivakṣase || 2 ||
tvām | oṃ iti | te | muḍaābhuva: | śubhanti | aśvaḍadhasa: | veti | tvām | upaḍasercanī | vi | va: | made | ṛjīti: | agne | ā'huti: | vivakṣase ||2||
॰svābhuva: svaprakāśena dīpyamānā: ॰aśvarādhasa: vyāptadhanā: ॰te yajamānā: he agne ॰tvāsu tvāmeva ॰śubhanti śobhayanti |
kiṃca ॰upasercanī tavopari kṣaraṇaśīlā ॰ṛjīti: ṛjugāminī hyamānā ॰āhuti: he agne tvāṃ ॰veti gacchati |
kṛṣṇā rūpāṇyarjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhipe virvakṣase |
tve | dharmārṇa: | āmate | juhūbhi: | siñcatī:'iva | kṛṣṇā | rūpāṇi | arjunā | vi | va: | made | viśvā | adhi | śriya: | dhipe | virvakṣase ||3||
॰dharmārṇa: yajñasya dhārayitāra ṛtvija: ॰juhūbhi: saṃpūrṇāhutibhirhomapātrai: ॰tve tvāmeva ॰āsate upāsate sevante |
vṛṣṭilakṣaṇā: pṛthivīṃ siñcantya ॰āpo'bhi ॰yathā svapitṛtvena sevante tadvat |
juhūbhi: siñcatīriva sicyamānā āhutaya iva dharmārṇastvayā dhāryamāṇā raśmayastve tvayyāste niyasanti |
he agne tvaṃ ॰kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇavarṇāni ॰arjunā arjunāni śvetavarṇāni jvālāntargatarūpāṇi ca ॰viśvā: sarvā: ॰śriya: śobhā: ॰adhi ॰dhipe adhikaṃ yathā bhavanti tathā dhārayasi |
tamā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citramā bharā virvakṣase |
yam | agne | manyase | rayim | sahasā'van | amartya | tam | ā | na: | vāja'sātaye | vi | va: | made | yajñeṣu | citram | ā | bhara | virvakṣase || 4 ||
1. ta-va: ' nāsti | 2. ta1.2.4.5-vivakṣate | 3. ta-ahajñāmaitat | 4. ta-bha-dīptadhanā: | 5. ta-siṃcati | 6. ta3.4.5-bha1.2-āpa: ammān; ta1.2.6.7-āpa vṛṣṭyudakaṃ pṛthivīṃ amrīn; bhava-āpa iva ammān |

he ᵥamartya amaraṇadharman ᵥsahasāvan balavan evaṃbhūta he ᵥagne tvaṃ ᵥyaṃ ᵥrathi ᵥmanyase sarveṣu dhaneṣu yaddhanaṃ variṣṭhamiti jānāsi ᵥcitraṃ cāyanīyaṃ ᵥtaṃ ᵥrathiṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥvājasātaye annalābhāya ᵥā ᵥbhara āhara prayaccha |
ᵥvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ ᵥyajñeṣu ᵥvimade vividhasomādi- havirjanyamadanimitte |
bhuvaddhūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase ||
agniḥ | jātaḥ | artharvaṇā | vidat | viśvāni | kāvyā | bhuvat | dūtaḥ | vivasvataḥ | vi | vaḥ | made | priyaḥ | yamasya | kāmyaḥ | vivakṣase || 5 ||
ᵥviśvāni samastāni ᵥkāvyā kāvyāni stotrakarmāṇi ᵥvidat vetti |
ᵥvivasvataḥ yajamānasya ᵥdūtaḥ devānāmāhvānārthaṃ ᵥbhuvat bhavati |
kiṃca ᵥyamasya saṃyanturyajamānasya ᵥpriyaḥ iṣṭaḥ san ᵥkāmyaḥ kamanīyaḥ prārthanīyo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
tvaṃ vasṷ̄ni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase ||
tvām | yajñeṣu | īḻate | agne | pra | adhvare | tvam | vasṷ̄ni | kāmyā | vi | vaḥ | made | viśvā | dadhāsi | dāśuṣe | vivakṣase || 6 ||
he ᵥagne ᵥtvāṃ ᵥprayati prakarṣeṇa gacchanti pravartamāne ᵥadhvare yāge ᵥyajñeṣu yajñanīyeṣu haviḥ- pvāsaneṣu satsu ᵥīḻate ṛtvijyajamānāḥ stuvanti |
api ca he agne ᵥtvaṃ ᵥviśvā viśvāni ᵥkāmyā kāmyāni kamanīyāni ᵥvasṷ̄ni dhanāni ᵥdāśuṣe havirdattavate yajamānāya ᵥvimade somādihavirjanya- tṛptau satyāṃ ᵥdadhāsi prayacchasi |
ataḥ kāraṇāt ᵥvivakṣase ᵥtvaṃ mahān bhavasi ||
ghṛtapratīkaṃ manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭhamakṣabhirvivakṣase ||
tvām | yajñeṣu | ṛtvijam | cārum | agne | ni | sedire | ghṛta'pratīkam | manuṣaḥ | vi | vaḥ | made | śukram | cetiṣṭham | akṣabhiḥ | vivakṣase || 7 ||
he ᵥagne ᵥtvāṃ manuṣyā yajamānāḥ ᵥyajñeṣu yāgeṣu ᵥni ᵥpedire niyamena sthāpayanti |
ᵥṛtvijaṃ hotṛnāmakaṃ ᵥcāruṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ᵥghṛtapratīkam ājyāhutipūrṇamukhaṃ ᵥśukraṃ jvalantam ᵥakṣabhiḥ vyāptaistejobhiḥ ᵥcetiṣṭham atiśayena jñātāram |
ᵥvi ᵥvo ᵥmade tava somādi- havirjanyavividhatṛptyartham |
abhikrandanvapāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase ||
agne | śukena | śociṣā | uru | prathayase | bṛhat | abhi'krandan | vṛṣa'yase | vi | vaḥ | made | garbham | dadhāsi | jāmiṣu | vivakṣase || 8 ||
he agne bṛhat mahāsvaṃ śukena dīsena śociṣā tejasā uru prathayase vistīrṇaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pratyāto bhavasi |
kiṃca abhikrandan ābhimukhyena yuddhārthaṃ śatrūnāhvayan vṛpāyase vṛpa ivācarasi |
tvaṃ mādhyamikaḥ san jāmiṣu bhaginībhūtāsvoṣadhīṣu garbhaṃ bījalakṣaṇaṃ dadhāsi vṛṣṭadvāreṇa dhārayasi |
vi vo made tava vividhasomādihavirjanyamade saṃjāte sati |
yasmādevaṃ kṛtavānasi tasmāt tvaṃ vivakṣase mahān bhavasi |
vivakṣasa iti mahannāma vaktervā vahatervā sanantasya rūpamiti ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ— 'kuha pañcanā purastādvāhataṃ triṣṭubantaṃ tvaṃ syā cidā nastvaṃ no'nuṣṭubhaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'kuha śruta indro yuṣmasya ta iti niṣkevalyam' ( āśva. śrau. 7. 11 ) iti ||
kuha śruta indraḥ kasminnadya jane mitro na śrūyate |
ṛṣīṇāṃ vā yaḥ kṣaye guhā vā carkṛṣe girā ||
kuha | śrutaḥ | indraḥ | kasmin | adya | jane | mitraḥ | na | śrūyate | ṛṣīṇām | vā | yaḥ | kṣaye | guhā | vā | carkṛṣe | girā || 1 ||
adya asmin dine indraḥ kuha kutra sthāne śrutaḥ viśrutaḥ prakhyātaḥ |
kasmin jane yajamāna ijyatvena stutyatvenāvasthitaḥ śrūyate prakhyāyate |
mitro na sūrya iva sakheva vā tadvat |
yaḥ indraḥ ṛṣīṇāṃ bhṛgvādīnāṃ kṣaye nivāsa āśrame guhā vā guhāyāmarakhye vā girā stutilakṣaṇayā vācā carkṛṣe atyarthamākṛṣyate |
sa indraḥ kuha śruta iti pūrveṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||
iha śruta indro asme adya stavai vajryacīṣamaḥ |
mitro na yo janeṣvā yaśaścakre asāmyā ||
iha | śrutaḥ | indraḥ | asme | adya | stavai | vajrī | ṛcīṣamaḥ | mitraḥ | na | yaḥ | janeṣu | ā | yaśaḥ | cakre | asāmyā || 2 ||
iha asmin yajñe indraḥ śrutaḥ prakhyātaḥ |
adya asmindavase asme asmābhiḥ stave stūyate |
yadvāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīstasyuḥ na tvā
vajrin' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 70. 5) ityādikayā stutyā samānaguṇa ityarthaḥ |
'yaḥ indraḥ 'mitro 'na sūryaṃ iva snigdha iva vā 'janeṣu stotṛjaneṣu 'yaśaḥ annaṃ kīrtiṃ vā 'cakre karoti |
sa indro'smābhiḥ stūyata iti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ ||
maho yaspatiḥ śarvaso asāmyā maho numṇasya tūtujiḥ |
bhartā vajrasya dhṛṣṇoḥ pitā putramiva priyam ||
mahaḥ | yaḥ | patiḥ | śarvasaḥ | asāmi | ā | mahaḥ | numṇasya | tūtujiḥ | bhartā | vajrasya | dhṛṣṇoḥ | pitā | putram'iva | priyam || 3 ||
kiṃca 'dhṛṣṇoḥ śatrūṇāṃ dharṣakasya 'vajrasya svakīyasyāyudhasya 'bhartā ya indro dhārayitā |
yujāno aśvā vātasya dhunīṃ devo devasya vajrivaḥ |
yujānaḥ | aśvā | vātasya | dhunīṃ iti | devaḥ | devasya | vajrivaḥ | syantāṃ | prathā | virukmatā | sṛjānaḥ | stoṣya | adhvanaḥ || 4 ||
tvaṃ tyā cidvātasyāśvāgā ṛñjā tmanā vahadhyai |
tvam | tyā | cit | vātasya | aśvā | ā | agāḥ | ṛñjā | tmanā | vahadhyai | yayauḥ | devaḥ | na | matyaḥ | yantā | narkiḥ | vidāvyaḥ || 5 ||
'yayauḥ tvadīyayoḥ 'yantā niyantā nivārayitā 'devo 'na devānāṃ madhye kaścidapi devo nāsti 'matyaḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ madhye kaścidapi nāsti 'nakiḥ na kaścidapi 'vidāvyaḥ vettā |
he indra 'tvaṃ 'vātasya vāyorbalena javena ca yuktau 'ṛñjā ṛjugāminau 'tyā cit tāvapi 'aśvā tvadīyāvaśvau 'tmanā ātmanaiva |

adhu gmantornā pṛcchate vāṃ kadarthā nu ā gṛham | ā jagmathuḥ parākādivaśca gmaśca martyam || 6 || adha | gmantā | uśanā | pṛcchate | vām | kat'arthā | nu | ā | gṛham | ā | jagmathuḥ | parākāt | divaḥ | ca | gmaḥ | ca | martyam || 6 ||
vatha atha yajñasamāpyanantaram vuśanā bhārgava ṛṣiḥ he indrāgnī vgmantā svasthānaṃ prati gacchantau vvāṃ yuvāṃ vpṛcchate pṛcchati sma |
uśanasamindrasya sakhibhūtaṃ bhārgavamindraṃ ca yuvāṃ sarvo yajamānaḥ pṛcchati |
yuvāṃ vkadarthā kadaryau kiṃyojanavantau santo vnaḥ asmadīyam |
vdivaśca dyulokācca vgmaśca bhūlokācca vmartya manuṣyaṃ māṃ pratyāgatavantau |

ā ne indra pṛkṣase'smākaṃ brahmadyatam | tatvā yācā mahe'vaḥ śuṣṇaṃ yaddhanamānuṣam || 7 || ā | naḥ | indra | pṛkṣase | asmākam | brahma | ut'dyatam | tat | tvā | yācā mahe | avaḥ | śuṣṇam | yat | han | armānuṣam || 7 ||
kiṃca vayamapi vtvā evaṃbhūtaṃ tvāṃ vtat |
tattādṛśamannam vavaḥ tadrakṣaṇaṃ ca vyācāmahe prārthayāmahe |
tathā vyat vśuṣṇaṃ balam vamānuṣaṃ manuṣyādanyaṃ rākṣasādikaṃ vhan hanti tadutkṛṣṭaṃ balaṃ ca yācāmahe |
he indra tvaṃ śuṣṇametannāmānamanuṣyaṃ manuṣyavyatiriktamanasuraṃ han hatavānasi |
hatvā ca yajñena rakṣaṇena trailokyaṃ pālitavānasi tadavaḥ pālanamasmākamapi bhavediti tvāṃ yācāmaha iti vākyārthaḥ ||

akarmā dasyurābhi nau amanturanyavrato armānuṣaḥ | tvaṃ tasyāmitrahan vardhārdasasya dambhaya || 8 || akarmā | dasyuḥ | abhi | naḥ | amantuḥ | anya'vrataḥ | armānuṣaḥ | tvam | tasya | amitra'han | vardhaḥ | dāsasya | dambhaya || 8 ||
vakarmā avidyamānayāgādikarmā vdasyuḥ upakṣapayitā vabhi ābhimukhyena svarūpataḥ vnaḥ asmān vamantuḥ ajñātā |
ya2 evaṃbhūto'sti he vamitrahan śatrūṇāṃ hantārindra vtvaṃ vdāsasya upakṣapayitavyasya vvadhaḥ hantā san vdambhaya taṃ śatruṃ hindhi ||

tvaṃ na indra śūra śūrairuta tvotāso barhaṇā | purutrā te vi pūrtayo narvanta kṣoṇayo yathā || 9 || tvam | naḥ | indra | śūra | śūraiḥ | uta | tvā'ūtāsaḥ | barhaṇā | puru'trā | te | vi | pūrtayaḥ | narvanta | kṣoṇayaḥ | yathā || 9 ||
he śūra vikrānta indra tvaṃ śūraiḥ bhaṭaiḥ marudbhiḥ sahitaḥ san naḥ asmān pāhi iti śeṣaḥ |
uta api ca tvotāsaḥ tvayā rakṣitā vayaṃ barhaṇā parivarhaṇāyāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsāyāṃ samarthā bhavema |
kiṃca te tvadīyāḥ pūrtayaḥ kāmānāṃ pūraṇānīpsitārthapradānāni purutrā bahūn stotṛn vi narvanta vividhaṃ vyāpnuvanti |
manuṣyāḥ svakīyaṃ svāminaṃ sevārthaṃ yathā vyāpnuvanti tadvat ||
tvaṃ tān vṛtrahatye codaya nṝn kārpāṇe śūra vajrivaḥ |
he <sup>v</sup>śūra vikrānta <sup>v</sup>indra <sup>v</sup>asme asmākaṃ svabhūtā: <sup>v</sup>vasvī: mahatya: <sup>v</sup>abhiṣṭaya: ābhi- mukhyeṇa ijyā:|
kiṃ tarhi he <sup>v</sup>vajriva: vajrindra <sup>v</sup>te tava prasādāt <sup>v</sup>vayaṃ vayam <sup>v</sup>rivyaja- mānā:|
<sup>v</sup>āsām ijyānāmicchānāṃ vā saṃbandhini <sup>v</sup>sudhe sukhe avasthitā: <sup>v</sup>syāma bhavema|
vayamabhiṣṭajanyena dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasukhena yuktā: śīghraṃ bhavemetyāśāsmahe ityartha:||
asme tā te indra santu satyāhisantīrupaspṛśa: |
vidhāma yāsāṃ bhujau dhenāṃ na vajriva: ||
asme iti| tā| te| indra| santu| satyā| ahisantī:| upa'spṛśa:| vidhāma| yāsām| bhuja:| dhenām| na| vajriva: || 13 ||
tā satyā ityubhayatra prathamābahuvacanasya chāndasa ākāra: sanviti nirdeśaviśeṣaṇatvāt|
he <sup>v</sup>vajriva: indra <sup>v</sup>yāsāṃ stutīnāṃ saṃbandhin: <sup>v</sup>bhuja: dṛṣṭādṛṣṭān bhogān <sup>v</sup>vidhāma vayaṃ labhemahi|
gavāṃ kṣīrādibhogān yathā gosvāmī labhate tadvat|
ahastā| yat| apadī| vardhata| kṣā:| śacībhi:| vedyānām| śuṣṇam| pari| pra'dakṣiṇit| viśva'āyave| ni| śiśnatha: || 14 ||
he indra <sup>v</sup>yat yadā <sup>v</sup>kṣā: bhūmi: <sup>v</sup>ahastā pāṇirahitā <sup>v</sup>apadī caraṇavarjitā ca|
<sup>v</sup>vedyānāṃ stotrayogyānāṃ svaprabhṛtīnāṃ devānāṃ saṃbandhibhi: <sup>v</sup>śacībhi: karmabhi: <sup>v</sup>vardhata avadhata|
tadā tvaṃ <sup>v</sup>pari <sup>v</sup>pradakṣiṇit evaṃbhūtāṃ pṛthivīṃ pariveṣṭya pradakṣiṇa yathā bhavati tathā sthitaṃ <sup>v</sup>śuṣṇam asuraṃ <sup>v</sup>viśvāyave|

yadā śuṣṇasyā- cchādanārthaṃ hastapādavarjinā kācitpṛthivī veditavyānāmasurāṇāṃ māyārūpai: karmabhi: <sup>v</sup>śuṣṇamasuraṃ pariveṣṭya pradakṣiṇa yathā bhavati tathāvasthitāvardhata tadānīṃ tāṃ māyotpāditāṃ pṛthivīṃ viśvāyave<sup>2</sup> sarvavyāpakasya marudraṇasya praveśanāyarthaṃ ni śiśnatha:||
pibāpibedindra śūra somaṃ mā riṇyayo vasavān vaṃsu: san |
uta trāyasva gṛṇato maghono mahaśca rāyo revataskṛdhi na: ||
piba'piba| it| indra| śūra| somam| mā| riṇya:| vasavān| vasu:| san| uta| trāyasva| gṛṇata:| maghona:| maha:| ca| rāya:| revata:| kṛdhi| na: || 15 ||
he śūra vīra indra svamabhiṣutaṃ somaṃ śīghraṃ piba |
yāgakālātipāto yāvanna bhavati tāvacchīghraṃ somaṃ pibetyarthaḥ |
he vasavāna vasūnāṃ dhanānāmetaḥ tvaṃ vasuḥ praśastaḥ san mā riṣyaṇyaḥ yāgakālātikramajātena doṣenā- smān hiṃsīḥ |
uta api ca he indra tvaṃ gṛṇataḥ tvāṃ stuvataḥ stotṛn maghonaḥ havilakṣaṇadhanavato yajamānāṃśca trāyasva pramādajanita- karmavaiguṇyadoṣāt pālayasva |
kiṃca mahaśca rāya ityubhayatra tṛtīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī |
mahaḥ mahatā rāyaḥ dhanena ca naḥ asmān revataḥ kṛdhi dhanavataḥ kuru ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- 'yajāmahe sahādyānye triṣṭubhau pañcamyabhisāriṇī' iti |
caturthe'hani mādhyandinasavane tṛtīyāpañcamyo- rāvartanena trīṃścān hotakā ekaikaṃ tṛcamāvaperan |
sūtritaṃ ca—'yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇamiti dvitīyānevameva' ( ādha. śrau. 7. 11 ) iti ||
yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇa̭ harīṇāṃ ra॒thya̭ṃ vi॒vratā̭nām |
pra i॒maśrṷ do॒rdhuva̭ddhūrva॒thā bhu॒dri se॒nābhi̭rda॒ryamā̭no vi rā॒dhasā̭ ||
yajāmahe | indram | vajra'dakṣiṇam | harīṇām | rathyam | vi'vratānām | pra | imaśru | dordhuvat | ūrdhva'sthā | bhūta | vi | senābhiḥ | daryamānaḥ | vi | rādhasā || 1 ||
vajradakṣiṇa śatruvadhāya satataṃ vajro dakṣiṇe haste yasya taṃ vivratānāṃ rathavahanādivividhakarmaṇāṃ harīṇām etatsaṃjjñakānā- maśvānāṃ rathyam ānetāram |
sa indraḥ somapānānantaraṃ imaśru svakīyāni imaśrūṇi dordhuvat punaḥ- punaḥ dhunvānaḥ san ūrdhvathā ūrdhvaṃ pra bhūta prādurabhūt |
kiṃca senābhiḥ marudādisvakīyaiḥ sainyaiḥ vi dayamānaḥ vividhaṃ śatrūn hiṃsan rādhasā |
harī nva̭sya॒ yā vanḙ vi॒de vasvindro̭ mṛ॒dhairmagha̭vā vṛ॒trahā̭ bhu॒vat |
ṛ॒bhuvā̭ja॒ ṛbhṷkṣāḥ pa॒tyate॒ śavo̭'va॒ kṣaumi̭ dā॒sasya̭ nā॒ma ci॒t ||
harī iti | nu | asya | yā | vane | vide | vasu | indraḥ | mṛdhaiḥ | maghavā | vṛtra'hā | bhuvat | ṛbhuḥ | vājaḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | patyate | śavaḥ | ava | kṣaumi | dāsasya | nāma | cit || 2 ||
asya indrasya saṃbandhinau yā yau harī aśvau vane |
vanayante saṃbhajyante'smin devā iti vanaṃ yajño'raṇyaṃ vā |
tasmin vasu ṛjīpalakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ yavasakṣaṇaṃ vā nu kṣipraṃ vide vindate labhate |
yau harī asyendrasya vane saṃbhajanārthaṃ vasu' vasuno lābhāya kṣipraṃ bhavata iti śeṣaḥ |
tābhyāṃ haribhyāṃ maghaiḥ dhanaiḥ maghavā dhanavān indraḥ vṛtrahā vṛtrākhyasyāsurasya meghasya vā hantā bhuvat bhavati |
api ca ṛbhuḥ dīptaḥ vājaḥ balavān ṛbhukṣāḥ mahānindraḥ śavaḥ śavaso
1. ta-karmavaiguṇyena | 2. ta-'ca' nāsti | 3. tabha-saṃbhajaṃtesmin | 4. ta-mu-ṛjīpalakṣaṇaṃ | 5. ta-bha1.2.4-'vasu' nāsti |

balasya dhanasya vā paśyate īṣṭe | yadvā | śatrūṇāṃ dalaṃ prati paśyate pratipadyate gacchati | ahamapi tasya prasādāt dāsasya upakṣapayitavyasya śatroḥ nāma cit | namyate'neneti nāma śiraḥ | tadapi ava kṣaṇāṃmi ava hanmi | kimutānyadaṅgam | athavā nāmadheyamapi nāśayami kimuta śatrum ||
yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidhā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ |
ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ ||
yadā | vajram | hiraṇyam | ita | artha | ratham | harī iti | yam | asya | vahataḥ | vi | sūribhiḥ | ā | tiṣṭhati | maghavā | sanaśrutaḥ | indraḥ | vājasya | dīrghaśravasaḥ | patiḥ || 3 ||
yadā indraḥ hiraṇyaṃ hitaramaṇīyaṃ vajraṃ svakīyamāyudhaṃ śatruhananāya gṛhṇātīti śeṣaḥ |
atha tadānīm asya indrasya harī aśvau yaṃ rathaṃ vahataḥ gantavyapradeśaṃ viśeṣeṇa prāpayataḥ |
balamapradānaiḥ vardhayati tathā vṛṣṭadvāreṇa sarvasya jagataḥ vśavaḥ balaṃ vvavṛdhe vardhayati vasya indrasya vtattadit tattadeva vpaurasya balaṃ vguṇīmasi vayaṃ stumaḥ |
indro yena yena balena śatrūn hanti tasya tattadvalaṃ vayaṃ stuma ityarthaḥ ||
stormaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanatpūrvyaṃ purutamaṃ sudānave |
vidvā hasya bhojanaminsya yadā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karā mahe ||
stormam | te | indra | vi'madāḥ | ajījanan | apūrvyam | puru'tamam | su'dānave | vidvān | hi | asya | bhojanam | inasya | yat | ā | paśum | na | gopāḥ | karā mahe ||6||
he vindra vte tubhyaṃ vsudānave śobhanadānasyārthāya vvimadāḥ vimadanāmāno vayaṃ vstormaṃ stotraviśeṣam vajījanat janitavantaḥ |
indraṃ | soma̭m | ima̭m | piba̭ | madhṷmantam | camṷ̄ iti̭ | sutam | asme iti̭ | rayim | ni | dhāraya | vi | vaḥ | madḙ | sahasriṇa̭m | puru॒so iti̭ puru॒'vaso | viva̭kṣase || 1 ||
he ᵥindra tvam ᵥimam īdṛśaṃ ᵥsomaṃ ᵥpiba |
ᵥmadhumantaṃ ᵥmadhurasorūpetaṃ ᵥcamū camvoḥ adhipavaṇaphalakayoḥ ᵥsutam abhiputam |
tadanantaraṃ ᵥpuruvaso bahudhana he indra ᵥvaḥ tava ᵥvimade viśeṣeṇa somajanyamade sati ᵥasme asmāsu ᵥrayiṃ dhanaṃ ᵥni dhāraya nitarāṃ sthāpaya : kīdṛśam |
svayā dattena dhanena yasmāddhayaṃ punarapi tvadarthaṃ yāgaṃ kurmaḥ tasmādasmāsu dhanaṃ nidhehītyarthaḥ |

tvāṃ ya॒jñebhi̭ru॒kthairṷpa॒ havyḙbhi॒rīma̭he | śacī̭pate śacī̭nāṃ vi vo made॒ śreṣṭha̭ṃ no dhehi॒ vārya̭ṃ viva̭kṣase || 2 || tvām | ya॒jñebhi̭: | u॒kthai: | upa̭ | havyḙbhi: | īma̭he | śacī̭'pate | śacī̭nām | vi | vaḥ | madḙ | śreṣṭha̭m | naḥ | dhehi̭ | vārya̭m | viva̭kṣase || 2 ||
he indra vayaṃ ᵥyajñebhiḥ yajñaiḥ somayāgādibhiḥ ᵥukthaiḥ śastralakṣaṇaiḥ¹ stotraiḥ ᵥhavyebhiḥ havyaiḥ puroḍāśādibhiśca |
ᵥtvām upetya ᵥīmahe abhilaṣitaṃ dhanaṃ yācāmahe |
ato he ᵥśacīpate karmaṇāṃ pālavitaḥ tvaṃ kepācitkarmaṇāṃ pālako na bhavasīti na kiṃtu ᵥśacīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ pālako bhavatītyarthaḥ |
evaṃ yācitastvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥvāryaṃ varaṇīyaṃ ᵥśreṣṭhaṃ praśastatamaṃ² padhādidhanaṃ ᵥdhehi dehi |

ya॒spati̭rvāryā̭ṇāmasi॒ radha̭sya॒ codi̭tā | indra̭ sto॒tṝṇāma̭vitā vi vo made॒ dviṣo̭ na॒ḥ pāhā̭ṃhaso viva̭kṣase || 3 || yaḥ | pati̭: | vāryā̭ṇām | asi̭ | radha̭sya | codi̭tā | indra̭ | sto॒tṝṇām | a॒vi॒tā | vi | vaḥ | madḙ | dviṣa̭: | naḥ | pāhi̭ | aṃha̭sa: | viva̭kṣase ||3||
he indra ᵥyaḥ tvaṃ ᵥvāryāṇāṃ varaṇīyānāṃ dhanānāṃ ᵥpatiḥ ᵥasi svāmī bhavasi |
ᵥradhasya rādhakasya stotuśca ᵥcoditā dhanadānena karmasu niśroktā ca bhavasi |
kiṃca he ᵥindra yastvaṃ ᵥstotṛṇāṃ- macitā rakṣako'si sa tvaṃ ᵥvi ᵥvo ᵥmade tava vividhe somajanyamade sati ᵥdviṣaḥ dveṣṭuḥ sakāśāt ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥpāhi rakṣa |

yuvaṃ śakrā māyāvinā̭ samī॒cī ni̭ra॒manthatam | vi॒mudḙna॒ yadī̭ḻitā nāsa̭tyā॒ nira̭manthatam || 4 || yuva̭m | śakrā̭ | māyā'vinā̭ | sa॒mī॒cī iti̭ sa॒m'īcī̭ | ni | a॒ma॒ntha॒ta॒m | vi'mudḙna | yat | ī॒ḻi॒tā | nāsa̭tyā | ni: | a॒ma॒ntha॒ta॒m || 4 ||

he <sup>v</sup>śakrā śatrau śatravadhādikarmasu samarthau he aśvinau <sup>v</sup>māyāvinā māyāvinau prajñāvantau śatruvañcanakuśalau vā <sup>v</sup>yuvaṃ yuvāṃ <sup>v</sup>samīcī parasparaṃ saṃgatau <sup>v</sup>niramanthatam agniṃ niramabhītam |

<sup>v</sup>yat yadā <sup>v</sup>nāsatyā nāsatyau yuvāṃ <sup>v</sup>vimadena mayā <sup>v</sup>īlitā īlitau stutau <sup>v</sup>niramanthataṃ niramabhītaṃtadā tadā yuvāṃ parasparaṃ saṃgatau nirmathitavantau’ stha ityarthaḥ ||
viśvḙ | de॒vāḥ | a̭kṛpanta | su॒m'ī̭bhyoḥ | niḥ'pa̭tantayoḥ | nā̭sa॒tyā | a̭bruvan | de॒vāḥ | pu॒naḥ | ā | va॒hatā̭t | iti̭ || 5 ||

he aśvinau yuvābhyāmimanthanakālḙ preryamāṇayoḥ <sup>v</sup>samīcyoḥ parasparaṃ saṃyuktayoraraṇyoḥ <sup>v</sup>niṣpa- tantayoḥ visphuliṅgān nirgamayantyoḥ satyoḥ <sup>v</sup>viśve sarva indrādayo <sup>v</sup>devāḥ <sup>v</sup>akṛpanta yuvāmastuvan |
punaḥ- punarīdṛśāni jagatsthitihetubhūtāni karmāṇi yuvāmābhimukhyena sthigvāvahatām |
yuvābhyāmu- tpādyamānaḥ punarāśrayamagnirasmadīyāni<sup>4</sup> havīṃṣyāvahatviti devā nāsatyāvabruvan ||
tā naṷ de॒vā de॒vata̭yā॒ yuva̭ṃ ma॒dhu॒ma॒tkṛ॒tam ||
ma॒dhu॒'mat | me॒ | pu॒rā̭'a̭yanam | ma॒dhu॒'mat | pu॒naḥ | ā॒'a̭yanam | tā | na̭ḥ | de॒vāḥ | de॒vata̭yā | yu॒vam | ma॒dhu॒'mat | kṛ॒tam || 6 ||
api ca he <sup>v</sup>devā devau dyotamānau <sup>v</sup>tā tau <sup>v</sup>yuvaṃ yuvāṃ <sup>v</sup>naḥ asmān <sup>v</sup>madhumataḥ prītiyukkān <sup>v</sup>kṛtaṃ kurutam |
‘ṛṣiścānyasmāt’ iti paribhāṣayā prājāpatya aindro vā vimado vā vāsukro vasukrūṣiḥ |
bha॒draṃ no̭ a॒pi vā̭taya॒ mano॒ dakṣa̭muta kra॒tum |
a॒dhā tḙ sa॒khye a̭ndha॒so vi vo̭ ma॒de ra॒ṇan gāvo॒ na ya̭va॒se vi̭va॒kṣasḙ ||
bha॒dram | na̭ḥ | a॒pi | vā॒taya̭ | mana̭ḥ | dakṣa̭m | u॒ta | kra॒tum | a॒dhā | tḙ | sa॒khye | a̭ndha॒saḥ | vi | vo॒ | ma॒de | ra॒ṇan | gāva̭ḥ | na | ya̭va॒se | vi॒va॒kṣasḙ || 1 ||
he soma tvaṃ naḥ asmadīyaṃ manaḥ bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ dhātaya gamaya |
vṛddhaṃ sarvavyāpinamantarātmānamapi bhadraṃ śubha- kāritvalakṣaṇaṃ prāpaya |
utāpi ca kratuṃ prajñānaṃ bhadraṃ śubhādhyavasāyalakṣaṇaṃ prāpaya |
atha atha stotāraḥ te tatra sakhye stutyastotrejyayaṣṭṛtvalakṣaṇe sakhikarmaṇi raṇan ramantām |
yathā dhenavo ghāse ramante prītiṃ kurvanti tadvat |
andhasaḥ somasyasyānnasya saṃbandhini tava vimade vividhasomajanyamadanimitte sati |
adhā kāmā ime mam vi vo made vi tiṣṭhante vasuyavo virvakṣase ||

gāvo yavaṃ prayutā aryo akṣan tā apaśyaṃ sahagaupāścarantīḥ | havā idyo abhitaḥ samāyanikyadāsu svarpaticchandayāte || 8 || gāvaḥ | yavam | prayutāḥ | aryaḥ | akṣan | tāḥ | apaśyam | saha'gaupāḥ | carantīḥ | havāḥ | ita | aryaḥ | abhitaḥ | sam | āyan | kiyat | āsu | svaḥ'patiḥ | chandayāte ||8|| vgāvaḥ dhenavaḥ vprayutāḥ prakarṣeṇa miśritāḥ parasparaṇa saha bhūtāḥ vyavaṃ maddṛṣṭinitayavādi- ghāsam vakṣan adanti bhakṣayanti | varyaḥ sarvasya svāmyahaṃ vtāḥ gāḥ vapaśyaṃ paśyāmi | kīdṛśīḥ | vsahagaupāḥ paśupālakena sahitāḥ vcarantīḥ ghāsaṃ bhakṣayantīḥ | evaṃbhūtāstāḥ parayā prītyā paśyāmītyarthaḥ | kiṃca vhavāḥ vāhanadohanārthamāhvānāhā gāḥ varyaḥ | dvitīyārthe prathamā | arya svāminaṃ prati vabhitaḥ sarvataḥ 1 vsamāyan | samidhyekībhāve | ekībhūyāgacchanti | vhṛditi pūraṇaḥ | āgatāsu vāsu goṣu vsvapatiḥ svānāṃ gavāṃ svāmī vkiyata kṣīraṃ vchandayāte dogdhuṃ kāmayate | madarthaṃ dogdhītyarthaḥ 2 | ‘ gāva āśiraṃ duduhe ’ ( ṛ. maṃ. 8. 60. 6 ) iti vacanāt ||

saṃ yadvayai yatrasādo janānāmahaṃ yavādaṃ urvajñai antaḥ | atrā yukto'vasātāramicchādatho ayuktaṃ yunajadvanvān || 9 || sam | yat | vayam | yava'ardaḥ | janānām | aham | yava'ardaḥ | uru'ajñai | annāritaṃ | atra | yuktaḥ | ava'sātāram | icchāta | atho | iti | ayuktam | yunajat | vanvān || 9 ||

atredu me maṃsase satyamuktaṃ dvipācca yaccatuṣpātsaṃsujāni | strībhiryo atra vṛṣaṇaṃ pṛtnyādyudgho asya vi bhaṃjāni vedaḥ || 10 || atra | ita | ū~ iti | me | maṃsase | satyam | uktam | dvi'pāt | ca | yat | catuḥ'pāt | sam'sṛjāni | strībhiḥ | yaḥ | atra | vṛṣaṇam | pṛtnyāt | ayuddhaḥ | asya | vi | bhajāni | vedaḥ ||10|| vme mama vatra asmin stotre vuktaṃ mayā kathitaṃ vsatyamit yathābhūtameva vmaṃsase tvaṃ jānīhi | arthavādarūpeṇa naitadadhyāropitaguṇamityarthaḥ | vu iti pūraṇaḥ | kiṃca vdvipācca manuṣyādikaṃ ca vcatu- ṣpāt ca paśvādikaṃ ca vyaṃta sthāvarajaṅgamātmakaṃ jagat vsaṃsṛjāni ahamutpādayānīti tvaṃ jānīhi | vatra asmiñjagati vstrībhiḥ strīsadṛśaiḥ balādihīnaiḥ puruṣaiḥ saha vyaḥ śūramanyo janaḥ vvṛṣaṇam abhi- laṣitasya varṣitāraṃ mām | parityajyeti śeṣaḥ | vpṛtnyāt yuddhaṃ kartumicchati aham vasya īdṛśasya
tava-mu-anayā ṛṣiriṃdra- prasādalabdhaṃ svasya sārvabhaumyaṃ prakāśayati |
janānāṃ lokānāṃ madhye ye yavasādaḥ tṛṇasyāttāraḥ paśavaḥ te vayamiti saṃ samyak jānīhi |
ye ca yavādaḥ yavopalakṣitasyānnasya attāro manuṣyāstepi vayamiti saṃjānīhi |
vastutastu urvajñe vistīrṇaṃ ajiraṃgaṇe hārdākāśarūpe yat aṃtaḥ aṃtaryāmi rūpaṃ brahma tadahamasmi |
antrāsmin hārdākāśe yuktaḥ samāhito bhavāniṃdraḥ avasātāraṃ ātmanaḥ saṃbhāraṃ icchāta icchati ātmasākṣātkartuṃ |
atho api ca ayuktaṃ ayoginaṃ vanvān |
vanvaṃtaṃ atiśayena viṣayān sevamānaṃ puruṣaṃ yunajat yunakti saṃsāre |
svabhūtaṃ ᵥveda: dhanam ᵥāyuddha: tena puruṣeṇāyoddhā san balādapahṛtya ᵥvi ᵥbhajāni stotṛbhyo yaṣṭṛbhyaśca dadāmītyartha: ||

yasyānkṣā duhitā jātvās kastāṃ vidvā~ abhi manyāte andhām | kṛtaro merni prati taṃ muṃcāte ya īṃ vahāte ya īṃ vā vareyāt || 11 || yasya | anakṣā | duhitā | jātu | āsa | ka: | tām | vidvān | abhi | manyāte | andhām | katara: | menim | prati | tam | muṃcāte | ya: | īm | vahāte | ya: | īm | vā | vare'yāt || 11 ||
ᵥyasya indrasya mama kāraṇarūpeṇāvasthitasya ᵥanakṣā akṣavarjitā darśanahīnā |
sāmarthyāt mahāpralaye mayyeva līnā satī sarva
ādityarūpīndraḥ pattaḥ raśmyākhyaiḥ pādaiḥ jagāra vṛttilakṣaṇamudakaṃ girati gṛhṇāti vā |
gṛhītvā ca pratyaṅgam ātmānaṃ pratigatamudakaṃ atti bhakṣayati |
tadanantaraṃ varūthaṃ varaṇīyaṃ vṛttilakṣaṇamudakaṃ śīrṇāṃ śiraḥ- sthānīyena raśmijālena śiraḥ sarvasya lokasya mastakaṃ prati dadhau dadhāti |
kiṃca upasi upasthe svasamīpasthāne maṇḍale āsīnaḥ upaviṣṭaḥ san ūrdhvam udgatāṃ svadīptiṃ kṣiṇāti hinasti |
nyaṅ raśmisamūhatvena nīcairaśritā gantā san uttānāṃ vitatāṃ bhūmim anveti anugacchati ||
bṛhacchrāyo apalāśo arvī tasthau mātā virṣito atti garbhaṃ |
anyasyā vatsaṃ riṃhatī mimāya kayā bhuvā ni dadhe dhenurudhaḥ ||
bṛhan | acchāyaḥ | apalāśaḥ | arvī | tasthau | mātā | virṣitaḥ | atti | garbhaḥ | anyasyāḥ | vatsam | riṃhatī | mimāya | kayā | bhuvā | ni | dadhe | dhenuḥ | ūdhaḥ || 14 ||
kiṃca mātā vṛṣṭipradānadvāreṇa sarvasya jagato nirmātā virṣitaḥ vimuktaḥ |
garbhaḥ trailokyasya garbhabhūta audityātmanendraḥ atti havīṃṣi bhakṣayati |
kiṃca anyasyāḥ adityākhyāyā devamātuḥ vatsam apatyabhūtamādityaṃ riṃhatī āsvādayantī upajīvantī vardhayantī mimāya nirmimīte |
dhenuḥ dyaurudakasyādhāratvāt kṣaritvācca ūdhaḥsthānīyamādityaṃ ni dadhe sthāpayati |
navaṃ paścātātsthavimantaṃ āyan daśa prāksānu vi tirantayaśvaḥ ||
sapta | vīrāsaḥ | adharāt | ut | āyan | aṣṭa | uttattāt | sam | ajagmirna | te | navam | paścātāt | sthavimantam | āyan | daśa | prāk | sānu | vi | tiranti | aśvaḥ || 15 ||
sapta saptasaṃkhyākāḥ vīrāsaḥ prajāpateḥ putrā viśvāmitrā- dayaḥ adharāt prajāpateradhaḥkāyāt udāyan utpannā babhūvuḥ |
aṣṭa aṣṭasaṃkhyākāḥ te prasiddhā vālakhilyādayaḥ uttarāttāt uttarākāyapradeśāt samajagmirna saṃjajñire |
sthavimantaḥ sthānavantaḥ nava navasaṃkhyākā bhṛgavaḥ paścātāt pṛṣṭhataḥ āyan āgatāḥ |
tathā daśa daśasaṃkhyākā aṅgirasaḥ prāk agrata utpannāḥ santaḥ akṣaḥ aśanavato dyulokasya sānu unnatapradeśaṃ
3. ga-tuṣṭāva ayamādityaḥ bṛhan mahān acchāyaḥ apalāśaḥ chāyārahitapalāśarahitaḥ |
daśasaṃkhyākāste'śrā'śanavata indrasya prākapradeśe sthitāḥ samucchritamudakaṃ tejo vā vi tiranti |
daśānāmekaṃ kapilaṃ samānaṃ taṃ hinvanti ṛtave pāryāya |
garbhaṃ mātā sudhitaṃ vṛkṣaṇāsvavenantaṃ tuparyantī bibharti ||
daśānām | ekam | kapilam | samānam | tam | hinvanti | ṛtave | pāryāya | garbham | mātā | sudhitam | vṛkṣaṇāsu | avenantam | tuparyantī | bibharti || 16 ||
daśānāṃ daśasaṃkhyākānāṃ pūrvoktānāmevāṅgirasāṃ madhye ekaṃ mukhyaṃ kapilam etannāmānaṃ taṃ prasiddhamṛpim | kīdṛśam | samānaṃ sadṛśam | kena | sāmarthyāt prajāpatinā
vi | krośanāsaḥ | vivvaḥ | āyan | pacati | nemeḥ | nahi | pakṣat | ardhaḥ | ayam | me | devaḥ | savitā | tat | āha | du'annaḥ | it | vanavat | sarpiḥ'annaḥ ||18||
ᐁvi ᐁkrośanāsaḥ vivadhaṃ prajāpatiṃ pitaramāhvayantaḥ ᐁvivvaḥ nānāgatayo nānāpūjanā vā sarvai'ṅgirasaḥ ᐁāyan āgacchan |
utpannamānaḥ ᐁnemeḥ adho'ṅgirasāṃ madhya eko bhāgaḥ ᐁpacāti prajāpatyarthaṃ havīṃṣi pacati |
ᐁardhaḥ aparo bhāgaḥ ᐁnahi ᐁpakṣat nahi pacati |
ᐁayam īdṛśaḥ ᐁdevaḥ dyotamānaḥ ᐁsavitā sarvasya preraka ādityo vā prajāpatirvā ᐁme mahyaṃ ᐁtat sarvaṃ yathoktam ᐁāha |
kiṃca ᐁsarpiḥrannaḥ ghṛtaudanaḥ ᐁbrahma ᐁit dāvaudanaḥ agnirāpi ᐁvanavat havirdvāreṇa prajāpātaṃ vanati saṃbhajate ||
sirṣāktyuryaḥ pra yugā janānāṃ sadyaḥ śikṣā pramināno navīyān ||
apaśyam | grāmam | vahamānam | ārāt | acakreyā | svadhayā | vartamānam | sirṣākti | aryaḥ | pra | yugā | janānām | sadyaḥ | śikṣā | pra'minān | navīyān ||19||
ᐁacakrayā cakravarjitayā rathahīnayā ᐁsvadhayā svayamāramānaṃ dhārayantyā senayā ᐁvartamānam āgaccha- ntam |
kiṃca ᐁaryaḥ sarvasya svāmīndraḥ ᐁjanānāṃ yajamānānāṃ kāryatvena saṃbandhanaḥ ᐁyugā yugāni yajñakālaviśeṣān ᐁpra ᐁmipakti prakarṣeṇa sevate |
' śikṣaṃ śrayateḥ ' ( niru. 4. 19 ) iti nirvacanāt kṣatritṛṇi tāḍayitṛṇi rākṣasatdivṛndāni ᐁpraminān prakarṣeṇa hiṃsan ᐁnavīyān śarīreṇa ca balapauruṣayanādibhiśca navataraḥ ||
etau me gāvau pramurasya yuktau mo ṣu pra sadhīmṛhurnirmamandhi |
ārpaśridasya vi naśantyarthaṃ sūraśca marka uparo babhūvān ||
etau | me | gāvau | pra'bhurasya | yuktau | mo iti | su | pra | sadhīḥ | muhuḥ | it | mamandhi | āpaḥ | cit | asya | vi | naśanti | artham | mūraḥ | ca | markaḥ | upaḥ | babhūvān ||20||

kāryakāraṇayorabhedopacārāt ' ātmā vai putranāmāsi ' ( āśva. gṛ. 1.15.11 ) iti vacanā- cchendrarūpeṇāvasthitasya ᐁpramarasya prakarṣeṇa śatrūṇāṃ mārayituḥ ᐁme mama svabhūtā ᐁetau etādṛśau ᐁyuktau rathe niyuktau ᐁsu suṣṭhu pūjitau ᐁgāvau śatrūn yajñāṃśca prati gantārau harī ᐁmo ᐁpra ᐁsedhīḥ |
kiṃ tarhi ᐁmuhuriti muhurmuhuḥ ᐁmamandhi punaḥpunaḥ stuhi mamāramantvityarthaḥ |
ᐁāpaśrit vṛṣṭilakṣaṇānyudakānyapi ᐁasya indrasya ᐁatha gatiṃ ᐁvi ᐁnaśanti |
ᐁmarkaḥ mārjayitā sarvasya śodhayitā ᐁuparaḥ meghasadṛśaḥ ᐁbabhūvān bhavan |

ayaṃ yo vajraḥ purudhā vivṛtto'vaḥ sūryasya bṛhataḥ purīṣāt | śrava idenā puro anyadasti tadavyathī jarimāṇastaranti || 21 || ayam | yaḥ | vajraḥ | purudhā | vi'vṛttaḥ | avaḥ | sūryasya | bṛhataḥ | purīṣāt | śravaḥ | it | enā | puraḥ | anyat | asti | tat | avyathī | jarimāṇaḥ | taranti || 21 || ^yaḥ ^ayaṃ ^vajraḥ ^indrasya ^svabhūtaḥ ^sūryasya ^ādityasya ^bṛhataḥ ^mahataḥ ^purīṣāt ^purakāt maṇḍalāt ^avaḥ ^avastādadhobhāge ^sthiteṣu ^vivṛttaḥ ^vṛṣṭyartha ^pravṛttaḥ ^patitaḥ | ^icchaddho'pyarthe | tacchabdaśruteryacchabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | ^paraḥ ^parastādantarikṣalokasyopari ^sthite ^sūrya maṇḍale ^sthitam ^enā enat | ^śravaḥ ^ityannanāma | ^taddhetutvādudakaṃ ^śrava ^ityucyate | ^yadapyudakaṃ ^meghodaragatādudakāt ^anyat api ^asti ^avyathī ^vyavahāritāḥ ^jarimāṇaḥ ^stotāro ^marudādayaḥ ^tat ^tādṛśamudakaṃ ^taranti antarikṣalokaṃ ^pratyavatārayanti ||

vṛkṣevṛkṣe niyatā mīmayadvaistato vayaḥ pra pantānapūrupādaḥ | athedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhayāt indrāya sunvadapaye ca śikṣat || 22 || vṛkṣe'vṛkṣe | ni'ryatā | mīmayat | gauḥ | tataḥ | vayaḥ | pra | pantān | puru'ardaḥ | artha | idam | viśvam | bhuvanam | bhayāte | indrāya | sunvat | ṛpaye | ca | śikṣat || 22 || ^vṛkṣevṛkṣe ^sarvasmin ^vṛkṣamaye ^dhanuṣi ^niyatā ^saṃvaddhā | ^gauḥ ^gosambandhinī ^snāyumanī ^maurvī ^mīmayat | ^mīmayatiḥ ^śabdakarmā | ^ākṛṣyamāṇā ^satī ^śabdaṃ ^karoti | ^tataḥ ^tasmāddhanupaḥ ^purupādaḥ ^śatrujanānāmattāraḥ | ^mārayitāra ^ityarthaḥ | ^vayaḥ ^paścimadaśā ^gantāro ^bāṇāḥ ^pra ^patanān ^śatrūn ^prati prapatanti | ^atha ^tadānīm ^indrāya ^indrārtha ^sunvat ^somayāgaṃ ^kurvat ^ṛpaye ^ca ^śikṣat karmaṇāṃ ^draṣṭa ^ṛtvije ^ca ^sampūrṇāṃ ^dakṣiṇāṃ ^dadapi ^idam ^idaśaṃ ^viśvaṃ ^samastaṃ ^bhuvanaṃ ^bhūtajātaṃ ^bhayāte ^indrādbibheti | ^anyatkimatetyarthaḥ ||

sa roruvadvṛṣabhāstigmaśṛṅgo varṣmantasthau varimannā pṛthivyāḥ | viśveṣvenaṃ vṛjaneṣu pāmi yo me kukṣī sutasomaḥ pṛṇāti || 2 || saḥ | roruvat | vṛṣabhaḥ | tigma'śṛṅgaḥ | varṣman | tasthau | variman | ā | pṛthivyāḥ | viśveṣu | enam | vṛjaneṣu | pāmi | yaḥ | me | kukṣī iti | suta'somaḥ | pṛṇāti || 2 ||
vṛṣabhaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣitā tigmaśṛṅgaḥ tīkṣṇaraśmiḥ saḥ indro'haṃ pṛthivyāḥ antarikṣasya varṣman varṣmaṇi |
evaṃbhūto'haṃ viśveṣu sarveṣu vṛjaneṣu saṃgrāmeṣu enam īdṛśaṃ vasuṃ yajamānaṃ pāmi rakṣāmi |
yaḥ yajamānaḥ sutasomaḥ abhiṣutasomaḥ me mama kukṣī ubhau pārśvau pṛṇāti somarasapuroḍāśādihavirbhiḥ pūrayati |

adriṇā te mandinaṃ indra tūryāntsunvanti somānpibasi tvamepām | parcanti te vṛṣabhā~ atisa teṣāṃ pṛkṣeṇa yanmadhavanhūyamānaḥ || 3 || adriṇā | te | mandinam | indra | tūryān | sunvanti | somān | pibasi | tvam | eṣām | parcanti | te | vṛṣabhān | ati | teṣām | pṛkṣeṇa | yat | maghavan | hūyamānaḥ || 3 ||
he indra te tvadarthaṃ mandinaḥ mādayitnūn tūryān avilambitān somān adriṇā abhiṣava- grāvṇā sunvanti yajamānā abhipuṇvanti |
eṣām asmadādiyajamānānāṃ saṃbandhināḥ somān tvaṃ pibasi |
kiṃca tvadarthaṃ vṛṣabhān paśūn ye ca yajamānāḥ parcanti teṣāṃ saṃbandhino havi- rbhūtān paśūn ati bhakṣayasi |
he maghavan dhanavacchindra tvaṃ yadā pṛkṣeṇa havirbhūtenānnena nimittena hūyamānaḥ yajamānairhūyase tadeti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ ||

idaṃ su me jaritrā cikiddhi pratīpaṃ śāpaṃ nadyo vahanti | lopāśaḥ siṃhaṃ pratyaśvamatsāḥ kroṣṭā varāhaṃ niratakta kakṣāt || 4 || idam | su | me | jaritrā | cikiddhi | prati'īpam | śāpam | nadyaḥ | vahanti | lopāśaḥ | siṃham | pratyaśvam | atsārita | kroṣṭā | varāham | niḥ | atakta | kakṣāt || 4 ||
he jaritaḥ śatrūṇāṃ jarayitarindra tvaṃ me mama su śobhanamapi idam īdṛśaṃ rūpaṃ sāmarthyam ā cikiddhi ā samantājjñānīhi |

pādaḥ3 pūrvaṃ vyākhyeyaḥ | he ᵥsindhavaḥ syandanaśīlā apaḥ ᵥvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ᵥyaḥ ᵥgarbhaḥ ᵥmadhvaḥ madhurarasasya ᵥutsaḥ utsyandanaḥ prastravaṇaḥ | yacchabdayogāttacchabdo'- dhyāhāryaḥ | taṃ ᵥmadhumantaṃ madhurarasopetam ᵥūrmim apsaṃghātam | sāramityarthaḥ | ᵥasmai ayendrasyārthāya 1. ta-āhatābhistābhiḥ | 2. ta-eva...prahībhavanti ’ nāsti | 3. ta-pāda ’ nāsti |
vadhvareṣu yajñeṣu vghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ ghṛtamājyaṃ pṛṣṭhe yasya tam |
kiṃca he vāpa: yūyaṃ vrevatī: revatya: asmabhyaṃ yāni dhanāni dātavyāni tairadhanavatya: vme madīyaṃ vhavam āhvānaṃ vśṛṇuta ||
taṃ sindhavo matsaramindrapānarmūrmi pra heta ya ubhe iryati |
tam | sindhava: | matsaram | indra'pānam | ūrmim | pra | heta | ya: | ubhe iti | iryati | mada'cyutam | auśānam | nabha:'jām | pari | tri'tantum | vi'carantam | utsam || 9 ||

tenādhiṣavaṇacarmaṇā ūdhaso'dhastādavasthiteneti manyamāno niruktakāro bravīti3—‘yājñe śakaṭa iti’ vā’ (niru. 6. 22) iti|

evamatra praśabdenārthasya sutarāṃ prakaṭatā bhavatīti bhāṣyakāreṇa praśabdo'dhyāhṛtaḥ|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘āpo revatīḥ kṣayathā hi vasva upa prayanta iti sūkte’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 13) iti||

rāyaśca stha svapatyasya patnīḥ sarasvatī tadgṛṇate vayo dhāt ||

adhvaryubhirmanasā saṃvidānā indrāya somaṃ susṛtaṃ bharantīḥ ||

prati| yat| āpaḥ| ahram| ā'yatīḥ| ghṛtam| payāṃsi| bibhratīḥ| madhūni| adhvaryubhiḥ| manasā| sam'vidānāḥ| indrāya| somam| su'sutam| bharantīḥ||13|| he 4āpaḥ 4āyatīḥ asmadyajñaṃ pratyāgacchantīḥ 4yat| ‘supāṃ suluk’ iti vibhakterluk| yāḥ yuṣmān 4prati 4ahraṃ pratipaśyāmi 4ghṛtaṃ somasaṃsṛṣṭamājyaṃ 4madhūni madhusadṛśāni mṛṣṭarasāni
apsu hi yajñaśritaḥ brahmakarmadhanānāṃ lābhāya hinota yajñasya yogārtha ūdhaḥ ātmīyaṃ vi vyadhvaṃ vimuktaṃ kuruta|
he āpaḥ yūyaṃ śrutīvarīḥ sukhavatyo bhūtana bhavatāsmabhya|

payāṃsi udakāni gha saṃbhūya vibhratī: yāgakāle dhārayanti: tathā adhvaryubhi: manasā agata:- karaṇena saṃvidānā: saṃbhāpamāṇā: kiṃca indrāya indrārthaṃ suputaṃ suṣṭhu sutaṃ somaṃ bharantī: dhārayantī: evaṃbhūtāstā yuṣmāntaumīti śeṣa:2 ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'emā amanrevatīrjīvadhanyā iti dve sapnāsūtaryā paridhāya' (āśva. śrau. 5.1) iti||
ni barhipi dhattana somyāso'pāṃ naptrā saṃvidānāsa enā: ||
ā | imā: | amanr | revatī: | jīvadhanyā: | adhvaryava: | sādayata | sakhāya: | ni | barhipi | dhattana | somyāsa: | apām | naptrā | sam'vidānāsa: | enā: || 14 ||
revatī: revatya: dhanavatya: jīvadhanyā: jīvānāṃ pālayiṣya:3 prīṇayiṣyo vā imā: īdṛgbhūtā āpa: ā amanr asmadarthaṃ pratyāgacchan |
etajjñātvā he sakhāya: sakhibhūtā he adhvaryava: yūyam apāṃ naptrā vṛṣṭikarmavadhikṛtena4 devena saha saṃvidānā: saṃmantrayamāṇā: enā: etā apa: sādayata sthāpayata |
somyāsa: somasaṃpādino'dhvaryava: yūyaṃ barhipi vedyāmāstīrṇe kuśamaye ni dhattana niyamena sthāpayata ||
adhvaryava: sunutendrāya somamabhūdu va: suśakā devayujyā ||
ā | amanr | āpa: | uśatī: | barhi: | ā | idam | ni | adhvare | asadan | deva'yantī: | adhvaryava: | sunuta | indrāya | somam | abhūta | ūṃ iti | va: | su'śakā | deva'yujyā || 15 ||
āpa: vasatīvyekadhanākhyā: idam īdṛśaṃ barhi: vedistaraṇam uśatī: uśatya: kāmayamānā: āgamana āgacchan |
asmadarthaṃ prati ā āgatya ca adhvare asmadīye yajñe devayantī: devān kāmayamānā: |
etajjñātvā he adhvaryava: yūyam indrāya indrārthaṃ somaṃ sunuta abhipuṇuta |
idānīmapāṃ prasādāt va: yuṣmākaṃ devayajyā devānindrādīnuddiśya kriyamānā yāgakriyā suśakā suṣṭhu kartuṃ śakyā abhūdu āsīdeva ||
'ā na:' ityekādarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ kaśyapārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevam |
anukrāntaṃ ca—'ā na ekādaśa vaiśvadevam' iti |
ekādaśinasya vaiśvadevasya paśo: puroḍāśasya 'ā na:' ityetānuvākyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'viśva atha maruto viśva ūyā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃsa:' (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti||
tathā adhvaryubhi: manasā aikamatyaṃ gatā indrārthe suṣṭhubhiṣutaṃ somaṃ bharantī: |

ā nau devānāmupa vetu śaṃso viśvebhisturairavase yajatraḥ | tebhirvayaṃ susakhāyo bhavema taranto viśvā duritā syāma || 1 || ā | naḥ | devānām | upa | vetu | śaṃsaḥ | viśvebhiḥ | turaiḥ | avase | yajatraḥ | tebhiḥ | vayam | su'sakhāyaḥ | bhavema | tarantaḥ | viśvā | duḥ'itā | syāma || 1 ||
devānāṃ stotṛṇāṃ naḥ asmākaṃ śaṃsaḥ stotavyaḥ yajatraḥ yaṣṭavyaḥ evaṃbhūta indraḥ turaiḥ svaraṇaśīlaiḥ viśvebhiḥ sarvaiḥ mahadbhiḥ saha avase asmadrakṣaṇārtham ā upa vetu upā- gacchatu |
vayam api tebhiḥ taiḥ saha susakhāyaḥ śobhanasakhāyaḥ bhavema syāma |
kiṃca viśvā duritā viśvāni duritāni pāpāni tarantaḥ syāma ||

pari cinnarto draviṇaṃ samanyātasya pṛthā namasā vivāset | uta svena ṛtunā saṃ vadet śreyā~saṃ dakṣaṃ manasā jagṛbhyāt || 2 || pari | cit | marteḥ | draviṇam | mamanyāt | ṛtasya | pṛthā | namasā | vivāset | uta | svena | ṛtunā | sam | vadet | śreyā~sam | dakṣam | manasā | jagṛbhyāt || 2 ||
martaḥ manuṣyaḥ yajamānaḥ pari cit sarvataḥ draviṇaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ yāgārthaṃ dhanaṃ mama- nyāt manyatiḥ kāntikarmā |
dhanaṃ labdhvā ca ṛtasya yajñasya pathā mārgeṇa namasā havirākhyena namena ā vivāset paricaret |
uta api ca svena ātmīyena ṛtunā3 prajñātena3 |
havirgṛhītvā vaṣaṭ kariṣyan viśvān devān manasādhyāyedityarthaḥ |
viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ yāgānantaraṃ ca tatprasādāt śreyā~sam ati- śayena praśasyamānaṃ dakṣaṃ pravṛddhaṃ sarvavyāpinaṃ manasā dhyānasādhanenāntaḥkaraṇena jagṛbhyāt gṛhṇīyāt ||

adhāyi dhītiraṃsasagramaśāstīrthe na dasmamupa yantyūmāḥ | abhyānaṃ suvitasya śubhaṃ naivedaso amṛtānāmabhūma || 3 || adhāyi | dhītiḥ | asaṃsagram | aṃśāḥ | tīrthe | na | dasmam | upa | yanti | ūmāḥ | abhi | ānaṃm | suvitasya | śubham | naivedasaḥ | amṛtānāma | abhūma || 3 ||
tadanantaram ūmāḥ avitārastarpayitāraḥ aṃśāḥ asmābhirdattā havirbhāgāḥ dasmaṃ darśanīyaṃ śatrūṇāmupakṣapayitāraṃ vā asasagram asamānasṛṣṭim |
3 evaṃbhūtaṃ devasaṃgham upa yanti upa- gacchanti |
tīrthe na yathā gaṅgāditīrthe tarpaṇamukhe visraṣṭā apāṃmaṃśāḥ devasaṃghamupa- gacchanti tadvat |
tadanantaraṃ vayaṃ suvitasya su itasya suṣṭhu prāptasya svargādikasya śubhaṃ sukham abhyānam abhiprāmavāma |
1. ta-duritāni | 2. bha- 'viśvāni' nāsti | 3. ta-'ṛtunā prajñātena' nāsti | 4. ta-'dakṣaṃ' nāsti | 5. ta-su-uprajanmāna |

nityaścākanyātsvarpatirdarmūnā yasmā u devaḥ savitā jujāna | bhago vā gobhiryamemanajyātso asmai cāruchadayaduta syāt || 4 || nityaḥ | cākanyāt | sva'rpatiḥ | darmūnāḥ | yasmai | oṃ iti | devaḥ | savitā | jujāna | bhagaḥ | vā | gobhiḥ | aryamā | īm | anajyāt | saḥ | asmai | cāruḥ | chadayat | uta | syāt ||4||
^u uta api ca ^yasmai yajamānāya mahaṃ ^savitā sarvasya preraka ^devaḥ ^jujāna janitavān |
tathā ^bhagaḥ devaśca ^gobhiḥ asmadīyābhiḥ stuti- rūpābhiḥ vāgbhiḥ ^aryamā devaśca ^īm īdṛgbhūtaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalam ^anajyāt vyaktīkuryāt |
^uta api ca ^syāt anyo'pi ^yo devagaṇo'sti ^cāhaḥ ramaṇīyaḥ ^saḥ api devagaṇaḥ ^asmai yajamānāya mahaṃ ^chadayat dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ dātuṃ kāmayatāmityetadāśāsmahe ||

iyaṃ sā bhūyā upasāmiva kṣā yadvai kṣumantaḥ śavasā sumāryan | asya stutiṃ jaritṛbhikṣamāṇā ā naḥ śammāsa upa yantu vājāḥ || 5 || iyam | sā | bhūyāḥ | upasām'iva | kṣāḥ | yat | ha | kṣu'mantaḥ | śavasā | sam'āryan | asya | stutim | jarituḥ | bhikṣamāṇāḥ | ā | naḥ | śammāsaḥ | upa | yantu | vājāḥ ||5||
^evaṃ- bhūtā devāḥ ^śavasā balena ^yat yāmasmadīyāṃ stutiṃ prati ^samāyan samāgacchan saṃprāptāḥ ^sā ^iyaṃ stutirdevānāṃ prāpyā ^bhūyāḥ bhūyāt bhavatu |
yathā pṛthivī upasāṃ vyāpyā sarveṣāṃ prāpyā bhavati tadvat |
sukhāḥ sukhakarāḥ ^vājāḥ sudhanvanaḥ putrāścāpyṛbhubhirvā vāja ityete ^naḥ asmānābhimukhyena ^upa ^yantu upagacchantu ||

asyedeṣā sumatiḥ paprathānābhavatpurvyā bhūmanā gauḥ | asya sanīḻā asurasya yonau samāna ā bharṇe bibhramāṇāḥ || 6 || asya | it | eṣā | su'matiḥ | paprathānā | abhavat | purvyā | bhūmanā | gauḥ | asya | sa'nīḻāḥ | asurasya | yonau | samāne | ā | bharṇe | bibhramāṇāḥ ||6||

etajjñātvā sarve devāḥ ^asurasya prajārūpabalavataḥ ^asya mama sambandhinī ^samāne sarvadevasādhāraṇe ^bharṇe sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ puṣṭikara ^yonau yajñalye sthāne ^sanīḻāḥ samānasthānāḥ ^bibhramāṇāḥ asmadarthaṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaṃ dhārayantaḥ ^ā gacchantviti śeṣaḥ ||
kiṃ svid‌vanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |
saṃtasthāne ajare itaūtī ahāni pūrvīṛṣaso jaranta ||

kim | svit | vanam | kaḥ | ū~ iti | saḥ | vṛkṣaḥ | āsa | yataḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | niḥ'tatakṣuḥ || saṃtasthāne iti sam'tasthāne | ajare iti | itaūtī itīnaḥ'ūtī | ahāni | pūrvīḥ | upasaḥ | jaranta || 7 ||
^yata: yasmādvṛkṣāt ^dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ^niṣṭatakṣuḥ devāḥ niḥśeṣeṇa kṛtavantaḥ ^sa: tādṛśa: ^vṛkṣa: ^ka ^u ^āsa kīdṛgvā babhūva |
^saṃtasthāne samyak‌tiṣṭhantau ^ajare jarāvarjite ^itaūtī ita etebhyo daṃtebhyo'rakṣaṇaṃ yathoste |
naitāvatenā puro anyadastyukṣā sa dyāvāpṛthivī bibharti |
tvacaṃ pavitraṃ kṛṇuta svadhāvāndīṃ sūrye na harito vahanti ||
na | etāvata | enā | puraḥ | anyat | asti | ukṣā | saḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | bibharti | tvacam | pavitram | kṛṇuta | svadhā'vān | yat | īm | sūryam | na | haritaḥ | vahanti ||8||
dyāvāpṛthivyāṃnirmāṇarūpam ^etāvata devajātaṃ sāmarthyena yuktamiti ^na api tu ^enā etebhyo devebhya: ^para: utkṛṣṭa: ^anyat anyo hiraṇyagarbha: ^asti |
hiraṇyagarbha: paramasūkṣmo vāyurūpo liṅgātmā apa: praviśya ^dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ^bibharti dhāra- yati |
kiṃca ^svadhāvān balavānjñavān vā sa hiraṇyagarbha: ^pavitraṃ pavitramayaṃ ^tvacam ātmīyaṃ śarīraṃ dīptaṃ mantraṃ vā ^kṛṇuta karoti |
^yat yadā ^īm imāṃ ^tvacaṃ ^harita: aśvā: ^sūrye ^na ^vahanti na prāpayanti tadeti |
stego na kṣāmatyeti pṛthivīṃ mihaṃ na vāto vi ha vāti bhūma |
mitro yatra varuṇo ajyamāno'gnirvanai na vyasṛṣṭa śokam ||
stegaḥ | na | kṣām | ārti | eti | pṛthivīm | miham | na | vātaḥ | vi | ha | vāti | bhūma | mitraḥ | yatra | varuṇaḥ | ^ajyamānaḥ | agniḥ | vanai | na | vi | asṛṣṭa | śokam || 9 ||
raśmisaṃghātī āditya: ^pṛṣṭhavīṃ vistīrṇāṃ ^kṣāṃ bhūmiṃ tejasā ^na ^atyeti nātigacchati |
^vāta: vāyurapi khalu ^bhūma bhūmiṃ ^mihaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ ^na ^vi ^vāti samartho'pi san vividhaṃ na gamayati |
bhūmiṃ prati sāva- śeṣameva varṣayatīti’ vāta: stūyate |
^śokaṃ svīyāṃ dīptiṃ ^vyasṛṣṭa visṛjati sarvato vikṣipati tathā ^varuṇa: ca vyaktībhavan^2 svadīptiṃ vikṣipati |
^agni: deva: ^vane ^na yathā vṛkṣasaṃghāte svadīptiṃ sarvato visṛjati tadvat |
stūrīyatsūkta sadyo ajyamānā vyathiryūthīḥ kṛṇuta svagaupā |
putro yatpūrvaḥ pitrorjaniṣṭa śamyāṃ gaurjagāra yadve pṛcchān ||
stūrīḥ | yat | sūta | sadyaḥ | ajyamānā | vyathiḥ | anyathīḥ | kṛṇuta | svagaupā | putraḥ | yat | pūrvaḥ | pitroḥ | janiṣṭa | śamyām | gauḥ | jagāra | yat | ha | pṛcchān || 10 ||

ᐯsadyaḥ śīghram ᐯajyamānā niṣidhyamānetaraskā satī ᐯyat yadā ᐯsūta vatsaṃ prasūte tadā ᐯvyathiḥ duḥkhānāṃ bādha- yitrī ᐯsvagopā svāyattagoptrakā svabhunarakṣaṇā vā satī sā gauḥ ᐯanyathīḥ vyathārahitāḥ prajāḥ ᐯkṛṇuta karoti |
yadā śamī putrasthānīyamaśvatthaṃ prasūte tadānīmaraṇyaharaṇāya tādṛśamaśvatthamanviṣya- tāmṛtvijāmaśvatthasya janayitrī śamī sukhaheturbhavatītyarthaḥ |
ᐯpitroḥ janayitroraraṇyayoḥ sakāśāt ᐯyat yadā ᐯjaniṣṭa mathanena prādurbhavati tadānīṃ ᐯgauḥ pṛthivī tayoraraṇyayormātṛbhūtāṃ ᐯśamyām aśvatthagarbhāṃ tāṃ śamīm |
ᐯyadva yāṃ khalu śamīṃ ᐯpṛcchān ṛtvijaḥ pṛcchanti vīpsanti gaveṣayanti ||
uta kaṇvaṃ nṛpadaḥ putramāhuruta śyāvo dhanamādatta vājī |
uta | kaṇvam | nṛ'padaḥ | putram | āhuḥ | uta | śyāvaḥ | dhanam | ā | adatta | vājī | pra | kṛṣṇāya | ruśat | apinvat | ūdhaḥ | ṛtam | atra | nakiḥ | asmai | apīpet || 11 ||
ᐯuta api ca ᐯkaṇvam ṛṣiṃ ᐯnṛpadaḥ 'putramāhuḥ vedavādino vadanti |
ᐯuta api ca ᐯvājī havirlakṣaṇāśvavān kaṇvaḥ ᐯśyāvaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ sañsmādagneḥ sakāśāt ᐯdhanamādatta agṛhṇāt |
ᐯkṛṣṇāya śyāmavarṇāya nārthadāya kaṇavāyāgneḥ ᐯūdhaḥ ᐯruśat rocamānarūpaṃ ᐯpra ᐯapinvat prāsiñcat |
ᐯatra itthamagnyatiriktaḥ kaścidapi devaḥ ᐯasmai kaṇavāya ᐯṛtaṃ yajñaṃ ᐯnakiḥ ᐯapīpet nāvardhayat |
'pra su mantā' iti navarcaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sūktam | āditaḥ pañca jagatyaḥ | atha ṣatastriṣṭubhaḥ | pūrvadṛṣṭipadete | tathā ca tukrāntaṃ—'pra su mantā nava pañcādyā jagatyaḥ' iti | gato viniyogaḥ ||

^ye tvadīyā adhāḥ ^muhuḥ punaḥpunaḥ ^adhvarān asmadīyān yajñān prati ^tvā tvām ^upa^ vahanti samīpe prāpayanti ^te aśvāḥ ^vavanān vacanena stutyā saṃbhaktṛn ^arādhasaḥ dhana- rahitānasmān ^su^ suṣṭhu ^vanvantu dhanapradānārthaṃ saṃbhajantām ||
tadinmai chantasrdhūpuṣo vapuṣṭaraṃ putro yajjānaṃ pitroradhīyati |
jāyā patiṃ vahati vagunā mumatapuṃsa indro vahatuḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ ||

vapuṣmato'pi ^vapuṣṭaraṃ rūpavattaramatyantaṃ surūpaṃ ^tat yajña- karma ^me mahyaṃ ^chansat indraḥ kāmayatām |

suvahyāhvānakāle'mukaśarmaṇaḥ putro yajata ityātmano janma saṃkīrtayati |
yajananādāgataṃ dhanaṃ pitroḥ sakāśātputro'dhigacchati tadeva mahamicchatu |
^jāyā patnī ^patiṃ yajamānaṃ ^sumata kalyāṇaṇe ^vamunā vāgrūpeṇa śabdena ^vahati ātmasamīpaṃ prāpayati |
taduktaṃ--' subhadramarya bhojanaṃ bibharpi ' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 1. 34) iti |

yata āgatya prakāśa- yet yatra kāraṇamāha |
arcakasya mama svabhūtā ^mātā devatāguṇānāṃ niṣpādayitrī stutiḥ ^yūthasya yaṣṭotṝgaṇasya ^pūrvyā prathamabhāvinī khalu |
saptacchandaskaḥ saptartukaḥ sapta- hotrātmako vayaṃ ^janaḥ ^vāṇasya stutiśabdasya ^abhi kartā khalu |
yasmin sthāne dhenavaḥ payaḥpradānena prīṇa- yiṣyo gāvo vahatum |
tathā yasmin manturmantavyā pūjanīyā putrasamūhasya mātābhigacchati vāṇasya vācasya saptadhāturnipādādisasvaropeto jano'bhigacchati tadvattadupopetaṃ prayaccheti bhāvaḥ ||
pra vo'cchā ririce devayuṣpadamekoṃ rudrairyāti turvaṇiḥ |

he yajamānāḥ ^devayuḥ devān kāmayamāno hotā ^vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ^padam ^accha sthānaṃ prati ^pra ^ririce pariklī'bhūtaḥ |
atha ^hotrabhyaḥ^6 sakāśāt ^ekaḥ mukhya indraḥ ^rudraiḥ rudraputraiḥ marudbhiḥ saha ^turvaṇiḥ kṣiprāgāmī san ^yāti gacchati yuṣmadīyaṃ yajñam |
