akṣetravitkṣetravidaṃ hyaprāṭ sa praiti kṣetravidānuśiṣṭaḥ | etadvai bhadramanuśāsanasyota sutiṃ vindatyaṅ‌gasīnām || 7|| akṣetravit | kṣetravidam | hi | aprāṭ | saḥ | pra | eti | kṣetravidā | anuśiṣṭaḥ | etat | vai | bhadram | anuśāsanasya | uta | sutim | vindati | aṅ‌gasīnām || 7||
panthānamajānan puruṣaḥ kṣetravidaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ puruṣam aprāṭ pṛṣṭavān |
saḥ kṣetravidā pathijñena tena anuśiṣṭaḥ pradarśitamārgaḥ san praiti svābhilaṣitaṃ deśaṃ gacchati |
anuśāsanasya mārgo- padeśarūpasya etadvai etatkhalu bhadraṃ bhajanīyaṃ kalyāṇakaram |
uta api ca aṅ‌gasīnām ṛjunā mārgeṇa gantavyānāmapāṃ sutiṃ mārgaṃ pipāsitaḥ san vindati labhate |

aghedu prāṇīdamannimāhāpīṃvrato adhyayanamātururdhaḥ | emainamāpa jarimā yuvānaṃmahailanvasuḥ sumanā babhūva || 8|| agha | ita | ū~ iti | pra | ānīt | armana | imā | ahā | arpi'vṛtaḥ | adhyanat | mātuḥ | ūdhaḥ | ā | īm | enam | āpa | jarimā | yuvānam | ahailan | vasuḥ | muḍabhanāḥ | babhūva || 8||
ayamagniḥ agnena atauvāśmindine prāṇān mathanena naṣṭito'bhavat |
tadānīmeva imā imāni ahā ahāni saumikāni amaman netumamanyata |
api ca arpāvṛtaḥ tejobhiḥ parivṛtaḥ man mātuḥ pṛthivyāḥ ūdhaḥ sārabhūtaṃ somādikaṃ haviḥ adhyanat pibati |
tathā yuvānaṃ nityataruṇaṃ devānāṃ haviṣā miśrayantaṃ vā enam agni jarimā jaratiḥ stutikarmā |
stotṛbhiḥ kriyamāṇā stutiḥ āpa ābhimukhyena vyāpnoti |
tataḥ ahelan akudhyan stotṛprati vasuḥ vāsayitā sarveṣāṃ dhanadānenācchādayitā tejobhiḥ śatrūṇāṃ vā vasumān vāgbhiḥ sumanāḥ śobhanamanasko babhūva ||
sa ca pṛṣṭhobhigaṃtavyamena mārgeṇeti vadati tataḥ puruṣaḥ; ta-kṣetrajñaṃ puruṣamaprāṭ pṛṣṭavān; ta3-bha5.6-pathijñe hi yasmāt aprāṭ pṛcchati |
sa ca kadābhigaṃtavyamānena mārgeṇa iti tataḥ sa puruṣaḥ; bha1.2.4.7- ‘kṣetrajñaṃ...saḥ’ nāsti |
etāni bhadrā kalaśa kriyām kuruśravaṇa dardato maghāni |
dāna iddhau maghavānaḥ so astvayaṃ ca somo hṛdi yaṃ bibharmi ||
etāni | bhadrā | kalaśa | kriyām | kuru'śravaṇa | dardataḥ | maghāni | dānaḥ | it | vaḥ | magha'vānaḥ | saḥ | astu | ayam | ca | somaḥ | hṛdi | yam | bibharmi ||9||
teṣāṃ svabhūtānāṃ stutīnāṃ śrotarhe indra maghāni dhanāni stotṛbhyo yaṣṭṛbhyaśca dadataḥ prayacchatavendrasyārtham etāni bhadrā bhajanīyāni havīṃṣi stotrāṇi ca kriyām vidheyāsma |
he maghavānaḥ mahanīyastotrarūpadhanavantaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saḥ indraḥ dāna it dhanāderdataiva astu bhavatu |
ayaṃ ca yajñe sthitaḥ somaḥ dātāstu hṛdaye ātmīye yaṃ pītaṃ somaṃ bibharmi dhārayāmi |
he kalaśakulajāta he kuruśravaṇaitannāmaka trasadasyoḥ putra rājan ṛtvigbhyo dhanāni prayacchataḥ tavārthaṃ vayaṃ karmāṇi kriyāma |
evaṃ yāgakarma kurvāṇasya tavendro dātā bhavatu |
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukabhūpālasāmrājya- dhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśa ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye saptamaṣṭake saptamo'dhyāyaḥ ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra 'pra mā' iti navarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktamailūvasya kavaṣasyārṣam |
'kuru- śravaṇāvṛṇi' iti dvābhyāṃ trasadasyuputrasya kuruśravaṇanāmno rājño dānaṃ tuṣṭāva |
atha 'yasya prasvādasaḥ' ityādibhiścatasṛbhirmitrātithināmni rājñi paralokaṃ gate śokābhibhūtaṃ tasya putramupaśravaṇātmānaṃ kavaṣa ṛṣiḥ snehavaśādabhigamya vigataśokamakarot |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'pra māyā vaiśvadevyendraḥ pragāthaḥ parā gāyatryo dve kuruśravaṇasya trāsadasasya dānastutiḥ parābhirmṛte mitrātithau rājñi tasnehādadhipamaśravamaṃ putramasya vyaśokayat' iti |
pra mā yuyuje prayujo janānāṃ vahāmi sma pūṣaṇamantareṇa |
viśve devāso adhu māmarakṣan duḥśāsurāgāditi ghoṣa āsīt ||
pra | mā | yuyuje | pra'yujaḥ | janānām | vahāmi | sma | puṣaṇam | antareṇa | viśve | devāsaḥ | artha | mām | arakṣan | duḥśāsuḥ | ā | agāt | iti | ghoṣaḥ | āsīt || 1 ||
^janānāṃ yajamānānāṃ ^prayujaḥ prayoktāro devāḥ ^mā māṃ kavaṇamṛṣi ^pra ^yuyuje kuruśravaṇaṃ prati yuktavantaḥ |
^antareṇa mārge ^pūṣaṇaṃ devam adhvanāṃ patiṃ sakhāyamahaṃ ^vahāmi ^sma uḍhavānasmi |
tathā śrūyate—'aindrāgnekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapejjananāmetyan' ityupakramya 'pauṣṇaṃ carumanu nirvapet' (tai. saṃ. 2.2.1.4) iti |
^duḥśāsuḥ kenāpi duḥśāsano'yamṛṣiḥ ^āgāt āgacchati ^iti ^ghoṣaḥ śabdaśca mārge ^āsīt abhūt ||
ni bādhate amartirnamṛtā jasurvenaṃ vevīyate matiḥ ||

sam | mā | tapanti | abhitaḥ | supatnīḥ | iva | paśavaḥ | ni | bādhate | amartiḥ | namratā | jasuḥ | veḥ | na | vevīyate | matiḥ || 2 || ^mā māṃ devatāprasādarahitaṃ kavaṇaṃ ^paśavaḥ pārśvasthīni annābhāvādaurbalyāt kuśayanācca ^sapatnīriva yathā sapattyastadvat ^abhitaḥ ubhayataḥ ^saṃ tapanti duḥkhayantītyarthaḥ | kiṃca ^amatiḥ dāridrādāgatā durmatiḥ sarvārthaviṣayā sā ^māṃ ^ni ^bādhate māṃ pīḍayati | vastrābhāvādāgatā ^namratā ca māṃ ni bādhate | ^jasuḥ aśnābhāvādāgata upakṣayo'pi māṃ ni bādhate | kiṃca ^verna yathā pakṣiṇaḥ matiḥ śākuninyādhabhayāt^ kampayate tathā me ^matiḥ śatroḥ ^vevīyate bhṛśaṃ kampayate ||
mūṣo na śikṣā vyadanti mādhyaḥ stotāraṃ te śatakato |
sakṛtsu nau maghavannindra mṛḻayādhā piteva no bhava ||

mūṣaḥ | na | śikṣā | vi | adanti | mā | ā'dyaḥ | stotāram | te | śatakato iti śata'krato | sakṛt | su | naḥ | maghavan | indra | mṛḻaya | adha | pitā'iva | naḥ | bhava || 3 || he ^śatakrato bahukarman ^maghavan dhanavan ^indra ^te tava ^stotāraṃ ^mā māṃ kavaṇam ^ādyaḥ ādyaḥ ^mūṣo ^na yathā mūṣikāḥ ^śibhā āsanātāni sūtrāṇi abhanti tathā ^vyadanti vividhamadanti | tathā ca yāskaḥ—'saṃtapanti māmabhitaḥ sapatnya ivemāḥ paśavaḥ kūpaparśāvo mūṣikā ighāsnātāni sūtrāṇi vyadanti | svāṅgābhidhānaṃ vā^ syācchiābhāni vyadantīti^ | saṃtapanti mādhyaḥ kāmāḥ' (niru. 4. 6) iti | tathā ca sati ^naḥ asmān ^sakṛt ^su ^mṛḻaya abhīṣṭapradānena samyak sukhaya | ^adha atha ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^piteva yathā pitā tadvadrakṣitā ^bhava ||
kuru'śravaṇam | avṛṇi | rājānam | trāsadasyavam | maṃhiṣṭham | vāghatām | ṛṣiḥ || 4 ||

ṛṣiḥ atīndriyārthadraṣṭā kavaṣo'haṃ trāsadasyavaṃ trasadasyoḥ putraṃ maṃ hiṣṭhaṃ dhanānāmatiśayena dātāraṃ kuruśravaṇam|
tadīyānāṃ stutīnāṃ śrotāraṃ kuruśravaṇaṃ nannāmakaṃ rājānaṃ vāghanām ṛtvijāmarthāya avṛṇi dhanāni prārthaye ||
yasya mā harito rathe tisro vahanti sādhuyā | stavai sahasradakṣiṇe || 5 || yasya | mā | haritaḥ | rathe | tisraḥ | vahanti | sādhuyā | stavai | sahasra'dakṣiṇe || 5 ||
yasya kuruśravaṇākhyasya rājñaḥ svabhūtāḥ tisraḥ haritaḥ trayo'śvāḥ rathe prasthitaṃ mā māṃ kavaṣaṃ sādhuyā mā'śu vahanti kuruśravaṇaṃ rājānamahaṃ sahasradakṣiṇe asmin yāge stavai staumi |
ataḥ paraṃ 'yasya' ityādikena sūktaśeṣeṇa mitrātithau rājñi mṛte tatputrasyopamaśravasaḥ samīpa- māgatya kavaṣaḥ snehācchokaṃ nivārayati ||
yasya prasvādaso gira upamaśravasaḥ pituḥ | kṣetraṃ na rvamucuṣe || 6 || yasya | prasvādasaḥ | giraḥ | upama'śravasaḥ | pituḥ | kṣetram | na | rvam | ūcuṣe || 6 ||
he rājan upamaśravasaḥ tava pituḥ yasya mitrātitheḥ giraḥ vācaḥ prasvādasaḥ prakarṣeṇa svādayiṣyaḥ |
ūcuṣe sevamānāya daridrāya dānārthaṃ prakalpitaṃ rvaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ kṣetraṃ na yathā kṣetraṃ svādayituṃ tadvadiṣṭyarthaḥ |
adhi putropamaśravo napānmitrātitherihi | pituṣṭe asmi vanditā || 7 || adhi | putra | upama'śravaḥ | napāt | mitra'atithe | ihi | pituḥ | te | asmi | vanditā ||7||
he putra upamaśravaḥ mitrātithe napāt putra tvam adhi ihi matsamapamāgaccha |
te tava pituḥ tasya mitrātitherahaṃ vanditā stotā asmi |
yadīśīyāmṛtaṃ nāmuta vā martyānām | jīvedinmaghavā mama || 8 || yat | īśīya | amṛtām | uta | vā | martyānām | jīvet | it | maghavā | mama || 8 ||
uta api ca yat yadi amṛtānāṃ devānāṃ martyānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vā maraṇahetūnām īśīya ahamīśvaraḥ syāṃ tarhi mama kavaṣasya yājyaḥ maghavā dhanavān mitrātithī rājā jīvet prāṇān dhārayet |
tathā ca nāhaṃ maraṇahetorīśvaraḥ tasmādayaṃ rājā mṛta ityarthaḥ ||
na devānamarti vrataṃ śatārmā cana jīvati | tardhā yujā vi vavṛte || 9 || na | devānām | ati | vratam | śata'ātmā | cana | jīvati | tardhā | yujā | vi | vavṛte ||9||
devānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ vrataṃ maryādālakṣaṇaṃ karma ati atikramya śatārmā cana śatasaṃvatsaraḥ kaścana na jīvati |
tathā yujā sahāyādinā vi vavṛte vivartate viyukto bhavatīti jñātvā śokaṃ mā kurvityarthaḥ ||

‘prāvepāḥ’ iti caturdaśacaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktamailūṣasya kaṣapasyārṣaṃ mujavataḥ putrasyākṣāsya vā |
atra dvādaśī akṣān stauti navamyādyā ca saptamī |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ--‘prāvepāḥ pañcanā maujavānkṣākṣa- kṛṣipraśaṃsā cākṣakitavanindā ca saptamī jagatī’ iti |
prāvepā mā bṛhato mādayanti pravātejā iriṇe varvṛtānāḥ |
prāvepāḥ | mā | bṛhataḥ | mādayanti | pravātejāḥ | iriṇe | varvṛtānāḥ | somasya'iva | maujavatasya | bhakṣaḥ | vibhīdakaḥ | jāgṛviḥ | mahyam | acchān || 1 ||
‘bṛhataḥ mahato vibhītakasya phalatvena saṃbandhin : ‘pravātejāḥ pravaṇe deśe jātāḥ ‘iriṇe āsphāre ‘varvṛtānāḥ pravartamānāḥ ‘prāvepāḥ pravepiṇaḥ kampanaśīlā akṣāḥ ‘mā māṃ ‘mādayanti harṣayanti |
kiṃca ‘jāgṛviḥ jayaparājayayorharṣaśokābhyāṃ kitavānāṃ jāgaraṇasya kartā ‘vibhīdakaḥ vibhītakavikāro'kṣo ‘mahaṃ mām ‘acchān acchadat arthyaṃ mādayati |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘pravepiṇo mā mahato vibhītakasya phalāni mādayanti |
pravātejāḥ pravaṇejā iriṇe vartamānā iriṇaṃ nirṛṇamṛṇaterapāṇaṃ bhavatyaparatā asmādoṣadhaya iti vā |

somasyeva maujavatasya bhakṣo maujavatāṃ mujavati jāto mujavān parvato mujavān muñjo vimucyata’ ipīkayepīkatergatikramaṇaṃ’ iyamapītarepīkaitasmādeva vibhītakāṃ vibhedanājāgṛvirjāgaraṇānmahyamacchadat’ (niru. 9. 8) iti ||
na mā mimetha na jihīḻa eṣā śivā sakhibhya uta mahyamāsīt |
na | mā | mimetha | na | jihīḻe | eṣā | śivā | sakhibhyaḥ | uta | mahyam | āsīt | akṣasya | aham | eka'parasya | hetoḥ | anu'vratām | apa | jāyām | arodham || 2 ||
‘eṣā asmadīyā jāyā ‘mā māṃ kitavaṃ ‘na mimetha na cukrodha ‘na jihīḻe na ca lajjitavatī |
ittham ‘anuvratām anukūlāṃ ‘jāyām ‘ekaparasya ekaḥ paraḥ pradhānaṃ yasya tasya ‘akṣasya ‘hetoḥ kāraṇāt ‘aham ‘apa ‘arodhaṃ parityaktavānasmītyarthaḥ ||
dveṣṭi śvaśrūrpa jāyā ruṇaddhi na nāthito vindate marḍitāram |
aśvasyeva jarato vastyasya nāhaṃ vindāmi kitavasya bhogam ||
dveṣṭi | śvaśrūḥ | apa | jāyā | ruṇaddhi | na | nāthitaḥ | vindate | marḍitāram | aśvasya'iva | jarataḥ | vastyasya | na | aham | vindāmi | kitavasya | bhogam || 3 ||
vśvaśrū: jāyāyā mātā gṛhagataṃ kitavaṃ vdveṣṭi nindatītyarthaḥ|
kiṃca vjāyā bhāryā vapa vruṇaddhi niruṇaddhi|
api ca vnāthitaḥ yācamānaḥ kitavo' dhanaṃ vmarḍitāraṃ dhanadānena sukhayitāraṃ vna vvindate na labhate|
itthaṃ buddhayā vimṛśan vahaṃ vjarataḥ vṛddhasya vvastasya|
tadaīsya vaśvasyeva vkitavasya vbhogaṃ vna vvindāmi na labhe ||
anye jāyā pariṃ mṛśantyasya yasyāgadhredane vājyakṣaḥ |
pitā mātā bhrātara enamāhurna jānīmo nayatā baddhametam ||
anye | jāyām | pari | mṛśanti | asya | yasya | agṛdhrata | vedane | vājī | akṣaḥ | pitā | mātā | bhrātaraḥ | enam | āhuḥ | na | jānīmaḥ | nayatā | baddham | etam || 4 ||
vyasya kitavasya vvedane dhane vvājī balavān vakṣaḥ devaḥ vagṛdhrat abhikāṅkṣāṃ karoti tasya vasya kita

akṣāsa idaṅkuśino nitodino nikṛtvāṃstapanāstāpayiṣṇavaḥ| kumāradeṣṇā jayataḥ punaharṇo madhvā saṃpṛktāḥ kitavasya barhaṇā || 7 || akṣāsaḥ | ita | aṅkuśinaḥ | nitodinaḥ | nikṛtvāṃna | tapanāḥ | tāpayiṣṇavaḥ | kumāradeṣṇāḥ | jayataḥ | punaḥharnaḥ | madhvā | samapṛktāḥ | kitavasya | barhaṇā || 7 || vakṣāsa vit akṣa eva vaṅkuśinaḥ aṅkuśavantaḥ vnitodinaḥ nitoditavantaśca vnikṛ- tvānaḥ parājaye nikartanaśīlāḥ kṣetratāro vā vtapanāḥ parājaye kitavasya saṃtāpakāḥ vtāpayiṣṇavaḥ sarvasva- hārakatvena kuṭumbasya saṃtāpanśīlaśca bhavanti | kiṃca vjayataḥ vkitavasya vkumāradeṣṇāḥ dhanadānena dhanyatāṃ labhyantaḥ kumārāṇāṃ dātāro bhavanti | api ca vmadhvā madhunā vsaṃpṛktāḥ pratikitavena vbarhaṇā parivṛddhena sarvasvaharaṇena kitavasya vpunarhaṇaḥ punarhantāro bhavanti ||

tripañcāśaḥ krīḻati vrāta eṣāṃ devaiva savitā satyadharmā | ugrasya cinmanyave nā namante rājā cidebhyo nama itakṛṇoti || 8 || tripañcāśaḥ | krīḻati | vrātaḥ | eṣām | devaḥ iva | savitā | satyadharmā | ugrasya | cit | manyave | na | namante | rājā | cit | ebhyaḥ | namaḥ | it | kṛṇoti || 8 || veṣām akṣṇāṃ vtripañcāśaḥ adhikapañcāśatsaṃkhyākaḥ vvrātaḥ saṃghaḥ vkrīḻati āsphāre viharati | akṣikāḥ prāyeṇa tāvajjharakṣairdīvyanti hi | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | vsatyadharmā vsavitā sarvasya jagataḥ prerakaḥ sūryo vdevaiva | yathā savitā devo jagati viharati tadvadakṣāṇāṃ saṃgha āsphāre viharatītyarthaḥ | kiṃca vugrasya vcit krūrasyāpi vmanyave krodhāya ete akṣāḥ vna vnamante na prahvībhavanti | na vaśe vartante | taṃ na namantītyarthaḥ | vrājā vcit jagata īśvara'pi vebhyaḥ vnama vit namaskārameva devanavelāyāṃ vkṛṇoti | nāvajñāṃ karotītyarthaḥ ||

nīcā vartanta upari sphurantyahastāso hastaṃvantaṃ sahante | divyā aṅgārā iriṇe nyuptāḥ śītāḥ santo hṛdayaṃ nirdahanti || 9 || nīcā | vartante | upari | sphuranti | ahastāsaḥ | hastaṃvantam | sahante | divyāḥ | aṅgārāḥ | iriṇe | ni'uptāḥ | śītāḥ | santaḥ | hṛdayam | nirdahanti || 9 || api caite'kṣāḥ vnīcā nīcīnasthale vvartante | tathāpi vupari parājayāt bhītānāṃ dyūtakārāṇāṃ hṛdayasyopari vsphuranti | vahastāsaḥ hastarahitā apyakṣāḥ vhastaṃvantaṃ dyūtakaraṃ kitavaṃ vsahante parājayakaraṇenābhibhavanti | vdivyāḥ divi bhavā apakṛtāḥ vaṅgārāḥ aṅgārasadṛśā akṣāḥ viriṇe indhanarahite āsphāre vnyuptāḥ vśītāḥ śītasparśāḥ vsantaḥ api vhṛdayaṃ kitavānāntaḥ- karaṇaṃ vnirdahanti parājayajanitasaṃtāpena bhasmīkurvanti ||
2. ga-tamapi jayantītyarthaḥ; ta1.2.5.6-tamayetītyarthaḥ; ta4-ma1.2.4.7- tamapi yaṃtītyarthaḥ; ta7-na namayatītyarthaḥ; bha6-namayatītyarthaḥ |

jāyā tapyate kitavasya hīnā mātā putrasya carataḥ kaṃ stvat | ṛṇāvā bibhyaddhanamicchamāno'nyeṣā mastamupa naktameti || 10 || jāyā | tapyate | kitavasya | hīnā | mātā | putrasya | carataḥ | kaṃ | stvat | ṛṇa'vā | bibhyat | dhanam | icchamānaḥ | anyeṣām | astam | upa | naktam | eti || 10 ||
ᵥka ᵥstvāt kāpi ᵥcarataḥ nirvedādgacchataḥ ᵥkitavasya ᵥjāyā bhāryā ᵥhīnā parityaktā satī ᵥtapyate viyogajasaṃtāpena' saṃtasā bhavati |
ᵥmātā jananyapi ᵥputrasya ᵥkāpi carataḥ kitavasya saṃbandhāhīnā' tapyate |
ᵥṛṇāvā akṣaparājayāhaṇavān kitavaḥ sarvato ᵥbibhyaddhanaṃ steyajanitam ᵥicchamānaḥ kāmayamānaḥ ᵥanyeṣāṃ brāhmaṇādīnām ᵥastaṃ gṛham |
akṣaiḥ | mā | dīvyaḥ | kṛṣim | it | kṛṣasva | vitte | ramasva | bahu | manyamānaḥ | tatra | gāvaḥ | kitava | tatra | jāyā | tat | me | vi | caṣṭe | sritā | ayam | aryaḥ ||13||
he kitava bahu manyamānaḥ madvacane viśvāsaṃ kurvastvam akṣaimāṃ dīvyaḥ dhūtaṃ mā kuru |
vitte kṛṣyā saṃpādite dhane ramasva ratiṃ kuru |
tat eva dharmarahasyaṃ śrutismṛtikartā savitā sarvasya prerakaḥ ayaṃ dṛṣṭigocaraḥ aryaḥ īśvaraḥ vi caṣṭe vividhamākhyātavān ||
mitraṃ kṛṇudhvaṃ khalu mṛḻatā no mā nau ghoreṇa caratābhi dhṛṣṇu |
ni vo nu manyurviśatāmarātiranyo babhrūṇāṃ prasitā nvastu ||
mitram | kṛṇudhvam | khalu | mṛḻata | naḥ | mā | naḥ | ghoreṇa | carata | abhi | dhṛṣṇu | ni | vaḥ | nu | manyuḥ | viśatām | arātiḥ | anyaḥ | babhrūṇām | pra'sitau | nu | astu ||14||
he akṣāḥ yūyaṃ mitraṃ kṛṇudhvam asmāsu maitrīṃ kuruta |
ghoreṇa asahena mā abhi carata mā gacchata |
kiṃca vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ manyuḥ krodhaḥ arātiḥ asmākaṃ śatruḥ ni viśatām asmacchatruṣu tiṣṭhatu |
anyaḥ asmākaṃ śatruḥ kaścit babhrūṇāṃ babhruvarṇānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ prasitau prabandhane nu kṣipram astu bhavatu ||
‘abudhram’ iti caturdaśarcaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktaṃ dhanakaputrasya luśasyārṣam |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘abudhraṃ luśo dhānāko vaiśvadevaṃ tu dvitriṣṭubhantaṃ tu’ iti |
ekādaśinasya vaiśvadevasya paśorvapā- yāgasyānuvākyā ‘viśve adya’ ityeṣā |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘viśve adya maruto viśva uttyā no devānāmupa vetu śaṃsaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti ||
abudhramu tya indravanto agrayo jyotirbharanta upaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
mahī dyāvāpṛthivī caitatāmapo'dyā devānām ā vṛṇīmahe ||
abudhram | tya | indra'vantaḥ | agrayaḥ | jyotiḥ | bharantaḥ | upasaḥ | vi'uṣṭiṣu | mahī | dyāvāpṛthivī | caitatām | apaḥ | adyā | devānām | ā | vṛṇīmahe ||1||
indravantaḥ yaṣṭavyatvenendrasambandhinaḥ tye te amī āvahanīyādayaḥ agnayaḥ uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu vyucchaneṣu tamasāṃ vivāsanakāleṣu jyotiḥ tejaḥ bharantaḥ dhārayantaḥ abudhraṃ prabuddhā āsan |
mahī mahatyau dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau apaḥ karma |
atha asminnahani devānām indrādīnām acaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ vayam ā vṛṇīmahe ||
anāgāstvaṃ sūryamupāsamīmahe bhadraṃ someḥ suvāno adya kṛṇotu naḥ ||
divaḥpṛthivyoḥ | arbaḥ | ā | vṛṇīmahe | mātṛn | sindhūn | parvatān | śaryaṇāvataḥ | anāgāḥ'tvam | sūryyam | upasam | īmahe | bhadram | somaḥ | suvānaḥ | adya | kṛṇotu | naḥ || 2 ||
divaḥpṛthivyoḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ kāryatvena saṃbandha avaḥ rakṣaṇaṃ vayam ā vṛṇīmahe |
kiṃca mātṛn lokasya nirmātṛn sindhūn śaryaṇāvataḥ sarasaḥ saṃbandhanaḥ parvatān śiloccayāṃśca tathā sūryyamupasaṃ ca anāgāstvaṃ karmavaiguṇyajanitapāparāhinyam īmahe vayaṃ yācāmahe |
kiṃca adya asminnahani naḥ asmākaṃ suvānaḥ abhigūyamāṇaḥ somaḥ bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ kṛṇotu karotu ||
dyāvā no adya pṛthivī anāgaso mahī triyatāṃ suvitārya mātarau |
dyāvā | naḥ | adya | pṛthivī iti | anāgasaḥ | mahī iti | trāyatām | suvitārya | mātarau | upāḥ | ucchantī | apa | bādhatām | adham | svasti | agnim | sam idhānam | īmahe || 3 ||
mahī mahyau mātarau mātarau sarvasya mātṛbhūte dyāvā pṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau adya asminnahani anāgasaḥ aparādharahitān naḥ asmān suvitāya suvāya trāyatāṃ rakṣatām |
kiṃca ucchantī tamāṃsi vivāsayantī upāḥ asmākam aghaṃ pāpam apa bādhatām apanayatu |
api ca samidhānaṃ samyagdīpyamānaṃ agniṃ svasti sarvaprakārāvināśam īmahe vayaṃ yācāmahe ||
iyaṃ na ussā prathamā sudevyai revatsunibhyo revatī vyucchatu |
āre manyuṃ durvividrasya dhīmahi svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
iyam | naḥ | ussā | prathamā | sudevyam | revat | sunibhyaḥ | revatīṃ | vi | ucchatu | āre | manyum | duḥ'vidrasya | dhīmahi | svasti | agnim | sam idhānam | īmahe || 4 ||

revatī dhanavatī prathamā mukhyā iyam ussā pāpānamutsāriṇī upāḥ sudevyaṃ śobhanadevāī revat dhanavat pradhānayāgakālatvaṃ sanibhyaḥ bhajamānebhyaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ prayacchantī vyucchatu tamāṃsi vivāsayatu |
kiṃca durvividrasya durdhanasya puruṣasya manyuṃ krodham āre dūre dhīmahi nidadhmahe |
pra yāḥ sistrate sūryyasya raśmibhirjyotirbharantīrupaso vyuṣṭiṣu |
bhadrā nau adya śravase vyucchata svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
pra | yāḥ | sistrate | sūryyasya | raśmi'bhiḥ | jyotiḥ | bharantīḥ | upasaḥ | vi'uṣṭiṣu | bhadrāḥ | naḥ | adya | śravase | vi | ucchata | svasti | agnim | sam idhānam | īmahe || 5 ||

yāḥ upasaḥ sūryyasya raśmibhiḥ kiraṇaiḥ pra sistrate saṃgacchante vyuṣṭiṣu vyucchaneṣu tamāṃsāṃ vivāsanakāleṣu jyotiḥ ātmīyaṃ tejaḥ bharantīḥ bharanti ca tā yūyaṃ naḥ asmākam adya asmin- hani śravase annāya bhadrāḥ bhajanīyā bhavata vyucchata tamāṃsi vivāsayata ca |

anamīvā uṣasa ā carantu na udrayau jihatāṃ jyotiṣā bṛhat | āyukṣātāmaśvinā tūtuji rathe svastyagniṃ samidhānamīmahe || 6 || anamīvāḥ | uṣasaḥ | ā | carantu | naḥ | ut | agrayaḥ | jihatām | jyotiṣā | bṛhat | ayukṣātām | aśvinā | tūtujim | ratham | svasti | agnim | sam | idhānam | īmahe || 6 || vanamīvāḥ rogarahitāḥ vuṣasaḥ vnaḥ asmān vā vcarantu āgacchantu | vbṛhat bṛhatā mahatā vjyotiṣā tejasā yuktāḥ vagrayaḥ api vut vjihatām udgacchantu | vaśvinā aśvināvapi vtūtuji kṣipragāminaṃ vratham vāyukṣātām | asmān pratyāgantuṃ rāsabhyāṃ yuktām | ‘harita ādityasya rāsabhāvaśvinoḥ’ ( ni. 1. 15. 3-4 ) iti pāṭhāt | siddhamanyat ||
śreṣṭhaṃ no adya savitarvareṇyaṃ bhāgamā suva sa hi ratnadhā asi |

vatha asminnahani vbarhiḥ vstarīmaṇi vedyāṃ staraṇe vmananmanaḥ mananīyasyābhīṣṭasya phalasya vmādhe sādhake vprāgjām abhipavarāpānānāṃ vyoge somena saha saṃyoge ca sati vadveṣaḥ dveṣavarji- tānādityān vīmahe vayamabhīṣṭaṃ yācāmahe |
he stotaḥ tvaṃ teṣām vādityānāṃ devānāṃ vśarmaṇi sukhe sthāne vā vsthāḥ tiṣṭha |
vbhuraṇyasi kartavyāni karmāṇi bibharṣi gacchasi vā |
ā nau barhiḥ sadhamāde bṛhadivi devā īḻe sādayā sapta hotan |
indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇa sātye bhagaṃ svastyagriṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
ā | naḥ | barhiḥ | sadha'māde | bṛhat | divi | devān | īḻe | sādaya | sapta | hotan | indram | mitram | varuṇam | sātyai | bhagam | svasti | agnim | sam'idhānam | īmahe || 10 ||
vnaḥ asmākaṃ vvṛhat vṛhati mahati vdivi dīpte vsadhamāde |
vbarhiḥ barhiṣi yajñe vsapta saptasaṃkhyākān vhotan vaṣaṭkartan vindraṃ vmitraṃ ca vvaruṇaṃ ca vbhagaṃ ca vdevān itarānapi yajñyān devān he agne tvam vā vsādaya |
agnerābhimukhyakaraṇam ‘ ihādya daivyaṃ janaṃ barhirā sādayā vaso ’ ( ṛ. saṃ. 1. 45. 9 ) ityevamādimantrairavagamyate |
tatra hyathā āsā- ditāṃstannindādīn devānahaṃ vsātye dhanalābhāya vīḻe staumi |
ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye vṛdhe nau yajñamavatā sajoṣasaḥ |
te | ādityāḥ | ā | gata | sarvatātaye | vṛdhe | naḥ | yajñam | avata | sa'joṣasaḥ | bṛhaspatim | pūṣaṇam | aśvinau | bhagam | svasti | agnim | sam'idhānam | īmahe || 11 ||
he vādityāḥ ye'smābhirāhatāḥ vte yūyaṃ vsarvatātaye yajñārtham vā vgata āgacchata |
āgatya ca he vsajoṣasaḥ saṃgatā yūyaṃ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vvṛdhe vardhanāya vyajñaṃ prati vavata gacchata |
vayaṃ ca vbṛhaspatiṃ vpūṣaṇaṃ ca vaśvinā aśvinau ca vbhagaṃ bhagasya devaṃ ca vsamidhānaṃ samyagdīptam vagniṃ ca vsvasti sarvaprakārāvināśam vīmahe yācāmahe ||
tanno devā yacchata suvācanaṃ chardiradityāḥ subharaṃ nṛpāyyam |
paśve tokāya tanayāya jīvasai svastyagriṃ samidhānamīmahe ||
tat | naḥ | devāḥ | yacchata | su'pravācanam | chardiḥ | ādityāḥ | su'bharam | nṛ'pāyyam | paśve | tokāya | tanayāya | jīvasai | svasti | agnim | sam'idhānam | īmahe || 12 ||

he vādityāḥ vdevāḥ yūyaṃ vsupravācanam atyantaṃ praśastaṃ vsubharaṃ sumahad vnṛpāyyaṃ nṛṇāṃ rakṣakaṃ vtat asmadabhilaṣitaṃ vchardiḥ gṛhaṃ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vpaśve paśave vtokāya’ putrāya vtanayāya pautrāya ca vjīvase jīvanārthaṃ vyacchata datta |
viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagrayaḥ samiddhāḥ |
viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||
viśve | adya | marutaḥ | viśve | ūtī | viśve | bhavantu | agnayaḥ | samiddhāḥ | viśve | naḥ | devāḥ | avasā | ā | gamantu | viśvam | astu | draviṇam | vājaḥ | asme iti || 13 ||
vaadya asminnahani pradhānayāgadivase vaviśve sarve vamarutaḥ vaviśve sarve marudgaṇasahacaritāḥ rudrādayo devāśca vaūtī ūtyai rakṣaṇāya bhavantu |
api ca vaviśve sarve vaagnayaḥ āhavanīyādayaḥ vasamiddhāḥ saṃdīptāḥ vabhavantu |
api ca vaviśve sarve indrādayaḥ vadevāḥ vanaḥ asmākam vaavasā rakṣaṇena vaā gamantu āgacchantu |
kiṃca vaasme asmāsu vaviśvaṃ sarvaṃ vadraviṇaṃ dhanaṃ vavājaḥ annaṃ ca vaastu bhavatu ||
yaṃ devāso'vatha vājasātau yaṃ trāyadhve yaṃ pipṛthātyahaḥ |

grāvā abhiṣavapāṣāṇaḥ vadan abhiṣavavelāyāṃ śabdaṃ kurvan rakṣāṃsi yāgavighnakārīṇi apa sedhatu vinivārayatu |

ᵥsuhavaṃ svāhvānaṃ ᵥpāvakaṃ śodhakam ᵥṛṣvaṃ darśanīyaṃ ᵥśaṃbhuvaṃ sukhasya bhāvayitāraṃ ᵥrāyaḥ dhanasya ᵥpoṣaṃ poṣakaṃ ᵥmārutaṃ marutāṃ saṃbandhanaṃ ᵥgaṇaṃ saṃghaṃ ᵥsadhryāya sakhibhāvāya ᵥupa ᵥhvaye upagamya hvayāmi |

tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘namo dvādaśa sauryo'bhitapāḥ sauryaṃ jāgataṃ vai triṣṭubdaśī’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘citraṃ devānāṃ namo mitrasya’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘vibhrāḍbṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhu namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣasa iti stotriyānurūpau’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 6) iti |
svapantamanyastamaye sati rātri śeṣaṃ sthitvā prātaḥ ‘yena sūrya jyotiṣā’ ityādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ sūrya upastheyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘adhyādhitaṃ cetsva- pantamādityo'bhyastamiyādvāgayatato'nupaviśan rātri śeṣaṃ bhūtvā yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tama iti pañcabhirādityamupatiṣṭheta’ (āśva. gṛ. 3.7.1) |
svapantamanyudite ‘yasya te viśvā’ ityādi- bhiścatasṛbhiḥ sūrya upastheyaḥ |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘abhyudiyāccetkarmaśāntamanabhirūpeṇa karmaṇā vāgyata iti samānamuttarābhistasṛbhirupasthānam’ (āśva. gṛ. 3. 7. 2) iti |

vivāhe kanyārodanīye ‘jīvaṃ rudantī’ ityeṣā japya (āśva. gṛ. 1. 8. 4) ||
namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tadṛtaṃ saparyana |

āpaḥ ca syandante viśvahā sarvadā sūryaḥ ca udeti |
na te adevaḥ pradivo ni vāsate yadetaśobhiḥ paturai ratharyasiṃ |
prācīnamanyadanu vartate raja udanven jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya ||

udyantaṃ tvā mitramaho divedive jyogjīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||

ārohantaṃ bṛhataḥ pārjasaspari vayaṃ jīvāḥ prati paśyema sūrya ||

mahiṃ | jyotiḥ | bibhratam | tvā | tri'cakṣaṇa | bhāsvantam | cakṣuṣe'cakṣuṣe | maryaḥ | ā'rohantam | bṛhat | pārjasaḥ | pari | vayam | jīvāḥ | prati | paśyema | sūrya || 8 || ha ᵥvicakṣaṇa bibhrataḥ ᵥsūrya ᵥmahi mahat ᵥjyotiḥ tejaḥ ᵥbibhrataṃ dhārayantaṃ ᵥbhāsvantaṃ dīsi- mantaṃ ᵥcakṣuṣecakṣuṣe sarveṣāṃ draṣṭṛṇāṃ cakṣupe ᵥmayaḥ sukhakaraṃ ᵥbṛhataḥ mahataḥ ᵥpājamaḥ balavataḥ ᵥpari | mahato balavataḥ samudrasyodakasyoparisthārthaḥ | ᵥārohantaṃ ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥjīvāḥ ciraṃ jīvantaḥ ᵥvayaṃ ᵥprati pratidinaṃ ᵥpaśyema ||

yasya te viśvā bhuvanāni ketunā pra cerate ni ca viśantai aktubhiḥ | anāgāstvena harikeśa sūryāhnā no vasyasāvasyasodihi || 9 || yasya | te | viśvā | bhuvanāni | ketunā | pra | ca | īrate | ni | ca | viśantai | aktu'bhiḥ | anāgāḥ'tvena | hari'keśa | sūrya | ahnā'ahnā | naḥ | vasyasā'vasyasā | ut | ihi || 9 || he ᵥharikeśa haritavarṇakeśa ᵥsūrya ᵥyasya ᵥte tava ᵥketunā prajñāne ᵥviśvā viśvāni ᵥbhuvanāni bhūtajātāni ᵥpra ca ᵥīrate prakarṣeṇa gacchanti ᵥaktubhiḥ rātribhiḥ ᵥni ᵥviśante ca viśrāmyanti ca | svapantītyarthaḥ | sa tvaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmākam ᵥanāgāstvena aparādhavarjitatvena ᵥvasyasā- vasyasā atyantaśreyaskareṇa vasumuttareṇa vā ᵥahnā tena tena divasena ᵥudihi udgaccha ||

śaṃ no bhava cakṣasā śaṃ no ahnā śaṃ bhānunā śaṃ himā śaṃ ghṛṇena | yathā śamadhvacchamasaṃduroṇe tatsūrya draviṇaṃ dhehi citram || 10 || śam | naḥ | bhava | cakṣasā | śam | naḥ | ahnā | śam | bhānunā | śam | himā | śam | ghṛṇena | yathā | śam | adhvan | śam | asat | duroṇe | tat | sūrya | draviṇam | dhehi | citram || 10 || he ᵥsūrya tvaṃ ᵥcakṣasā tejasā ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥśaṃ sukhakaraḥ ᵥbhava | ᵥahnā divasena ca ᵥśaṃ sukhakaraḥ ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ bhava | ᵥbhānunā raśminā ca ᵥśaṃ bhava asmākaṃ sukhakaro bhava | ᵥhimā śaityena ca ᵥśaṃ bhava | ᵥghṛṇena auṣṇeyena, ca śaṃkaro bhava | ᵥyathā yādṛśena ᵥnaḥ asmākam ᵥadhvan adhvani mārge ᵥśaṃ bhavati ᵥduroṇe gṛhe ca ᵥśaṃ sukham ᵥasat bhavati ᵥtat ᵥcitraṃ pūjanīyaṃ ᵥdraviṇaṃ dhanaṃ ᵥdhehi asmabhyaṃ prayaccha ||

asmākaṃ devā ubhayāya janmane śarma yacchata dvipade catuṣpade | adatpibadūrjayamānamāśitaṃ tadasme śaṃ yorapo dadhātana || 11 || asmākam | devāḥ | ubhayāya | janmane | śarma | yacchata | dvi'pade | catuḥ'pade | adat | pibat | ūrjyamānam | āśitam | tat | asme iti | śam | yoḥ | arapaḥ | dadhātana || 11 || he ᵥdevāḥ sūryeṇābhyanujñātā yūyam ᵥasmākaṃ ᵥdvipade manuṣyātmakāya ᵥcatuṣpade paśvātmakāya ca ᵥubhayāya ubhayavidhāya ᵥjanmane bhūtajātāya ᵥśarma sukhaṃ ᵥyacchata datta | kiṃca yathāsmātputrādikam ᵥadat bhakṣaṇīyaṃ bhakṣayat ᵥpibat pānīyaṃ pibat ᵥūrjyamānaṃ balavantamivātmānamācarat ᵥāśitaṃ
suhitaṃ ca bhavati tathā 'śaṃ rogaśāntinimittakaṃ sukhaṃ 'yo: viṣayayogajanitaṃ sukhaṃ ca 'arapa: apāpaṃ ca 'dhyātana prayacchata ||

yadau devāścakuma jihvayā guru manaso vā prayutī devheḻanam | arāvā yo nau abhi ducchunāyate tasmintadenoṃ vasavo ni dhaitana || 12 || yat | vaḥ | devāḥ | cakruma | jihvayā | guru | manasaḥ | vā | pra'yutī | deva'heḻanam | arāvā | yaḥ | naḥ | abhi | ducchunā'yate | tasmin | tat | enaḥ | vasavaḥ | ni | dhaitana ||12|| he 'vasavaḥ vāsayitāraḥ 'devāḥ 'vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ vayaṃ 'jihvayā vācā 'manasaḥ 'prayutī prayutyā prayogeṇa 'guru mahat 'devheḻanaṃ devadrohanaṃ ca 'yat 'enaḥ 'cakrama akārṣma 'yaḥ asmacchatruḥ 'naḥ asmān 'abhi prati 'arāvā gamanavān bhūtvā 'ducchunāyate pāpandyācarati asmānudvejayati vā 'tasmin asmacchatrau 'tat 'enaḥ asmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ 'ni 'dhaitana sūryasyājñayā nidhatta | sthāpayate- myarthaḥ || ||13||
apare tu tāṇḍyaśākhyāyanakā asya sūktasya muṣkaravānindro devatā luśa ṛṣiriti varṇayanti ||

asminna indra pṛtsutau yaśasvati śimīvati krandasi prāva sātaye | yatra gorpātā dhṛṣiteṣu khādiṣu viśvakapartanti divvoṃ nṛpāhai || 1 || asmin | naḥ | indra | pṛtsutau | yaśasvati | śimī'vati | krandasi | pra | atra | sātaye | yatra | go'pātā | dhṛṣiteṣu | khādiṣu | viśvak | patanti | divvaḥ | nṛ'sahai || 1 || he 'indra tvaṃ 'yaśasvati kīrtimati 'śimīvati parasparaprahāralakṣaṇakarmavati 'asmin upasthite 'pṛtsutau saṃgrāme 'krandasi siṃhanādaṃ karoṣi | 'sātaye dhanalābhāya 'prāva 'naḥ asmān prarakṣasi ca | kasminnityatrāha | 'yatra yasmin 'gopātā gāṃsātau labdhapaśuke 'nṛpāhye nṛṇāmabhibhāvuke ca saṃgrāme 'khādiṣu parasparakhādakeṣu ca yoddhṛṣu 'dhṛṣiteṣu dhṛṣṭeṣu satsu 'divvaḥ āyudhāni 'viśvak sarvataḥ 'patanti ||

sa naḥ kṣumantaṃ sadane vyūrṇuhi goarṇasaṃ rayiminra śravāyyam | syāma te jayataḥ śakra medino yathā vayamuśmasi tadvaso kṛdhi || 2 || saḥ | naḥ | kṣu'mantam | sadane | vi | ūrṇuhi | go'arṇasam | rayim | indra | śravāyyam | syāma | te | jayataḥ | śakra | medinaḥ | yathā | vayam | uśmasi | tat | vaso iti | kṛdhi ||2|| he 'indra 'saḥ sarvānugrāhakatvena prasiddhastvaṃ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'sadane gṛhe 'kṣumantam annavantaṃ śabdavantaṃ vā 'goarṇasam | gāvo'rṇakamiva pravṛddhā yasmin | taṃ 'śravāyyaṃ śravaṇīyaṃ 'rayiṃ dhanaṃ 'vyūrṇuhi vividhamācchādaya | kiṃca he 'vaso vāsaka 'śakra indra 'jayataḥ śatruṃ 'te tava prasādādvayaṃ 'medinaḥ medasā yuktā balavantaḥ 'syāma bhavema | kiṃ bahuktyā | 'yathā yat 'vayamuśmasi kāmayāmahe 'tat sarvaṃ 'kṛdhi kuru ||

yo no dāsu āryā vā puruhūtadeba indra yudhaye ciketati | asmābhiṣṭe susahāḥ santu śatravastvayā vayaṃ tānvanuyāma saṃgame || 3 || yaḥ | naḥ | dāsaḥ | āryaḥ | vā | puru'stuta | adevaḥ | indra | yudhaye | ciketati | asmābhiḥ | te | su'sahāḥ | santu | śatravaḥ | tvayā | vayam | tān | vanuyāma | sam''game ||3|| he puruhūta bahustuta indra yaḥ dāsaḥ karmakaraḥ śadraḥ vā āryaḥ travarṇiko vā adevaḥ devāda- nyo'suro vā naḥ asmān yudhaye yuddhāya ciketati jānāti te sarve śatravaḥ asmadasyaḥ te tava prasādāt asmābhiḥ susahāḥ svavibhavāḥ santu bhavantu | kiṃca vayaṃ tvayā sahāyena tān śatrūn saṃgame saṃgrāme vanuyāma hanyāma ||
taṃ viśvāde sakhimadha śrutaṃ naraṃrvāśvamindramavase karāmahe ||
tathā cānukrāntam—‘yo vāṃ palunā kākṣīvatī ghoṣārdhinaṃ hi triṣṭubantam’ iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yo vāṃ parijmeti trīṇi triśrigno atha’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 15) iti||
yo vāṃ parijmā suvṛdaśvinā ratho doṣāmuṣāso havyo haviṣmatā|
śaśvattamāsutsu vāmidaṃ vayaṃ piturna nāma suhavaṃ havāmahe ||
yaḥ| vām| pari'jmā| su'vṛt| aśvinā| rathaḥ| doṣām| uṣasaḥ| havyaḥ| haviṣmatā| śaśvat'tamāsaḥ| tam| ūṃ iti| vām| idam| vayam| pituḥ| na| nāma| su'havam| havāmahe || 1 ||
he aśvinā aśvinau vāṃ yuvayoḥ parijmā parito gantā suvṛt suṣṭhu vartamānaḥ rathaḥ|
vāṃ yuvayoḥ svabhūtaṃ suhavaṃ śobhanāhvānaṃ tamu tameva rathaṃ śaśvattamāsaḥ atiśayena ciraṃtanā vayaṃ pitunaṃ yathā pituḥ idaṃ nāma tathā havāmahe hvayāmaḥ||
codayataṃ sūnṛtāḥ pinvataṃ dhiya utpuraṃdhīrirayataṃ taduimasi|
yaśasaṃ bhāgaṃ kṛṇutaṃ no aśvinā somaṃ na cāruṃ maghavatsu naskṛtam ||
codayatam| sūnṛtāḥ| pinvatam| dhiyaḥ| ut| puram'dhīḥ| īrayatam| tat| uimasi| yaśasam| bhāgam| kṛṇutam| naḥ| aśvinā| somam| na| cārum| maghavat'su| naḥ| kṛtam||2||
he aśvinā aśvinau yuvāṃ sūnṛtāḥ vāca upaso vā codayataṃ prerayatam|
asmākaṃ dhiyaḥ karmāṇi ca pinvataṃ pūrayatam|
puraṃdhīḥ bahvīḥ prajñāśca ut īrayatam udgamayataṃ prerayatam|
kiṃca naḥ asmākaṃ yaśasaṃ yaśasvinaṃ bhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ dhanādikaṃ kṛṇutaṃ kurutam|
cāruṃ kalyāṇaṃ somaṃ na somamiva naḥ asmān maghavatsu dhanavatsu kṛtaṃ kurutam||
andhasya cinnāsatyā kṛśasya cidvāmidāhurbhiṣajā rutasya cit ||
amā'juraḥ| cit| bhavathaḥ| yuvam| bhagaḥ| anāśaḥ| cit| avitārā| apamasya| cit| andhasya| cit| nāsatyā| kṛśasya| cit| yuvām| ita| āhuḥ| bhiṣajā| rutasya| cit || 3 ||
he nāsatyā nāsatyau yuvaṃ yuvām amājuraśrit pitṛgṛhe jūryanyā api durbhagāyā ghoṣāyāḥ bhagaḥ bhavathaḥ|
śobhanarūpeṇātmānaṃ pariṇamayya patiṃ dattavantau stha ityarthaḥ|
‘ghoṣāyai cipsitapade duroṇe patiṃ jūryanyā aśvināvadattam’ (kra. saṃ. 1. 110. 7) iti|
vanāśośrita anaśanasyāpi vavitārā rakṣitārau yuvāṃ bhavataḥ|
vapamasya vcit jātyātikṛṣṭa- syāpi rakṣitārau bhavataḥ|
kiṃca vyuvāmita yuvāmeva vṛtasya vcit yajñasyāpi vbhipajau vaidyau vāhuḥ vidvāṃsaḥ ||
yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sunayaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuḥ |
yuvam | cyavānam | sunayam | yathā | ratham | punaḥ | yuvānam | carathāya | takṣathuḥ | niḥ | tauryam | ūhathuḥ | ataḥ | abhyaḥ | pāri | viśvā | it | tā | vām | sarveṣu | pra'vācyā ||4||
he aśvinau vyuvaṃ yuvāṃ vsanayaṃ purāṇaṃ vcyavānam ṛṣiṃ vyathā vrathaṃ jīrṇaṃ rathamiva vpunaryuvānaṃ taruṇaṃ vcarathāya caraṇāthaṃ vtakṣathuḥ tatakṣathuḥ |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ sanayaṃ purāṇaṃ yathā rathaṃ punaryuvānaṃ carathāya takṣathuryā prayoti karmāṇi takṣatiḥ karotikarmā’ (niru. 4. 19) iti |
kiṃca yuvāṃ vtaudhyaṃ tumaputraṃ bhujyum vañjayaḥ vpari samudrasyopari vniḥ vūhathuḥ |
kiṃca vvāṃ yuvayoḥ vviśvā viśvāni vtā tāni karmāṇi vmavaneṣu yajñeṣu vpravācyā pravācyāni prakarṣeṇa vaktavyāni ||
purāṇā vāṃ vīryā pra bravā jane'thau hāsathurbhipajā mayobhuvā |
tā vāṃ nu navyāvavase karā mahe'yaṃ nāsatyā śradirithā dadhat ||
purāṇā | vām | vīryā | pra | brava | janai | atho | iti | ha | āsathuḥ | bhiṣajā | mayaḥ'bhuvā | tā | vām | nu | navyau | avase | karā mahe | ayam | nāsatyā | śrat | ariḥ | yathā | dadhat ||5||
he aśvinau vvāṃ yuvayoḥ vpurāṇā purāṇāni vīryāṇi vjane loke vpra2 vbrava2 prabravīmi |
vatho api ca he vnāsatyā nāsatyau yuvāṃ vmayobhuvā sukhasya bhāvitārau vbhiṣajā bhiṣajau vaidyau vāsathuḥ babhūvathuḥ |
vtā1 tau1 yuvām vavase rakṣaṇāya vnavyau stutyau vkarā mahe kurmaḥ |
vayam variḥ gantā patiryajamānaḥ vyathā vśrat vdadhat śraddhayāditi ||
iyaṃ vāmahve śṛṇutaṃ mai aśvinā putrāyaiva pitarā mahai śikṣatam |
anāpijñā asajātyāmatiḥ purā tasyā abhiśterava spṛtam ||
iyam | vām | ahve | śṛṇutam | me | aśvinā | putrāya'iva | pitarā | mahyam | śikṣatam | anāpiḥ | ajñāḥ | asajātyā | amatiḥ | purā | tasyāḥ | abhi'śasteḥ | ava | spṛtam ||6||
he vaśvinā aśvinau vvāṃ yuvām viyaṃ ghoṣā aham vahve āhvayāmi |
śrutvā cāhvānaṃ vmahyaṃ vputrāyaiva yathā putrāya vpitarā mātāpitarau tadvat

^śikśataṃ dhanaṃ datsam | ^anāpiḥ abandhuḥ ^ajñā akṛtajñā ^asajātāmatiḥ abhraddheyā cābhiśastiḥ māmāgacchati | ^tasyā ^abhiśasteḥ ^purā prāgeva ^ava ^spṛṣṭaṃ māmavapārayatm || yuvaṃ rathena vimudārya śundhyuvaṃ nyūhathuḥ purumitrasya yoṣanām | yuvaṃ haveṃ vadhimatyā agacchataṃ yuvaṃ suṣṭutiṃ cakrathuḥ puraṃdhaye || 7 || yuvam | rathena | vi'mudārya | śundhyuvam | ni | ūhathuḥ | purumitrasya | yoṣanām | yuvam | havam | vadhi'matyāḥ | agacchatam | yuvam | su'stutim | cakrathuḥ | puram'dhaye || 7 || he aśvinau ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^purumitrasya purumitranāmadheyasya ^yoṣaṇāṃ duhitaraṃ ^śundhyuvaṃ nāma jāyāṃ ^vimadāya vimadanāmadheyāya ṛṣaye ^rathena svasenāparivṛtena rathena ^nyūhathuḥ prāpayatam | vimadasya gṛhaṃ nītavantau stha ityarthaḥ | tathā ca nigamamāntaraṃ—‘yāvarbhagāya vimadāya jāyāṃ senājuvā nyūhat rathena’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 1) iti | kiṃca ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^vadhimatyāḥ saṃgrāme śatrubhiśchinmahastāyāḥ ^havam āhvānam ^agacchatam | āgamya ca ^tasyai hiraṇmayaṃ hastaṃ prāyacchatam ^ | tathā ca nigamamāntaram—‘ajohavījjāsathā karā vāṃ mahe yāman purubhujā puraṃdhiḥ | śrutaṃ tacchāsuriva vadhimatyā hiraṇyahastamaśvinādattam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 13) iti | kiṃca ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^puraṃdhaye bahuprajñāyai vadhimatyai ^suputiṃ suprasravaṃ śobhanamaśvayaṃ vā ^cakrathuḥ kṛtavantau sthaḥ || yuvaṃ viprasya jaraṇāmupeyuṣaḥ punaḥ kalerakṛṇutaṃ yuvadvaryaḥ | yuvaṃ vandanamṛśyādādupathuryavaṃ sadyo viśapalāmetave kṛthaḥ || 8 || yuvam | viprasya | jaraṇām | upa'īyuṣaḥ | punariti | kaleḥ | akṛṇutam | yuvat | vayaḥ | yuvam | vandanam | ṛśya'dāt | ut | upathuḥ | yuvam | sadhaḥ | viśapalām | etave | kṛthaḥ ||8|| he aśvinau ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^viprasya medhāvinaḥ ^jaraṇāṃ jarāma ^upeyuṣaḥ upagatavataḥ ^kaleḥ kali- nāmadheyasya ṛṣeḥ ^vayaḥ ^punaḥ punarapi ^yuvat yuvatvayuktam ^akṛṇutam akurūtam | tathā ca nigamā- ntaraṃ—‘kaliṃ yābhiravittajāni duvasyathaḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 112. 15) iti | kiṃca ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^vandanaṃ jāyāviyogasaṃtāpena kṛpapatitaṃ vandanākhyamṛṣima ^ṛśyadāt kṛpāt ^udapathuḥ udairayatam | tathā nigamamāntaram—‘uddandanamairayataṃ svardṛśe’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 112. 5) iti | kiṃca ^yuvaṃ yuvāṃ ^viśapalām | khelasya rogaḥ senāyāṃ yoddhuṃ | viśapalā nāma kācit strī | tāṃ saṃgrāme śatrubhiśchinmajaṅghāṃ ^sadhaḥ tadaiva ^etave gamanāya ^kṛthaḥ akurutam | tathā ca nigamamāntaraṃ—‘caritraṃ hi verivācchedi parṇamājā khelasya paritakayāyām | sadyo jaṅghāmāyasīṃ viśapalāyai dhane hite sataṃve pratyadhattam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 15) iti || yuvaṃ ha rebhaṃ vṛṣaṇā guhā hitamudairyarataṃ mamuvāṃsamaśvinā | yuvamubīsamata tṛsamatraya ormanvantaṃ cakrathuḥ saptavadhaye || 9 || yuvam | ha | rebham | vṛṣaṇā | guhā | hitam | ut | airayatam | mamuvāṃsam | aśvinā | yuvam | ūbīsam | uta | tṛsam | atraye | omena'vantam | cakrathuḥ | sapta'vadhaye || 9 || 1. ta-bha6-mu-‘ca’ nāsti | 2. ta-bha6-mu-tasmai | 3. ta-bha6-mu-prayacchata; ta3-bha1.4- aprayacchata; bhara-aprayacchata |
he vṛṣaṇā varṣitārau aśvinā aśvinau yuvaṃ yuvāṃ guhā guhāyāṃ hitam asurairnihitaṃ mamṛvāṃsaṃ triyamāṇaṃ rebhaṃ rebhākhyamṛṣim uderayatam uttāritavantau stha|
tathā ca nigamantaraṃ— ‘daśa rātrīraśivenā nava ghnavanandaṃ kṣathitamapsantaḥ|
vimṛtaṃ rebhamudani pravṛttamunjinmathuḥ somamiva śubheṇa’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 24) iti|
uta kiṃca yuvaṃ yuvāṃ tasam ṛbīsam abhikuṇḍam agnaye agnerdhāya omanvantam avanavantaṃ cakrathuḥ|
vṛṣṭvā niśamayya śītaṃ kṛtavantau stha ityarthaḥ|
tathā ca nigamantaraṃ— ‘himenāgniṃ aṃsamavārayethāṃ pitumatīmūrjaṃmasmā adhattam|
ṛbīse atri madhināvanītamunjinmathuḥ sarvagaṇaṃ svasti’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 8) iti|
kiṃca yuvāṃ sasavardhaye aśvamedhena rājñā kenacidaparādhena kāṣṭhamayamñapāyāṃ nihitasya sasavardhināmadheyasya ṛṣerthāya cakrathuḥ|
tathā ca nigamantaraṃ— ‘vi jihīṣva vanaspate yoniḥ sūryamantyā iva|
śrutaṃ me aśvinā havaṃ sasavardhi ca muñjatam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 5. 78. 5) iti||

tena vajreṇa śatrum asmadarim ārāt asmatsamīpāt dūram apa bādhasva tvamapagamaya |
kiṃca asme asmāsu yavamat yavayuktaṃ gomat goyuktaṃ ca dhanaṃ dhehi nidhehi |
kiṃca jaritre stotre mahyaṃ vājaratnāṃ ramaṇīyān dhiyaṃ karma kṛdhi kuru ||

pra yamantarvṛṣavāso agman tīvrāḥ somo bahulāntāsa indram | nāhaṃ dāmānaṃ maghavā ni yaṃsi sunvate vahati bhūri vāmam || 8 || pra | yam | antaḥ | vṛṣa'vāsaḥ | agman | tīvrāḥ | somāḥ | bahula'antāsaḥ | indram | na | aham | dāmānam | magha'vā | ni | yaṃsat | ni | sunvate | vahati | bhūri | vāmam ||8||

antaḥ jaṭhare yam indraṃ vṛṣavāsaḥ vṛṣasā agmau somasya varṣitṛbhirvyadhurbhirabhipūtāḥ tīvrāḥ tīvrarasāḥ bahulāntāsaḥ bahulambādikamante yebhyaste bahulāntāḥ somāḥ pra agman pragacchanti sa maghavā dhanavānindraḥ dāmānaṃ dātāraṃ yajamānaṃ nāha naiva ni yaṃsat niyacchati |
kiṃtu sunvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate yajamānāya bhūri adhikaṃ vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ dhanaṃ ni vahati nitarāṃ prāpayati ||

uta prahāmatidivyā jayaṃti kṛtaṃ yacchunī vivinorti kāle | yo devakāmo na dhanā raṇaddhi samitaṃ rāyā sṛjati svadhāvān || 9 || uta | pra'hām | ati'dīvya | jayati | kṛtam | yat | śnī | vi'cinoti | kāle | yaḥ | deva'kāmaḥ | na | dhanā | raṇaddhi | sam | itam | rāyā | sṛjati | svadhā'vān || 9 ||
ᵛuta api cendraḥ ᵛprahāṃ prahantāram ᵛatidīvya |
ᵛśnī kitavaḥ ᵛkṛtaṃ kṛtamayaṃ pratikitavaṃ kitavānāṃ madhye ᵛvicinoti parīkṣya gṛhnāti tadvadindraḥ ᵛkāle yuddhakāle balavantaṃ śatruṃ parīkṣya vadhārthaṃ gṛhnātītyarthaḥ |
kiṃca ᵛyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵛdevakāmaḥ devān yaṣṭuṃ stotuṃ vā abhilāpavān bhavati tasyārthāya ᵛdhanā dhanāni ᵛna ᵛruṇaddhi nāvṛṇoti |
kiṃtu ᵛsvadhāvān balavānindraḥ ᵛtaṃ devakāmaṃ ᵛrāyā dhanena ᵛsaṃ ᵛsṛjati saṃyojayatyeva ||
gobhi̭ṣṭerāmarmarti durevāṃ yarvena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām |

accha̭ | me | indra̭m | mata̭yaḥ | sva̭ḥ'vida̭ḥ | sa॒dhrīcī̭ḥ | viśvā̭ḥ | u॒śatī̭ḥ | a॒nūṣa̭ta | pa॒rī | sra॒jantḙ | ja॒naya̭ḥ | yathā̭ | pa॒tim | marya̭m | na | śu॒ndhyum | magha̭'vānam | ū॒tayḙ || 1 ||
āṅgirasasya kṛṣṇasya me mama svarvivaḥ sarvasya lambhayiṣyaḥ sadhrīcīḥ saṃgatāḥ viśvāḥ vyāsāḥ uśatīḥ kāmayamānāḥ matayaḥ stutayaḥ indram accha anūṣata abhiṣṭuvanti |

kiṃca janayaḥ jāyāḥ yathā patiṃ bhartāraṃ nayaḥ na yathā ca manuṣyaṃ śundhyuṃ śuddhaṃ dāparahitaṃ maghavānaṃ dhanavantam ūtaye rakṣaṇārthaṃ pari dhvajante āliṅganti tadvadindraṃ me stutayaḥ pari dhvajante ||
na ghā॒ tvadi̭rapa॒ veti̭ me॒ manṷsta॒vetkā̭maṃ pu॒rahṷ̄ta॒ śiśra̭ya |
rā॒jeva̭ da॒sma ni ṣa̭do॒'dhi ba॒rhiṣya॒sminyu॒ su॒ soma̭mava॒pāna̭mastu te ||

na | gha | tvadi̭k | a॒pa | veti̭ | me | mana̭ḥ | tve iti̭ | it | kā॒mam | pu॒ru'hṷta | śiśra̭ya | rā॒jā'i̭va | da॒sma | ni | sa॒daḥ | a॒dhi | ba॒rhiṣi̭ | a॒smin | su | soma̭m | a॒va॒pāna̭m | a॒stu | te || 2 ||
he puruhūta bahubhirāhūta dasma darśanīyendra tvadik tvadabhimukhaṃ me madīyaṃ manaḥ na gha na khalu apa veti tvatto'pagacchati |
kiṃca tve tvayyeva kāmam abhilāpaṃ śiśraya sthāpayāmi |
kiṃca rājeva īśvara iva barhiṣi adhi ni padaḥ niṣīda |
kiṃca te tava asmin some avapānamastu bhavatu ||
vi॒ṣū॒vṛdi̭ndro a॒matḙru॒ta kṣudha̭ḥ sa i॒drāyo̭ magha॒vā vasva̭ īśate |
tasyḙdi॒me pra̭va॒ṇe su॒pta sindha̭vo॒ vayo॒ vardha̭nti vṛṣa॒bhasya̭ śu॒ṣmiṇa̭ḥ ||

vi॒ṣū॒'vṛt | indra̭ḥ | a॒matḙḥ | u॒ta | kṣudha̭ḥ | saḥ | it | rā॒yaḥ | magha̭'vā | vasva̭ḥ | ī॒śatḙ | tasya̭ | it | i॒me | pra॒va॒ṇe | su॒pta | sindha̭vaḥ | va॒yaḥ | va॒rdha॒nti॒ | vṛ॒ṣa॒bhasya̭ | śu॒ṣmiṇa̭ḥ || 3 ||
indraḥ amateḥ asmākaṃ durbuddheḥ prajñāpahāriṇyāḥ pipāsāyā vā viṣūvṛt vipnavartanako bhavatu |
uta api ca kṣudhaḥ bubhukṣāyā viṣūvṛt bhavatu |
kiṃca saḥ it sa eva maghavā dhanavā- nindraḥ vasvaḥ vāsayituḥ rāyaḥ dhanasya īśate īṣṭe |
kiṃca vṛṣabhasya varṣitaḥ tasyeta indrasyaiva ime prasiddhāḥ sasa saptasaṃkhyākāḥ sindhavaḥ nadyaḥ pravaṇe deśe vayaḥ asya vardhanti vardhayanti ||
vayo॒ na vṛ॒kṣaṃ su॒palā̭śa॒māsa̭da॒nsomā̭ indra॒ṃ mandi̭na॒ścamū॒sada̭ḥ |

va॒yaḥ | na | vṛ॒kṣam | su॒'palā̭śam | ā | a॒sa॒da॒n | somā̭saḥ | indra̭m | mandi̭naḥ | ca॒mū॒'sada̭ḥ | pra | e॒ṣām | a॒nī̭kam | śarva̭sā | de॒vi॒dyu॒tat | vi॒dat | sva̭ḥ | ma॒navḙ | jyoti̭ḥ | ā॒ryam ||4||
vayo na yathā pakṣiṇaḥ supalāśaṃ śobhanaparṇaṃ vṛkṣam āsīdanti tadvat mandinaḥ madakarāḥ camūṣadaḥ camasāgreṣu sthātāraḥ somāsaḥ somāḥ indram ā asadan āsīdanti |
eṣām indramadhitiṣṭhatāṃ somānāṃ śavasā vegena yuktam anīkam agraṃ pra davidyutat
1. ga-he iṃdra yasya suhastasya; ta3-bha1.4.5-7-he ghoṣe yasya suhastasya |
kiṃcāyamindraḥ svaḥ svātmanā āryaṃ preyaṃ jyotiḥ ādityākhyaṃ tejaḥ manave manuṣyebhyaḥ vidat prayacchatu ||
kṛtaṃ na śraghnī vi cinoti devane saṃvargaṃ yanmaghavā sūrya̭ jaryat |
na tattai anyo anu vīryaṃ śakanna purāṇe maghavanota nūtanaḥ ||
kṛtam | na | śraghnī | vi | cinoti | devane | sam'vargam | yat | magha'vā | sūryam | jaryat | na | tat | te | anyaḥ | anu | vīryam | śakat | na | purāṇaḥ | magha'van | na | uta | nūtanaḥ ||5||
śraghnī parasvānāṃ hantā kitavaḥ devane cyūte kṛtaṃ na yathā kṛtaṃ vi cinoti tadvadindraḥ sūrya mṛgayate |
yat yadā maghavā dhanavānindraḥ saṃvargaṃ samyagvṛṣṭvarjayitāraṃ sūryam ādityaṃ jayat tadīyarasāpaharadvārā jayati |
he maghavana dhanavannindra te tava tat sūryajayalakṣaṇaṃ vīryaṃ vīra

vṛṣā na kruddhaḥ patayadrajaḥsvā yo aryapatnīrakṛṇodimā apaḥ | sa sunvate maghavā jīradānave'vindajjyotirmanave haviṣmate || 8 || vṛṣā | na | kruddhaḥ | patayat | rajaḥ'su | ā | yaḥ | arya'patnīḥ | akṛṇot | imāḥ | apaḥ | saḥ | sunvate | magha'vā | jīra'dānave | avindat | jyotiḥ | manave | haviṣmate || 8 ||

ᵥrajaḥsu lokeṣu ᵥvṛṣā ᵥna yathā vṛṣabhaḥ ᵥkruddhaḥ san prativṛṣabhadhāya ᵥpatayat gacchati tadvat ᵥyaḥ indraḥ kruddhaḥ san meghavadhāya patayati hatvā ca megham ᵥaryapatnīḥ sarvasya jagataḥ svāmina indrasya pālayitavyāḥ ᵥimāḥ prasiddhāḥ ᵥapaḥ vṛṣṭyudakāni ᵥā ᵥakṛṇot ākṛṇoti asmadabhi- mukhaṃ karoti ᵥsaḥ ᵥmaghavā ᵥdhanavānindraḥ ᵥsunvate somābhiṣavaṃ kurvate ᵥjīradānave kṣiprādānāya ᵥhaviṣmate ᵥmanave manuṣyāya |

ujyātāṃ paraśujyotiṣā saha bhūyā ṛtasya sudughā purāṇavat | vi raucatāmaruṣo bhānunā śuciḥ sva1rṇa śukraṃ śuśucīta sarpatiḥ || 9 || ut | jāyatām | paraśuḥ | jyotiṣā | saha | bhūyāḥ | ṛtasya | sudughā | purāṇa'vat | vi | rocatām | aruṣaḥ | bhānunā | śuciḥ | svaḥ | na | śukram | śuśucīta | sata'patiḥ ||9||
ᵥparaśuḥ indrasya vajraḥ ᵥjyotiṣā tejasā ᵥsaha ᵥujāyatām |
kiṃca ᵥṛtasya satyasya ᵥsudughā mādhyamikā vāk ᵥpurāṇavat pratnavat kāle ᵥbhūyāḥ bhūyāt |
kiṃca indraḥ ᵥarupaḥ ārocamānaḥ ᵥbhānunā dīpyā ᵥśuciḥ jvalan ᵥvi ᵥrocatāṃ prakāśatām |
kiṃca ᵥsatpatiḥ satāṃ patirindraḥ ᵥsvarna āditya iva ᵥśukraṃ jvalan ᵥśuśucīta ᵥatyantaṃ dīpyatām ||

gobhiṣtaremāmartiṃ durevāṃ yavena kṣudhaṃ puruhūta viśvām | vayaṃ rājabhiḥ prathamā dhanānyāsmākena vṛjanena jayema || 10 || gobhiḥ | tarema | armātim | duḥ'evām | yavena | kṣudham | puru'hūta | viśvām | vayam | rāja'bhiḥ | prathamāḥ | dhanāni | asmākaina | vṛjanena | jayema || 10 ||

bṛhaspatirnaḥ pari pātu paścādutattarasmādadharādaghāyoḥ | indraḥ purastāduta madhyato naḥ sakhā sakhibhyo varivaḥ kṛṇotu || 11 || bṛhaspatiḥ | naḥ | pari | pātu | paścāt | uta | uta'uttarasmāt | adharāt | agha'yoḥ | indraḥ | purastāt | uta | madhyataḥ | naḥ | sakhā | sakhi'bhyaḥ | varivaḥ | kṛṇotu || 11 ||
‘ā yātu’ ityekādaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya kṛṣṇasyāpamaindram | āditastatstriṣṭubhaḥ | tataḥ ṣaṭ jagatyaḥ | tato dve triṣṭubhau | tathā cānukrāntam—‘ā yātu tritriṣṭubhādi’ iti | ābhi-
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā yātvindraḥ svapatirimāṃ dhiyamiti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 9) iti ||

ā yātvindraḥ svapatirmadāya yo dharmaṇā tūtajānasturviṣmān | pratvakṣāṇo ati viśvā sahā~syapāreṇa mahatā vṛṣṇyena || 1 || ā | yātu | indraḥ | sva'patiḥ | madāya | yaḥ | dharmaṇā | tūtajānaḥ | turviṣmān | pra'tvakṣāṇaḥ | ati | viśvā | sahā~si | apāreṇa | mahatā | vṛṣṇyena || 1 ||

pa yaḥ indraḥ pa tūtajānaḥ tvaramāṇaḥ pa tuviṣmān vṛddhimān pa viśvā viśvāni pa sahā~si śatru- balāni pa apāreṇa mahatā adhikena pa vṛṣṇyena balena pa pratvakṣāṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa tanukurvan pa ati gacchatīti śeṣaḥ |
pa svapatiḥ dhanapatiḥ pa indraḥ pa madāya madāya pa dharmaṇā dhārakeṇa rathena pa ā pa yātu asmadyajñaṃ pratyāgacchatu ||

suṣṭhāma rathaḥ suyamā harī te mimyakṣa vajro nṛpate garbhastau | śībhaṃ rājansupathā yārvārvāṅ vardhāma te papuṣo vṛṣṇyāni || 2 || su'sthāmā | rathaḥ | su'yamā | harī iti | te | mimyakṣa | vajraḥ | nṛ'pate | garbhastau | śībham | rājan | su'pathā | ā | yāhi | arvāṅ | vardhāma | te | papuṣaḥ | vṛṣṇyāni || 2 ||
he pa nṛpate nṛṇāṃ pālakendra pa te tava pa rathaḥ pa suṣṭhāma śobhanāsthānaḥ pa harī aśvāvapi pa suyamā suyamau |
pa kiṃca tava pa garbhastau bāhau pa vajraḥ pa mimyakṣa saṃhato bhavati |
tathā sati he pa rājan sarvasyeścarendra pa śībhaṃ śīghraṃ pa supathā śobhanena mārgeṇa pa arvāṅ asmadabhimukham pa ā pa yāhi āgaccha |
āgatya pa papuṣaḥ somaṃ pītavataḥ pa te tava pa vṛṣṇyāni balāni pa vardhāma vayaṃ vardhayāmaḥ ||

endrāvahau nṛpatiṃ vajrabāhumugramugrāsaṃtaviṣāsa enam | pratvakṣasaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ satyaśuṣmamemaṃ sadhamādau vahantu || 3 || ā | indra'vāhaḥ | nṛ'patim | vajra'bāhum | ugram | ugrāsaḥ | tuviṣāsaḥ | enam | pra'tvakṣasam | vṛṣabham | satya'śuṣmam | ā | īm | asma'trā | sadha'mādaḥ | vahantu || 3 ||
pa nṛpatiṃ nṛṇāṃ pālakaṃ pa vajrabāhuṃ vajrahastam pa ugram ugraṃ pa pratvakṣasaṃ śatrubalānāṃ prakarṣeṇa tanū- kartāraṃ pa vṛṣabhaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣitāraṃ pa satyaśuṣmam avisaṃvādivalam pa enam indram |
pa ā pa īm iti pūraṇau |
pa ugrāsaḥ ugrāḥ pa tuviṣāsaḥ pravṛddhāḥ |
pa sadhamādaḥ saha mādyantaḥ pa indravāhaḥ indrasya voḍhāraḥ pa asmatrā asmāsu pa ā pa vahantu ||
evā patiṃ droṇasācaṃ sacetasamurjaḥ skambhaṃ dharuṇa ā vṛṣāyase |
orjaḥ kṛṣva saṃ gṛbhāya tve apyaso yathā kenipānāmino vṛdhe ||
eva | patim | droṇa'sācam | sa'caitasam | ūrjaḥ | skambham | dharuṇai | ā | vṛdha'yase | ojaḥ | kṛṣ | sam | gṛbhāya | tve iti | api | asaḥ | yathā | ke'nipānām | inaḥ | vṛdhe || 4 ||
he indra svam ᵥeva evaṃ ᵥpati pālakaṃ ᵥdroṇasācaṃ droṇakalaśasya sevitāraṃ ᵥsacetasaṃ samajñam ᵥūrjaḥ ᵥskambhaṃ balasya dhārakaṃ somaṃ ᵥdharuṇai dhārake jaṭhare ᵥā ᵥvṛdhāyase āsiñjase |
kiṃca mahyam ᵥojaḥ balaṃ ᵥkṛṣva kuruṣva |
ᵥtve tvayi asmān ᵥapi ᵥsaṃ ᵥgṛbhāya saṃgṛhṇa ca |
ᵥvṛdhe vardhanāya ᵥyathā ᵥyathāvat sarvathā ᵥinaḥ svāmī ᵥasaḥ bhavasi ||
garman‌asme vasūnyā hi śaṃsiṣaṃ svāśiṣaṃ bharamā yāhi sominaḥ |
tvamīśiṣe sāsminnā sattisa barhiryenādhṛṣyā tav pātrāṇi dharmaṇā ||
garman | asme iti | vasūni | ā | hi | śaṃsiṣam | su'āśiṣam | bharam | ā | yāhi | sominaḥ | tvam | īśiṣe | saḥ | asmin | ā | sattisa | barhiṣi | anādhṛṣyā | tava | pātrāṇi | dharmaṇā || 5 ||
he indra ᵥvasūni tvadeyāni dhanāni ᵥasme mayi ᵥā ᵥgaman āgacchantu |
kiṃca ᵥsominaḥ somavato mama ᵥsvāśiṣaṃ śobhanā āśiṣo yasmistaṃ ᵥbharaṃ yajñam ᵥā ᵥyāhi samāgaccha |
evaṃvidhaḥ ᵥsaḥ ᵥtvam ᵥasmin asmadīye vedyāstṛte ᵥbarhiṣi ᵥā ᵥsattisa āsīda |
kiṃca ᵥtava somapātrāṇi ᵥdharmaṇā rākṣasānāṃ karmaṇā anādhṛṣyāṇi dharṣayitumaśakyāni ᵥ ||
pṛthak prāyan prathamā devahūtayo'kṛṇvata śrusyāni duṣṭarā |
na ye śekuryajñiyāṃ nāvamāruhamīmaiva te nyaviśanta kerpayaḥ ||
pṛthak | pra | āyan | prathamāḥ | deva'hūtayaḥ | akṛṇvata | śrusyāni | dustarā | na | ye | śekuḥ | yajñiyām | nāvam | ā'ruham | īrmā | eva | te | ni | aviśanta | kerpayaḥ ||6||
he indra tava prasādāt te ᵥpṛthak ᵥprāyan devalokān pṛthaggacchanti ye ᵥprathamāḥ pūrvai mukhyā vā ᵥdevahūtayaḥ devānāmāhvātāraḥ |
kiṃca ᵥduṣṭarā anyairdustarāṇi ᵥśravasyāni śravaṇī- yāni yaśāṃsi ᵥakṛṇvata ᵥakurvata |
kiṃca ᵥye tvatprasādarāhitā janāḥ ᵥyajñiyāṃ yajñasambandhinīm |
ᵥnāvam ᵥāruham āroḍhuṃ ᵥna ᵥśekuḥ na śaknuvanti ᵥte ᵥkepayaḥ kutsitapūya- karmaṇaḥ pāpakarmaṇo janāḥ ᵥīmaiva ṛṇenaiva ᵥnyaviśanta nīcairaviśanta |

tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘ pṛthak prāyan pṛthak prathateḥ prathamā devahūtayo ye devānāhvayantākurvata śravaṇīyāni yaśāṃsi duranukārānyathairiśaktanuvantyiśiyāṃ nāvamārohaṇamatha ye nāśakanuvantyiśiyāṃ nāvamārohaṇamaiva te nyaviśanta ṛṇenaiva te nyaviśantāsminneva loka iti vā ’ (nigha. 5. 25) iti ||

evaivāpāgapare santu duḍhyo'śvā yeṣāṃ duryaje āyuyuje | itthā ye prāgupare santi dāvane puruṇi yatre vayunāni bhojanā || 7 || eva | eva | apāk | apare | santu | duḥ'dhyaḥ | aśvāḥ | yeṣām | duḥ'yujaḥ | ā'yuyuje | itthā | ye | prāk | upare | santi | dāvane | puruṇi | yatra | vayunāni | bhojanā || 7 || vevaiva evameva vdūḍhyaḥ durvṛddhayaḥ | vapare anye | ayajvāna ityarthaḥ | vapāk apācīnā adhogantāraḥ vsantu bhavantu vyeṣāṃ yajñakurvatām vaśvāḥ vduryajaḥ duryojāḥ prabalāḥ vaśvāḥ vāyuyuje rathepu yujyante | ye satyapi sāmarthye na yajanti te narakaṃ gacchantīti bhāvaḥ | kiṃca vitthā itthaṃ te svargagāmino bhavanti vye vupare yajvānaḥ vprāk maraṇātpūrvameva vdāvane devānāṃ havirdānāya vsanti3 bhavanti3 | vyatra yeṣu ca yajñakāriṣu vvayunāni prajñānāni kāntāni vā vbhojanā bhogyāni dhanāni vpuruṇi bahūni devebhyo dānāya santi ||

jagubhma te dakṣiṇamindra hastaṃ vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām | vidmā hi tvā goparti śūra gonāmasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ || 1 || jagubhma | te | dakṣiṇam | indra | hastam | vasu'yavaḥ | vasu'pate | vasūnām | vidma | hi | tvā | go'patim | śūra | gonām | asmabhyam | citram | vṛṣaṇam | rayim | dāḥ || 1 || ^vasūnāṃ ^vasupate bahūnāṃ dhanānāṃ svāmin he ^indra ^te tava ^dakṣiṇa ^hastaṃ ^vasūyavaḥ vasukamā vayaṃ ^jagubhma gṛhīmaḥ | yathā bahupradasyārthino ^madyamadatvā na gantavyamiti hastaṃ gṛhṇanti tadvat | he ^śūra vikrāntendra ^tvā tvāṃ ^gonāṃ ^gopatim | atra vṛṣyavṛttibhyāṃ svāmitvaṃ bahutvaṃ ca pratipādyate | bahūnāṃ gavāṃ goparti ^vidma jānīmaḥ | ataḥ ^asmabhyaṃ ^citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ ^vṛṣaṇaṃ varṣakaṃ ^rayiṃ dhanaṃ ^dāḥ dehi ||

svāyudhaṃ svarvasaṃ sunīthaṃ catuḥsamudraṃ dharuṇa rayīṇām | carkṛtyaṃ śasyaṃ bhūrivāramasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ || 2 || su'āyudham | su'arvasam | su'nītham | catuḥ'samudram | dharuṇam | rayīṇām | carkṛtyam | śasyam | bhūri'vāram | asmabhyam | citram | vṛṣaṇam | rayim | dāḥ || 2 || ^svāyudhaṃ śobhanavajrādyāyudhaṃ ^svarvasaṃ śobhanarakṣaṇaṃ sugamanaṃ vā ^sunīthaṃ sunayanaṃ ^catuḥsamudraṃ caturaḥ ^samudrān yo yaśasā vyāpnoti taṃ ^dharuṇaṃ dhārakam | keṣām | ^rayīṇāṃ dhanānām | ^carkṛtyaṃ punaḥpunaḥ kartavyaṃ ^śasyaṃ stutyaṃ ^bhūrivāraṃ bhūrīṇāṃ duḥkhānāṃ vārakaṃ bahubhirvareṇīyaṃ vā tvāṃ vidheti śeṣaḥ | tādṛśo'smabhyamityādi^ pūrvavat | yadvā | he indra uktaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ putrākhyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ dehi ||

subrahmāṇaṃ devavantaṃ bṛhantamuruṃ gabhīraṃ pṛthubudhnamindra | śrutarṣimugramabhimātipāhamasmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ || 3 || su'brahmāṇam | deva'vantam | bṛhantam | urum | gabhīram | pṛthu'budhnam | indra | śruta'ṛṣim | ugram | abhimāti'saham | asmabhyam | citram | vṛṣaṇam | rayim | dāḥ || 3 || he ^indra tvaṃ ^subrahmāṇam | brahma parivṛḍhaṃ stutilakṣaṇaṃ karma | śobhanastutikamityarthaḥ | ^devavantaṃ ^bṛhantaṃ mahāntam ^uruṃ vistīrṇaṃ ^gabhīram asurādibhiragamyaṃ ^pṛthubudhnaṃ vistṛtamūlaṃ ^śrutarṣi śrutā ṛṣayo yena tādṛśarṣīṇāṃ sthāpayitāraṃ prathitajñānaṃ vā ^ugram udghūrṇabalamata eva ^abhimāti- pāham abhimātīnāṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāṃ hantāram ^asmabhyaṃ ^citraṃ pūjyaṃ ^vṛṣaṇaṃ varṣakaṃ putraṃ ^rayiṃ dhanaṃ ca ^dāḥ dehi^ | athavā viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvaḥ | uktalakṣaṇaṃ putrākhyaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||

ahaṃ ra̭ndhayaṃ mṛ॒gaya̭ṃ śru॒tarva̭ṇe ya॒nmāji̭hī॒ta vayṷnā॒ canā̭nu॒pak | ahaṃ veśa̭ṃ na॒mrā ya̭vḙ'kara॒maha̭ṃ sa॒vyāya̭ pa॒ḍbhi̭marandhayam || 5 || aham | ra॒ndha॒yam | mṛ॒gaya̭m | śru॒tarva̭ṇe | yat | mā | a॒ji॒hī॒ta | va॒yu॒nā | cana̭ | ā॒nu॒pak | aham | veśa̭m | na॒mram | ā॒yavḙ | a॒kara̭m | aham | sa॒vyāya̭ | pa॒ḍbhi̭m | a॒ra॒ndha॒yam ||5||

vaham indraḥ vmṛgayam etannāmakasuraṃ vśrutarvaṇe etannāmakāya maharṣaye vrandhayam | radhyati- vaṃśagamane | vaśamanayam | vyat yasmāt śrutarvā vmā mām vajihīta | 'ohāṅ gatau' | āgacchat | tadevocyate | vvayunā prajñānena snānena vānupak anupakto'bhūt | vcana iti pūraṇaḥ | vahaṃ vveśam etannāmānaṃ vnamraṃ prahaṃ vkaram akārṣam | karoterluṅi 'kṛmṛdṛhibhyaḥ' iti caleraṅ | aḍabhāva- śchāndasaḥ | vahaṃ vsavyāya etannāmakāya vpaḍbhim etannāmakam varandhayaṃ vaśamanayam || 7 ||

ahaṃ sa yo na̭rva॒āstva̭ṃ bṛha॒dratha̭ṃ saṃ vṛ॒treva̭ dā॒saṃ vṛ̭tra॒hārṷjam | yadvardha̭yantaṃ prathaya̭ntamānu॒pak dū॒re pā॒re ra̭ja॒so ro̭canā॒kara̭m || 6 || aham | saḥ | yaḥ | narva̭'vāstvam | bṛha॒t'ra̭tham | sam | vṛ॒trā'i̭va | dā॒sam | vṛ॒tra॒hā | a॒ru॒jam | yat | va॒rdha॒yanta̭m | pra॒tha॒yanta̭m | ā॒nu॒pak | dū॒re | pā॒re | ra॒jasa̭ḥ | ro॒canā̭ | a॒kara̭m || 6 ||
vaham indraḥ vsaḥ 'asmi' vyaḥ vnavavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ ca vvṛtreva vṛtramiva vdāsam upa- kṣapayitāramiva navavāstvaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ ca varujam ahaṃ bhañjakaravam |
vyat yadā vvardhayantaṃ vprathayantaṃ prathamānaṃ cobhau śatrū vānupak anupaktaḥ san vrocanā rocanasya vrajasaḥ lokasya vdūre vpāre vakaraṃ kṛtavānasmi ||
ahaṃ sūrya̭sya॒ pari̭ yā॒myāśṷbhiḥ prai॒taśḙbhi॒rvaha̭māna॒ oja̭sā |
yanmā॒ sāvo॒ manṷṣa ā॒ha ni॒rṇija̭ ṛ॒dhakkṛ̭ṣe dā॒saṃ kṛ॒tyaṃ ha̭thaiḥ ||
1. bha- 'janapadān ' nāsti | 2. bha-prabharāṇi | 3. ta-bha1.4-akaraṃ | 4. ta1.2.7-bha- 'saḥ asmi ' nāsti |

^ahaṃ ^sūryasya devasya ^āśubhiḥ śīghragāmibhiḥ ^etaśebhiḥ ^etaśavarṇairaśvaiḥ ^vahamānaḥ udyamānaḥ ^ojasā ātmīyena balena prakarṣeṇa ^pari ^yāmi parigacchāmi sūryātmanā |

ahaṃ saṃmahā nahuṣo nahuṣṭaraḥ prāśrāvayaṃ śavaṃsā turvaśaṃ yadum | ahaṃ nya̭nyaṃ sahasā sahaskaraṃ nava vādhato narvṛtiṃ ca vakṣyam || 8 || aham | mma'hā | nahuṣaḥ | nahuḥ'taraḥ | pra | aśravayam | śavaṃsā | turvaśam | yadum | aham | ni | anyam | sahasā | sahaḥ | karam | nava | vādhataḥ | narvṛtim | ca | vakṣyam ||8||
kiṃca ^nahupaḥ bandhakasyāpi ^nahuṣṭaraḥ bandhakatarohaṃ ^śavasā balena ^turvaśaṃ ^yaduṃ ca ^prāśrāvayaṃ śatrusambandhitvādipradānena śrāvita- vānasmi |
tau yathā loke śrutau bhavataḥ tathākāryamityarthaḥ |

ahaṃ sapta sravato dhārayaṃ vṛṣā dravitnarvaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sīrā ardhi | ahamarṇāṃsi vi tirāmi sukṛtyurdhā vidaṃ manave gātumiṣṭayai || 9 || aham | sapta | sravataḥ | dhārayam | vṛṣā | dravitnarvaḥ | pṛthivyām | sīrāḥ | ardhi | aham | arṇāṃsi | vi | tirāmi | su'kratuḥ | yudhā | vidam | manave | gātum | iṣṭayai || 9 ||
kiṃca ^manave manuṣyāya ^iṣṭaye tasya gamanāya ^gātuṃ mārgaṃ ^yudhā saṃprahāreṇa |

ahaṃ tadāsu dhārayaṃ yadāsu na devaścana tvaṣṭā ryaduśat | spāhaṃ gavāmūrdhaḥsu vṛkṣaṇāsvā madhomadhu śrātryaṃ somamāśiram || 10 || aham | tat | āsu | dhārayam | yat | āsu | na | devaḥ | cana | tvaṣṭā | adhorayat | ruśat | spāham | gavām | ūrdhaḥ'su | vṛkṣaṇāsu | ā | madhoḥ | madhu | śrātryam | somam | ā'śiram || 10 ||

˅ahaṃ ˅tat prasiddhaṃ payaḥ ˅āsu goṣu ˅dhārayaṃ dhṛtavānasmi | ‘dhṛñ dhāraṇe’ | ṇyantasya laṅi rūpam | ˅yat payaḥ ˅āsu goṣu ˅devaśna ˅śvaṣṭā devaśilpī sūryo vā devaḥ ˅na ˅cana ˅adhārayat dhartuṃ nāśaknot | kīdṛk payo'dhārayamiti cet ucyate | ˅raśat dīptaṃ ˅spāhaṃ spṛhaṇīyam | keṣu pradeśeṣviti ucyate | ˅gavāmūdhaḥsu uddhatateṣu gāvāṃ payodhāraṇapradeśeṣu | kiṃca ˅madhu udakaṃ ˅vakṣaṇāsu | nadīnāmaitat | vahanaśīlāsu nadīṣu dhārayāmītyanupajyate | nadyudakadhāraṇasyāvadhirucyate | ˅ā ˅madhoḥ ā udakotpatteḥ | āgāmivarṣāsamayaparyantamityarthaḥ | kīdṛśaṃ madhviti taducyate | ˅śrādhyam | śrātramiti kṣipranāma | kṣipragamanāhaṃm | yadvā | śrādhyamityuttaratra saṃbadhyate | śrādhyaṃ sukhāvahaṃ ˅somaṃ prati ˅āśiraṃ dhārayam ||
evā devā indro vinye nūn pra cyauteneṃ maghavā satyarādhāḥ |
viśvettā tai harivaḥ śacīvo'bhi turāsaḥ svayaśo gṛṇanti ||
eva | devān | indraḥ | vinye | nūn | pra | cyauteneṃ | magha'vā | satya'rādhāḥ | viśvā | it | tā | te | harivaḥ | śacīvaḥ | abhi | turāsaḥ | sva'yaśaḥ | gṛṇanti ||11||
‘tasmātpagacīḥ prajāḥ pra vīyante pratīcīrjāyante ’ ( tai. saṃ. 6. 3. 1. 4 ) iti brāhmaṇam |

he ˅harivaḥ haribhyāṃ tadvan ˅śacīvaḥ karmavan he ˅svayaśaḥ svāyattakīrte'jñavan ˅vendra ˅tā tāni ˅viśvā sarvāṇi karmāṇi ˅te tava saṃbandhīni yeṣu karmasu ˅turāsaḥ tvaramāṇā ṛtvijaḥ ˅abhi ˅gṛṇanti abhiṣṭuvanti ||
ādito dvau daśākṣarau tato dvau dvādaśakau sābhisāriṇī |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘pra vo mahe sapta dvijagathyādyantaṃ ke'ḍabhisāriṇyau’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘pra vo mahe mandamānāndhasa iti nividvānam’ ( ai. ā. 5. 3. 1 ) iti ||
pra vo mahe mandamānāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve |
indrasya yasya surmakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ ||
pra | vaḥ | mahe | mandamānāya | andhasaḥ | arca | viśvānarāya | viśva'bhuve | indrasya | yasya | su'makham | sahaḥ | ˅maha | śravaḥ | ˅nṛmṇam | ca | rodasī iti | saparyataḥ ||1||

he stotaḥ ˅vaḥ svam | pūjārthaṃ bahuvacanam | ˅mahe mahate ˅andhasaḥ | andhase'rthaḥ | | somena ˅mandamānāya modamānāya ˅viśvānarāya sarvasya netre | ‘nare saṃjñāyām’ iti sāṃhitiko dīrghaḥ | ˅viśvābhuve sarvasya bhāvayitre mahamindrāya ˅pra ˅arca | arcatiḥ stutikarmā | proccāraya | ˅yasya mama
1. ga-ta-bha-mu-dhṛ | 2. ga-madhurasaṃ; ta-bha-madhu madhuraṃ | 3. ta-bha-mu-tvamityarthaḥ; bha1.4-tvarthaḥ; bhara-tvadarthaḥ | 4. ta1.2.3-bha-netre viśvābhuve |
vindrasya vsumukhaṃ suṣṭhu saṃhanīyaṃ vsahaḥ balaṃ vmahi mahat vśravaḥ annaṃ vnṛmṇaṃ sukhaṃ vca vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vsaparyataḥ pūjayataḥ |
so cinnu sakhyā narya inaḥ stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate narai |
viśvāsu dhūrṣu vājakṛtyeṣu satapate vṛtre vāpsvabhi śūra mandase ||
saḥ | cit | nu | sakhyā | naryaḥ | inaḥ | stutaḥ | carkṛtyaḥ | indraḥ | māvate | narai | viśvāsu | dhūrṣu | vājakṛtyeṣu | satapate | vṛtre | vā | apsu | abhi | śūra | mandase || 2 ||
vso vcinnu sa khalu vindraḥ vsakhyā sakhibhūtena nimittena vnaryaḥ nṛbhyo hitaḥ vinaḥ sarvasyeśvaraḥ vstutaḥ sarvairabhiṣṭutaḥ |
vmāvate matsadṛśāya vnare narāya vcarkṛtyaḥ punaḥpunaḥ kartavyaḥ |

he vsatapate satāṃ pālakandra sa tvaṃ vviśvāsu sarvāsu vdhūrṣu voḍhavyeṣu kāryabhāreṣu vvājakṛtyeṣu ca balakṛtyeṣu ca vvṛtre vvāpsu meghe vartamāneṣūdakeṣu ca nimitteṣu he vśūra tvam vabhi vmandase abhiṣṭūyase ||
ke te nara indra ye ta iṣe ye teṃ sumnaṃ sadhanvyamiryakṣān |
ke te vārjāyāsuryāya hinvire ke apsu svāsurvarāṃsu pauṃsyai ||
ke | te | naraḥ | indra | ye | te | iṣe | ye | te | sumnam | sadhanvyam | iryakṣān | ke | te | vājāya | asuryāya | hinvire | ke | apsu | svāsu | urvarāsu | pauṃsyai || 3 ||
he vindra vte vnaraḥ ke manuṣyā iti praśnaḥ |
vye narāḥ vte tava viṣe annāya prabhavantīti śeṣaḥ |
vye ca vte vsumnaṃ sukhaṃ tvadīyaṃ vsadhanvyaṃ dhanayuktam viryakṣān gacchanti |
tvadīyamidaṃ sukhaṃ dhanaṃ ca ye labhante te ke mahātmāna iti |
kiṃca vke vte tava vasuryāya asurasaṃbandhane teṣāṃ vadhanimittāya vvājāya balāya vhinvire6 prerayanti somādi haviḥ |
vke vā vapsu vsvāsu svāpekṣiteṣūdakeṣu vurvarāsu sarvasasyāḍhyāsu bhūmisu vpauṃsyai puṃstve ceti teṣu nimittabhūteṣu haviḥ prerayantītyanuvartate |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ mahoṃ indro ya ojasā bhuvasvamindra brahmaṇā mahān ’ ( āśva. śrau. 1. 6 ) iti |
‘ bhuvasvamindra brahmaṇā mahānamīvāsa iḻayā ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 11 ) iti hi sūtritam |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ śasyamuktaṃ bṛhaspatisavena śvaṃ bhuvaḥ pratimānaṃ pṛthivyā bhuvasvamindra brahmaṇā mahān ’ ( āśva. śrau. 9. 5 ) iti ||
bhuvasvamindra brahmaṇā mahānbhuvo viśveṣu sarveṣu yajñiyaḥ |
bhuvo nṛścyautano viśvasmin bhare jyeṣṭhaśca mantrau viśvacarṣaṇe ||

ye tai vipra brahmakṛtaḥ sute sacā vasūnāṃ ca vasuṃśca dāvane | pra te sumnasya manasā pathā bhuvanade sutasya somyasyandhasaḥ || 7 || ye | te | vipra | brahma'kṛtaḥ | sute | sacā | vasūnām | ca | vasun | ca | dāvane | pra | te | sumnasya | manasā | pathā | bhuvan | bhade | sutasya | somyasya | andhasaḥ || 7 ||

ha 'vipra medhāvinnindra 'te tubhya 'ye 'brahmakṛtaḥ stotrakartāro haviṣkartāro vā stotāraḥ 'sacā saṃghībhūtāḥ 'sute some'bhipute 'vasūnāṃ bahūnāṃ dhanānāṃ 'vasuṃśca ekasya nivāsayogyasya dhanasya ca 'dāvane dānāya paricaranti śeṣaḥ |
atra vasūnāmiti bahuvacanena aihikabhogasādhanāni1 dhanāni2 abhipretāni |
vjātavedaḥ jātaprajña vte vviśvāḥ sarvāḥ vtanvaḥ tanūḥ sarvāṇyaṅgāni vbahudhā bahuprakāram vekaḥ devaḥ vapaśyat dṛṣṭavān ||

ko mā dadarśa katamaḥ sa devo yo me tanvau bahudhā paryapaśyat | kāha mitrāvaruṇā kṣiyantyagnerviśvāḥ samidho devayānīḥ || 2 || kaḥ | mā | dadarśa | katamaḥ | saḥ | devaḥ | yaḥ | me | tanvaḥ | bahudhā | pari'apaśyat | kaḥ | aham | mitrāvaruṇā | kṣiyanti | agneḥ | viśvāḥ | sam'idhaḥ | devayānīḥ || 2 ||
vsa vdevaḥ vkatamaḥ vyo vme mama vtanvaḥ tanūḥ vbahudhā bahuprakāraṃ sthitāḥ vparyapaśyat paridṛṣṭavān |

he vmitrā- varuṇā mitrāvaruṇau vagneḥ mama vviśvāḥ sarvāḥ vsamidhaḥ dīptāḥ vdevayānīḥ devayānasādhanabhūtāḥ tanvo dṛṣṭā ityuktaṃ yadi dṛṣṭāstarhi vka vkṣiyanti ka nivasantītyevaṃ devānāṃ purato vartamānāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvāhāgniḥ ||

aicchāma tvā bahudhā jātavedaḥ praviṣṭamagne apsvoṣadhīṣu | taṃ tvā yamo acikeccitrabhāno daśantaruṣpādatirocamānam || 3 || aicchāma | tvā | bahudhā | jāta'vedaḥ | pra'viṣṭam | agne | ap'su | oṣadhīṣu | tam | tvā | yamaḥ | aciket | citrabhāno iti citra'bhāno | daśa'antaruṣpāt | ati'rocamānam || 3 ||
he vjātavedaḥ jātaprajña vagne vtvā tvām anu vaicchāma |
kīdṛśaṃ tvām vapsu udakeṣu voṣadhīṣu ca vbahudhā vpraviṣṭam |
anviṣya ca vtaṃ tādṛśamapraviṣṭaṃ vtvā vtvā vyamaḥ devaḥ vaciketa jñātavān he vcitrabhāno cāyanīya raśme |
pṛthivyādayastrayo lokā abhivātvādirākhyayo devā āpa oṣadhayo vanaspatayaḥ prāṇaśarīramiti daśa sthānāni ||

hotrādahaṃ varuṇa bibhyadāyaṃ nedeva māṃ yunajannatra devāḥ | tasya me tanvau bahudhā niviṣṭā etamarthaṃ na ciketāhamagniḥ || 4 || hotrāt | aham | varuṇa | bibhyat | āyam | na | it | eva | mā | yunajan | atra | devāḥ | tasya | me | tanvaḥ | bahudhā | ni'viṣṭāḥ | etam | artham | na | ciketa | aham | agniḥ ||4||
anayā devā māṃ jñātavanta iti niścitya gahanasya prayojanamāha |
he vvaruṇa deva vahaṃ vhotrāt hotṛṣyāt |
ataḥ vmā mām veva evaṃ pūrvaprakāreṇa vatra asmin havirvahane vnet vyunajan naiva yojayantu vdevāḥ |
tādṛśasya bibhyataḥ ᵛme ᵛtanvo ᵛbahudhā ᵛniviṣṭāḥ apsu |
ᵛetamartham etadvivahanakāryam ᵛagniḥ ᵛahaṃ ᵛna ᵛciketa na budhye nāṅgīkaromi ||

ehi manurdevayuryajñakāmo'laṃkṛtyā tamasi kṣepyagre | sugānpathaḥ kṛṇuhi devayānān vaha havyāni sumanasyamānaḥ || 5 || ā | ihi | manuḥ | devayuḥ | yajñakāmaḥ | aram'kṛtya | tamasi | kṣepi | agne | sugān | pathaḥ | kṛṇuhi | devayānān | vaha | havyāni | sumanasyamānaḥ || 5 ||
ᵛmanuḥ manuṣyo yaṣṭā manarnīyā mana rājā vā ᵛdevayuḥ devān yaṣṭumicchan ᵛyajñakāmaśca bhavati |
kiṃ kurvan yajña- kāmo bhavatīti ceducyate |
tvaṃ tu alaṃkṛtyātmānamalaṃkurvan ᵛtamasi anyairjñātumaśakye ᵛndhakāre ᵛkṣepi nivasasi |
he agne āgaccha ca ᵛdevayānān devān prati yairmanuṣyā gacchanti tān ᵛpathaḥ mārgān ᵛsugān ᵛkṛṇuhi kuru |
ᵛvaha ca ᵛhavyāni asmadīyāni ᵛsumanasyamānaḥ saumanasyamācarasvam ||

agneḥ pūrve bhrātaro arthametaṃ rathī'ivādhvānanmanvāvarītuḥ | tasmādbhiyā varuṇa dūramāyaṃ gauro na kṣemoravije jyāyāḥ || 6 || agneḥ | pūrve | bhrātaraḥ | artham | etam | rathī'iva | adhvānam | anu | ā | avarīvṛtuḥ | tasmāt | bhiyā | varuṇa | dūram | āyam | gauraḥ | na | kṣepraḥ | avije | jyāyāḥ || 6 ||
he devāḥ ᵛagneḥ mama ᵛpūrve pūrvamutpannāḥ ᵛbhrātaraḥ bhūpati- rbhuvanapatirbhūtānāṃ patiriti trayo'grajāḥ ᵛetam ᵛartha havirvahanālyamartham ᵛanvāvarītuḥ anukramena vṛtavantaḥ |
ᵛtasmāt maraṇāt ᵛbhiyā bhītyā he ᵛvaruṇa ᵛdūraṃ deśam ᵛāyam |
kiṃca ᵛkṣemoḥ iṣukṣeptuḥ dhanuṣaḥ ᵛjyāyāḥ sakāśāt ᵛgauro ᵛna gauramṛga iva sa yathā bibheti calati vā tadvat ᵛavije akampe |

amumitihāsaṃ prasantya kaupītakibrāhmaṇaṃ—‘tasmādāhurābhreyāḥ prayājā ābhreyā anuyājā āgneyājyamāgneyaḥ puroḍāśaḥ’ iti|
‘śarīradāyā ha vā agnayo bhavanti’ iti ca brāhmaṇaṃ ‘purupāhutiryasya priyatamā’ iti ca ||
tavaṃ prayājā anuyājāśca kevala ūrjasvanto haviṣaḥ santu bhāgāḥ|

‘viśve devāḥ śāsatana’ iti ṣaḍcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ saucīkasyābhreyaṃ vaiśvadevam|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘viśve devāḥ śāsatana mā yathehārādhi hotā nipadā yajīyān’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 4) iti ||
viśve devāḥ śāsatana mā yatheha hotā vṛto manavai yanniṣadya|
pra mai brūta bhāgadheyaṃ yathā vo yena pṛthā havyamā vo vahāni ||

yatheha yajñe hotā devānāmāhvayatā san vṛta: hotṛtvena vṛto'haṃ manavai staumi bhavata: |
me mama bhāgadheyaṃ pra brūta yathā va: yūyaṃ bhāgaṃ kalpitavantaḥ tathā te bhāgaṃ pra brūta |
yena ca pathā va: havyamā vahāni vahanaṃ karomi ||
ahaṃ hotā nyasīdaṃ yajīyān viśve devā maruto mā junanti |

darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ purā 'arādhi' ityeṣā japya | sūtramudāhṛtam || arā̭dhi॒ hotā̭ ni॒ṣadā॒ yajī̭yānbha॒i prayā̭ṃsi su॒dhitā̭ni hi॒ rūta | yajāma̭hai ya॒jñiyā̭n hanta॒ devā̭n ī॒ḻāma̭he ī॒ḍyā̭n ā॒jyena̭ || 2 || arā̭dhi | hotā̭ | ni॒'sadā̭ | yajī̭yān | a॒bhi | prayā̭ṃsi | su॒'dhitā̭ni | hi | rūta | yajāma̭hai | ya॒jñiyā̭n | hanta̭ | de॒vān | ī॒ḻāma̭he | ī॒ḍyā̭n | ā॒jyena̭ || 2 ||
ayamagniḥ hotā homaniṣpādakaḥ yajīyān yaṣṭamaśca san nipadā vedyāṃ niṣadanena arādhi siddho'bhūt |
tathābhūto'yaṃ sudhitāni suṣṭhu nihitāni prayāṃṃsi carupuro- ḍāśādyannāni abhi hi rūta abhiceṣṭa sarvataḥ paśyati |
yajñiyān yaṣṭavyān āhutibhājaḥ devān hanta śīghram ājyena yajāmahai tathā īḍyāna stutibhājau devān stutyā īḻāmahe iti buddhayeti śeṣaḥ ||

yasmin yajamāne jīvati mṛtaśabdo jāyate tasya surabhimatīṣṭiḥ kartavyā | 'sādhvīmakaḥ' ityeṣā tatrā yājyā | sūtritaṃ ca—'agnihotrā nyasīdacajīyān sādhvīmakadevavīti no adya' (āśva. śrau. 3. 13) iti || sā॒dhvī॒ma॒kadḙvavī॒ti no॒ adya̭ ya॒jñasya̭ ji॒hvāma̭vi॒daṃ guhā̭m | sa ā॒yurā̭gā॒tsura̭bhirva॒sāno॒ bhadrā̭ma॒kadḙvahū॒ti no॒ adya̭ || 3 || sā॒dhvī॒m | aka̭ḥ | de॒va'vī̭tim | naḥ | adya̭ | ya॒jñasya̭ | ji॒hvām | a॒vi॒dam | guhā̭m | saḥ | ā॒yuḥ | ā | a॒gāt | su॒ra॒bhiḥ | va॒sāna̭ḥ | bhadrā̭m | aka̭ḥ | de॒va'hṷ̄tim | naḥ | adya̭ ||3||
ayamagniḥ adya naḥ asmākaṃ devavītiṃ devānāmāgamanavantaṃ devānāṃ havirbhakṣaṇopetaṃ vā yajñaṃ sādhvīmakaḥ sādhumakarot |
vayaṃ ca yajñasya guhāṃ gūḍhatarāṃ jihvāmavidāma labdhavantaḥ sma |
agniṃ hi yajñasya jihvā tena devānāṃ pānājihvātvenaupacāraḥ |
vāyuḥ devaiḥ dattamāyuṣyaṃ vvasānaḥ ācchādayan vāgāt āgacchati |
āgasya ca vnaḥ asmadartha vdevahūti devānāmāhvānavantaṃ yajñaṃ vbhadrāmakaḥ kalyāṇaṃ kṛtavān vatha idānīm ||
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāmidhenyarthaṃ preṣitena hotrā ‘tadya vācaḥ’ ityeṣā japya|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīyeti samāpta’ (āśva.śrau. 1.2) iti ||
tadya vācaḥ prathamaṃ masīya yenāsurā~ abhi devā asāma |
ūrjāda uta yajñiyāsaḥ pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣadhvam ||
tat | adya | vācaḥ | prathamam | masīya | yena | asurān | abhi | devāḥ | asāma | ūrjāda'adaḥ | uta | yajñiyāsaḥ | pañca | janāḥ | mama | hotram | juṣadhvam || 4 ||
vācāṃ mukhyaṃ vtat vvācaḥ vacaḥ vacanaṃ vmasīya masīya uccārayāmi |
vyena vacasā ahaṃ vdevāḥ ca vayam vasurān vabhi vasāma abhibhavema |
vūrjādaḥ he annādaḥ vuta api ca vyajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhā he vpañca vjanāḥ devamanuṣyādayaḥ yūyaṃ vmama vhotraṃ vjuṣadhvaṃ sevadhvamiti |
pañca janā mama hotraṃ juṣantāṃ gojātā uta ye yajñiyāsaḥ |

vpañca vjanāḥ devādyaḥ vmama vhotraṃ havamāhvānaṃ vjuṣantāṃ sevantām |
vuta api ca vye vyajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhāḥ santi te mama hotraṃ juṣantām |
kiṃca vpṛthivī pṛthivīdevatā vpārthivāt pṛthivīsambandhāt vnaḥ asmān vaṃhasaḥ pāpāt vpātu rakṣatu |
tathā vanta- rikṣam antarikṣadevatā vdivyāt āntarikṣādaṃhasaḥ pāpasakāśāt vasmān vpātu ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘avi- dhūnvan saṃtataṃ stṛṇan savyena gārhapatyādāhavanīyameti tantuṃ tanvañjaso bhānumanvihi’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 11) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘gārhapatyādavicchinnā- mudadhārāṃ harettantuṃ tanvañjaso bhānumanvihi’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 2) iti |
anyantarāle śrāti- krame'nayā gārhapatyāhavanīyayormadhyamudakena bhasmanā ca pūrayet |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘gārhapatyāhavanīyayo- rantaraṃ bhasmarājyaudakarājyā ca saṃtanuyāt’ (āśva. śrau. 3.10) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tantuṃ tanvañjaso bhānumanvihevā na indro maghavā virapśī’ (āśva. śrau.5.20) iti ||
tantuṃ tanvanrajaso bhānumanvahi jyotiṣmataḥ pṛtho rakṣa dhiyā kṛtān |
anulvaṇaṃ vayat joguvāmapo manurbhava janaya daivyaṃ janam ||

tathā kṛtvā ᐁpra tarata tāṃ nadīmu- llaṅghayata |

ᐁye'sukhabhūtāḥ ᐁasan abhavan asmānāśritya vartante tāñjahāma |
tathā kṛtvā ᐁśivān sukhakarāṇi ᐁvājān annāni havīpi ᐁabhi prāptum ᐁuttarem ||

‘tāṃ su te’ iti ṣarcaṃ dvādaśa sūktaṃ vāmadevagotrasya bṛhadukthasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |

sūtritaṃ ca—‘apūrvyā purutamāni tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ tvaṃ mahāṃ indra’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 7) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā bhūya idvāvṛdhe vīryāya’ (ai. ā. 5. 1. 6) iti ||
tāṃ su teṃ kīrtiṃ maghavanmahitvā yarvā bhīte rodasī ahyetām |
prāvau devā~ ātiro dāsumojaḥ prajāyai tvasyai yadaśikṣa indra ||

asurān hatvā devānāṃ rakṣaṇena dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ bhītiṃ paryahara iti yadasti kiṃca tvasyai ekasyai prajāyai yajamānarūpāyai yat balam aśikṣaḥ prāyacchaḥ |

sūktaśeṣaṃ jaguścāsya cetaso dhāraṇā ya te' (bṛhade. 7. 97. 101) iti ||

tato yathārthakathanena tuṣṭaḥ puruṣo nābhānediṣṭāyaiva svaṃ bhāgaṃ prādādityuktam|
tathācadhvaryubrāhmaṇo'pi 'sanuḥ putrebhyo dāyaṃ vyabhajanta sa nābhānediṣṭaṃ' (tai. saṃ. 3. 1. 9. 4) ityādināyamartha uktaḥ|
idamithā raudraṃ gurtavacā brahma katvā śacyāṃntarājī|
krāṇā yadasya pitarā maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ parṣatpakthe ahanā susa hotṝn ||
idam | itthā | raudram | gurtavacāḥ | brahma | katvā | śacyām | antarājī | krāṇā | yat | asya | pitarau | maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ | parṣat | pakthe | ahanā | susa | hotṝn || 1 ||

gartavacā. unnatavacano nābhānediṣṭaḥ 'idaṃ yatra stotraṃ raudraṃ hṛdavarṇanam' itthā ittha- midānīṃkriyamāṇaprakāraṃ kṛtvā prajñānena niṣpādya stotraṃ śacyāmantaḥ karmaṇi satramadhye ājau aṅgirasāṃ saṃghe karotīti śeṣaḥ|
yat stotraṃ krāṇā bhāgaṃ kurvāṇā bhāgaṃ kurvāṇau asya pitarā pitarāvanve ca maṃhaneṣṭhāḥ āgapradāne vartamānāḥ āṅgirasa golābhasādhanatvena kalpayanti śeṣaḥ|
tena nābhānediṣṭaḥ pakthe pakthye ahan ahani|
'te ṣaṣṭhe'hamevāhārāgatya muhyanti'⁹ tānete sūkte ṣaṣṭhe'hani śaṃsaya' (ai. brā. 5.14) ityuktatvāt|
yatsa hotṝn hotṛpraśastyābrāhmaṇā- caṃsyādikān ā paryantaṃ sarvato'paśyan|
sa idānāya dabhyāya vanvañjayavānaḥ sudaimimīta vedim|
turvyāṇo gurtavacastamaḥ kṣodo na reta itaūti siśrat ||
saḥ | it | dānāya | dabhyāya | vanvan | cyavānaḥ | sudaiḥ | abhimīta | vedim | turvyāṇaḥ | gurtavacastamaḥ | kṣodaḥ | na | retaḥ | itaḥ | ūti | siśrat || 2 ||
ma it sa kṛṣṇavāsī puruṣo rudrāsya dānāya stotṛṇāṃ dhanapradānāya dabhyāya śatrūṇāṃ vadhāya ca vanvan stotṛn saṃbhajan sudaiḥ sudakauhisakaiḥ 11 śastraiḥ cyavānaḥ rakṣāṃsi cyāvayan vedim

vtūryathāṇaḥ tūrṇagamanaḥ vgūrtavacastamaḥ atyantamudyatavacāḥ rudraḥ vkṣodo vna udakamiva |

manaḥ | na | yeṣu | harvaneṣu | tigmam | vipaḥ | śacyā | vanuthaḥ | dravantā | ā | yaḥ | śaryābhiḥ | tuvinmṛṇaḥ | asya | aśriṇīta | ā | diśam | garbhastau || 3 ||

he aśvinau yuvāṃ vmano vna mana iva yathā manaḥ vnigmaṃ tīkṣṇamāśu dhāvati āgacchati evaṃ vyeṣu vhavaneṣu āhvāneṣu vvipaḥ stotuḥ vśacyā prajñānena gantavyamiti buddhyā vdravantā dravantau vvanuthaḥ saṃbhajathaḥ |
vyaḥ adhvaryuḥ vā ābhimukhyena vtuvinmṛṇaḥ prabhūtahavirlakṣaṇadhanaḥ san vasya karmaṇi pravṛttasya mama sambandhī vśaryābhiḥ aṅgulībhiḥ vaśrīṇīta śrīṇāti |
tādṛśaṃ madīya- madhvaryuṃ yeṣu havaneṣu vvanuthaḥ saṃbhajathaḥ tau yuvāṃ huva ityuttaratra sambandhaḥ ||
kṛṣṇā yaddorvvaruṇīṣu sīdadvio napātāśvinā huve vām |
vītaṃ mai yajamā gataṃ me annaṃ vavanvāṃsā neṣamasmṛtadhra ||
kṛṣṇā | yat | goṣu | aruṇīṣu | sīdat | divaḥ | napātā | aśvinā | huve | vām | vītam | me | yajñam | ā | gatam | me | annam | vavanvāṃsā | na | iṣam | asmṛtadhra || 4 ||
vkṛṣṇā rātriḥ vyat yadā varuṇīṣu aruṇavarṇāmu vgoṣu vsīdat nivasati |
upaḥkāle he vdivo vnapātā dīpyamānasya svargamya prakāśatmakasya yāgasya vā na pātayitārau he aśvinau vtrāṃ vhuve āhvaye |
tadarthaṃ vme vyajñam vā vgatam āgacchatam |
prathiṣṭa yasya vīrakarmiṣṇadanuṣṭhitaṃ nu naryo apauhat |
prayiṣṭa | yasya̭ | vīra̭'karmam | iṣṇat | anṷ'sthitam | nu | nayai̭ | arpa̭ | auhat | puna̭riti̭ | tat | ā | vṛhati̭ | yat | kanāyā̭ḥ | duhitṷḥ | āḥ | anṷ'bhṛtam | anarvā ||5||
yathā svāṃśena bhagavān rudraḥ prajāpatirvāstoṣpatiṃ rudramasṛjat tadetadādibhiritisubhirbhedati |
yena retamo- ṣṇā vīrā bhavanti tādṛmetaḥ pradhiṣṭa prathitamāsīt tadetaḥ anuṣṭitaṃ prajāpatināpatyārtha niṣiktaṃ nayaiḥ narebhyo hito yadvā netrabhyo devebhyo hito rudraḥ apohat apohati |
punastat retaḥ ā vṛhati sarvata uskhidati udgamayati puruṣākāreṇa svayamutpannaḥ san |
yat retaḥ kanāyāḥ kāntāyāḥ duhituḥ svaputryāḥ tasyāmityarthaḥ |
‘prajāpatirvai svāṃ duhitaramadhya- dhyāyaditimanya āhurāpasamimyanye’ (ai. brā. 3. 33) iti brāhmaṇam ||
madhyā yatkartvamabhavadabhīke kāmaṃ kṛṇvāne pitari yuvatyām |
manānagretau jahaturyantā sānau nirbhiktaṃ sukṛtasya yonau ||
madhyā | yat | katvam | abhavat | abhīke | kāmam | kṛṇvāne | pitari̭ | yuvatyām | manānak | reta̭: | jahatṷḥ | triyantā̭ | sānaṷ | ni̭'siktam | sṷ'kṛtasya | yonaṷ || 6 ||
kāmaṃ yathecchaṃ kṛṇvāne kurvāṇa pitari prajāpatau yuvatyāṃ duhitaryapi divi vā |
madhyā tayormadhye 'ntarikṣamadhye vā abhīke samīpe yat katvaṃ karma abhavat mithunībhāvākhyaṃ tadānīṃ manānak alpaṃ retaḥ jahatuḥ tyaktavantau |
prajāpatinā sānau samucchrite sthāne sukṛtasya yajñasya yonau niṣiktam āsīdityarthaḥ |
pitā yatsvāṃ duhitaramadhiṣkan kṣmayā retaḥ saṃjagmāno ni piṃścat |
svādhyau'janayan brahma devā vāstoṣpatiṃ vratapāṃ niratakṣan ||
pitā | yat | svām | duhitara̭m | adhi̭'skan | kṣmayā̭ | reta̭: | sam'jagmānaḥ | ni | piṃścat | sṷ'ādhyauḥ | ajanayan | brahma̭ | devā̭ḥ | vāsto̭'patim | vrata̭'pām | niḥ | atakṣan ||7||

pitā prajāpatiḥ yat yadā svāṃ duhitaraṃ divamupasaṃ vā adhiṣkan adhyaskandat tadānī- meva kṣmayā pṛthivyā saha saṃjagmānaḥ saṃgacchamānaḥ prajāpatirasmiṃlloke rohitaṃ bhūtāmṛgyo bhūtvā retaḥ ni piṃścat niṣekamakarot |
‘tāmṛśyo bhūtvā rohitaṃ bhūtāmabhyait’ (ai. brā. 3. 33) iti brāhmaṇam |
tadānīṃ svādhyaḥ sudhyānāḥ sukarmāṇo vā devāḥ brahma ajanayan udapādayan |
vāstoṣpatiṃ yajñavāstusvāminaṃ vratapāṃ vratasya karmaṇaḥ rakṣaḥprabhṛtibhyaḥ pālakaṃ niratakṣan samudapādayan |

sa īṃ vṛṣā na phenamasyadājau smadā pairairdapa dubhraścaitāḥ | satpadā na dakṣiṇā parāvṛṅ na tā nu me pṛśnyo jagṛbhe || 8 || saḥ | īm | vṛṣā | na | phenam | asyat | ājau | smadā | ā | parā | ait | arpa | dubhraścaitāḥ | sarat | padā | na | dakṣiṇā | parāvṛk | na | tāḥ | nu | me | pṛśnyaḥ | jagṛbhe || 8 || aṅgirasāṃ satrānte nābhānidiṣṭo gonirgathāthāgacchantaṃ vāstoṣpatiṃ purataḥ paśyan vadati | 'sa 'īm so'yaṃ 'vṛṣā 'na varṣaka indra iva ma yathā namucivadhārtham 'ājau saṃgrāme 'phenamasyat kṣisavān tadakṣepamanā vāstāṃppaniridānīṃ tavaita vāstubhāgo yukta iti yathārthakathanānantaraṃ 'smat asmattaḥ 'ā 'apa 'paraita apaparāgacchati | 'dubhracetāḥ alpamanasko yaḥ kaścit 'dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇā- rthānāṃ gavāṃ 'parāvṛk parāvarjitā san 'padā padāni 'na 'sarat na sarati asmadabhimukhamāgacchati | 'me mama maṃtrandhinvyaḥ 'nāḥ gāḥ aṅgirobhirdattāḥ 'pṛśnyaḥ paśrikānāmabhisrpainakuśalo rudraḥ 'na 'jagṛbhe na gṛhārtā'yevamāśamne ||

makṣu na vahniḥ prajāyāṃ upandigmaṃ na nama upa sīdadūrdhaḥ | sanitedhamaṃ sarnitota vājaṃ sa dhartā jajñe sahasā yavīyut || 9 || makṣu | na | vahniḥ | 'prajāyāḥ | upandiḥ | agnim | na | namaḥ | upa | sīdat | ūrdhaḥ | sanitā | idhamam | sanitā | uta | vājam | saḥ | dhartā | jajñe | sahasā | yavi'yut || 9 || vāstoṣpatinā rudreṇa gopyamāne'smin yajñe 'vahniḥ vahnidāhako rākṣasādiḥ 'makṣu 'na śīghraṃ 'na 'upa 'sīdat nāgacchati | yo vahniḥ 'prajāyāḥ 'upandiḥ upapīḍako bhavati | yajñavighātāthaṃ- māgacchati | ṛtvigādirūpāyāḥ prajāyā na pīḍāṃ karotyahani | tathā 'ūdhaḥ | rātrināmaitat | rātrāvapi 'agni jvalannaṃ 'namaḥ vivasano rākṣasādiḥ 'na 'upa 'sīdat | evaṃ rudre rakṣitari mati maḥ agniḥ 'idhamaṃ 'saninā 'jajñe utpannaḥ | 'uta api ca 'vājam annaṃ haviḥ 'sanitā jajñe | 'sa 'dhartā yajñasya phalasya vā dhāraka utpannaḥ so'gniḥ 'sahayā valena 'yatrīyut yajñamiśrayitṛṇāṃ rakṣaḥ- prabhṛtīnāṃ yoddhrā jajñe ||

makṣu kunāyāḥ suruyaṃ narvagvā ṛtaṃ vadanta ṛtayuktimagman | dvirhaṃso ya upa gopamāguradakṣiṇāso acyutā dudukṣan || 10 || makṣu | kunāyāḥ | satyam | narvagvāḥ | ṛtam | vadantaḥ | ṛta'yuktim | agman | dviḥ'haṃsaḥ | ye | upa | gopam | ā | arguḥ | adṛśriṇāsaḥ | acyutā | dudukṣan || 10 || 'narvagvāḥ aṅgirasaḥ | gavāmayanasya satramanuṣṭhitāmaṅgirasāṃ madhye ye navamu māseṣu labdhagāvaḥ manta utthitāste navagvāḥ | te 'ṛtaṃ 'vadantaḥ 'makṣu śīghraṃ 'kunāyāḥ kamanīyāyāḥ stuterbhā- nediṣṭhapreritāyāḥ prakāśāna 'ṛtayuktim uktayogaparimamāstim 'agman prāptāḥ | yadvā | ṛtayukti yajñayogopetamamṛtaṃ śabdaṃ stutiṃ vadanto'ṅgirasaḥ kunāyāḥ pṛśnyāḥ satyamagmanniti yojanā | 'dvirhaṃsaḥḥ
