dvayoḥ sthānayorvāpṛthivyoḥ parivṛḍhāḥ 'ye aṅgirasaḥ 'gopaṃ gopāyitāraṃ nābhānidiṣṭamindraṃ vā 'upa 'āguḥ upagatāḥ te 'adakṣilāṇaḥ dakṣiṇarahitāḥ |
' adakṣiṇāni satraṇītyāhuḥ ' iti hi vacanaṃ 'ye yajamānāsta ṛtvijaḥ ' iti |
makṣu kunāyāḥ sukhaṃ navīyau rādho na retaṃ ṛtamirturaṇyan |
śuci yatte rekaṇa āryajanta sabudughāyāḥ parya ustriyāyāḥ ||
makṣu | kunāyāḥ | sukhyam | navīyaḥ | rādhaḥ | na | reta: | ṛtam | ita | turaṇyan | śuci | yat | te | rekaṇaḥ | ā | aryajanta | saḥ | dughāyāḥ | parya | ustriyāyāḥ || 11 ||
vtadita tatraiva vnu kṣipram vasya indrasya vparipdvānaḥ parito vartamānāḥ paricārakā raśmayaḥ vagman prakāśanāthamagacchan |
vpuru puruṇi kṛtrimāṇi vsadanataḥ sīdanto'surāḥ vnāryadaṃ nṛṣadaḥ putraṃ vbibhitsan bhantumaicchan |
kiṃcāyaṃ vśuṣṇasya etannāmakasyāsurasya vpuruprajātasya bahuprādurbhāvasya vsaṃgrathitaṃ marma vvidan vanti |
ayamindraḥ vyat asurasya durjñeyaṃ marma vguhā guhāyāṃ gopitaṃ tadvidan||

bhargo ha nāmota yasya devāḥ sva̭rṇa ye tripadhasthe nipeduḥ | agni̭ha nāmota jātavedāḥ śrudhī nau hotaṛtasya hotādhruk || 14 || bhargaḥ | ha | nāma | uta | yasya | devāḥ | sva̭ḥ | na | ye | tri'padhasthe | ni'seduḥ | agniḥ | ha | nāma | | uta | jāta'vedāḥ | śrudhi | naḥ | hotaḥ | ṛtasya | hotā | adhruk || 14 ||
vuta api ca bhargo vha vnāma tattejaḥ kila prasiddhaṃ vyasya tejasa āgneyasya saṃbandhini vtripadhasthe barhiṣi vye vdevāḥ santi te sarve vsvarṇa svarge yathā tathaiva vnipeduḥ niṣīdanti |
vuta api ca tattejaḥ vagniha vnāma agniḥ kila nāma |
utāpi ca vjātavedāḥ jātaprajño jātānāṃ veditā etadapi tasya tejaso nāma |
agnerbharga ityagniriti jātavedā iti ca trīṇi nāmānītyarthaḥ |
ha vhāntaḥ homaniṣpādakottanāmābhe vṛtasya vhotā yajñasya saṃbandhināṃ devānāmāhvātā vadhrak droharahitastvaṃ vnaḥ asmākāhvātaṃ vśrudhi śṛṇu ||

uta tyā me raudrāvarcimantā nāsatyāvindra gurtaye yajadhyai | manuṣyadvaktarbarhiṣe rarāṇā mandū hitaprayasā viśva yajyū || 15 || uta | tyā | me | raudrau | arci'mantā | nāsatyau | indra | gurtaye | yajadhyai | manuṣyat | vṛkta'barhiṣe | rarāṇā | mandū | hita'prayasā | viśva | yajyū iti || 15 ||
vuta api ca he vindra vtyā tau prasiddhau vraudrau rudraputrau |
'kṣodo na reta itaūti siñcat' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 61. 2) iti hi rudraputratvamuktam |
varcimantā dīsimantau vnāsatyau aśvinau vme vgurtaye stutaye vyajadhyai yāgāya ca bhavetāmiti śeṣaḥ |

kiṃca vmanuṣyat mama piturmatoriva tasya yajñe yathā tathaida vvṛktabarhiṣe stīrṇabarhiṣe mahyaṃ vrarāṇā ramamāṇau vmandū madiṣṇū vhitaprayasā prerita- dhanau vviśva ṛtvikṣvasmadīyeṣu tathā vyajyū yaṣṭavyau bhavatamiti śeṣaḥ ||

ayaṃ stuto rājā vandi vedhā apaśca viprastarati svasetuḥ | sa kukṣīvantaṃ rejayatso agni nemi na cakramervato raghudru || 16 || ayam | stutaḥ | rājā | vandi | vedhāḥ | apaḥ | ca | vipraḥ | tarati | sva'setuḥ | saḥ | kukṣīvantam | rejayat | saḥ | agnim | nemim | na | cakram | arvataḥ | raghu'dru || 16 ||
vayaṃ vvedhāḥ sarvasya vidhātā vrājā somaḥ vstutaḥ sarvaiḥ vvandi stūyate'smābhiḥ |
kiṃca vvipraḥ viśeṣeṇa pūrako vipravacchudvo vā vsvasetuḥ yasya svabhūtā raśmayo jagadandhakāḥ santi sa somaḥ vapaśca antarikṣaṃ ca vtarati laṅghayati pratidinam |
va sa: sa eva agni havirdohamaśakaṃ samaṃtaṃ palāyyāpsu praviṣṭaṃ rejayat |
nemiṃ namanaśīlaṃ raghudru laghugamanaṃ cakram arvaṃta: arvaṃto'śvā iva te yathā tathā rejayat |
sa dvibandhurvaitaraṇo yaṣṭā savadhuṃ dhenumastvaṃ duhadhyai |
sa: | dvibandhu: | vaitaraṇa: | yaṣṭā | sabadhum | dhenum | astvam | duhadhyai | sam | yat | mitrāvaruṇā | vṛñje | ukthai: | jyeṣṭhai: | aryamaṇam | varuthai: || 17 ||
vasa: agni: dvibandhu: dvayorlokayorbandhubhūta: vaitaraṇa: sarvasya viśeṣeṇa tārayitā |
yaṣṭā devānāṃ yājako'gni: savadhum amṛtopamapayodogdhrīṃ dhenum astvam aprasūtāṃ nivṛttaprasavāṃ śayave duhadhyai dohāyākarot |
yata yadā sa śayu: mitrāvaruṇau aryamaṇaṃ ca jyeṣṭhebhi: jyeṣṭhai: praśastai: varuthai: varaṇīyai: ukthai: śastrai: saṃ vṛñje samyakstauti |
yadā sa śayurmitrāvaruṇa.yaṃgaṇāṃ stutiṃ karoti tadā tepāmājñayāpsunirvṛttaprasavāṃ payodagdhīmakaroditi ||
tadvandhu: sūrirdivi teṃ dhiyaṃdhā nābhānediṣṭo rapati pra vernan |
sā no nābhi: paramāsya vā ghāhaṃ tatpaśvā katithaścidāsa ||
tat bandhu: | sūri: | divi | te | dhiyam dhā: | nābhānediṣṭa: | rapati | pra | vernan | sā | na: | nābhi: | paramā | asya | vā | gha | aham | tat | paśvā | katitha: | cit | ām || 18 ||
sūri: stute: preraka: divi vartamānasya te tava svabhūta iti śeṣa: |
taccādityaputro manurmano: putro nābhānediṣṭa ityevaṃ sūryāpsya- tve'pi paryavasyati |
ma ca dhiyaṃdhā: karmaṇāṃ dhārako nābhānediṣṭa: venan aṅgirodattaṃ gosahasraṃ venan kāmayan pra rapati pralapati |
sā dyau: na: asmākaṃ paramā utkṛṣṭā nābhi: bandhikā ca asya ādityasya adhiṣṭhānabhūtāsti |
ahaṃ tat tasyādityasya paśvā paścādanantaraṃ katitha: katipayānāṃ pūraṇa: āsa abhavam |

ᵥyaḥ yajñaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥsvamante avināśāya ᵥaṃhaḥ pāparūpaṃ mārgamavaidikam ᵥati ᵥparvat ati- pārayati taṃ yajñaṃ ko vālaṃkarotīti ||
yebhyo hotrāṃ prathamāmāyeje manuḥ samiddhāgnirmanasā sapta hotṛbhiḥ |
ta ādityā abhayaṃ śarma yacchata sugā naḥ karta supathā svastaye ||
yebhyaḥ | hotrām | prathamām | ā'yeje | manuḥ | samiddha'agniḥ | manasā | sapta | hotṛbhiḥ | te | ādityāḥ | abhayam | śarma | yacchata | sugā | naḥ | kartu | su'pathā | svastaye ||7||

ᵥsamiddhāgniḥ havirbhiḥ samyagdīptāgniḥ ᵥmanuḥ vaivasvato manuṣyāṇāṃ prathamabhāvī śraddhayānena ᵥmanasā ᵥsapta saptasaṃkhyākaiḥ ᵥhotṛbhiḥ vaṣaṭkartṛbhirṛtvigbhiśca saha ᵥyebhyaḥ yuṣmabhyaṃ ᵥprathamāṃ prathamaṃ mukhyaṃ yadvā sarveṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāmagre kriyamāṇatvādādyaṃ ᵥhotrām |
he ᵥādityāḥ aditaḥ putrā he devāḥ ᵥte yūyaṃ no'- smabhyam ᵥabhayaṃ ᵥśarma ca sukhaṃ prayacchata |
kiṃca ᵥnaḥ asmākaṃ ᵥsvastaye kṣamāya ᵥsupathā supathāni śobhanān vaidikamārgān ᵥsugā maṣṭhu gantavyāna ᵥkarte kumta |
karoterloṭi ‘ bahulaṃ chandasi ’ iti vikaraṇasya luk |
ya īśire bhuvanasya pracetamo viśvasya sthāturjagataśca mantavaḥ |
te naḥ kṛtakṛtādenaṃsparyā devāḥ piprata svastaye ||
ye | īśire | bhuvanasya | pra'cetasaḥ | viśvasya | sthātuḥ | jagataḥ | ca | mantavaḥ | te | naḥ | kṛtāta | arkṛtāta | enasaḥ | pari | atha | devāḥ | piprata | svastaye || 8 ||
ᵥpracetasaḥ prakṛṣṭajñānāḥ ᵥmantavaḥ sarvasya veditāraḥ ᵥye devāḥ ᵥsthānuḥ sthāvarasya ᵥjagataḥ jaṅgamasya ᵥviśvasya sarvasya ᵥbhuvanasya lokasya ᵥīśire īśvarā bhavanti |
he ᵥdevāḥ devā ya uktaguṇāḥ ᵥte yūyaṃ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥkṛtān kāyikapāpān ᵥakṛtān karacaraṇādibhirakṛtāt ᵥenasaḥ kiṃtu mānasapāpācca ᵥadya asmindine ᵥsvastaye avināśāyāyupo'bhivṛddhaye ᵥpiprata pārayata |
bhareṣvindraṃ suhavaṃ havāmahe'homucaṃ sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ janam |
agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ sātaye bhagaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī marutaḥ svastaye ||
bhareṣu | indram | su'havam | havāmahe | aṃhaḥ'mucam | su'kṛtam | daivyam | janam | agnim | mitram | varuṇam | sātaye | bhagam | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | marutaḥ | svastaye || 9 ||
bhareṣu | indram | ᵥsuhavam | havāmahe | ᵥaṃhaḥ'mucam | ᵥsukṛtam | ᵥdaivyam | ᵥjanam | agnim | mitram | varuṇam | ᵥsātaye | bhagam | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | marutaḥ | svastaye || 9 ||
aṃhomucam aṃhasaḥ pāpasya mocakaṃ suhavaṃ śobhanāhvānam indraṃ bhāreṣu |
bhṛṇanti bharjayanti vināśayanti śatrūniti bharāḥ saṃgrāmāḥ |
kiṃca sukṛtaṃ sukarmāṇaṃ daivyaṃ devasambandhanamanyaṃ janaṃ cāhvayāmahe |
agniṃ mitraṃ varuṇaṃ bhagaṃ bhajanīyametannāmānaṃ devaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau marutaḥ ca mātaye aklābhāya svastaye avināśāya rakṣaṇāyāhvayāmahe ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'aditi-haṃjaniṣṭa sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ ghāmanehasam' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ ghāmanehasaṃ mahīm pu mātaraṃ sutrānām' (āśva. śrau. 4. 3) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ ghāmanehasamiti nāvam' (āśva. gṛ. 2. 6. 8) iti ||
sutrāmāṇam | pṛthivīm | yām | anehasam | suśarmāṇam | aditima | supraṇītim | daivīm | nāvam | suaritrām | anāgasam | asravantīm | ā | ruhema | svastaye || 10 ||

sutrāmāṇaṃ suṣṭhu trāyantīṃ pṛthivīṃ vistṛtām anehasaṃ pāparahitāṃ suśarmāṇaṃ śobhanasukhayuktām aditima adīnāṃ supraṇītiṃ supraṇayanāṃ suṣṭhu praṇetrīṃ daivīṃ devasambandhinīṃ svaritrāṃ śobhanāritrāṃ jalāharaṇaśīladāruyuktām anāgasaṃ pāparahitām asravantīṃ agacchantīm-vinaśvarīṃ nāvaṃ nāvamiva sthitāṃ dyāṃ svastaye avināśāya devatvaprāptaye ā ruhema vayamārohema |
viśve yajatrā ardhi vocatotaye trāyadhvaṃ no durevāyā abhihutaḥ |
satyā vo devahūtayā huvema śṛṇvato devā avase svastaye ||
viśve | yajatrāḥ | ardhi | vocata | ūtaye | trāyadhvam | naḥ | duḥevāyāḥ | abhi'hutaḥ | satyā | vaḥ | deva'hūtayā | huvema | śṛṇvataḥ | devāḥ | avase | svastaye || 11 ||
he yajatrāḥ yajanīyā he viśve sarve devā yūyam ūtaye rakṣaṇārtham abhi vocata asmā-nadhibrūta |
ābhāvya ca abhihutaḥ abhihiṃsitvāḥ durevāyaḥ durgataiḥ naḥ asmān trāyadhvam |
yadyevaṃ kurutha tarhi he devāḥ śṛṇvataḥ stotrāṇyasmābhiruktāni tādṛśān vaḥ yuṣmān satyā yathārthabhūtayā devahūtayā |
avase rakṣaṇāya śatrubhyaḥ svastaye kṣemāya jīvanābhivṛddhaye ca ||
1. ga-ta1.2.3.7-bha6.7-nāvaṃ navaratheneti; ta4.6.8-bha1.4.5-nāvaṃ na ratheneti; ta5-nāvamāha-hemeti; bha2-nāvaṃ ratheneti; bha8-nāvaṃ na ratheti |

apāmī̭vā॒mapa̭ vi॒śvāma̭nāhu॒tima̭pārā॒tiṃ du॒rvi॒datrā̭maghā॒yata̭: | ārḙ de॒vā dve॒ṣo a॒smadyṷyotano॒ru ṇa॒ḥ śarma̭ yacchatā svastayḙ || 12 || apa̭ | a॒mī॒vām | apa̭ | vi॒śvām | a॒nā॒hu॒tim | apa̭ | a॒rā॒tim | dṷḥ'vi॒datrā̭m | a॒gha॒'yata̭: | ārḙ | de॒vāḥ | dve॒ṣaḥ | a॒smat | yu॒yo॒ta | u॒ru | na॒ḥ | śarma̭ | ya॒ccha॒ta | sva॒stayḙ || 12 ||
he ^devāḥ ^amīvāṃ rogādikaṃ yadvā rogavarddhāpakaṃ śatrumasatto dūre ^apa kuruta pṛthakkuruta |
tathā ^viśvāṃ sarvām ^anāhutiṃ devānāmāhvānabuddhiṃ yadvā devānāṃ mahāśatruṃ pṛthakkuruta |
kiṃca ^arātim adānaṃ lobhabuddhiṃ yadvā devebhyo havipāmadātāraṃ śatrum ^apa gamayata |
api ca ^aghāyataḥ pāpamicchataḥ śatroḥ ^durvivatrāṃ durjñānaṃ duṣṭāṃ buddhim itthaṃ ca ^dvepaḥ dveṣan sarvāṃścatran ^asmat asmattaḥ ^āre dūre ^yuyotana pṛthakkuruta |
evaṃ yadi yūyaṃ ^naḥ asmabhyam ^uru vistīrṇaṃ ^śarma sukhaṃ ^svastaye kalyāṇāya prayacchata ||

ari̭ṣṭaḥ sa ma॒rto vi॒śva ḙdhate॒ pra pra॒jābhi̭rjāyate॒ dharma̭ṇa॒spari̭ | yamā̭di॒tyāso॒ naya̭thā munī॒tibhi̭rati॒ viśvā̭ni du॒ritā॒ svastayḙ || 13 || ari̭ṣṭaḥ | saḥ | ma॒rtaḥ | vi॒śvaḥ | e॒dha॒te | pra | pra॒jā'bhi̭: | jā॒ya॒te | dharma̭ṇaḥ | pari̭ | yam | ā॒di॒tyāsa̭ḥ | naya̭tha | mu॒nī॒ti'bhi̭: | a॒ti | vi॒śvā̭ni | du॒'ritā̭ | sva॒stayḙ || 13 ||
he devāḥ ^viśvaḥ sarvaḥ ^martaḥ ^saḥ manuṣyaḥ ^ariṣṭaḥ kaiścidapyahiṃsitaḥ mana ^edhate paścādibhirvardhate |
tathā ^dharmaṇaspari dhārakātkarmaṇo'nantaraṃ sa manuṣyaḥ ^prajābhiḥ putrādibhiḥ ^pra ^jāyate prakarṣeṇāvirbhūto bhavati |
he ^ādityāsaḥ ādityā devāḥ ^yaṃ manuṣyaṃ ^munītibhiḥ sunayanaiḥ ^viśvāni sarvāṇi ^duritā duritāni pāpāni tadapācchatrunvā ^svastaye kṣemāya ^ati ^nayatha atītya sanmārge nayatha |

yaṃ dḙvāso'vatha॒ vāja̭sātau॒ yaṃ śūra̭sātā ma॒ruto॒ hite॒ dhanḙ | prāta̭ryā॒vāṇa॒ṃ ratha̭mindra॒ sānṷsimari̭ṣyanta॒mā rṷhema svastayḙ || 14 || yam | de॒vāsa̭ḥ | a॒va॒tha | vāja̭'sātau | yam | śūra̭'sātā | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | hi॒te | dhanḙ | prāta̭ḥ'yā॒vāṇa̭m | ratha̭m | i॒ndra | sānṷ'sim | a॒ri॒ṣyanta̭m | ā | ru॒he॒ma | sva॒stayḙ || 14 ||
he ^devāsaḥ devāḥ ^vājasātau annabhajane'nnalābhe vā ^yaṃ ratham ^avatha rakṣatha he ^marutaḥ ^śūrasātā |
saṃgrāmanāmaiṭat śūrāḥ syanti khidyante'treti^ śūrāḥ sīyante vināśayante yoddhṛbhiratreti^ |
he ^indra sarveṣāṃ mukhya ^prātaryāvāṇaṃ prātareva yuddhaṃ prati gantāraṃ ^sānasiṃ saṃbhajanīyam ^ariṣyantaṃ kaiścidapyahiṃsitam |
sūtritaṃ ca—'svasti naḥ padhyāsu dhanvasviti dve agne naya supathā rāye asmān' (āśva. śrau. 4. 3) iti |

svasti naḥ padhyāsu dhanvasu svastyapsu vṛjane svarvati | svasti naḥ putrakṛtheṣu yoniṣu svasti rāye maruto dadhātana || 15 || svasti | naḥ | padhyāsu | dhanvasu | svasti | apsu | vṛjane | svaḥ'vati | svasti | naḥ | putra'kṛtheṣu | yoniṣu | svasti | rāye | marutaḥ | dadhātana || 15 || he marutaḥ sitarāvino devāḥ naḥ asmākaṃ padhyāsu pathi yogyeṣu modakeṣu deśeṣu svasti kalyāṇaṃ kuruta | tathā dhanvasu nirudakeṣu deśeṣu svasti kalyāṇamudakajanana- lakṣaṇaṃ kuruta | tathā apsu udakeṣu svasti | tathā svarvati savairayudhairyukte senālakṣaṇe vṛjane śatrūṇāmāvarjakaṃ balaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ kuruta | naḥ asmākaṃ putrakṛtheṣu putrāṇāṃ kartṛtpādakeṣu strīṇāṃ yoniṣu svasti kalyāṇaṃ yathā garbhā na patanti tathā kṣemaṃ kuruta | kiṃca no'smākaṃ rāye dhanāya gavādilakṣaṇāya svasti kṣemaṃ dadhātana dhatta kuruta ||

svastiriddhi prapathe śreṣṭhā rekṇasvatyabhi yā vāmameti | sā nau amā so araṇe ni pātu svāveśā bhavatu devagopā || 16 || svastiḥ | it | hi | pra'pathe | śreṣṭhā | rekṇasvatī | abhi | yā | vāmam | eti | mā | naḥ | amā | mo iti | araṇe | ni | pātu | mu'āveśā | bhavatu | deva'gopā || 16 || yā pṛthivī gantumucchuktānāṃ prapathe prakṛṣṭāya mārgāya svastirit kṣemakāriṇyeva bhavati śreṣṭhā praśastatamā rekṇasvatī dhanavatī yā pṛthivī vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ yajñam abhi eti uttaravedyātmanā vābhiprāpnoti yā pṛthivī naḥ asmākam agā | gṛhārmatat | gṛhaṃ rakṣatu | tathā so sā u medha araṇe gantavye deśe'raṇe'ramaṇe'raṇyadika deśe vā no'smān ni pātu nitarāṃ rakṣatu | tathā devagopā devā gopāyitāro yasyāḥ santi sā pṛthivyasmākaṃ svāveśā śobhananivāsā bhavatu ||

evā pte. munuravīvṛdhaddo viśva ādityā adite manīṣī | īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi janau divyo gayena || 17 || eva | pte | munuḥ | avīvṛdhat | vaḥ | viśve | ādityāḥ | adite | manīṣī | īśānāsaḥ | naraḥ | amartyena | asnāvi | janau | divyaḥ | gayena || 17 || he viśve ādityāḥ sarve devāḥ he adite devānāṃ mātaretannāmike devi vaḥ yuṣmān manīṣī prājñaḥ stotā pte etannāmakastaparye sūnuḥ putro gayo nāma eva evamuktarityā avīvṛdhat
1. ga-ta1.2.3.7-deśeṣu ca | 2. ga-ta-bha1.2.6.7.8-tano nosmākaṃ | 3. ga-ta-bha-bhavatu | 4. ga-ta-ga-asmān | 5. ta-gṛhe | 6. ga-ta1.2.3.6.7.8-mātṛbhūte etannāmike |

'amartyena manuṣyadharmarahitena stutena yena devajanena 'naraḥ manuṣyāḥ 'īśānāsaḥ dhanasyeśvarāḥ svāmino bhavanti saḥ 'divyaḥ divi bhavaḥ 'janaḥ devagaṇaḥ 'gayena etannāmakena mayā 'astāvi abhiṣṭo'bhūt |
'kathā' iti saptadaśarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ jñātasya gayasyārṣaṃ vaiśvadevam |
'yāṃ me dhiyam' ityeṣā dvādaśī ṣoḍaśīsadṛśyā ca triṣṭubhaḥ śaṃpā' jagatyaḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- 'kathā yāṃ me triṣṭup' iti |

kathā devānāṃ katamasya yārmani sumantu nāme śṛṇutāṃ manāmahe | ko mṛḻāti katamo no maryaskaratkatama ūtī abhyā vavartati || 1 || kathā | devānām | katamasya | yārmani | mu'mantu | nāma | śṛṇutām | manāmahe |

naraiḥ śaṃsanīyametannāmānaṃ ᵥpūṣaṇaṃ stotṛṇāṃ dhanadānena poṣakametannāmānaṃ tathā ᵥaṃgāham aghitamamyaṃgantumaśakyaṃ ᵥdeveddhaṃ vāmadevādibhirṛṣibhirdīpitam ᵥagne ca ᵥgirā stutyā ᵥabhyarcase abhiṣṭuhi |

tau sūryācandramasau ᵥdivi dyuloke sthitaṃ ᵥyamaṃ ca ᵥtritaṃ tripulaṃ keṣu tataṃ svamahimnā vistṛtaṃ tristhānaṃ vā tamindraṃ ᵥvātaṃ vāyum ᵥupamam upaḥkālam ᵥaktuṃ rātrim ᵥaśvinā adhināṃ caitāndavān tattalliṅgaiḥ stotrairabhiduhi ||
kathā kuvisturvīravān kayā girā bṛhaspatirvāvṛdhate suvṛktibhiḥ |
kathā | kaviḥ | nuvidvavān | kayā | girā | bṛhaspatiḥ | vavṛdhate | suvṛktibhiḥ | ajaḥ | ekapāt | muḍahavebhiḥ | arkabhiḥ | ahiḥ | śṛṇotu | budhnyaḥ | havīmāni ||4||
ᵥkaviḥ krāntaprajño'gniḥ ᵥkathā kathaṃ kena prakāreṇa ᵥtuvīravān bahustotrayukto bhavati ||
ᵥkayā vā ᵥgirā stutyā bahumān bhavati |
ᵥbṛhaspatiḥ ᵥetannāmako devaḥ ᵥsuvṛktibhiḥ śobhanābhiḥ stutibhistathā ᵥvāvṛ- dhate |
tādṛśo divo dhārayitā ᵥajaḥ etannāmako devaśca ᵥsuhavebhiḥ śobhanāhvānaiḥ ᵥarkabhiḥ mantravadbhiḥ stotraiḥ ᵥvāvṛdhate ete trayo devā vardhante |
ᵥahirbudhnyaḥ ca etannāmako devaśca havīmāni āhlāne asmān ᵥśṛṇotu ||
dakṣasya vādite janmani vrate rājāṃnā mitrāvaruṇā vivāsasi |
atṛtapanthāḥ pururtho aryamā saptahautā viṣṇurūpeṣu janmasu ||
dakṣasya | vā | adite | janmani | vrate | rājāṃnā | mitrāvaruṇā | ā | vivāsasi | atṛtapanthāḥ | pururthaḥ | aryamā | saptahautā | viṣṇurūpeṣu | janmasu || 5 ||
he ᵥadite pṛthivi ᵥdakṣasya sūryasya ᵥjanmani tasmiñjāte ᵥvrate tasya yajñakarmaṇi ᵥrājānā rājantau ᵥmitrāvaruṇau ᵥvivāsasi |
yathā tvaṃ vedibhūtā satī tau paryacaraḥ eva- midānīmapyasmadyajñe kurviti pṛthivīmāśāste |
saḥ ᵥaryamā arīṇāṃ tamasāṃ yantā niyantā sūryaḥ ᵥvipurūpeṣu nānārūpeṣu ᵥjanmasu karmasu ᵥanvahamucan ᵥsaptahautā |
sapta raśmayo yasmin rasān juhvati prakṣipanti sa etādṛśo bhavati |
he adite prātastani saṃdhye dakṣasyādityasya janman yudayākhye janmani karmaṇi |
vāśabdaḥ śrutisāmarthyāddakṣasya vā janmani tvattastava vā janmani dakṣāditi |
‘ahaveṃ mitro rātrivaruṇa:’ ( ai. brā. 4.10 ) iti śruterahorātrau mitrāvaruṇāvucyete |
malimlucāṃhasaspatisahitā: saptanaivo yasya hotāro bhavanti tādṛśa: |
atra niruktaṃ — ‘dakṣasya vādite janmani karmaṇi vrate’ rājānau’ ( niru. 11.23 ) ityādi ||
te no arvento havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadrava: |
sahasrā medhasātivi tmanā maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jajñire ||
te | na: | arventa: | havana'śruta: | havam | viśve | śṛṇvantu | vājina: | mita'drava: | sahasra'sā: | medhasāti'iva | tmanā | maha: | ye | dhanam | samitheṣu | jajñire || 6 ||

havanaśrutaḥ āhvānaṃ śṛṇvantaḥ | vājinaḥ balavantaḥ | mitadravaḥ mitamārgā adhvānaṃ paricchindantaḥ viśve sarve prasiddhāḥ | arventaḥ aśvā indrādīnāṃ vāhanabhūtā haryādayaḥ | naḥ asmākaṃ havam āhvānaṃ śṛṇvantu | kīdṛśāḥ | medhasātivi | medhāḥ stutayaḥ sāyanye saṃbhajyante'treti medhasātiryajñaḥ | tasminniva tmanā ātmanaiva | mahasmāḥ sahasraṃ vyākathanasya dātāraḥ te śṛṇvantu | ye adhāḥ samitheṣu | saṃgrāmanāmaṃtat | saṃprāpyate yoddhṛbhiratreti | teṣu saṃgrāmeṣu mahaḥ mahat dhanaṃ jajñire śatrubhya āharanti | hagraharbheḥ ||
pra vo vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ puraṃdhiṃ stomai: kṛṇudhvaṃ sakhyāya pūṣaṇam |
te hi devasya savitu: savīmani kratuṃ sacante sucita: sacetasa: ||
pra | va: | vāyum | ratha'yujam | puram'dhim | stomai: | kṛṇudhvam | sakhyāya | pūṣaṇam | te | hi | devasya | savitu: | savīmani | kratum | sacante | su'cita: | sa'cetasa: || 7 ||
he stotāraḥ vaḥ yūyaṃ vāyuṃ rathayujaṃ rathasya yoktāraṃ puraṃdhrim bahukarmāṇamindraṃ pūṣaṇam etannāmānaṃ ca stomaiḥ trivṛtpañcadaśādilakṣaṇaiḥ sakhyāya savikarmaṇe pra kṛṇudhvaṃ prakurudhvam |
yathā te'smākaṃ dhanādipradānena sakhāyo bhavanti tathā kuruta |

hi yasmāt macitaḥ jñānayuktāḥ te devāḥ sacetasaḥ parasparaṃ sagānabuddhayaḥ santaḥ savituḥ sarvasya prerakasya devasya ādityasya savīmani prasave'ṅki kratuṃ yajñaṃ sacante sevante tasmāt prakurudhvam ||
tri: sapta sasrā nadyo mahīrapo vanaspatīn parvatā~ agnibhūtaye |
kṛśānumastṛn tiṣyaṃ sadhastha ā rudraṃ rudreṣu rudriyaṃ havāmahe ||
tri: | sapta | sasrā: | nadya: | mahī: | apa: | vanaspatīn | parvatān | agnim | ūtaye | kṛśānum | astṛn | tiṣyam | sadha'sthe | ā | rudram | rudreṣu | rudriyam | havāmahe || 8 ||
tri: | sapta ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ | sasrāḥ sarantīḥ | nadyaḥ nadīḥ | sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhuriti ṛcāṃ gaṇānāṃ pradhānabhūtāḥ | tadādyā nadīḥ | mahīḥ mahānti | apaḥ tāsāmudakāni somābhiṣekārtha

vvanaspatīn dārumyāṃścamasādīn vparvatān somābhipavārthaṃ grāvṇaḥ vagniṃ homaniṣpādakaṃ vkṛśānaṃ somapālametannāmānaṃ gandharvam vastṛn ipūṇāṃ kṣaptuṃstadanucarān gandharvān vutaye somarakṣaṇāya vtipyaṃ nakṣatraṃ ca vrudriyaṃ rudrastāmāhaṃ vrudraṃ havirbhāginaṃ rudrametannāmānaṃ yadvā yajñapariśiṣṭasvāminaṃ rudraṃ ca etān sarvān vsadhastha |
tasmin vrudreṣu stotrakāriṣu tadarthaṃ vhavāmahe stutyatvenāhvayāmahe ||

sarasvatī sarayuḥ sindhurūrmibhirmaho mahīravasā yantu vakṣaṇīḥ | devīrāpo mātaraḥ sūdayitnvā ghṛtavatpayo madhumanno arcata || 9 || sarasvatī | sarayuḥ | sindhuḥ | ūrmibhiḥ | mahaḥ | mahī | avasā | ā | yantu | vakṣaṇīḥ | devīḥ | āpaḥ | mātaraḥ | sūdayitnvaḥ | ghṛtavat | payaḥ | madhumat | naḥ | arcata || 9 ||

vmahaḥ mahato'pi vmahīḥ mahatyo'tyantaṃ mahatyaḥ vūrmibhiḥ sahitāḥ vsarasvatī vsarayuḥ vsindhuḥ etādyā ekaviṃśatisaṃkhyākāḥ vvakṣaṇīḥ imā nadyaḥ vavasā rakṣaṇena hetunā vā vyantu asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ pratyāgacchantu |
tataḥ vdevīḥ devanaśīlāḥ vmātaraḥ mātṛbhūtāḥ vsūdayitnvaḥ prerayitavyaḥ nāmābha vāpaḥ vghṛtavat ghṛtayuktaṃ vmadhumat madhusahitamātmārthaṃ vpayaḥ vnaḥ asmabhyam varcata prayacchantu ||

uta mātā bṛhadivā śṛṇotu nastvaṣṭā devebhijarnibhiḥ pitā varcaḥ | ṛbhukṣā vājo rathaspatirbhago raṇvaḥ śaṃsaḥ śaśamānasya pātu naḥ || 10 || uta | mātā | bṛhat'divā | śṛṇotu | naḥ | tvaṣṭā | devebhiḥ | jarnibhiḥ | pitā | varcaḥ | ṛbhukṣāḥ | vājaḥ | rathaḥpatiḥ | bhagaḥ | raṇvaḥ | śaṃsaḥ | śaśamānasya | pātu | naḥ || 10 ||
mahatī divā dīptiryasyāḥ sā vmātā devamātā vnaḥ asmākāhmānaṃ vśṛṇotu |
tathā vdevebhiḥ devairindrādibhiḥ vjanibhiḥ devapatnībhiśca vpitā sarveṣāṃ vtvaṣṭā etannāmako'smadīyaṃ vvacaḥ śṛṇotu |

tathā vṛbhukṣāḥ indraḥ vvājaḥ tatsahāyā vājāṃ nāma saudhanvanaḥ kanīyān vrathaspatiḥ rathasya patiḥ vbhagaḥ ca tathā vraṇvaḥ ramaṇīyaḥ vśaṃsaḥ stutyo marudraṇaśca tataḥ vśaśamānasya śaṃsamānasya stotuḥ vnaḥ asmān vpātu rakṣatu ||

raṇvaḥ saṃdṛṣṭau pitumā~iva kṣayo bhadrā rudrāṇāṃ marutāmupastutiḥ | gobhiḥ śyāma yaśaso janeṣvā sadā devāsa iḻayā sacemahi || 11 || raṇvaḥ | sam'dṛṣṭau | pitumān'iva | kṣayaḥ | bhadrā | rudrāṇām | marutām | upa'stutiḥ | gobhiḥ | śyāma | yaśasaḥ | janeṣu | ā | sadā | devāsaḥ | iḻayā | sacemahi || 11 ||
vsaṃdṛṣṭau saṃdarśane vraṇvaḥ ramaṇīyo marudgaṇaḥ vpitumāniva annavāniva vkṣayaḥ nivāsaḥ stotṛṇāṃ bhavati |
vrudrāṇāṃ rudraputrāṇāṃ teṣāṃ vmarutām vupastutiḥ anugrahabuddhiḥ |
tasmāt vjaneṣu janānāṃ madhye vayaṃ vgobhiḥ gavādabhiḥ vyaśasaḥ yaśasvinaḥ vsyāma bhavema |
vā anantaraṃ he vdevāmaḥ devā yuṣmān vsadā sarvadā viḻayā agnena havirlakṣaṇena vsacemahi sacama saṃgacchema |
yāṃ me dhiyaṃ marut indra devā ardadāta varuṇa mitra yūyam |
tāṃ pīpayat paryaseva dhenuṃ kuvidviro adhi rathe vahātha |
yām | me | dhiyam | marutaḥ | indra | devāḥ | ardadāta | varuṇa | mitra | yūyam | tām | pīpayata | paryagā'iva | dhenam | kuvit | giraḥ | adhi | rathe | vahātha || 12 ||
he vmarutaḥ he vindra vdevāḥ he vvaruṇa he vmitra vyūyaṃ vyāṃ vdhiyaṃ yatkarma vme mahyam vadadāta dattavantaḥ stha |
kiṃca vgiraḥ asmadīyāḥ stutīḥ vadhi vrathe ātmīye rathe vkuvit bahuvāraṃ vvahātha prāptāḥ stha |
stuteṣu satsu yajñaṃ pratyāgamanāya rārūḍhā bhavatha |
kuvidaṅga prati yathā citasya naḥ sajātyasya maruto bubodhatha |
nābhā yatra prathamaṃ saṃnasāṃhe tatra jāmitvamaditirdhātu naḥ |
kuvit | aṅga | prati | yathā | cit | asya | naḥ | sa'jātyasya | marutaḥ | bubodhatha | nābhā | yatra | prathamam | sam'nasāṃhe | tatra | jāmitvam | aditiḥ | dadhātu | naḥ || 13 ||
he vmarutaḥ yūyaṃ no'smān vkuvit bahuvāraṃ vprati vbubodhatha tathā pratibudhyadhvam |
vyathā vnaḥ asmān vsajātyasya vasya bāndhavasya viṣayabhūtān kurutha tathā jānītha |

tataḥ vnābhā pṛthivyā nābhisthāne vyatra yasminnuttaravedilakṣaṇe deśe vprathamam eva vsaṃnasāṃhe haviṣā yatra saṃgacchemahi vtatra eva deśe vaditiḥ devānāṃ mātā vnaḥ asmākaṃ vjāmitvaṃ manuṣyaiḥ saha bāndhavaṃ vdadhātu vidadhātu |
te hi dyāvāpṛthivī mātaraṃ mahī devī devāñjanmanā yajñiyai itaḥ |
ubhe bibhṛta ubhayaṃ bharīmabhiḥ puru retāṃsi pitṛbhiśca siñcataḥ |

te iti | hi | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | mātarau | mahī iti | devī iti | devān | janmanā | yajñiye iti | itaḥ | ubhe iti | bibhṛtaḥ | ubhayam | bharīmabhiḥ | puru | retāṃsi | pitṛ'bhiḥ | ca | siñcataḥ || 14 ||
vmātarā sarvasya jagato nirmātryau ata eva vmahī mahatyau vdevā devarnaśāle vyajñiye yajñārhe vte vdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau vdevān indrādīn vjanmanā eva vitaḥ |

kiṃca 7ubhe dyāvāpṛthivyau 7bharīmabhiḥ bharairnānāvidhaiḥ 7ubhayaṃ janaṃ devānmanuṣyāṃśca 7vibhṛtaḥ dhārayataḥ poṣayataḥ |
tathā 7pitṛbhiḥ pālakadevaiḥ maṃgate te 7puru puru- pyātmāyāni 7raṃtāṃsi udakāni 7siñcataḥ kṣarata: |
vi pā hotrā viśvamakṣoti vāryaṃ bṛhaspatirarmatiḥ panīyasī |
vi | mā | hotrā | viśvam | akṣoti | vāryam | bṛhaspateḥ | aramatiḥ | panīyasī | grāvā | yatra | madhusut | ucyate | bṛhat | avīvaśanta | matibhiḥ | manīṣiṇaḥ || 15 ||
7sā vāk 7vāryaṃ varaṇīyaṃ 7viśvaṃ sarvaṃ padhvādisahitaṃ dhanaṃ 7vi 7akṣoti vividhaṃ vyāpyate |
taṃ stutimantaṃ yajñaṃ 7manīṣiṇaḥ devāḥ 7matibhiḥ stutibhiḥ saha 7avīvaśanta kāmayante |
eva | kaviḥ | tuvīrvān | ṛtajñāḥ | draviṇasyuḥ | draviṇasaḥ | cakānaḥ | ukthebhiḥ | atra | matibhiḥ | ca | vipraḥ | apīpayat | gayaḥ | divyāna | janma || 16 ||
7vipraḥ medhāvī 7gayaḥ nāmarṣiḥ evamukta- prakāreṇa 7atra sūkte 7ukthebhiḥ śabdaiḥ 7matibhiḥ stutibhiḥ ca 7divyāni divi jātāni 7janma jananāni devān 7apīpayat avardhayat |
evā pluteḥ sunuravīvṛdhadviśvaṃ ādityā adite manīṣī |
īśānāso naro amartyenāstāvi janau divyo gayena |
eva | pluteḥ | sunuḥ | avīvṛdhat | vaḥ | viśvai | ādityāḥ | adite | manīṣī | īśānāsaḥ | naraḥ | amartyena | astāvi | janaḥ | divyaḥ | gayena || 17 ||
‘amirendraḥ’ iti pañcadaśarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ vasukruptasya vasukarṇasyārṣaṃ vaiśvadevam |
tathā cānukramyate—‘amirendraḥ pañconā vāsukro vasukarṇastriṣṭubantaṃ tu’ iti |

agnirindro varuṇo mitro aryamā vāyuḥ pūṣā sarasvatī sajoṣasaḥ | ādityā viṣṇurmarutaḥ svarbṛhatsomo rudro aditirbrahmaṇaspatiḥ || 1 || agniḥ | indraḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | vāyuḥ | pūṣā | sarasvatī | sa'joṣasaḥ | ādityāḥ | viṣṇuḥ | marutaḥ | svaḥ | bṛhat | somaḥ | rudraḥ | aditiḥ | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ || 1||
agnyādaya ādityādayaḥ vabṛhat bṛhatī vasvaḥ dyauśca somādaya ete devāḥ vasajoṣam saṃgatāḥ santo'ntarikṣaṃ svamahimnāpūrayantītyuttareṇa saṃbandhaḥ ||

indrāgnī vṛtrahatyeṣu sartapatī mithau hinvānā tanvā' samaukasā | antarikṣaṃ mahā paprojasā somo ghṛtaśrīmahimānamīrayan || 2 || indrāgnī iti | vṛtra'hatyeṣu | sartapatī iti sataḥpatī | mithaḥ | hinvānā | tanvā | mam'okasā | antarikṣam | mahi | ā | papruḥ | ojasā | somaḥ | ghṛta'śrīḥ | mahimānam | īrayan ||2||

teṣu vamithaḥ parasparaṃ vatanvā śarīriṇa tatrasthena balena śatrūn vahinvānā preyantau vasartapatī satāṃ patī vasamaukasā samānasthānau vaindrāgnī vaghṛtaśrīḥ udakaṃ vasatīvaryākhyaṃ śrayamāṇaḥ vamahimānam ātmīyam vaīrayan sarvatodīrayannudyamyan vasomaḥ ca ete sarve ca vamahi mahat vaantarikṣam vaojasā svabalena āpapruḥ āpūrayanti |

teṣāṃ hi mhā mahatāmarṇavāṃ stomā~ iryamṛrtajñā ṛtāvṛdhām | ye apsuvarmarṇavaṃ citrarādhaste nau rāsantāṃ mahaye sumitrāḥ || 3 || teṣām | hi | mhā | mahatām | anarvaṇām | stomān | iryam | ṛta'jñāḥ | ṛta'vṛdhām | ye | apsuvam | arṇavam | citra'rādhasaḥ | te | naḥ | rāmantām | mahaye | su'mitrāḥ || 3 ||

vamhā svamahatvena vamahatāmanarvaṇām anyasminnapratyutānāṃ śatrubhiranabhigantavyānām vaṛtāvṛdhāṃ satyabhūtena yajñena vṛddhānāṃ vateṣām agnyādīnāṃ devānāmeva vaṛtajñāḥ yajñasya jñātāhaṃ vastomān vairyam prerayāmi |
vacitrarādhasaḥ cāyanīyadhanopetā yadvā paścādi- lakṣaṇabahudhanāḥ vaye devāḥ vaapsuvam |
arṇavaḥ salo- paśca (kā. 5. 2. 109. 2) iti matvarthīyo vapratyayaḥ |
udakavantaṃ meghaṃ varṣanti te vasumitrāḥ śobhanasakhirmāṇaḥ vate devāḥ vanaḥ asmabhyaṃ vamahaye janeṣu madhye pūjārtha dhanaṃ varāmantāṃ prayacchantu |

svarṇarantarikṣāṇi rocanā dyāvābhūmī pṛthivīṃ skambhurojasā | pakṣāīva mahayantaḥ surātayo devāḥ stavante manuṣāya sūrayaḥ || 4 || svaḥ'naram | antarikṣāṇi | rocanā | dyāvābhūmī iti | pṛthivīm | skambhuḥ | ojasā | pakṣāḥ'iva | mahayantaḥ | su'rātayaḥ | devāḥ | stavante | manuṣāya | sūrayaḥ || 4 ||
madhyasthitāni rocanā ārocamānāni tejāṃsi dyāvābhūmī dyāvāpṛthivyau pṛthivīṃ vistīrṇamantarikṣaṃ ca etānādityādīn ojasā svabalenaiva devāḥ skambhuḥ dhārayanti|

kiṃca pakṣā iva daridreṣu dhanāni saṃparyanta iva ata eva mahayantaḥ stotṛn dhanādibhiḥ pūjayantaḥ surātayaḥ mudānāḥ manuṣyāya manuṣyāya sūrayaḥ dhanānāṃ prerakā ete devāḥ stavante asmin‌yajñe stūyante||
mitrāya śikṣa varuṇāya dāśuṣe yā samrājā manasā na prayucchataḥ|
yayordhāma dharmaṇā rocate bṛhadyayorbhe rodasī nārthasī vṛttau||
mitrāya| śikṣa| varuṇāya| dāśuṣe| yā| samrājā| manasā| na| prayucchataḥ| yayoḥ| dhāma| dharmaṇā| rocate| bṛhat| yayoḥ| ubhe iti| rodasī iti| nārthasī iti| vṛttau|| 5||
dāśuṣe dhanāni stotṛbhyaḥ prayacchate mitrāya varuṇāya ca śikṣa havīṃṣi prayaccha|
samrājā samrājau sarvasya yā yau mitrāvaruṇau manasā antaḥkaraṇenāpi na prayucchataḥ na pramādyataḥ|
yayoḥ mitrāvaruṇayoḥ bṛhat mahat dhāma śarīraṃ dharmaṇā ātmīyena lokaprakāśanādilakṣaṇena karmaṇā rocate samyagdīpyate|
yācamāne ubhe rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vṛttau vartamāne bhavataḥ|
nārthasī devamanuṣyaiḥ samṛddhe dyāvāpṛthivyau tayorvṛtau vartamāne bhavataḥ|
yā gaurvartaniṃ paryeti niṣkṛtaṃ payo duhānā vratanīrvārataḥ|
sā prabruvāṇā varuṇāya dāśuṣe devebhyo dāśadvipā vivasvate||
yā| gauḥ| vratanim| paryeti| niḥkṛtam| payaḥ| duhānā| vratanīḥ| avārtaḥ| sā| prabruvāṇā| varuṇāya| dāśuṣe| devebhyaḥ| dāśat| haviṣā| vivasvate|| 6||

yā iyaṃ madīyā payaḥ kṣīrādikaṃ duhānā vratanīḥ āśrayaṇapayaḥ pradānena karmaṇo netrī gauḥ niṣkṛtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ vratanim āvāsasthānaṃ yajñam avārtaḥ avaraṇena apārthanenaiva paryeti parigacchati svayamevāgacchati prabruvāṇā mayā prastūyamānā sā gauḥ dāśuṣe havirdattavate varuṇāya devebhyaḥ anyebhya indrādibhyaśca haviṣā annena vivasvate devān paricarate mahyaṃ māṃ rakṣituṃ dāśat payaḥ prayacchatu|
gauriti mādhyamikī vāk yā paya ūrjaṃ duhānā 'sā no mandremūrjaṃ duhānā' (ṛ. saṃ. 8. 100. 11) ityādiṣu dṛṣṭatvāt|
divakṣaso agnijihvā ṛtāvṛdha ṛtasya yoniṃ vimṛśanta āsate|
dyāṃ skabhitvāya pa ā cakrurojasā yajñaṃ janitvī tanvī ni mā mṛjuḥ||
divakṣasaḥ | agni'jihvāḥ | ṛta'vṛdhaḥ | ṛtasya | yonim | vi'mṛśantaḥ | āsate | dhām | skabhitvī | apaḥ | ā | cakruḥ | ojasā | yajñam | janitvā | tanvi | ni | mamṛjuḥ ||7||
^ṛtavṛdhaḥ yajñavṛddhā yajñasya vardhayitāro vā devāḥ ^ṛtasya satyabhūtasya yajñasya ^yonim sthānaṃ ^vimṛśantaḥ vicārayantaḥ pratīkṣamāṇāḥ santaḥ ^āsate sarvatra tiṣṭhanti |
ta ime ^dyāṃ dyulokaṃ ^skabhitvī skabhitvā tāṃ dhārayitvā ^ojasā svabalena ^apaḥ apekṣityānudakāni ^ā ^cakruḥ ākurvanti |
tataḥ ^yajñaṃ yajanīyaṃ haviśca ^janitvī janayitvā ^tanvi svaśarīre ^ni ^māmṛjuḥ nimṛjanti nitarāmalaṃkurvanti |
parikṣitāṃ pitarāṃ pūrvajāvarī ṛtasya yonā kṣayataḥ samaukasā |
dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇāya savrate ghṛtavatpayau mahiṣāya pinvataḥ ||
pari'kṣitā | pitarā | pūrva'jāvarī | ṛtasya | yonā | kṣayataḥ | sama'okasā | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | varuṇāya | savrate iti sa'vrate | ghṛta'vata | payaḥ | mahiṣāya | pinvataḥ ||8||

^parikṣitā parito nivasantyau sarvatra vyāpinyau ^pitarā sarveṣāṃ mātāpitṛbhūte ata eva ^pūrvajāvarī pūrvaṃ jāte ^samaukasā samānanivāsasthāne ete dyāvāpṛthivyau ^ṛtasya yajñasya ^yonā yonāṃ sthānaṃ ^kṣayataḥ āhuryādhikaraṇatvena nivamataḥ |
kiṃca ^savrate samānakarmaṇā te ^mahiṣāya mahate pūjyāya vā ^varuṇāya taṃ yajñam |
parjanyāvātā vṛṣabhā purīpiṇendravāyū varuṇo mitro aryamā |
devā ādityā aditiṃ havāmahe ye pārthivāso divyāsau apsu ye ||
parjanya'vātā | vṛṣabhā | purīpiṇā | indravāyū iti | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | devān | ādityān | aditim | havāmahe | ye | pārthivāmaḥ | divyāḥ | apsu | ye ||9||

etān ^ādityān ^devān ^aditiṃ teṣāṃ mātaraṃ ca ^havāmahe asmin yajñe vayamāhvayāmaḥ |
kiṃca ^ye devāḥ ^pārthivāmaḥ pārthivāḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhavā ye ca divyā divi jātāḥ ^ye ca ^apsu antarikṣe samutpannāḥ tānāhvayāmahe ^ ||
1. ta-yaṃ vyāpnutaḥ; bha1.2.4.6.8-iva vyāpnutaḥ; bha7-divaṃ vyāpnutaḥ |

tvaṣṭāraṃ vāyuṃbhavo ya ohete daivyā hotārā upaseṃ svastaye | bṛhaspatiṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ sumedhasamindriyaṃ somaṃ dhanasā u īmahe || 10 || tvaṣṭāram | vāyum | ṛbhavaḥ | yaḥ | ohete | daivyā | hotārā | upasam | svastaye | bṛhaspatim | vṛtra'khādam | su'medhasam | indriyam | somam | dhana'sā | ū iti | īmahe || 10 || he ṛbhavaḥ | ṛtena satyena bhāntītyṛbhavaḥ | uru prabhūtaṃ svatejasā bhāntīti vā | he medhāvinaḥ yaḥ somaḥ | svastaye kalyāṇāya yuṣmākaṃ madāya tvaṣṭraprabhṛtīn ohete | ohirgatyarthaḥ | bhauvādikaḥ | āvahati prāpnoti | tathā bṛhaspatiṃ sumedhasaṃ suprajñaṃ vṛtrakhādaṃ vṛtrasyāsurasya khādi- tāramindraṃ ca prāpnoti dhanasāḥ dhanaṃ saṃbhajamānā vayam indriyam indrajuṣṭaṃ taṃ somam īmahe dhanaṃ yācāmahe | īmaha iti yācārthā | 'īṅ gatau' | daivādikaḥ | 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti vikaraṇasya luk || || 10 ||

brahma gāmaśvaṃ janayanta oṣadhīrvanaspatīn pṛthivīṃ parvatāṃ apaḥ | sūryaṃ divi rohayantaḥ sudānava āryā vratā visṛjanto adhi kṣami || 11 || brahma | gām | aśvam | janayantaḥ | oṣadhīḥ | vanaspatīn | pṛthivīm | parvatān | apaḥ | sūryam | divi | rohayantaḥ | su'dānavaḥ | āryā | vratā | vi'sṛjantaḥ | adhi | kṣami || 11 || brahma vardhanamādhanamaṅgam | agnena hi sarvāḥ prajā vardhante | gāmaśvam enatprabhṛtīn paśūn tathā oṣadhīrvanaspatīn ca tathā pṛthivīṃ vistīrṇāṃ bhūmiṃ parvatān śiloccayān vṛṣṭyā jagadāpūrakān meghān vā apaḥ udakāni antarikṣaṃ vā etān janayantaḥ utpādayantaḥ kiṃca divi dyuloke sūryam ādityaṃ rohayantaḥ | sudānavaḥ śobhanadānāste'mī devāḥ | adhi kṣami | āta iti yogavibhāgāt (pā. sū. 6. 4. 140 ) ākāralopaḥ | kṣamāṃ pṛthivyām āryā śreṣṭhāni kalyāṇāni vratā vratāni karmāṇi yāgādīni visṛjantaḥ prasārayantaḥ sarvatra vartante | tān vayaṃ dhanaṃ yācāmaha iti śeṣaḥ ||

bhujyumahaṃsaḥ pipṛtho niraśvinā śyāvaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyā ajinavatam | kamadyuvaṃ vimadāyauhathuryavaṃ viṣṇvāpvaṃ viśvakāyāva sṛjathaḥ || 12 || bhujyum | ahaṃsaḥ | pipṛthaḥ | niḥ | aśvinā | śyāvam | putram | vadhri'matyāḥ | ajinavatam | kam | adyuvam | vi'madāya | ūhathuḥ | yavam | viṣṇu'āpvam | viśva'kāya | ava | sṛjathaḥ || 12 || he aśvinā aśvavantau sarvaṃ vyāpnuvantau vaitabhamako he devau ahaṃsaḥ upadravakāriṇaḥ samudrāt bhujyuṃ tumaputrametannāmānaṃ niḥ pipṛthaḥ niṣpārayathaḥ nitarāṃ rakṣathaḥ | 'pṛ pālanapūraṇayoḥ' | jauhotyādikaḥ | 'nippraidhyaṃ pārayathaḥ samudrāt' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 118. 6) iti nigamaḥ | tathā śyāvaṃ hiraṇyahastanāmānaṃ putraṃ vadhrimatyāḥ etannāmikāyāḥ ajinavatam aprīṇayatama adattam | 'hiraṇyahastamaśvinā rarāṇā' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 119. 24) ityādi nigamaḥ | tathā
tathā ^viṣṇāvam etannāmānaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ putraṃ ^viśvakāya ṛṣaye ānīya ^ava ^sṛjatha: adattam |
‘paśuṃ na naṣṭamiva darśanāya’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 116. 23) iti nigama: ||

pāvī̭ravī ta॒nyu॒tarḙpā॒dajo̭ di॒vo dha॒rtā sindhṷrapa॒ḥ samṷdriyaḥ | viśvḙ de॒vāsa̭ḥ śṛṇva॒n vacā̭ṃsi me॒ sara̭svatī sa॒ha dhī॒bhiḥ pura̭ndhyā || 13 || pāvī̭ravī | ta॒nyu॒tuḥ | eka̭'pāt | a॒jaḥ | di॒vaḥ | dha॒rtā | sindhṷḥ | āpa̭ḥ | samṷdriyaḥ | viśvḙ | de॒vāsa̭ḥ | śṛṇva॒n | vacā̭ṃsi | me | sara̭svatī | sa॒ha | dhī॒bhiḥ | pura̭m'dhyā || 13 ||
^pāvī̭ravī āyudhavatī ^tanyutu: stanayitrī vāgmādhyamikā tathā ^diva: dyulokasya ^dhartā dhārayitā ^aja: ^ekapāt eka eva pacyate gacchatīti na jāyata ityetatsaṃjñako deva: ^sindhu: ca ^samudriya: |
^viśve devāśca ^dhībhi: karmabhiryuktā: ^purandhyā bahuvidhayā prajñayā sahitā ^sarasvatī ca ^me madīyāni ^vacāṃsi vaktavyāni stotrāṇi ^śṛṇvan śṛṇvantu |
‘pavi: śalyo bhavati yadvipunāti kāyam’ (niru. 12.30) ityādi niruktamanusaṃdheyam ||

viśvḙ de॒vāḥ sa॒ha dhī॒bhiḥ pura̭ndhyā॒ mano̭rya॒jatrā̭ a॒mṛtā̭ ṛta॒jñāḥ | rā॒ti॒pāco̭ a॒bhiṣā̭caḥ sva॒vi̭daḥ sva॒rgi̭ro॒ brahma̭ sū॒ktaṃ jṷṣerata || 14 || viśvḙ | de॒vāḥ | sa॒ha | dhī॒bhiḥ | pura̭m'dhyā | mano̭ḥ | ya॒jatrā̭ḥ | a॒mṛtā̭ḥ | ṛta̭'jñāḥ | rati̭'sācaḥ | a॒bhi'sāca̭ḥ | sva̭ḥ'vida̭ḥ | sva̭ḥ | gi॒raḥ | brahma̭ | su'ṷktam | jṷṣerata || 14 ||

^dhībhi: karmabhi: sahitā: ^purandhyā prajñānena yuktā: ^mano: manuṣyasya yajñe ^yajatrā: yaṣṭavyā: ^amṛtā: maraṇadharmarahitā: ^ṛtajñā: satyavida: ^rātipāca: dīyamānaṃ havi: sevamānā: ^abhipāca: ābhimukhyena yajñaṃ samavayantaḥ saṃgatamavantaḥ ^svarvida: sarvasya lambhakā: ^viśve sarve indrādaya: ^devā: ^sva: sarvā: ^gira: asmadīyā: stutī: ^brahma mahaccātra ^sūktaṃ suṣṭhu vaktavyaṃ stomaṃ yadvā suṣṭhu mantreṇa saha dattamanaṃ ^juṣerata sevantām |

de॒vān vasi̭ṣṭho a॒mṛtā̭n vavande॒ ye viśvā̭ bhuva॒nāni̭ pra॒tasthuḥ | te naṷ rāsantā॒murṷgā॒yamu॒dha yūyaṃ pā̭ta sva॒sti॒bhiḥ sa॒dā na̭ḥ || 15 || de॒vān | vasi̭ṣṭhaḥ | a॒mṛtā̭n | va॒va॒nde॒ | ye | viśvā̭ | bhuva॒nāni̭ | pra॒tasthuḥ | te | na̭ḥ | rāsantā̭m | u॒ru॒'gā॒yam | a॒dha | yūyam | pā̭ta | sva॒sti॒bhiḥ | sa॒dā | na̭ḥ || 15 ||
1. ga-ta-bha-yuvāṃ | 2. ta-bha-liṭi | 3. ta-bha- ‘viśvā’ nāsti | 4. ga-ta1.2.3-bhuvanā bhuvanāni |
vte devā: vatha asmindine vna: asmabhyam vurugāyaṃ prabhūtayaśaskamannaṃ vrāsannāṃ prayacchantu |
he devā: vyūyaṃ vsvastibhi: kalyāṇībhirutibhi: vna: asmān vsadā sarvadā vpāta rakṣata ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'iheha va iti catasro devān huva iti vaiśvadevam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 5) iti ||

devān huve bṛhacchravasa: svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasa: | ye vāvṛdhu: prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdha: || 1 || devān | huve | bṛhat'śravasa: | svastaye | jyoti:'kṛta: | adhvarasya | pra'cetama: | ye | vavṛdhu: | pra'taram | viśva'vedasa: | indra'jyeṣṭhāsa: | amṛtā: | ṛta'vṛdha: || 1 ||

vbṛhacchravasa: prabhūtānnān vjyotiṣkṛta: ādityākhyasya tejasa: kartṛn vpracetasa: prakṛṣṭajñānāṃ- stāna vdevān vadhvarasya asya yajñasya vsvastaye avināśāya nirvighnena yajñapārisamāptaye vhuve āhvayāmi |
vamṛtā: maraṇadharmarahitā: vṛtāvṛdha: yajñena pravṛddhā: vye devā: vprataram atyantaṃ vvavṛdhu: vardhante ||

indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotipo bhāgamāṃśu: | marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūraya: || 2 || indra'prasūtā: | varuṇa'praśiṣṭā: | ye | sūryasya | jyotipa: | bhāgam | ānśu: | marut'gaṇe | vṛjane | manma | dhīmahi | māghone | yajñam | janayanta | sūraya: || 2 ||

vindraprasūtā: indreṇa tatkāryepu preritā: vvaruṇapraśiṣṭā: varuṇeśānuśiṣṭā anumoditā: vye maruta: vjyotipa: dyotamānasya vsūryasya svasvakarmaṇi sarvasya prerakasyāpyādityasya vbhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ lokam vānśu: ānaśire vyāptavanta: |
vvṛjane śatrūṇāṃ chedake vmāghone maghavata indrasya saṃbandhini vmarudgaṇe teṣāṃ marutāṃ gaṇe vmanma mananīyaṃ stotraṃ vdhīmahi dadhma: |
kiṃca vsūraya: prājñā yajamānāstannimittameva vyajñaṃ vjanayanta janayanti |

indro vasubhi: pari pātu no gayamādityairno aditi: śarma yacchatu | rudro rudrairdevo mṛḻayāti nastvaṣṭā no grābhi: suvitārya jinvatu || 3 || indra: | vasubhi: | pari | pātu | na: | gayam | ādityai: | na: | aditi: | śarma | yacchatu | rudra: | rudrai: | deva: | mṛḻayāti | na: | tvaṣṭā | na: | grābhi: | suvitārya | jinvatu || 3 ||
vvasubhi: etannāmakairdevai: sahita: vindra: vna: asmadīyaṃ vgayam gṛhanāmaitat |
prāptavyaṃ gāyate śabdayate'treti vā gayaṃ gṛham |
devaiḥ saha ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥśarma sukhaṃ prayacchatu |
kiṃca ᵥdevaḥ dīpyamānaḥ ᵥrudro ᵥrudrebhiḥ ᵥsvaputraiḥ marudbhiḥ saha ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥmṛḻayāti sukhayatu |
api ca ᵥtvaṣṭā prajāpatiḥ ᵥbhrābhiḥ devapatnībhiścandobhiḥ ᵥsuvitāya suṣṭhu prāptavyāyābhyudayāya ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥjinnatu prīṇayatu ||
de॒vā~ ā̭di॒tyā~ a̭va॒se ha̭vāmahe va॒sūnrṷdrā॒nsavi̭tāraṃ su॒daṃsa̭sam ||
aditiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | ṛtam | mahat | indrāviṣṇū iti | marutaḥ | svaḥ | bṛhat | devān | ādityān | avase | havāmahe | vasūna | rudrān | savitāram | sudaṃsasam || 4 ||
ᵥaditirdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥmahat mahān ᵥṛtaṃ satyabhūtau'bhiḥ ᵥindrāviṣṇū ᵥmarutaḥ ca ᵥbṛhat parivṛḍhaḥ ᵥsvaḥ ādityaḥ ete devāḥ sarvatra svamahimnā vartante |
etān ᵥdevān ādityādīn ᵥsudaṃsasaṃ sukarmāṇaṃ ᵥsavitāram etannāmānaṃ ca ᵥavase rakṣaṇāya ᵥhavāmahe vayamāhvayāmahe ||
bra॒hma॒kṛ॒to a̭mṛ॒tā vi॒śvavḙdasaḥ śa॒rma no̭ yaṃsa॒ntri॒varṷ̄tha॒maha̭saḥ ||
sarasvān | dhībhiḥ | varuṇaḥ | dhṛtavrataḥ | pūṣā | viṣṇuḥ | mahimā | vāyuḥ | aśvinā | brahmakṛtaḥ | amṛtāḥ | viśvavedasaḥ | śarma | naḥ | yasan | trivarūtham | ahaṃsaḥ || 5 ||

ᵥdhībhiḥ prajñābhiryuktaḥ ᵥsarasvān etannāmā ᵥdhṛtavrataḥ dhṛtakarmā ᵥvaruṇaḥ ca ᵥpūṣā ᵥmahimā mahattvena yuktaḥ ᵥviṣṇuḥ ca ᵥvāyuḥ ᵥaśvinā aśvinau ᵥbrahmakṛtaḥ karmakṛtaḥ stotṛṇāmannadātāro vā ᵥviśvavedasaḥ sarvadhanā vyāsajñānā vā ᵥaṃhasaḥ pāparūpāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantāraḥ ᵥamṛtāḥ ete devāḥ ᵥnaḥ asmabhyaṃ ᵥtrivarūthaṃ trikambhaṃ trikakṣyaṃ ᵥśarma gṛham |
droṇādhavaniyapūtabhṛtsaṃjña- kāni trīṇi pātrāṇi yatra triyante saṃbhajyante tadyajñasādhanaṃ gṛham |
vṛ॒ṣā ya॒jño vṛ̭ṣaṇaḥ santu ya॒jñiyā̭ vṛ॒ṣaṇo̭ de॒vā vṛ̭ṣaṇo ha॒viṣkṛ̭taḥ |
vṛ॒ṣā dyāvā̭pṛthi॒vī ṛ॒tāvarī̭ vṛ॒ṣā pa̭rjanya॒ vṛ̭ṣaṇo vṛ॒ṣasta̭bhaḥ ||
vṛṣā | yajñaḥ | vṛṣaṇaḥ | santu | yajñiyāḥ | vṛṣaṇaḥ | devāḥ | vṛṣaṇaḥ | haviṣkṛtaḥ | vṛṣā | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | ṛtāvarī iti ṛtāvarī | vṛṣā | parjanyaḥ | vṛṣaṇaḥ | vṛṣastabhaḥ ||6||
tathā ᵥyajñiyāḥ yajñāhā~ devāśca ᵥvṛṣaṇaḥ ᵥsantu |
kiṃca ᵥdevāḥ stutikāriṇa ṛtvijaḥ ᵥvṛṣaṇaḥ dhanavarṣaṇe kāraṇāni santu sādhustutikaraṇena |
tathā ᵥhaviṣkṛtaḥ haviṣāṃ kartāro'dhvaryvādayaḥ ᵥvṛṣaṇaḥ avyagratayā mantrasāhyena ca haviṣpradānena |
api ca ᵥṛtāvarī yajñavatyau ᵥdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥvṛṣaṇā haviṣpādanena kāmānāṃ varṣiṇyau
yāvīṃjire ˅vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ ||
agnīṣomā| ˅vṛṣaṇā| ˅vāja'sātaye| puru'praśastā| ˅vṛṣaṇā| ˅upa| bruve| yau| īṃjire| ˅vṛṣaṇaḥ| ˅deva'yajyayā| tā| naḥ| ˅śarma| ˅tri'varūthama| vi| yaṃsataḥ || 7 ||
˅vṛṣaṇā varṣaṇaśīlau ˅purupraśastā bahubhiḥ praśastau ˅agnīṣomā agnīṣomau ˅vājasātaye annalābhāya ˅upa ˅bruve ahamupastaumi|
tena ˅īṃjire yajante havirbhiḥ pūjayanti ˅tā tau prasiddhau ˅naḥ asmabhyaṃ ˅trivarūthaṃ trikambhaṃ ˅śarma gṛhaṃ ˅vi ˅yaṃsataḥ viśeṣeṇa prayacchatām ||
dhṛta'vratāḥ| kṣatriyāḥ| ˅yajñaniḥkṛtaḥ| bṛhat'divāḥ| adhvarāṇām| ˅abhi'śriyaḥ| agni'hotāraḥ| ˅ṛta'sāpau| adruhaḥ| ˅apaḥ| asṛjan| anu| ˅vṛtra'tūrye || 8 ||
tasya kartāraḥ ˅bṛhadivāḥ mahātejaskāḥ ˅adhvarāṇāṃ rakṣobhirahimitānāṃ yajñānām ˅abhiśriyaḥ abhisevakāḥ ˅agnihotāraḥ agnihotrā āhvātā yeṣāṃ tādṛśāḥ ˅ṛtasāpaḥ|
antarikṣaṃ svarā paprute vaśaṃ devāsamanvastrī ni māmṛjuḥ ||
˅devāsaḥ devā indrādayaḥ ˅dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ˅abhi abhilakṣya ˅vratā vratena svena karmaṇā ˅āpaḥ|
˅apa udakāni ˅oṣadhīḥ ca tathā ˅yajñiyā yajñārhān ˅vanināni vane ardhān palāśadīn vṛkṣān ˅janayan utpādayan|
taṃ yajaṃ tanvi svaśarīre 'ni 'mamṛjuḥ nitarāṃ śuddhamalaṃskṛtaṃ cakuḥ ||
dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ |
āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhargo rātirvājino yantu me havam ||
dhartāraḥ | divaḥ | ṛbhavaḥ | suhastāḥ | vātāparjanyā | mahiṣasya | tanyatoḥ | āpaḥ | oṣadhīḥ | pra | tirantu | naḥ | giraḥ | bhagaḥ | rātiḥ | vājinaḥ | yantu | me | havam ||10||
°divaḥ dyulokasya °dhartāraḥ dhārayitāraḥ °ṛbhavaḥ satyena bhāsamānāḥ °suhastāḥ śobhanavajrā- cāyudhayuktahastā devāstathā °mahiṣasya mahataḥ °tanyataḥ śabdasya |
śabdasya kartārau °vātāparjanyā vātaśca parjanyaśca tatkāryāḥ °āpaḥ °oṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaśca °naḥ asmākaṃ °giraḥ stutīḥ °pra °tirantu pravardhayantu |
‘agnirvāyuḥ sūryaste vai vājinaḥ’ (tai. brā. 1. 6. 3. 9) iti taittirīyabrāhmaṇam |
ahirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇvadūrcausi me viśve devāsa uta sūryo marma ||
samudraḥ | sindhūḥ | rajaḥ | antarikṣam | ajaḥ | ekapāt | tanayitnuḥ | arṇavaḥ | ahiḥ | budhnyaḥ | śṛṇvat | vacāṃsi | me | viśve | devāsaḥ | uta | sūryaḥ | marma || 11 ||
°samudraḥ samudranaśīlaḥ syandamānodakaḥ °sindhūḥ enannāmakaḥ °antarikṣaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyorantarā madhye kṣitamupitaṃ °rajaḥ madhyamalokam °aja °ekapāt |
etatsaṃjako devaḥ °arṇavaḥ udakavān °tanayitnuḥ stanayitnurmeghaḥ °budhnyaḥ antarikṣa bhavaḥ °ahiḥ etatsaṃjake ete devāḥ °me mam °vacāṃsi vaktavyāni stotrāṇi °śṛṇvan pratyekaṃ śṛṇotu |
°uta api ca °sūryaḥ prājñāḥ °viśve °devāsaḥ devāḥ °mama stotrāṇi śṛṇvantu ||
syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāścaṃ no yajñaṃ pra ṇayata sādhuyā |
ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvat ||
syāma | vaḥ | manavaḥ | devavītaye | prāścam | naḥ | yajñam | pra | nayata | sādhuyā | ādityāḥ | rudrāḥ | vasavaḥ | sudānavaḥ | imā | brahma | śasyamānāni | jinvat || 12 ||
he devāḥ °manavaḥ manuṣyā vayaṃ °vaḥ yuṣmadīyāya °devavītaye devānāṃ vītibhakṣaṇaṃ yasmin sa yajñaḥ |
he °ādityāḥ he °rudrāḥ rudraputrā marutaḥ he °sudānavaḥ śobhanadānā he °vasavaḥ °imā imāni °śasyamānāni °brahma brahmāṇi stotrāṇi °jinvat prīṇayata ||
