daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthāmanvaimi sādhuyā|
kṣetrasya patiṃ prativeśamīmahe viśrvāndevā~ amṛtā~ agrayucchataḥ ||
daivyā | hotārā | prathamā | puraḥ'hitā | ṛtasya | panthām | anu | emi | sādhuyā | kṣetrasya | patim | prati'veśam | īmahe | viśvān | devān | amṛtān | apra'yucchataḥ ||13||
'prathamā' mukhyau 'purohitā purohitau purato nihitau 'daivyā devasambandhinau 'hotārā hotārā- venannāmānau agnyādityau 'anvemi' havirbharinugacchāmi|
tataḥ 'ṛtasya yajñasya 'panthāṃ panthānaṃ 'sādhuyā kalyāṇaṃ vimmarāhityena 'anvemi anugacchāmi|
anantaraṃ 'prativeśaṃ samīpe vartamānaṃ 'kṣetrasya 'patiṃ pālayitārametannāmānam 'amṛtān maraṇadharmarahitāna 'aprayucchataḥ apramādyataḥ 'viśvān sarvān 'devān ca 'īmahe dhanaṃ yācāmahe ||
prītāiva jñātayaḥ kāmumetyāsme devāso'rva dhūnutā vasu ||
vasiṣṭhāsaḥ | pitu'vat | vācam | akrata | devān | īḻānāḥ | ṛṣi'vat | svastaye | prītāḥ'iva | jñātayaḥ | kāmam | ā'itya | asme iti | devāsaḥ | arba | dhūnuta | vasu || 14 ||
'ṛṣivat pūrve ṛṣaya iva 'devān 'īḻānāḥ stuvantaḥ 'vasiṣṭhāsaḥ vasiṣṭhakulajātā ṛṣayaḥ 'pituvat vasiṣṭhavat 'svastaye avināśāya 'vācaṃ stotram 'akrata kurvanti|
he 'devāsaḥ devāḥ yūyaṃ 'kāmam asmadabhilāpam 'gṛhya āgatya 'asme asmāsu 'vasu gavādilakṣaṇaṃ dhanam 'atra 'dhūnuta abhimukhaṃ prerayata|
'prītāiva yathā prītāḥ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ 'jñātayaḥ bandhavaḥ svajanasya dhane prerayanti tadvadvidānena stutikaraṇena ca bandhuvasmāsu dhanaṃ prerayateti bhāvaḥ ||
devān vasiṣṭho amṛtān vavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ|
te nau rāsantāmurugāyamudya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
devān | vasiṣṭhaḥ | amṛtān | vavande | ye | viśvā | bhuvanā | abhi | pra'tasthuḥ | te | naḥ | rāsantām | urugāyam | adya | yūyam | pāta | svasti'bhiḥ | sadā | naḥ || 15 ||
'imāṃ dhiyam' iti dvādaśacaṃ saptamaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasyāsyasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubham|
tathā cānukāntam—'imāṃ dhiyaṃ dvādaśāyāsyo bārhaspatyaṃ tu' iti|
sutritaṃ ca—‘imāṃ dhiyamiti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī viṣṇonuṃ kamiti sūkte’ ( āśva. śrau. 7. 9 ) iti ||
imāṃ dhiyaṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ pitā na ṛtaprajātāṃ bṛhatīmavindat |
imām | dhiyam | saptaśīrṣṇīm | pitā | naḥ | ṛtaprajātām | bṛhatīm | avindat | turīyam | svit | janayat | viśvajanyaḥ | ayāsyaḥ | uktham | indrāya | śaṃsan || 1 ||
sa tu devānāṃ hitopadeśa- nāyendrasya purohito'bhavat |
kadācittasya gāvaḥ paṇināma kairasurairapahṛtya valapuraṃ prāpya triṣu sthāneṣu tamasāvṛteṣu sthāpitā āsan |
atha tāsāmanveṣaṇāyandreṇa prerito bṛhaspatiraṅgiḥ saha tatrāgatya gavāṃ guhāsthitānāṃ darśanāya sūryaṃ janayitvā valanāmānamasuraṃ tadanucarān parṇāśca haravā gā āja- hāreti |
dhiyaṃ karmaṇāṃ dhātrīṃ saptaśīrṣṇīṃ sapta- śiraskāṃ saptabhiḥ śiraḥsthānīyaistanūpradhānabhūtairmarudgaṇairupatām |
ṛtaprajātāṃ yajñārthamutpannāṃ bṛhatīṃ mahatīm imāṃ tanuṃ naḥ asmākaṃ pitā aṅgirāḥ avindat labdhavān |
‘ye'ṅgirā āsaṃste'ṅgiraso'bhavan yadaṅgirāḥ punaravaśāntā uddīpyanta tadbṛhaspatirabhavat’ ( ai. brā. 3. 34 ) iti brāhmaṇam |
tathā turīyaṃ svit nasāramapi janayat ajanayat viśvajanyaḥ sarvajanahitaḥ indrāya īśvarāya bṛhaspatitha indrāya vā ukthaṃ stotraṃ śaṃsan ayam ayāsyaḥ nāmarṣiḥ |
ṛtaṃ śaṃsanta ṛju dīdhyānā divasputrāso asurasya vīrāḥ |
vipraṃ padamaṅgiraso dadhānā yajñasya dhāma prathamaṃ mananta ||
ṛtam | śaṃsantaḥ | ṛju | dīdhyānāḥ | divaḥ | putrāsaḥ | asurasya | vīrāḥ | vipram | padam | aṅgirasaḥ | dadhānāḥ | yajñasya | dhāma | prathamam | mananta || 2 ||
ṛtaṃ satyabhūtaṃ stotraṃ śaṃsantaḥ stuvantaḥ ṛju kalyāṇaṃ dīdhyānāḥ karmāṇi dhyāyantaḥ divaḥ dīsasya asurasya prajñāvataḥ agneḥ aṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ |
vīrāḥ vikrāntaprajñā ete'ṅgirasaḥ vipraṃ prajñāpakaṃ yajñasya dhāma dhārakaṃ padaṃ bṛhaspatyākhyaṃ dadhānāḥ karmaṇā dhārayantaḥ santaḥ prathamam ādita eva mananta stuvanti |
devasuvāṃ haviḥpu bṛhaspataye vācaspataya ityasya yājyā ‘haṃsairiva’ ityeṣā |
sutritaṃ ca— ‘bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiḥ ’ ( āśva. śrau. 4. 11 ) iti ||
1. ga-ta-teṣāmanveṣa | 2. ga-ta-bha- ‘svit’ nāsti | 3. ga-ta-bhara.4.6.8-ajanayaditi; bha1.7-iti | 4. ga4-putrāsaḥ | 5. ta-bha-kārakam |
haṃsaiḥ'iva | sakhi'bhiḥ | vāvadat'bhiḥ | aśman'mayāni | nahanā | tri'asyan | bṛhaspatiḥ | abhi'kanikradat | gāḥ | uta | pra | astaut | uta | ca | vidvān | agāyat ||3||

^haṃsairiva madhuravāgbhiḥ ^sakhibhiḥ sakhibhūtaiḥ ^vāvadadbhiḥ atyantaṃ śabdayamānairmarudbhiḥ ^aśmanmayāni aśmamayāni ^nahanā gavāṃ vandhakanyācarakāpyasurāṇāṃ sthānāni ^vyasyan vikṣipan śithilayan ^abhikanikradat ābhimukhyena śabdayan ^gāḥ paṇibhirapahatān paśūnājihīrṣuḥ saḥ ^bṛhaspatiḥ vartate |
vāvadadbhiratyantaṃ stuvadbhiḥ stotṛbhiḥ saha gāḥ stotralakṣaṇā vāco'bhi- kanikradat ābhimukhyenoccārayan |
karmaṇi pravṛttau yajñasya sakhibhiḥ sahāsīnaḥ sāma gātuṃ prastauti |
^vidvān sarvaṃ jānānaḥ sa udgātā bhūtvā ^ut ^agāyata devān udgāyati abhiṣṭauti ||
avo dvābhyāṃ pūra ekayā gā guhā tiṣṭhantīrṛtasya setau |
bṛhaspatistarmasi jyotiricchanmudusā ākṛviṃ hi tisra ārvāḥ ||
avaḥ | dvābhyām | puraḥ | ekayā | gāḥ | guhā | tiṣṭhantīḥ | ṛtasya | setau | bṛhaspatiḥ | tamasi | jyotiḥ | icchan | | ut | usāḥ | ā | akaḥ | vi | hi | tisraḥ | ārvaḥ || 4 ||
paṇayo gā āhvaya triṣu sthāneṣu nidadhuḥ |
tataḥ ^paraḥ parastādavasthitā gāḥ ^ekayā ekena sthānena udagamayat |
^bṛhaspatiḥ tasmin ^tamasi ^jyotiḥ kartum ^icchan tatra sthitāḥ ^usāḥ gāḥ ^ut ^ākaḥ udakārṣīt |
bṛhaspatirupasaṃ sūrya gāka viveda stanayanniva dyauḥ ||
vi'bhiyā | puram | śayathā | īm | apārcīm | niḥ | trīṇi | sākam | udadheḥ | akṛntat | bṛhaspatiḥ | upasam | sūryam | gām | arkam | vi'veda | stanayan'iva | dyauḥ || 5 ||

saḥ ^bṛhaspatiḥ ^śayathā ^upaśayena sthitvā ^apārcīṃ parāṅmukhīm ^īm imām ^asurapurīṃ ^vibhiya ^vidārya ^udadheḥ balāt megharūpādasurāt ^sākaṃ saha yugapat ^trīṇi ^upasaṃ ^sūrya ^gām etāni trīṇi ^niḥ ^akṛntat nirgatamakārṣīt |
tamasāvṛteṣu sthāneṣuḥkālaṃ tataḥ paścādvāvinaṃ sūrya ca janayitvā paśūñjigaramayadityarthaḥ |
2. ga-ta-upaśayena sthitvā; bha-upa upaśayena sthitvā; su-upaśayena sthitvā |

indro vulaṃ rakṣitāraṃ durgāṇāṃ kareṇaiva vi cakarta raveṇa | svedāñbhirāśiremicchamāno'rodayatpaṇimā gā amuṣṇāta || 6 || indraḥ | vulam | rakṣitāram | durgāṇām | kareṇa'iva | vi | cakarta | raveṇa | svedāñbhiḥ | ā'śiram | icchamānaḥ | arodayat | paṇim | ā | gāḥ | amuṣṇāta ||6|| indraḥ īśvaro bṛhaspatiḥ dugānāṃ kṣīrasya dogdhrīṇāṃ gavāṃ rakṣitāraṃ valam asuraṃ kareṇeva sāyudhakara iva sthitena raveṇa śabdena valaṃ vi cakarta viviccheda | kiṃca svedāñbhiḥ | svedā- ñyo marutaḥ kṣaradābharaṇāḥ | taiḥ saha āśiram āśrayaṇaṃ saṃyogam icchamānaḥ kāmayamānaḥ saḥ paṇi valasyānucarametanāmasuram arodayat vyanāśayat | tatastenāpahṛtāḥ gāḥ amuṣṇāta ājahāra || || 15 ||

sa īṃ satyebhiḥ sakhibhiḥ śucadbhirgodhāyasaṃ vi dhanasairdarda | brahmaṇaspatirvṛṣabhirvarāhairrdhamasvedairdraviṇaṃ vyā naṭ || 7 || saḥ | īm | satyebhiḥ | sakhibhiḥ | śucadbhiḥ | go'dhāyasam | vi | dhanasaiḥ | adardaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ | patiḥ | vṛṣabhaiḥ | varāhaiḥ | gharma'svedaiḥ | draviṇam | vi | ānaṭ || 7 || saḥ bṛhaspatiḥ satyebhiḥ yathārthabalaiḥ sakhibhiḥ sakhibhūtaiḥ śucadbhiḥ dīpyamānaiḥ dhanasaiḥ dhanasya saṃbhaktṛbhirmarudbhiḥ saha godhāyasaṃ gavāṃ dhārakam īm enaṃ valaṃ vi adardaḥ vyadārayat | tataḥ brahmaṇaḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmalakṣaṇasya stotrasya patiḥ adhipatiḥ saḥ vṛṣabhaiḥ varṣaṇṛbhiḥ varāhaiḥ varāhairivarasya varaṇīyasyodakasyāhartṛbhiḥ gharmasvedaiḥ dīptāgmanaiḥ | yadvā kṣaradudakaiḥ | athavā gharmo yajñaḥ | taṃ prati gantubhiḥ marudbhiḥ draviṇaṃ golakṣaṇaṃ dhanaṃ vyānaṭ vyāpnot ||

te satyena manasā goparti gā iyānāsa iṣaṇayanta dhībhiḥ | bṛhaspatirmitho'vadyapebhirudusriyā asṛjata svayugbhiḥ || 8 || te | satyena | manasā | go'patim | gāḥ | iyānāsaḥ | iṣaṇayantaḥ | dhībhiḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | mithaḥ'avadyapebhiḥ | ut | usriyāḥ | asṛjata | svayugbhiḥ || 8 || gāḥ paṇibhirapahatān paśūn iyānāsaḥ abhigacchantaḥ satyena yathārthabhūtena manasā yuktāḥ te marutaḥ dhībhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ karmabhiritaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ gopatiṃ tadāharaṇena gavāṃ svāminaṃ kurma iti iṣaṇayanta aicchan | bṛhaspatiḥ ca mitho'vadyapebhiḥ | pāteḥ karmaṇyoṇādikaḥ kapratyayaḥ | avadya- rūpādurādrakṣitavyā gāvo yeṣu marutsu parasparaṃ saṃgacchanta iti te tathoktāḥ | taiḥ svayugbhiḥ svayameva yuktairmarudbhiḥ usriyāḥ gāḥ ut asṛjata parvatānnirgamayat ||
taṃ vardhayanto matibhiḥ śivābhiḥ siṃhamiva nārnadataṃ sadhasthe |
bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ śūrasātau bharebhare anu madama jiṣṇum ||
tam | vardhayantaḥ | mati'bhiḥ | śivābhiḥ | miham'iva | nānadatam | sudha'sthai | bṛhaspatim | vṛṣaṇam | śūra'sātau | bhare'bhare | anu | madam | jiṣṇum || 9 ||

tasmin ᐯsiṃhamiva ᐯnānadataṃ punaḥ- punaḥ śabdayamānaṃ ᐯvṛṣaṇaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣitāraṃ ᐯjiṣṇuṃ jayaśīlaṃ ᐯtaṃ ᐯbṛhaspatiṃ ᐯvardhayantaḥ mahato varya ᐯśūrasāto śūraiḥ saṃbhajanīye ᐯbharebhare saṃgrāme ᐯśivābhiḥ kalyāṇībhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᐯanu ᐯmadam anuṣṭumaḥ |

yadā vājam'sanadviśvarūpamā dyāmarukṣaduttarāṇi sarva | bṛhaspatiṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vardhayanto nānā santo bibhrato jyotirāsā || 10 || yadā | vājam | asanat | viśvarūpam | ā | cām | arukṣat | ut'tarāṇi | sarva | bṛhaspatim | vṛṣaṇam | vardhayantaḥ | nānā | santaḥ | bibhrataḥ | jyotiḥ | āsā || 10 ||
sa bṛhaspatiḥ ᐯyadā yasmin kāle ᐯviśvarūpaṃ nānārūpaṃ ᐯvājaṃ golakṣaṇamannam ᐯasanat bhajate yadā vāhanapaśukaḥ san ᐯyāṃ dyulokam ᐯarukṣat ārohati athavā ᐯuttarāṇi vā ᐯsadya sthānānanyā- rohati |
tadānīṃ ᐯvṛṣaṇaṃ varṣitāraṃ ᐯbṛhaspatim ᐯāsā āsyena devāḥ ᐯvardhayantaḥ bhavanti |
tathā ᐯnānā dikṣu ᐯsantaḥ bhavantaḥ ᐯjyotiḥ ᐯbibhrataḥ dhārayanto devāśca stuvanti ||

satyāmāśiṣaṃ kṛṇutā vayodhai kīriṃ cidyavatha svebhirevaiḥ | paścā mṛdho arpa bhavantu viśvāstadodasī śṛṇutaṃ viśvaminve || 11 || satyām | ā'śiṣam | kṛṇuta | vayaḥ'dhe | kīrim | cit | hi | artha | svebhiḥ | evaiḥ | paścā | mṛdhaḥ | arpa | bhavantu | viśvāḥ | tat | rodasī iti | śṛṇutam | viśvaminve iti viśvam'inve || 11 ||
he bṛhaspatiprabhṛtayo devāḥ ᐯvayodhai annasya nidhānāyāsmadīyām ᐯāśiṣaṃ stutiṃ ᐯsatyāṃ yathārthāṃ ᐯkṛṇuta kuruta |
tathā yūyaṃ ᐯsvebhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ ᐯevaiḥ gamanaiḥ ᐯkīriṃ stotāraṃ mām ᐯavatha rakṣatha |
paścāt ᐯviśvāḥ sarvāḥ ᐯmṛdhaḥ hiṃsiṣyaḥ ᐯapa ᐯbhavantu naśyantu |
ᐯtat idamasmābhiruktaṃ vacanaṃ he ᐯviśvaminve viśvasya prīṇayitryau he ᐯrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᐯśṛṇutam ||

indro mahā mahato arṇavasya vi mūrdhānamabhinadarbudasya | ahanahimariṇātsapta sindhūn deverdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ || 12 || indraḥ | mahā | mahataḥ | | arṇavasya | vi | mūrdhānam | abhinat | arbudasya | ahan | ahim | ariṇāt | sapta | sindhūn | devaiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | pra | avatam | naḥ || 12 ||
ᵥindraḥ īśvaraḥ ᵥmahā mahasvena yukto bṛhaspatiḥ ᵥmahato ᵥarṇavasya udakavataḥ ᵥarbudasya ambudasya meghasya ᵥmūrdhānaṃ śiraḥ ᵥvi ᵥabhinat vyacchinat |
ᵥahim ahantyamapāmā- varakaṃ śatrum ᵥahan avadhīt |
tataḥ ᵥsasa sarpaṇaśīlāḥ ᵥsindhūn syandamānā apaḥ |
he dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥdevaiḥ saha ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥprāvataṃ prakṣatam ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘pra maṃ hiṣṭhāyādprato'cchā ma indram’ (āśva.śrau.6.1) iti ||
udprato na vayo rakṣamāṇā vārdato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ |
ud'prataḥ | na | vayeḥ | rakṣamāṇāḥ | vārdataḥ | abhriyasya'iva | ghoṣāḥ | giri'abhrajaḥ | na | ūrmayaḥ | mardantaḥ | bṛhaspatim | abhi | arkāḥ | anāvana || 1 ||
ᵥudprataḥ udakasyodmayitāraḥ ᵥvayaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ pakvāstasyāt ᵥrakṣamāṇāḥ kṛpīvalāḥ |
yathā ca ᵥvāvadataḥ punaḥpunaḥ śabdadāyamānasya ᵥabhriyasyeva abhra- samūhasya ᵥghoṣāḥ śabdā yathā bhavanti |
kiṃca ᵥgiribhrajaḥ giribhyo meghebhyo bhraṣṭā nirgatāḥ ᵥūrmayaḥ apsamūhā yathā ᵥmadantaḥ śabdadāyamānā bhavanti |
tathā ᵥarkāḥ arcakāḥ stotāraḥ ᵥbṛhaspatim ᵥabhi ᵥanāvana abhiṣṭuvanti |
janai mitro na darpatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśū~rivājau ||
sam | gobhiḥ | āṅgirasaḥ | nakṣamāṇaḥ | bhagaḥ'iva | it | arthamaṇam | nināya | janai | mitraḥ | na | darpatī iti dam'patī | anakti | bṛhaspate | vājaye | āśun'iva | ājau || 2 ||
ᵥāṅgirasaḥ aṅgirasaḥ putraḥ ᵥnakṣamāṇaḥ svatejasā vyāptuvan ᵥbhagaivet bhago deva iva sthito bṛhaspatireva ᵥarthamaṇaṃ stuteḥ prerakaṃ stotāraṃ ᵥgobhiḥ saha ᵥsaṃ ᵥnināya saṃnayati saṃyojayati |
ᵥmitro ᵥna mitro yathā ᵥjane janapade svaraśmīn saṃyojayati tadvat ᵥdarpatī jāyāpatī ᵥanakti saṃgamayati |
he ᵥbṛhaspate āśūn vyāsān svaraśmīn ᵥvājāya tava stotṛṣu gamaya sthāpaya |
ᵥāśūniva vyāsānśvān ᵥājau saṃgrāme yoddhāro yathā saṃgamayanti tadvat ||
bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nigā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ ||
sādhu'aryāḥ | atithinīḥ | iṣirāḥ | spārhāḥ | suvarṇāḥ | anavadya'rūpāḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | parvatebhyaḥ | vi'tūrya | ni | gāḥ | ūpe | yavam'iva | sthivibhyaḥ || 3 ||

7sādhvaryā: sādhūnāṃ kalyāṇānāṃ payasāṃ netrī: 7atithinī: satataṃ gacchantī: 7iṣbirā: epaṇīyā: 7spārhā: 1 spṛhaṇīyā: 7suvarṇā: śobhanaśuklādivarṇopetā: 7anavayarūpā: praśastarūpā etā: 7gā: 7parvatebhya: valasaṃbandhibhya: 7vittyaṃ nirgamayya 7upe devasamīpe nirvapati prāpayati |
sādhuyananādiguṇayuktā gā apa: parvatebhyo meghebhya āhṛtya sarvatra varṣati ||

āpruṣāṇyamadhunaṃ ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyo: | bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā uddeva vi tvacaṃ bibheda || 4 || ā'pruṣāṇan | madhunā | ṛtasya | yonim | ava'kṣipan | arka: | ulkām'iva | dyo: | bṛhaspati: | uddharan | aśmana: | gā: | bhūmyā: | uddā'iva | vi | tvacam | bibheda ||4||

7ṛtasya udakasya 7yoniṃ megham 7avakṣipan vṛṣṭyarthamavakiran 7arka: arcanīya: 7bṛhaspati: 7dyo: dyulokāt 7ulkāmiva ulkāṃ yathoddharati tadvat 7aśmana: śilocayādalenādhiṣṭhitān 7gā: paṇibhirapahatān paśyan 7uddharan ūrdhvaṃ gamayan 7bhūmyā: 7tvacaṃ teṣāṃ śaphe 7vi 7vibheda vibhinnakāryān |
yathā vṛṣṭyudakena parjanyo bhūmiśvacaṃ vibhinatti tadvat ||

apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudra: śīpālamiva vāta ā jat | bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyābhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gā: || 5 || apa | jyotiṣā | tama: | antarikṣāt | udra: | śīpālam'iva | vāta: | ājat | bṛhaspati: | anu'mṛśya | valasya | abhram'iva | vāta: | ā | cakre | ā | gā: || 5 ||
sa: 7bṛhaspati: 7jyotiṣā tamasāvṛte parvatavivare kṛtena sūryeṇa 7antarikṣāt 7tama: 7apa 7ājat apāgamayat |
tata: so'yam 7anumṛśya atra gāvastiṣṭantīti vicārya niścitya 7valasya svabhūtasya parvatasyāntargatā: 7gā: 7ā 7cakre samantādakārṣīt |

yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhedṛhaspatiragnitapobhirkai: | durnaṃ jihvā pariviṣṭamārdavirnidhaurṛkuṇodustriyāṇām || 6 || yadā | valasya | pīyataḥ | jasum | bhet | bṛhaspati: | agnitapa:'bhi: | arkai: | dat'bhi: | na | jihvā | pari'viṣṭam | ārdat | āvi: | 'ni'dhan | akṛṇot | ustriyāṇām || 6 ||
1. ga4-ta4-prāptyā ata eva spārhā: ( ta4-aspārhā: ) sarve: spṛhaṇīyā:; itaralikhitapustakeṣu ‘spārhā: spṛhaṇīyā:’ nāsti |
hiṃsakasya valasya jasum āyudhaṃ yadā yasminkāle bheta bhinatti |
amṛtapobhiḥ agnivatpanaśīlaiḥ arkaiḥ arcanīyai raśmibhiḥ api vā mantrairbhinatti |

yathā dantaiḥ pariviṣṭaṃ bhakṣyaṃ jihvā bhakṣayati tadvat saḥ pariviṣṭaṃ parvate paṇibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ valanāmānaṃ yadā ādat abhakṣayat avadhīt tadānīṃ tairapahatānāṃ ustriyāṇāṃ gavāṃ nidhīn āviḥ akuṇot āvirbhūta makarot ||
vsa: vbṛhaspati: tatra parvatavivare gavāṃ darśanāya vuṣāṃ upasam vavindat alabhata |
vsa: eva vsva: ādityaṃ vsa: vagniṃ labdhvā varkena arcanīyena tejasā vtamāṃsi vvi vbabādhe atyarthaṃ bādhitavān |
tata: sa: vgovapupa: gorūpaśarīrasya paśubhi: parivṛtasya vvalasya vparvaṇa: parvatāt tā gā: vni: vjabhāra balena nirjahāra |
asthno majānaṃ yathā atikreśena nirharanti tadvat ||
himeva pūrṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayad‌lo gā: |
himā'iva | pūrṇā | muṣitā | vanāni | bṛhaspatinā | akṛpayat | vala: | gā: | ananukṛtyam | apunariti | cakāra | yāt | sūryāmāsā | mitha: | uta'ścarāta: || 10 || vhimeva yathā himena vpūrṇā parṇāni
he 'agne 'te 'tvadīyaṃ 'yat 'anīkaṃ raśmisaṃghaṃ 'manuḥ etannāmakaḥ yathā 'samīpe havirbhiḥ samyagdīpayati 'sumitraḥ etannāmako'haṃ samīdhe samyagdīpayāmi |
yaṃ tvā pūrvamīḻito vadhyaśvaḥ saṃmīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva |
sa naḥ stipā uta bhavā tanupā dātraṃ rakṣasva yadidaṃ tai asme ||
tebhyo hitāni parvaṇyā parvatabhavāni vasūni gavādilakṣaṇāni saṃ jigetha śatrubhyaḥ saṃjitavānasi|
tathā āyāṃ balavadbhiḥ kṛtān dāsā dāsairasuraiḥ kṛtān vṛtrāṇi upadravān saṃ jigetha|
śūrahva ṣṭapnuḥ janānāṃ cyavanaḥ tvaṃ pṛtanāyūn saṃgrāmakāmān abhi pyāḥ abhibhava|
dyumān dyumatsu nṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu ||
dīrghatantuḥ| bṛhat'ukṣā| ayam| agniḥ| sahasra'starīḥ| śata'nīthaḥ| ṛbhvā| dyumān| dyumat'su| nṛbhiḥ| mṛjyamānaḥ| su'mitreṣu| dīdayaḥ| devayat'su || 7 ||

prabhūtaśmimuktaḥ sahasrastarīḥ havīrūpabahacchādanaḥ śatanīthaḥ āhavanīyādidvāreṇa bahuvidha nayanaḥ ṛbhvā mahān dyumatsu dīptimatsu madhye dyumāna atiśayena dīptimān ayamagniḥ nṛbhiḥ karmanetṛbhirdhvigabhiḥ mṛjyamānaḥ alaṃkriyamāṇo bhavati|
sa tvaṃ devayatsu devān kāmayamāneṣu sumitreṣu asmāsu dīdayaḥ dīpyasva|
tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo'saścataiva samanā saṃbadhuk|
tve iti| dhenuḥ| su'dughā| jāta'vedaḥ| asaścatā'iva| samanā| sabaḥ'dhuk| tvam| nṛbhiḥ| dakṣiṇāvata'bhiḥ| agne| su'mitrebhiḥ| idhyase| devayat'bhiḥ || 8 ||
he jātavedaḥ he agne tve tvayi sudughā suṣṭhu payaso dogdhrī kāciddhomasādhanabhūtā dhenuḥ asti|
asaścataiva saṃgavarjitenaiva sthityabhāvātkutrāpi na saṃyuktenānvitena samanā saṃgatā sabaṃdhuk amṛtaṃ duhānā gorūpā mādhyamikī vāgvaicyute tvayyastīti bhāvaḥ|
tādṛśaḥ tvaṃ nṛbhiḥ karmanetṛbhiḥ dakṣiṇāvadbhiḥ ṛtvigbhyo deyatvena tadvadbhiḥ devayadbhiḥ devakāmaḥ sumitrebhiḥ asmābhiḥ idhyase havirbhirdīpyase ||
devā~ścitte amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhyaśca pra vocana|
devāḥ| cit| te| amṛtāḥ| jāta'vedaḥ| mahimānam| vādhri'aśva| pra| vocan| yat| sam'pṛccham| mānuṣīḥ| viśaḥ| āyan| tvam| nṛbhiḥ| ajayaḥ| tvā'vṛdhebhiḥ ||9||
he jātavedaḥ he vādhryaśva agne te tava mahimānam amṛtāḥ devāścit devā api pra vocan prabruvanti|

yat yadā mānuṣīḥ manuṣyasambandhinyaḥ viśaḥ prajāḥ saṃpṛcchaṃ devaiḥ saha ko vā asurān hantītyevādikaṃ saṃpṛkṣam āyan prāptavantaḥ tadā tvaṃ nṛbhiḥ sarvasya netṛbhiḥ tvāvṛdhebhiḥ tvayā vardhitairdevaiḥ saha karmavighnakāriṇastān ajayaḥ jitavānasi ||
juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvī avnordhāṃtaścit ||
pitā'iva | putram | avibhaḥ | upa'sthe | tvām | agne | vadhi'aśvaḥ | saparyana | juṣāṇaḥ | asya | sam'idham | yaviṣṭha | uta | pūrvīḥ | avnoḥ | dhāṃtaścit ||10||
paricaran 'vadhyaśvaḥ mama pitā 'abibhaḥ dhṛtavān havirbhiḥ poṣitavānvā |
'piteva yathā pitā samīpe 'putraṃ sthāpayati poṣayati vā |
laṅi' tipi guṇe kṛte halḍyādinā tipo lopaḥ |
he 'yaviṣṭha yuvattamāme 'uta api ca 'asya vadhyaśvasya piturvā mama vā 'samidhaṃ 'juṣāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ san 'pūrvān prastān 'vrādhataścit bādhakānapi śatrūna 'avanoḥ avadhīḥ |
śaśvat | agniḥ | vadhi'aśvasya | śatrūn | nṛbhiḥ | jigāya | sutasomavat'bhiḥ | samanam | cit | adahaḥ | citrabhāno iti citra'bhāno | arva | vrādhantam | abhinat | vṛdhaḥ | cit || 11 ||
atha tava stotā vadhyaśvaḥ 'vṛdhaścit svayaṃ vṛddho bhavan 'vrādhantaṃ vardhamānaṃ hiṃsakaṃ vā 'ava 'abhinat avāṅmukhaṃ kṛtvā acchinat |
sa no ajāmīṃruta vā vijāmīnbhi tiṣṭha śardhato vrādhyaśva ||
ayam | agniḥ | vadhi'aśvasya | vṛtra'hā | sanakāt | pra'iddhaḥ | namasā | upa'vākyaḥ | maḥ | naḥ | ajāmīn | uta | vā | vi'jāmīn | abhi | tiṣṭha | śardhataḥ | vrādhi'aśva ||12||
'vṛtrahā śatrūṇāṃ hantā 'ayamagniḥ 'sanakāt cirādārabhya 'vadhyaśvasya haviṣā 'preddhaḥ prakarṣeṇa dīpito bhavati |
tathā tasya 'namasā namaskāreṇa saha 'upavākyaḥ upastotavyo bhavati |
he 'vrādhyaśva vadhyaśvakule mathanena samutpannāgne 'saḥ tvaṃ 'naḥ asmākam 'ajāmīn ajñātīn śatrūn 'uta vā api vā 'śardhataḥ hiṃsataḥ 'vijāmīn vividhān jñātīnpi 'abhi 'tiṣṭha abhibhava ||
‘imāṃ me’ ityekādaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ vādhyaśvasya sumitrasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubham |
mūtritaṃ ca—‘samiddho adyeti sarveṣāṃ yayarpi vā’ ( āśva. śrau. 1. 2 ) iti ||

imāṃ me agne samidhaṃ juṣasveḻaspade prati haryā ghṛtācīm | varṣman pṛthivyāḥ sudinatve ahāmūdhrdho bhava sukrato devayajyā || 1 || imām | me | agne | sam‌'idham | juṣasva | iḻaḥ | pade | prati | haryā | ghṛtācīm | varṣman | pṛthivyāḥ | sudinatve | ahaḥ'mūdhrdhaḥ | bhava | sukrato iti su'krato | deva'yajyā || 1 ||
‘etadvā iḻāyāspadaṃ yaduttaravedīnābhiḥ’ ( ai. brā. 1. 28 ) iti brāhmaṇam |
uttaravedyām imāṃ me madīyāṃ samidhaṃ juṣasva sevasva |
tathā ghṛtācīṃ ghṛtamañjantīṃ sūcaṃ prati haryā pratikāmayasva |
kiṃca he sukrato suprajña pṛthivyāḥ varṣman varṣmaṇi samucchrite pūrvokte deśe ahnāṃ sudinatve tannimittaṃ devayajyā devayāgena hetunā ūrdhvaḥ jvālābhi- runnataḥ bhava ||

ā devānāṃmagrayāveha yāṃtu narāśaṃso viśvarūpebhiraśvaiḥ | ṛtasya pathā namasā miyedho devebhyo devatamaḥ supudat || 2 || ā | devānām | agra'yāvā | iha | yātu | narāśaṃsaḥ | viśva'rūpebhiḥ | aśvaiḥ | ṛtasya | pathā | namasā | miyedhaḥ | devebhyaḥ | deva'tamaḥ | su'pudat || 2 ||
naraiḥ śamanīya etannāmako'gniḥ viśvarūpebhiḥ nānārūpaiḥ aśvaiḥ rohidādyaiḥ saha iha asmin yajñe ā yātu |

āgatya ca miyedhaḥ medhyo yajñahitaḥ stutiyogyo vā devatamaḥ devānāṃ mukhyaḥ so'gniḥ havirnayanayogena ṛtasya yajñasya pathā mārgeṇa namamā stotreṇa saha devebhyaḥ indrādibhyaḥ supudat haviḥ prerayatu ||

śaśvattamamīḻate dūtyāya haviṣmanto manuṣyāso agnim | vahniairaśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena devān vakṣi ni ṣadeha hotā || 3 || śaśvat'tamam | īḻate | dūtyāya | haviṣmantaḥ | manuṣyāsaḥ | agnim | vahnibhiḥ | aśvaiḥ | su'vṛtā | rathena | devān | vakṣi | ni | sada | iha | hotā || 3 ||
śaśvattamam atyantaṃ nityam agniṃ haviṣmantaḥ saṃbhṛtahaviṣkāḥ manuṣyāsaḥ manuṣyāḥ yajamānāḥ dūtyāya |
sa tvamevaṃ stutaḥ vahniḥ voḍhṛtamaiḥ aśvaiḥ suvṛtā suvartanena rathena ca saha devān indrādīn ā vakṣi asmadīyaṃ yajñaṃ pratyāvaha prāpaya |
tatastvaṃ hotā bhavan iha asmin yajñe ni ṣada niṣīda ||
vi pra̭thatāṃ deva॒juṣṭaṃ tira॒ścā dī॒rghaṃ drā॒ghmā su॒rabhi̭ bhū॒tvasme |
ahḙḻatā॒ mana̭sā de॒va ba॒rhi ri̭ndrajye॒ṣṭhā u॒śato॒ yakṣi̭ de॒vān ||
vi | pra॒tha॒tām | de॒va॒'juṣṭa̭m | ti॒ra॒ścā | dī॒rgham | drā॒ghmā | su॒ra॒bhi | bhū॒tu | a॒sme iti̭ | ahḙḻatā | mana̭sā | de॒va | ba॒rhiḥ | indra̭'jyeṣṭhān | u॒śa॒taḥ | yakṣi̭ | de॒vān || 4 ||
he barhirnāmakāme 'devajuṣṭaṃ devaiḥ sevitaṃ 'tiraścā nimnaṃ tiryagjanamidaṃ barhiḥ |
akudhyatā 'manasā 'uśataḥ havīṃṣi kāmayamānān 'indrajyeṣṭhān indrapradhānān 'devān 'yakṣi yaja pūjaya ||
di॒vo vā॒ sānṷ spṛśatā॒ varī̭yaḥ pṛ॒thivyā॒ vā mā॒trayā॒ vi śra̭yadhvam |

di॒vaḥ | vā | sānṷ | spṛ॒śa॒tā | varī̭yaḥ | pṛ॒thivyā̭ḥ | vā | mā॒trayā̭ | vi | śra॒ya॒dhva॒m | u॒śatī̭ḥ | dvāra̭ḥ | ma॒hinā̭ | ma॒hat'bhi̭ḥ | de॒vam | rathḙm | ra॒tha'yuḥ | dha॒ra॒ya॒dhva॒m || 5 ||
divaśca 'sānu samucchritaṃ 'varīyaḥ urutaraṃ sthānaṃ 'spṛśata unnatā bhavatetyarthaḥ |
'pṛthivyāḥ 'ca yāvatī mātrāsti tāvatyā 'mātrayā 'vi śrayadhvaṃ vistṛtā bhavata |
rathakāmāḥ satyaḥ 'mahinā mahimnā 'mahadbhiḥ devairadhiṣṭhitam ata etra 'devaṃ dyotamānaṃ 'rathaṃ ramaṇasādhanaṃ 'dhārayadhvaṃ dhārayata ||
de॒vī di॒vo dṷhi॒tarā॒ suśi̭lpe u॒pāsā॒naktā॒ sada̭tāṃ ni yo॒nau |
ā vā̭ṃ de॒vāsa̭ u॒śatī̭ u॒śanta̭ṃ u॒rau sī̭dantu su॒bhage॒ upa̭sthe ||

de॒vī iti̭ | di॒vaḥ | du॒hi॒tarā̭ | su॒śi॒lpe iti̭ su'śi̭lpe | u॒pāsā॒naktā̭ | sada̭tām | ni | yo॒nau | ā | vā॒m | de॒vāsa̭ḥ | u॒śatī̭ iti̭ | u॒śanta̭m | u॒rau | sī̭dantu | su॒bhage iti̭ su'bhagḙ | u॒pa'sthḙ ||6||
'devī dyotamāne 'divaḥ dyulokasya 'duhitarā duhitarau 'suśilpe śobhanarūpe 'upāsānaktā upāśca naktaṃ cāhorātrau 'yonau yajñasya sthāne 'ni 'sadatām niṣīdatām |
he 'uśatī uśatyau kāmayamāne he 'subhage śobhanadhane he devyau 'vāṃ yuvayoḥ 'urau vistīrṇe 'upasthe samīpasthe sthāne 'uśantaḥ havīṃṣi kāmayamānāḥ 'devāsaḥ devāḥ 'ā 'sīdantu upaviśantu ||
ū॒rdhvo grā॒vā bṛha॒dbhiḥ sa॒middhaḥ pri॒yā dhā॒mānya̭dite॒rupa̭sthe |
pu॒rohi̭tā॒vṛtvi̭jā ya॒jñe a॒smin vidṷṣṭarā॒ dravi̭ṇamā ya̭jethām ||
ūrdhvaḥ | prāvā | bṛhat | agniḥ | samiddhaḥ | priyā | dhāmāni | aditeḥ | upasthai | puraḥhitau | ṛtvijā | yajñe | asmin | viduḥtarā | draviṇam | ā | yajethām || 7 ||

^grāvā somābhipavāya yadā ^ūrdhvaḥ unnato bhavati yadā ca ^bṛhat mahān ^agniḥ ^samiddhaḥ havirbhiḥ samyagdīpto bhavati tathā priyāṇi devānāṃ somādihaviṣpradānena prīṇayitṛṇi ^dhāmāni haviṣāṃ dhārakāṇi yajñapātrāṇi ^aditeḥ pṛthivyāḥ ^upasthe yajñasadane yadāsāditāni bhavanti tadānīṃ he ṛtvijau daityau ^purohitau hotārī purato nihitau ^viduṣṭarā |
tisro devīrbarhiridaṃ varīya ā sīdata cakrumā vaḥ syonam |
manuṣyajñaṃ sudhitā havīṃṣīḻā devī ghṛtapadī juṣanta ||
tisraḥ | devīḥ | barhiḥ | idam | varīyaḥ | ā | sīdata | cakruma | vaḥ | syonam | manuṣyat | yajñam | sudhitā | havīṃṣi | iḻā | devī | ghṛta'padī | juṣanta || 8 ||

^iḻā etannāmikā ^devī dyotamānā sarasvatī ^ghṛtapadī dīkṣapadopetā bhāratī ca etāḥ ^manuṣyat manauryajñe yathā havīṃṣyasevanta tadvadasmadīyaṃ ^yajñaṃ ^sudhitā suṣṭhu nihitāni ^havīṃṣi ca ^juṣanta sevantām ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘deva tvaṣṭaryaddha cārutva- mānaṭ piśaṅgarūpaḥ subharo vayodhāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8 ) iti ||
sa devānāṃ pātha upa pra vidvānuśan yakṣi draviṇodaḥ suratnaḥ ||
deva | tvaṣṭaḥ | yat | ha | cārutvam | ānaṭ | yat | aṅgirasām | abhavaḥ | sacā'bhūḥ | saḥ | devānām | pāthaḥ | upa | pra | vidvān | uśan | yakṣi | draviṇaḥ'daḥ | su'ratnaḥ ||9||
he ^deva ^tvaṣṭaḥ etannāmaka tvaṃ ^yat ^cārutvaṃ havirbhiḥ kalyāṇarūpatvam ^ānaṭ prāptavānasi |
he ^draviṇodaḥ dhanasya dātaḥ ata eva ^suratnaḥ sudhanaḥ ^saḥ tvam ^uśan havīṃṣi kāmayamānaḥ san ^vidvān asyedamasyedamiti prajānan ^devānāṃ ^pāthaḥ annam ^upa ^yakṣi upayaja |
sūtritaṃ ca—devebhyo vanaspate havīṃṣi vanaspate raśanayā niyuyeti sūktamukhyāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 5 ) iti ||

vanaspate raśanayā ninyūyā devānāṃ pātha upa vakṣi vidvān | svadāti devaḥ kṛṇavaddhavīṣyarvatāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī havai me || 10 || vanaspate | raśanayā | ninyūya | devānām | pāthaḥ | upa | vakṣi | vidvān | svadāti | devaḥ | kṛṇvat | havīṃṣi | arbatām | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | havam | me || 10 ||
he vanaspati vanaspativikāra yūpa vidvān jānansvaṃ raśanayā rajjvā ninyūya baddhvā paridhyāya pāthaḥ annaṃ devānām indrādīnām upa vakṣi upavaha prāpaya |
tataḥ devaḥ vanaspatiḥ svadāti haviṣprāpaṇena svadayatu |
tathā havīṃṣi asmābhirdattāni kṛṇvat devānāṃ karotu |
tathā me madīyaṃ havaṃ devavipayāhvānaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau avatāṃ rakṣatām ||

āgne vaha varuṇamiṣṭayai na indraṃ divo maruto antarikṣāt | sīdantu barhirviśva ā yajatrāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām || 11 || ā | agne | vaha | varuṇam | iṣṭayai | naḥ | indram | divaḥ | marutaḥ | antarikṣāt | sīdantu | barhiḥ | viśve | ā | yajatrāḥ | svāhā | devāḥ | amṛtāḥ | mādayantām || 11 ||
he agne tvaṃ naḥ asmākam iṣṭaye yāgāya indraṃ varuṇaṃca marutaḥ ca divaḥ dyulokāt antarikṣāt ca asmadīyaṃ yajñam ā vaha prāpaya |
āgatāste yajatrāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ viśve sarve devāḥ barhiḥ ā sīdantu tatrāsannā bhavantu |
tataḥ amṛtāḥ maraṇadharmarahitāḥ devāḥ svāhā svāhākāreṇa dattahavirbhiḥ mādayantām ātmānaṃ mādayantu ||
uktaṃ hi bṛhaddevatāyāṃ—'sujyotiḥ paramaṃ brahma yadyogānmsamāpnute |
anukrāntaṃ ca—'bṛhaspate bṛhaspatijñānaṃ tuṣṭāva navamī jagatī' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ haṃsairiva sakhibhirvāvadadbhiḥ ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 11 ) iti ||

bṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agraṃ yatprairata nāmadheyaṃ dadhānāḥ | yadeṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yadaripramāsītpreṇā tadeṣāṃ nihitaṃ guhāviḥ || 1 || bṛhaspate | prathamam | vācaḥ | agram | yat | pra | airat | nāmadheyam | dadhānāḥ | yat | eṣām | śreṣṭham | yat | aripram | āsīt | preṇā | tat | eṣām | ni'hitam | guhā | āviḥ || 1 ||
bṛhaspatiranena sūktena viditavedhārthān bālān dṛṣṭvā smayamānaḥ' svātmānaṃ saṃbodhyāha |
he bṛhaspate antarātman prathamam utpadyanantaramitaravāguccāraṇāprāgeva nāmadheyaṃ nāma dadhānāḥ |
padārtheṣu nidadhānā bālāḥ yat yaista preritavantaḥ tat vāco'graṃ bhavati|
yattata tātetyādikaṃ vākyaṃ pūrvamabhidhāya paścādanyā vāco vadiṣyanti khalu tasmādvāco'gram|
tathedānīm eṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ praśasyatamaṃ yat yacca aripraṃ pāparahitaṃ vedārthajñānam āsīt eṣāṃ tajjñānaṃ guhā guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ gopyaṃ tat preṇā|
evaṃ vismaye gṛhaspate prathamaṃ vāco agram ’ (ai. ā. 1. 3. 6) ityādikamāraṇyakamanusaṃdheyam ||
saktumiva titaunā punanto yatra dhīrā manasā vācamakrata|
atrā sakhāyaḥ sakhyāni jānate bhadrā lakṣmīrnihitādhi vāci ||
saktumiva | titaunā | punantaḥ | yatra | dhīrāḥ | manasā | vācam | akrata | atra | sakhāyaḥ | sakhyāni | jānate | bhadrā | eṣām | lakṣmīḥ | nihitā | adhi | vāci || 2 ||

uktanirvacanena sūryeṇa saktumiva yathā kaścinmaktuṃ durdhāvaṃ punāti tadvat prakṛtitaḥ pratyayastacca śabdāntupunantaḥ dhīrāḥ dhīmanto vidvāṃsaḥ yatra yasmin kāle vidvatsaṃghe vā manasā prajñāyuktena vācamakrata kurvanti|
atra tatra kāle sakhāyaḥ samānakhyānāḥ śākhādvitripayajñānāste sakhyāni teṣu bhavāni jñānāni jānate jānanti|
sakhāyo vācā baddhamadhyāste tasyāstasyā vācaḥ sakhyāni jānanti|
tasmān eṣāṃ vāci bhadrā kalyāṇī nihitā lakṣmīḥ bhavati|
titau paripavanaṃ bhavati tatavadvā tuṣavadvā tilamātranubhamiti vā saktumiva titaunā (niru. 4. 10) ityādi nirukta- manusaṃdheyam ||
vāgadevyapaśopapuroḍāśayaḥ 'yajñena vācaḥ' ityādike dve krameṇa yājye|
sūtritaṃ ca—'yajñena vācaḥ padavīyamāyanniti dve devīṃ vācamajanayanta devāḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||
tāmābhṛtyā vyadadhuḥ purutrā tāṃ sapta rebhā abhi saṃ navante ||
yajñena | vācaḥ | padavīyam | āyan | tām | anu | avindan | ṛṣiṣu | praviṣṭāṃ | tām | ā'bhṛtya | vi | adadhuḥ | puru'trā | tām | sapta | rebhāḥ | abhi | sam | navante ||3||
viditāthāṃ dhīrāḥ padavīyam veteḥ aco yat|
taṃ vācaḥ mārgaṃ yajñena āyan prāptavantaḥ|
ṛṣiṣu atīndriyārthadarśiṣu praviṣṭāṃ tāṃ vācam avindan alabhanta|
anantaraṃ tāṃ vācam ābhṛtya āhṛtya purutrā bahuṣu deśeṣu vyadadhuḥ vyakārṣuḥ|
etādṛśīṃ vācaṃ rebhāḥ śabdayamānāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ pakṣirūpāṇi gāyadhyādīni sapta chandāṃsi abhi saṃ navante abhitaḥ saṃgacchante ||
uta tvaḥ paśyandadarśa vācamuta tvaḥ śṛṇvanśṛṇotyenām |
uto tvasmai tanvaṃ vi sasre jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ ||
uta | tvaḥ | paśyan | na | dadarśa | vācam | uta | tvaḥ | śṛṇvan | na | śṛṇoti | enām | uto iti | tvasmai | tanvam | vi | sasre | jāyā'iva | patye | uśatī | suvāsāḥ || 4 ||
paśyan api manasā paryālocayannapi vācaṃva na dadarśa darśanaphalābhāvācca paśyati |
śṛṇvan api enāṃ vācaṃ na śṛṇoti śravaṇaphalābhāvāt |
tvasmai ekasmai api tanvam ātmīyaṃ śarīraṃ vi sasre svayaṃ vāgvividhaṃ gamayati |
jāyeva yathā uśatī saṃbhogaṃ kāmayamānā suvāsāḥ śobhanavasanā jāyā patye bhartṛ ṛtukānte saṃbhogārthaṃ svayamātmānaṃ vivṛṇute |
tadvadenāṃ paśyati śṛṇoti ceti viditavedārthasya praśaṃsā |
'apyekaḥ paśyan paśyati vācam' (niru. 1. 19) ityādi niruktamatra draṣṭavyam ||
uta tvaṃ sakhye sthirapītamāhurnainaṃ hinvantyapi vājineṣu |
adhenvā carati māyayaiṣa vācaṃ śuśruvā~ aphalāmapuṣpām ||
uta | tvam | sakhye | sthira'pītam | āhuḥ | na | enam | hinvanti | api | vājineṣu | adhenvā | carati | māyayā | eṣaḥ | vācam | śuśruvān | aphalām | apuṣpām || 5 ||
tvam uta ekamapi sakhye viduṣāṃ saṃsadi |
loke yathā jñātārthaṃ puruṣaṃ pītārthamiti vadanti |
vāk inā īśvarā yeṣāṃ te vājinā arthā vāca āyattāḥ khalu |
vājineṣu sārabhūteṣu nirūpaṇīyeṣvartheṣvenaṃ na hinvanti na bahiḥ kurvanti |
eṣaḥ avijñātārthaḥ puruṣaḥ adhenvā dhenutvavivarjitayā kāmanāṃ dogdhyā devamanuṣyasthāneṣu vākpratirūpayā māyayā carati |
yajñe bhavaṃ jñānaṃ yājñaṃ devatāsu bhavaṃ jñānaṃ daivatam |

yathā vandhyā pīnā gauḥ kiṃ droṇamātraṃ kṣīraṃ dogdhīti māyāmutpādayantī carati yathā vandhyo vṛkṣo'kāle palvādimuktaḥ san puṣyati phalatīti bhrāntimutpādayanstiṣṭhati tathā pāṭhaṃ prabhuvāṇaḥ caratītyarthaḥ |
yastityāja savidiṃ sakhāyaṃ na tasya vācyapi bhāgo asti |
yadi~ śṛṇotyalakaṃ śṛṇoti nahi praveda sukṛtasya panthām ||
ya: | tilyāja | saci'vidam | sakhāyam | na | tasya | vāca | api | bhāga: | asti | yat | īm | śṛṇoti | alakam | śṛṇoti | nahi | pra'veda | su'kṛtasya | panyām || 6 ||
yo'dhyetā sa vedasya sakhā saṃpradāyo- ccheda nivārakatvena vedaṃ pratyupakāritvāt |
tamabhinnaṃ ^sakhāyam adhyetṛṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ svārthabodhaneopakāritvāsakhibhūtaṃ vedaṃ ^ya: pumān ^tilyāja tathyāja parārthaviniyogena parityajati |
^tasya puruṣasya ^vāci sarvasyāṃ laukikyāṃ śāstrīyāṃ vācyapi ^bhāga: bhajanīya: kaścidartha: ^na ^asti |
^īm ayaṃ purupa: ^yat vedavyatiriktaṃ ^śṛṇoti tat ^alakam alīkaṃ vyarthameva ^śṛṇoti |
dvitīyacaturthapādayorabhiprāya āraṇyake darśita: ' na tasyānūkte bhāgo'sti ' ( ai. ā. 3. 2. 4 ) ityādinā |
tathā ' taṃ yo'ntsṛjyatyabhāgo vāci avaśyabhāgo nāke tadepābhyuktā ' ( tai. ā. 2. 15. 5 ) ityadhvaryubhiśca ||
ādaghnāsa upakakṣāsa u tve hṛdā iva snātvā u tve dadṛśre ||
akṣṇa'vantaḥ | karṇa'vantaḥ | sakhāya: | mana:'javeṣu | asamā: | vabhūvu: | ādaghnāsa: | upa'kakṣāsa: | u | tve | hṛdā'iva | snātvā | u | tve | dadṛśre ||7||

^akṣṇavantaḥ akṣimantaḥ | ' chandasyapi dṛśyate ' ityakṣiśabdādanaṅ | ' ano nuṭ ' iti nuṭ | anena dṛśyate sarvamityakṣi | yadvā | taijasatvāt anyebhyo'nyebhyo vyaktataram | tathā ca śrūyate—' tasmā- dete vyaktatare iva ' iti | nādṛśākṣiyuktā: | ^karṇavantaḥ | karṇau nikṛṣṭadvāra: | garbhāvasthāyāmeva kenāpi nirmitabila ityartha: | yadvā śarīrasya śiramo vodhaṃ gate uccai: sthite | karṇavilakṣaṇākāśa- vantaḥ | tathā cānāyate—' ṛcchantī iva khe udagantām ' iti | tādṛśā: ^sakhāya: | samānaṃ sthānaṃ jñānaṃ yeṣāmiti sakhāya: | teṣu vākyeṣu bāhyondriyepu samānajñānā ityartha: | te ^manojaveṣu | manasā gamyante jñāyanta iti manojavā: prajñāyā: | teṣu ^asamā: | atulyā: ^babhūvu: bhavanti | teṣu madhye kecit ^ādaghnāsa: | āsyaśabdasya pṛṣodarāditvādākārādeśa: | āsyadaghnā āsyapramāṇodakā hṛdā iti madhyamaprajñānāha | atha ^tve eke | sarvanāmatvāja: śībhāva: | ^upakakṣāsa: | kakṣasamīpa- pramāṇodakā hradā iva | alpodakā ityartha: | anenālpaprajñānāha | tathā ^tve eke ^stvā | jñāte: kṛtyārthe tvanpratyaya: ( pā. sū. 3.4.14 ) | sa ca ' arhe kṛtyatṛcaśca ' ( pā. sū. 3.2.169 ) ityahārthe ca bhavati | jñānāhā akṣobhyodakā: ^hṛdā iva ^dadṛśre dṛśyante | anena mahāprajñānāha | u: pūraṇa: | ' akṣimantaḥ karṇavantaḥ sakhāyo'kṣi cakṣe: ' ( niru. 1. 9 ) ityādi kaṃ niruktamatra draṣṭavyam ||
hudā tuṣṭeṣu manaso javeṣu yadbrāhmaṇā: saṃyajante sakhāya: |
atrāha tvaṃ vi jahurvedyābhirohabrahmāṇo vi carantyu tve ||
hudā | tuṣṭeṣu | manasa: | javeṣu | yat | brāhmaṇā: | sam'yajante | sakhāya: | atra | aha | tvam | vi | jahu: | vedyābhi: | oha'brahmāṇa: | vi | caranti | u | tve ||8||
^sakhāya: samānaruyānā: ^brāhmaṇā: ^hṛdā buddhimatāṃ hṛdayane ^taṣṭheṣu niściteṣu parikalpiteṣu ^manaso ^javeṣu gantavyeṣu vedārtheṣu guṇadoṣanirūpaṇā: ^yat ^yadā ^saṃyajante saṃgacchante |
^atra asmin brāhmaṇasaṃghe ^tvam avijñātārthamekaṃ puruṣaṃ ^vedyābhi: veditavyābhi: vidyābhi: pravṛttirbhirvā ^vi ^jahu: viśeṣeṇa parityajanti |
ūhamānaṃ brahma vidyāśrutisatibuddhilakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathoktā: |
tādṛśāsta eke vidvāṃsa: ^vi ^caranti yathākāmaṃ vedārtheṣu viniścayārtha pravartante |
‘hṛdā taṣṭheṣu manasāṃ prajaveṣu’ (niru. 13. 13) ityādirkaṃ niruktaṃ draṣṭavyam ||
ime ye nāvāḍ‌ga puraścaranti na brāhmaṇāso na sutekarāsa: |
ta ete vācamabhipardha pāparyā sirīstantraṃ tanvate apraṃjajñaya: ||
ime | ye | na | arvāk | na | pura: | caranti | na | brāhmaṇāsa: | na | sute'karāsa: | te | ete | vācam | abhi'pardha | pāparyā | sirī: | tantram | tanvate | apra'jajñaya: ||9||
^hame ^ye avidvāṃsa: ^arvāk arvācīnamadhobhāvinyasmiṃlloke brāhmaṇe: saha ^na ^caranti ye ^para: parastāt devai: saha ^na caranti te ^brāhmaṇāsa: brāhmaṇā: vedārthatatparā: ^na bhavanti |
avidvāṃsa: ^ta ^ete manuṣyā: ^vācaṃ laukikīm ^abhidhapa prāpya tayā ^pāpayā pāpakāriṇyā vācā yuktāste ^sirī: |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘soma yāste mayobhuva iti tisra: sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 4) iti ||
sarve nandanti yaśasāgatena sabhāsāhena sakhyā sakhāya: |
sarve | nandanti | yaśasā | ā'gatena | sabhā'sahena | sakhyā | sakhāya: | kilbiṣa'spṛt | pitu'sani: | hi | eṣām | aram | hita: | bhavati | vājināya ||10||

^sakhāya: samānaruyānā: samānajñānā: ^sarve sabhyā manuṣyā: ^sabhāsahena^ sabhāṃ soḍhuṃ śakuvatā ^sakhyā ṛtvijāṃ sakhibhūtena yajñaṃ prati ^āgatena ^yaśasā yaśasvinā somena hetunā ^nandanti hṛṣṭā bhavanti |
ya: svasmādanya: puruṣa: śreṣṭhāmaśnute^ sa kilbiṣaṃ bhavati bādhyatvena |
yathā pāpaṃ sadācārai: bādhitavyaṃ^ bhavati tadvat |
yajñe sādhvanupravacanākaraṇena yatkilbiṣameṣāṃ jāyate tadyo^ bādhate sa kilbiṣaspṛt |

1. ta-bha-mu-yathā | 2. ga-bha-mu-saṃgatakaraṇavācī | 3. ga4-ta1.2.4.6.8-jñāte: | 4. ga4-ta1. 2.3.6.7.8-bha-mu-somapravaṇe; ta4-somapravāhaṇe; ta5-somapravāhā | 5. ga4-ta-bhara.6.8-mu-sabhā- sāhena | 6. ga4-ya: śreṣṭhavamaśrute; ta-bha-ya: śreṣṭhāmaśrute | 7. ga-bādhitaṃ | 8. ga-ta-bha-taṃ yo |
kiṃca hitaḥ pātreṣu nihitaḥ somaḥ vājināya |
teṣāṃ vīryāya tatkartum aram alaṃ paryāptaḥ samartho bhavati |
‘sarve nandanti yaśasāgatenetyanvāha yaśo vai somo rājā’ ityādikam ‘indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ vājinamajarasaṃ hāsmai vājinaṃ nāpacchidyate’ ityantaṃ brāhmaṇamatrānusaṃdheyam (ai. brā. 1. 12) ||
ṛcāṃ tvaḥ poṣamāste pupuṣvān gāyatraṃ tvo gāyati śakvarīṣu |
brahmā tvo vadati jātavidyāṃ yajñasya mātrāṃ vi mimīta u tvaḥ ||
ṛcām | tvaḥ | poṣam | āste | pupuṣvān | gāyatram | tvaḥ | gāyati | śakvarīṣu | brahmā | tvaḥ | vadati | jāta'vidyām | yajñasya | mātrāṃm | vi | mimīte | ūṃ iti | tvaḥ || 11 ||
tvaḥ eko hotā ṛcāṃ poṣaṃ yathāvidhi karmaṇi prayogaṃ pupuṣvān |
tvaḥ ekaḥ brahmā ca jātavidyāṃ jāte jāte kartavye prāyaścittādau vedadhiyaṃ vācaṃ vadati |
brahmā hi sarvaṃ vedituṃ yogyo bhavati khalu |
tvaḥ eko'dhvaryuśca yajñasya mātrāṃ yajñā yā miyate'dhipavagrahaṇādikayā kriyayā tāṃ mātrāṃ yajñaśarīraṃ vi mimīte atyarthaṃ nirmimīte |
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukkabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdharasāyaṇācārya- viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśa ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye'ṣṭamāṣṭake dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra ‘devānām’ iti navarcamanuvākāpekṣayā caturthaṃ sūktamānuṣṭubhaṃ devadaivatyam |
lokanānnaḥ putro bṛhaspatirāṅgirasa eva vā bṛhaspatirṛṣiḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘devānāṃ nava laukyo vā bṛhaspatirdākṣāyaṇyaditirvā daivānuṣṭubham’ iti |
devānāṃ nu vayaṃ jānā pra vocāma vipannayā |
devānāṃ | nu | vayam | jānāṃ | pra | vocāma | vipanyā | ukthepu | śasyamāneṣu | yaḥ | paśyāt | ut'tare | yuge || 1 ||
ᵥvayaṃ ᵥdevānām ādityānāṃ ᵥjānā janmāni ᵥpra ᵥvocāma prakathayāma |
ᵥyaḥ devānāṃ gaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ yuga utpanno'pi ᵥukthepu ᵥśasyamāneṣu yāge śastreṣvanuṣṭhīya- māneṣu ᵥuttare ᵥyuge vartamānaṃ stuvantaṃ stotāraṃ ᵥpaśyāt paśyati |
anekeṣvapi yugeṣu gateṣu karmasu stūyamānoᵥ vartata ityarthaḥ ||
na svotpannaṃ kāryaṃ svasyaiva kāraṇamapi bhavatīti vipratipinnamiti vācyam |
tathā hi—‘aditerdakṣo ajāyata dakṣādaditiḥ parīti ca |
tarakathamupa- payeta samānajanmānau syātāmityapi vā devadharmeṇetaretarajanmānau syātāmitaretaraprakṛtī’ (niru. 11. 23) iti ||
sutritaṃ ca—‘aditirha- janiṣṭa sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dhāmanehasam’ (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti ||
aditiḥ | hi | arjaniṣṭa | dakṣaḥ | yā | duhitā | tarva | tām | devāḥ | anu | ajāyanta | bhadrāḥ | amṛta'bandhavaḥ || 5 ||
he vdakṣa vtava vyā vduhitā abhūta sā vaditiḥ vajaniṣṭa vhi putrānādityān |
vtāṃ vdevāḥ vanvajāyanta vbhadrāḥ stutyā bhajanīyāḥ vamṛtabandhavaḥ amaraṇa- bandhanāḥ ||
yat | devāḥ | adaḥ | salile | su'sa~rabdhāḥ | atiṣṭhata | atra | vaḥ | nṛtyatām'iva | tīvraḥ | reṇuḥ | apa | āyata || 6 ||
vyat yadā he vdevāḥ vadaḥ amuṣmin vsalile yūyaṃ vsusa~rabdhāḥ suṣṭhu labdhātmānaḥ vatiṣṭhata sthitavantaḥ |
‘āpo vā idaṃ sarvam’ (tai. ā. 10. 22) ‘apa eva sasarjādau’ (manu. 1. 8) iti śrutismṛtī |
vatra asmin salile vnṛtyatāmiva vvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ saṃbandhī vtīvraḥ duḥsahaḥ vreṇuḥ aṃśabhūta ekaḥ vapāyata apāgacchat |
yat | devāḥ | yatayaḥ | yathā | bhuvanāni | apinvata | atra | samudre | ā | gūḻaham | ā | sūryam | ajabhartana || 7 ||
1. ta-bha-bhūriti uttānapado | 2. ga1-māmeva; gara-ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ma-amumeva | 3. ga-ta-bhara. 4.1.8-samānadharmāṇau | 4. ga-ta-mu-yā tava |
yat yadā he devāḥ yatayo yathā|
vṛṣṭyā niyamayantīti vā varṣaṇaina yātayantīti vā yatayo meghāḥ|
te yathodakaiḥ bhuvanāni lokaṃ pūyanti tadvatsvatejobhiḥ āpinvanta pūritavantaḥ|
atra samudre apsu ā gūḻahaṃ nigūḻahaṃ sūrya prātarudayāya ā ajabhartana āhatavantaḥ||
aṣṭau| putrāsaḥ| aditaye| ye| jātāḥ| tanvaḥ| pari| devān| upa| pra| ait| saptabhiḥ| parā| mārtāṇḍam| āsyat || 8 ||
aṣṭau putrāsaḥ putrā mitrādayaḥ aditaye bhavanti ye aditaye tanvaspari śarīrāt jātāḥ utpannāḥ|
tathā hi—‘tānanukramiṣyāmo mitraśca varuṇaśca dhātā cāyamā cāṃśaśca bhagaśca vivasvānādityaśca’ (tai. ā. 1. 13. 3) iti|

tathā tatraiva pradeśāntare'diti prastutyāmnātaṃ—‘tasyā ucchreṣaṇamadadustatpaścāt sā reto'dhatta tasyai catvāra ādityā ajāyanta sā dvitīyamapacat’ ityādināṣṭānāmādityānāmutpattirvarṇitā (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 6. 1)|

harva eṣāmasuro nakṣata dyāṃ śravasyatā manasā nisat kṣām | kṣoṇā yatra suvitārya devā dhyaurna vārebhiḥ kuṇvantu svaiḥ || 2 || harvaḥ | eṣām | asuraḥ | nakṣata | dyām | śravasyatā | manasā | nisat | kṣām | kṣoṇāḥ | yatra | suvitārya | devāḥ | dhyauḥ | na | vārebhiḥ | kuṇvantu | svaiḥ || 2 || eṣām anuṣṭhātṛṇāmaṅgirasāṃ harvaḥ āhvānaśabdaḥ | asuraḥ indrasya prerakaḥ | dyāṃ divaṃ nakṣata vyāpnot | tatratyā indrasambandhino devāḥ śravasyatā annamicchatā manasā kṣāṃ pṛthivīṃ nisat prāsavanta | yatra yasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kṣoṇāḥ paṇibhirapahatā gāḥ paśyantaḥ devāḥ suvitārya suṣṭhu hitāya svātmano'bhyudayāya caurna āditya iva vārebhiḥ varaṇīyaiḥ havaiḥ tejobhiḥ kuṇvanta prakāśamakurvan | gavāṃ pradānāndhakāramapanetumiti śeṣaḥ | athavā | eṣāṃ yajvanāmapahatānāṃ gavāṃ havo'sura indrasya prerayitā sannakṣata | indrapreritā aṅgirasaḥ śravasyatā annaṃ kīrti vecchatā manasā kṣāṃ bhūmiṃ nisat | anuṣṭhātṛṇāṃ gāḥ pradarśayitumityarthaḥ | itarassāmānam ||

atra pradhānabhūtāḥ sapta nadyastadavayavabhūtā nadyastisraḥ stūyante |
he ᵥgaṅge he ᵥyamune he ᵥsarasvati he ᵥśutudri he ᵥparuṣṇi |
he ᵥasikanyā avayavabhūtayā sahite ᵥmarudvṛdhe he ᵥvitastayā ᵥsuṣomayā ca sahite ᵥārjīkīye tvaṃ ca evaṃ sapta nadyo yūyaṃ ᵥme ᵥstomaṃ stotramasmadīyam ᵥā ᵥsacata āsevadhvam |
ārjakīyāyā vitastayā supomayā ca sāhityaṃ nirukta uktaṃ—‘vitastayā cārjīkīya ā śṛṇuhi supomayā ca’ iti |
tuṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ sustarvā rasā śvetyā tyā |
tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ kumuṃ mehattvā sarathaṃ yābhirīyase ||
tuṣṭa'amayā | prathamam | yātave | sajūḥ | su'starvā | rasā | śvetyā | tyā | tvam | sindho iti | kubhayā | go'matīm | kumum | mehattvā | sa'ratham | yābhiḥ | īyase ||6||
he ᵥsindho ᵥtvaṃ ᵥkumuṃ kramaṇaśīlāṃ ᵥgomatīṃ nadīṃ ᵥyātave pratiyātuṃ parvatādavarūḍhā ᵥprathamaṃ ᵥtuṣṭāmayā nadyā ᵥsajūḥ saṃgatāsi |
paścāt ᵥsustarvā ᵥrasā ᵥśvetyā ᵥtyā ᵥkubhayā ᵥmehattvā ca saha sajūrbhava ᵥyābhiḥ tvaṃ ᵥsarathaṃ samānaṃ rathamāruhya ᵥīyase gacchasi ||
ṛjītyenī ruśatī mahitvā pari jyāyauṃsi bharate rajāṃsi |
adabdhā sindhūrapasāmapastamāśvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā ||
ṛjītī | enī | ruśatī | mahi'tvā | pari | jyāyauṃsi | bharate | rajāṃsi | adabdhā | sindhuḥ | apasām | apaḥ'tamā | aśvā | na | citrā | vapuṣī'iva | darśatā ||7||
ᵥṛjītī ṛjugāminī ᵥenī śvetavarṇā ᵥruśatī dīpyamānā sindhuḥ ᵥjyāyauṃsi vegavanti ᵥrajāṃsi udakāni ᵥpari ᵥbharate prabharati |
tādṛśī ᵥadabdhā ahiṃsitā ᵥsindhuḥ ᵥapasāṃ karmavatīnāṃ madhye ᵥapastamā vegākhyakarmavatī bhavati |
ᵥaśvā ᵥna vaḍaveva ᵥcitrā cāyanīyā ᵥvapuṣī vapuṣmatī yoṣit ᵥiva ᵥdarśatā darśanīyā bhavati ||

svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī | ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatyutādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham || 8 || su'aśvā | sindhuḥ | su'rathā | su'vāsāḥ | hiraṇyayī | su'kṛtā | vājinī'vatī | ūrṇā'vatī | yuvatiḥ | sīlamā'vatī | uta | adhi | vaste | su'bhagā | madhu'vṛdham || 8 ||
seyaṃ ᐯsindhuḥ ᐯsvaśvā śobhanāśopetā ᐯsurathā śobhanarathā ᐯsuvāsāḥ śobhanavasanā ᐯhiraṇyayī hiraṇmayābharaṇā ᐯsukṛtā ᐯvājinīvatī annavatī ᐯūrṇāvatī |
tasyāḥ samīpe deśe hi santyūrṇāḥ yāsāṃ romabhiḥ kambālāḥ kriyante |
sīrāṇi yayaupadhyā rajjubhūtayā badhyante sā sīlameti nigadyate kṛṣīvalaiḥ |
ᐯuta api ca ᐯsubhagā sindhuḥ ᐯmadhuvṛdhaṃ madhuvardhakaṃ nirguṇḍayādikam ᐯadhi ᐯvaste ācchādayati |

sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhuraśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ sanipadasminnājau | mahān hyasya mahimā panasyate'dabdhasya svaryaśaso virapśinaḥ || 9 || su'kham | ratham | yuyuje | sindhuḥ | aśvinam | tena | vājam | sanipat | asmin | ājau | mahān | hi | asya | mahimā | panasyate | adabdhasya | svaryaśasaḥ | virapśinaḥ || 9 ||
ᐯsindhuḥ devatā ᐯsukhaṃ sukhakaraṃ śobhanadvāraṃ vā ᐯaśvinam aśvavantaṃ ᐯrathaṃ ᐯyuyuje yunakti |
ᐯtena rathena ᐯvājam annaṃ ᐯsanipat prayacchatu |
ᐯasminnājau saṃgrāme yajñe vā ᐯasya sindhurathasya ᐯmahimā ᐯmahān hi ᐯpanasyate stūyate |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘ā vo'ṣṭau sarpa airāvato jaratkarṇo grāvṇo'stau’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā va ṛñse pra vo grāvāṇa iti sūktayorantaropariṣṭātpurastādvā’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 12) iti ||

ā va ṛñse ūrjā vyuṣṭiṣvindraṃ maruto rodasī anaktana | ubhe yathā no ahanī sacābhuvā sardaḥsadaḥ varivasyāta ujjidā || 1 || ā | vaḥ | ṛñse | ūrjam | vi'uṣṭiṣu | indram | marutaḥ | rodasī iti | anaktana | ubhe iti | yathā | naḥ | ahanī iti | sacā'bhuvā | sardaḥ'sadaḥ | varivasyātaḥ | ut'jidā || 1 ||
he grāvāṇaḥ ᐯvaḥ yuṣmān ᐯūrjā sārabhūtānāmannavatīnāṃ vopasāṃ ᐯvyuṣṭiṣu vibhāteṣu2 satsu ᐯā ᐯṛñse āprāsādhayāmi |
yūyaṃ somena ᐯindraṃ ᐯmaruto ᐯrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ca ᐯanaktana vyañjayata |
ᐯnaḥ asmān ᐯubhe ᐯsacābhuvā sahotpanne3 ᐯahanī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᐯsadaḥsadaḥ sarveṣu yāgagṛheṣu ᐯvarivasyātaḥ paricarataḥ |

tadu śreṣṭhaṃ sarvataṃ sunotanātyo na hastayato adriḥ| sotariṃ| vidadvayo abhibhūti pausyaṃ maho rāye cittarute yadarvataḥ|| 2|| tat| ū~ iti| śreṣṭham| sarvatam| sunotana| atyaḥ| na| hasta'yataḥ| adriḥ| sotari| vidat| hi| aryaḥ| abhi'bhūti| pausyam| mahaḥ| rāye| cit| tarute| yat| arvataḥ||2||
he grāvāṇaḥ yūyaṃ tadu tameva śreṣṭhaṃ praśastaṃ savanaṃ somaṃ sunotana abhipuṇuta|
adriḥ abhiṣavagrāvā hastayataḥ hastābhyāṃ gṛhītaḥ san asyo na dhṛto'śva iva bhavati sotari abhiṣavakartaryadhvaryau|
sa yathā hastābhyāṃ dṛḍhaṃ gṛhīto'pi valgati tadvat|
ayaṃḥ grāvṇāmabhiṣavāya preraka yajamānaḥ abhibhūti śatrūṇāmabhibhāvukaṃ pausyaṃ balaṃ vidadvi labhate khalu devebhyaḥ|
kiṃca mahe mahate rāye cit dhanāyāpi yat yo grāvā arvataḥ aśvān tarute tanute prayacchati|

tadidvaryasya sarvataṃ viverapo yathā purā manave gātumaśrait| go'rṇasi tvāṣṭre aśvaṃnirniniji premadhvareṣvadhvarau aśiśrayuḥ|| 3|| tat| it| hi| asya| sarvatam| viveḥ| apaḥ| yathā| purā| manave| gātum| aśrait| go'rṇasi| tvāṣṭre| aśvaṃ'nirniniji| pra| īm| adhvareṣu| adhvaran| aśiśrayuḥ|| 3||
asya grāvṇaḥ tat savanam abhiṣavopetamasmadīyaṃ somagāthākhyam apaḥ karma viveḥ vyāpnotu|
vetervipūrvasya vā chāndase ślau vāpararūpamiti saṃdehadanavagrahaḥ|
yathā purā manave rāje gātuṃ gamanam aśrait ājagāma tadvat vyāpnotu|
kiṃca go'rṇasi gorupe apahatairgobhiḥ parivṛte tathā aśvanirniniji|
īdṛśe tvāṣṭre tvaṣṭuḥ putre hantavye satīti doṣaḥ|
īm etān adhvarān asurairahisthānadhvarasādhakān vopalān adhvareṣu aśiśrayuḥ āśrayanti pūrve yajamānāḥ|

arpa hata rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ skabhāyat nirṛtiṃ sedhatāmatim| ā nau rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ sunotana devyaṃ bharata ślokamadrayaḥ|| 4|| arpa| hata| rakṣasaḥ| bhaṅgura'vataḥ| skabhāyate| niḥ'ṛtim| sedhata| amatim| ā| naḥ| rayim| sarva'vīram| sunotana| deva'avya| bharata| ślokam| adrayaḥ||4||
he adrayaḥ yūyam apa hata vināśayata rakṣasaḥ rākṣasān|
tathā skabhāyata dūre pariharata nirṛtiṃ pāpadevatām|
kiṃca sedhata niṣedhata amarti hiṃsāmarti rakṣaḥprabhṛtim|
kiṃca naḥ asmākaṃ sarvavīraṃ bahuputrādyupetaṃ rayiṃ dhanam ā sunotana|
kiṃca devāvyaṃ devaprītanaṃ ślokaṃ bharata saṃpādayata|

1. ta-tadeva| 2. bha-abhiṣavāyādhvarvādyaḥ| 3. ga-ta1.2.3.4.5.7-bhara-prerayitā; ta6.8-bha1. 4.6-preritā| 4. ta-bha-tat| 5. ta6.8-bha- ' kiṃca ... ... rakṣaḥprabhṛti ' nāsti| 6. ga- ślokaṃ śabda he adrayaḥ|
divaḥ | cit | ā | vaḥ | amavat'tarebhyaḥ | vi'vanā | cit | aśvapaḥ'tarebhyaḥ | vāyoḥ | cit | ā | somarbhaḥ'tarebhyaḥ | agneḥ | cit | arca | pitukṛt'tarebhyaḥ ||5||
he adhvarvādayaḥ vo yūyamucyamānalakṣaṇebhyo grāvabhya ā sarvato'rcaṃtetyevaṃ prativākyaṃ yojyam |
bhurantu no yaśasaḥ sotvandhaso grāvāṇo vācā divitā divitmatā |
naro yatra duhate kāmyaṃ madhvāghoṣayanto abhito mithasturaḥ ||
bhurantu | naḥ | yaśasaḥ | sotu | andhasaḥ | grāvāṇaḥ | vācā | divitā | divitmatā | naraḥ | yatra | duhate | kāmyam | madhu | ā'ghoṣayantaḥ | abhitaḥ | mithaḥ'turaḥ || 6 ||
^yaśasaḥ yaśasvinaḥ ^grāvāṇaḥ ^naḥ asmabhyaṃ ^sotu sutam ^andhasaḥ somasya rasaṃ ^bhurantu bharantu saṃpādayantu |
sunvanti somaṃ rathirāso adrayo nirasya rasaṃ guviṣo duhanti te |
duhantyudhupasecanāya kaṃ narau huvyā na marjayanta āsabhiḥ ||
sunvanti | somam | rathirāsaḥ | adrayaḥ | ni | asya | rasam | go'īṣaḥ | duhanti | te | duhanti | ūdhaḥ | upa'secanāya | kam | narau | huvyā | na | marjayante | āsa'bhiḥ ||7||
^naraḥ netāro'bhipavakatāraṃ ṛtvijaḥ ^huvyā ^na havīṃṣi cānyupasecanānantaram ^āsabhiḥ svāsyaiḥ ^marjayante śodhayanti |

ete nara̭: sva॒rpaso̭ a॒bhūta̭na॒ ya indra̭āya su॒nutha॒ soma̭ma॒draya̭: | vā॒maṃvā̭maṃ vo di॒vyāya॒ dhāmne॒ vasṷvasa॒ va: pā॒rthivāya̭ su॒nvatḙ || 8 || ete | nara̭: | su'a̭rpasa: | a॒bhūta̭na | ye | indra̭āya | su॒nutha̭ | soma̭m | a॒draya̭: | vā॒mam'vā̭mam | va: | di॒vyāya̭ | dhāmnḙ | vasṷ'vasa॒ | va: | pā॒rthivāya̭ | su॒nvatḙ || 8 ||
he nara̭: netāra: he adraya: ete yūyaṃ svapaso'bhūtana śobhanābhiṣavakarmaṇo bhavata |
ye yūyam indrāya somaṃ sunutha va: yūyaṃ vāmaṃvāmaṃ yadyaddnīyaṃ dhanamasti tattat divyāya dhāmne tejase kuruta |
tathā vasuvasu yadyadvāsayogyaṃ dhanamasti tat va: yūyaṃ pārthivāya sunvate yajamānāya kuruta ||
'aśrapruṣa:' ityaṣṭacaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ bhṛgugotrasya syūmaraśmerāṣaṃ marudevatākam |
tathā cānukrāntam- 'aśrapruṣa: syūmaraśmirbhāṃgavato mārutaṃ tu pañcamī jagatī' iti |

a॒śraprṷṣo na vā॒cā prḙṣā vasṷ ha॒viṣma̭nto na ya॒jñā vi̭jānu॒ṣa: | su॒mā॒ru॒taṃ na bra॒hmāṇa̭marha̭se ga॒ṇama̭sto॒ṣyeṣā̭ṃ na śobhase || 1 || a॒śra'prṷṣa: | na | vā॒cā | prḙṣā | vasṷ | ha॒viṣma̭ntaḥ | na | ya॒jñā: | vi'jā̭nu॒ṣa: | su'mā̭rutam | na | bra॒hmāṇa̭m | arha̭se | ga॒ṇam | a॒sto॒ṣyḙṣām | na | śobha̭se || 1 ||
'aśrapruṣo na meghāścirgacchanta udakabindava iva vācā stutyā prītā maruta: vasu dhanaṃ pṛṣa siñcanti |
kiṃca haviṣmanto na yajñā: havirbhiryuktā yāgā iva vijānupa: jagato vijanayitārau bhavanti |
teṣām eṣāṃ sumārutaṃ śobhanānāṃ marutāṃ brahmāṇaṃ mahāntaṃ gaṇam arhase pūjārthaṃ na astoṣi nāstauṣam |
tathā śobhase śobhārthamapi mārutaṃ gaṇaṃ na astoṣi |

śri॒ye ma॒ryāso̭ a॒ñjī̭rakṛṇvata su॒mā॒ru॒taṃ na pū॒rvīri̭ti kṣapa̭: | di॒vaspṷtrāsa e॒tā na yḙti॒ra ā̭di॒tyāsa̭ste a॒krā na vā̭vṛdhu: || 2 || śri॒ye | ma॒ryāsa̭: | a॒ñjī̭n | a॒kṛ॒ṇvata̭ | su'mā̭rutam | na | pū॒rvī: | a॒ti̭ | kṣapa̭: | di॒va: | pu॒trāsa̭: | e॒tā: | na | yḙti॒re | ā̭di॒tyāsa̭: | te | a॒krā: | na | va॒vṛ॒dhu: || 2 ||
'śriye śobhārthaṃ maryāsa: mārakā manuṣyarūpā vā maruta: |
pūrvaṃ manuṣyā: santaḥ paścātsukṛta- viśeṣeṇa amarā āsan |
sumārutaṃ śobhanānāṃ marutāṃ gaṇaṃ pūrvī: bahvya: kṣapa: kṣapayiṣya: senā: na ati na parābhāvayantīti śeṣa: |
kiṃca diva: ghudevatāyā: putrāsa: putrā: etā: gantāra: na yetire nirgacchanti |
te ādityāsa: adita: putrā: akrā: ākramaṇaśīlā maruta: na vāvṛdhu: na vardhante |
1. ga-ta-bha-sumārutaṃ na | 2. ga-ta4.5-śobhanārtha | 3. ga4-śobhārtha | 4. ta-bha-tai sumāruta |

pra ye divaḥ pṛthivyā na barhaṇā tmanā ririce abhrāt na sūryaḥ | pārjasvanto na vīrāḥ panasyavo riśadasaḥ na maryāḥ abhidharvaḥ || 3 || pra | ye | divaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | na | barhaṇā | tmanā | ririce | abhrāt | na | sūryaḥ | pārjasvantaḥ | na | vīrāḥ | panasyavaḥ | riśadasaḥ | na | maryāḥ | abhidharvaḥ || 3 || ye marutaḥ divaḥ pṛthivyā na pṛthivyāśca | neti cārthe | barhaṇā mahattvena tmanā ātmanaiva ririce riricire atiriktā abhavan svaśarīreṇa abhrāt abhrādiva sūryaḥ | kiṃca pārjasvanto na vīrāḥ balavanto vīrā iva panasyavaḥ stutikāmā bhavanti | kiṃca riśadasaḥ na maryāḥ riśatāmasitāro manuṣyā iva abhidharvaḥ abhigatadīptayo bhavanti ||

yuṣmākaṃ budhe apāṃ na yāmani vithuryati na mahī śratharyati | viśvapsuryajño arvāgayaṃ su vaḥ prayasvanto na satrāca ā gata || 4 || yuṣmākam | budhe | apām | na | yāmani | vithuryati | na | mahī | śratharyati | viśvapsuḥ | yajñaḥ | arvāk | ayam | su | vaḥ | prayasvantaḥ | na | satrācaḥ | ā | gata || 4 || he marutaḥ yuṣmākaṃ budhe parasparasaṃghāte apāṃ na yāmani pravṛddhānāmudakānāṃ gamana iva mahī mahatī bhūḥ na vithuryati na vyathate | nāpi śratharyati na viśīrṇā bhavati | śīghragatayo'pi yūyamenāṃ na pīḍayadhvamityarthaḥ | viśvapsuḥ viśvarūpaḥ ayaṃ yajñaḥ yāgasādhanaṃ haviḥ vaḥ yuṣmākam arvāk abhimukhaṃ su suṣṭhu gacchati | prayasvanto na aśnavantaḥ parikartāra iva sukhapradāḥ santaḥ satrācaḥ sahāñcanāḥ ā gata āgacchata | saṃghākāreṇāgacchatetyarthaḥ | ' sasagaṇā vai marutaḥ ' ( tai. saṃ. 2. 2. 5. 7 ) iti śruteḥ ||

yūyaṃ dhṛṣu prayujo na raśmibhirjyotiṣmanto na bhāsā vyūṣṭiṣu | śyenāso na svayaśaso riśadasaḥ pravāso na prasinatāḥ parimṛṣaḥ || 5 || yūyam | dhṛḥsu | pra'yujaḥ | na | raśmibhiḥ | jyotiṣmantaḥ | na | bhāsā | vi'uṣṭiṣu | śyenāsaḥ | na | sva'yaśasaḥ | riśadasaḥ | pravāsaḥ | na | pra'sitāsaḥ | pari'mṛṣaḥ || 5 || he marutaḥ yūyaṃ dhṛṣv rathasambandhinīṣu raśmibhiḥ yoktraiḥ prayujaḥ prayuktā baddhā aśvā iva parimṛṣaḥ parito gantāraḥ stha | tathā jyotiṣmanto na tejasvanta ādityādaya iva bhāsā yuktā bhavatha vyūṣṭiṣu uṣaḥsūditāsu | kiṃca śyenāso na śyenā iva svayaśasaḥ svāyattayaśasaḥ te yathā riśadasaḥ riśatāmasitārastadvadriśadasaḥ svāyattayaśasaśca | kiṃca pravāso na pravāsina iva pathikā iva prasitāsaḥ prasiddhānāḥ | uktarūpā marutaḥ parimṛpaḥ parito gantāro bhavatha || 10 ||
pra yadhve marutaḥ parākādyaṃ muhaḥ saṃvaraṇasya vasvaḥ |

pra | yat | vaha̭dhve | ma॒rutaḥ | pa॒rākā̭t | yūyam | ma॒haḥ | sum'va̭raṇasya | va॒svaḥ | vi॒dānā̭saḥ | va॒sava̭ḥ | rā॒dhyasya̭ | ā॒rāt | ci॒t | dveṣa̭ḥ | su॒nuta̭ḥ | yu॒yota || 6 || he ma॒haḥ | yūya̭ṃ yat yadā | pa॒rākā̭t atyantaṃ dūradeśāt | vaha̭dhve āgacchatha tadānīṃ ma॒haḥ mahat saṃvarasya saṃvaraṇīyaṃ rādhyasya saṃrādhanīyaṃ va॒svaḥ vasu dhanaṃ vi॒dānāsaḥ prayacchanto he va॒savaḥ yūyam ā॒rāccit dūrādeva yu॒yota pṛthakuruta | kānīti ucyate | dveṣaḥ dveṣan | kīdṛśān | su॒nutaḥ antarhitān | nigṛḍhānityarthaḥ | sanutarityantarhitanāma ||

ya u॒dvāci̭ ya॒jñe a̭dhva॒reṣṭhā̭ ma॒rudbhi̭yo na mā॒nuṣo̭ dadā॒śat | re॒vatsa va॒yo da̭dhate su॒vīra̭ṃ sa de॒vānā̭mapi go॒pīthḙ astu || 7 || yaḥ | u॒t'arci̭ | ya॒jñe | a॒dhva॒re'sthāḥ | ma॒rut'bhyaḥ | na | mā॒nuṣaḥ | dadā॒śat | re॒vat | saḥ | va॒yaḥ | da॒dhate | su॒'vīra̭m | saḥ | de॒vānā̭m | a॒pi | go॒'pīthḙ | astu ||7|| adhvareṣṭhāḥ yāge sīdan mānuṣaḥ yaḥ yajamānaḥ yajñe udarci sati | ṛkṣandena stotra- mupalakṣyate | yajñe samāsastutike sati saṃpūrṇe sati marudbhayo na marudbhya ivānyepā madhvaryubhyaḥ ṛtvigādibhyaḥ dadāśat dadyāt | yadvā yajña udacyupakrānta ityarthaḥ | tasmin yajñe marudbhya ivānyasmai indrāya dadāśat dadāti | saḥ yajamānaḥ revat dhanavat suvīraṃ śobhanaputrādyupetaṃ vayaḥ annaṃ dadhate dhārayati | vyatyayenaikavacanam | sa devānām indrādīnām api gopīthe somapāne astu bhavatu ||

te hi ya॒jñeṣṷ ya॒jñiyā̭sa ū॒mā ā̭di॒tyena॒ nāmnā॒ śaṃbha̭viṣṭhāḥ | te naṷ'vantu ratha॒tūrya̭ṇīpāṃ ma॒haśca॒ yāma̭nnadhva॒re ca̭kānāḥ || 8 || te | hi | ya॒jñeṣṷ | ya॒jñiyā̭saḥ | ū॒māḥ | ā॒di॒tyena̭ | nāmnā̭ | śam'bha̭viṣṭhāḥ | te | naḥ | a॒va॒ntu | ratha̭'tūḥ | ma॒nīpā̭m | ma॒haḥ | ca | yāma̭n | a॒dhva॒re | ca॒kānāḥ || 8 || te hi te khalu yajñeṣu yāgeṣu yajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhā yaṣṭavyāḥ ūmāḥ avitāraḥ ādityena nāmnā ādityasambandhinodakena śaṃbhaviṣṭhāḥ sukhasya bhāvayitāraḥ | yadvā | ādityākhyena nāmnāditya- nāmakena devena saha śaṃbhaviṣṭhāḥ | te marutaḥ naḥ asmān avantu | rathatūḥ rathaturo rathasya yajña- gamanasādhanasya tvarayitāraḥ santaḥ manīpāṃ stutimavantu rakṣantu | kīdṛśāste | adhvare yāman yāgamane mahaḥ mahadbhiḥ cakānāḥ kāmayamānāḥ ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘viprāso dvitīyā pañcamyādyāśca tisro jagatyaḥ’ iti |
vi॒prāso̭ na ma॒nmabhi̭ḥ svā॒dhyo̭ de॒vyo̭ na ya॒jñaiḥ sva॒rmasa̭ḥ |
rā॒jāno̭ na ci॒trāḥ su॒saṃdṛśa̭ḥ kṣitī॒nāṃ na ma॒ryā a̭re॒pasa̭ḥ ||
viprāsaḥ | na | manma'bhiḥ | su'ādhyaḥ | de va'avyaḥ | na | yajñaiḥ | su'apsasaḥ | rājānaḥ | na | citrāḥ | su'saṃdṛśaḥ | kṣitīnām | na | maryauḥ | arepasaḥ || 1 ||
ᵥviprāso ᵥna viprā brāhmaṇā iva te yathā ᵥmanmabhiḥ stutibhiḥ ᵥsvādhyaḥ śobhanādhyānā bhavanti evaṃ ᵥmaruto'pyasmadīyairmanmabhirmananīyaiḥ stotraiḥ svādhyaḥ sumanaso bhavanti |
manmabhiḥ stotrairyuktā viprāso na medhāvinaḥ stotāra iva svādhyo yajñe yajamāne vā sudhyānā ityarthaḥ |
tathā ᵥyajñaiḥ yāgaiḥ ᵥdevākhyo ᵥna devānāṃ tarpayitāro yajamānā iva ᵥsvamasaḥ |
te yathā karmasu vyāpṛtā bhavanti tadvadvṛṣṭipradānādikarmasu vyāpṛtā ityarthaḥ |
ᵥrājāno ᵥna mūrdhābhiṣiktāḥ kṣitipataya iva ᵥcitrāḥ cāyanīyāḥ |
tathā ᵥkṣitīnāṃ nivāsānāṃ svāminaḥ ᵥmaryauḥ ᵥna manuṣyā iva ᵥarepasaḥ apāpāḥ |
yathā pratigrahādhamanyatrāgatvā svagṛhe evānutiṣṭhanto nirdoṣā bhavanti tādṛśā ityarthaḥ |

agniṃ ye ārjasā rukmavakṣaso vātāso na svayujaḥ sadyaūtayaḥ | prajñātāro na jyeṣṭhāḥ sunītayaḥ suśarmāṇo na somā ṛtaṃ yate || 2 || agniḥ | na | ye | ārjasā | rukma'vakṣasaḥ | vātāsaḥ | na | sva'yujaḥ | sadyaḥ'ūtayaḥ | pra'jñātāraḥ | na | jyeṣṭhāḥ | su'nītayaḥ | su'śarmāṇaḥ | na | somāḥ | ṛtam | yate || 2 ||

he marutaḥ ᵥagniṃ agniriva sa ᵥyathā ᵥārjasā tejasā śobhate tadvārājasā yuktāḥ kiṃca ᵥrukmavakṣasaḥ rukmālaṃkṛtavakṣaskāḥ ᵥvātāso ᵥna pratyakṣavātā iva ᵥsvayujaḥ svayaṃ ᵥyujyamānāḥ ᵥsadyaūtayaḥ sadyogamanāḥ ᵥprajñātāro ᵥna prakarṣeṇa jñātāro jñānina iva ᵥjyeṣṭhāḥ pūjyāḥ ᵥsunītayaḥ sunayanāḥ ᵥsuśarmāṇo ᵥna ᵥsomāḥ susukhāḥ somā iva te yūyam ᵥṛtaṃ ᵥyate yajñaṃ gacchate yajamānāya gacchateti ||

vātāso na dhunayo jiglavo'gnīnāṃ na jihvā virokirṇaḥ | varmaṇvanto na yodhāḥ śimīvantaḥ pitṛṇāṃ na śaṃsāḥ surātayaḥ || 3 || vātāsaḥ | na | ye | dhunayaḥ | jiglavaḥ | agnīnām | na | jihvāḥ | vi'rokirṇaḥ | varman'vantaḥ | na | yodhāḥ | śimī'vantaḥ | pitṛṇām | na | śaṃsāḥ | su'rātayaḥ || 3 ||
ᵥye marutaḥ ᵥvātāso ᵥna vāyava iva ᵥdhunayaḥ śatrūṇāṃ kampayitāraḥ ᵥjiglavaḥ gamanaśīlāḥ |
atra marute sūkte marutāmeva dṛṣṭāntakathanaṃ saṃcaraṇasvabhāvavāyupadārthatadabhimānidevatābhedenā viruddham |
tathā ᵥagnīnāṃ ᵥna ᵥjihvāḥ agnīnāṃ jvālā iva ᵥvirokiṇaḥ virocanaśīlamukhāḥ |
tathā ᵥvarmaṇvanto ᵥna ᵥyodhāḥ kavacino yoddhāra iva ᵥśimīvantaḥ śauryakarmavantaḥ |
tathā ᵥpitṛṇāṃ ᵥna ᵥśaṃsāḥ pitṛṇāṃ janakānāṃ śaṃsā vāca iva ᵥsurātayaḥ sudānāḥ |
1. ta-mu-evamete | 2. ga-ta-bha-'sa' nāsti | 3. ta4.5.7-'yathā' nāsti | 4. ta-bha1. 2.4.1.8-svayujyamānāḥ |

rathānāṃ na ye'rāḥ sanābhayo jigīvāṃso na śūrā abhirvaḥ | vareyavo na mayī ghṛtapṛṣo'bhisṛtāro arkaṃ na suṣṭuṃbhaḥ || 4 || rathānām | na | ye | arāḥ | sa'nābhayaḥ | jigīvāṃsaḥ | na | śūrāḥ | abhi'dharvaḥ | vare'yavaḥ | na | mayīḥ | ghṛta'pṛṣaḥ | abhi'svartāraḥ | arkam | na | su'stuṃbhaḥ || 4 || rathānāṃ na rathakraṇāmiva arāḥ te yathā bahavo'pi sanābhayaḥ samānanābhayo bhavanti tadvat ye parasparaṃ sanābhayaḥ samānabandhanā ekasminnevāntarikṣe vartamānāḥ | parasparaṃ bandhubhūtā ityarthaḥ | jigīvāṃso na śūrāḥ jayaśīlāḥ śūrā iva abhidharvaḥ abhigatadīptayaḥ | kiṃca vareyavo na maryāḥ vṛtaṃ varaṃ parasmai pradātumicchanto manuṣyā iva ghṛtapṛṣaḥ udakasektāraḥ | udakapūrvaṃ hi varāṇi vasūni dīyante niyamena | vṛṣṭyudakapradā ityarthaḥ | kiṃca
guhā | śiraḥ | ni'hitam | ṛdhak | akṣī iti | asinvana | atti | jihvayā | vanāni | annāni | asmai | paṭbhiḥ | sam | bharanti | uttāna'hastāḥ | namasā | adhe | viśva ||2||
asyāgneḥ ᵥśiraḥ mūrdhā ᵥguhā guhāyāṃ ᵥnihitaṃ manuṣyodareṣu vartate |
asya ᵥakṣī akṣiṇī ᵥṛdhak pṛthagnihitaṃ nihite candrasūryātmanā |
īdṛśo yo'gniḥ ᵥasinvan dantai- rasakhādan ᵥjihvayā ᵥvanāni ᵥatti kāṣṭhāni bhakṣayati dāhabhūtaḥ ᵥasmai agnaye'dhvaravāṃdayaḥ ᵥpadbhiḥ pādairabhigatya ᵥannāni ᵥsaṃ ᵥbharanti saṃpādayanti havīṃṣi |
ᵥuttānahastāḥ pātradhāraṇārtha- munnatakarāḥ ᵥnamasā namaskāreṇa yuktāḥ |
pra mātuḥ prataraṃ guhāmicchan kumāro na vīradhaḥ |
sasaṃ na pakkamavidacchucantaṃ ririhāṃsaṃ ripa upasthe antaḥ ||
pra ᵥmātuḥ | pra'taram | guhyam | icchan | kumāraḥ | na | vīradhaḥ | ᵥsarpat | urvīḥ | ᵥsasam | na | pakkam | avidat | śucantam | ᵥririhāṃsam | ripaḥ | ᵥupasthe | ᵥantariti ||3||
ayamagniḥ ᵥmātuḥ pṛthivyāḥ saṃbandhinaḥ ᵥurvīḥ bahvīḥ ᵥvīradhaḥ latāḥ ᵥicchan tathā ᵥprataraṃ prakṛṣṭataraṃ ᵥguhyaṃ gopyaṃ tāsāṃ vīrūdhāṃ mūlamapīcchan kāmayamānaḥ ᵥpra ᵥsarpat sarpataḥ prasarati |
sa yathā stanyaṃ pātuṃ jānubhyāṃ sarpataḥ tadvat |
ᵥsasaṃ ᵥna pakkaṃ pakkamannamiva ᵥśucantaṃ dīpyamānaṃ nīrasaṃ vṛkṣaṃ ᵥripaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ᵥupasthe ᵥantaḥ utsaṅge'ntaḥ ᵥavidat vindati |
tadmṛtaṃ raudasī pra bravīmi jāyamāno mātarā garbho atti |
nāhaṃ devasya martyāściketāgniṃ vicetāḥ sa pracetāḥ ||
tat | vām | ᵥṛtam | rodasī iti | pra | bravīmi | jāyamānaḥ | ᵥmātarā | garbhaḥ | ᵥatti | na | aham | devasya | martyaḥ | ᵥciketa | agniḥ | ᵥaṅga | vi'caitāḥ | saḥ | ᵥpra'caitāḥ ||4||
he ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵥtat ᵥṛtaṃ satyaṃ ᵥpra ᵥbravīmi yadaraṇyabhyāṃ ᵥjāyamānaḥ utpannaḥ ᵥgarbhaḥ garbhasthānīyo'gniḥ ᵥmātarā araṇī ᵥatti bhakṣayati |
ᵥdevaśca dyotanādiguṇasyāgneḥ ᵥvartanaṃ ᵥmartyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ᵥahaṃ ᵥna ᵥciketa na jānāmi |
he ᵥaṅga vaiśvānara ᵥagniḥ śaraṇībhyāmutpannaḥ ᵥvicetāḥ vividhajñānavān ᵥsa ᵥpracetāḥ ᵥprakṛṣṭajñānaḥ |
agnireva vicetāḥ bahudhā jānāti sa pracetāḥ sa eva jānāti |
ya: | asmai | annam | tṛṣu | ā'dadhāti | ājyai: | ghṛtai: | juhoti | puṣyati | tasmai | sahasram | akṣarbhi: | vi | cakṣe | agne | viśvata: | pratyaṅ | asi | tvam || 5 ||
ya: yajamāna: vasmai agnaye vtṛṣu kṣipram vannam vādadhāti karoti vājyairghṛtai: kṣaradrūpai:¹ dīsairvā somarasai: vjuhoti vpuṣyati puṣṇāti cainaṃ kāṣṭhai: vtasmai |
taṃ vmahasaṃ sahasra- saṃkhyākai: vakṣabhi: akṣasthānīyābhiraparimitābhirjvālābhi: vvi vcakṣe vicakṣe vipaśyati² |
he vagne vtvaṃ vviśvata: sarvata: vpratyaṅṅasi pratyaṅjano bhavasi |
kiṃ deveṣu tyaja enaścakṛthāyai pṛcchāmi nu tvāmavidvān |
kim | deveṣu | lyaja: | ena: | cakartha | agne | pṛcchāmi | nu | tvām | avidvān | akrīḻan | krīḻan | hāri: | attave | adan | vi | parva'śa: | cakarta | gām'iva | asi: || 6 ||
he vagne vtvāṃ vnu kṣipraṃ vdeveṣu vkiṃ vtyaja: krodham vena: pāpaṃ ca vcakartha kṛtavānasīti vavidvān ahaṃ vpṛcchāmi |
kiṃca vakrīḻan kaciddeśe'viharan vkrīḻan kaciddeśe vinodaryalilayā dahan vhari: haritavarṇa: san vattave attavyam vadan annakāṣṭhādikaṃ vparvaśa: saṃgho saṃgho vvi vcakartha vividhaṃ karoṣi |
vgāmivāsi: gāṃ yathā asi: svadhiti: parvaśaśchinatti tadvat ||
cakṣade mitro vasubhi: sujātaḥ samānudhe parvabhirvāvṛdhāna: ||
virṣūca: | aśvān | yuyuje | vane'jā: | ṛjītibhi: | raśanābhi: | gṛbhītān | cakṣade | mitra: | vasu'bhi: | su'jāta: | sam | ānudhe | parva'bhi: | vavṛdhāna: || 7 ||
ayamagni: vvirṣūca: viṣvagjanān vaśvān vyāsān mahato vṛkṣān sarvato gantanaśvāneva vā vyuyuje yuṅkte vvanejā: vane pravaddha: saṃpanna: san |
vṛjītibhi: ṛjugāminībhi: vraśanābhi: raśanāsthānīyābhirlatābhi: vgṛbhītān parigṛhītān veṣṭitān |
sākṣādaśvapakṣe ṛjugatibhi:⁶ prasiddhābhī raśanābhirgṛbhītān gṛhītān svakīyānaśvān śīghradāhāya rathe yojitavāni- tyartha: |
tādṛśo'gni: vcakṣade cakṣāda⁵ śakalīkaroti vasūni vmitra: asmākaṃ mitrabhūta: vvasubhi: vāsakai: raśmibhi: vsujāta: suṣṭhu pravṛddha: san |
kiṃca vsamānudhe samyagvardhate vparvabhi: kāṣṭhakhaṇḍai: vvāvṛdhāna: vardhamāna: ||

‘agni: sasim’ iti saptarcaṃ dvādaśaṃ sūktaṃ saucīkasya vaiśvānarasyāgnerārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamāgneyam |

agni: sasiṃ vājaṃbharaṃ dadātyagniriṃ śrutyaṃ karmani:ṣṭhām | agnī rodasī vi caratsamañjanagninārīṃ vīrakukṣiṃ puraṃdhim || 1 || agni: | sasim | vājam'bharam | dadāti | agni: | vīram | śrutyam | karmani:'sthām | agni: | rodasī iti | vi | carat | sam'añjan | agni: | nārīm | vīra'kukṣima | puram'dhim || 1 ||
ayam agni: sasiṃ sarpaṇasvabhāvamaśvaṃ vājaṃbharaṃ yuddhe śatrūn jitvā'nnasaṃpādakaṃ dadāti stotṛbhya: |
tathā agnirvīraṃ vīryavantaṃ putraṃ śrutyaṃ pitṛvyapadeśakaṃ karmani:ṣṭhāṃ yāge'nanyacittaṃ dadāti |
agnī rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau samañjan samyagañjan vi carat vividhaṃ carati |
ayam agninārīṃ yoṣitaṃ vīrakukṣiṃ vīraprasavakukṣiṃ puraṃdhiṃ ca karoti ||

agnerama: samidastu bhadrāgnirmahī rodasī ā viveśa | agnirekaṃ codayatsamatasriprirvatrāṇi dayate purūṇi || 2 || agne: | ama: | sam'it | astu | bhadrā | agni: | mahī iti | rodasī iti | ā | viveśa | agni: | ekam | codayat | sam'atsu | agni: | vṛtrāṇi | dayate | purūṇi || 2 ||
amasa: karmavata: agne: samit bhadrā astu |
ayam agni: mahī mahatyau rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ā viveśa āviṣṭavān svatejasā |
tathāyam agnirekam asahāyameva codayat codayati prerayati samatsu saṃgrāmeṣu |
yuddhe svabhaktaṃ svayaṃ sahāya: san jayinaṃ karotītyartha: |
tathā agnirvṛtrāṇi purūṇi bahūn śatrūn dayate hanti ||

agnihaṃ tyaṃ jarata: karṇamāvāgnirdadyo niradahajarūtham | agniratriṃ dharma uruṣyadantaragnirnumedhaṃ prajāyāssṛjatsam || 3 || agni: | ha | tyam | jarata: | karṇam | āva | agni: | at'bhya: | ni: | adahat | jarūtham | agni: | atrim | gharme | uruṣyat | anta: | agni: | nuda'medham | pra'jayā | asṛjat | sam || 3 ||
agnihaṃ ayamagni: khalu tyaṃ taṃ prasiddhaṃ jarata: karṇaṃ jaratkarṇanāmānamṛṣima āva rarakṣa |
tathāyam agni: adraya: jarūtham etannāmānamasuram niradahat nirdagdhavān |
tathā agniratriṃ maharṣi gharme antaḥ ṛṣīse'vasthitam uruṣyat rarakṣa |
tathāyam agnirnumedham etannāmakarmarṣi prajayā putrādilakṣaṇayā sam asṛjat saṃyuyoja ||
agnirdadraviṇaṃ vīrapeśā agnirṣi ya: sahasrā sanoti |
agniḥ | dāt | draviṇam | vīra'peśaḥ | agniḥ | ṛṣim | yaḥ | sahasrā | sanoti | agniḥ | divi | havyam | ā | tatān | agne | dhāmāni | vi'bhṛtā | puru'trā || 4 ||
ayam agniḥ vīrapeśaḥ prerakajvālārūpaḥ draviṇaṃ dhanaṃ dāt dadāti |
tathā agniṛṣi mantradraṣṭāraṃ putraṃ prayacchatīti doṣaḥ |
yaḥ ṛṣiḥ sahasrā gavāṃ sahasrāṇi sanoti bhajate dakṣiṇātvena tanmūrdhni dadātīti |
tathā agniḥ divi dyuloke havyaṃ yajamānairhutam ā tatāna deveṣu vistārayati |
tathā agnerdhāmāni śarīrāṇi vibhṛtā vibhṛtāni saṃbhṛtāni purutrā bahuṣu sthāneṣvāhavanīyadhiṣṇyādiṣu kṣityādiṣu vā ||
agnimukthairṛṣayo vi hvayante'gniṃ naro yāmani bādhitāsaḥ |
agniṃ vayo antarikṣe patanto'gniḥ sahasrā pari yāti gonām ||
agniḥ | ukthaiḥ | ṛṣayaḥ | vi | hvayante | agnim | naraḥ | yāmani | bādhitāsaḥ | agnim | vayaḥ | antarikṣe | patantaḥ | agniḥ | sahasrā | pari | yāti | gonām || 5 ||
agnimukthaiḥ śastraiḥ ṛṣayaḥ pūrvai vi hvayante vividhamāhvayanti yajñe svīye |

sāhyam dāsmārtha tvayā yujā sahasrakṛtena sahasā sahasvatā ||
yaḥ | te | manyo iti | avidhat | vajra | sāyaka | sahaḥ | orjaḥ | puṣyati | viśvam | ānupak | sāhyam | dāsam | āryam | tvayā | yujā | sahaḥ | kṛtena | sahasā | sahasvatā || 1 ||

ᵥyaḥ yajamānaḥ ᵥte tubhyam ᵥavidhat paricarati he ᵥvajra vajravatsārabhūta ᵥsāyaka sāyakavacchatrūṇāṃ hiṃsaka sa manuṣyaḥ ᵥsahaḥ balaṃ ᵥojaḥ śārīraṃ balaṃ ca ᵥbhānuṣak anuṣaktaṃ ᵥpuṣyati svadanugrahātsaṃgrāme |
yasmādevaṃ tasmādya ᵥdāsam upakṣayakartāram ᵥāryam asmatto'dhikaṃ cobhayavidhaṃ śatruṃ ᵥsāhyam abhibhavema |
ᵥsahasrakṛtena balotpāditena ᵥsahasā sahamānena parān ᵥsahasvatā balavatā |
manyurindro manyurevāsa devo manyurhotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ |
manyuṃ viśa īḻate mānuṣīryāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sujoṣāḥ ||
manyuḥ | indraḥ | manyuḥ | eva | āsa | devaḥ | manyuḥ | hotā | varuṇaḥ | jāta'vedāḥ | manyum | viśaḥ | īḻate | mānuṣīḥ | yāḥ | pāhi | naḥ | manyo iti | tapasā | su'joṣāḥ ||2||
atha ᵥmanyurindraḥ ᵥmanyureva ᵥdevaḥ sarvo'pi manyureva ᵥbhāsa abhavat |
tathā manyuḥ ᵥvaruṇaḥ api ᵥjātavedāḥ jātaprajño varuṇaśca |
yāḥ mānuṣīḥ manuṣo'payabhūtāḥ viśaḥ prajāḥ santi tāḥ manyuṃ eva devam īḻate stuvanti |
he manyo tapasā etannāmakenāsminpannā sajoṣāḥ samānaprītisthaṃ pāhi rakṣa ||
abhīhi manyo tavastavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn |
amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasanyā bharā tvaṃ naḥ ||
abhi | ihi | manyo iti | tavaḥ | tavīyān | tapasā | yujā | vi | jahi | śatrūn | amitra'hā | vṛtra'hā | dasyu'hā | ca | viśvā | vasūni | ā | bhara | tvam | naḥ || 3 ||
sa tvaṃ tapasā asmatpannā yujā sahāyena śatrūn vi jahi |
tathā vṛtrahā āvarakāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantā tathā dasya

ayaṃ te asmā upa mehavād pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadhāyaḥ | manyo vajrinnabhi māmā vavṛtsva hanā va dasyū~rata bodhyāpeḥ || 6 || ayama | te | asmi | upa | mā | ā | ihi | arvāṅ | pratīcīnaḥ | sahure | viśva'dhāyaḥ | manyo iti | vajrin | abhi | mām | ā | vavṛtsva | hanā va | dasyūn | uta | bodhi | āpeḥ ||6|| he sahure śatrūṇāṃ sahanaśīla viśvadhāyaḥ viśvasya dhartarmanyā ayaṃ jano'haṃ te tava asmi karmakṛt | yata evamataḥ pratīcīnaḥ pratigantā arvāṅ asmadabhimukhaṃ mā māṃ upa ihi upāgaccha | he manyo vajrin mām abhi ā vavṛtsva abhyāvartasva | kimarthamabhyāgamanamiti ceducyate | hanāva āvāṃ dasyūn śatrūn | uta api ca āpeḥ bandhu bodhi budhyasva ||
abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā me'dhā vṛtrāṇi jaghanāva bhūri | juhomi te dharuṇa madhu agramubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibāva || 7 || abhi | pra | ihi | dakṣiṇa

agniriva manyo tviṣitaḥ sahasva senānīrnaḥ sahure hūta edhi | hatvāya śatrūniva bhajasva veda ojo mirmāno vi mṛdho nudasva || 2 || agniḥ'iva | manyo iti | tvipitaḥ | sahasva | senānīḥ | naḥ | sahure | hutaḥ | edhi | hatvāya | śatrūn | vi | bhajasva | vedaḥ | ojaḥ | mirmānaḥ | vi | mṛdhaḥ | nudasva || 2 ||
he 'sahure sahanaśīla 'senānīḥ 'edhi bhava 'naḥ asmākaṃ saṃgrāme 'hutaḥ san |
kiṃca 'ojo 'mimānaḥ asmākaṃ balaṃ kurvan 'mṛdhaḥ śatrūn 'vi 'nudasva ghātayetyarthaḥ ||

sahasva manyo abhimātisme rujan mṛṇan pramṛṇan prehi śatrūn | ugraṃ te pājoṃ nunvā rurudhe vṛśī vaśaṃ nayasa ekaja tvam || 3 || sahasva | manyo iti | abhi'mātim | asme iti | rujan | mṛṇan | pra'mṛṇan | pra | ihi | śatrūn | ugram | te | pājaḥ | nu | ā | rurudhe | vṛśī | vaśam | nayase | eka'ja | tvam || 3 ||
'rujan hiṃsan 'mṛṇan 'pramṛṇan prakarṣeṇa hiṃsan yathā punarna jīvettathā kurvastvaṃ 'śatrūn prati 'prehi |
na tathā saṃbhavati he 'ekaja 'tvam asahāyaḥ 'vaśī tvaṃ 'vaśaṃ 'nayase prāpayasi śatrūm ||

ekau bahūnāmasi manyavīḻito viśaṃviśaṃ yudhaye saṃ śiśādhi | akṛtaruktavayā yujā vayaṃ ghumantaṃ ghoṣaṃ vijayārya kṛṇmahe || 4 || ekaḥ | bahūnām | asi | manyo iti | īḻitaḥ | viśam'viśam | yudhaye | sam | śiśādhi | akṛta'ruk | tvayā | yujā | vayam | ghu'mantam | ghoṣam | vi'jayāya | kṛṇmahe || 4 ||
he 'manyo 'īḻitaḥ stutastvam 'ekaḥ eva asahāya eva 'bahūnāṃ śatrūṇām 'asi bhavasi paryāpto hantum |
ataḥ 'viśaṃviśaṃ tāṃ tāmasmadvirodhinīṃ prajāṃ 'yudhaye yuddhāya 'saṃ 'śiśādhi samyak tīkṣṇīkuru |
kiṃca he 'akṛtaruk acchidyadīpte 'tvayā 'yujā sahāyena 'vayaṃ 'ghumantaṃ dīptimantaṃ 'ghoṣaṃ siṃhanādavantaṃ 'vijayāya viśiṣṭajayārthe 'kṛṇmahe kurmaḥ ||
priyaṃ te nāma sahure gṛṇīmasi vidmā tamutsaṃ yata ābabhūtha ||
vijeṣa'kṛt | indraḥ'iva | anava'bravaḥ | asmākam | manyo iti | adhi'pāḥ | bhava | iha | priyam | te | nāma | sahure | gṛṇīmasi | viśva | tam | utsam | yataḥ | ā'babhūtha ||5||
ᐁidaśasvam ᐁasmākam ᐁadhipāḥ adhikaṃ pātā rakṣitā ᐁbhava ᐁiha asmin‌yajñe |
he ᐁsahure śatrūṇāṃ sahanaśīla ᐁte ᐁpriyaṃ ᐁnāma stotraṃ ᐁgṛṇīmasi gṛṇīmaḥ stumaḥ |
ᐁyataḥ nāgnaḥ stotrāt tvam ᐁābabhūtha ābhavasi pravṛddho bhavasi ᐁtamurasaṃ balasyodmayitāraṃ ᐁviśva jānīmaḥ ||
satyena | uttabhitā | bhūmiḥ | sūryeṇa | uttabhitā | dyauḥ | ṛtena | ādityāḥ | tiṣṭhanti | divi | somaḥ | adhi | śritaḥ || 1 ||
satyena anṛtapratiyoginā dharmeṇa bhūmiruttabhitāvṛtā phalitā bhavantyarthaḥ |
asati satye bhūmyāṃ sasyādayo na phalanti |
ṛtena yajñena ādityāḥ aditaḥ putrā devāḥ tiṣṭhanti |
divi dhuloke somaḥ devānāmāpyāyanakārī valīrūpo devatārūpaśca adhi śritaḥ adhiṣṭhitaḥ |
somena | ādityāḥ | balinaḥ | somena | pṛthivī | mahī | atho iti | nakṣatrāṇām | eṣām | upasthe | somaḥ | āhitaḥ || 2 ||
somenādityāḥ aditaḥ putrā indrādayaḥ balinaḥ bhavanti |
tathā somena āhutyātmanāpro hutena pṛthivī bhūmiḥ mahī mahatī bhavati |
na kṣa trāyanta iti nakṣatrā pracchamasadayaḥ |
prasiddhānāmeva nakṣatrāṇāmupastha upasthāne dhuloke soma āhitaḥ |
'tṛtīyasyāmito divi soma āsīttaṃ gāyatryāharan' (tai. brā. 3. 2. 1. 1) ityādi śruteḥ |
somaṃ yaṃ brahmāṇo vidur na tasyāśnāti kaścana ||
somam | manyate | papidvān | yat | sam | pibanti | oṣadhim | somam | yam | brahmāṇaḥ | viduḥ | na | tasya | aśnāti | kaḥ | cana || 3 ||
yaṃ somam ᵛoṣadhi valīrūpaṃ ᵛsarpiṣanti sāmarthyādrāsāya nikāḥ |
ᵛsomaṃ hi taṃ manyate ᵛyaṃ ᵛbrahmaṇaḥ |
‘kuto nu carasi brahman’ ‘tasmai mā brūyā nidhipāya brahman’ ityādiprayogatvāt |
te catvijo yajamānaśca2 yāgasādhanabhūtaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ ᵛviduḥ jānanti ᵛtasya aṃśam |
taṃ somaṃ manyate papivān pītavān3 yajamāno yadyamoṣadhirūpaṃ sarpiṣamyabhiṣavagrāvabhiradhvayrvādyo yajamānaśca4 |
yaṃ brahmāṇe brāhmaṇā abhijñā daivajñā viduḥ kathayanti candramasaṃ na tasyābhāti kaścanādevo devebhyo'nyo manuṣyādiḥ |
yajñārhasomasyāsomatvaṃ na nindāyai api tu itarasya stutyai iti mantavyam |
grāṇṇāmicchṛṇvan tiṣṭhasi na tai aśnāti pārthivaḥ ||
ācchat'vidhānaiḥ | gupitaḥ | bārhataiḥ | soma | rakṣitaḥ | grāṇṇām | it | śṛṇvan | tiṣṭhasi | na | tai | aśnāti | pārthivaḥ || 4 ||
ācchādayanti vidhānāni yeṣāṃ vidyante ta ācchadvidhānāḥ |
tathā ᵛbārhataiḥ gupitaḥ svānaājñājñāyādibhiḥ5 saptabhiḥ somapālaiḥ ᵛrakṣitaḥ tvam |
‘ete vā amuṣmiṃlloke somamarakṣan’ (tai. saṃ. 6.1.10.5) iti brāhmaṇam |
ᵛgrāṇṇāmicchṛṇvan abhiṣava- grāṇṇāṃ dhvaniṃ śṛṇvanneva ᵛtiṣṭhasi |
ᵛte ᵛtvāṃ ᵛpārthivaḥ pārthivo janaḥ ᵛna ᵛaśnāti |
na hi duṣya- śrandrarūpaḥ somo'tathyaiḥ pānayogyau bhavati |
‘candramā vai somo devānāmanaṃ taṃ paurṇamāsyāmabhiṣu- ṇvanti’ (śa. brā. 11.1.5.3) iti vājasaneyakam ||
yattvā deva prapibanti tat ā pyāyase punaḥ |
vāyuḥ somasya rakṣitā samānāṃ māsa ākṛtiḥ ||
yat | tvā | deva | pra'pibanti | tataḥ | ā | pyāyase | punariti | vāyuḥ | somasya | rakṣitā | samānām | māsaḥ | ākṛtiḥ || 5 ||
he ᵛdeva soma ᵛyat yadā ᵛtvā tvāṃ ᵛprapibanti oṣadhirūpaṃ trivaṣapi savaneṣu ᵛtataḥ anantara- meva ᵛpunaḥ ᵛā ᵛpyāyase |
‘ā pyāyasva sam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 91. 16) iti prātaḥsavane ‘saṃ te payāṃsi’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 91. 18) ityuttarayoḥ savanayorāpyāyase |
1. ga4-śrāmānakaḥ; ta1.2.3.6.7-nyaḥ nakaḥ; ta8-nyanekaḥ; bha1-nyanaḥ ka; bhara-nya nakaḥ; bha4.6.8-nyanakaḥ |
4. ga4-pītavān pātā; ta1.2.3.6.7-pītavān pītasomo; bha-pītavān pīta |
sa ca samānāṃ saṃvatsarāṇām ākṛtiḥ ākatīṃ dhyavacchedako bhavati |
saṃvatsare saṃvatsare vasantādi kāleṣvanuṣṭhīyamānatvāt 'vasante vasante jyotipā yajeta' iti śruteḥ |
he deva soma yadyadā tvā tvāṃ prapibanti raśmayo'parapakṣe tato'nantarameva pūrvapakṣe punarāpyāyase |
ekaikakalāhāsavṛddhibhyāṃ hi māsaḥ pūryate taiḥ saṃvatsara iti ||
stomāḥ | āsan | prati'dhayaḥ | kurīram | chandaḥ | opaśaḥ | sūryāyāḥ | aśvinau | varā | agniḥ | āsīt | puraḥ'gavaḥ || 8 ||
sūryāyā rathasya ᵥstomāḥ trivṛdādayaḥ ᵥpratidhayaḥ ᵥāsan |
tathā ᵥkurīraṃ ᵥchandaḥ kurīranāmakaṃ chando'nasaḥ ᵥopaśaḥ abhavat |
tādṛśāyāḥ ᵥsūryāyāḥ ᵥaśvinā aśvinau ᵥvarā varāvāstāmiti śeṣaḥ |
tasyā vivāhe ᵥpurogavaḥ purogantā purato gantā yaḥ pūrvameva prastāvāthaṃ gacchati tasthānīyaḥ ᵥamirāsīt |
‘prajā- patirvai² somāya rājñe duhitaraṃ prāyacchatsūryāṃ sāvitrīṃ tasyai sarve devā varā āgacchan ’ (ai. brā. 4.7) ityādi hi brāhmaṇam |
tathā ca satyadhinau prabalau4 santāvājiṃ purato gatvā tāmalabhetāmiti |
somaḥ | vadhu'yuḥ | abhavat | aśvinau | āstām | ubhā | varā | sūryām | yat | patye | śaṃsantīm | manasā | savitā | adadāt || 9 ||
tasmin samaye ᵥaśvinā aśvinau ᵥubhā ubhau ᵥvarā varau ᵥāstām abhūtām |
ᵥyat yadā ᵥsūryāṃ ᵥpatye ᵥśaṃsantīṃ patiṃ kāmayamānām |
sūryā ᵥmanasā sahitāya ᵥsomāya varāya ᵥsavitā taṣpitā ᵥadadāt prādāt ditsāṃ cakāra ||
manaḥ | asyāḥ | anaḥ | āsīt | dyauḥ | āsīt | uta | cchadiḥ | śukrau | anaḍvāhau | āstām | yat | aryāt | sūryā | gṛham || 10 ||
ᵥasyāḥ sūryāyāḥ patyurgṛhaṃ gacchantyāḥ ᵥanaḥ rathaḥ ᵥmanaḥ ᵥāsīt |
yā patigṛhaṃ khayā gacchā- mīti matirasti sā ᵥana āsīt |
ᵥuta api ca tasyā anasaḥ ᵥdyauḥ dyulokaḥ ᵥcchadiḥ uparyapidhānam ᵥāsīt |
ᵥśukrau dīptau sūryācandramau ᵥanaḍvāhau rathasya voḍhārau ᵥāstām abhavatām |
ᵥyat yadā ᵥsūryā ᵥgṛhaṃ somam ᵥayāt agāt ||
śrotraṃ te cakre āstāṃ divi panthāścarācaraḥ ||
ṛk'sāmābhyām | abhi'hitau | gāvau | te | sāmanau | itaḥ | śrotram | te | cakre | iti | āstām | divi | panthāḥ | | carācaraḥ || 11 ||
1. ga-ta-bha-gaṃtāsīt | 2. ta-bha-prajāpatiḥ | 3. ta-bha-‘somāya prāyacchat’ nāsti | 4. ta1. 2.6.7.8-ma1.2.4.6.8-prabalau sabalau | 5. ta4.5-sahitā |
he sūrye devi ᵥte tava ᵥṛksāmābhyām abhidhānīsthānābhyām ᵥabhihitau ᵥgāvau' gosthānīyau sūryācandramasau ᵥsāmanau sāmānau ᵥsantau ᵥitaḥ gacchataḥ |
varasya guṇagrāhiṇī śrotre eva ᵥcakre ᵥāstām |
śucī te cakre yātyā vyāāno akṣa āhataḥ |
śucī iti | te | cakre iti | yātyāḥ | tri'ānaḥ | akṣaḥ | ā'ahataḥ | anaḥ | manusmayam | sūryā | ā | arohata | pra'yatī | patim || 12 ||
ᵥyātyāḥ gacchantyāḥ ᵥte tava anasaḥ ᵥcakre caṅkramaṇaśīle rathāṅge ᵥśucī śrotre āstām |
ubhayarathacakracchidragāminī yā kāṣṭhā sā ca rathasya sarvaṃ bhāraṃ vahati |
ᵥmanasmayaṃ manomayam ᵥanaḥ śakaṭaṃ ᵥsūryā ᵥpatiṃ somaṃ prati ᵥprayatī prakarṣeṇa gacchantī ᵥārohana ārūḍhavatī |
patiṃ prati jigamipormanorūpasya rathasya patyurguṇa- śrāviṇī śrotre eva cakre abhūtāṃ vyāno dhārako vāyuścekṣo'bhūdityarthaḥ ||
sūryāyāḥ | vahatuḥ | pra | agāt | bhavitā | yam | atra'asṛjat | aghāsu | hanyante | gāvaḥ | arjunyoḥ | pari | uhyate || 13 ||
sa ca ᵥprāgāt tasyā api pūrvamagacchat |
ᵥyaṃ vahatuṃ ᵥsavitā asyāḥ pitā ᵥavāsṛjat avasṛṣṭavān |
kadā sāgācchat kadā vahaturityubhayoḥ kāla ucyate |
maghā- nakṣatreṣu ᵥgāvaḥ savitrā dattā gāvaḥ somagṛhaṃ prati ᵥhanyante daṇḍaistāḍyante preraṇārtham |
tayornakṣatrayoḥ savituḥ sakāśāt ᵥpari somagṛhaṃ prati ᵥuhyate nīyate rathena ||
viśve devā anu tadvāmajānan putraḥ pitarāvavṛṇīta pūṣā ||
yat | aśvinā | pṛcchamānau | ayātam | tri'cakreṇa | vahatum | sūryāyāḥ | viśve | devāḥ | anu | tat | vām | ajānan | putraḥ | pitarau | avṛṇīta | pūṣā || 14 ||
6. ga1.2-rathena prāpyate maghābhirgāva ityādi gṛhaṃ; ga4-ta4.5-bha1. 2.6-pustakeṣu 'rathena' ityasyānantaraṃ kiyāṃścidavakāśo vidyate |
he ᵥaśvinā aśvinau ᵥyat yadā ᵥpṛcchamānau savitāraṃ praṣṭum ᵥayātam agacchatam |
ᵥtat tadānīṃ ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ savitāraṃ prati gacchantau ᵥviśve sarve ᵥdevā: ᵥanu ᵥajānan anujñātavantaḥ |
tathā ᵥpitarau ᵥputra: aśvino: putra: ᵥpūṣā ᵥatṛṇīta vṛtavān ||
yat | ayātam | śubha: | patī iti | vare'yam | sūryām | upa | kaṃ | ekam | cakram | vām | āsīt | kaṃ | deṣṭārya | tasthathu: || 15 ||
he ᵥśubhaspatī udakasya svāminau ᵥyat yau ᵥayātam agacchatam |
ᵥvareyaṃ varaṇīyāyā: sūryāyā: saṃbandhinaṃ varaṃyācitavyaṃ vā |
ᵥvāṃ bhavata: saṃprati dṛśyamānamidam ᵥekaṃ ᵥcakraṃ ᵥkaṃ āsīt purā |
ᵥkaṃ vāṃ yuvāṃ ᵥdeṣṭāya dānāya pravṛttau ᵥtasthathu: ityaśvinornivāsaṃ pṛcchati ||
dve teṃ cakre sūrye brahmāṇa ṛtuthā viṃdu: |

ᵥathaikaṃ ᵥcakraṃ tṛtīyaṃ saṃvatsarātmakaṃ ᵥguhā guhāyāṃ nihitaṃ ᵥyat asti ᵥtadadvātaya ᵥit |

tatra 'vi hi sotora- sṛkṣata' 'kiṃ subāho svaṅgure' 'indrāṇīmāsu nāriṣu' iti dve 'ukṣṇo hi me' 'ayamemi' iti catasra ityetā navarca indravākyāni |
'parā hīndra' iti pañca 'avīrām' iti dve 'vṛṣabho na tigmaśṛṅgaḥ' ityādyāścatasra indraṇyā vākyāni |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'vi hi vyadhikaindro vṛṣākapirendrrāṇīndraśca samadire pāṅktam' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'atha vṛṣākapiṃ saṃsedhathā hotāvyāyāṃ caturthe' (āśva. śrau. 8. 3) iti |
yadi paṣṭhe- hanyukthastotrāṇi tripadāsu na stuvīran māmagā yadi vedamaharamiṣṭomaḥ syāttadānīṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsī mādhyadine savana ārabhaṇīyābhya ūrdhvametatsūktaṃ saṃseddhvamityapi |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ—'sukīrti brāhmaṇācchaṃsī vṛṣākapiṃ ca paṅktiśaṃsam' (āśva. śrau. 8. 4) iti ||
vi | hi | sotoḥ | asṛkṣata | na | indram | devam | amaṃsata | yatra | amadat | vṛṣākapiḥ | aryaḥ | puṣṭeṣu | matsaṃkhā | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | uttaraḥ || 1 ||
yāgaṃ prati mayā visṛṣṭā anujñātāḥ stotāro vṛṣākaperyaṣṭāraḥ |
mayā preritāḥ santo'pi te stotāro na stuvantaḥ |
'yatra yeṣu 'puṣṭeṣu somena pravṛddheṣu yāgeṣu 'aryaḥ svāmī 'vṛṣākapiḥ mama putraḥ matsaṃkhā mama sakhibhūtaḥ san 'amadat somapānena hṛṣṭo'bhūt |
mādhavabhaṭṭāstu vi hi saṃtāriṣyeparindrāṇyā vākyamiti manyante |
indrāyai kalpitaṃ haviḥ kaścinmṛgo'ṅgudapadindraputrasya vṛṣākapirpaye vartamānaḥ |
kiṃca mama patimindraṃ devaṃ nāmaṃsata stotāro na stuvanti |
yatra yasmin janapade puṣṭeṣu pravṛddheṣu dhaneṣvaryaḥ svāmī vṛṣākapirmadat |
matsaṃkhā mapriyaścendro viśvasmāt sarvasmājjagata uttaraḥ utkṛṣṭataraḥ ||
no ahū pra vindasyanyatra somapītaye viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
