anyatra somapītaye somapānāya no aha naiva ca pra vindasi pragacchasītyarthaḥ |
yasmā̭ i॒rasya̭sīdu॒ nvaryo̭ vā॒ puṣṭi̭mada॒su vi॒śvasmā̭dindra u॒ttara̭ḥ ||
kim | a॒yam | tvā॒m | vṛ॒ṣāka̭piḥ | ca॒kāra̭ | ha॒rita̭ḥ | mṛ॒gaḥ | yasmai̭ | i॒rasya̭si | it | ū~ iti̭ | nu | arya̭ḥ | vā | pu॒ṣṭi॒'mat | va॒su | vi॒śvasmā̭t | indra̭ḥ | u॒t'ta̭raḥ || 3 ||
he indra tvāṃ prati haritaḥ haritavarṇaḥ mṛgaḥ mṛgabhūtaḥ ayaṃ vṛṣākapiḥ |
yasmai vṛṣākapaye puṣṭimat poṣayuktaṃ vas dhanam aryo vā udāra iva ma tvaṃ nu kṣipram irasyamīn prayacchasyeva |
śvā nva̭sya ja॒mbhi॒pa॒di ka॒rṇaṃ va̭rāha॒yurvi॒śvasmā̭dindra u॒ttara̭ḥ ||
yam | i॒mam | tvam | vṛ॒ṣāka̭pim | pri॒yam | indra̭ | a॒bhi'ra̭kṣasi | śvā | nu | a॒sya | ja॒mbhi॒pa॒t | a॒rpi | ka॒rṇam | va॒rāha॒yuḥ | vi॒śvasmā̭t | indra̭ḥ | u॒t'ta̭raḥ ||4||
he indra tvaṃ priyam iṣṭaṃ putraṃ yamimaṃ vṛṣākapim abhirakṣasi paripālayasi asya enaṃ vṛṣākapim |
varāhayuḥ varāhamicchan śvā nu kṣipraṃ jambhipat bhakṣayatu |
śi॒ro nva̭sya rā॒vi॒ṣaṃ na su॒gaṃ du॒ṣkṛtai̭ bhu॒vaṃ vi॒śvasmā̭dindra u॒ttara̭ḥ ||
pri॒yā | ta॒ṣṭāni̭ | me | ka॒piḥ | vi'a̭ṅkā | vi | a॒du॒dūpa॒t | śi॒raḥ | nu | a॒sya | rā॒vi॒ṣam | na | su॒gam | du॒ḥ'kṛtai̭ | bhu॒vam | vi॒śvasmā̭t | indra̭ḥ | u॒t'ta̭raḥ ||5||
me mamaindrāyai taṣṭāni yajamānaiḥ kalpitāni priyā priyāṇi vyaktā vyaktānyājyai- viśeṣeṇāktāni havīṃṣi kaścit vṛṣākaperviṣaye vartamānaḥ kapiḥ vyadūpata dūṣayāmāsa |
tato'ham asya tatkapisvāmino vṛṣākapeḥ śiro nu kṣipraṃ rāviṣaṃ lunīyām |
duṣkṛte duṣṭasya karmaṇaḥ kartre vṛṣākapaye'smai sugaṃ sukhaṃ na bhuvam ahaṃ na bhaveyam |
asyā mama patiḥ indraḥ viśvasmāt uttaraḥ ||

na mattī subhasattarā na suyāśutarā bhuvat | na matpraticyavīyasī na sakthyudyamīyasī viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 6 || na | mat | strī | subhasattarā | na | suyāśutarā | bhuvat | na | mat | prati'cyavīyasī | na | sakthya | ut'dyamīyasī | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||6|| ^mat matto'nyā ^strī nārī ^subhasattarā atiśayena subhagā ^na ^bhuvat na bhavāte | nāstī- tyarthaḥ | kiṃca matto'nyā strī ^suyāśutarā atiśayena susukhātiśayena suputrā vā ^na bhavati | tathā ca mantrāntaraṃ—‘dadāti mahyaṃ yādurī yāśūnāṃ bhojyā śatā’ (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 126. 6) iti | kiṃca ^mat matto'nyā ^praticyavīyasī pumāṃsaṃ prati śarīrasyātyantaṃ cyāvayitrī ^na asti | kiṃca matto'nyā strī ^sakthyudyamīyasī saṃbhoge'tyantamutkṣeptrī ^na asti | na matto'nyā kācidapi nārī maithune'nuguṇaṃ sakthyucchatītyarthaḥ | mama patiḥ ^indraḥ ^viśvasmāt ^uttaraḥ utkṛṣṭaḥ ||

uve amba sulābhike yathaivāṅga bhaviṣyati | bhasanmai amba sakthi me śiro me vīṃva hṛṣyati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 7 || uve | amba | sulābhike | yathā'iva | aṅga | bhaviṣyati | bhasat | me | amba | sakthi | me | śiraḥ | me | vi'iva | hṛṣyati | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ || 7 || eṣamindrāṇyā śaso vṛṣākapayevīti | ^uve iti saṃbodhanātho nipātaḥ | he ^amba māta: ^sulābhike śobhanalābhe tvayā ^yathaiva yena prakāreṇoktaṃ tathaiva tat ^aṅga kṣipraṃ ^bhaviṣyati bhavatu | kimanena tvadanuprītikāriṇā graheṇa mama prayojanam | kiṃca ^me mama pituḥ tvadīyo ^bhasat bhaga upayu- jyatām | kiṃca mama pitustvadīyaṃ ^sakthi copayujyatām | kiṃca ^me mama pitaramindraṃ tvadīyaṃ ^śiraḥ ca priyālāpena ^vīva yathā kokilādiḥ pakṣī tadvat ^hṛṣyati harṣayatu | mama pitā ^indraḥ ^viśva- smāt ^uttaraḥ ||

kiṃ subāho svadaṅgure pṛthuṣṭe pṛthujāghane | kiṃ śūrapali nustvamabhyamīṣi vṛṣākapi viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 8 || kim | subāho | iti su'bāho | su'aṅgure | pṛthu'ṣṭe | pṛthu'jāghane | kim | śūra'pali | naḥ | tvam | abhi | amīṣi | vṛṣākapim | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||8|| kuddhādindra upaśamayati | he ^subāho he śobhanabāho ^svadaṅgure śobhanāṅgulike ^pṛthuṣṭe pṛthukeśasaṃghāte ^pṛthujaghane vistīrṇajaghane ^śūrapali vīrabhārye he indrāṇi ^tvaṃ ^naḥ asmadīyaṃ ^vṛṣākapi ^kaṃ kimartham ^amyamīṣi abhikupyasi | ekaḥ kiṃśabdaḥ pūraṇaḥ | yasya pitā ^indraḥ ahaṃ ^viśvasmāt ^uttaraḥ ||

avīrāmiva māmayaṃ śarārubhi manyate | utāhamasmi vīriṇīndrapatnī marutsakhā viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 9 || avīrāmiva | mām | ayam | śarāruḥ | abhi | manyate | uta | aham | asmi | vīriṇī | indrapatnī | marutsakhā | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||9||
mām indrāṇīm avīrāmiva abhi manyate vijānāti |
uta api ca indrapatnī indrasya bhāryā aham indrāṇī vīriṇī putravatī marutsakhā marudbhiryuktā ca asmi bhavāmi |
yasyā mama patiḥ indraḥ viśvasmāt uttaraḥ ||

saṃhotraṃ sma purā nārī samanaṃ vāva gacchati | vedhā ṛtasya vīriṇīndrapatnī mahīyate viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 10 || sam'hotram | sma | purā | nārī | samanam | vā | atra | gacchati | vedhāḥ | ṛtasya | vīriṇī | indrapatnī | mahīyate | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ || 10 ||
nārī strī ṛtasya satyasya vedhāḥ vidhātrī vīriṇī putravatī indrapatnī indrasya bhārye- ndrāṇī saṃhotraṃ sma sarmācīnaṃ yajñaṃ khalu samanaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ vā |
tasyā mama patiḥ indraḥ viśvasmāt uttaraḥ ||

indrāṇīmāsu subhagāmahaśravam | nahyasyā aparaṃ cana jarasā marate patirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 11 || indrāṇīm | āsu | nārīṣu | subhagām | aham | aśravam | nahi | asyāḥ | aparam | cana | jarasā | marate | patiḥ | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ || 11 ||
āsu saubhāgyavattayā prasiddhāsu nāriṣu strīṣu strīṇāṃ madhye indrāṇīṃ subhagāṃ saubhāgyavatīm aham indraḥ aśravam aśrauṣam |
kiṃca asyāḥ indrāṇyāḥ patiḥ pālakaḥ viśvasmāt uttaraḥ utkṛṣṭataraḥ indraḥ aparaṃ cana anyadjanajātamiva jarasā vayohānyā nahi marate na khalu mriyate |
tasmin pakṣe tvahamiti śabdo vṛṣākapiparatayā yojyaḥ |

nāhamindrāṇi rāraṇa sakhyurvṛṣākaperte | yasyedampyaṃ haviḥ priyaṃ deveṣu gacchati viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 12 || na | aham | indrāṇi | raraṇa | sakhyuḥ | vṛṣākapeḥ | ṛte | yasya | idam | apyam | haviḥ | priyam | deveṣu | gacchati | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ || 12 ||
1. ta-punarindrāṇī brūte | 2. ga-ta-bha- ‘ ghātuko ’ nāsti | 3. ta-bha1.2.4- ‘ strīṣu ’ nāsti | 4. ta-bha-utkṛṣṭaḥ | 5. ta-bha1.2.4.6.8-yasmin |
he indrāṇi aham indra: sakhyu: mama sakhibhūtāt vṛṣākaperete priyaṃ vṛṣākapiṃ vinā na raṇa na rame|
apyam apsu bhavamantrivāṃ saṃskṛtaṃ priyaṃ prītikaram idam upasthitaṃ havi: deveṣu devānāṃ madhye yasya mamendrasya sakāśaṃ gacchati|
he indrāṇi vṛṣākape: sakhyurindrāte'haṃ vṛṣākapinaṃ rārana na rame|
ghasat indra ukṣarṇa: priyaṃ kācitkaraṃ havirviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
vṛṣākapāyi | revati | su'putre | āt | ū~ iti | su'snuṣe | ghasat | te | indraḥ | ukṣarṇaḥ | priyam | kācit'karam | haviḥ | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'tarḥ ||13||
revati dhanavati suputre śobhanaputre susnuṣe śobhanasnuṣe he indrāṇi te tavā'yam indraḥ ukṣarṇaḥ secanasamarthān ādu anantarameva |
tatkaraṃ haviḥ priyam iṣṭaṃ kurviti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca te patiḥ indraḥ viśvasmāt uttaraḥ |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—' vṛṣākapāyi revati suputre madhyamena susnuṣe mādhyamikā vācā |
priyaṃ kuruṣva sukhācayakaraṃ haviḥ sarvasmācca indra uttaraḥ ' ( niru. 12. 9 ) iti ||
ukṣṇo hi me paśvadaśa sākaṃ pacanti viṃśatim |
utāhamadbhi pīva idubhā kukṣī pṛṇanti me viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
ukṣṇaḥ | hi | me | paśva'daśa | sākam | pacanti | viṃśatim | uta | aham | adbhi | pīvaḥ | it | ubhā | kukṣī | iti | pṛṇanti | me | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'tarḥ || 14 ||
me madarthaṃ pañcadaśa pañcadaśasaṃkhyākān viṃśatiṃ viṃśatisaṃkhyākāṃśca ukṣṇaḥ vṛṣabhān sākaṃ saha mama bhāryendrāṇyā preritā yaṣṭāraḥ pacanti |
uta api ca ahamabhi tān bhakṣayāmi |
jagdhvā cāhaṃ pīva it sthūla eva bhavāmīti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca me rāma ubhā ubhau kukṣī pṛṇanti somena pūrayanti yaṣṭāraḥ |
manthasta indra śaṃ hṛde yaṃ tai sunoti bhāvayuviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ ||
vṛṣabhaḥ | na | tigma'śṛṅgaḥ | antaḥ | yūthepu | roruvat | manthaḥ | te | indra | śam | hṛde | yam | tai | sunoti | bhāvayuḥ | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'tarḥ ||15||
tigmaśṛṅgaḥ tīkṣṇaśṛṅgaḥ vṛṣabho na yathā vṛṣabhaḥ yūthepu gosaṃghepu antaḥ madhye roruvat śabdaṃ kurvan gā abhiramayati tathā he indra tvaṃ māmabhiramayati śeṣaḥ |
1. ta-bha-maheṃdrasya | 2. ta-kiṃca tvaṃ | 3. tā1.2.3.6-sādhuvādinati | 4. ta-ubhau ca |

ᵥhe indra ᵥte tava ᵥhave hṛdayāya ᵥmantha: dakṣo mathanavelāyāṃ śabdaṃ kurvan ᵥśaṃ śaṃkaro bhavatviti śeṣa: | kiṃca ᵥte tumyaṃ ᵥyaṃ somaṃ ᵥbhāvayu: bhāvamicchantīndrāṇī ᵥsunoti abhipuṇoti so'pi śaṃkaro bhavatvityartha: | mama pati: ᵥindra: ᵥviśvasmāt ᵥuttara: || 3 || na seśe yasya rambate'ntarā sakadhyāi karpaṭ | sedīśe yasya romaśaṃ niṣeduṣau vijṛmbhate viśvasmādindra uttara: || 16 || na | sa: | īśe | yasya | rambate | antarā | sakadhyā | karpaṭ | sa: | it | īśe | yasya | romaśam | ni'seduṣa: | vi'jṛmbhate | viśvasmāt | indra: | uta'nera: || 16 || ᵥhe indra ᵥsa: jana: ᵥna ᵥīśe maithunaṃ kartuṃ neṣṭe na śaknoti

ayamemi vicārśadcinvanan dāsamāryam | pibāmi pākamutvano'bhi dhīramacākaśaṃ viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 19 || ayam | emi | vi'cārśat | vi'cinvanan | dāsam | āryam | pibāmi | pāka'sutvanaḥ | abhi | dhīram | acākaśam | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||19|| athendro bravīti | 'vicārśat paśyan yajamānān 'dāsam upakṣapayitāramasuram 'āryam api ca 'vicinvan pṛthakkurvan 'ayam ahamandraḥ 'emi yajñaṃ prati gacchāmi'| yajñaṃ gatvā ca 'pākasutvanaḥ | pacatīti pākaḥ | sunotīti sutvā | haviṣā pakkuḥ somasyābhipoturyajamānasya pākena vipakkena manasā somasyābhipotur yajamānasya saṃbandhine gomaṃ 'pibāmi | tathā 'dhīraṃ dhīmantaṃ yaja- mānam 'abhi 'acākaśam abhipaśyāmi | yo'ham 'indraḥ 'viśvasmāt 'uttaraḥ ||

dhanvaṃ ca yaktantraṃ ca kati strittā vi yojanā | nadīṃyasāṃ vṛṣākupaṃ'stamāṃhaṃ guhā upa viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 20 || dhanva | ca | yat | kuntatram | ca | kati | strit | nā | vi | yojanā | nedīyasaḥ | vṛṣākape | astam | ā | ihi | gṛhān | upa | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||20|| 'dhanva nirūdako'raṇyarahito deśaḥ | 'kuntatraṃ kartanīyamaraṇyam | 'yat yat 'ca 'dhanva 'ca kuntatraṃ ca bhavati | mṛgodvāsamaraṇyamevaṃvidhaṃ bhavati na tvatyantavipinam | tasya śatrunilayasyāsmadīya- gṛhasya ca madhye 'kati 'strit 'nā tāni 'yojanā yojanāni sthitāni | nātyantadūre tadbhavatīyarthaḥ | ataḥ 'nedīyasaḥ atiśayena samīpācchatrunilayāt he 'vṛṣākape tvam 'astam asmākaṃ gṛhaṃ 'vi 'gṛhi viśeṣeṇagaccha | āgatya ca 'gṛhān yajñagṛhān 'upa gaccha | yatāṃ'ham 'indraḥ 'sarvasmādutkṛṣṭaḥ ||

punarehi vṛṣākape suvitā kalpayāvahai | ya eṣa svapnunaṃśane'stumerṣi pathā punarviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 21 || punaḥ | ā | ihi | vṛṣākape | suvitā | kalpayāvahai | yaḥ | eṣaḥ | svapna'naṃśan | astam | erṣi | pathā | punaḥ | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||21|| āgatya pratigataṃ vṛṣākapimandro bravīti | he 'vṛṣākape tvaṃ 'punarehi asmān pratyāgaccha | āgate ca tvayi 'suvitā suvitāni kalyāṇīni tvaccittaprānikarāṇi karmāṇi 'kalpayāvahai indrāṇyahaṃ ca āvāmubhau paryālocya kuryāva | kiṃca 'yaḥ 'svapnanśanaḥ udayena sarvasya prāṇinaḥ svapmānāṃ nāśayitā ādityaḥ saḥ 'eṣaḥ 'tvaṃ 'pathā mārgeṇa 'astam ātmīyamāvāsaṃ 'punaḥ 'eṣi gacchasi | yato'ham 'indraḥ 'viśvasmāt 'uttaraḥ | tathā ca yāskaḥ---'suprasūtāni vaḥ karmāṇi kalpayāvahai ya eṣa svapna- naṃśan svapnānnāśayasyāditya udayena so'stamepi pathā punaḥ ' (niru. 12. 28) iti ||

yadudaśvo vṛṣākape gṛhamandrājargantana | kasya pulvagho mṛgaḥ karmagañjanayopano viśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 22 || yat | udaśvaḥ | vṛṣākape | gṛham | indra | arjagantana | kaḥ | sya | pulvaghaḥ | mṛgaḥ | kam | agan | jana'yopanaḥ | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||22||
he indra paramaiśvaryavan he vṛṣākape yūyam udaśvaḥ udgāminaḥ santo madraham arjagantana āgacchata |
tatra bhavataḥ sambandhī pulvaghaḥ bahūnāṃ bhaumarasānāṃ mattā syaḥ maḥ mṛgaḥ kva abhūt janayopanaḥ janānāṃ modayitā mṛgaḥ kaṃ vā deśam agan agacchan |
atra yāskaḥ—‘yadudaśvo vṛṣākape gṛhamandrājagata ka sya pulvagho mṛgaḥ ka sa bahādī mṛgaḥ |

parśurha nāma mānavī sākaṃ sasva viśatim | bhadraṃ bhal tyasyā abhūdyasyā udaramāmayadviśvasmādindra uttaraḥ || 23 || parśuḥ | ha | nāma | mānavī | sākam | sasva | viśatim | bhadram | bhal | tyasyāḥ | abhūt | yasyāḥ | udaram | āmayat | viśvasmāt | indraḥ | ut'taraḥ ||23||
mānavī manorduhiteyaṃ viśati viśatisaṃkhyākān putrān sākaṃ samūha arjāyanta |
tyasyai tasyai bhadraṃ bhajanīyaṃ kalyāṇam abhūt bhavatu |
tathā cānukrānta—‘rakṣohaṇaṃ pañcādhikā pāyurāmayaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ caturnupubantam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘dhiṣṇayāvanām’ ityādinā ‘pari tvāme puraṃ vayam’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 13) ityantena ||

rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinamā jigharmi mitraṃ prathiṣṭhamupa yāmi śarma | śiśāno agniḥ kratubhiḥ samiddhaḥ sa no divā sa riṣaḥ pātu naktam || 1 || rakṣaḥ'hanam | vājinam | ā | jigharmi | mitram | prathiṣṭham | upa | yāmi | śarma | śiśānaḥ | agniḥ | kratubhiḥ | sam'iddhaḥ | saḥ | naḥ | divā | saḥ | ripaḥ | pātu | naktam ||1||
rakṣohaṇaṃ rakṣāṃ hantāraṃ vājinaṃ balavantamannavantaṃ vāmim ā jigharmi ghṛtenājuhomi |
kiṃca mitraṃ yajamānānāṃ sakhāyaṃ prathiṣṭhaṃ pṛthutamaṃ śarma gṛham upa yāmi upagacchāmi |
2. ga4-indreṇa vijayamānaṃ śaramanena mantreṇa; ta-he iṃdra visṛjyamānaṃ anaṃtaramantreṇa; bha-he iṃdra visṛjyamānamena mantreṇa |
vagniḥ vśiśānaḥ jvālāstīkṣṇīkurvan vkratubhiḥ karmaparaiḥ puruṣaiḥ vsamiddhaḥ' prajvālito bhavati |
kiṃca vsaḥ agniḥ vnaḥ asmān vdivā ahani vripaḥ hiṃsakādrakṣasaḥ vpātu rakṣatu |
vsaḥ agniḥ vnaktaṃ rātrau cāsmān rakṣasaḥ pātu ||

ayardaṃṣṭro arciṣā yātudhānānupa spṛśa jātavedaḥ samiddhaḥ | ā jihvayā mūradevān rabhasva kravyādo vṛkttvarpi dhatsvāsan || 2 || ayaḥ'daṃṣṭraḥ | arciṣā | yātudhānān | upa | spṛśa | jātavedaḥ | sam'iddhaḥ | ā | jihvayā | mūra'devān | rabhasva | kravya'adaḥ | vṛkttvā | arpi | dhatsva | āsan ||2|| he vjātavedaḥ jātadhana jātaprajña vā tvaṃ vsamiddhaḥ samyagdīptaḥ vayardaṃṣṭraḥ ayomayadaṃṣṭraḥ | tīkṣṇa- daṃṣṭraḥ sanmiśryarthaḥ | vyātudhānān rākṣasān varciṣā jvālayā vupa vspṛśa maṃdahetyarthaḥ | kiṃca tvaṃ vmūradevān mūḍhadevān mārakavyāpārān rākṣasān vjihvayā jvālayā vā vrabhasva mārayetyarthaḥ | mārayitvā ca vkravyādaḥ māṃsabhakṣakān rākṣamān vvṛkttvā chitvā vāmana āsye vapi vdhatsva adhidhehi | ācchādayetyarthaḥ ||

ubhobhayāvinupa dhehi daṃṣṭrā hiṃsaḥ śiśāno'varaṃ paraṃ ca | utāntarikṣe pariṃ yāhi rājana jambhaiḥ saṃ dhehyabhi yātudhānān || 3 || ubhā | ubhayāvina | upa | dhehi | daṃṣṭrā | hiṃsaḥ | śiśānaḥ | avaram | param | ca | uta | antarikṣe | pari | yāhi | rājan | jambhaiḥ | sam | dhehi | abhi | yātudhānān ||3|| he vubhayāvin ubhābhyāṃ daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ yuktābhyāṃ tvaṃ vhiṃsaḥ rākṣasānāṃ hiṃsakastvaṃ vubhā ubhe vdaṃṣṭrā daṃṣṭre vśiśānaḥ tīkṣṇīkurvan vupa vdhehi vadhahetu rākṣaseṣu pratiṣṭhāpaya | kiṃca vavaraṃ vparaṃ vca jagat rakṣa | vuta api ca he vrājan dīptāme tvam vantarikṣe sthitān rākṣamān vpari vyāhi parigaccha | parigatya ca tān vyātudhānān rākṣamān vjambhaiḥ bhakṣaṇārthanabhūtābhiḥ daṃṣṭrābhiḥ vabhi vsaṃ vdhehi saṃyojaya | bhakṣayetyarthaḥ ||

yairiṣūḥ saṃna̭māno agre vācā śalyā~ aśanibhirdihānaḥ | tābhirvidhya hṛdaye yātudhānān pratīco bāhūna prati bhaḍdhyepām || 4 || yaiḥ | iṣūḥ | sam'na̭mānaḥ | agre | vācā | śalyān | aśanibhiḥ | dihānaḥ | tābhiḥ | vidhya | hṛdaye | yātudhānān | pratīcaḥ | bāhūna | prati | bhaḍdhi | eṣām || 4 || he vagne tvaṃ vyajñaiḥ asmadīyabalakairyāgaiḥ vvācā asmadīyayā stutyā ca viṣūḥ vakrān bāṇān vsaṃnamānaḥ saṃmanayan vśalyān tāmāṃ śalyān vaśanibhiḥ dīptibhiḥ vdihānaḥ tīkṣṇīkurvan vtābhiḥ iṣubhiḥ vyātudhānān rākṣasān vhṛdaye vvidhya | tataḥ veṣāṃ yātudhānānāṃ saṃbandhinḥ vpratīcaḥ yuddhāya tvāṃ pratigatan vbāhūna vprati vbhaḍdhi pratyāmardaya ||
1. bha-'samiddhaḥ' nāsti | 2. ta-ma1.4.7-'tāṃkṣaṇadaṃṣṭraḥ' nāsti | 3. ta1.2.3.6.7.8- bha-'daṃṣṭrābhiḥ' nāsti | 4. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha-saṃdihānaḥ | 5. ta-bha-'tvāṃ' nāsti |

agne tvacaiṃ yātudhānasya bhindhi hiṃsrānirherasā hantavenam | pra parvāṇi jātavedaḥ śṛṇīhi kravyātkreviṣṇurvi cinotu vṛkṇam || 5 || agne | tvacam | yātu'dhānasya | bhindhi | hiṃsrā | aśaniḥ | harasā | hantu | enam | pra | parvāṇi | jāta'vedaḥ | śṛṇīhi | kravya'at | kraviṣṇuḥ | vi | cinotu | vṛkṇam ||5|| he jātavedaḥ jātadhana jātaprajña vā agne tvaṃ yātudhānasya rākṣasasya tvacaṃ bhindhi dāraya | enaṃ bhinnatvacaṃ yātudhānaṃ hiṃsrā hiṃsanaśīla tada aśaniḥ vajraṃ harasā tāpena hantu hinastu | hatasya rākṣasasya parvāṇi śarīraparvāṇi ca pra śṛṇīhi chinddhyarthaḥ | chinneṣu ca śarīrasaṃdhiṣu satsu vṛkṇaṃ chinnamabhimenaṃ yātudhānaṃ kraviṣṇuḥ māṃsamicchan kravyāta māṃsabhakṣakaṃ vṛkādiḥ vi cinotu bhakṣayatvityarthaḥ || 5 ||
he ᵥyaviṣṭha yuvatama ᵥagne ᵥyaḥ ᵥyātudhānaḥ rākṣasa''smathajñavighnakārī ᵥyaḥ cānya''pi piśācādiḥ ᵥidaṃ yajñadūpaṇādi ᵥkaroti ᵥsaḥ ᵥyatamaḥ |
ᵥiha asminsvadviṣaya- yāgakarmaṇi vartamānāya mahyaṃ ᵥpra ᵥbrūhi |
ᵥtaṃ pāpakāriṇaṃ ᵥsamidhā svakīyena tejasā ᵥā ᵥrabhasva hantuṃ prārabhasva |
tataḥ ᵥenaṃ pāpiśaṃ ᵥnṛcakṣasaḥ nṛṇāṃ draṣṭastva ᵥcakṣupe tejase ᵥrandhaya vaśaṃ naya |
tīkṣṇenāgne cakṣuṣā rakṣa yajñaṃ prāśvaṃ vasubhyaḥ pra ṇaya pracetaḥ |
hiṃsraṃ rakṣāṃsyābhi śoṣucānaṃ mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā nṛcakṣaḥ ||
tīkṣṇena | agne | cakṣuṣā | rakṣa | yajñam | prāśvam | vasubhyaḥ | pra | naya | praceta iti pra'cetaḥ | hiṃsram | rakṣāṃsi | abhi | śoṣucānam | mā | tvā | dabhan | yātudhānāḥ | nṛ'cakṣaḥ || 9 ||
he ᵥagne tvaṃ ᵥtīkṣṇena tigmena ᵥcakṣuṣā tejasā ᵥyajñam asmadīyaṃ yāgaṃ ᵥrakṣa pālaya |
kiṃca he ᵥpracetaḥ prakṛṣṭajñānāgne ᵥprāśvaṃ prājñitāraṃ yajñaṃ ᵥvasubhyaḥ vasūnāmarthāya ᵥpra ᵥṇaya prakarṣeṇa naya |
kiṃca he ᵥnṛcakṣaḥ nṛṇāṃ draṣṭarame ᵥrakṣāṃsi ᵥhiṃsraṃ hiṃsanaśīlam ᵥabhi ᵥśoṣucānam abhipradīptaṃ ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥyātudhānāḥ rākṣasāḥ ᵥmā ᵥdabhan mā hiṃsiyuḥ ||
nṛcakṣaḥ rakṣaḥ pariṃ paśya viśva tasya trīṇi prati śṛṇīhyagrā |
tasyāgne pṛṣṭīrharasā śṛṇīhi tredhā mūlaṃ yātudhānasya vṛkṣa ||
nṛ'cakṣaḥ | rakṣaḥ | pari | paśya | viśva | tasya | trīṇi | prati | śṛṇīhi | agrā | tasya | agne | pṛṣṭīḥ | harasā | śṛṇīhi | tredhā | mūlam | yātu'dhānasya | vṛkṣa || 10 ||
he ᵥagne ᵥnṛcakṣaḥ nṛṇāṃ draṣṭā tvaṃ ᵥviśva manuṣyeṣu hiṃsakatvena vartamānaṃ ᵥrakṣaḥ rākṣasaṃ ᵥpari ᵥpaśya sarvato'valokaya |
avalokaya ca ᵥtasya rakṣasaḥ ᵥtrīṇi ᵥagrāṇi agrāṇi śirāṃsi ᵥprati ᵥśṛṇīhi chindvītyarthaḥ |
tataḥ ᵥtasya rakṣasaḥ ᵥpṛṣṭīḥ pārśvasthān rākṣasānapi ᵥharasā svakīyena tejasā ᵥśṛṇīhi māraya |
evaṃ ᵥtredhā ᵥyātudhānasya tasya rākṣasasya ᵥmūlaṃ pādaṃ ᵥvṛkṣa chindhi ||
triyātudhānaḥ prasiṃti ta etvṛtaṃ yo agne anṛtena hanti |
tamirṣā sphūrjaṃyajñātavedaḥ samakṣamainaṃ guṇate ni vṛddhi ||
triḥ | yātu'dhānaḥ | pra'sitim | te | etu | ṛtam | yaḥ | agne | anṛtena | hanti | tam | arciṣā | sphūrjayan | jātaḥ'vedaḥ | sam'akṣam | enam | guṇate | ni | vṛddhi || 11 ||
he ᵥjātavedaḥ jātaprajña ᵥagne ᵥte tvadīyaṃ ᵥprasiti jvālāprabandhanaṃ ᵥyātudhānaḥ rākṣasaḥ ᵥtriḥ trīnvārān ᵥetu gacchatu |
kiṃca ᵥyaḥ yātudhānaḥ rākṣasaḥ ᵥṛtaṃ satyam ᵥanṛtena asatyena ᵥhanti hinasti ᵥtaṃ yātudhānam ᵥarciṣā svakīyena tejasā ᵥsphūrjayan niṣpadyan |
ᵥenaṃ yātudhānaṃ ᵥguṇate stotraṃ kurvate mahyaṃ ᵥsamakṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ ᵥni ᵥvṛddhi |

tada̭gne॒ cakṣu॒ḥ prati̭ dhehi re॒bhe śa॒phārṷjaṃ yena॒ paśya̭si yātu॒dhāna̭m | atha̭rva॒jjyoti̭ṣā॒ daivyḙna sa॒tyaṃ dhūrva̭nta॒maci̭ta॒ṃ nyoṣa̭ || 12 || ta | a॒gne | cakṣṷḥ | prati̭ | dhe॒hi॒ | re॒bhe | śa॒pha'ā॒ru॒jam | yena̭ | paśya̭si | yā॒tu॒'dhāna̭m | a॒tha॒rva॒'vat | jyo̭ti॒ṣā | daivyḙna | sa॒tyam | dhūrva̭ntam | a॒ci॒tam | ni | oṣa̭ || 12 ||

he agne tvaṃ rebhe śabdāyamāne rākṣase tatta cakṣuḥ tejaḥ prati dhehi prakṣipa yena cakṣuṣā śaphārujaṃ śaphābhyāmārujantaṃ śaphasadṛśairnakhaiḥ sādhūnāmibhimukhyena bhakṣakaṃ yātudhānaṃ rākṣasaṃ paśyāmi |
kiṃca satyaṃ dhūrvantam amayane hiṃsantam acitam ajñānaṃ daivyena divi bhavena jyotiṣā tejasā atharvavat nyoṣa nitarāṃ daha |

yarda̭gne a॒dya mi॒thunā॒ śapā̭to॒ yadvā॒castṛ̭ṣṭa॒ṃ jana̭yanta re॒bhāḥ | ma॒nyormana̭sa॒ḥ śara॒vyā॒ jāya̭te॒ yā tayā̭ vidhya hṛda̭ye yātu॒dhāna̭n || 13 || yat | a॒gne | a॒dya | mi॒thunā̭ | śapā̭taḥ | yat | vā॒caḥ | tṛ॒ṣṭam | ja॒na॒ya॒nta | re॒bhāḥ | ma॒nyoḥ | ma॒nasa̭ḥ | śa॒ra॒vyā̭ | jā॒ya॒te | yā | tayā̭ | vi॒dhya | hṛda̭ye | yā॒tu॒'dhāna̭n || 13 ||
he agne yat yadā adya asminnahani mithunā strīpumaṃsau śapātaḥ parasparamākrośataḥ yata yadā rebhāḥ stotāraḥ vācaḥ saṃbandhi tṛṣṭaṃ kaṭukaṃ parasparākrośa lakṣaṇamadharaṃ vā janayanta |
tadā manyoḥ dīptasya kudrasya vā tatra |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—'manyurmanyaterdīpti- karmaṇaḥ krodhakarmaṇo vadhakarmaṇo vā' (niru. 10. 29) iti |
manasaḥ bhakāśāt yā śaravyā iṣuḥ jāyate tayā śaravyā yātudhānān rākṣamān hṛdaye vidhya tāḍaya |

pa॒rā śṛ̭ṇīhi॒ tapa̭sā yātu॒dhāna̭n pa॒rāgne॒ rakṣo॒ hara̭sā śṛ̭ṇīhi | pa॒rāci̭pā॒ mūrḙde॒vāñchṛ̭ṇīhi॒ parā̭su॒tapo॒ abhi̭ śośucānaḥ || 14 || pa॒rā | śṛ॒ṇī॒hi॒ | tapa̭sā | yā॒tu॒'dhāna̭n | pa॒rā | a॒gne | rakṣa̭ḥ | hara̭sā | śṛ॒ṇī॒hi॒ | pa॒rā | a॒rci॒ṣā | mū॒ra'de॒vān | śṛ॒ṇī॒hi॒ | parā̭ | a॒su॒'tapa̭ḥ | a॒bhi | śo॒śu॒cā॒naḥ || 14 ||
he agne yātudhānān tapasā tāpena parā śṛṇīhi māraya |
kiṃca rakṣo harasā tvadīyenauṣṇena parā śṛṇīhi |
kiṃca mūradevān mārakavyāpārān rākṣasān arciṣā svakīyena tejasā parā śṛṇīhi |
api ca asutupaḥ manuṣyāṇāmasubhistṛptā ye tānapi parā śṛṇīhītyarthaḥ ||

pa॒rādya̭ de॒vā vṛ॒jina̭ṃ śṛṇantu॒ pratya̭ge॒naṃ śapa̭thā yantu॒ tṛṣṭā̭ḥ | vā॒cāstḙna॒ṃ śara̭va ṛcchantu॒ marma̭n vi॒śvasyai̭tu॒ prasi̭tiṃ yātu॒dhāna̭ḥ || 15 || pa॒rā | a॒dya | de॒vāḥ | vṛ॒jina̭m | śṛ॒ṇa॒ntu॒ | pra॒tyak | e॒na॒m | śapa̭thāḥ | ya॒ntu॒ | tṛ॒ṣṭā̭ḥ | vā॒cā | ste॒nam | śara̭vaḥ | ṛ॒ccha॒ntu॒ | marma̭n | vi॒śvasya̭ | e॒tu॒ | pra॒si̭tim | yā॒tu॒'dhāna̭ḥ || 15 ||
vaadya asmin ahani vadevā: agnipurogā: sarve devā: vavṛjinaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇairvarjitāraṃ yātudhānaṃ vaparā vaśṛṇvantu |
atha vaenam āyāntaṃ rākṣasaṃ vatṛṣā: kaṭukā asmābhiruktā: vaśapathā: vapratyak vayantu |
kiṃca vavācāstenam anutavacanamenaṃ yātudhānaṃ vaśarava: śarā: vamarman marmaṇi vaṛcchantu gacchantu |
tathā ca yāska:—‘prasiti: prasanattanturvā4 jālaṃ vā’ (niru. 6. 12) iti |
ya: pauruṣeyeṇa kraviṣā samaṅkte yo aśvyena paśunā yātudhāna: |
yo aghnyāyā bharati kṣīramagre teṣāṃ śīrṣāṇi harasāpi vṛśca ||
ya: | pauruṣeyeṇa | kraviṣā | sama'aṅkte | ya: | aśvyena | paśunā | yātu'dhāna: | ya: | aghnyāyā: | bharati | kṣīram | agne | teṣām | śīrṣāṇi | harasā | api | vṛśca || 16 ||
vaya: vayātudhāna: rākṣasa: vapauruṣeyeṇa puruṣasambandhinā vakraviṣā māṃsena vasamaṅkte ātmānaṃ saṃgama- yati |
yo vā yātu- dhāno'nyena vapaśunā ātmānaṃ saṃgamayati |
vaya: vā yātudhāna: vaaghnyāyā: go: vakṣīraṃ vabharati harati |
he vaagne tvaṃ vateṣāṃ sarveṣāmapi rākṣasānāṃ vaśīrṣāṇi śirāṃsi vaharamā tvadīyena tejasā vavṛśca chindhi ||
saṃvatsarīṇam | parya | usriyāyā: | tasya | mā | aśīt | yātu'dhāna: | nu'cakṣa: | pīyūṣam | agne | yatamāt | titṛpsāt | tam | pratyañcam | arciṣā | vidhva | marman || 17 ||
he vanṛcakṣa: nṛṇāṃ draṣṭa: vaagne vausriyāyā: asmadīyāyā go: |
vasaṃvatsarīṇaṃ saṃvatsareṇa bhavaṃ yat vapatha: asti vayātudhāna: rākṣasa: vatasya vamāśīt tatpaya: mā bhakṣayatu |
kiṃca vayatamā: yo rākṣasa: vapīyūṣaṃ pīyūṣeṇa |
asmadīyāyā go: payasā vatitṛpsāt ātmānaṃ tarpayitumicchati vataṃ vapratyañcaṃ yuddhāyāramānaṃ pratigataṃ rākṣasaṃ vamarman marmaṇi prāṇaviyogasthāne vaarciṣā svakīyena tejasā vavidhva tāḍaya |
viṣaṃ gavāṃ yātudhānā: pibantvā vṛścyantāmaditaye durevā: |
pairainān deva: savitā dadātu parā bhāgamoṣadhīnāṃ jayantām ||
viṣam | gavām | yātu'dhānā: | pibantu | ā | vṛścyantām | aditaye | du:'evā: | pairainān | deva: | savitā | dadātu | parā | bhāgam | oṣadhīnām | jayantām || 18 ||
he agne vayātudhānā: rākṣasā: vagavāṃ paśūnāṃ gṛhe sthitaṃ vaviṣaṃ vapibantu |
kiṃca vaaditaye adityarthaṃ vadurevā: dumbarā yātudhānā: vaā vavṛścyantāṃ tvadīyerāyudhairācchidyantām |
kiṃca vasavitā vadeva: vaenān rākṣasān vaparā vadadātu hiṃsebhya: prayacchatu |
api ca te'mī rākṣasā: vaoṣadhīnāṃ svabhūtaṃ vabhāgaṃ bhajanīyamannaṃ vaparā vajayantāṃ labhantāmityartha: ||
1. ga-ta-bha1.2.4.6.8-śṛṇtu parāśrṛṇvantu | 2. ta-pratyayenamāyaṃtu | 3. ga-ta4-kiṃca viśvasya | 4. ga-ta-bha-prasahanāt turvā | 5. ga4-na labhaṃtāmityartha: |

sanādagre mṛṇasi yātudhānān tvā rakṣāṃsi pṛtanāsu jigyuḥ | anu daha sahamūrān kravyādo mā tai hetyā mukṣat daivyāyāḥ || 19 || sanāt | agne | mṛṇasi | yātudhānān | na | tvā | rakṣāṃsi | pṛtanāsu | jigyuḥ | anu | daha | sahamūrān | kravya'adaḥ | mā | te | hetyāḥ | mukṣat | daivyāyāḥ || 19 ||
he agne tvaṃ sanāt cirādevārabhya yātudhānān rākṣasān mṛṇasi bādhase |
tathāpi tvā tvāṃ pṛtanāsu saṃgrāmeṣu rakṣāṃsi rākṣasāḥ na jigyuḥ nājayan |
kiṃca sa tvamadhunā anu anukrameṇa sahamūrān mūlena sahitān mārakavyāpāreṇa yuktān kravyādaḥ māṃsabhakṣakān rākṣasān daha tejasā bhasmīkuru |
kiṃca nava saṃbandhanaḥ daivyāyāḥ daivyāt hetyāḥ āyudhāt te yātudhānāḥ mā mukṣata muktā mā bhūvan ||
tvaṃ nau agne adharādudaktāttvaṃ paścāduta rakṣā purastāt |
pari̭ | tvā | agne | pura̭m | vaya̭m | vipra̭m | saha̭sya | dhīmahi | dhṛ॒ṣa॒dvarṇa̭m | divḙdi॒ve | ha॒ntāra̭m | bhaṅgura̭vetām | || 22 ||

ha ⋁mahasya mahase hita sahamo jāta vā ⋁agne ⋁puraṃ pūrakaṃ ⋁vipraṃ medhāvinaṃ ⋁dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dharṣakarūpaṃ ⋁bhaṅgurāvatāṃ bhaṅgurakarmayuktānāṃ rakṣasāṃ ⋁divedive pratyahaṃ ⋁hantāraṃ hiṃsitāraṃ ⋁tvā tvāṃ ⋁vayaṃ pāyunāmadheyā bhāradvājā rakṣasāṃ hananāya ⋁pari ⋁dhīmahi ||
vi॒peṇa̭ bhaṅgu॒rāva̭taḥ | prati̭ ṣma | rakṣa̭so | daha | agnḙ | ti॒gmena̭ | śo॒ciṣā̭ | tapṷra॒grābhi̭ḥ | || 23 ||

viṣeṇaṃ | bhaṅguravataḥ | prati | sma | rakṣasaḥ | daha | agne | tigmena | śociṣā | tapuḥ ⋁agrābhiḥ | ⋁ṛṣṭibhiḥ | || 23 || he ⋁agne tvaṃ ⋁bhaṅgurāvataḥ bhañjanakarmayuktāna ⋁rakṣasaḥ rākṣasān ⋁vipeṇa vyāsena ⋁tigmena tīkṣṇena ⋁śociṣā tejamā ⋁prati ⋁daha bhasmīkuru | tathā ⋁tapuragrābhiḥ tapanaśīlāgrābhiḥ ⋁ṛṣṭibhiḥ | ṛṣṭya āyudhaviśeṣāḥ | tābhirapi prati daha ||
pratya̭gne | mi॒thunā̭ | daha | yātu॒dhānā̭ | kimīdi॒nā | saṃ | tvā | śi॒śāmi̭ | jā॒gṛ॒hyada̭bdham | vipra̭ | ma॒rma̭bhiḥ | || 24 ||

prati | agne | mithunā | daha | yātudhānā | kimīdinā | sam | tvā | śiśāmi | jāgṛhi | adabdham | vipra | marmabhiḥ | || 24 || he ⋁agne tvaṃ ⋁mithunā mithunabhūtāni ⋁kimīdinā | kimīdanīmiti ye caranti te kimīdinaḥ | tān | tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘ kimīdine kimīdanīmiti carate kimidaṃ kimidamiāti vā ’ ( niru. 6. 11 ) iti | ⋁yātudhānā yātudhānātrākṣamān ⋁prati ⋁daha | kiṃca he ⋁vipra medhāvinnagne ⋁adabdhaṃ kenāpyahiṃsitaṃ ⋁tvā tvāṃ ⋁manmabhiḥ stutibhirahaṃ ⋁saṃ ⋁śiśāmi staumītyarthaḥ | atastvaṃ ⋁jāgṛhi nidrāṃ mā kuru | budhyasvetyarthaḥ ||
pratya̭gne | hara̭sā | harḙ | śṛ॒ṇīhi | viśva̭taḥ | prati̭ | yātu॒dhāna̭sya | rakṣa̭saḥ | bala̭m | vi | ru॒ja | vī॒rya̭m | || 25 ||

prati | agne | harasā | hareḥ | śṛṇīhi | viśvataḥ | prati | yātudhānasya | rakṣasaḥ | balam | vi | ruja | vīryam | || 25 || he ⋁agne tvaṃ ⋁harasā svadīyena tejasā | tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘ haro haraterjyotirhara ucyate ’ ( niru. 4. 19 ) iti | ⋁yātudhānasya rākṣasasya ⋁haraḥ haraṇaśīlaṃ ⋁balaṃ ⋁prati ⋁śṛṇīhi nāśaye- tyarthaḥ | tathā ⋁rakṣasaḥ rākṣasasya ⋁vīryaṃ ca ⋁vi ⋁ruja bhañjaya || || 9 ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘havirekonāṅgiraso mūrdha- nvānnāmadevyo vā sauryavaiśvānarīyam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘haviṣpāntamamirhotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 8) iti ||
tasya bharmaṇe bhuvanāya devā dharmaṇe svadhayā prapadhanta ||
haviḥ | pāntam | ajaram | svaḥ | vide | divi'spṛśi | ā'hutam | juṣṭam | agnau | tasya | bharmaṇe | bhuvanāya | devāḥ | dharmaṇe | kam | svadhayā | prapadhanta || 1 ||

vpāntaṃ pānīyaṃ somātmakam vajaraṃ jarārahitaṃ vjuṣṭaṃ devānāṃ priyaṃ yan vhaviḥ vsvarvivi sūryasya veditari vdivispṛśi divi spaṣṭari vagnau vāhutamabhihutaṃ vtasya somātmakasya haviṣaḥ vbharmaṇe bharaṇāya vbhuvanāya bhāvanāya ca vdharmaṇe dhāraṇāya ca vkaṃ sarvasya sukhakaramimamagniṃ vdevāḥ vsvadhayā annena vprapadhanta prathayanti |

tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘havirhvānīyamajaraṃ sūryavidi divispṛ- ṣṭyihutaṃ juṣṭamau tasya bharaṇāya ca bhāvanāya ca dhāraṇāya caitebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ karmabhyo devā imamabhi- mannenāprapadhanta’ (niru. 7. 25) iti ||
tasya devāḥ pṛthivī dyautāporaṇyoṣadhīḥ sakhye asya ||
gīrṇam | bhuvanam | tamasā | apa'gūḻam | āviḥ | svaḥ | abhavat | jāte | agnau | tasya | devāḥ | pṛthivī | dyauḥ | uta | āpaḥ | araṇyan | oṣadhīḥ | sakhye | asya ||2||

vgīrṇaṃ pūrvaṃ nigīrṇaṃ vtamasā andhakāreṇa vapagūḻam ācchāditaṃ vsvaḥ sarvaṃ vbhuvanam vagnau yasmin vaiśvānare vjāte utpanne sati vāviḥ vabhavat āvirbhavati vtasya vasya vaiśvānarasyāgneḥ vsakhye sakhyakarmaṇi vdevāḥ indrādayaḥ vpṛthivī bhūmiśca vdyauḥ ca vāpaḥ antarikṣaṃ codakāni ca voṣadhīḥ oṣadhyaśca varaṇyan aramanta |
yo bhānunā pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāmātatān rodasī antarikṣam ||
devebhiḥ | nu | ipitaḥ | yajñaiyebhiḥ | agnim | stoṣāṇi | ajaram | bṛhantam | yaḥ | bhānunā | pṛthivīm | dyām | uta | imām | ā'tatān | rodasī iti | antarikṣam ||3||
vyajñaiyebhiḥ yajñārhaiḥ vdevebhiḥ devairindrādibhiḥ vnu kṣipram viṣitaḥ aham vajaraṃ jarārahitaṃ vbṛhantaṃ mahāntam vagniṃ taṃ vaiśvānaragniṃ vstopāṇi stopāmi |
vyaḥ vaiśvānarāgniḥ vbhānunā tejasā vpṛthivīṃ bhūmim vuta api ca vimāṃ vdyāṃ divaṃ ca vātatāna ātanoti |
1. ta-bhuvanaṃ gīrṇaṃ; bha1.2.7-pūrṇa nigīrṇaṃ | 2. ga-iṣitaḥ preṣitaḥ | 3. ga-mu-staumi | 4. ga-ta4.5-antarikṣaṃ ca; ta1.2.3-mu-cāṃtarikṣaṃ ca |
yo hotāsītprathamo devajuṣṭo yaṃ samāñjanājyainā vṛṇānāḥ |
yaḥ | hotā | āsīt | prathamaḥ | devajuṣṭaḥ | yam | sam | añjan | ājyena | vṛṇānāḥ | maḥ | patatri | tvaram | sthā | jagat | yat | śvātram | agniḥ | akṛṇot | jātavedāḥ ||4||

yaḥ vaiśvānaro'gniḥ devajuṣṭaḥ devaiḥ sevitaḥ prathamaḥ mukhyaḥ hotā āsīt abhūt yaṃ ca vaiśvānaraṃ yajamānāḥ vṛṇānāḥ ājyena samāñjan samañjanti jātavedāḥ jātaprajño jātadhanā vā saḥ vaiśvānaraḥ agniḥ patatri patanaśīlaṃ pakṣajātam tvaraṃ gamanaśīlaṃ sarīsṛpādikaṃ sthā sthāvaraṃ vṛkṣādirūpaṃ ca jagat |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘sa patatri cetvaraṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yatkṣipramagnirakurutajātavedāḥ’ (niru.5.3) iti ||
yajjātavedo bhuvanasya mūrdhannatiṣṭho agre saha rocanena |
taṃ tvāhama matibhirgīrbhirṛkthaiḥ sa yajñiyo abhavo rodasiprāḥ ||
yat | jātavedaḥ | bhuvanasya | mūrdhan | atiṣṭhaḥ | agre | saha | rocanena | tam | tvā | aham | matibhiḥ | gīḥbhiḥ | ukthaiḥ | saḥ | yajñiyaḥ | abhavaḥ | rodasiprāḥ ||5||

he jātavedaḥ jātaprajña agne yat yastvaṃ bhuvanasya trailokyasya mūrdhan mūrdhani rocanena ādityena saha atiṣṭhaḥ sthitavānasi taṃ vaiśvānaraṃ tvā tvāṃ matibhiḥ arcanīyābhiḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ ukthaiḥ śastraiśca aham prapadyāmahe |
saḥ vaiśvānaratvaṃ rodasiprāḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ pūrayitā yajñiyaḥ yajñārhaśca abhavaḥ bhavasi ||
mūrdhā bhuvo bhavati naktamagniratataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyan |
mūrdhā | bhuvaḥ | bhavati | naktam | agniḥ | tataḥ | sūryaḥ | jāyate | prātaḥ | ut'yana | māyām | ūṃ iti | tu | yajñiyānām | etām | apaḥ | yat | turṇīḥ | carati | prajānan ||6||
agniḥ vaiśvānaro'gniḥ naktaṃ rātrau bhuvaḥ bhūtajātasya mūrdhā śirovatpradhānabhūtaḥ bhavati |
kiṃca yajñiyānāṃ yajñapādināṃ devānāṃ māyāmu praśābheva etāṃ manyante kavaya iti śeṣaḥ |
yat prajānan prajñāyamānaḥ sūryaḥ turṇīḥ svaramāṇaḥ san apaḥ antarikṣaṃ karma vā carati |
tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘mūrdha mūrtamasmindhīyate mūrdhā yaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ bhavati naktamabhirataḥ sūryo jāyate prātarudyansa eva’ |
prajñāṃ tvetāṃ manyante yajñiyānāṃ devānāṃ yajñasaṃpādinā- mapo yatkarma carati prajānansarvāṇi sthānānyanusaṃcarati svaramāṇaḥ ’ (niru. 7. 27) iti ||
dṛśyendyaḥ | yaḥ | mahinā | sam'īṅgaḥ | arocata | dvividyoniḥ | vibhā'rvā | tasmin | agnau | sūkta'vākena | devāḥ | haviḥ | viśve | ā | ājuhavuḥ | tanu'pāḥ ||7||

yaḥ vaiśvānaro'gniḥ mahinā mahattvena dṛśyendyaḥ sarvadarśanīyaḥ samiddhaḥ samyagdīptaḥ dvivi- yoniḥ dyusthānaḥ vibhāvā dīptimāṃśca san arocata dīpyate tasmin vaiśvānare agnau tanpāḥ śarīrāṇāṃ rakṣakāḥ viśve sarve devāḥ sūktavākena 'idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī' ityādivākyena stotrāṇāṃ vacanena vā haviḥ ājuhavuḥ ābhimukhyena juhuvuḥ ||
sa eṣāṃ yajño abhavattanupāstaṃ dyaurveda taṃ pṛthivī tamārpaḥ ||
sūkta'vākam | prathamam | āt | it | agnim | āt | it | haviḥ | ajanayanta | devāḥ | saḥ | eṣām | yajñaḥ | abhavat | tanu'pāḥ | tam | dyauḥ | veda | tam | pṛthivī | tam | āpaḥ ||8||
prathamaṃ pūrvaṃ sūktavākam 'idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī' ityādi vākyaṃ manasā nirūpayanti ādita anantarameva agniṃ mathanenotpādayanti āditya anantarameva devāḥ havirajanayanta janayanti |
saḥ vaiśvānaro'gniḥ eṣāṃ devānāṃ yajñaḥ yaṣṭavyaḥ abhavat bhavati |
saḥ tanpāḥ śarīrāṇāṃ rakṣitā ca bhavati |
tam agniṃ dyauḥ dyulokaḥ veda jānāti |
tam agniṃ pṛthivī bhūmirapi ca jānāti |
tam agnim āpaḥ antarikṣaṃ ca jānāti ||
yam | devāsaḥ | ajanayanta | agnim | yasmin | ā | ājuhavuḥ | bhuvanāni | viśvā | maḥ | arciṣā | pṛthivīm | dyām | uta | imām | ṛju'yamānaḥ | atapat | mahi'tvā ||9||

yaṃ vaiśvānaram agniṃ devāsaḥ devāḥ ajanayanta utpāditavantaḥ yasmin ca utpanne vaiśvānare'gnau viśvā viśvāni bhuvanāni bhūtāni ājuhavuḥ ābhimukhyena juhuvuḥ sarvamedhe saḥ vaiśvānaro'gniḥ arciṣā tejasā pṛthivīm antarikṣam |
dyāṃ divaṃ ca uta api ca imāṃ bhūmiṃ ca ṛjuyamānaḥ ṛjugamanaḥ mahitvā mahattvena atapat sarvaṃ tapati ||
stomena hi divi devāso agniṃrjījanañchaktibhī rodasīprām |
tamū akṛṇvantredhā bhuve kaṃ sa oṣadhīḥ pacati viśvarūpāḥ ||
stomena | hi | divi | devāsaḥ | agnim | ajījanan | śakti'bhiḥ | rodasī'prām | tam | ū~ | iti | akṛṇvan | tredhā | bhuve | kam | saḥ | oṣadhīḥ | pacati | viśva'rūpāḥ ||10||
1. ga4-ta1.2.5.6-ābhimukhyenājuhavuḥ; ta4-ābhimukhyenājuhuvuḥ; bha1.4.6-ābhimukhyena juhuvuḥ; bha7-ābhimukhyena jahuvuḥ |
vdevāsa: devā: vśaktibhi: karmabhi: vrodasaprāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyorāpūrayitāram vagniṃ sūryātmakaṃ vdivi dhuloke vstomena vhi stutyā khalu vajījanan utpāditavantaḥ |
api ca vtamu tameva vkaṃ sukhakarama.meṃ yajñe vtredhā vbhuve tredhābhāvāya vakṛṇvan kurvanti |
vsa: pṛthivyāṃ vartamāna: vviśvarūpā: sarvarūpā: vopadhī: brīhyādyāstena tenopakāreṇa vpacati |
atra yāska:—‘ stomena yaṃ hi divi devā- so'bhimajanayan śaktibhi: v karmabhirvāpṛthivyo: pūraṇaṃ tamakurvastredhābhāvāya pṛthivyāmantarikṣe divīti śākapūṇi: |
yadasya divi tṛtīyaṃ tadasāvāditya iti hi brāhmaṇam’ ( niru. 7.28 ) iti ||
yadā | it | enam | adadhu: | yajñiyāsa: | divi | devā: | sūryam | ādityam | yadā | cariṣṇū iti | mithunau | abhūtām | āt | it | pra | apaśyan | bhuvanāni | viśvā || 11 ||
vyandet yadaiva prāta: vādityam adita: putraṃ vsūryam venam agniṃ ca vyajñiyāsa: yajñārhā: vdevā: vdivi dhuloke vadadhu: dhṛtavantaḥ |
vyadā cemau vcariṣṇū caraṇaśīlau sūryavaiśvānarau vmithunā- vabhūtāṃ prādurabhūtām |
vāditan anantarameva vviśvā viśvāni vbhuvanāni bhūtajātāni vprāpaśyan tau paśyanti |
atra yāska:—‘ yadainamadadhuryajñiyā: sarve divi devā: sūryamadite: putraṃ yadā cariṣṇū mithunau prādurabhūtāṃ sarvadā sahacāriṇāvupāśvādityaśca |
mithunau kasmānbhinoti: śrayatikarmā thu iti nāmakaraṇasthakāro vā nayati: paro vanivā samāśritāvanyonyaṃ nayato vanuto vā |
manuṣyamithunāpye- tasmādeva methantāvanyonyaṃ vanuta iti vā ’ ( niru. 7. 29 ) iti ||
viśvasmā agniṃ bhuvanāya devā vaiśvānaraṃ ketumadhāmakṛṇvan |
ā yastatānoṣasī vibhātīrūrṇāti tamo arciṣā yan ||
viśvasme | agnim | bhuvanāya | devā: | vaiśvānaram | ketum | ahrām | akṛṇvan | ā | ya: | tatāna | upasa: | vi'bhātī: | ūrṇāti | tama: | arciṣā | yan || 12 ||
vdevā: indrādaya: vviśvasme vbhuvanāya vvaiśvānaraṃ viśvanarahitam vagniṃ vahnāṃ divasānāṃ vketuṃ prajñāpakam vakṛṇvan akurvan |
vya: vaiśvānaro'gni: vupaso vvibhātī: vividhaṃ dīpyamāna: vā vtatāna vistārayati |
kiṃca so'yaṃ vyan gacchan vtama: andhakāram varciṣā tejamā vapo vūrṇāti apagamayati ||
vaiśvānaram | kavaya: | yajñiyāsa: | agnim | devā: | ajanayan | ajūryam | nakṣatram | pratnam | arbhinat | cariṣṇu | yakṣasya | adhyakṣam | taviṣam | bṛhantam || 13 ||
1. ta1.3-ma-hi yaṃ | 2. ma-‘śaktibhi:’ nāsti | 3. ta1.2.7-āpūraṇaṃ | 4. ga-ta2.7- sūryamādityamadite: putraṃ; ta1.6-sūryamādite: yamadite putraṃ | 5. ga-ta-viśvasmai sarvasmai | 6. ta-bha- havanāya |
ᵥkavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ ᵥyajñiyāsaḥ yajñārhā yajñasaṃpādino vā ᵥdevāḥ ᵥajuryaṃ jarāvarjitamahiṃsyaṃ vā ᵥvaiśvānaraṃ viśvanarahitaṃ sūryātmakam ᵥagnim ᵥajanayan utpāditavantaḥ |
sa ca devairūpādito'gniḥ ᵥnakṣatraṃ kṛttikādi ᵥpraśnaṃ purāṇaṃ ᵥcariṣṇu caraṇaśīlaṃ ᵥyakṣasya |
yakṣasya pūjyasya devasya ᵥadhyakṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ svāminaṃ vā ᵥtaviṣaṃ vṛddhaṃ ᵥbṛhantaṃ mahāntam ᵥaminat hiṃsitavān |
vaiśvānaraṃ viśvahā dīdivāṃsaṃ mantrairabhi kṛvimacchā vadāmaḥ |
yo mahimnā paribhūvūrvī utāvastāduta devaḥ purastāt ||
tathā ca nigamamāntaram—' uta manye'hamenamanyorhi śirastoḍayaṃ prātarjāyate ' iti |
arcanīyayā stutyā ^vimṛṣṭaṃ śodhitaṃ saṃskṛta- magniṃ ^bibhrataḥ dhārayataḥ |
^saḥ ^aprayucchan apramādyan ^taraṇiḥ kṣipakārī ^ājamānaḥ dīpyamāno'gbhiḥ ^viśvā viśvāni ^bhuvanāni ^pratyaṅ abhimukhaḥ ^tasthau tiṣṭhati |
tathā ca śrūyate—' tasmātsarvaṃ eva manyante māṃ pratyudagāt ' ( tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 4. 2 ) iti ||

yatrā vadate avaraḥ paraśca yajñanyoḥ kataro nau vi veda | ā śeṃkuritsadhrmādaṃ sakhāyo nakṣanta yajñaṃ ka idaṃ vi vocat || 17|| yatra | vadate iti | avaraḥ | paraḥ | ca | yajña'nyoḥ | kataraḥ | nau | vi | veda | ā | śeṃkuḥ | ita | sadhra'mādam | sakhāyaḥ | nakṣanta | yajñam | kaḥ | idam | vi | vocat ||17||

^yatra yasminkāle ^avaraḥ pārthivo'gnirdivyo hotā ^paraśca madhyamo vāyuśca ubhau ^vadate vivādaṃ kurvāte ^yajñanyoḥ yajñasya netroḥ ^nau āvayormadhye ^kataraḥ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yajñaṃ ^vi ^veda vetti tatra ^sakhāyaḥ samānakhyānā ṛtvijaḥ ^sadhramādaṃ yajñam ^ā ^śekuḥ kartuṃ śaknuvanti |
tathā ^yajñaṃ ^nakṣanta abhinuvate'nutiṣṭhanti ca ye teṣāṃ viduṣāṃ yajñamanuvānānāṃ madhye ^kaḥ vidvānnuṣṭhātā vā ^idam asya vivādasya nirṇayarūpaṃ vākyaṃ ^vi ^vocat bravīti |

tathā ca yāskaḥ— ' yatra vivadate daivyau hotāravyaṃ cāgnimau ca madhyamaḥ kataro nau yajñe bhūyo vedetyāśukurvanti tatsaha- madanaṃ samānakhyānā ṛtvijasteṣāṃ yajñaṃ sama'nuvānānāṃ ko na idaṃ vivakṣyati ' ( niru. 7. 30 ) iti||

katyagnayaḥ kati sūryāḥ katyupāsaḥ katyu stridārpaḥ | nopaspijaṃ vaḥ pitaro vadāmi pṛcchāmi vaḥ kavayo vidmane kam || 18|| kati | agnayaḥ | | kati | sūryāḥ | | kati | upasaḥ | | kati | ū~ iti | strit | āpaḥ | | na | upa'spijam | vaḥ | pitaraḥ | vadāmi | pṛcchāmi | vaḥ | kavayaḥ | | vidmane | kam ||18||
kiṃ taryahamajānan he ^kavayaḥ medhāvinaḥ yuṣmān ^vidmane vijñānāya ^kaṃ sukhaṃ varūpaparyālocanakleśamantareṇa ^pṛcchāmi |
atrottarāṇi vālakhilyasaṃhitāyāṃ darśitāni—' eka evāgnirbahudhā samiddha ekaḥ sūryo viśvamanu prabhūtaḥ |
ekaivoṣāḥ sarvamidaṃ vibhātyekaṃ vā idaṃ vi babhūva sarvam ' ( ṛ. saṃ. 8. 58. 2 ) iti ||

yāvanmātramuṣaso na pratīkaṃ suparṇyo vasate mātariśvaḥ | tāvaddhātyupa yajñamāyan brāhmaṇo hoturavaro niṣīdan || 19|| yāvat'mātram | upasaḥ | | na | pratīkam | su'parṇyau | vasate | mātariśvaḥ | | tāvat | dadhāti | upa | yajñam | ā'yan | brāhmaṇaḥ | hoturaḥ | avaraḥ | ni'sīdan ||19||
prakṛtasya vaiśvānarasya viṣaye yaḥ prabhastasya nirṇayamanayā vadanti|
he mātariśvaḥ mātaryantarikṣe śvasan mādhyamika vāyo yāvanmātraṃ yāvadeva suparṇyaḥ supatanā rātrayaḥ upasaḥ pratīkaṃ mukhaṃ prakāśālyaṃ darśanaṃ vā|
vasate ācchādayanti tāvat eva brāhmaṇaḥ hotā avaraḥ nikṛṣṭaḥ hotṛḥ asyāmevaiśvānarasya daivyasya hotṛḥ niṣīdan hautraṃ karma kartumupaviśan yajñamāyan upagacchan upa dadhāti|

tathā ca yāskaḥ—‘yāvanmātramupasaḥ pratyaktaṃ bhavati pratidarśanamiti vāstyupamānasya saṃpratyarthe prayoga iheva niṣedhīti yathā suparṇyaḥ supatanā etā rātrayo vasate mātariśvañjyotirvarṇasya tāvadupadadhāti yajñamāgacchan brāhmaṇo hotāsyāme-hauturavaro niṣīdan hotṛpastvanabhivaiśvānarayo bhavati’ (niru. 7. 31) iti||
‘indraṃ stava’ ityaṣṭādaśacaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśāmitrasya reṇorāpaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram|
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘indraṃ stava dyūnā reṇuḥ’ iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘sūryastutā yaśaskāmaḥ pibā somamabhīndraṃ steveti madhyaṃdinaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 8) iti||

indraṃ stavā nṛtamaṃ yasya mhā viṃbabādhe raucanā vi jmo antān| ā yaḥ pṛgrau carṣaṇīdhṛtorbhiḥ pra sindhubhyo riricāno mahitvā ||1|| indram| stava| nṛtamam| yasya| mhā| tri'babādhe| rocanā| vi| jmaḥ| antān| ā| yaḥ| pṛgrau| carṣaṇīdhṛta| varaḥ'bhiḥ| pra| sindhubhyaḥ| riricānaḥ| mahitvā||1||
he stotaḥ tvaṃ nṛtamaṃ netṛtamam indraṃ stava stuhi|
yaḥ cendraḥ carṣaṇīdhṛta manuṣyāṇāṃ dhartā sindhubhyaḥ samudrebhyo'pi mahitvā mahatvena pra riricānaḥ pravardhamānaśca san varobhiḥ tamasāṃ vārakaistejobhiḥ ā pṛgrau dyāvāpṛthivyāvāpūrayati||

sa sūryaḥ paryṷrū varāṃsyendrau vavṛtyādrathyaiva cakrā| atiṣṭhantamupasyaṃ na sargaṃ kṛṣṇā tamāṃṃsi tviṣyā jaghāna ||2|| saḥ| sūryaḥ| pra| uru| varāṃsi| ā| indraḥ| vavṛtyāt| rathyaḥ'iva| cakrā| atiṣṭhantam| apasyam| na| sargam| kṛṣṇā| tamāṃsi| tviṣyā| jaghāna||2||
sūryaḥ suvīryaḥ saḥ prasiddhaḥ indraḥ uru bahūni varāṃsi tejāṃsi pari ā vavṛtyāt paryāvartayati|
rathyaiva yathā sārathī rathasambandhīni cakrā cakrāṇi āvartayati tadvadiṣṭyarthaḥ|
kiṃca so'yam atiṣṭhantaṃ śīghraṃ gacchantam apasyaṃ na karmaṇyamiva sargam|
taṃ kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāni tamāṃṃsi tviṣyā dīptyā jaghāna hanti||
2. ga1.2-hotṛrvā niṣīdan; ta-bha4.8-hotṛrjñānaniṣīdan; bha1-hotṛ-janidan; bhara-hotṛvaro niṣīdan; bha6-mu-hotṛrjñānaṃ niṣīdan|
samānamasmā arnāpāvṛdarca kṣmayā divo asaṃsaṃ brahma navyam |
vi yaḥ pṛṣṭheva janimānyarya indraścikāya na sakhāyamīṣe ||
samānam | asmai | anapa'vṛta | arca | kṣmayā | divaḥ | asaṃsam | brahma | navyam | vi | yaḥ | pṛṣṭhā'iva | janimāni | aryaḥ | indraḥ | cikāya | na | sakhāyam | īṣe || 3 ||
he stotaḥ tvaṃ samāna mayā saha anapāvṛt apagatārahitaṃ kṣmayā divaḥ divaḥ pṛthivyāśca asaṃsam atyantamatiriktama |
navyaṃ navanaramanyaiḥkṛtapūrva brahma stotram asmai indrāya arca uccāraya |
yaḥ indraḥ janimāni yajñeṣu jātāni pṛṣṭheva pṛṣṭhasaṃjñakāni stotrāṇīva arthaḥ arīn śatrūn vi cikāya vivinoti sakhāyaṃ ca na īṣe necchati ||
indrāya giro aniśitasargā apaḥ prerayaṃ sargarasya bubhāt |
yo akṣeṇeva cakriyā śacībhirviśvaktastambha pṛthivīmuta dyām ||
indrāya | giraḥ | aniśita'sargāḥ | apaḥ | pra | īrayam | sargarasya | bubhāt | yaḥ | akṣeṇa'iva | cakriyā | śacībhiḥ | viśvak | tastambha | pṛthivīm | uta | dyām ||4||
indrāya indrārtham aniśitasargāḥ atankṛtavisargā uparyupari vartamānā yāḥ giraḥ stutayaḥ tābhirgīrbhiḥ sargarasya antarikṣasya |
bubhāt pradeśāt apaḥ udakāni prerayaṃ prerayāni |
yaḥ indraḥ śacībhiḥ karmabhiḥ pṛthivīm uta api ca dyāṃ divaṃ cakriyā rathacakrāṇi akṣeṇeva yathā rathākṣaṃ tadvat viśvak sarvataḥ tastambha astabhnāt ||
somo viśvānyatasā vanāni nāvvāgindraṃ pratimānāni dedhuḥ ||
āpāṃta'manyuḥ | tṛpala'prabharmā | dhuniḥ | śimī'vān | śaru'mān | ṛjīṣī | somaḥ | viśvāni | atasā | vanāni | na | arvāk | indram | prati'mānāni | dedhuḥ ||5||

āpāṃtamanyuḥ āpāditamanyuḥ tṛpalaprabharmā prāvabhiḥ kṣipraprahārī dhuniḥ śatrūṇāṃ kampayitā śimīvān karmavan śarumān āyudhavān ṛjīṣī ṛjīpavān somo viśvāni sarvāṇi atasā atasamayāni vanāni araṇyāni vardhayatīti śeṣaḥ |
anyatra pratinidhīyamānāni gurūṇi tānyā- tmābhimukhamākarṣanti naivamindraṃ kurvantīti |

tathā ca yāskaḥ—' āpāditamanyustṛpaprahārī kṣipraprahārī momo vendro vā dhunirdhūnoteḥ śimīti karmanāma śamayatervā śakrotervarjīṣī somo yassomasya pūyamānasyātiricyate tadajīpamapārjitaṃ bhavati tenarjīṣī somo'thātyendro nigamo bhavatyarjīṣī vatrtīti |
1. ta-bha-antarikṣaṃ ca | 2. ga1.2-ta-bha-mu-'yaḥ' nāsti | 3. tara.7-bha-rathākṣeṇeva | 4. gara- āpādita0 | 5. ta-bha-pratinidhāyamānāni | 6. ta1.2.7-mu-kṣipraprahārī kṣapraprahārī |
nāvāgindraṃ pratimānāni dabhnuvanti yairainaṃ pratimimate mainaṃ tāni dabhnuvanti' (niru. 5. 12) iti ||

na yasya dyāvāpṛthivī na dhanva nāntarikṣaṃ nādrayaḥ somo akṣāḥ | yadasya manyuradhinīyamānaḥ śṛṇāti vīḻu rujati sthirāṇi || 6 || na | yasya | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | na | dhanva | na | antarikṣam | na | adrayaḥ | somaḥ | akṣāriti | yat | asya | manyuḥ | adhi'nīyamānaḥ | śṛṇāti | vīḻu | rujati | sthirāṇi || 6 ||
vdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau vyasya indrasya pratimānabhūte vna bhavataḥ v|
vna^2 vdhanva udakamapi pratimānabhūtaṃ na bhavati |
kiṃca vyat yadā vasya indrasya vmanyuḥ krodhaḥ vadhinīyamānaḥ śatrūṇāmupari prāpyamāṇo bhavati tadānīmayamindraḥ vvīḻu dṛḍhaṃ vśṛṇāti hinasti |

jaghāna vṛtraṃ svadhitirvaneva ruroja puro aradan sindhūn | bibheda giriṃ navamina kumbhamā gā indro akṛṇuta svayugbhiḥ || 7 || jaghāna | vṛtram | sva'dhitiḥ | vanā'iva | ruroja | puraḥ | aradat | sindhūn | bibheda | girima | navam | it | na | kumbham | ā | gāḥ | indraḥ | akṛṇuta | svayug'bhiḥ ||7||
api ca vsvadhitiḥ paraśuḥ vvaneva vanānīva vpuraḥ śatrunagarīḥ vruroja rujati bhinatti |
śatrungarībhiśvā ca vsindhūn nadīḥ varadan vṛṣṭyudakenālikhat |
kiṃca vgiriṃ meghaṃ vnava vna navamiva vkumbhaṃ kalaśaṃ vbibheda vit bhinatteva |
kiṃca vindraḥ vsvayugbhiḥ svayaṃ yujyamānairmarudbhiḥ vgāḥ udakāni vā vakṛṇuta asmadabhimukhaṃ karoti ||

tvaṃ ha tyadaṇyā indra dhīro'sirna parva vṛjinā śṛṇāsi | pra ye mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma yujaṃ na janā minanti mitram || 8 || tvam | ha | tyat | ṛg'yāḥ | indra | dhīraḥ | asiḥ | na | parva | vṛjinā | śṛṇāsi | pra | ye | mitrasya | varuṇasya | dhāma | yujam | na | janāḥ | minanti | mitram || 8 ||
vindra vdhīraḥ prājñaḥ vtvaṃ vha tvaṃ khalu vtyat tat vṛṇayāḥ stotṛviṣayāṇāmṛṇānāṃ prāpayitāsi |
kiṃca svam vasirna śastramiva vparva paśūnāṃ parvāṇi vvṛjinā vṛjināni stotṛṇāmupa- dravāṇi vśṛṇāsi haṃsi |
kiṃca vmitrasya vvaruṇasya mitrāvaruṇayoḥ vdhāma dhārakaṃ karma vyujaṃ vna yujmiva vmitra vye ajñā nṛśaṃsāḥ vjanāḥ vya vminanti prakarṣeṇa hiṃsanti tānapi śṛṇāsītyarthaḥ ||
pra ye mitraṃ prārthyamāṇaṃ durevāḥ pra saṃgiraḥ pra varuṇa minanti |
nya mitreṣu vṛdhamindra tubhraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vṛṣaṇamaruṣaṃ śiśāiha ||
1. ta-pratimānabhūtaṃ na bhavati; bha-pramāṇabhūte na bhavati | 2. ta-bha-'na' nāsti | 3. ta-bha- antarikṣaṃ | 4. ta-bha-adrayaḥ | 5. ta-bha-1.2.4.6-mupadravāṇāṃ; bha8-mupadravyāṇāṃ |
pra | ye | mitram | pra | arthamaṇam | duḥ'evāḥ | pra | sum'gireḥ | pra | varuṇam | minanti | ni | amitreṣu | vadham | indra | tubhram | vṛṣan | vṛṣāgam | arutram | śiśīhi || 9 ||

ᵥye ᵥdurevāḥ duṣṭagamanā janāḥ ᵥmitra devaṃ ᵥpra ᵥminanti prahiṃsanti ᵥarthamaṇaṃ ca devaṃ ᵥpra minanti ᵥsaṃgiraḥ samīcīnastutimato marutaśca ᵥpra minanti ᵥvaruṇaṃ ca devaṃ ᵥpra minanti teṣu ᵥamitreṣu śatruṣu |
he ᵥvṛṣan kāmānāṃ varṣaka ᵥindra tvaṃ ᵥtubhraṃ gamanaśīlaṃ ᵥvṛṣāṇaṃ kāmānāṃ varṣakam ᵥarutram ārocamānaṃ ᵥvadhaṃ vajram |

indrau diva indra īśe pṛthivyā indrau apāmindra itaparvatānām | indrau vṛdhāmindra inmedhirāṇāmindraḥ kṣeme yoge havya indraḥ || 10 || indraḥ | divaḥ | indraḥ | īśe | pṛthivyāḥ | indraḥ | apām | indraḥ | ita | parvatānām | indraḥ | vṛdhām | indraḥ | ita | medhirāṇām | indraḥ | kṣeme | yoge | havyaḥ | indraḥ || 10 ||
ᵥdivaḥ dyulokasya ᵥindraḥ ᵥīśe īṣṭe ᵥpṛthivyāḥ bhūmerapi ᵥindraḥ īśe īśvaro bhavati |
ᵥmedhirāṇāṃ prājñānāmapi ᵥindraḥ eva īśvaro bhavati |
kiṃca ᵥindraḥ ᵥkṣeme labdhasya dhanasya paripālane ᵥhavyaḥ hrātavyaḥ ᵥyoge alabdhasya dhanasya lābhe'pi ᵥindraḥ eva hrātavyo bhavati ||

prāktumbhya indraḥ pra vṛdho ahaṃbhyaḥ prāntarikṣātpra samudrasya dhāseḥ | pra vātasya prathasaḥ pra jamo antātpra sindhubhyo ririce pra kṣitibhyaḥ ||11|| pra | akku'bhyaḥ | indraḥ | pra | vṛdhaḥ | ahaṃbhyaḥ | pra | antarikṣāt | pra | samudrasya | dhāseḥ | pra | vātasya | prathasaḥ | pra | jamaḥ | antāt | pra | sindhubhyaḥ | | ririce | pra | kṣiti'bhyaḥ ||11||
ᵥindraḥ ᵥakkubhyaḥ rātribhyaḥ ᵥpra ᵥvṛdhaḥ pravṛddhaḥ |

pra śoṣucatyā uṣaso na keturasinvā tai vartatāmindra hetiḥ | aśmeva vidhva diva ā sṛjñānastarpiṣṭena hepasā droghamitrān || 12 || pra | śoṣucatyāḥ | uparsaḥ | na | ketuḥ | asinvā | te | vartatām | indra | hetiḥ | aśmā'iva | vidhva | divaḥ | ā | sṛjñānaḥ | tarpiṣṭena | hepasā | drogha'mitrān || 12 ||
he ᵥindra ᵥte tava ᵥaminvā bhedanarahitaṃ ᵥhetiḥ vajrākhyamāyudhaṃ ᵥśoṣucatyāḥ jvalantyāḥ ᵥupaso ᵥna yathopasaḥ ᵥketuḥ patākāsthānīyo raśmistadvacchatruṣu ᵥpra ᵥvartatām |
atiśayena śatrūṇāṃ tāpayitavyā ᵥheṣasā śabdakāriṇyā hetyā ᵥdrohamitrān |
anvinrdraṃ rodasī vāvaśāne anvāpo ajihata jāyamānam ||
anu | aha | māsāḥ | | anu | it | vanāni | anu | oṣadhīḥ | anu | parvatāsaḥ | anu | indram | rodasī iti | vāvaśāne iti | anu | āpaḥ | ajihata | jāyamānam ||13||
ᵥjāyamānaṃ prādurbhavantam ᵥindraṃ ᵥmāsāḥ caitrādayaḥ ᵥanu ᵥajihataṃ anugacchanti |
ᵥvāvaśāne kāmayamāne ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyāvapi ᵥindram anu gacchataḥ |
kahīṃ svitsā taṃ indra cetyāsadaghasya yadvinado rakṣa eṣat |
mitrakuvo yacchasane na gārvaḥ pṛthivyā āpagumuyā śayante ||
kahīṃ | svit | sā | te | indra | cetyā | asat | aghasya | yat | bhinadaḥ | rakṣaḥ | ā'īṣat | bhinada'kuvaḥ | yat | śasane | na | gārvaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | ā'pṛk | amuyā | śayante ||14||
he ᵥindra ᵥte tava ᵥsā hetiripurvā ᵥcetyā caṃtayitavyā śatru kṣesavyā ᵥkahīṃ ᵥsvit kadā vā ᵥasat bhaviṣyati |
ahatm ᵥepat yuddhārthamāgacchat ᵥrakṣaḥ ᵥbhinadaḥ abhinat |

ᵥyat yayā ca śaktyā ᵥmitrakuvaḥ mitrāṇāṃ krūrasya karmaṇaḥ kartāro janāḥ ᵥpṛthivyāḥ saṃbandhini ᵥśasane viśasanasthāne ᵥgāvo ᵥna paśava iva ᵥāpṛk āpacarnāhatāḥ santaḥ ᵥamuyā anayā pṛthivyā saṃgatā yuddhe ᵥśayante śerate ||
śatruyanto abhi ye nastatse mahi vrādhanta oguṇāsa indra |
andhenāmitrāstamasā sacantāṃ sujyotiṣau aktuvastā~ abhi pyuḥ ||
śatru'yantaḥ | abhi | ye | naḥ | tatase | mahi | vrādhantaḥ | oguṇāsaḥ | indra | andhena | amitrāḥ | tamasā | sacantām | su'jyotiṣau | aktuvaḥ | tān | abhi | pyuḥ iti syuḥ ||15||
he ᵥindra³ ᵥśatruyantaḥ ᵥmahi atyantaṃ ᵥvrādhantaḥ asmān bādhamānāḥ ᵥoguṇāsaḥ saṃghībhūtāḥ |
ᵥye śatravaḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥabhi ᵥtatase nikṣipanti ᵥte ᵥamitrāḥ śatravaḥ ᵥandhena ᵥtamasā maha- tāndhakāreṇa ᵥsacantāṃ saṃgacchantām |
kiṃca ᵥtān amitrān ᵥsujyotiṣaḥ divasāḥ ᵥaktuvaḥ rātrayaśca ᵥabhi ᵥpyuḥ abhibhavantu ||
purūṇi hi tvā savanā janānāṃ brahmāṇi mandanaṃ guṇatāmṛṣīṇām |
imāmāghoṣan‌vasā sahūtiṃ tiro viśvā arcato yāhyarvāṅ‌ ||
purūṇi | hi | tvā | savanā | janānām | brahmāṇi | mandana | guṇatām | ṛṣīṇām | imām | ā'ghoṣan | avasā | sa'hūtim | tiraḥ | viśvān | arcataḥ | yāhi | arvāṅ‌ || 16 ||
he indra tvā tvāṃ janānāṃ sambandhīni purūṇi bahūni savanā savanāni brahmāṇi stotrāṇi ca mandanaṃ stuvanti modayanti vā |

guṇatāṃ stuvatām ṛṣīṇām imāṃ sahūtiṃ stutiṃ tvam āghoṣan mahatī śobhanā ceyaṃ stutiriti vadan arcataḥ stuvato'nyān viśvān sarvānapi tiraḥ tiraskṛtya avasā rakṣaṇena saha arvāṅ asmadabhimukhaṃ yāhi gaccha ||
evā tai vayamindra bhujatīnāṃ vidyāma sumatīnāṃ navānām |
vidyāma vastoravasā guṇanto viśvāmitrā uta ta
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ | sahasrākṣaḥ | sahasrapāt | saḥ | bhūmim | viśvataḥ | vṛtvā | ati | atiṣṭhat | daśāṅgulam || 1 ||
yāni sarvaprāṇināṃ śirāṃsi tāni sarvāṇi tadehāntaḥpā- titvādvidyānyeveti sahasraśīrṣatvam |
saḥ puruṣaḥ bhūmiṃ brahmāṇḍa- golakarūpāṃ viśvataḥ sarvataḥ vṛtvā pariveṣṭya daśāṅgulaṃ daśāṅgulaparimitaṃ deśam atyatiṣṭhat atikramya vyavasthitaḥ |
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhavyam |
puruṣaḥ | eva | idam | sarvam | yat | bhūtam | yat | ca | bhavyam | uta | amṛtatvasya | īśānaḥ | yat | annena | atirohati || 2 ||
yat idaṃ vartamānaṃ jagat tat sarvaṃ puruṣa eva |
yat ca bhūtam atītaṃ jagat yacca bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyajjagat tadapi puruṣa eva |
yathāsmin kalpe vartamānāḥ prāṇidehāḥ sarve'pi virāḍ- puruṣasyāvayavāḥ tathaivātītāgāminorapi kalpayordṛṣṭavyamityabhiprāyaḥ |
uta api ca amṛtatvasya devatvasya ayam īśānaḥ svāmī |

yat yasmātkāraṇāt annena prāṇināṃ bhogyenānnena nimitta- bhūtena atirohati svakīyāṃ kāraṇāvasthāmatikramya paridṛśyamānāṃ jagadavasthāṃ prāpnoti tasmātprāṇināṃ karmaphalabhogāya jagadavasthāsvīkārābhedaṃ tasya vastutvamityarthaḥ ||
etāvān | asya | mahimā | ataḥ | jyāyān | ca | puruṣaḥ | pādaḥ | asya | viśvā | bhūtāni | tripāt | asya | amṛtam | divi || 3 ||
atītānāgatavartamānarūpaṃ jagadāvadasti etāvān sarvo'pi asya puruṣasya mahimā svakīyasāmarthyaviśeṣaḥ |
vāstavavastu puruṣaḥ ataḥ mahimno'pi jyāyān atiśayenādhikaḥ |

tasya hotā bhavasi yāsi dūtyaṃmupa brūṣe yajasyadhvarayasi ||
yaḥ | tubhyam | agne | amṛtāya | martyaḥ | sam'idhā | dāśat | uta | vā | haviḥ'kṛti | tasya | hotā | bhavasi | yāsi | dūtyam | upa | brūṣe | yajasi | adhvariḥ'asi || 11 ||
he agne amṛtāya maraṇadharmarahitāya tubhyaṃ yaḥ martyaḥ manuṣyaḥ samidhā samidham |
dāśat dadāti prayacchati uta vā api vā haviṣkṛti |
haviṣāṃ kṛt karaṇaṃ yasmin sa haviṣkṛt |
kiṃca tvaṃ dūtyaṃ devān prati dūtakarma kartuṃ yāsi gacchasi |
kiṃca tvaṃ brahmā bhūtvāsimin karmaṇi yuṣmabhyamimāni havīṃṣi yajamānena prahitānīti upa brūṣe upakramya bravīṣi |
kiṃca tvaṃ yajasi yajamāno bhūtvā devebhyo havīṃṣi dadāsi |
4. ta-mu-dadātīti saṃskṛtaṃ yasmin tadyajñamanutiṣṭhatīti; bha-dadātīti saṃskṛtaryasmin tadyajñamanu- tiṣṭhatīti |

imā asmai mṛtayo vāco asmadā ṛco giraḥ suṣṭutayaḥ samagmata | vasūyo vasave jātavedase vṛddhāsu cidvardhano yāsu cākanat || 12 || imāḥ | asmai | mṛtayaḥ | vācaḥ | asmat | ā | ṛcaḥ | giraḥ | su'stutayaḥ | sam | agmat | vasu'yavaḥ | vasave | jātavedase | vṛddhāsu | cit | vardhanaḥ | yāsu | cākanat || 12 ||
^jātavedase jātaprajñāya ^vasave vāsayitre ^asmai agnaye ^matayaḥ pūjayiṣyaḥ ^imāḥ ^vācaḥ ^vasūyavaḥ asmadarthaṃ dhanakāmāḥ satyaḥ ^asmat asmatto nirgatya ^ā ^samagmata ābhimukhyena saṃgacchante |
tathā ^yāsu ^vṛddhāsu ^cit svata eva vṛddhāsvapi ^vardhanaḥ punarapi vardhayitā sañjñiḥ ^cākanat stotṛn kāmayate |

imāṃ pratnāya suṣṭutiṃ navīyasīṃ voceyamasmā uśate śṛṇotu naḥ | bhuyā antarā hṛdyasya nispṛśe jāyeva patya uśatī suvāsāḥ || 13 || imām | pratnāya | su'stutim | navīyasīm | voceyam | asmai | uśate | śṛṇotu | naḥ | bhuyāḥ | antar | hṛdi | asya | ni'spṛśe | jāyā'iva | patye | uśatī | su'vāsāḥ || 13 ||
^pratnāya purāṇāya ^uśate stotraṃ kāmayamānāya ^asmai agnaye ^navīyasīṃ navatarāmanyaiḥ akṛta- pūrvāṃ ^suṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ ^voceyam ahaṃ vakṣyāmi |
kiṃcāham ^asya agneḥ ^hṛdi hṛdaye tatrāpi ^antarā madhye ^nispṛśe saṃspardhanāya |
^patye patyurhṛdayasya madhye ^suvāsāḥ śobhanavastrādinā maṇḍitā ^jāyā ^uśatī kāmayamānā yatheṣṭatamā bhavati tadvadityarthaḥ ||

yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭā āhutāḥ | kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaye cārumagnaye || 14 || yasmin | aśvāsaḥ | ṛṣabhāsaḥ | ukṣaṇaḥ | vaśā | meṣāḥ | avasṛṣṭāḥ | ā'hutāḥ | kīlāla'pe | soma'pṛṣṭhāya | vedhase | hṛdā | matim | janaye | cārum | agnaye || 14 ||

secanasamarthāḥ ^aśvāsaḥ aśvāḥ ^ṛṣabhāsaḥ ṛṣabhāśca ^vaśāḥ svabhāvatandhyāśca ^meṣāḥ ca ^avasṛṣṭāḥ devatārtham avasṛṣṭāḥ parityaktāḥ santo'śvamedhe ^āhutāḥ ābhimukhyena hutā bhavanti ^kīlālape sautrāmaṇyāṃ surāṃ pibate |
udakaṃ^ pibate ^somapṛṣṭhāya somayuktaḥ pṛṣṭha upari- bhāgo yasya tasmai somapṛṣṭhāya ^vedhase vidhātre tasmai ^agnaye ^hṛdā hṛdayena ^cāruṃ kalyāṇoṃ ^matiṃ stutiṃ ^janaye janayāmi |
1. bha-pūjayitvityarthaḥ | 2. ta-mu-pravṛddhāsvapi | 3. ga-manasi suṣṭhu anupraviṣṭo | 4. ta-asmin | 5. ta-svabhāvatavaṃdhyāśca | 6. ga-ta-'udakaṃ' nāsti |

ahā̭vya॒gre ha॒virā॒syḙ te su॒cī̭va ghṛ॒taṃ ca॒mvī̭va॒ soma̭ḥ | vā॒jasa̭niṃ ra॒yima॒sme su॒vīra̭ṃ pra॒śasta̭ṃ dhehi॒ yaśa̭saṃ bṛha॒ntam || 15 || a॒hā॒vi | a॒gne | ha॒viḥ | ā॒syḙ | te | su॒cī̭'iva | ghṛ॒tam | ca॒mvī̭'iva | soma̭ḥ | vā॒jasa̭nim | ra॒yim | a॒sme iti̭ | su॒vīra̭m | pra॒śasta̭m | dhe॒hi | yaśa̭sam | bṛha॒ntam || 15 ||
he 'agne 'te tava 'āsye mukhe 'haviḥ puroḍāśādihavirasmābhiḥ 'ahāvi satataṃ prakṣipyate |

tathā tvaṃ 'vājasanim annasya dātāraṃ 'suvīraṃ śobhanaputropetaṃ 'praśastaṃ suvarṇādikaṃ 'yaśasaṃ yaśasvinaṃ kīrtimantaṃ 'bṛhantam aparimitaṃ mahāntaṃ vā 'rathiṃ ramaṇīyaṃ dhanam 'asme asmabhyaṃ 'dhehi dehi ||
'ya॒jñasya̭ ' iti pañcadaśarcaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ manoḥ putrasya śaryātāsyāpa̭ jāgataṃ bahudevatākam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'ya॒jñasya śaryāto mānavo vaiśvadevaṃ tu jāgatam' iti |
cāturvaṃśika ārambhaṇīye- 'hani vaiśvadevaśastra idaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvadevanirvidvānam |
sūtritaṃ ca—'te hi dyāvāpṛthivī yajñasya vo rathyam' (āśva. śrau. 7. 4) iti |

ya॒jñasya̭ vo ra॒thya̭ṃ vi॒śapa̭tiṃ vi॒śāṃ ho॒tāra̭ma॒kto ra̭ti॒thiṃ vi॒bhāva̭sum | śo॒ca॒cchu॒ṣkāsṷ ha॒rī̭ṇeṣu ja॒rbhṷrat vṛ॒ṣā ke॒turya̭to ghā॒maśa̭yata || 1 || ya॒jñasya̭ | vaḥ | ra॒thya̭m | vi॒śaḥ'pa̭tim | vi॒śām | ho॒tāra̭m | a॒ktoḥ | a॒ti॒thim | vi॒bhā'va̭sum | śo॒ca̭n | śu॒ṣkāsṷ | ha॒rī̭ṇeṣu | ja॒rbhṷrat | vṛ॒ṣā | ke॒tuḥ | ya॒jataḥ | dhāma̭ | a॒śayata || 1 ||

he devāḥ 'vaḥ yūyaṃ 'yajñasya 'rathyaṃ netāraṃ 'viśapatiṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ pālakaṃ svāminaṃ vā 'viśāṃ devānāṃ 'hotāram āhvātāram 'aktoḥ rātreḥ 'atithim atithibhūtaṃ 'vibhāvasuṃ vividyadīptadhanaṃ tamagniṃ paricarateti śeṣaḥ |

'śuṣkāsu śuṣkabhūtāsvoṣadhīṣu 'śocan jvalan 'harīṇeṣu haritavarṇāṃsu ārdrāsvoṣadhīṣu 'jarbhṷrat bhakṣayan kuṭilaṃ gacchan vā 'vṛṣā kāmānāṃ varṣitā 'ketuḥ prajñāpakaḥ 'yajataḥ yaṣṭavyo'gniḥ 'ghāṃ divam 'aśayata pratiṣṭhate ||

i॒maṃ ja̭jña॒pā'mu॒bhayḙ akṛṇvata dha॒rmāṇa̭ma॒gniṃ vi॒dha̭sya॒ sādha̭nam | a॒ktuṃ na ya॒hamṷṣaḥ puro॒hita̭ṃ ta॒nū॒napā̭ta॒marṷṣasya॒ nisa̭te || 2 || i॒mam | a॒jñaḥ'pām | u॒bhayḙ | a॒kṛ॒ṇva॒ta | dha॒rmāṇa̭m | a॒gnim | vi॒dha̭sya | sādha̭nam | a॒ktum | na | ya॒ham | u॒pasa̭ḥ | puraḥ'hi̭tam | ta॒nū॒na'pā̭tam | a॒ru॒ṣasya̭ | nisa̭te || 2 ||
'ubhaye devamanuṣyāḥ 'ajñapām ajñasā rakṣakaṃ 'dharmāṇaṃ dhārakam 'imam 'agniṃ 'vidathasya yajñasya 'sādhanaṃ sādhayitāram 'akṛṇvata akurvata |
kiṃca 'aruṣasya ārocamānasya vāyoḥ 'tanūnapātaṃ putraṃ 'yahaṃ mahāntaṃ 'purohitam3 'upasaḥ 'aktuṃ 'na svaraśmibhiraktamādityamiva 'nisate cumbayanti |

baḻasya nīthā vi paṇeśca manmahe vayā aṃhu prahutā āmurattave | yadā ghorāsau amṛtavamāśatādijanasya dainyasya carkiran || 3 || baṭ | asya | nīthā | vi | paṇeḥ | ca | manmahe | vayāḥ | asya | pra'hutāḥ | āsuḥ | attave | yadā | ghorāsaḥ | amṛta'tvam | āśata | āt | it | janasya | dainyasya | carkiran ||3||
vvipaṇeḥ asmābhirvividhaṃ paṇitavyasya stutyasyāgreḥ vnīthā nīthānyasmatsaṃbandhīni prajñānāni vbaṭ satyāni syuriti vmanmahe vayaṃ kāmayāmahe |
kiṃca vasya agneḥ vvayāḥ asmadīyā ajñātahutaḥ vattave bhakṣaṇāya vprahutāḥ vāsuḥ bhaveyuriti kāmayāmahe |
kiṃca vyadā yasmin kāle vghorāsaḥ ghorāḥ1 agnerjvālāḥ vamṛtatvam avināśitvam vāśata prāpnuvanti vādit anantaramevāsmāka- mṛtvijaḥ vdainyasya
krāṇāḥ | rudrāḥ | marutaḥ | viśva'kṛṣṭayaḥ | divaḥ | śyenāsaḥ | asurasya | nīḻayaḥ | tebhiḥ | caṣṭe | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | indraḥ | devebhiḥ | arśabhebhiḥ | arveśaḥ || 6 ||

^asurasya meghasya ^nīḻayaḥ āvāsabhūtāḥ ^divaḥ antarikṣasya saṃbandhanaḥ ^iyenāsaḥ iyenāḥ śaṃsanīyagatayaḥ ^viśvakṛṣṭayaḥ vyāsamamanuṣyāḥ ^rudrāḥ rudraputrā ye ^marutaḥ ^krāṇāḥ svādhikārakarmāṇi kurvāṇā āsata iti śeṣaḥ |
^tebhiḥ taiḥ ^arvaśebhiḥ aśvavadbhiḥ somavadbhir ^devebhiḥ devaiḥ saha ^arvaśaḥ aśvavān somavānvā ^indraḥ ^caṣṭe paśyati |
^varuṇaḥ ca ^mitraḥ ca ^aryamā ca somavadbhiḥ marudbhiḥ saha paśyanti ||
indre bhujaṃ śaśamānāsa āśata sūro dṛśīke vṛṣaṇaśca pausye |
pra ye nvasyārhaṇā tatakṣire yujaṃ vajraṃ nusardaneṣu kāravaḥ ||
indre | bhujam | śaśamānāsaḥ | āśata | sūraḥ | dṛśīke | vṛṣaṇaḥ | ca | pausye | pra | ye | nu | asya | arhaṇā | tatakṣire | yujam | vajram | nusardaneṣu | kāravaḥ || 7 ||
ye ^śaśamānāsaḥ śaśamānāḥ ^stotāraḥ ^indre stute sati ^bhujaṃ pālanam ^āśata prāpnuvanti |
^sūraḥ sūrye stute sati ^dṛśīke darśanaṃ sarvavastuviṣayaṃ prāpnuvanti |

kiṃca ^ye ^kāravaḥ stotāraḥ ^asya indrasya ^arhaṇā pūjanāni ^nu kṣipraṃ ^tatakṣire prakṛṣṭāni kurvanti te stotāraḥ ^nusardaneṣu naraḥ kartṛtvena yeṣu sīdanti tiṣṭhanti teṣu yajñeṣu ^yujaṃ sahāyamindrasya ^vajraṃ prāpnuvanti ||
sūraścidā harito asya riramadindrādā kaścidbhayate tavīyasaḥ |
bhīmasya vṛṣṇo jaṭharādabhiśvaso divedive sahuriḥ stṛnabādhitaḥ ||
sūraḥ | cit | ā | haritaḥ | asya | riramat | indrāt | ā | kaḥ | cit | bhayate | tavīyasaḥ | bhīmasya | vṛṣṇaḥ | jaṭharāt | abhiśvasaḥ | dive'dive | sahuriḥ | stṛn | abādhitaḥ ||8||
^sūraḥ sūryo'pi ^asya indrasya parameśvarasya paramātmana ājñāṃ paripālayituṃ manvānaḥ ^haritaḥ aśvān prerayatīti śeṣaḥ |
yaḥ ^kaścit devo'pi sṛṣṭau ^bhayate bibheti sa devaḥ ^tavīyasaḥ pravṛddhāt ^indrāt paramātmano bhayādeva bibheti |
tathā ca taittirīye paṭhitaṃ—‘bhīpāsmādvātaḥ pavate’ (tai. u. 2. 8) ityādinā |

kiṃca ^vṛṣṇaḥ kāmānāṃ varṣituḥ ^bhīmasya sarvabhayaṃkarasya paramātmanaḥ parameśvarasya ^divedive anvaham ^abhiśvasaḥ ābhi- mukhyena śvasataḥ ^jaṭharāt udarādantarikṣāt ^sahuriḥ sahanaśīlaḥ ^abādhitaḥ bādharahitaḥ ^stan stanayati śabdaṃ karoti ||
stomaṃ vo adya rudrāya śikaṃse kṣayadvīrāya namasā didiṣṭana |
yebhiḥ śivaḥ svavā~ avyāvabhirdivaḥ sirṣakti svayaśā nikāmabhiḥ ||

stoma̭m | vaḥ | atha | rudrāya | śika̭se | kṣaya̭t'vīrāya | nama̭sā | didi̭ṣṭana | yebhi̭: | śiva̭: | sva'vān | e॒vyāva̭'bhiḥ | diva̭: | mi̭sakti | sva'rya̭śāḥ | nikā̭ma'bhiḥ ||9||

paevyāvabhiḥ aśvairāgacchadbhiḥ payebhiḥ yairmarudbhiḥ saha pasvavān jñātamān pasvayaśāḥ svabhūta- kīrtiḥ paśivaḥ sukhakaraḥ parameśvaraḥ padivaḥ dyulokājamānān pasiṣakti sevate he ṛtvijaḥ yūyam paatha asmin yāge panikāmabhiḥ niyatābhilāpaiḥ patermarudbhiḥ sahitāya pakṣayadvīrāya kṣitaśatrave4 paśikase śaraṇe śaklāya parudrāya panamasā annena namaskāreṇa vā saha pastomaṃ stotraṃ padidiṣṭana diśata sṛjata |
te hi pra॒jāyā̭ a॒rhera̭nta vi śra॒vo̭ bṛha॒spati̭rvṛ॒ṣabha̭: soma̭jāmayaḥ |
ya॒jñairdha॒rvā pra̭tha॒mo vi dhā̭raya॒ddevā̭ da॒kṣairbhṛ̭ga॒vaḥ saṃ ci̭kitire ||

te | hi | pra'jāyā̭: | a॒rhera̭nta | vi | śra॒va̭ḥ | bṛha॒spati̭: | vṛ॒ṣabha̭: | soma̭'jāmayaḥ | ya॒jñai: | a॒rdhavā̭ | pra॒tha॒maḥ | vi | dhā̭rayat | de॒vāḥ | da॒kṣai: | bhṛ̭ga॒vaḥ | sam | ci̭kitire ||10||

pahi yasmātkāraṇāt pavṛṣabhaḥ kāmāānāṃ varṣitā pabṛhaspatiḥ pasomajāmayaḥ anye somabandhavaḥ5 pate viśve devāḥ prajāyāḥ arthāya paśravaḥ annaṃ pavi paabharanta vibharanti vṛṣṭidvāreṇa poṣayanti tasmātkāraṇāt tāsāṃ6 prajānāṃ madhye paatharvā nāmarṣiḥ paprathamaḥ7 prathamameva8 kriyamāṇe9 payajñaiḥ pavi padhārayat devān karmamārgān vā vistṛtanakarot |
atra nigamaḥ—' yajñairatharvā prathamaḥ pathastate ' (ṛ. saṃ. 1. 83. 5) iti |
atha padakṣaiḥ balaiḥ saha padevāḥ viśve pabhṛgavaḥ ṛpayaśca pasaṃ pacikitire atharvaṇā kṛtaṃ yajñaṃ gatvā paśūn saṃjñātavantaḥ ||
te hi dyāvā̭pṛthi॒vī bhūri̭retasā na॒rāśa̭ṃsaścatṷraṅgo ya॒mo'di̭tiḥ |
de॒vastvaṣṭā̭ dravi॒ṇodā̭ ṛbhu॒kṣaṇa̭ḥ pra raṷdasī ma॒ruto viṣṇura̭hire ||

te iti | hi | dyāvā̭pṛthi॒vī iti | bhūri̭'retasā | na॒rāśa̭ṃsaḥ | catṷ:'aṅgaḥ | ya॒maḥ | adi̭tiḥ | de॒vaḥ | tvaṣṭā̭ | dravi॒ṇaḥ'dāḥ | ṛbhu॒kṣaṇa̭ḥ | pra | raṷdasī iti | ma॒rutaḥ | viṣṇa̭ḥ | a॒hire ||11||

pabhūriretasā bahudake padyāvāpṛthibī dyāvāpṛthivyau payamaḥ devaḥ paaditiḥ ca patvaṣṭā padevaḥ ca padraviṇodāḥ agniśca paṛbhukṣaṇaḥ ṛbhavaśca parodasī rudrasya patnī ca pamarutaḥ devāśca paviṣṇuḥ10 ca10 ete viśve devāḥ |
pacaturaṅgaḥ caturbhirmibhiryuktastasmin11 panarāśaṃsaḥ narāśaṃsanāmadheye yajñe papra12 paahire asmābhiḥ stotubhiḥ pūjyante13 ||
uta sya na̭ u॒śijā̭mu॒rviyā̭ ka॒virhi̭ḥ śṛṇotu bu॒dhnyo̭ ha॒vīṃma̭ni |
sūryā̭mā॒sā vi ca̭ra॒ntā di॒vikṣi̭tā dhi॒yā śa̭mī॒nahṷṣī a॒sya bo̭dhatam ||
uta | syaḥ | naḥ | uśijām | urviyā | kaviḥ | ahiḥ | śṛṇotu | budhnyaḥ | havīmani | sūryāmāsā | vi'carantā | dvi'dvikṣātā | dhriyā | śamīnahuṣī iti | asya | bodhatam ||12||

he ᵥviśvepābhirajvavaḥ bhuvanānāmīśvarāḥ ᵥdevānāṃ dyotanādiguṇayuktānāṃ bhavatāṃ ᵥmahaḥ mahat ᵥvāḥ varaṇīyaṃ dhanaṃ vidhata iti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca ᵥviśve sarve yūyaṃ ᵥviśvamahasaḥ vyāsatejaskāḥ |
kiṃca ᵥviśve yūyaṃ ᵥyajñeṣu ᵥyajñiyāḥ yaṣṭavyāḥ ||
te dyā rājāno amṛtasya mandrā aryamā mitro varuṇaḥ parijmā |

tā~ hāyaṃ jñātvābhirovāda haye jāye manasā’ (śa. brā. 11. 5. 1) ityādi ||

purūravo mā mṛthā mā pra pso mā tvā vṛkāso aśavāsa u kṣan | na vai straiṇāni sakhyāni santi sālāvṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayānyetā || 15 || purūravaḥ | mā | mṛthāḥ | mā | pra | psaḥ | mā | tvā | vṛkāsaḥ | aśavāsaḥ | ū~ iti | kṣan | na | vai | straiṇāni | sakhyāni | santi | sālāvṛkāṇām | hṛdayāni | etā || 15 || tamitarā pratyuvāca | he purūravaḥ tvaṃ mā mṛthāḥ mṛrti mā prāpnuhi | mriyaterluṅi thāsi 'hasvādṅgāt' iti sico lopaḥ | tathā mā pra psaḥ atraiva patanaṃ mā kārṣīḥ | paterluṅi ludvitvāt 'pupādi' ityādinā caleraṅ | pataḥ pum iti pum | tathā tvā tvām aśavāsaḥ aśubhāḥ vṛkāsaḥ vṛkāḥ | mā u kṣan | u ityevakārārthe | akṣan | sāmyavahārayantu | kimityevamasmadu- paryāgrahaṃ karopi | mā kārṣīrityarthaḥ | adeluṅi 'luḍsanorghasla' (pā. sū. 2. 4. 37) iti ghaslādeśaḥ | 'mantre ghasa' iti calerluk | 'śasavāsi' ityādinā patvam | 'khari ca' iti carvam | bāhulakādaḍabhāvaḥ | atha svasnehasyāsāratāmāha | straiṇāni strīṇāṃ kṛtāni sakhyāni na vai santi | na santi khalu | abhāve kāraṇamāha | etā etāni sakhyāni sālāvṛkāṇāṃ hṛdayāni teṣāṃ hṛdayāni yathā vatsādīnāṃ viśvāsāpannānāṃ ghātukāni tadvat | atra vājasaneyakaṃ— 'bhetadāhathā na vai strai sakhyamasti punargahāniheti haivanaṃ taduvāca' (śa. brā. 11. 5. 1. 9) iti || 3 ||

yadvirūpācaraṃ martyeṣvavasaṃ rātrīḥ śaraduścatasraḥ | ghṛtasya stokaṃ sakṛdaha āśmāṃ tādevedaṃ tātṛpāṇā carāmi || 16 || yat | vi'rūpā | acaram | martyeṣu | avasam | rātrīḥ | śaradaḥ | catasraḥ | ghṛtasya | stokam | sakṛt | ahaḥ | āśma | tāt | eva | idam | tātṛpāṇā | carāmi || 16 || yat yadā virūpā manuṣyasaṃparkādgatasahajabhūtadevarūpā pathyānukūlyena nānārūpā vā martyeṣu manuṣyeṣu acaraṃ tadānīṃ rātrīḥ paramathiyatrīḥ catasraḥ śaradaḥ avasaṃ nyavasam | atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | tadānīṃ ghṛtasya stokaṃ sakṛdaha āśma | tādeva tenaiva stokenāham idaṃ saṃprati tātṛpāṇā tṛptā satī carāmi ||

antarikṣaprāṃ rajaso vimānimupa śikṣāmyurvaśīṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ | upa tvā rātiḥ sukṛtasya tiṣṭhānni vartasva hṛdayaṃ tapyate me || 17 || antarikṣa'prām | rajasaḥ | vi'mānīm | upa | śikṣāmi | urvaśīm | vasiṣṭhaḥ | upa | tvā | rātiḥ | su'kṛtasya | tiṣṭhān | ni | vartasva | hṛda | tapyate | me || 17 || antarikṣaprāṃ svatejasāntarikṣasya pūrayitrīṃ tathā rajasaḥ rajaskasyodakasya vimānīṃ nirmātrīm urvaśīṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ madhye'tiśayena vāsayitāham upa śikṣāmi vaśaṃ nayāmi | sukṛtasya śobhanakarmaṇaḥ rātiḥ dātā purūravāḥ tvā tvām upa tiṣṭhān upatiṣṭhatu | me hṛdayaṃ tapyate | ato ni vartasva | evaṃ rājovāca ||

iti tvā devā iha āhuraiḻa yathaimetadbhavasi mṛtyubandhuḥ | prajā tai devān haviṣā yajāti svargaṃ u tvamapi mādayāse || 18 || iti | tvā | devāḥ | ime | āhuḥ | aiḻa | yathā | īm | etat | bhavasi | mṛtyu'bandhuḥ | pra'jā | te | devān | haviṣā | yajāti | svaḥ'ge | oṃ iti | tvam | api | mādayāse ||18||
he aiḻa pururavaḥ tvā tvām ime devāḥ iti āhuḥ |
mṛtyubandhuḥ mṛtyoḥ bandhakaḥ mṛtyorbandhubhūto vā mṛtyuvaśaprāpnuvastvaṃ yathai yathā etadbhavasi bhaviṣyasi prajā prakarṣeṇa jāyamānastvaṃ te tava sambandhino yaṣṭavyān devān haviṣā yajāsi yajasi |
svargaṃ u svarga eva tvamapi mādayāse mādayase'smābhiḥ saha |
yasmādevaṃ karoṣi tasmādabhilāpaṃ hitvā sukhī bhaveti seyaṃ pururavasaṃ pratyuvāca ||
atha 'pra te mahe' iti trayodaśacaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ sūktam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'pra te sasonā bahuḥ sarvaharivendro harisutirdvi- triṣṭubantam' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pra te maha ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇeti yājyā' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsipaṃ harī iti tisro jagatyaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 6. 2) iti ||

pra tai mahe vidathai śaṃsipaṃ harī pra tai vanve vunuṣo haryataṃ madam | ghṛtaṃ na yo haribhiścāru secaṃta ā tvā viśaṃtu harivapaṃsaṃ giraḥ || 1 || pra | te | mahe | vidathai | śaṃsipam | harī iti | pra | te | vanve | vunuṣaḥ | haryatam | madam | ghṛtam | na | yaḥ | hari'bhiḥ | cāru | secate | ā | tvā | viśantu | hari'vapasam | giraḥ ||1||
he indra te tava harā aśvau mahe mahati vidathe yajñe pra śaṃsipam aśāṃsipam |
yaḥ indraḥ haribhiḥ haritavarṇairaśvaiḥ maghāṃ gatvā cāru caraṇīyaṃ ghṛtaṃ na ghṛtamiva suptamudakaṃ secate varṣati taṃ tādṛśaṃ harivapasam |
harirūpaṃ tvā tvām ā viśantu giraḥ asmadīyāḥ stutivācastva madāya ||

suveva yasya hariṇī vipetatuḥ śikhre vājāya hariṇī davidhvataḥ | pra yatkṛte camase marmṛjadūrī pītvā madasya haryatasyāndhasaḥ || 9 || suvā'iva | yasya | hariṇī iti | tri'petatuḥ | śikhre iti | vājāya | hariṇī iti | davidhvataḥ | pra | yat | kṛte | camase | marmṛjat | harī iti | pītvā | madasya | haryatasya | andhasaḥ || 9 ||
vyasya indrasya vhariṇī harivarṇavaśvau vvipetatuḥ ratha indramāropya vipatato yajñamasmadīyam |
yathā suvā suvāṃ haviṣā pūrṇaṃ pātraviśeṣaṃ homāthaṃ vipantaḥ tadvat |
tathā yasya ca vhariṇī harivarṇe vśikhre han vvājāya somalakṣaṇāyānnāya vdavidhvataḥ kampayataḥ purataḥ prattasya3 somasya prītyā4 calataḥ5 |

yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā|
manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca ||
yāḥ | oṣadhīḥ | pūrvāḥ | jātāḥ | devebhyaḥ | tri'yugam | purā | manai | nu | babhrūṇām | aham | śatam | dhāmāni | sapta | ca || 1 ||
yāḥ oṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ pūrvāḥ purātanyaḥ jātāḥ utpannāḥ|
athavā triṣu yugeṣu vasanta prāvṛpi śaradi cetyarthaḥ|
ahaṃ babhrūṇāṃ babhrūṇāṃ somādyoṣadhīnāṃ śataṃ sapta ca dhāmāni anulepamārjanābhiṣekādirūpeṇāśrayabhūtāni sthānāni nu kṣipraṃ manai manye|

atra vājasaneyakaṃ - 'yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ puretyatro vai devāstebhya etābhiḥ purā jāyante vasante prāvṛpi śaradi manai nu babhrūṇāmahamiti somo vai babhruḥ somyā oṣadhaya auṣadhaḥ puruṣaḥ śataṃ dhāmānīti yadidaṃ śatāyuḥ śatārhaḥ śatavīrya etāni hāsya tāni śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ceti|
ya eteme sapta śīrṣanprāṇāstānetadāha' (śa. brā. 7. 2. 4. 26) iti|
atra niruktaṃ ca - 'yā oṣadhayaḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyarṇī yugāmi purā manye nu tadvabhrūṇāmahaṃ bharaṇānāṃ haraṇā- nāmiti vā śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ceti|
dhāmāni trayāṇi bhavanti sthānāni nāmāni janmāni|
janmanyatrābhipretāni' saptaśatāni sapta śataṃ puruṣasya marmaṇāṃ tepvenā dadhati' (niru. 9.28) iti||
śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ|
athā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta ||
śatam | vaḥ | amba | dhāmāni | sahasram | uta | vaḥ | ruhaḥ | athā | śata'kratvaḥ | yūyam | imam | me | agadam | kṛta || 2 ||
he amba mātara oṣadhayaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ dhāmāni sthānāni janmāni vā śatam aparimitāni|
uta api ca vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ruhaḥ prarohaḥ prodbhavaḥ sahasram aparimitaḥ|
atha api ca he śata- kratvaḥ śatakarmāṇaḥ yūyamimaṃ me mā madīyaṃ vā janamāmayagrastam agadam|
