aśvavatīm | somavatīm | ūrjayanatīm | ut'ojasam | ā | avanti | sarvāḥ | oṣadhīḥ | asme | ariṣṭa'tātaye || 7 ||
aśvāvatyādayaḥ pradhānabhūtā oṣadhayastataḥ| tāḥ sarvā oṣadhīḥ āvisi ājāne| saumīyarthaḥ| asmā ariṣṭatātaye| amuṃ rogaṃ vināśayitumisyarthaḥ ||
ut | śuṣmāḥ | oṣadhīnām | gāvaḥ | goṣṭhāt'iva | īrate | dhanam | saniṣyantīnām | ātmānam | tarva | purupa || 8 ||
oṣadhīnāṃ śuṣmāḥ balāni ut īrate udgacchanti|
he pūrupa purupa rogagrasta tava ātmānaṃ śarīraṃ prati |
he purupa priyaṅgavādyoṣadhisvāmin tavātmānaṃ vardhayituṃ dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāṃ vīryādyoṣadhīnāṃ śuṣmā udīrate ||
iṣkṛtīrnāma vo mātātho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ |
iṣkṛtīḥ | nāma | vaḥ | mātā | atho | iti | yūyam | stha | niḥ'kṛtīḥ | sīrāḥ | patatriṇīḥ | sthana | yat | āmayati | niḥ | kṛtha || 9 ||
he oṣadhayaḥ vo mātā jananī iṣkṛtīrnāma, sarveṣāṃ rugṇānāṃ niṣkartrīti prasiddhā|
atha ato yūyamapi niṣkṛtīḥ niṣkṛtayaḥ stha bhavatha |
kiṃca yūyaṃ sīrāḥ saraṇaśīlāḥ patatriṇīḥ patanavatyaśca sthana bhavatha |
kiṃca purupaḥ yat yadi āmayati vyādhitaṃ bhavati taṃ niṣkṛtha saṃskurutha ||
1. ga-ta-bha-mu-oṣadhyaḥ | 2. gara-samagacchaṃta | 3. ta-bha-mu-'nāśayitā' nāsti | 4. gata- bha-opadhyastatraḥ | 5. ta-mu-ariṣṭatātaye asmai rogāya | 6. ta4.5-darśayituṃ |

ati | viśvāḥ | pari'sthāḥ | stenaḥ'iva | vrajam | akramaḥ | oṣadhīḥ | pra | anu'cyuḥ | yat | kim | ca | tanvaḥ | rapaḥ || 10 || ^viśvāḥ vyāptāḥ ^pariṣṭhāḥ paritaḥ sthitā oṣadhayaḥ ^ati ^akramaḥ vyāptīnatikrāntavatyaḥ | ^stenahava ^vrajam | yathā steno vrajamatyakramīt tadvat | tathā kṛtvā ^opadhīḥ opadhayaḥ ^prācucyavuḥ pracyāvayanti ^yatkiṃ ^ca ^tanvaḥ rugṇaśarīrasya ^rapaḥ pāpaṃ vyādhilakṣaṇamasti taditi || 9 ||

yadimā vājayanmahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe | ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā || 11 || yat | imāḥ | vājayan | aham | opadhīḥ | haste | ā'dadhe | ātmā | yakṣmasya | naśyati | purā | jīva'gṛbhaḥ | yathā || 11 || ^ahaṃ ^yat yadi ^imāḥ opadhīḥ ^hasta ^ādadhe ādhārayāmi | kiṃ kurvan | ^vājayana rugṇaṃ balinaṃ kurvan | nataḥ ^purā ^yakṣmasya rogasya ^ātmā ^naśyati naṣṭo bhavati ^jīvagṛbho ^yathā | jīvānāṃ śakunyādīnāṃ grāhakagrāhādyathā jīvā naśyanti tadvat | yadvā | jīvagṛbho mṛtyoḥ sakāśā- jīvo'pahniyate tadvat ||

yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathā'ṅgaṃ'aṅgaṃ paruḥ'paruḥ | tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhymaśīriva || 12 || yasya | oṣadhīḥ | pra'sarpatha | aṅgaṃ'aṅgam | paruḥ'paruḥ | tataḥ | yakṣmam | vi | bādhadhve | ugraḥ | madhymaśīḥ'iva || 12 || he ^opadhīḥ opadhayaḥ ^yasya rugṇasya ^aṅgaṃ yadaṅgaṃ ^paruḥparuḥ yatparva ^prasarpatha prakarṣeṇāśrayatha ^tataḥ aṅgātparvaṇaśca ^yakṣmaṃ vyādhiṃ ^vi ^bādhadhve | ^ugraḥ udbhaṇabalaḥ ^madhymaśīḥḥ madhyamasthāne vartamāno rājā yathā ^upadravakāriṇaḥ samanantaraśatrūn pade pade vibādhate tadvat ||

sākaṃ yakṣmaṃ pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā | sākaṃ vātasya bhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā || 13 || sākam | yakṣmam | pra | pata | cāṣeṇa | kikidīvinā | sākam | vātasya | bhrājyā | sākam | naśya | ni'hākayā || 13 || he asmadīyasya puruṣasya śarīrādhiṣṭhāyin ^yakṣma vyādhe tvaṃ ^sākaṃ sahaiva ^pra ^pata prakarṣeṇa śīghraṃ gaccha | kena sākamiti | ucyate | ^cāṣeṇa aniśīghraṃ patanā cāpākhyena pakṣiṇā saha | tathā ^kikidīvinā pakṣiṇā ca saha | tathā ^vātasya śīghraṃ gacchato vāyoḥ ^bhrājyā | 'bhraja gatau' | gatyā vegena saha gaccha | tathā ^nihākayā godhikayā ^sākaṃ ^naśya nāśaṃ prāpnuhi ||
tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā varcaḥ ||
anyā | vaḥ | anyām | atranu | anyā | anyasyāḥ | upa | atrana | tāḥ | sarvāḥ | sam'vidanāḥ | idam | me | pra | atrana | varcaḥ || 14 ||
he oṣadhayaḥ vaḥ yuṣmākaṃ madhye va anyā oṣadhiḥ va anyām oṣadhim va avatu prāpnotu |
tathā va anyānyasyāḥ samīpam va upāvata upagacchata |
evaṃ yāḥ santi kṣityāmoṣadhayaḥ va tāḥ va sarvāḥ va saṃvidanāḥ parasparamekamatyaṃ prāptāḥ satyaḥ va idaṃ va me madīyaṃ va vacaḥ prārthanālakṣaṇaṃ vacanaṃ va prāvata prakṣata ||
yāḥ phalinyā afalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ |
yāḥ | phalinyaḥ | yāḥ | afalāḥ | apuṣpāḥ | yāḥ | ca | puṣpiṇīḥ | bṛhaspati'prasūtāḥ | tāḥ | naḥ | muñcantu | aṃhasaḥ || 15 ||
va yāḥ va phalinyaḥ phalavatyaḥ va yā va afalāḥ phalavarjitāḥ yāḥ va apuṣpāḥ puṣparahitāḥ va yāśca va puṣpiṇīḥ puṣpavatyaḥ va bṛhaspatiprasūtāḥ |
va tāḥ va naḥ asmān va aṃhasaḥ va muñcantu mocayantu ||
muñcantu | mā | śapathyāt | atho | iti | varuṇyāt | uta | atho iti | yamasya | paḍvīśāt | sarvasmāt | deva'kilbiṣāt || 16 ||
va mā mām oṣadhayaḥ va śapathyāt śapathasaṃjātādenasaḥ sakāśāt va muñcantu |
va atho api ca va varuṇyāt varuṇasambhavāt va māṃ muñcantu |
va atho api ca va yamasya va paḍvīśāt pādavandhanānnigaḍātmuñcantu |
na kevalaṃ varuṇādeḥ pāpāt kiṃtu va sarvasmādevakilbiṣāt devaiḥ kṛtātpāpānmuñcantu ||
yaṃ jīvamaśvāmahai na sa riṣyāti puruṣaḥ ||
ava'patantīḥ | avadan | divaḥ | oṣadhayaḥ | pari | yam | jīvam | aśvāmahai | na | saḥ | riṣyāti | puruṣaḥ || 17 ||
va divaḥ dyulokāt va avapatantīḥ avapatantyaḥ va oṣadhayaḥ itthaṃ va pari va avadan |
va yaṃ va jīvaṃ jīvantaṃ va aśvāmahai vyāpsumaḥ va na va saḥ va puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ va riṣyāti riṣyati vinaśyati ||
4. ga-ta7-mu-na hiṃsyate; ta1.2-ma hiṃsyate; ta3.6-ma hiṃsyeta; ta8-bha-na hiṃsyāt |

yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ | tāsāṃ tvamasyuttamāṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde || 18 || yā | oṣadhīḥ | soma'rājñīḥ | bahvīḥ | śata'vicakṣaṇāḥ | tāsām | tvam | asi | ut'tamā | aram | kāmāya | śam | hṛde || 18 || ᐁyā ᐁoṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ ᐁsomarājñīḥ somo rājā svāmī yāsāṃ tāstathoktāḥ ᐁbahvīḥ asaṃkhyātāḥ ᐁśatavicakṣaṇāḥ bahudarśanā he somāgye opadhe ᐁtāsām oṣadhīnāṃ ᐁtvam ᐁuttama ᐁasi | yasmādevaṃ tasmāt ᐁaram alamatyarthaṃ ᐁkāmāya kāntāya ᐁhṛde hṛdayāya ᐁśaṃ sukhakarī bhaveti śeṣaḥ ||

yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu | bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃ datta vīryam || 19 || yā | oṣadhīḥ | soma'rājñīḥ | vi'sthitāḥ | pṛthivīm | anu | bṛhaspati'prasūtāḥ | asyai | sam | datta | vīryam || 19 || ᐁyā ᐁoṣadhīḥ oṣadhayaḥ ᐁsomarājñīḥ ᐁpṛthivīmanu ᐁviṣṭhitāḥ vividhaṃ sthitāḥ divaḥ sakāśādāgatya pṛthivyāṃ nānābhedena sthitāḥ ᐁbṛhaspatiprasūtāḥ bṛhaspatinānujñātāḥ sadyo yūyam ᐁasyai rugṇatanve ᐁvīryaṃ ᐁsaṃ datta saṃdhatta ||

mā vo riṣatkhanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ | dvipaccatuṣpadasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam || 20 || mā | vaḥ | riṣat | khanitā | yasmai | ca | aham | khanāmi | vaḥ | dvi'pat | catuḥ'pat | asmākam | sarvam | astu | anāturam || 20 || he oṣadhayaḥ ᐁvaḥ yuṣmān ᐁmā ᐁriṣat mā hiṃsyāt | kaḥ | ᐁkhanitā bhūmeḥ khananakartā | ᐁyasmai rugṇāya ᐁcāhaṃ khanāmi ᐁvaḥ yuṣmān | kiṃca ᐁasmākaṃ saṃbandhi ᐁdvipat putrabhṛtyādikaṃ ᐁcatuṣpat gomahiṣyādikaṃ ca yadasti tat ᐁsarvam ᐁanāturam arogam ᐁastu ||

yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāṃgatāḥ | sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃ datta vīryam || 21 || yāḥ | ca | idam | upa'śṛṇvanti | yāḥ | ca | dūram | parā'gatāḥ | sarvāḥ | sam'gatya | vīrudhaḥ | asyai | sam | datta | vīryam || 21 || ᐁyāśca oṣadhayaḥ ᐁidaṃ stotram ᐁupaśṛṇvanti ᐁyāśca oṣadhayaḥ ᐁdūraṃ ᐁparāṃgatāḥ ᐁsarvāḥ ᐁvīrudhaḥ ᐁsaṃgatya saṃgatāḥ satyo he ᐁvīrudhaḥ ᐁasyai rugṇatanve ᐁvīryaṃ ᐁsaṃ datta ||

oṣadhayaḥ saṃ vadante somena saha rājñā | yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi || 22 || oṣadhayaḥ | sam | vadante | somena | saha | rājñā | yasmai | kṛṇoti | brāhmaṇaḥ | tam | rājan | pārayāmasi || 22 || voṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ vsomena vrājñā vsaha vsaṃ vvadante saṃvādaṃ kurvanti | kimiti taducyate | vyasmai rugṇāya vbrāhmaṇaḥ oṣadhimāmarthyajño brāhmaṇo vaiyaḥ vkṛṇoti karoti cikitsāṃ vtaṃ rugṇaṃ he vrājan vpārayāmasi pārayāmaḥ || idanto masiḥ ||

tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tarva vṛkṣā upastayaḥ | upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmā~ abhidāsati || 23 || tvam | ut'tamā | asi | oṣadhe | tava | vṛkṣāḥ | upastayaḥ | upastiḥ | astu | saḥ | asmākam | yaḥ | asmān | abhi'dāsati || 23 || he voṣadhe somāgye vtvam oṣadhīnāmanvāsām vuttamasi | tava vvṛkṣāḥ sarve vupastayaḥ adhaḥśāyina eva | tathā sati vsaḥ vupastirastu avaḥśāyī bhavatu vyo'smān vabhi- dāsati abhihinasti ātnuya iti || || 11 ||
‘bṛhaspate prati’ iti dvādaśarcamaṣṭamaṃ sūktaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ bṛhaspatimitrādisarvadevatākam |
asya sūktasyārthaṃ nihakkāraḥ pradarśayati—‘devāpiśvāṣṭipeṇaḥ śaṃtanuśca kauravyau bhrātarau babhūvatuḥ |
tataḥ śaṃtano rājye dvādaśa varṣāṇi devo na vavarṣa |
tamūcurbrāhmaṇā adharmasavayā carito jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaramantarityā- bhiṣecitaṃ tasmātte devo na varṣatīti |

bṛhaspate prati me devatāmihi mitro vā yadvaruṇo vāsi pūṣā | ādityairvā yadvasubhirmarutvāntsa parjanyaṃ śaṃtanave vṛṣāya || 1 || bṛhaspate | prati | me | devatām | ihi | mitraḥ | vā | yat | varuṇaḥ | vā | asi | pūṣā | ādityaiḥ | vā | yat | vasubhiḥ | marutvān | saḥ | parjanyam | śam'tanave | vṛṣāya || 1 || tatra brahmatve pravṛtto bṛhaspatimanudhāvati | he vbṛhaspate vme mama vṛṣṭyarthaṃ vprati vdevatāṃ vprati vihi pratigaccha | yaṣṭavyā devatāḥ pratigaccha | yadi tvaṃ vmitro vā vasi athavā vvaruṇaḥ asi vyadvā vpūṣā asi athavā vādityaiḥ dvādaśādityairuṇādibhiḥ vvasubhiḥ vāsakairavasubhirdhruvā- dibhiḥ saha vmarutvān | maruto devāḥ | tadvānsi | vsaḥ tvaṃ vparjanyaṃ tarpayitāraṃ meghaṃ vśaṃtanave rājñe vvṛṣāya varṣaya | ‘chandasi śāyajapi’ iti vyatyayena śapo'pi śāyajādeśaḥ ||
1. ga-ta-bha-oṣadhīnāmanveṣāṃ | 2. ga-ta1.2.3.6.8-bha4.5.8-sa devāpistapaḥ | 3. ta1.2.3. 6.7.8-ma1.2.4.8-vṛṣṭyarthe | 4. ta1.2.3.6.7-vā athavā ; ta4.5-vā yadvā | 5. ga4-vā athavā |

ā devo dūto ajiraścikitvān tvaddevāpe abhi māmagacchat | pratīcīnaḥ prati māmā vavṛtsva dadhāmi te ghumatīṃ vācamāsan || 2 || ā | devaḥ | dūtaḥ | ajiraḥ | cikitvān | tvat | deva'āpe | abhi | mām | agacchat | pratīcīnaḥ | prati | mām | ā | vavṛtsva | dadhāmi | te | ghumatīm | vācam | āsan ||2||
^devaḥ kaścit ^dūtaḥ ^ajiraḥ gamanaśīlaḥ ^cikitvān cetanāvān he ^devāpe ^tvat tvattaḥ makāśāt tvayā preṣitaḥ san ^mām ^abhi ^ā ^agacchat abhyāgacchatu |

asme dhehi ghumatīṃ vācamāsan bṛhaspate anamīvāmiṣirām | yaryā vṛṣṭiṃ śaṃtanave vanātra divo drapso madhumā~ ā viveśa || 3 || asme iti | dhehi | ghumatīm | vācam | āsan | bṛhaspate | anamīvām | iṣirām | yaryā | vṛṣṭim | śaṃ'tanave | vanātra | divaḥ | drapsaḥ | madhumān | ā | viveśa || 3 ||
he ^bṛhaspate tvam ^asme asmāsu ^ghumatīṃ dīptimatīṃ ^vācaṃ stotrātmikām ^āsan āsye- 'smadīye ^dhehi sthāpaya |
^yayā vācā stutyātmikayā devāniṣṭvā ^śaṃtanave vṛṣṭikāmāya ^vanāva saṃbhajevahi ^vṛṣṭiṃ tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca ^divaḥ dyulokāt |

ā nau drapsā madhumanto viśantvindra dedhirathaṃ sahasram | ni ṣpīda hotramṛtuthā yajasva devān devāpe haviṣā saparya || 4 || ā | naḥ | drapsāḥ | madhumantaḥ | viśantu | indra | dehi | adhi'ratham | sahasram | ni | sīda | hotram | ṛtuthā | yajasva | devān | deva'āpe | haviṣā | saparya || 4 ||
he ^indra parameśvara bṛhaspate ^adhirathaṃ rathasyādhyupari vartamānaṃ ^sahasraṃ sahasrasaṃkhyakaṃ dhanaṃ ^dehi dhehi |
niṣaṇṇaśca tvam ^ṛtuthā kāle kāle ^yajasva yaṣṭavyān ^devān stutyā ^haviṣā ca ^saparya paricara ||

ārṣṭiṣeṇo hotramṛṣirniṣīdan devāpirdevasumatiṃ cikitvān | sa uttarasmādadharaṃ samudramapo divyā asṛjadvarṣyā abhī || 5 || ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ | hotram | ṛṣiḥ | ni'sīdan | deva'apiḥ | deva'sumatim | cikitvān | saḥ | ut'tarasmāt | adharam | samudram | apaḥ | divyāḥ | asṛjat | varṣyāḥ | abhi || 5 ||
vārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya putraḥ vdevāpiḥ vṛṣiḥ vdevasumarti devānāṃ kalyāṇīṃ matiṃ stutiṃ vcikīrṣvān jānan vhotraṃ hotrakarma kartuṃ vniṣīdan nipaṇṇo bhavati |
vsa vuttarasmāt upari vartamānadantarikṣāt samudrāt vadharam adho vartamānaṃ pārthivaṃ vsamudram vabhi vdivyāḥ divi bhavāḥ vvarṣyāḥ varṣabhavāḥ vapaḥ vasṛjat sṛjatu |
atra ‘ārṣṭiṣeṇa ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya putraḥ’ (niru. 2. 11) ityādi niruktaṃ draṣṭavyam ||

asminsamudre adhyuttarasminnāpo devebhirnirvṛtā atiṣṭhan | tā adravannāṣṭiṣeṇena sṛṣṭā devāpinā preritā mṛkṣaṇīṣu || 6 || asmin | samudre | adhi | utta'rasmin | āpaḥ | devebhiḥ | ni'vṛtāḥ | atiṣṭhan | tāḥ | adravan | ārṣṭiṣeṇena | sṛṣṭāḥ | deva'apinā | pra'īṣitāḥ | mṛkṣaṇīṣu || 6 ||
vuttarasmin samudre antarikṣasthe vāpaḥ udakāni vdevebhiḥ dyotamānaiḥ vnivṛtāḥ niruddhāḥ vatiṣṭhan |
vtāḥ āpaḥ vārṣṭiṣeṇena ṛṣṭiṣeṇasya putreṇa vdevāpinā vsṛṣṭāḥ vpreṣitāḥ prakarṣeṇecchāṃ prāptāḥ kāṅkṣitāḥ vmṛkṣaṇīṣu mṛṣṭavatīṣu parimṛṣṭāsu sthalīṣu vadravan sravanti ||

yaddevāpiḥ śaṃtanave purohito hotrārya vṛtaḥ kupyanadīveta | devaśrutaṃ vṛṣṭivarni rarāṇo bṛhaspatirvācamasmā ayacchat || 7 || yat | deva'apiḥ | śam'tanave | puraḥ'hitaḥ | hotrārya | vṛtaḥ | kupyan | adīvet | deva'śrutam | vṛṣṭi'varnim | rarāṇaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ | vācam | asmai | ayacchat || 7 ||
vyat yadā vdevāpiḥ ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ vśaṃtanave svabhrātre kauravyāya vpurohitaḥ san vhotrāya hotrārthaṃ vvṛtaḥ san vdevaśrutam |
taṃ tathā vvṛṣṭivarni vṛṣṭiyācinaṃ bṛhaspatim vadhītya anvadhyāyat sa ca vrarāṇaḥ ramamāṇaḥ vbṛhaspatiḥ devaḥ vasmai devāpaye vvācam vayacchat ||

yaṃ tvā devāpiḥ śuśucāno agne ārṣṭiṣeṇo manuṣyaḥ samīdhe | viśvebhirdevairanumadyamānaḥ pra parjanyamīrayā vṛṣṭimantam || 8 || yam | tvā | deva'apiḥ | śuśucānaḥ | agne | ārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ | manuṣyaḥ | sam'idhe | viśvebhiḥ | devaiḥ | anu'madyamānaḥ | pra | parjanyam | īraya | vṛṣṭi'mantam || 8 ||

he agne vyaṃ vtvā tvāṃ vśuśucānaḥ stotreṇa jvalan vmanuṣyaḥ vārṣṭiṣeṇaḥ vdevāpiḥ vsamīdhe samyagdīpayati sa tvaṃ vviśvebhiḥ sarvaiḥ vdevaiḥ vanumadyamānaḥ anumādyamānaḥ3 san vparjanyaṃ meghaṃ vvṛṣṭi- mantaṃ varṣavantaṃ vpra vīraya gamaya ||
tvāṃ pūrva ṛṣayo gīrbhirāyan tvāmadhvareṣu puruhūta viśve |
sahasrāṇyarthānyasme ā nau yajñaṃ raṃhiśśopa yāhi ||
tvām | pūrvai | ṛṣayaḥ | gīḥ'bhiḥ | āyan | tvām | adhvareṣu | puruhūta | viśve | sahasrāṇi | adhi'rathāni | asme iti | ā | naḥ | yajñam | rohita'aśva | upa | yāhi ||9||
he agne tvāṃ pūrvai ṛṣayaḥ gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ āyan āgacchan |
tathā he puruhūta bahubhi- rāhūtāgne viśve sarve'pīdānīṃtanā yajamānāḥ adhvareṣu yajñeṣu stutibhiḥ gacchantīti śeṣaḥ |
kiṃca sahasrāṇi sahasrasaṃkhyāni goyūthāni adhirathāni rathādhikāni asme asmākaṃ śaṃtanunā dakṣiṇā- tvena saṃkalpitāni bhavantviti śeṣaḥ |
he rohitaśva no yajñam upa yāhi upāgaccha ||
tebhirvardhasva turvaḥ śūra pūrvīrdivo nau vṛṣṭimiṣito rirīhi ||
etāni | agne | nṛtiḥ | nava | tve iti | ā'hutāni | adhi'rathā | sahasrā | tebhiḥ | vardhasva | turvaḥ | śūra | pūrvīḥ | divaḥ | naḥ | vṛṣṭim | iṣitaḥ | rirīhi || 10 ||
he agne gavāṃ navaniḥ nava ca tathā etāni adhirathāni sahasrā sahasrāṇi ca rathādhikāni gavāṃ sahasrāṇi ca tve tvayi āhutāni tvayi praṇayitavye satyāhutāni |
tebhiḥ taiḥ prattaiḥ pūrvīḥ bahvīḥ tanvaḥ tanūḥ yuṣmadīyāḥ vardhasva vardhaya |
naḥ asmadarthaṃ divaḥ dhulokāt vṛṣṭim iṣitaḥ prārthitaḥ san rirīhi pūraya ||
etānyagne nṛti sahasrā saṃ pra yaccha vṛṣṇa indrāya bhāgam |
vidvān pṛtha ṛtuśo devayānān divi deveṣu dhehi ||
etāni | agne | nṛtim | sahasrā | sam | pra | yaccha | vṛṣṇe | indrāya | bhāgam | vidvān | pṛtha | ṛtu'śaḥ | deva'yānān | arpi | aulānam | divi | deveṣu | dhehi || 11 ||
he agne gavām etāni nṛti sahasrā sahasrāṇi ca vṛṣṇe varṣitre indrāya bhāgaṃ saṃ pra yaccha |
kiṃca devayānān pathaḥ devayānān mārgān vidvān tvam ṛtuśaḥ kāle kāle aulānam api kurukulajātamāpi śāntanavaṃ deveṣu madhye dhehi nidhehi sthāpaya ||
agne bādhasva vi mṛdho vi duhāpāmīṃvāmapa rakṣāṃsi sedha |
asmātsamudrāddhuto divo no'pāṃ bhūmānamurpa naḥ sṛjaha ||
agne | bādhasva | vi | mṛdhaḥ | vi | duḥ'gahā | apa | amīvām | apa | rakṣāṃsi | sedha | asmāt | samudrāt | bṛhataḥ | divaḥ | naḥ | apām | bhūmānam | urpa | naḥ | sṛja || 12 ||
he agne durgāṇi durgahāṇi duḥkhena gāhitavyāni śatrupurāṇi vi bādhasva |
2. ga-sa tvamadhirāthāni sahasrāṇi rathoparī vartamānāni dhanāni sahasrasaṃkhyākāni asmabhyaṃ yaccheti śeṣaḥ |
3. ga1.2-āhutāni āhūtāni; ga4-āhutāvāhūtāni; tara-āhutāni āhatāni; ta6.8-bha1.4.7-āhutāni āhutāni |
^bṛhat : mahataḥ ^divaḥ dyulokādantarikṣādvā ^apām udakānāṃ ^bhūmānaṃ bahubhāvaṃ vṛṣṭisaṃsyāyam ^iha asmi~lloke ^upa ^sṛja prayacchetyarthaḥ ||
‘kaṃ naḥ’ iti dvādaśarcaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ vaikhānasasya vantrasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ —‘kaṃ no vantro vaikhānasaḥ’ iti|

kaṃ na̭ścitra॒miṣa̭ṇyasi ci॒ki॒tvānpṛ॒thumā̭na॒ṃ vāśra̭ṃ vā॒vṛdha̭dhyai | katta̭sya॒ dātu॒ śava̭so॒ vyṷṣṭau॒ takṣa̭dva॒jraṃ vṛ̭tra॒tura̭ma॒pinva̭t || 1 || kam | naḥ | citram | iṣaṇyasi | cikitvān | pṛthumānam | vāśram | vāvṛdhadhyai | kata | tasya | dātuḥ | śavasaḥ | vi'uṣṭau | takṣat | vajram | vṛtra'turam | apinvata || 1 || he indra ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ ^kaṃ dhanaviśeṣam ^iṣaṇyasi prerayasi | ^cikitvān sarvathā preraṇīyamiti jānan | kīdṛśaṃ tam | ^pṛthumānaṃ pṛthubhāvaṃ prāpnuvantaṃ ^vāśraṃ śabdanīyaṃ stutyam | kimartham | ^vavṛdhadhyai asmākaṃ vardhanāya | kiṃca ^tasya indrasya ^śavasaḥ balasya ^vyuṣṭau dyucchane sati ^kata ^dātu kiṃ dānamasmākaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | yaṃ ^vajraṃ vṛtraturaṃ vṛtrasyācarakasya pāpasya hiṃsakaṃ tvaṣṭā ^takṣat atakṣat sādhu saṃpāditavān ^apinvata abhijagdha | tasya śavaso vyuṣṭāviti saṃbandhaḥ | yadvā | he indra kata ^kiṃ tasya ^vajrasya dānaṃ bhavati yaṃ vajramindrārthaṃ takṣaditi yojanā | ‘mahaṃ tvaṣṭā vajramatakṣadāyasam’ (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 48. 3) iti mantrāntaram ||

sa hi yu॒tā vi॒dyutā̭ veti॒ sāma̭ pṛ॒thuṃ yo॒nimasura̭tvā॒ sesā̭da | sa sa॒nīḻaiḥ pra॒sahā̭no a॒sya bhrātṷrna ṛ॒te sa॒ptatha̭sya mā॒yāḥ || 2 || saḥ | hi | yutā | vi'yutā | veti | sāma | pṛthum | yonim | asura'tvā | ā | sesāda | saḥ | sa'nīḻaiḥ | prasahānaḥ | asya | bhrātuḥ | na | ṛte | saptathasya | māyāḥ || 2 || ^sa ^hi sa khalvindraḥ ^yutā dyotamānena ^vidyutā etannāmakena āyudhena yuktaḥ san ^sāma stotrātmakaṃ yajñasaṃbandha ^veti gacchati | tathā ^asuratvā asuratvena balena yuktaḥ san ^pṛthuṃ vistīrṇaṃ ^yoniṃ phalasyotpādakaṃ yajñaṃ ^sesāda saṃgato bhavati | ^saḥ indraḥ ^sanīḻaiḥ nīḍaṃ vimānam | savimānairmarudbhiryuktaḥ san ^prasahānaḥ abhibhavan bhavati | tasya ^saptathasya ādityānāṃ dhātrādīnāṃ madhye saptamasyendrasya ^bhrātuḥ bhārgabhaktavyasya ^māyā āsurī ^ṛte yajñe ^na saṃbhavatīti śeṣaḥ ||

sa vā॒jaṃ yā̭ta॒rpadṷṣpadā॒ yanta̭rva॒rpātā॒ pari̭ ṣa॒tsani̭ṣyan | a॒rvā ya̭ccha॒tadṷrasya ve॒do a॒cchra̭de॒vā a॒bhi va̭rpa॒sā bhṷ̄t || 3 || saḥ | vājam | yātā | arpadaḥ'padā | yan | straḥ'sātā | pari | sadat | saniṣyan | arvā | yacchat | śata'durasya | vedaḥ | ghnan | śikṣat'devān | abhi | varpasā | bhūt || 3 ||
1. ta-bha- ‘kiṃ’ nāsti | 2. ga4-kiṃ tvasya; ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ma-kiṃ tasya; ta4.5-ka tvasya | 3. ta-bha- ‘sa hi’ nāsti | 4. bha-yathā |
^apa- duṣpadā apagataduṣṭapatanena ^yan gacchan ^saniṣyan tatra śatrudhanāni saṃbhaktumicchan ^pari ^ṣadat pariṣīdati|
kiṃca ^anarvā yuddhe apratyata^ indraḥ ^śatadurastha śatadvārasya śatrupurasya antarnihitaṃ ^yat ^vedaḥ dhanamasti taddhanaṃ ^varṣasā āvarakeṇa balena ^abhi ^bhūta^ abhilavati|

sa yahvayo^'vanīrgoṣvā juhoti pradhnyānu sastriḥ| apādo yatra yujyāso^'rathā droṇyaśvāsa īrate ghṛtaṃ vāḥ|| 4|| saḥ| yahvayaḥ| avanīḥ| goṣu| arvā| ā| juhoti| pra'dhnyānu| sastriḥ| apādaḥ| yatra| yujyāsaḥ| arathāḥ| droṇi'aśvāsaḥ| īrate| ghṛtam| vāriti vāḥ||4||
kenāpi śūnyāḥ ^droṇyaśvāsaḥ drutavyāpanāḥ ^yujyāsaḥ yujyā indrasya sakhyo nadyaḥ ^vāḥ vārakaṃ ^ghṛtam udakam ^īrate prerayanti tatrājuhoti||

sa rudrebhiraśastavāra ṛdhvā hitvī garyamoreaṃvadya āgāt| vagrasya manye mithunā virvatrī anaṃbhītyārodayanmuṣāyan|| 5|| saḥ| rudrebhiḥ| aśasta'vāraḥ| ṛdhvā| hitvī| garyam| āre'aṃvadyaḥ| ā| agāt| vagrasya| manye| mithunā| virvatrī iti vi'rvatrī| anaṃm| abhi'itya| arodayat| muṣāyan||5||
kiṃca ^vagrasya etannāmakasya ṛṣermama ^mithunā mithunau mātāpitarau ^vivavatrī vigatajvarau ^manye avagacchāmi|
atha vagraḥ ^adhraṃ śatrusaṃbandhi ^abhītya abhiprāya ^muṣāyan muṣṇan ^arodayat rodayati|

sa idāsaṃ tuvīravaṃ patirdana ṣaḻakṣaṃ triśīrṣāṇaṃ damanyat| asya trito nvojasā vṛdhāno vipā varāhamatyagrayā han|| 6|| saḥ| it| dāsam| tuvi'rarvam| patiḥ| dan| ṣaṭ'akṣam| tri'śīrṣāṇam| damanyat| asya| tritaḥ| nu| ojasā| vṛdhānaḥ| vipā| varāham| aryaḥ'aprayā| han iti han|| 6||
1. ta-bha- ‘saṃgrāme’ nāsti| 2. bha- ‘apratyata ...... bhūt’ nāsti| 3. ga-ta-kīdṛśaḥ saḥ| 4. ga-ta-ma-āgacchati|

ᐡsa ᐢit sa evendraḥ ᐣpatiḥ sarvasya svāmī ᐤdāsam upakṣapayitāraṃ ᐥtuvīkhaṃ bahuśabdaṃ saṃgrāme bhayaṃkaraṃ śabdaṃ kurvāṇaṃ vṛtraṃ ᐦdanaṃ damanay ᐧpalakṣam akṣapaṭkopetaṃ ᐨtriśīrṣāṇaṃ triśiraskaṃ svaṣṭuḥ putraṃ viśvarūpaṃ ᐩdamanyat damituṃ prahartumaicchat |
kiṃca ᐪtritaḥ etannāmā maharṣiḥ ᐫasya indrasya ᐬojasā balena ᐭvṛṣānaḥ vardhamānaḥ ᐮvipā aṅgulyā |
sa bradhataḥ śavasānebhi̭rasya kutsā̭ya॒ śuṣṇa̭ṃ kṛ॒paṇe॒ parā̭dāt |
a॒yaṃ ka॒virma̭nayaccha॒syamā̭na॒tkaṃ yo a̭sya sa॒rnitā॒ta nṛ॒ṇām ||
saḥ | bradhataḥ | śavasānebhiḥ | asya | kutsāya | śuṣṇam | kṛpaṇe | parā | adāt | ayam | kavim | anayat | śasyamānam | arkam | yaḥ | asya | sarnitā | uta | nṛṇām ||9||
mahato'pi śatrūna vśavasānebhiḥ balamācarannrāyudhaiḥ vasya asyatu |
‘kutsāya śuṣṇamaśuṣa ni barhīḥ’ (ṛ. saṃ. 4. 16. 12) iti mantrāntaram |
vśasyamānaṃ stuvantam vanayat vaśaṃ prāpa- yattasya virodhinam |
vyaḥ kaviḥ vasya indrasya varkaṃ rūpaṃ vsanitā saṃbhaktā bhavati |
vuta api ca vnṛṇāṃ vṛṣṭyādinetṝṇāmindrādanucarāṇāṃ marutāṃ yaḥ kaviḥ sanitā tamanayaditi ||
a॒yaṃ da̭śa॒syanna̭ryaibhi̭rasya da॒smo de॒vebhi̭rva॒ruṇo॒ na mā॒yī |
ayam | daśasyan | naryaibhiḥ | asya | dasmaḥ | devebhiḥ | varuṇaḥ | na | māyī | ayam | kanīnaḥ | ṛtupāḥ | avedi | amimīta | aruram | yaḥ | catuḥ'pāt || 10 ||
vayam indraḥ vdaśasyan stotṛbhyo dhanaṃ prayacchan |
tathā vdevebhiḥ dyotamānaiḥ svatejobhiḥ vdasmaḥ darśanīyaḥ vvaruṇo vna varuṇa iva |
tathā vayaṃ vkanīnaḥ kamanīyaḥ vṛtupāḥ ṛtau pātā vavedi ajñāyi |
a॒sya sto॒mebhi̭rau॒śija̭ ṛ॒jiśvā॒ vraja̭ṃ da̭raya॒dvṛṣa̭meṇa pi॒prauḥ |
su॒tvā yadya̭jato dī॒daya̭dgīḥ pu॒ra i॒yāno॒ abhi̭ va॒rpasā̭ bhūt ||
asya | stomebhiḥ | auśijaḥ | ṛjiśvā | vrajam | darayat | vṛṣeṇa | piprauḥ | sutvā | yat | yajataḥ | dīdayat | gīḥ | puraḥ | iyānaḥ | abhi | varpasā | bhūt || 11 ||

'asya indrasya 'stomebhiḥ stotraiḥ 'a~śijaḥ uśijaḥ putraḥ 'ṛjiśvā etannāmā 'vṛṣabheṇa' vajreṇa vṛṣabheṇa vā yuktaṃ 'vrajaṃ goṣṭhaṃ 'piproḥ etannāmakasyāsurasya saṃbandhine tenāpahastya pālitaṃ 'darayat adārayat |
evā maho asura vṛkṣathāya vamrakaḥ pṛṣṭhirupa sarpadindram |
sa īyānaḥ karati svastimāsmā iṣamūrjaṃ sukṣitiṃ viśvamābhāḥ ||
eva | mahaḥ | asura | vṛkṣathāya | vamrakaḥ | pṛṣṭhibhiḥ | upa | sarpat | indram | saḥ | iyānaḥ | karati | svastim | asmai | iṣam | ūrjam | sukṣitim | viśvam | ā | abhāḥ || 12 ||
he 'asura balavannindra svām 'eva evamukta- prakāreṇa 'mahaḥ mahato havipaḥ stotrasya vā 'vṛkṣathāya vahanāya mahataḥ svargādeḥ prāpaṇāya vā 'pṛṣṭhibhiḥ pādaiḥ 'upa 'sarpat upāgamat |
tathā 'iṣam annam 'ūrjaṃ rasaṃ 'sukṣitiṃ sunivāsaṃ samyak 'viśvaṃ sarvam 'ābhāḥ āharatu ||
tatra 'indra dadha' iti dvādaśacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ candanaputrasya duvasyorvāṣa vaiśvadevam |
tathā cānukrāntam—' indra duvasyurvāndano vaiśvadevaṃ svanayā triṣṭup ' iti |
indra dadha maghavantvāvadidduja iha stutaḥ sutapā bodhi no vṛdhe |
devebhiḥ naḥ savitā prāvatu śrutamā sarvatātimiditi vṛṇīmahe ||
indra | dadha | maghavan | tvā'vat | ita | bhuje | iha | stutaḥ | sutapāḥ | bodhi | naḥ | vṛdhe | devebhiḥ | naḥ | savitā | pra | avatu | śrutam | ā | sarvatātim | aditima | vṛṇīmahe || 1 ||
he 'indra 'maghavan dhanavan tvaṃ 'tvāvadit tvatsadṛśameva śatrupalaṃ 'dadha māraya |
tadartham 'iha asmin yajñe 'stutaḥ san 'sutapāḥ sutasya abhiputasya somasya pātā 'bodhi budhyasva |
kiṃca 'devebhiḥ devaiḥ saha 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'śrutaṃ viśrutaṃ yajñaṃ 'savitā sarvasya svasvakamaṃsu prerako devaḥ 'prāvatu prarakṣatu |
1. ga-ta1.2.3.6.7-mu-vṛṣabheṇa varṣaṇe | 2. ga.1.2-ta-bha-' iyānaḥ ' nāsti | 3. ta1.2.3. 4.5.6-bha1.2.4.7-upagamyamānaḥ | 4. ta4.5-golābhāya |

bharā̭ya॒ su bha̭rata॒ bhāga̭mu॒ti॒vaṃ pra vā॒yavḙ śu॒ci॒pe kṛ॒ndadi̭ṣṭaye | gau॒rasya॒ yaḥ pa̭ryasaḥ pī॒timā̭ṃna॒śa ā sa॒rvatā̭ti॒madi̭ti॒ vṛṇī̭mahe || 2 || bharā̭ya | su | bha̭rata | bhāga̭m | ṛ॒tvi॒yam | pra | vā॒yavḙ | śu॒ci॒'pe | kṛ॒ndat'i̭ṣṭaye | gau॒rasya̭ | yaḥ | pa̭ryasaḥ | pī॒tim | ā॒na॒śe | ā | sa॒rva'tā̭tim | adi̭tim | vṛṇī̭mahe ||2|| ^bharā̭ya saṃgrāmakāriṇe sarveṣāṃ poṣakāya vendrāya ^ṛtviyaṃ kāle jātaṃ prāptakālaṃ ^bhāgaṃ ^su ^bharata suṣṭhu saṃpādayata he ṛtvijaḥ | tathā ^śucipe śuddhasya somasya pātre ^krandadiṣṭaye śabditagamanāya | vāyoḥ śīghragamane hi śabdaḥ pratyakṣaḥ | tādṛśāya ^vāyave ^devāya ^pra bharata bhāgamiti śeṣaḥ | ^yaḥ devaḥ ^gaurasya gauravarṇasya paśoḥ ^
ayam ᐁindra: ᐁukthena ᐁśavasā stutyena balena ᐁpaḥ parva yajñiyamasmadīyaṃ vā ᐁdadhe dhārayati|
he ᐁbṛhaspate ᐁāyupaḥ mamāyupasya ᐁpratarītā pravardhayitā ᐁasi bhava|
tathā ᐁyajño ᐁmanuḥ mantā ᐁpramatiḥ prakṛṣṭā matiryasya saḥ ᐁnaḥ ᐁpitā pālakaḥ san ᐁkaṃ sukhaṃ prayacchatu|
yajño mantro buddhiśca pratyekaṃ sukhaṃ prayacchatu ||

indrasya nu sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho'gnigṛhe jaritā medhiraḥ kaviḥ | yajñaśca bhūdvidhve cārurantam ā sarvatātimaditi vṛṇīmahe || 6 || indrasya | nu | su'kṛtam | daivyam | sahaḥ | agniḥ | gṛhe | jaritā | medhiraḥ | kaviḥ | yajñaḥ | ca | bhut | vidathe | cāruḥ | antam | ā | sarva'tātim | aditima | vṛṇīmahe || 6 ||
ᐁdaivyaṃ devānāṃ hitaṃ ᐁsahaḥ balaṃ yadasti tat ᐁindrasya ᐁsukṛtaṃ indreṇa khalu suṣṭhu saṃpāditam|
yasukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho balaṃ¹ marasaṃjñakamasti tadindrasya nu indrasya saṃbandhi khalu|
indrasya nu² saṃbandhi sukṛtaṃ daivyaṃ saho devāhaṃ balam ᐁagnigṛhe asmadīye yāgagṛhe vartata iti śeṣaḥ|
indrasya saṃbandhī suṣṭhu saṃpādito devānāṃ balabhūto'gnigṛhepatyaḥ san vartata ityarthaḥ|
sa cāgniḥ ᐁjaritā devānāṃ stotā ᐁmedhiraḥ|
tadvān ᐁkaviḥ krāntaprajñaḥ ᐁyajñaḥ yaṣṭavyaḥ ᐁca ᐁbhūta bhavati|
kiṃca so'gniḥ ᐁcāruḥ caraṇīyaḥ ᐁantamaḥ asmākamanti- katamaśca ||

na vo guhā cakram bhūri~ duṣkṛtaṃ nāviṣṭyai vasavo devaheḻanam | mārkino devā anṛtasya varpasa ā sarvatātimaditi vṛṇīmahe || 7 || na | vaḥ | guhā | cakram | bhūri~ | duḥ'kṛtam | na | āviḥ'tyam | vasavaḥ | deva'heḻanam | mārkiḥ | naḥ | devāḥ | anṛtasya | varpasaḥ | ā | sarva'tātim | aditima | vṛṇīmahe ||7||
he devāḥ³ ᐁvaḥ yuṣmākaṃ ᐁguhā guhāyāṃ pracchanne deśe ᐁbhūri prabhūtaṃ ᐁduṣkṛtaṃ pāpam|
tathā ᐁāviṣṭyam āviḥ saṃbhūtaṃ ᐁdevaheḻanaṃ devānāṃ krodhanaṃ tannimittaṃ drohaṃ ᐁna cakram he ᐁvasavaḥ vāsakā devāḥ|
kiṃca he ᐁdevāḥ ᐁnaḥ asmākam ᐁanṛtasya ᐁvarpasaḥ rūpasya prāptiḥ ᐁmākiḥ mā bhūt|
itaḥ paraṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ mā bhūdityarthaḥ|

apāmīvāṃ savitā sāviṣatparvarīṃ idapa sedhantvadrayaḥ | grāvā yatra madhusuducyate bṛhadā sarvatātimaditi vṛṇīmahe || 8 || apa | amīvām | savitā | sāviṣat | ᐁgvarīm | idapa | sedhantu | adrayaḥ | grāvā | yatra | madhu'sut | ucyate | bṛhat | ā | sarva'tātim | aditima | vṛṇīmahe || 8 ||
ᐁsavitā sarvasya prerakaḥ savitādevo'smākaṃ saṃbandhinm ᐁamīvāṃ rogam ᐁapa ᐁsāviṣat apamerayatu|

ubhe dhurau vahnirāpindamāno'ntaryoneva carati dvijāniḥ | vanaspatiṃ vana āsthāpayadhvaṃ ni ṣū dadhidhvaṃ makhanenta utsam || 11 || ubhe iti | dhurau | vahniḥ | ā'pindamānaḥ | annaḥ | yonā'iva | carati | dvi'jāniḥ | vanaspatim | vane | ā | āsthāpayadhvam | ni | su | dadhidhvam | makhanentaḥ | utsam || 11 ||
havirdhānaśakaṭasya ubhe dhurau āpindamānaḥ āviṣadamānaḥ vahniḥ havirvāhako'naḍvāān yonau antaḥ iva dvijāniḥ dvijāyaḥ tayorantaḥ carati |
taṃ vanaspatiṃ vanaspativikāraṃ śakaṭaṃ vane vanasaṃbandhini vṛkṣe |
tatpaścāt tatratyaṃ somaṃ su suṣṭhu ni dadhidhvaṃ sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā sthāpaya- tāsanthām |
abhipavapradeśe ca paścāt utsaṃ tadrasam avanantaḥ saṃpādayatetyarthaḥ |
yasya lāṅgalasyobhe dhurāvāpindamāno'piśadamāno vahniranaḍvāān antaryonāvivetyādi samānam |
tādṛśaṃ vanaspatiṃ vanaspativikāraṃ lāṅgala vane vananīye vapanārthaṃ karṣaṇapradeśa āsthāpayadhvam |
su suṣṭhu sarvatra taṃ lāṅgala ni dadhidhvam |
utsaṃ sekasādhanaṃ gartaṃ siktaṃ vā pradeśamakhanantaḥ ||

tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘pra te mudgalo bhārmyaśva ṛṣeṇa dudhaṇena vājiṃ jigāyeti drāghaṇaṃ vādyā tṛtīyānanyā ca bṛhatya:’ iti|

dudhaṇaṃ cāgrata: kṣitvā corebhyo jagṛhe svagā:’ iti|
tathā nirukte'pīyaṃ kathā sūcitā—‘mudgalo bhārmyaśva ṛṣivṛṣabhaṃ ca dudhaṇaṃ ca yuktvā saṃgrāme vyavahṛtyājiṃ jigāya’ (niru. 9. 23) iti||
pra| te| ratham| mithu'kṛtam| indra:| avatu| dhṛṣṇuyā| asmin| ājau| puru'huta| śravāyyai| dhana'bhakṣeṣu| na:| ava|| 1||
he mudgala te rathaṃ mithukṛtaṃ mitha:kṛtasahāyaṃ kṛtam|
aśvādibhi: śūnyaṃ kṛtaṃ dhṛṣṇuyā dharṣaṇaśīla: indro'vatu rakṣatu|
he puruhūta bahubhirāhūtendra asmin‌ājau saṃgrāme'pahṛtagomiśrairai: kṛte saṃgrāme|
utsma vātau vahati vāsau asyā adhirathaṃ yadajayatsahamam|
ut| sma| vāta:| vahati| vāsa:| asyā:| adhi'ratham| yat| ajayat| sahasram| rathī:| abhūt| mudgalānī| go'iṣṭau| bhare| kṛtam| vi| acet| indra'senā || 2||
asyā: ‘rathīrabhūnamudgalānī’ iti vakṣyamāṇatvādasya mudgalasya patnyā: sārathibhūtāyā: vāsa: aṃśukaṃ vāta: vāyu: ut vahati ūrdhvaṃ prāpayati|
yat yadā adhiratham adhikaṃ rathamāruhya sahasraṃ sahasrasaṃkhyākaṃ gosaṃgham ajayat tadā|
gaviṣṭhau gavāmapahatānāmeṣaṇe mudralānī mudralasya strī rathīrabhūta sārathirbhavat |
indrasya śatrūṇāṃ dārayiturmudralasya senānī- rūpā mudralānī |
bhare saṃgrāme kṛtaṃ saṃpāditaṃ gosaṃghaṃ vyacet vyacinot |
dāsasya vā maghavannāryasya vā sanutaryavayā vadham ||

antaḥ | yaccha | jighāṃsataḥ | vajram | indra | abhidāsataḥ | dāsasya | vā | maghavan | āryasya | vā | sanutaḥ | yavaya | vadham || 3 || he indra jighāṃsataḥ hantumicchataḥ abhidāsataḥ abhidruhyataḥ śatroḥ vajram antaryaccha antargamaya | tadevāha | he maghavan dhanavannindra dāsasya vā upakṣīṇasyālpasya āryasya abhi- gantavyasya mahato vā śatroḥ vadham | vajranāmaitat | hananasādhanaṃ vajraṃ sanutaḥ | antarhitanāmaitat | antarhitaṃ gūḍhaṃ prayujyamānaṃ yavaya pṛthak kuru ||
pra muṣkabhāraḥ śrave icchamāno'jiraṃ bāhū aṃbaratipāsan ||

udraḥ | hṛdam | apibat | jarhapāṇaḥ | kūṭam | sma | tuṃhat | abhimātim | eti | pra | muṣkabhāraḥ | śravaḥ | icchamānaḥ | ajiram | bāhū iti | abharat | sisāsan || 4 || atra vṛṣabhaḥ stūyate | vṛṣabhaḥ udraḥ udakasya hṛdam agādhajalāśayam apibat jarhapāṇaḥ atyantaṃ harṣitaḥ san | tathā kūṭaṃ parvataścauraṃgopidhanāthaṃ nihitaṃ tuṃhat sma śatreṇa vihiṃsitavān | vyadārayadityarthaḥ | tathā kṛtvā abhimātimeti śatruṃ gacchati hantum | paścāt muṣkabhāraḥ pravṛddhamuṣkaḥ | pravṛddhasya vṛṣabhasya hi muṣkavṛddhirbhavati | tathā pravṛddho vṛṣabhaḥ śravaḥ | śrūyata iti śravo yaśaḥ | icchamānaḥ icchan ajiraṃ gamanaśīlaṃ śatruṃ bāhū bāhubhyāṃ bāhvorvā pra abharat prahatavān | yadvā ajiramiti kṣipranāma | kṣipraṃ sipāsan saṃbhaktumicchan bāhū prābharat | prasāritavānityarthaḥ ||
tena sūryameva śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudralaḥ pradhane jigāya ||

ni | akrandayan | upayantaḥ | enam | amehayan | vṛṣabham | madhye | ājeḥ | tena | sūryameva | śatavat | sahasram | gavām | mudralaḥ | pradhane | jigāya || 5 || mudrala āha | teneti tacchabdaśruteryacchabdādhyāhāraḥ | yam enaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ nyakrandayan nitarāṃ krandanaṃ kurvan | ke | upayantaḥ samīpe gacchanto naraḥ | yathā pracaṇḍena krandanena śatravo bhītāḥ palāyante tathākurvan | kim | vṛṣabhaṃ varṣakaṃ settāram ājeḥ saṃgrāmasya madhye amehayan mūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ
tena utkarūpeṇa vṛṣabheṇa subharvaṃ suṣṭhu yavasādi śatavat śatopetaṃ gavāṃ sahasraṃ mudgalaḥ etannāmāhaṃ pradhane saṃgrāme jigāya ajeyam ||
dudhairyuktasya dravataḥ sahārnasa ṛcchanti ṣmā niṣpadoṃ mudlānīm ||
kukardaive | vṛṣabhaḥ | yuktaḥ | āsīt | avāvacīt | sārathiḥ | asya | keśī | dudhaiḥ | yuktasya | dravataḥ | saha | anasā | ṛcchanti | sma | niḥpadaḥ | mudlānīm || 6 ||
kukardaive hiṃsanāya śatrūṇāṃ vṛṣabhaḥ varṣitā gauḥ |
keśī keśavān pragrahavān asya rājñaḥ rathasya vā sārathiḥ |
‘vaca paribhāṣaṇe’ ityasya kevalasyāntarbhūta- ṇyarthasya yaṅlugantasya luṅi rūpam |
asya sārathiḥ sahāyabhūtaḥ keśī prakṛṣṭakeśo vṛṣabho'- vāvacīta bhṛśamaśabdayat |

evaṃbhūtasya dudheḥ durdharasya anasā saha dravataḥ śīghraṃ śatrumadhye rathena saha dhāvato vṛṣabhasya bhayaṃkaraśabdena niṣpadaḥ nirgacchanto yoddhāraḥ mudlānīṃ mudlānīṃ yoṣitaṃ sārathibhūtāṃ prati ṛcchanti sma agacchannityarthaḥ |
uta | pradhim | ut | ahan | asya | vidvān | upa | ayunak | vaṃsagam | atra | śikṣan | indraḥ | ut | āvrat | patim | adhanyānām | arhata | padyābhiḥ | kukurvān || 7 ||
uta api ca vidvān sa mudgalaḥ asya rathasya pradhim pradhirlakṣacchidrakāpaḥ prāntakāṣṭhaḥ |
tadanantaram atra rathe vaṃsagaṃ vananīyagamanaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ śikṣan śikṣayan rajjuṣu sthāpayan upāyunak rathasamīpe yuge'yojayat |
evaṃ sati indraḥ devaḥ adhanyānāṃ ahantavyānāṃ gavāṃ patim ut utkṛṣṭam āvrat rakṣāmakarot |
paścāt kukurvān vṛṣabhaḥ padyābhiḥ saraṇibhiḥ arhata vegenāgamat |
nṛmṇāni kṛṇvan bṛhave janāya gāḥ paspaśānastarvipīradhatta ||
śunam | aṣṭavī | acarat | kapardī | varatrāyām | dāru | ānahamānaḥ | nṛmṇāni | kṛṇvan | bṛhave | janāya | gāḥ | paspaśānaḥ | tarvipīḥ | adhatta || 8 ||
śunam iti sukhanāma | sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā | aṣṭavī | aṣṭa pratodaḥ tadvān | chāndaso viniḥ | kapardī kapardavān acarat saṃcarati | kiṃ kurvan | varatrāyāṃ vadhrau dāru kāṣṭhaṃ rathāṅgabhūtam
imaṃ taṃ paśya vṛṣabhasya yujaṃ kāṣṭhāyā madhye dughaṇaṃ śayānam |
yenaṃ jigāya śatavatsahasraṃ gavāṃ mudgalaḥ pṛtanājyeṣu ||
imam | tam | paśya | vṛṣabhasya | yujam | kāṣṭhāyāḥ | madhye | dughnam | śayānam | yena | jigāya | śatavat | sahasram | gavāṃ | mudgalaḥ | pṛtanājyeṣu || 9 ||
kaṃcana sakhāyaṃ senādisahāyābhāvena jayaviṣaya upahāsaṃ kurvāṇaṃ prati bravīti |
tatra ^śayānaṃ hantadhyān sarvān hatvā sukhena svapantaṃ nirvyāpāratvena vartamānam |
^yena dughaṇena ^śatavat śatapetaṃ ^gavāṃ ^sahasraṃ ^pṛtanājyeṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ^jigāya ahamajaipaṃ tamimaṃ paśyeti samanvayaḥ |
āre aghā ko ni^tthā dadarśa yaṃ yujanti tambrā sthopayanti |
nāsmai tṛṇaṃ nodakamā bharantyuttaro dhuro vahati pradediśat ||
āre | aghā | kaḥ | nu | itthā | dadarśa | yam | yujanti | tam | ^oṃ iti | ā | ^sthāpayanti | na | asmai | tṛṇam | na | udakam | ā | bharanti | ut'taraḥ | dhuraḥ | vahati | pra'dediśat || 10 ||
yaḥ ^āre samīpa eva ^aghā aghāni duḥkhāni śatrurūpāṇi karoti taṃ ^kaḥ naraḥ ^nu idānīm ^itthā itthaṃ ^dadarśa paśyati |
kiṃca ^yaṃ dughaṇaṃ ^yujanti rathe ^tamu tameva ^ā ^sthāpayanti āroha- yantītyarthaḥ^ |
yaṃ rathe yujanti tameva praharaṇādhamā sthāpayanti |
īdṛśo dughaṇaḥ ^uttaraḥ dakṣiṇasya vṛṣabhasya svayamuttaraḥ san ^dhuraḥ rathabhārasya rathadhuraṃ ^vahati ^pradediśat prakarṣeṇa jayaṃ svāmine pradiśan śatrūṇāṃ vā bhayaṃ pradiśan vahati |
ebaiṣyā cidrathyā jayema sumaṅgala sirnavadastu sātam ||

parivṛttā'iva | pati'vithyam | ānṭ | pīpyānā | kūcreṇa'iva | sidhnan | e'eṣyā | cit | radhyā | jayema | su'maṅgalam | sirna'vat | astu | sātam || 11 ||
tathā patisamīpaṃ sārathivaināgatya vpīpyānā vardhamānā bhavati |
tena varṣaṇīyatvena nimittena sidhnan jalaṃ varṣanmegha iva |
sa yathāntarikṣe svalpamātro'pi varṣaṇasamaye mahānbhavati tadvadiyamapi śatrumadhye śaradhārā varṣantī vardhata ityartha: |
īdṛśyā tathā vrathyā sārathibhūtayā vjayema śatrubhirapahṛtaṃ gosaṃgham |
tasyā: vsātaṃ dattaṃ saṃbhajanaṃ vā vsumaṅgala śobhanamaṅgalavat vsinavat |

tvaṃ viśvasya jagataścakṣurindrāsi cakṣupaḥ | vṛṣā yadājiṃ vṛṣaṇā sipāsasi codayan vṛdhiṇā yujā || 12 || tvam | viśvasya | jagata: | cakṣu: | indra | asi | cakṣupa: | vṛṣā | yat | ājim | vṛṣaṇā | sipāsasi | codayan | vṛdhiṇā | yujā || 12 ||
he vindra vtvaṃ vviśvasya sarvasya vjagata: vcakṣuṣa: cakṣuṣmata: paśyato vā jagata: vcakṣu: vasi |
tvāmeva hi yajñādinā labdhvā purupārthān sādhayanti |
viśvasya jagato yannijaṃ cakṣurasti tasyāpi cakṣupastvaṃ cakṣurasi |

vyat yasmāt vvṛṣā abhimatavarṣakastvam vājiṃ mudralasya mama saṃgrāmaṃ vvadhiṇā pāśena vyujā yujāṃ yuktau vvṛṣaṇā vṛṣaṇā varṣakāśvau rathe yojayitvā vcodayan śatrupu prerayan vsipāsasi ājiṃ saṃbhaktumicchasi tasmāccakṣurasi ||
'āśu: śiśāna:' iti trayodaśacaṃ caturtha sūktamindraputrasyāpratirathanāmna ārṣam |
tathā cānukrāntam—'āśu: sasainandro'pratirathaścaturthī bārhaspatyo'pānyāvādevyanyānuṣṭupmārutī vā' iti |
sāmicitye kratau cittamabhiprā praṇīyamāneṣu dakṣiṇato vajatā brahmaṇaitatsūktaṃ japyam |
tathā ca sūtritaṃ—'dakṣiṇataśca vraja- apatyāśu: śiśāna iti sūktaṃ samāpya' (āśva. śrau. 1. 12) iti |
āśu: śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghana: kṣobhaṇadharṣaṇīnām |
āśuḥ | śiśāṃnaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ | na | bhīmaḥ | ghanāghanaḥ | kṣobhaṇaḥ | carṣaṇīnām | mṛ'krandanaḥ | ani'miṣaḥ | eka'vīraḥ | śatam | senāḥ | ajayat | sākam | indraḥ || 1 ||
ayamindraḥ ᐁāśuḥ śīghrakārī vyāpakau vā ᐁśiśānaḥ niścitaḥ |
sa yathā tīkṣṇābhyāṃ śṛṅgābhyāṃ bhīmo bhavati tadvat |
vṛṣabho na bhīmaḥ vṛṣabho yathā śṛṅgābhyāṃ bhayajanakaḥ tadvacchatrūṇāṃ bhayajanakaśca |
hanteḥ pacādyaci ' hanterdhaśca ' (pā.sū.6.1.12.7) iti dvivacanamabhyāsasyāḍāgamo ghatvaṃ ca dhātvabhyāsayoḥ |
ᐁsaṃkrandanaḥ samyak- krandayitā prāṇināmākarṣaṇena prahāreṇa vā |
īdṛśo'yam ᐁindraḥ ᐁśataṃ ᐁsenāḥ ᐁsākaṃ saha ekodyo- genaiva ᐁajayat jayati ||
tadindreṇa jayat tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā ||

samṛ'krandanena | ani'miṣeṇa | jiṣṇunā | yut'kāreṇa | duḥ'cyavanena | dhṛṣṇunā | tat | indreṇa | jayat | tat | sahadhvam | yudhaḥ | naraḥ | iṣu'hastena | vṛṣṇā || 2 || astu nāmendra uktavidhaḥ tathāpyasmākaṃ kimiti cet tatrāha | ᐁsaṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa cokta- lakṣaṇena ᐁjiṣṇunā jayaśīlena ᐁyutkāreṇa | yodhanaṃ yut | yuddhakāriṇā | karmaṇyaṇ | ᐁduścyavanena anyairavicālyena | ' cyuṅ muṅ gatau ' | ' chandasi gatyarthebhyaḥ ' (pā. sū. 3. 3. 129) iti yuc | ᐁdhṛṣṇunā dharṣakeṇa īdṛśena ᐁindreṇa ᐁtat yuddhaṃ ᐁjayata | ᐁtat śatrubalaṃ ᐁsahadhvam abhibhavata | he ᐁyudhaḥ yoddhāro he ᐁnaraḥ netāraḥ | ' vibhāṣitaṃ viśeṣavacane bahuvacanam ' (pā. sū. 8. 1. 74) iti pūrvasyāvidyamānavattvaniṣedhāduttaraṃ nihanyate | punaḥ kīdṛśenendreṇeti | ᐁiṣuhastena ᐁvṛṣṇā varṣitrā ca ||
sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro guṇena |

saḥ | iṣu'hastaiḥ | saḥ | niṣaṅgibhiḥ | vaśī | sam'sraṣṭā | saḥ | yudhaḥ | indraḥ | guṇena | saṃsṛṣṭa'jit | somapāḥ | bāhu'śardhī | ugra'dhanvā | prati'hitābhiḥ | astā || 3 || pūrvamantra indreṇa jayata ityuktam | atra indrasya jayasādhanasamarthatvaṃ darśayati | ᐁsaḥ indraḥ ᐁiṣu- hastaiḥ bhaṭaiḥ marudādibhiḥ ᐁvaśī vaśyaistadvān | tathā ᐁniṣaṅgibhiḥ yuktaḥ | niṣaṅgaḥ khaḍgaḥ | tadvadbhiḥ ᐁvaśī | ᐁsaḥ ca ᐁindraḥ ᐁyudhaḥ yudhyamānaḥ san | igupadhalakṣaṇaḥ kaḥ | athavā yudho yuddhahetoḥ | ᐁguṇena śatrusaṃghena saha ᐁsaṃsraṣṭā ekībhavanaśīlaḥ | yata evaṃvidho'taḥ ᐁsaṃsṛṣṭajit | ye parasparamekanyena yuddhāya saṃsraṣṭā bhavanti teṣāṃ jetā | tathā ᐁsomapāḥ somasya pātā | ᐁbāhuśardhī | śardho balam | bāhrorbalaṃ bāhubalam | tadvān | matvarthīya iniḥ | yadvā | ' śrudhu prasane ' | bāhubhyāṃ śardhatyabhibhavatīti bāhuśardhī | ' supyajātau ṇinistācchīlye ' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 78) iti ṇiniḥ | ᐁugradhanvā udyata-
dhanvā ᵥpratihitābhiḥ śatrupu preritābhiripubhiḥ ᵥastā mārayitā |
yatrenmumukṣati tatra vṛthā na bhavantī- sthyarthaḥ |
bṛhaspate pari dīya rathena rakṣohāmitrā apubādhamānaḥ |
bṛhaspate | pari | dīya | rathena | rakṣaḥ'hā | amitrān | apa''bādhamānaḥ | pra'bhañjan | senāḥ | pra'mṛṇaḥ | yudhā | jayan | asmākam | edhi | avitrā | rathānām ||4||
he ᵥbṛhaspate vṛhatāṃ pātaḥᵥ pālayitadeva ᵥrathena ᵥpari ᵥdīya parigaccha |
āgatya ca ᵥrakṣohā rakṣasāṃ hantā ᵥamitrān śatrūn ᵥapabādhamānaḥ sarvato nāśayan tathā ᵥsenāḥ śatrusambandhinīḥ ᵥprabhañjan prakarṣeṇa nāśayan ᵥpramṛṇaḥ prakarṣeṇa hiṃsan |
ᵥjayan evaṃ sarvatra jayaṃ pratipadyamānaḥ īdṛśastvam ᵥasmākaṃ ᵥrathānām ᵥavitāᵥ ᵥgṛdhi bhava ||
balavijñāyaḥ sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvānvājī sahamāna ugraḥ |
abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit ||
bala'vijñāyaḥ | sthaviraḥ | pra'vīraḥ | sahasvān | vājī | sahamānaḥ | ugraḥ | abhi'vīraḥ | abhi'satvā | saha'jāḥ | jaitram | indra | ratham | ā | tiṣṭha | go'vit ||5||
balaṃ samāyamiti sarvairbalatvena vijñāta iti balavijñāyaḥ |
ᵥsthaviraḥ mahān ᵥpravīraḥ prakarṣeṇa vīraḥḥ ᵥsahasvān parābhavasāmarthyavān ᵥvājī vejanavānannavānvā ᵥsahamānaḥ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitā ᵥugraḥ uddharṇabalaḥ ᵥabhivīraḥ |
abhigatā vīrā vīryavanto'nucarā yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
ᵥabhisatvā abhi- gatasatvā ᵥsahojāḥ sahaso balājjātaḥ evaṃmahābhāvastvaṃ he ᵥindra ᵥjaitraṃ jayaśīlaṃ ᵥratham ᵥā ᵥtiṣṭha asmatsahāyyārthamāroḍhumarhasi |
tvaṃ ca ᵥgovit udakasya stutervā labdhā veditā vā ||
gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayanta majaṃ pramṛṇanta mojasā |
imaṃ sajātā anu vīradhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam ||
gotra'bhidam | go'vidam | vajra'bāhum | jayantam | ajam | pra'mṛṇantam | ojasā | imam | sa'jātāḥ | anu | vīrayadhvam | indram | sakhāyaḥ | anu | saṃ | rabhadhvam || 6 ||
gā udakāni āyanta iti gotrā meghāḥ |
teṣāṃ bhettāraṃ ᵥgovidam udakasya labdhāraṃ ᵥvajrabāhuṃ vajrahastam |

ᵥjayantaṃ jayaśīlam ᵥajaṃ gamanaśīlaṃ śatrubalam ᵥojasā balena jayantaṃ yadvā ajaṃ ājiṃ jayanta mojasā balena ᵥpramṛṇantaṃ śatrūnabhibhavantamīdṛśaṃ mahābhāvam ᵥimam indraṃ he ᵥsajātāḥ sahotpannā yoddhāro yūyam ᵥanu ᵥvīrayadhvam |

abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ | duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḻayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu || 7 || abhi | gotrāṇi | sahasā | gāhamānaḥ | adayaḥ | vīraḥ | śata'manyuḥ | indraḥ | duḥ'cyavanaḥ | pṛtanāṣāṭ | ayudhyaḥ | asmākam | senā | avatu | pra | yutsu || 7 || ayama 'indraḥ 'gotrāṇi abhrāṇi meghān 'sahasā balena 'abhi 'gāhamānaḥ praviśan 'adayaḥ nirdeyaḥ 'vīraḥ vikrāntaḥ 'śatamanyuḥ bahuyajño bahukrodho vā 'duścyavanaḥ anyairacālyaḥ | svayaṃ 'pṛtanāṣā
ut | harya | magha'van | āyudhāni | ut | satvanām | māmakānām | manāṃsi | ut | vṛtra'han | vājinām | vājināni | ut | rathānām | jayatām | yantu | ghoṣāḥ || 10 ||
he maghavana indra asmadīyāni āyudhāni uddarṣaya utkṛṣṭaṃ harṣaya |
māmakānāṃ madīyānāṃ satvanāṃ prāṇināṃ sainikānāṃ manāṃsi ca ut harṣaya |
he vṛtrahan indra vājinām aśvānāṃ vājināni vegāḥ ut yantu |
tathā jayatāṃ rathānāṃ ghoṣāḥ ut yantu ||
asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmā~ u devā avatā haveṣu ||
asmākam | indraḥ | sam'ṛteṣu | dhvajeṣu | asmākam | yāḥ | iṣavaḥ | tāḥ | jayantu | asmākam | vīrāḥ | ut'tare | bhavantu | asmān | ū~ iti | devāḥ | avata | haveṣu || 11 ||
asmākaṃ saṃbandhinaṣveva samṛteṣu parasenāṃ saṃtrāseṣu dhvajeṣu dhvajavatsu sainikeṣu indraḥ rakṣitā bhavatu |
tathā asmākaṃ yā iṣavaḥ santi tāḥ eva jayantu śatrūn |
tathā asmākaṃ vīrāḥ bhaṭāḥ uttare upari bhavantu |
he devāḥ asmā~ u asmāneva avata rakṣata haveṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ||
abhi prehi nirdaha htasu śokairandhaināmitrāstamasā sacantām ||
amīṣām | cittam | prati'lobhayantī | gṛhāṇa | aṅgāni | apye | parā | ihi | abhi | pra | ihi | niḥ | daha | hṛta'su | śokaiḥ | andhena | amitraḥ | tamasā | sacantām || 12 ||
he apye pāpābhimānini devate amīṣāṃ yoddhṛṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī vimohayantī satī aṅgāni teṣāmavayavān śiraādikān gṛhāṇa svīkuru |
teṣāṃ samīpaṃ gatvā ca hṛtasu hṛdayeṣu śokaḥ nirdaha nitarāṃ bhasmīkuru |
te amitrāḥ asmacchatravaḥ andhena tamasā sacantāṃ saṃgacchantām ||
preta jyatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu |
pra | ita | jayata | naraḥ | indraḥ | vaḥ | śarma | yacchatu | ugrāḥ | vaḥ | santu | bāhavaḥ | anādhṛṣyāḥ | yathā | asatha || 13 ||
he naraḥ netāraḥ saṃgrāmasya nirvoḍhāro yoddhāraḥ preta prakarṣeṇa gacchata |
vaḥ yuṣmākam indraḥ śarma sukhaṃ yacchatu prayacchatu |
vaḥ bāhavaḥ ugrāḥ udbhaṭabalāḥ santu bhavantu |
anādhṛṣyāḥ anyairanabhi- bhāvyāḥ yathā yūyam asatha bhaviṣyatha tathogrāḥ santu vo bāhavaḥ ||

asāvi somaḥ puruhūta tubhyaṃ harībhyāṃ yajñamupa yāhi tūyam | tubhyaṃ giro vipravīrā iyānā dadhanvira indra pibā sutasya || 1 || asāvi | somaḥ | puru'hūta | tubhyam | harī'bhyām | yajñam | upa | yāhi | tūyam | tubhyam | giraḥ | vipra'vīrāḥ | iyānāḥ | dadhanvira | indra | piba | sutasya || 1 || he 'puruhūta bahubhiḥ stotṛbhirāhūta 'tubhyaṃ 'tvadartha 'somaḥ 'asāvi abhiputo'bhūt | ‘puñ abhiṣave’ ityasmātkarmaṇi luṅ | ataḥ 'harībhyāṃ haritavarṇābhyāmaśvābhyāṃ 'yajñam asmadīyaṃ 'tūyaṃ tūrṇam 'upa 'yāhi upāgaccha | 'tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ 'giraḥ asmadīyāḥ sutayaḥ 'vipravīrāḥ | viprā medhāvino vīrā viśeṣeṇa prerayitāraḥ prodramayitāraṃ yāsāṃ tāstathoktāḥ | 'iyānāḥ gamanaśīlāḥ 'dadhanvira gamyante | asmābhiryuṣmatprīṇanāya prāpyanta ityarthaḥ | ‘iṅ gatau’ | tācchīlikāḥ śānac | chāndaso vikaraṇasya luk | dhavirgatyarthaḥ | iditānjum | karmaṇi chāndaso liṭ | yata evamataḥ 'sutasya abhiputasyāṃśaṃ sutaṃ somaṃ vā 'piba || prathame paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsistre ‘apsu dhūtasya’ ityeṣā yājyā | sūtritaṃ ca—‘apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeheti yājyā’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||

apsu dhūtasya harivaḥ pibeha nṛbhiḥ sutasya jaṭharaṃ pṛṇasva | mimikvaryamadraya indra tubhyaṃ tebhirvardhasva madamukthavāhaḥ || 2 || apsu | dhūtasya | hari'vaḥ | piba | iha | nṛbhiḥ | sutasya | jaṭharam | pṛṇasva | mimikvaḥ | yam | adrayaḥ | indra | tubhyam | tebhiḥ | vardhasva | madam | uktha'vāhaḥ || 2 || he 'harivaḥ | ‘ṛksābhe vā indrasya harī’ (ai. brā. 2. 24) iti śruteḥ stotraśastrādhāra- bhūtābhyāmṛksāmābhyāṃ harībhyāṃ tadvacchindra 'apsu ekadhanādipudakeṣu 'dhūtasya kampitasya | abhiputa- syetyarthaḥ | tathā 'nṛbhiḥ karmanetṛbhiḥ karmanirvāhakairvyavatrādibhiḥ 'sutasya abhiputasya | ubhayatra ‘kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam’ iti karmaṇaḥ saṃpradānasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘caturthyarthe bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti ṣaṣṭhī | īdṛśaṃ somam 'iha asmin‌yajñe 'piba | pītvā ca 'jaṭharaṃ svakīyaṃ 'pṛṇasva pūraya ca | ‘ādilope vibhāṣā’ iti prathamā tiṅ‌vibhaktirna nihanyate | 'yaṃ somam 'adrayaḥ abhiṣavagrāvāṇo he 'indra 'tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ 'mimikvaḥ setumabhitumicchan | abhiṣavamakurvantyarthaḥ | ‘miha secane’ ityasya sani liṅ‌śisi rūpam | he 'ukthavāhaḥ ukthaiḥ śasyamāna 'tebhiḥ taiḥ 'madaṃ 'vardhasva || dvitīye paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ ‘progrām’ ityeṣā yājyā | sūtritaṃ ca—‘aśvāvati prathamaḥ progrām pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāmiti yājyā’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti ||

progrām pītiṃ vṛṣṇa iyarmi satyāṃ praye sutasya harṣva tubhyam | indra dhenābhiriha mādayasva dhībhirviśvābhiḥ śacyā gṛṇānaḥ || 3 || pra | ugrām | pītim | vṛṣṇe | iyarmi | satyām | praye | sutasya | hari'aśva | tubhyam | indra | dhenābhiḥ | iha | mādayasva | dhībhiḥ | viśvābhiḥ | śacyā | gṛṇānaḥ || 3 || 1. ta-bha-te tubhyaṃ |
he haryaśva indra vṛṣṇe varṣakāya tubhyam ugrām udgūrṇaṃ satyāṃ pītiṃ somapāne pra hyarmi prerayāmi |
ato he indra śacyā śaktyā karmaṇā vā yuktaḥ gṛṇānaḥ stūyamānastvaṃ viśvābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ dhenābhiḥ stutivāgbhiḥ viśvābhiḥ dhībhiḥ sarvaiḥ karmabhiśca iha asmin yajñe mādayasva tṛpyasva |
tṛtīye paryāye brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ śastre 'ūtī śacīvaḥ' ityeṣā yājyā |
'ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇeti yājyā' (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti sūtritam ||
ūtī śacīvastava vīryeṇa vayo dadhānā uśija ṛtajñāḥ |
ūtī | śacī'vaḥ | tarva | vīryeṇa | vayaḥ | dadhānāḥ | uśijaḥ | ṛta'jñāḥ | prajā'vat | indra | manuṣaḥ | duroṇe | tasthuḥ | gṛṇantaḥ | sadha'mādyāsaḥ || 4 ||
he śacīvaḥ śaktivan indra tava ūtī ūtyā rakṣaṇena tava vīryeṇa vayaḥ annaṃ prajāvat prajopetaṃ dadhānāḥ dhārayantaḥ uśijaḥ tvāmeva kāmayamānāḥ ṛtajñāḥ ṛtaṃ yajñamaharjānantaḥ |
aṅgi- rasaḥ satramanutiṣṭhantaḥ ṣaṣṭhe'hani prayogamṛḍhāḥ manto nābhānediṣṭena pāraṃ gatā yataḥ atastepāmṛtajñatvam |
īdṛśo'ṅgirasaḥ manuṣaḥ manuṣyasya yajamānasya duroṇe yajñagṛhe gṛṇantaḥ tvāṃ stuvantaḥ sadhamādyāsaḥ saha mādyantaḥ tasthuḥ tiṣṭhanti |
mādayate : 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti vacanāt kartari 'aco yat' iti yat |
maṃhiṣṭhāmūrti vitire dadhānāḥ stotāra indra tarva sūnṛtābhiḥ ||
praṇīti'bhiḥ | te | hari'aśva | mu'stoḥ | mu'sumnasya | puru'rucaḥ | janāsaḥ | maṃhiṣṭhām | ūtim | tri'tire | dadhānāḥ | stotāraḥ | indra | tarva | sūnṛtābhiḥ || 5 ||

he haryaśva haritavarṇāśvopeta indra suṣṭuḥ suṣṭhu stūyamānasya supumnasya susukhasya sudhanasya vā pururucaḥ bahudīpteḥ te tava praṇītibhiḥ praṇayanairdhanādipradānaiḥ janāsaḥ janāḥ stotāraḥ sūnṛtābhiḥ priyatatyāsmikābhirvāgbhiḥ |
vitire anyebhyo- rthibhyo vitaraṇāya maṃhiṣṭhām atiśayena maṃhanīyāṃ tava sambandhinīm ūtiṃ rakṣāṃ dadhānāḥ āsata iti śeṣaḥ ||
upa brahmāṇi harivo haribhyāṃ somasya yāhi pītaye sutasya |
indra tvā yajñaḥ kṣamamāṇamānaṭ dāśvān asyadhvarasya praketaḥ ||
upa | brahmāṇi | hari'tvaḥ | hāri'bhyām | somasya | yāhi | pītaye | sutasya | indra | tvā | yajñaḥ | kṣamamāṇam | ānaṭ | dāśvān | asi | adhvarasya | pra'ketaḥ || 6 ||

he <sup>v</sup>hariva: harivaścindra <sup>v</sup>sutasya abhiputasya <sup>v</sup>somasya <sup>v</sup>pītaye pānāya <sup>v</sup>brahmāṇa pariṣṭutā- nyasmadīyāni karmāṇi stotrāṇi vā <sup>v</sup>upa <sup>v</sup>yāhi upāgaccha |
upa bhūṣanti giro apratītīndraṃ namasyā jaritu: pananta ||

<sup>v</sup>sahasravājam aparimitamaparimitabalaṃ vā <sup>v</sup>abhimātipāham abhimātīnāṃ sarvato hiṃsakānāṃ śatrūṇāmabhibhavitāraṃ <sup>v</sup>suteraṇam abhipute some ramamāṇaṃ <sup>v</sup>maghavānaṃ dhanavantaṃ <sup>v</sup>suvṛktiṃ śobhanastutikam <sup>v</sup>apratītaṃ yuddhe'nyairapratigatam <sup>v</sup>indraṃ <sup>v</sup>gira: stutirūpā vāca: <sup>v</sup>upa <sup>v</sup>bhūṣanti alaṃkurvanti |
saptāpau devī: suraṇā amṛktā yābhi: sindhumatara indra pūrbhīt |
navṛtti srotyā nava ca sravantīrdevebhyo gātuṃ manuṣe ca vinda: ||
he indra <sup>v</sup>dājñayā <sup>v</sup>sapta etatsaṅkhyākā: <sup>v</sup>āpa: anvapā: <sup>v</sup>devī: devyo gaṅgādyā: <sup>v</sup>suraṇā: suṣṭhu ramamāṇā: śobhanaśabdā vā |
he <sup>v</sup>indra <sup>v</sup>pūrbhi: purāṃ bhettā <sup>v</sup>yābhi: gaṅgādibhi: sasanadībhi: <sup>v</sup>sindhuṃ samudram <sup>v</sup>atara: |
sapta sarpaṇasvabhāvā utkalakṣaṇā āpo devyasvavayā sṛṣṭā: pravahanti yābhi: sindhuṃ nadīmatarā: |
nadī: <sup>v</sup>devebhya: havirarthaṃ <sup>v</sup>manuṣe manuṣyāya bhogāthaṃ <sup>v</sup>ca <sup>v</sup>gātuṃ gantavyaṃ tāsāṃ mārgaṃ ca <sup>v</sup>vinda: alabhathā: ||

apo mahīrbharasteramuśvā <sup>v</sup>'jāgarāsvardhi deva eke: | indra yāstvaṃ vṛtratūrye cakrartha tābhirviśvāyustanvaṃ pupuṣyā: || 9 || apa: | mahī: | abhi <sup>v</sup>'śaste: | amu <sup>v</sup>'tra | ajāga: | āsu | ardhi | deva | eke: | indra | yā: | tvam | vṛtra <sup>v</sup>'tūrye | cakrartha | tābhi: | viśva <sup>v</sup>'āyu: | tanvam | pupuṣyā: || 9 || 1. ga-antrā nadya:; ta1.2.3.7-antrā dyā; ta4.5.8-bha1.2.4.8-antrā dyā: | 2. ga1.2- ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha- ‘tvaṃ’ nāsti |
he indra vmahī: mahatī: vapa: udakāni vabhiśste: abhiśaṃsakāddhantrāt vamujña:|
vāsu muktāsvapsu vdeva: tvam veka: eka eva asahāya: san vadhi vajāga: apramatto bhavasi|
he vindra vtvaṃ vyā: apa: vvṛtratyai vṛtrahatyāyāṃ meghahanane vcakartha karoṣi vtābhi: adbhi: vviśvābhi: sarvābhi: tvaṃ vtanuṃ svakīyaṃ śarīraṃ vpupuṣyā: poṣaye:|

vīreṇyaḥ ṛturindraḥ suśastirutāpi dhenā puruhūtamīṭṭe| ārdeyadvṛtramakṛṇoḍu lokaṃ saṃsāhe śakraḥ pratanā abhiṣṭiḥ|| 10|| vīreṇyaḥ| ṛtuḥ| indraḥ| su'śastiḥ| uta| api| dhenā| puru'hutam| īṭṭe| ārdeyat| vṛtram| akṛṇot| ū~ iti| lokam| saṃsāhe| śakraḥ| pratanāḥ| abhiṣṭiḥ|| 10||
vindraḥ vvīreṇyaḥ vīrairantavyo'tiśayena vīro vā vṛtuḥ karmavān vsuśastiḥ śobhanastutikaḥ vuta api ca|
prīṇayitrī stutivāk vpuruhūtam indram vīṭṭe stauti pūjayati vā|
kiṃcāyaṃ vvṛtram āvarakameta- dnāmakamasuram vārdeyat hatavānityarthaḥ|
na kevalaṃ tamekameva api tu vśakraḥ śaka indraḥ vabhiṣṭiḥ śatrūṇāmabhigantā vpratanāḥ śatrusenāḥ vsamāhe abhyabhavat||

śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindramasminbhare nṛtamaṃ vājasātau| śṛṇvantamugramūtaye samatsu ghnantaṃ vṛtrāṇi saṃjitaṃ dhanānām|| 11|| śunam| huvema| magha'vānam| indram| asmin| bhare| nṛtamam| vāja'sātau| śṛṇvantam| ugram| ūtaye| samatsu| ghnantam| vṛtrāṇi| sam'jitam| dhanānām|| 11||
kutsaputro nāgnā durmitro guṇataḥ sumitraḥ yadvā nāgnā sumitro guṇato durmitraḥ sa ṛṣiḥ|
'harī yasya suyujā' 'vajraṃ yaścakre' iti dve pipīlika- madhye ekādaśapadaṃ‌kaikādaśake uṣṇikau|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'kadā kautso durmitro nāgnā sumitro guṇataḥ sumitro vā nāgnā durmitro guṇata auṣṇihaṃ harī vajraṃ pipīlikamadhye triṣṭubantyādyā gāyatrī vā' iti|
maṃtrārthastu he iṃdra vājasātau vājasyānnasya sātirlābho yasmin so'yaṃ vājasātiḥ|
bibhrati jayalakṣmīmenana yodhdāra iti bharaḥ saṃgrāmaḥ|
tasmin saṃgrāme śunamutsāhena patradraṃ maghavānaṃ dhanavaṃta ata eva iṃdraṃ niratiśayaiśvaryasaṃpannaṃ nṛtamaṃ savesya jagatotiśayena netāraṃ tvāṃ huvema kuśikā vayaṃ yajñārthamāhvayāma|

tathā śṛṇvati asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇāṃ stutiṃ śṛṇvaṃtaṃ ugraṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ samasta saṃgrāmeṣu vṛtrāṇi vṛtropalakṣitani sarvāṇi rakṣāṃsi ghnaṃtaṃ hiṃsaṃtaṃ dhanānāṃ śatrusaṃbandhināṃ saṃjitaṃ samprājetāraṃ tvāṃ ūtaye rakṣagāya vayamāhvayema|
kudā vaṃso stotraṃ haryata āva imā rudhadāḥ | dīrgha sutaṃ vātāpyāya || 1 || kudā | vaso iti | stotram | haryate | ā | ava | imā | rudhat | vāriti vāḥ | dīrgham | sutam | vātāpyāya || 1 ||
he vaso vāsayitarindra stotram asmatkṛtakaṃ haryate kāmayamānāya kāmayamānaṃ tvām |
kadā kasmin kāle ava rudhat ava- rosyati |
‘chanda- syubhayathā’ iti tir ārdhadhātukatvāt ‘jeraniṭi’ iti lope ‘halṅyābhyaḥ’ iti tilopaḥ |
yathā kutyetastana udakānyavaruṇaddhi avarudhya ca vārayati tathetyarthaḥ |
dīrgha savanatrayarūpeṇāyataṃ sutam abhiputaṃ somaṃ prati |

harī yasya suyujā vivratā verantānu śepā | ubhā rujī na keśinā patirdana || 2 || harī iti | yasya | suyujā | viḍavratā | veḥ | arbantā | anu | śepā | ubhā | rujī iti | na | keśinā | patiḥ | dan || 2 ||
yasya indrasya harī haritavarṇāvaśvau suyujā suṣṭhu niyojyau |
ubhā ubhau rajī na rajasī dyāvāpṛthivyāviva |
keśinā keśinau prakāśamānau keśanavanto vā īdṛśāvaśvau he indra yasya te tatra svabhūtau tayoḥ patiḥ svāmī tvaṃ dan dhanāni prayacchan anu veḥ stutaśastrādīnyanukāmayasva |
danniti dadāteḥ śatari ‘chandasyubhayathā’ ityārdhadhātukatvāt ‘āto lopa iti ca’ ityākāralopaḥ |
apa yoindraḥ pāpaja ā matoṃ na śaṃśamāṇo bibhīvān | śubhe yadyuyuje tarvipīvān || 3 || apa | yoḥ | indraḥ | pāpaje | ā | matau | na | śaṃśamāṇaḥ | bibhīvān | śubhe | yat | yuyuje | tarvipīvān || 3 ||
tasmin matau na manuṣya iva śaṃśamāṇaḥ tena saha yuddhe śrāmyan bibhīvān bibhyacca bhavati |
sa indraḥ yat yadā tarvipīvān marudbhirbalairbalavān yuyuje yujyate saṃpadyate śubhe śobhārthaṃ tadānīm apa yoḥ |
saccāyorindraścarṣu ā~ upānasaḥ saparyan | nadayortrivratayoḥ śūra indraḥ || 4 || saccā | āyoḥ | indraḥ | carṣe | ā | upānasaḥ | saparyan | nadayoḥ | viḍavratayoḥ | śūraḥ | indraḥ || 4 ||

vāyoḥ | manuṣyanāmetat | manuṣyasya stotuḥ vcarṣe punaḥpunarlekhanāya | dhanapradānāyeśyarthaḥ | vsacā saha dātavyairdhanaiḥ sahitaḥ | yadvā | āyoḥ sacā sahāyabhūtaḥ | vupānasaḥ anaḥ upagatavān | ‘atyādayaḥ krāntādyarthe dvitīyayā’ (pā. ma. 2. 2. 18. 4) iti prādisamāsaḥ | ‘anasantānna- puṃskāt’ (pā. sū. 5. 4. 103) iti samāsāntaṣṭac | ārūḍharatha ityarthaḥ | vsaparyan dhanaiḥ stotāraṃ pūjayan | yadvā | vyatyayena kartṛpratyayaḥ | stutibhirvibhiśca pūjyamānaḥ | uktaguṇaviśiṣṭaḥ man vā āgacchati | upasargaśruterucitakriyādhyāhāraḥ | kīdṛśa indraḥ | vnadayoḥ hepāśabdaṃ kurvataḥ vvivratayoḥ viśiṣṭakarmaṇoraśvayorniyantā vśūraḥ vikrāntaḥ ||
adhi yastasthau keśarvantā vyarcasvantā na puṣṭyai | vanoti śiprāmyāṃ śipriṇīvān || 5 || adhi | yaḥ | tasthau | keśa'vantā | vyarcasvantā | na | puṣṭyai | vanoti | śiprāmyām | śipriṇī'vān || 5 ||

vyaḥ indraḥ vkeśavantā keśinau vvyarcasvantā vyacanavantau vyāptimanau | vna ityanarthako nipātaḥ | īdṛśāvaśvau vpuṣṭyai popāya yajamānasyātmano vā vadhi vtasthau adhitiṣṭhati ārohati | ‘adhiśīṅsthāsāṃ karma’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 46) iti karmaṇo'dhikaraṇasaṃjñā | yadvā neti cārthe | tena guṇau samuccīyete | praśastakeśau vyacasvantau cetyarthaḥ | saḥ vśiprāmyāṃ hanubhyāṃ vśipriṇīvān śiprāvānindraḥ | eko mantrārtho'nuvādaḥ | vvanoti somān yācate | ‘vanu yācane’ | yadvā | vanuvyatihantikarmā | śatrūn hinasti || || 26 ||
prāstaudṛṣvaujā ṛṣvebhistakṣa śūraḥ śarvasā | ṛbhuna ṛtubhirmātariśvā || 6 || pra | astaut | ṛṣva'ojāḥ | ṛṣvebhiḥ | takṣa | śūraḥ | śarvasā | ṛbhuḥ | na | ṛtubhiḥ | mātariśvā || 6 ||
vyāsabalau vā vṛṣvebhiḥ darśanīyairmarudbhiḥ maha vprāstaut prastauti |
ya indraḥ vśūraḥ vikrāntaḥ vmātariśvā vṛṣṭinirmātaryantarikṣe śvasan vartamānaḥ san vśavasā balena vṛtubhiḥ
61.2-na idānīṃ puṣṭyai puṣṭyartha adhi tasthau adhitiṣṭhati |
5. ga1.2-pustakasthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamantra- bhāṣyaṃ-ṛṣvaujā mahaujā ṛṣvebhiḥ mahadbhiḥ saha yuddhaṃ prāstaut prastauti |
śavasā balena upeta indraḥ śūraḥ takṣa śatrūn tanūkaroti ; tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ |
ṛbhurna bhāsamāno mātariśvā vāyuryathā ṛtubhiḥ karmabhiḥ vanasya tanūkaroti tadvadityarthaḥ |

kriyamāṇaiḥ karmabhiḥ | yadvā | kraturiti prajñānāma | balena prajñābhiśca tatakṣa vṛtravadhādikaṃ cakāra | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 'ṛbhurna ṛbhava iva | 'supāṃ suluk' iti jasaḥ surādeśaḥ | ṛbhavo yathā karmabhiḥ prajñābhiranyasādhāraṇarathacamasādinirmāṇakurvan tadvadityarthaḥ ||
vajraṃ yaścakre suhanāya dasyave hirīmaśo hirīmān |
vajram | yaḥ | cakre | su'hanāya | dasyave | hirīmaśaḥ | hirīmān | aruta'hanuḥ | adbhutam | na | rajaḥ || 7 ||
yaḥ indraḥ 'suhanāya suṣṭhu hananīyāya 'dasyave upakṣapayitre śatrave tasya vadhāya 'vajraṃ praharaṇasādhanamāyudhaṃ 'cakre kṛtavān sa tvaṃ vṛjinā śiśahītyuttaratra saṃbandhaḥ |
arva | naḥ | vṛjinā | śiśīhi | ṛcā | vanema | anurcaḥ | na | abrahmā | yajñaḥ | ṛdhak | jorṣati | tve iti || 8 ||
he indra 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'vṛjinā vṛjināni varjanīyāni pāpāni 'ava 'śiśīhi atyarthaṃ tanukaru |
vayaṃ ca 'ṛcā stutyā sādhanena 'anurcaḥ astutikānayajamānān 'vanema hiṃsāma |
stutivirahitaḥ 'yajñaḥ 'ṛdhak sastṛtikāyajñapṛṣṭhabhūtaḥ 'tve tvayi 'na 'joṣati na sevate tvām |
ūrdhvā yattai tretinī bhūyajñasya dhuḥsu sabran |
ūrdhvā | yat | tai | tretinī | bhūt | yajñasya | dhuḥ'su | sabran | sa'naḥ | nārbam | svaryaśasam | sacā | āyoḥ || 9 ||

he indra 'te tava svabhūtā 'tretinī | tretābhitrayam | tadvatī tretigī kriyā | sā 'yat yadā 'ūrdhvā unnata' pravṛttā 'bhūt abhūt | yathogādanighātaḥ | kutra sthāne iti | 'yajñasya yāgasya 'sañjan sadane | kecit | 'dhuḥṣu karmaṇāṃ voḍhṛvṛttiṣu | tadānīṃ 'sañjūḥ yajamānena marudbhirvā saha
1. ga1.2-pustakasthaṃ saptamamantrabhāṣya-ya indraḥ suhanāya haṃtuṃ śaktyāya dasyave upakṣayitre śatrave vajraṃ cakre karoti haṃtuṃ |
hirīmaśaḥ haridaśmaśruḥ hirīmān harivān arutahanuḥ aśabditahaṃtavyaḥ |
evaṃbhūta indraḥ adbhutaṃ na mahacca tejaḥ prāptavānityarthaḥ |
2. ga1.2-pustakasthamaṣṭamamantra- bhāṣya-nosmākaṃ vṛjinā śatrūbalāni avaśirṣā hi nāśaya |
ṛcā maṃtreṇa anurcaḥ amaṃtrān vanema hanyāma |
abrahmā astutiryajñaḥ tve tvayi joṣati sevamāne ṛdhak vṛddho na bhavati |

3. ga1.2-pustakasthaṃ navamamantra- bhāṣya-yajñasya dhuḥṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu sabran sve sthāne yadyadā tvadartha tretinī abhipretā ūrdhvā unmukhā bhūt tadānīṃ sañjūḥ marudbhiḥ saṃgatastvaṃ āyoḥ yajamānasya sahāyaḥ svayaśasaṃ nāvaṃ karoṣi |
prīyamāṇaḥ san ˅āyoḥ manuṣyasya yajamānasya ˅sacā saha tena sākaṃ ˅svayaśasaṃ svāyasayaśasaṃ yaśaḥsādhanaṃ ˅nāvaṃ taraṇasādhanaṃ tarim |
ekameva rathaṃ ˅ yajamāna ārohati svataraṇārthaṃ tameva tasya sādhakamārohasīyarathaiḥ ˅ |
nāvaṃ rathaṃ svayaśasamāyoyaṃjamānasya sacā sahāyabhūtaḥ sajūstena saha prīyamāṇa ārohetyarthaḥ ||
śriya te pṛśniṃruṣesarcanī bhūcchiye darvirrepāḥ | yayā sve pātre siśvasa ut ||10|| śriya | te | pṛśniḥ | upa'sercanī | bhūt | śriye | darvaiḥ | arepāḥ | yayā | sve | pātre | siśvase | ut || 10 ||
he indra ˅te tava saṃbandhanaḥ somasya ˅śriye śrayanāya ˅pṛśniḥ gauḥ pṛśvarṇā ˅upasercanī payaso ˅dugdhrī ˅bhūt bhavatu |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
tatra ‘ubhā u nūnam’ ityekādaśarcamādyanuvākāpekṣayā saptamaṃ sūktaṃ traidhamaśvidaivatam |
tathā cānukramyate—‘ubhau bhūtāṃśāḥ kāśyapa āśvinam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ubhā u nūnaṃ daivyā hotārā prathamā purohiteti paridhānīyā’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti ||
ubhā u nūnaṃ tadidarthayethe vi tanvāthe dhiyo vastrāpasaiva |
sadhrīcīnā yārtave premajīgaḥ sudinaiva pṛkṣa ā taṃsayethe ||
ubhau | ū~ iti | nūnam | tat | ita | arthayethe iti | vi | tanvāthe iti | dhiyaḥ | vastrā | apasā'iva | sadhrīcīnā | yārtave | pra | īm | ajīgariti | sudinā'iva | pṛkṣaḥ | ā | taṃsayethe iti || 1 ||

he aśvinau 'ubhau yuvāṃ 'nūnam idānīṃ 'tadit asmābhirdīyamānaṃ haviḥ kriyamāṇaṃ stotrameva 'arthayethe prārthayathaḥ | ‘artha yācamāyām’ | caurādikaḥ | anudāttet | uḥ pūraṇaḥ | saṃprārthya ca 'dhiyaḥ karmāṇi stutīrvā 'vi 'tanvāthe vistārayathaḥ | ‘tanu vistāre’ | tānādikaḥ | tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ | 'apaseva apasvinnau kuvindau yathā 'vastrā vastrāṇi vistārayataḥ || apaḥśabdamasvarthīyo viniḥ | tasya ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti luk | prātipadikasvareṇāntodāttaḥ | | ubhayatra supa ākāraḥ || 'īm ayaṃ yajamānaḥ 'sadhrīcīnā sadhrīcīnau sahājñanau yuvām || sahapūrvādañcateḥ kini ‘sahasya sadhriḥ’ iti sadhryādeśaḥ | ‘vibhāṣā'gnerdikcchimyām’ iti khaḥ | supa ājādeśaḥ || tau 'yātave || tumarthe tavenpratyayaḥ || abhimataprāhyathaṃ 'pra 'ajīgaḥ prakarṣeṇa stauti | yadvā yuvāṃ prati stutīradbhiriti || ‘gṛ śabde’ | ‘gṛ nigaraṇe’ vā | etābhyāṃ laṅi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti vikaraṇasya śluḥ | ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ ityabhyāsasyetvam | dīrghaśchāndasaḥ | guṇe kṛte halṅādinā tipo lopaḥ || kiṃca 'sudineva sudinevvāni yathālaṃkurvanti | yadvā | sudinā sudinau | ahorātrayoḥ pravartakatvena tadvantau sūryā- candramasau svaraśmibhiryathājñānyalaṃkurutaḥ | tadbhūvāṃ 'pṛkṣaḥ | annanāmainat | bhoktṛbhiḥ saṃpracchayanta iti pṛkṣo'nnāni | 'ā 'taṃsayethe samantādalaṃ kuruthaḥ || ‘tasi bhūpa alaṃkāre’ | caurādikaḥ || 1 ||
utāreva pharvareṣu śrayethe prāyogaiva śvātrā śasurethaḥ |
duteva hi dyo yuśamā janaiṣu mārpa sthātaṃ mahiṣevātrapānāt ||
utārā'iva | pharvareṣu | śrayethe iti | prāyogā'iva | śvātrā | śasuḥ | ā | ithaḥ | dutā'iva | hi | dyo | yuśamā | janaiṣu | mā | arpa | sthātam | mahiṣā'iva | ava'pānāt ||2||
uṣṭaḥ kāmayete gantavyaṃ deśamityuṣṭārau prāsañjasya voḍhārāvanaḍvāhāviva |
tau yathā saṃpūrṇaghāteṣu saṃcarataḥ tadvat 'pharvareṣu stutibhirhavirbhiñca pūrayitṛṣu janeṣu 'śrayethe |
tau yuvāṃ 'śāsuḥ śaṃsituḥ stotuḥ stutiṃ prati 'ethaḥ āgacchathaḥ |
vpitareva pitarāviva yathātra pitarau prati vputrā putrau bandhubhūtau bhavataḥ tadvat|
tathā vumeva umāviva yathaumau svatejasorvāgnyādityau yathā rocamānau bhavataḥ tadvat vrucā dīpyā yuktau|
vnṛpatīva yathā nṛṇāṃ pālayitārau rājānau saṃbhramayuktāyai senāyai rakṣakatvena bhavataḥ tadvat vtuyai karmārthaṃ svaramāṇāyai saṃbhramavatyai janatāyai yuvāmabhīṣṭadātṛtvena bhavataḥ||
vkiraṇeva kiraṇāviva yathāgnyādityakiraṇau sarveṣāṃ prakāśanādidvāreṇa bhogāya bhavataḥ tadvat vbhujyai stotṛṇāṃ paribhogāya bhavataḥ|
tadantāvaśvau yathā lakṣyaṃ deśaṃ prati śīghraṃ gacchataḥ tadvat|
tadantau puruṣau yathā krīḍārthamāgacchataḥ taddyuvāṃ vhavam asmadīyamāhvānaṃ prati vā vgamiṣṭam āgacchatam||
vaṃsageva pūṣryā śimbātā mitreva ṛtā śatarā śārtapantā |
vājevoccā vayasā gharmyeṣṭhā meṣveṣā saparyā purīṣā ||
vaṃsagā'iva| pūṣryā| śimbātā| mitrā'iva| ṛtā| śatarā| śārtapantā| vājā'iva| uccā| vayasā| gharmyesthā| meṣā'iva| igā| saparyā| purīṣā || 5 ||

vvaṃsageva vaṃsagāviva vananīyagamanau vṛṣabhāviva tau yathā vpūṣryā pūṣryau pūṣaṇe bhavau| puṣṭā- vayavāvityarthaḥ| taddyuvāṃ sphītāṅgāvayavau| ‘pupa puṣṭau’| asmādauṇādiko bhāve'ranpratyayaḥ| tadantāt ‘bhave chandasi’ iti yat| tisvaritam| tathā vśimbātā śimbātā| sukhanāmaitat śimbena duḥkhānāṃ tanūkaraṇena hetunā ātaṃ vyāptamiti| ‘śind niśāne’| asmācchimbamiti bāhulakād- pratyayo mukca nipātyate| atateḥ karmaṇi ghan| supa ālādeśaḥ| sukhakarau bhavataḥ| vmitreva mitrāviva| mitraśabdena varuṇo'pyupalakṣyate sahāvasthānāt| mitrāvaruṇāviva vṛtā ṛtau satyabhūtau tadddyarthadarśinau bhavataḥ| tathā vśatarā śataṃ śatasaṃkhyākāni bahūni ratho dhanāni yayoḥ santi tau tathoktau| supau ṅādeśaḥ| yadvā| śatamekamindriyaprasādādi rāti dadātīti śatarā sukham| tena tadantau| vśātapantā śātapantau tīkṣṇastutikau| śātaṃ tīkṣṇam| pantam| panaterbāhulakāttan (u. sū. 3. 86)| yadvā śātapantā| śātena duḥkhānāṃ tanūkaraṇena panyate stūyata iti śātapantaṃ sukham| ‘śo tanūkaraṇe’| niṣṭhā| panatestan| tena yuvāṃ sukhavantau bhavataḥ| yadyapi śimbātā śatarā śātapantā iti trīṇyapi sukhanāmāni tathāpi kālatraye'pyadhinoḥ sukhakaratvasya vivakṣitatvena viṣaya- bhedādapaunaruktyam| vvājeva vājāviva yathāśvau ghāsādinojatau saṃpūrṇāvayavau tadvat vvayasā havī- rūpeṇānnena hetunā vuccā uccairvartamānau| puṣṭāvityarthaḥ|| uccā| uccaiḥśabdātsupo ṅādeśaḥ| ṅitvāhi-
‘tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam’ iti pūrvapadasya saptamyā aluk ||
tau yathājñena paricaraṇīyau tadbhūtvām hṛpā havīrūpeṇājñena saparyā saparyāṃ paricaraṇīyau bhavataḥ |
purīpā purīpau dhanādidānena stotṝṇāṃ poṣayitārau yadvā havirbhiḥ poṣaṇīyau bhavataḥ |
suṇyeva jarbharī turpharītū naitośevaṃ turpharīṃ parpharīkā |
udanyujeva jermanā maderū tā me jarāyujaraṃ marāyu ||
mṛṇyā'iva | jarbharī iti | turpharītu iti | nainośā'iva | turpharī iti | parpharīkā | udanyujā'iva | jermanā | maderū iti | tā | me | jarāyu | ajaram | marāyu || 6 ||
atra niruktaṃ- ‘dvividhā sṛṇirbhavati bhartā ca hantā ca tathāśvinau cāpi bhartārau jarbharī bhartārāvisthayastarpharītū’ hantārau’ (niru. 13. 5) ityādi |
tā tau pūrvoktaguṇāśvinau yuvāṃ me madīyaṃ jarāyu jarāyujam ata eva marāyu maraṇaśīlaṃ śarīram ajaraṃ jarārahitaṃ maraṇadharmarahitaṃ kurutam ||
pujeva carṣīṃ jāraṃ marāyu kṣevārtheṣu tartarītha ugrā |
pa॒jñā'i̭va | ca॒rcara̭m | jā॒ram | ma॒rāyṷ | kṣa॒ra'i̭va | a॒rtheṣṷ | ta॒rtrītha̭ḥ | u॒grā | ṛ॒bhū iti̭ | na | ā॒pat | kha॒ra॒jra | kha॒ra॒jra | vā॒yuḥ | na | pa̭rpharat | kṣa॒yat | ra॒yīṇām ||7||
he ugrā ugrāvuddhūrṇatejaskāvaśvinau pajñeva pajñāviva prārjitabalau vīrāviva sthitau |
yuvāṃ varcaraṃ caraṇaśīlaṃ jāraṃ jarāyuktam ata eva marāyu maraṇaśīlaṃ madīyaṃ śarīram atheṣu gantavyeṣu tarītavyeṣvāpadādiṣu kṣareva |
ṛbhū yathā svanirmito ratha āpat tadvat kharajrā kharaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ majayitārau śodhayitārau |
tādṛśau yuvāṃ kharajraḥ tīkṣṇagatirataśayena vegavān ṛbhubhirdatto ratho yuvām āpat āpnot ||
sa rathaḥ vāyurna vāyuriva parpharat sarvatrāpūrayat |
tataḥ sa rathaḥ rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ dhanāni kṣayat śatrubhya āgamayat ||
gha॒rmeva̭ ma॒dhu ja॒ṭharḙ sa॒nerṷ̄ bha॒gevi̭tā tu॒rpharī̭ phā॒rivāra̭m |
pu॒treva̭ ca॒carā̭ ca॒ndrani̭rṇi॒ṅma̭na॒ṛṅgā̭ ma॒nu॒nyā̭ na ja॒gmīṃ ||
gha॒rmā'i̭va | ma॒dhu | ja॒ṭharḙ | sa॒nerṷ̄ iti̭ | bha॒ge'a̭vi॒tā | tu॒rpharī̭ iti̭ | phā॒rivāra̭m | pa॒trā'i̭va | ca॒carā̭ | ca॒ndra'ni̭rṇi॒k | ma॒naḥ'ṛ̭ṅgā | ma॒nu॒nyā̭ | na | ja॒gmī iti̭ || 8 ||

gharmeva gharmāviva mahāvīrāviva jaṭhare svodare madhu madhunaḥ | paṣṭhyā luk | ghṛtasya sanerū saṃbhaktārau || ‘vana paṇa saṃbhaktau’ | asmādauṇādika erupratyayaḥ || bhagevitā | bhago dhanam | tadvipaya rakṣaṇayuktau || avaterbhāve kaḥ | ‘tatpuruṣe kṛti bahulam’ iti bahulavacanāt bahuvrīhāvapyaluk | yadvā | avatestṛjantasya supo ḍādeśaḥ | svarastu chāndasaḥ || aram alaṃ turpharī śatrūṇāṃ hiṃsitārau ata eva phārivā | phārirāyudham | tadantau bhavataḥ || sphuratirvadhakarmā | asmānṇic ‘cisaphuroṇau’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 54) ityātvam | tadantādipratyayaḥ | sakāralopaśca chāndasaḥ | ‘chandasīvanipau’ iti matvarthīyā vanipa | supo ḍādeśaḥ || patereva patrāviva patanaśīlau pakṣiṇāviva cacarā saṃcarantau candranirṇiṅ | nirṇigiti rūpanāma | supo luk | candranirṇijau candrasadṛśarūpayuktau | yadvā | candramāhlādakaṃ rūpaṃ yayostau vartate || manaṛṅgā manasā prasādhanaṃ yayostau | ṛñjatiḥ prasādhanakarmā | asmāddhāve ghañ | bahuvrīhisavaraḥ || mananyā na mananyau yathā | manane sādhū | stutyāvityarthaḥ || mananaśabdāt ‘tatra sādhuḥ’ iti yat | tisvaritam || tādṛśāviva jagmī yajñaṃ pratyāgamanaśīlau bhavataḥ || gameḥ ‘āgamahana’ iti kinpratyayaḥ ||
bṛha̭ntaiva ga॒mbharḙṣu pra॒tiṣṭhā̭ṃ pā॒dava̭ gā॒dhaṃ ta̭rate vi॒dātha̭ḥ |
ka॒rṇaiva̭ śā॒sa॒ranṷ hi sma॒ratho̭'śaiva no bha॒jata̭ṃ ci॒trama̭rmaḥ ||
bṛhantā'iva | gambhareṣu | prati'sthām | pādā'iva | gādham | tarate | vidāthaḥ | karṇā'iva | śāsuḥ | anu | hi | smarāthaḥ | aṃśā'iva | naḥ | bhajataḥ | citram | arbhaḥ ||9||

teṣāṃ vākyam | he 'sarame tava svāmī 'indraḥ 'kīdṛk | kiyatparākramavān | 'kā 'dṛśīkā | tasya kīdṛśī dṛṣṭiḥ | dṛṣṭirūpā senā kiyatī | 'yasya 'dūtīḥ dūtī tvam 'idam asmadīyaṃ sthānaṃ 'parākāt atidūrāt 'asaraḥ āgamaḥ | iti tāmuktvā idānīṃ te parasparamāhuḥ | eṣā saramā 'ā 'gacchāt 'ca āgacchatu ca | gamelyaḍāgamaḥ | svāmī 'bhavati bhavatu | na hyekasyā goḥ kiṃtu bahūnāṃ gavāṃ svāmī bhavatu | vṛthavṛttitbhyāṃ svāmitvaṃ bāhulyaṃ ca vivakṣyate ||

nāhaṃ taṃ veda dabhyaṃ dabhatsa yyedaṃ dutīrasaraṃ parākāt | na taṃ gṛhanti sravatau gabhīrā hātā indreṇa paṇaya: śayadhve || 4 || na | aham | tam | veda | dabhyam | dabhat | sa: | yasya | idam | dutī: | asaram | parākāt | na | tam | gṛhanti | sravata: | gabhīrā: | hātā: | indreṇa | paṇaya: | śayadhve || 4 ||

saramā vadati | he paṇaya: | tam indraṃ dabhyaṃ hantavyamiti na veda na jānāmi | dabhe: aco yat | katham | sa: indra: dabhat sarvān janān dabhati hinastyeva || dabheleṃṭi rūpam | vākya- bhedādanighāta: || yasya dutī: dūtī aham idaṃ yuṣmadīyaṃ sthānaṃ parākāt atidūradeśāt asaraṃ prāptābhavam | indro hiṃsitavyo na bhavatītyatra yuktimāha | sravata: | sravaṇaṃ srava: | tamācaranti || ācārārthe kvip | tugāgama: | jasi rūpam || sravaṇaśīlā: | gabhīrā: gabhīrā nadya: | tam indraṃ na gṛhanti na saṃvṛṇvanti | nācchādayanti | kiṃvāvipkurvanti | vayaṃ yasya mahimnā samudraṃ pratisarām | tasmādaṃhistha ityenaṃ prakaṭīkurvanti | ‘guhū saṃvaraṇe’ | bhauvādika: | tasmādve paṇaya: yūyam indreṇa tādṛśaparākrameṇa hātā: santaḥ śayadhve || ‘śīṅ svapre’ | ‘bahula chandasi’ iti śapo lugabhāva: ||

imā gārva: sarame yā aiccha: pariṃ divo antānsubhage patantī | kasta enā arba sṛjādyudhyutāsmākamāyudhā santi tigmā || 5 || imā: | gārva: | sarame | yā: | aiccha: | pari | diva: | antān | subhage | patantī | ka: | te | enā: | arba | sṛjāt | ayudhvī | uta | asmākam | āyudhā | santi | tigmā ||5||
he subhage śobhanasaubhāgyavati he sarame diva: dyulokasya antān paryantān pari patantī kutra gātrasitacchantīti parito gacchantī svam imā: paridṛśya- mānā: vyā: gātra: |
gā: aiccha: kāmayase tā: enā: gā: te svadīyā: ka: ayudhvī ayudhvā ava sṛjāt |
uta api ca asmākaṃ tigmā tīkṣṇāni āyudhā āyudhāni santi |

asenyrā va: paṇayo vacāṃsyaniṣvyāstanva: santu pāpī: | ardhṛṣṭo va etvā astu panthā bṛhaspatirva ubhayā na mṛḻāt || 6 || asenyrā | va: | paṇaya: | vacāṃsi | aniṣvyā: | tanva: | santu | pāpī: | ardhṛṣṭa: | va: | etvai | astu | panthā: | bṛhaspati: | va: | ubhayā | na | mṛḻāt || 6 ||
he paṇaya: va: yuṣmākaṃ vacāṃsi pūrvokāni vacanāni asenyā asenyāni |
śarīrāṇi ᵥanipadhyāḥ hrasvahaॉni na ᵥsantu parākramarāhisyena |
kiṃca ᵥvaḥ yuṣmadīyaḥ ᵥpanthāḥ mārgaḥ ᵥetavai gantum ᵥaṣṭaḥ asamarthaḥ ᵥastu ||
'tavai cāntaśca yugapat' (pā. sū. 6. 2. 51) iti dhātoḥ pratyayasya ca yugapadudāttatvam |
ᵥvaḥ yuṣmadīyān ᵥubhayā- ubhayavidhān pūrvoktāṃstanvo dehān ᵥbṛhaspatiḥ indrapreritaḥ ᵥna ᵥmṛḻāt na sukhayet |

evā ca tvaṃ sarama ājagantha prabādhitā sahasā daivyena | svasāraṃ tvā kṛṇvai mā punargā arpa te gavāṃ subhage bhajāma || 9 || eva | ca | tvam | sarame | ā'jagantha | pra'bādhitā | sahasā | daivyena | svasāram | tvā | kṛṇvai | mā | punaḥ | gāḥ | arpa | te | gavām | su'bhage | bhajāma || 9 || tayaivamukte sati paṇayaḥ praṇayavākyamāhuḥ | he <sup>v</sup>sarame <sup>v</sup>tvaṃ <sup>v</sup>daivyena devasambandhinā <sup>v</sup>sahasā balena <sup>v</sup>prabādhitā yathā tathā valapuraṃ prāpya tatra sthitā gā dṛṣṭvā punarāgaccheti tena prapīḍitā <sup>v</sup>tvam evaṃ<sup>1</sup> cet <sup>v</sup>ājagantha āgatavatyasi || caśabdaścārthe | ‘niśātairyadyadihanta°’ iti tiṅo nighātā- bhāvaḥ | gameliṭi thali rūpam | ‘saha supā’ ityatra saheti yogavibhāgāt samāsaḥ | ‘tiṅi codātta- vati’ iti gaternighātaḥ<sup>2</sup> | litsvaraḥ<sup>3</sup> || tarhi <sup>v</sup>tvā tvāṃ <sup>v</sup>svasāraṃ bhaginīṃ <sup>v</sup>kṛṇvai karavai | samūhā- pekṣyaikavacanam | tvaṃ tu <sup>v</sup>punaḥ <sup>v</sup>mā <sup>v</sup>gāḥ | indrādīn mā gaccha | api tarhi he <sup>v</sup>subhage sarame <sup>v</sup>te svadīyānāṃ <sup>v</sup>gavāṃ samūhaṃ parvatādapagamayya <sup>v</sup>bhajāma | tvaṃ ca vayaṃ ca vibhajāma | vibhāgaṃ karavāmetyarthaḥ ||

nāhaṃ veda bhrātṛtvaṃ no svasṛtvamindro vidurṅgirasaśca ghorāḥ | gokāmā me acchadyanyadāyamapāta ita paṇayo varīyaḥ || 10 || na | aham | veda | bhrātṛtvam | no iti | svasṛtvam | indraḥ | viduḥ | aṅgirasaḥ | ca | ghorāḥ | go'kāmā | me | acchadyan | yat | āyan | apa | ita | paṇayaḥ | varīyaḥ || 10 || sā<sup>4</sup> tān<sup>5</sup> pratyācaṣṭe | he paṇayaḥ <sup>v</sup>ahaṃ <sup>v</sup>bhrātṛtvaṃ <sup>v</sup>na <sup>v</sup>veda na jānāmi | tathā <sup>v</sup>svasṛtvaṃ ca <sup>v</sup>no veda naiva jānāmi | ke jānanti tānāha | <sup>v</sup>indraḥ <sup>v</sup>ghorāḥ śatrūṇāṃ bhayaṃkarāḥ <sup>v</sup>aṅgirasaśca <sup>v</sup>viduḥ jānanti | kiṃca asmān sthānādahaṃ <sup>v</sup>yat yadā <sup>v</sup>āyam indrādīn prāpavam || ‘aya paya gatau’ | laṅi rūpam || <sup>v</sup>me madīyāḥ <sup>v</sup>gokāmāḥ yuṣmābhirapahṛtā gāḥ kāmayamānā indrādayaḥ <sup>v</sup>acchadya- yan | yuṣmadīyaṃ sthānamācchādayanti | ‘chada apavāraṇe’ | <sup>v</sup>ataḥ kāraṇādde <sup>v</sup>paṇayaḥ<sup>6</sup> <sup>v</sup>varīyaḥ urunaraṃ gavāṃ vṛndaṃ parityajya <sup>v</sup>apa <sup>v</sup>ita anyasthānaṃ prati gacchata | yadvā | varīyaḥ prabhūtamatiyūraṃ deśaṃ gacchata || ita | ‘ig gatau’ | loṭi rūpam | varīyaḥ | uruśabdādiyasuni ‘priyasthira°’ ityādinā varādeśaḥ ||

duraṃmita paṇayo varīya udgāvo yantu minutīrṛtena | bṛhaspatiryā avindannigūḻhāḥ somo grāvāṇa ṛṣayaśca viprāḥ || 11 || duram | ita | paṇayaḥ | varīyaḥ | ut | gāvaḥ | yantu | minutīḥ | ṛtena | bṛhaspatiḥ | yāḥ | avindat | ni'gūḻhāḥ | somaḥ | grāvāṇaḥ | ṛṣayaḥ | ca | viprāḥ || 11 || he <sup>v</sup>paṇayaḥ yūyaṃ <sup>v</sup>varīyaḥ urutaraṃ <sup>v</sup>dūraṃ dūradeśam <sup>v</sup>ita gacchata | yuṣmābhirapahṛtāḥ <sup>v</sup>gāvaḥ <sup>v</sup>ṛtena satyena <sup>v</sup>minutīḥ minamyo dvārasya pidhāyakaṃ parvataṃ hiṃsatyo vidārayantyaḥ <sup>v</sup>ut <sup>v</sup>yantu
4. ga-anyān sa tān; ta-bha-anyān sā tān |
gā ṛtena stutibhirgantavyena-teṇa sahāyena bṛhaspatyādaya udyantu parvatāduttama- yantu |
nigūḍhāḥ nitarāṃ rathāpitāḥ vyāḥ gāḥ bṛhaspatiḥ avindat lapsyate tathā somaḥ tadabhiṣvakāriṇaḥ grāvāṇaḥ ca viprāḥ medhāvinaḥ ṛpayaḥ aṅgirasaḥ ca lapsyante ||
‘te'vadan’ iti sasarca daśamaṃ sūktam | juhūrnāma brahmavādinyṛṣiḥ | brahmaputra urdhvanābhā nāma vā | ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyavanuṣṭubhau | śiṣṭāḥ pañca triṣṭubhaḥ | viśve devā devatā | tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘
tāṃ haste gṛhītvā vā nināya ānaiṣīt |
' nityaṃ haste pāṇāvupayamane ' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 77 ) iti hastaśabdasya gatisaṃjñāyāṃ prahiṇā samāse hyap |

hastainaiva grāhya ādhirasyā brahmajāyāmiti cedavaucan | na dūtārya prahe tastha eṣā tathā rāṣṭraṃ gupitaṃ kṣatriyasya || 3 || hastaina | eva | grāhyaḥ | ā'dhiḥ | asyāḥ | brahma'jāyā | iyam | iti | ca | ita | avaucan | na | dūtārya | pra'hai | tasthe | eṣā | tathā | rāṣṭram | gupitam | kṣatriyasya || 3 ||
punaste devā idānīm viyaṃ vbrahmajāyā viti eva vavocan avādiṣuḥ ||
ata eva ' nipātairyadyadihanta ' iti tiṅo nighātābhāvaḥ |
veṣā brahmajāyā purā vprahe ' hi gatau vṛddhau ca ' |
hitāya tvayā bhāryānveṣaṇārthaṃ preṣitāya vdūtāya vtathā vna vtasthe |
yathā vkṣatriyasya rājñaḥ vgupitaṃ rakṣitaṃ vrāṣṭraṃ rājyaṃ śatrave yathā na prakāśayati tadvadasau daurbhāgyayuktatayā tasmai svātmānaṃ na prakāśitavatī |
idānīṃ tu tadgrāhyatvena prakāśamāneyaṃ vbrahma- jāyāyetyabruvan ||

devā etasyāmavadanta pūrvaṃ saptaṛṣayastapase ye niṣeduḥ | bhīmā jāyā brahmaṇasyopanītā dudhāṃ dadhāti parame vyoman || 4 || devāḥ | vetasyām | avadan | pūrvai | sapta'ṛṣayaḥ | | tapase | ye | ni'seduḥ | bhīmā | jāyā | brahmaṇasya | upa'nītā | duḥ'dhām | dadhāti | parame | vi'omana || 4 ||
vpūrva ciraṃtanāḥ vdevāḥ ādityādayaḥ vetasyāṃ viṣaye vavadanta |
saptasaṃkhyākā ṛṣayaḥ vtapase tapaścaraṇāya vniṣeduḥ niṣaṇṇā babhūvuḥ |
tataḥ vbhīmā śatrurūpāṇāṃ pāpānāṃ bhayaṃkārī sukṛtavatī eṣā vjāyā vbrāhmaṇasya bṛhaspateḥ vupanītā |
tapaḥ- prabhāvaḥ vdudhāṃ durdhanāmapi vparame vvyoman vyomamyuttame sthāne vdadhāti vidadhāti khalu |

brahmacārī carati veviṣadviṣa: sa devānāṃ bhavatyeka maṅgam | tena jāyāmanvavindadbṛhaspati: somena nītāṃ juhūṃ na devā: || 5 || brahma'cārī | carati | veviṣadviṣa: | sa: | devānām | bhavati | ekam | aṅgam | tena | jāyām | anu | avindat | bṛhaspati: | somena | nītām | juhūma | na | devā: ||5||
he devā: pūrvaṃ sa: brahmacārī jāyābhāvena brahmacārī carati |
ata eva vipa: sarveṣu yajñeṣu vyāptavān devān veviṣada stutibhirvibhirśca vyāmuvan devānām ekam aṅgaṃ bhavati |
‘nijāṃ trayāṇāṃ guṇa: ślau’ (pā. sū. 7. 4. 75) ityabhyāsasya guṇa: |
tena devānāṃ paricaraṇena bṛhaspati: jāyāṃ juhūnāmikāṃ mām anvavindat |
pūrvaṃ yathā somena nītāṃ ‘somo dadadgandharvāya’ (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 85. 41) ityādikrameṇa nītāṃ juhūṃ juhū yathā labdhavān tadvidānīmapi ||
‘udāttayaṇo halpūrvāt’ iti vibhaktyudāttatve prāpte ‘noddhātvo:’ iti pratiṣedhe ‘udāttasvaritayoryaṇa:’ iti svaritatvam ||

punarvai devā adadu: punarmanuṣyā uta | rājāna: satyaṃ kṛṇvānā brahmajāyāṃ punardu: || 6 || puna: | vai | devā: | adadu: | puna: | manuṣyā: | uta | rājāna: | satyam | kṛṇvānā: | brahma'jāyām | puna: | du: || 6 ||
devā: brahmajāyāṃ juhūṃ bṛhaspataye puna: adadu: |
evaṃ devamanuṣyai: kṛtaṃ dānaṃ satyaṃ yathārthaṃ kṛṇvānā: kurvāṇā: rājāna: api puna: tasmai dadu: |

punardadya brahmajāyāṃ kṛtvā dervairnikilbiṣam | ūrjaṃ pṛthivyā bhuktvāyorugāyamupāsate || 7 || puna:'dadya | brahma'jāyām | kṛtvā | devai: | ni'kilbiṣam | ūrjam | pṛthivyā: | bhuktvā | uru'gāyam | upāsate || 7 ||
kṛtvā brahmajāyāṃ brahmaṇo bṛhaspaterbhāyāṃ punardadya punardatvā ||
‘punaścanasośchandasi gatisaṃjñā vaktavyā’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 60. 2) iti puna:śabdasya gatisaṃjñāyāṃ samāsalyapau |
' kvo yak ' ( pā. sū. 7. 1. 47 ) iti yagāgamaḥ ||
bhaktvā vibhajya 7 urugāyaṃ bahukīrti bahubhiḥ stotavyaṃ vā bārhaspatyaṃ yajñam 7 upāsate sevante ||
tasya putro rāmo vā yaḥ paraśurāma iti prakhyāta: |
ataḥ samidādyāḥ satannūpāto narāśaṃsavarjitāḥ pratyṛcaṃ devatāḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—' samiddha ekādaśa jamadagnisuto vā rāma āpriyaḥ ' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—' samiddho atheti sarveṣāṃ yatharṣi vā ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 2 ) iti |
abhyayanāṅgabhūte prājāpatye paśau sarveṣāṃ nityamidamāgrī- sūktam |
sūtritaṃ ca—' prājāpatye tu jāmadagnyaḥ sarveṣām ' ( āśva. śrau. 3. 2 ) iti ||
samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devānyajasi jātavedaḥ |
ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvān dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ ||

he 7 jātavedaḥ jātaprajñe 7 devaḥ svatejasā dīpyamānastvaṃ 7 manuṣaḥ manuṣyasya yaṣṭuḥ 7 duroṇe |

tvaṃ devānāṃmasi yahva hotā sa ainānyakṣīṣṭo yajīyān ||

he ᵥagne tvamasmatkarmaṇi ᵥā ᵥyāhi āgaccha | kīdṛśaḥ | ᵥājuhvānaḥ devānāmāhvayatā | ‘hu dānādanayoḥ ’ | jauhotyādikaḥ | abhyastasvaraḥ | ᵥīḍyaḥ | īḍiradhyeṣaṇākarmā | adhyeṣyaḥ prārthyamānaḥ2 ᵥvandyaḥ stotavyaḥ ᵥvasubhiḥ devaiḥ ᵥsajoṣāḥ saha prīyamāṇaḥ | āgamya ca he ᵥyahva | mahannāmaitat | he yahva saḥ ᵥtvaṃ ᵥdevānāṃ ᵥhotā āhvayatā ᵥasi | tataḥ ᵥyajīyān || yaṣṭaśabdadādīthasuni ‘turiṣṭhe- meyaḥsu ’ iti tṛco lopaḥ || yaṣṭataraḥ ᵥsaḥ tvam ᵥiṣṭitaḥ asmābhiradhyepitaḥ prārthitaḥ san etān devān ᵥyakṣi yaja | haviṣā pūjaya ||
prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agne arhām |
vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||

vasanāyācchādanārtham ᵥahvām ᵥagre pūrvāhṇe ᵥpradiśā prakarṣeṇa dṛśyamānena mantreṇa ᵥasyāḥ prācyā diśaḥ ᵥvṛjyate stūyate āhriyate |
tathā ca nigamaḥ—‘ta ā vahanti kavathaḥ purastāt ’ (tai. saṃ. 1.1.2.1) ityādi |
taccāhataṃ ᵥvarīyaḥ urutaraṃ barhiḥ ᵥvitaraṃ vistīrṇataraṃ yathā bhavati tathā ᵥvi ᵥprathate |
tathā ᵥdevebhyaḥ ᵥaditaye2 vedilakṣaṇāyai pṛthivyai ca ᵥsyonaṃ sukhakaraṃ bhavati |

yasya śaśvatpāpivā~ indra śatrūnanānukṛtyā raṇyā cakrartha |

pra taṃ indra pūrvyāṇi pra nūnaṃ vīryā vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni | satīnamanyuśrathāyo adriṃ suvedanāmakṛṇobrahmaṇe gām || 8 || pra | te | indra | pūrvyāṇi | pra | nūnam | vīryā | vocam | prathamā | kṛtāni | satīna'manyuḥ | aśrathayaḥ | adrim | su'vedanāma | akṛṇoḥ | brahmaṇe | gām || 8 ||

yācamānān ^naḥ asmāna ^abhikhyā' abhikhyāpanena tejasā yuktān kuru |

he ^raṇakṛt śatrubhiḥ saha yuddhakartaḥ ata eva he ^masyaśuṣma yathārthabalopeta ^tvaṃ ^raṇaṃ ^kṛdhi kuru |
