tasya balaṃ pūrvamasmān rakṣatu paścādete'pi rakṣatāmiti bhāvaḥ |
^kṛṇvānaḥ vṛtravadhādikaṃ kurvāṇaḥ saḥ ^mahimānam ^indriyam indrasyātmanaḥ paryāptaṃ vīryaṃ ca ^yat yadā ^ait prāpnot ||

tama̭sya॒ viṣṇa̭rmahi॒māna॒moja̭sā॒'aṃśuṃ dadha̭nvānmadhṷno vi ra̭psate | de॒vebhi̭rindro ma॒ghavā̭ sa॒yāva̭bhirvṛ॒traṃ ja̭gha॒nvā~ a̭bha॒vadvarḙṇyaḥ || 2 || tam | a॒sya | viṣṇo̭: | ma॒hi॒māna̭m | oja̭sā | a॒ṃśum | dadha̭nvān | ma॒dhṷnaḥ | vi | ra॒psa॒te॒ | de॒vebhi̭: | indra̭: | ma॒ghavā̭ | sa॒yāva̭bhiḥ | vṛ॒tram | ja॒gha॒nvān | a॒bha॒vat | varḙṇyaḥ || 2 || ^viṣṇuḥ etannāmakaḥ | vyāso yajño vā | ^madhunaḥ madakarasya somasya ^aṃśuṃ latākhaṇḍaṃ ^dadhanvān prerayan || atraitadarthasya krasau idiśvā'numāgame kṛte vali lopaḥ || ^ojasā svavīryeṇa saṃjātam ^asya indrasya ^taṃ ^mahimānaṃ ^vi ^rapsate vividhaṃ śabdayati | stauti | ^maghavā dhanavān ^sayāvabhiḥ || yāteḥ 'āto manin0' iti kanip || sahagantubhiḥ ^devebhiḥ devaiḥ marudbhiśca ^vṛtraṃ ^jaghanvān hatavān ^indraḥ ^vareṇyaḥ sarvairvareṇīyaḥ saṃbhajanīyaḥ ^abhavat ||

vṛ॒treṇa॒ yadahi̭nā bi॒bhradāyṷdhā sa॒masthi̭thā yu॒dhayḙ śa॒ṃsamā̭vide | viśvḙ te a॒tra ma॒ruta̭ḥ sa॒ha tma॒nā'va̭rdhannu॒gra ma̭hi॒māna̭mi॒ndriya̭m || 3 || vṛ॒treṇa̭ | yat | a॒hi̭nā | bi॒bhrat | ā॒yu॒dhā | sa॒m | a॒sthi॒thāḥ | yu॒dhayḙ | śa॒ṃsam | ā॒'vi॒de॒ | viśvḙ | te | a॒tra | ma॒ruta̭ḥ | sa॒ha | tma॒nā | a॒va॒rdhan | u॒gram | ma॒hi॒māna̭m | i॒ndriya̭m ||3|| ^yudhaye yodhanāya ^āyudhā āyudhāni vajrādīni ^bibhrat dhārayannindrastvaṃ ^yat yadā ^ahinā āhantavyena ^vṛtreṇa ^samasthithāḥ sahāsthāḥ || tiṣṭhaterluṅi 'samapravibhyaḥ sthaḥ' (pā. sū. 1. 3. 22) ityātmanepadam | 'sthādhvorica' iti micaḥ kitvamikāraścāntādeśaḥ | 'hasvā- daṅgāt' (pā. sū. 8. 2. 27) iti sico lopaḥ | yatrogādanighātaḥ | 'tiṅi codāttavati' iti gaternighātaḥ || tat ^āvide | kṛtyārthe kenpratyayaḥ || tava vṛtravadhādikaṃ vīryaṃ prajñāpayituṃ ^śaṃsam aśaṃsam | śabdairahaṃ staumi || 'śaṃs stutau' | laṅ | vākyabhedādanighātaḥ || kiṃca he ^ugra udvarṇabala ^atra asmin kāle eva ^te tvadīyaṃ ^mahimānamindriyaṃ vīryaṃ ca ^viśve sarve ^marutaḥ ^tmanā ātmanā ^saha eva ^avardhan | varṇalopaśchāndasaḥ | avardhayan | maruto hīndrasya vīryaṃ bhavati ||

ja॒jñāna̭ e॒va vya̭bādhata॒ spṛdha̭ḥ prā॒paśya̭dvī॒ro a॒bhi pau॒ṃsyaṃ ra̭ṇam | a॒vṛ॒ścada̭dri॒mava̭ su॒syada̭: sṛ॒jadasta̭bhnā॒nnāka̭ṃ sva॒pasya̭yā pṛ॒thum || 4 || ja॒jñāna̭: | e॒va | vi | a॒bā॒dha॒ta॒ | spṛdha̭ḥ | pra | a॒pa॒śya॒t | vī॒raḥ | a॒bhi | pau॒ṃsyam | ra॒ṇam | a॒vṛ॒ścat | a॒drim | ava̭ | su॒syada̭: | sṛ॒jat | a॒sta॒bhnāt | nā॒kam | su॒'apa̭syayā | pṛ॒thum ||4|| sa indraḥ ^jajñāna ^eva | 'janī prādurbhāve' | chāndasasya liṭaḥ kānac || jāyamānā eva ^spṛdhaḥ śatrūn ^vyabādhata atyarthamapīḍayat || spṛdhaḥ | 'spadha saṃgharṣe' | kip | 'apaspṛdhethām' iti nipātanenaiketra saṃprasāraṇadarśanādatrāpi bhavati || ata eva ^vīraḥ samarthaḥ saḥ ^raṇaṃ saṃgrāmam abhilakṣya ^pauṃsyam ātmīyaṃ balaṃ ^prāpaśyat | asyetāvadvalamiti prakarṣeṇa paśyati | jānāti | kiṃca ^adriṃ megham ^avṛścat varṣaṇārthamacchinat ^ | anantaraṃ ^syadaḥ | 'syanda prasravaṇe' | kip | śasi nalopaḥ | saha syandamānā apaḥ ^ava ^sṛjat avāṅmukhamasṛjat niragamayat | tathā saḥ ^pṛthuṃ
ādindraḥ sutrā taviṣīrapatyat varīyo dyāvāpṛthivī abādhata |
arvābharadṛṣito vajramāyasaṃ śevaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya dāśuṣe ||
āt | indraḥ | satrā | taviṣīḥ | apatyat | varīyaḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | abādhata | arva | abharat | dhṛṣitaḥ | vajram | āyasam | śevam | mitrāya | varuṇāya | dāśuṣe || 5 ||

ᵥāt api ca sa ᵥindraḥ ᵥtaviṣīḥ mahatīḥ senāḥ ᵥsatrā sahaiva ᵥapatyata agacchat | ‘pada gatau’ | daivādikaḥ | varṇavyatyayaḥ || yadvā | pathata ityarthakarma | senānāmīṣṭe | tāsāmīśvaro'bhava- dityarthaḥ | sa eva ᵥdyāvāpṛthivī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥvarīyaḥ || tṛtīyāyāḥ suḥ || urutareṇa mahimnā ᵥabādhata | tayorantaḥ sthitān śatrūnavaghrīdityarthaḥ | ᵥdhṛṣitaḥ śatruvadhe pragalbhaḥ san ᵥāyasam ayomayaṃ ᵥvajram ᵥavābharat adhārayat | kimartham | ᵥmitrāya ᵥvaruṇāya ᵥdāśuṣe havirdattavate yajvane ca ᵥśevaṃ sukhaṃ kartum || || 14 ||
indrasyātra taviṣībhyo virapśina ṛdhāyato araṃhayanta manyavai |
vṛtraṃ yadugro vyarvṛścadojasāpo vibhrataṃ tamasā parīvṛtam ||
indrasya | atra | taviṣībhyaḥ | tri'rapśinaḥ | ṛdhāyataḥ | araṃhayanta | manyavai | vṛtram | yat | ugraḥ | vi | avṛścat | ojasā | apaḥ | vibhratam | tamasā | parī'vṛtam ||6||
ᵥatra asmin kāla eva ᵥvirapśinaḥ mahato vividhaṃ śabdayamānasya vā ᵥṛdhāyataḥ śatrūn hiṃsataḥ ᵥindrasya ᵥtaviṣībhyaḥ |
ᵥugraḥ udūrṇaḥ saḥ ᵥapaḥ udakāni ᵥvibhrataṃ dhārayantaṃ ᵥtamasā ᵥparīvṛtaṃ parito veṣṭitam |
taṃ ᵥvṛtraṃ ᵥyat yasmin kāle ᵥojasā svavīryeṇa ᵥvyavṛścat athyaṃmavadhīt ||
yā vīryāṇi prathamāni katvī mahitvebhirvartamānau samīyatuḥ |
dhvāntaṃ tamo'va dadhvase hata indro mahā pūrvahūtāvapatyata ||

kartavyāni ᵥyā yāni ᵥvīryāṇi ᵥsamīyatuḥ saṃyojyā- māstaḥ ||

viśve devāso adhu vṛṣṇyāni te'vardhayantsomavatayā vacasyayā | rudraṃ vṛtramahimindrasya hanmanāgnina jambhaistṛṣṇamavāyat || 8 || viśve | devāsaḥ | artha | vṛṣṇyāni | te | avardhayan | soma'vatayā | vacasyayā | rudram | vṛtram | ahim | indrasya | hanmanā | agniḥ | na | jambhaiḥ | tṛpnu | annam | āvayat ||8||
he indra adhva vṛtrahananānantaraṃ viśve devāsaḥ devā ṛtvijaḥ somavatayā somayuktayā vacasyayā stutīcchayā te tvadīyāni vṛṣṇyāni balāni avardhayan vardhayanti |
sugebhiḥ suṣṭhu gantavyaistairdhanaiḥ stotrairvā viśvā sarvāṇi duritā duritāni pāpāni tarema |
he indra adha asmin karmaṇi gādhaṃ grathyamānaṃ kriyamāgaṃ naḥ asmadīyaṃ stotram urviyā urutvena bahumānena su suṣṭhu vido |

‘gharmā’ iti daśacaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūktaṃ vaiśvadevam | sadhrirnāma vairūpa ṛṣiḥ | tapasaḥ putro dharmo vā | caturthī jagatī | śiṣṭāṣṭribhaḥ | tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘gharmā sadhristāpaso vā dharmo vaiśvadevaṃ caturthī jagatī’ iti | gato viniyogaḥ ||
gharmā samantā trivṛtaṃ vyāpatastayorjṛṣṭi mātriraśvā jagāma |
gharmā | sama'antā | trivṛtam | vi | āpatuḥ | tayoḥ | juṣṭim | mātariśvā | jagāma | divaḥ | paryaḥ | didhiṣāṇāḥ | avepan | viduḥ | devāḥ | saha'sāmānam | arkam || 1 ||
‘trayo vā ime trivṛto lokāḥ’ (ai. ā. 1. 1. 2) ityāmnānāt |
tayoḥ agnyādityayoḥ juṣṭiṃ prītiṃ jagāma gatavān |
‘sarvaṃ tejaḥ sāmarūpaṃ ha śaśvat’ (tai. brā. 3. 12. 9. 2) ityāmnānāt |
īdṛśam arkam arcanīyaṃ sūrya devāḥ dīpyamānāḥ svarimayaḥ viduḥ vividuḥ lebhire prāpuḥ |
tadā didhiṣāṇāḥ lokadhāraṇa- śīlāste divaḥ dyulokasya saṃbandha pathaḥ udakam avepan vyāptavantaḥ |
samantau saṃgatau gharmā svayaṃ dīpyamānau jīveśvarau trivṛtaṃ savarajastamoguṇātmikāṃ māyāṃ vyāpataḥ |
niyantṛniyatavyabhāvena mātariśvā paramātmā tayorjṛṣṭi saṃbhoktavyapadārthaiḥ saṃjātāṃ prītiṃ jagāma |
taṃ paramātmāne vedamayamimaṃ sūryamiti devā jānanti |
tisro deṣṭāya nirṛtīrupāsate dīrghaśruto vi hi jānanti vahyaḥ |
tāsāṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo nidānaṃ pareṣu yā guhyeṣu vrateṣu |
tisraḥ | deṣṭāya | niḥ'ṛtīḥ | upāsate | dīrgha'śrutaḥ | vi | hi | jānanti | vahyaḥ | tāsām | ni | cikyuḥ | kavayaḥ | nidānam | pareṣu | yā | guhyeṣu | vrateṣu || 2 ||

nirṛtīḥ | pṛthivīnāmailat | anenetaralokāvupalakṣyate | tatrādhiṣṭhitāḥ tisraḥ agnyādi- devatāḥ deṣṭāya haviṣāṃ pradānāya upāsate | yajamānā upāsanaṃ kurvate | tataḥ dīrghaśrutaḥ prabhūta- kīrtayaḥ vahyaḥ jagataḥ prāpikāstā devatāḥ vi jānanti | etaiḥ kṛtāmupāsanāṃ manvate eva | yadvā |
tāstisraḥ sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhatīḥ deṣṭrāyātmanaḥ karmabhogadānāyopāsate te dīrghaśruto dīrgha¹ saṃsāre śṛṇvanto mantavyadṛśyādipadārtha jānantaḥ |
ata eva vahyaḥ saṃsārasya voḍhārastā na jānanti |

⁷tasyāṃ vedyāṃ ⁷vṛṣaṇā vṛṣṇau haviṣā varṣitārau ⁷suparṇā suparṇau supatanau jāyāpatī yajamānabrahmaṇau vā ⁷ni ⁷ṣedatuḥ niṣaṇṇau bhavataḥ |
⁷yatra yasyāṃ vedyāṃ ⁷devāḥ agnyādayaḥ ⁷bhāgadheyam |
catuṣkapardāṃ nāmākhyātopasarganipātā- ścatvāraḥ kapardsthānīyā yasyāḥ sā yuvatistaruṇī nityā ghṛtapratīkā dīpyamānavarṇāvayavaupaniṣadī vāgvayunāni jñānāni vaste ācchādayati |
tasyāṃ vāci suparṇā suparṇau jīvaparamātmānau nipaṇṇau bhavataḥ |
ekaḥ suparṇaḥ sa samudramā viveśa sa idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ vi caṣṭe |
taṃ pākena manasāpaśyamantitaṃ mātā reḻhi sa u reḻhi mātaram ||

⁷ekaḥ sarvakāryeṣvasahāyaḥ ⁷suparṇaḥ supatano madhyamasthāno devaḥ ⁷samudram antarikṣam ⁷ā viveśa āviśati |
āviśya ca ⁷sa ⁷idaṃ ⁷viśvaṃ sarvaṃ ⁷bhuvanaṃ bhūtajātaṃ ⁷vi ⁷caṣṭe |
⁷tam evaṃrūpaṃ devaṃ ⁷pākena paripakkena ⁷manasā ⁷antitaḥ samīpe'ham ⁷apaśyam adarśam |
kiṃca ⁷mātā udakānāṃ nirmātrī mādhyamikī vāk tāṃ ⁷reḻhi āsvādayati |
⁷sa ⁷u sa khalu ⁷mātaraṃ vācaṃ ⁷reḻhi leḍhi |
suparṇaḥ pakṣavānnirādhāracāryaikaḥ prāṇavāyuḥ paramātmā vā samudram |
sa idaṃ viśvaṃ sarva lokaṃ vi caṣṭe viśeṣeṇa vyāpayati |
sati hi prāṇe paramātmani vā jīvantaḥ puruṣā lokaṃ vikhyātaṃ kurvanti |
taṃ devamupāsako'haṃ pākena paripakvajñānena manasā abhitaḥ ||
antikasya tasi kādilopo bhavatyāyudāttatvaṃ ca (pā. sū. 6. 4. 149. 8) iti kādilopaḥ ||
svāpe hi vāgvyāpāro na dṛśyate prāṇavyāpārastu dṛśyata iti ||
suparṇaṃ viprāḥ kavayo vacobhirekaṃ santaṃ bahudhā kalpayanti |
chandāṃsi ca dadhato adhvareṣu grahantsomasya mimate dvādaśa ||

anantaraṃ he indra tṛpat tṛpto bhava ā vṛṣasva |

asya piba kṣumataḥ prasthitasyendra somasya varamā sutasya | svastidā manasā mādayasvārvācīno revate saubhagāya || 2 || asya | piba | kṣumataḥ | prasthitasya | indra | somasya | varam | ā | sutasya | svastidāḥ | manasā | mādayasva | arvācīnaḥ | revate | saubhagāya || 2 ||
he indra kṣumataḥ stuiyuktasya yadvā havīrūpāśnavataḥ prasthitasya havirdhānāduttaravediṃ prati prasthāpitasya sutasya abhiṣutasya asya somasya varaṃ varaṇīyaṃ tvadīyaṃ bhāgam ā ābhimukhyena piba ||
tataḥ svastidāḥ kalyāṇasya dātā tvaṃ manasā antaḥkaraṇena mādayasva hṛṣṭo bhava |
revate dhanavate saubhagāya saubhāgyāya tadasmabhyaṃ dātum arvācīnaḥ abhimukhāñcano bhava ||
tasyottarapadasya hajjaga’ iti vṛddhinaipatye sarvavidhīnāṃ chandasi vikalpita- tvāt |

mamattu tvā divyaḥ soma indra mamattu yaḥ sūyate pārthiveṣu | mamattu yena varivaścakartha mamattu yena niriṇāsi śatrūn || 3 || mamattu | tvā | divyaḥ | somaḥ | indra | mamattu | yaḥ | sūyate | pārthiveṣu | mamattu | yena | varivaḥ | cakartha | mamattu | yena | niriṇāsi | śatrūn || 3 ||
he indra tvā tvāṃ divya: divi bhava: soma: mamattu |
tathā pārthivepu pṛthivyāṃ bhavepu devayajaneṣu ya: somo'smābhi: sūyate abhipūyate so'pyasmābhirdattaḥ mamattu tvāṃ harṣayatu |
yena somena variva: varaṇīyaṃ dhanaṃ cakratha kṛtavānasi sa ca mamattu |
kiṃca yena śatrūn nirṇiṇāsi nirgamayasi so'pi mamattu tvāṃ mādayatu ||
ā dvibarhā amino yātvindro vṛṣā haribhyāṃ pariṣiktamanrdha: |
gavyā sutasya prabhṛtasya madhva: satrā khedāmaruśahā vṛṣasva ||

vyarya indra tanuhi śravāṃsyojaḥ sthireva dhanvannabhimātīḥ | asmyagvāvṛdhānaḥ sahobhiranibhṛṣṭanvāvṛdhasva || 6 || vi | arthaḥ | indra | tanuhi | śravāṃsi | ojaḥ | sthirā'iva | dhanvan | abhimātīḥ | asmyak | vavṛdhānaḥ | sahaḥ'bhiḥ | anibhṛṣṭaḥ | tanvam | vavṛdhasva || 6 ||
he indra vyartheḥ svāmī tvaṃ śravāṃsi annāni |
tanoterloṭi ‘utaśca pratyayācchandasi vāvacanam’ (pā. sū. 6.4.106.1) iti heluṃgabhāvaḥ |
tān prati ojaḥ ātmīyaṃ vīryaṃ sthireva sthirāṇyeva dhanvan dhanuṃṣi ca vistāraya |
vāvṛdhānaḥ pravṛddhaḥ ata eva anibhṛṣṭaḥ śatrubhirparibhavanīyastvaṃ tanvam ātmīyaṃ śarīraṃ vāvṛdhasva vardhaya |

idaṃ havirmaghavan tubhyaṃ rātaṃ prati samrāḻahaṇāno gṛbhāya | tubhyaṃ suto maghavan tubhyaṃ pakko'drīndra piba ca prasthitasya || 7 || idam | haviḥ | magha'van | tubhyam | rātam | prati | sam'rāṭ | ahaṇānaḥ | gṛbhāya | tubhyam | sutaḥ | magha'van | tubhyam | pakkaḥ | adri | indra | piba | ca | pra'sthitasya || 7 ||
he maghavan dhanavan samrāṭ samyagrājamāna sarveṣāmīśvareti vā idaṃ somādilakṣaṇaṃ rātam asmābhirdattaṃ haviḥ he indra tubhyam ahaṇānaḥ akudhyan prati gṛbhāya pratigṛhāṇa |
he maghavan tubhyam eva ayaṃ somaḥ |
he indra taṃ puroḍāśam adri bhakṣaya |
kiṃca prasthitasya havirdhānāduttaravediṃ prati prasthāpitaṃ somaṃ piba |

adrīndra prasthitemā havīṃṣi canau dadhiṣva pacatota somam | paryasvantaḥ prati haryāmasi tvā satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ || 8 || adri | it | indra | pra'sthitā | imā | havīṃṣi | canaḥ | dadhiṣva | pacata | uta | somam | paryasvantaḥ | prati | haryāmasi | tvā | satyāḥ | santu | yajamānasya | kāmāḥ || 8 ||
he indra prasthitā prasthitānuttaravediṃ prati imā imāni | ubhayatra ḍādeśaḥ | havīṃṣi adrīt | hṛdadhāraṇe | bhakṣayaiva | canaḥ | cana ityannanāma | tat dadhiṣva dhāraya | udare prakṣipa ||
4. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-tava dadhiṣva; bha1-naghā dadhiṣva; bha2-tathā dadhiṣva; bha4-tacā dadhiṣva; bha7-tathā dadhiṣva; bha8-tavā dadhiṣva |
tasmān 'yajamānasya yāgaṃ kurvāṇasya 'kāmāḥ dhanādiviṣayā abhilāṣāḥ 'satyāḥ yathārthāḥ 'santu ||
aryāiva pari caranti devā ye asmabhyaṃ dhanadā udvidaśca ||
pra | indrāgnibhyām | suvacasyām | iyarmi | sindhau'iva | pra | īryam | nāvam | arkaiḥ | aryāḥ'iva | pari | caranti | devāḥ | ye | asmabhyam | dhanadāḥ | ut'bhidaḥ | ca ||9||
'sindhāviva sindhau nadyāṃ yathā 'nāvaṃ prerayanti tadvat 'arkaiḥ arcanīyarmantraiḥ sahitāṃ stutiṃ 'preryaṃ prāvādiṣam ||
ayanti karmakaraṇārthaṃ gacchantītyayā ṛtvijaḥ karmakarā vā |
'ye devāḥ 'asmabhyaṃ 'dhanadāḥ dhanasya dātāraḥ 'udvidaḥ asmacchatrūṇāmudvettāraḥ 'ca ye santi ||
tathā cānukāntaṃ—'na vā u bhikṣurdhanadānapraśaṃsāye jagatyau ' iti |
na vā u devāḥ kṣudhāmiddhaṃ daṃdurāśitamupa gacchanti mṛtyavaḥ |
uto rayiḥ pṛṇato nopa dasyatyutārpaṇaṃ marḍitāraṃ na vindate ||

na | vai | ū~ iti | devāḥ | kṣudham | it | vadham | daduḥ | uta | āśitam | upa | gacchanti | mṛtyavaḥ | uto iti | rayiḥ | pṛṇataḥ | na | upa | dasyati | uta | arpaṇam | marḍitāram | na | vindate ||1||
etādṛśīṃ vadharūpāṃ kṣudhamannadānena yaḥ śamayati sa dātā khalu |
yo'daśvā bhuṅkte tam 'āśitaṃ bhuñjānaṃ puruṣamapi 'mṛtyavaḥ maraṇāni 'upa 'gacchanti samīpe yānti ||

1. gara-pacatāni pakāni | 2. ta-vā | 3. ga-ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha-preryati | 4. tabha-'devāḥ vai ' nāsti | 5. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha-āhuḥ | 6. ta1.2.3.6.7-utaśabdastvapyarthe; ta4.5-uta- śabdasyārthe; bha-utaśabdāstvarthe |

‘dasu upakṣaye’| daivādikaḥ| ‘pṛṇa dāne’| taudādikaḥ| tasya śatrantasya ‘śatruñjo nadyajādī’ iti vibhakterāyudāttatvam|| dānaprasaṅgenādātāraṃ dūpayati| ‘apṛṇan aprayacchan puruṣastu ‘marḍitāram ātmanaḥ sukhayitāraṃ ‘na ‘vindate| na’ kutrāpi labhate| iha bandhavo'pradānācca sukhayanti devā api haviṣpradānābhāvāt||
sthiraṃ manaḥ kṛṇute sevate puroto cittasa marḍitāraṃ na vindate||
yaḥ| ādhrāya| cakamānāya| pitvaḥ| anna'vān| san| raphitāya| upa'jagmuṣe| sthiram| manaḥ| kṛṇute| sevate| purā| uta| iti| citta| saḥ| marḍitāram| na| vindate||2||
dāridryeṇa hiṃsitāya ‘upajagmuṣe gṛhaṃ pratyāgatāya atithaye ‘manaḥ ātmīyamantaḥkaraṇam adāne ‘sthiraṃ ‘kṛṇute kurute|
‘vikaraṇasvaraḥ satiśiṣṭo'pi lasārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate’ (pā. ma. 6. 1. 158. 11) iti lasārvadhātukasvaraḥ|
na kevalaṃ kleśakaraṇam api tu ‘purā tasya purastādeva ‘sevate bhogān|
sa iddhojo yo gṛhave dadātyanakāmāya carate kuśāya|
araṃasmai bhavati yāmahūtā utāparīṣu kṛṇute sakhāyam||
saḥ| it| bhojaḥ| yaḥ| gṛhave| dadāti| anna'kāmāya| carate| kuśāya| aram| asmai| bhavati| yāma'hūtau| uta| aparīṣu| kṛṇute| sakhāyam|| 3||
‘ma ‘it sa eva ‘bhojaḥ dātā khalu ‘yo ‘gṛhave grahe'gatvā- ditvāt kupratyayaḥ (u. sū. 1. 36)||
pratigrahītre ‘annakāmāya annaṃ yācamānāya ‘carate gṛhamā- gatavate ‘kuśāya dāridryeṇa etādṛśāyātithaye'nnaṃ ‘dadāṃta prayacchati||
tasya sarve sakhāya eva na śatrava ityarthaḥ||

na sa sakhā yo na dadāti sakhyai sacābhuve sacamānāya pitvaḥ | apāsmātpreyān tadoko asti pṛṇantamanyamaraṇaṃ cidicchet || 4 || na | saḥ | sakhā | yaḥ | na | dadāti | sakhyai | sacā'bhuve | sacamānāya | pitvaḥ | arpa | asmāt | pra | iyāt | na | tat | okaḥ | asti | pṛṇantam | anyam | araṇam | cit | icchet || 4 ||
'saḥ puruṣaḥ 'sakhā 'na bhavati 'yaḥ puruṣaḥ 'sacābhuve sarvadā sahabhavanaśīlāya 'sacamānāya sevamānāyopasarjanībhūtāya 'sakhye sakhvijanāya 'pitvaḥ pitūnannāni 'na 'dadāti na prayacchati |
sa gataḥ puruṣaḥ 'pṛṇantam annādikaṃ prayacchantam 'anyamaraṇaṃ 'cit arthaṃ svāminameva 'icchet kāmayeta ||

puṇīyādinnārthamānāya tavyān drāghīyāṃsamanu paśyet panthām | o hi vartante rathyaiva cakrānyamanyamupa tiṣṭhanta rāyaḥ || 5 || puṇīyāt | it | nārthamānāya | tavyān | drāghīyāṃsam | anu | paśyet | panthām | o iti | hi | vartante | rathyā'iva | cakrā | anyam'anyam | upa | tiṣṭhanta | rāyaḥ ||5||
'tavyān tavīyān dhanairatiśayena pravṛddhaḥ puruṣaḥ 'nādhamānāya yācamānāyātithaye 'puṇīyādit dhanāni dadādeva ||

moghamannaṃ vindate apracetāḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vadha itastasrya | nāryamaṇaṃ puṣyati no sakhāyaṃ kevalāgho bhavati kevalādī || 6 || mogham | annam | vindate | apra'cetāḥ | satyam | bravīmi | vadhaḥ | itaḥ | tasya | na | aryamaṇam | puṣyati | no | sakhāyam | kevalā'aghaḥ | bhavati | kevalādī ||6||
'apracetāḥ aprakṛṣṭajñānaḥ dāne ceto' mano yasya na bhavati 'saḥ 'moghaṃ vyarthameva 'annaṃ 'vindate labhate ||
1. ta-bha-janāya | 2. ga-ta1.2.3.6.7.8-sakhya; ta4.5-mu-nivāsaḥ | 3. ta-bha-' hi ' nāsti | 4. ta-bhavati uktavati | 5. ga-ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ceto ' nāsti |
na kevalaṃ vyartha kiṃtu tasya puruṣasya saḥ vadha it vadha evākṣaṃ parāmṛśataḥ||
yathā ‘jeraṇī0’ (pā. sū. 1. 3. 67) ityatra yat karmaṃ sa eva karteti||
athavā sa nirarthako vadha eva yaḥ puruṣaḥ arthamaṇam|
sarvān devānaryamādīn na puṣyati haviṣpradānena na poṣayati no nāpi sakhāyaṃ samānasthānamabhyāgatamatithi mitravargaṃ ca na popayati|
kṛṣannitphālaṃ āśitaṃ kṛṇoti yannadhvā̭namarpa vṛkte caritraiḥ|
kṛpan| it| phālaḥ| āśitam| kṛṇoti| yan| adhvānam| arpa| vṛkte| caritraiḥ| vadan| brahmā| avadataḥ| vanīyān| pṛṇan| āpiḥ| apṛṇantam| abhi| syāt|| 7||
kṛṣan kṛṣiṃ kurvan phālaḥ āśitaṃ karṣakaṃ bhoktāraṃ kṛṇoti karoti|
gacchan puruṣaḥ caritrai ātmīyairaṃgamanaiḥ apa vṛkte|
vadan śāstrārthaṃ bruvāṇaḥ brahmā brāhmaṇaḥ avadataḥ śāstrārthamabruvāṇājjanāt vanīyān saṃbhaktamaḥ priyakaro bhavati||
te yathā svakarmaṇi pravartamānāḥ pareśāpakārakāḥ tathā pṛṇan dātā puruṣaḥ apṛṇantam adātāraṃ janam abhi abhilakṣya āpiḥ syāt bandhurbhavat||
ekapā̭dyau dvipado vi cakrame dvipāritripā̭dabhyeti paścāta|
eka'pāt| bhūyaḥ| dvi'padaḥ| vi| cakrame| dvi'pāt| tri'pādam| abhi| eti| paścāt| catuḥ'pāt| eti| dvi'padām| abhi'svare| sam'paśyan| paṅktīḥ| upa'tiṣṭhamānaḥ||8||
ekapāt ekabhāgadhanaḥ puruṣaḥ dvipadaḥ dviguṇadhanasya mārgaṃ bhūyaḥ|
bhūyasā kālena vi cakrame vividhaṃ gacchati||
tathā dvipāt puruṣaḥ tripādaṃ tribhāgadhanaṃ puruṣaṃ paścāt abhyeti abhigacchati||
ekapādadhanādīnāṃ paṅktīḥ abhisvare abhigamaname saṃpaśyan samyagīkṣamāṇaḥ san upatiṣṭhamānaḥ eti gacchamāno bhavati|
tasmāttvam ahameva dhanavāniti na manyeḥ kiṃvatithimyo dhanāni dadastretyarthaḥ||

samau ciddhastau na sumaṃ viviṣṭa: saṃmātarāṃ cinna samaṃ duhāte | yamayościnna samā vīryāṇi jñātī citsantau na sumaṃ pṛṇītaḥ || 9 || samau | cit | hastau | na | samam | viviṣṭa: | sama'mātarāṃ | cit | na | samam | duhāte iti | yamayo: | cit | na | samā | vīryāṇi | jñātī iti | cit | santau | na | sumam | pṛṇītaḥ ||9||
atithibhyo dhanamaprayacchannapi mama bhrātā dāsyatīti cet tatra hetumāha |
samau ciddhastau samāvapi samaṃ samānaṃ na viviṣṭa: kāryaṃ na vyāmuta: |
tathā saṃmātarāṃ vatsasya mātarau dhenū same api samaṃ samānaṃ patha: na duhāte |
yamayościt sahajātayo: putrayorapi samā samāni vīryāṇi na santi |
tasmāt jñātī cit ekasmin kule santau jātāvapi samaṃ na pṛṇīta: na prayacchata: |

sa āhuto vi raucate'mirīḻenyau girā | sucā pratīka majyate || 3 || saḥ | ā'hutaḥ | vi | rocate | agniḥ | īḻenyaḥ | girā | sucā | pratīkam | ajyate ||3|| āhutaḥ ābhimukhyena hutaḥ || 'gatiranantaraḥ' iti gateḥ prakṛtisvaraḥ || girā stuti- lakṣaṇayā vācā īḻenyaḥ stotavyaḥ saḥ agniḥ vi rocate asyarthaṃ dīpyate | tathā pratīkaṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ pūrvameva sucā ghṛtasahitayā ajyate sicyate ||

ghṛtenāgniḥ samajyate madhupratīka āhutaḥ | rocamāno vibhāvasuḥ || 4 || ghṛtena | agniḥ | sam | ajyate | madhu'pratīkaḥ | ā'hutaḥ | rocamānaḥ | vibhā'vasuḥ ||4|| agniḥ ghṛtena haviṣā samajyate samyak sikto bhavati | kīdṛśaḥ | madhupratīkaḥ ghṛtaprayuktā- vayavaḥ āhutaḥ stutibhirhavirbhirvā rocamānaḥ dīpyamānaḥ vibhāvasuḥ svadīptyā sarvamācchādayan | yadvā | dīptireva dhanaṃ yasya saḥ ||

asoyāme hoturitariktokthye 'jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase' ityanurūpastṛcaḥ | sūtritaṃ ca—'jarābodha tadvividdhi jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase' (āśva. śrau. 9. 11) iti || jaramāṇaḥ samidhyase devebhyo havyavāhana | taṃ tvā havantu martyāḥ || 5 || jaramāṇaḥ | sam | idhyase | devebhyaḥ | havya'vāhana | tam | tvā | havantu | martyāḥ || 5 || he havyavāhana havyānāṃ prāpayitaḥ || 'havye'nantaḥpādam' (pā. sū. 3. 2. 66) iti ṇyuṭ || jaramāṇaḥ stotṛbhiḥ stūyamānaḥ | jaratiḥ stutikarmā | sa tvaṃ devebhyaḥ devārthaṃ samidhyase havirbhiḥ samyagdīpyase | taṃ tādṛśaṃ tvā tvāṃ martyāḥ manuṣyo sādhavo yajamānāḥ havanta āhvayanti || hyaterlaṅi 'bahulaṃ chandasi' iti samprasāraṇam || || 24 ||

taṃ martā amartyaṃ ghṛtenāgniṃ saparyata | adābhyaṃ gṛhapatim || 6 || tam | martāḥ | amartyam | ghṛtena | agnim | saparyata | adābhyam | gṛha'patim || 6 || he martāḥ ṛtvijaḥ amartyaṃ manuṣyadharmarahitam agniṃ ghṛtena haviṣā saparyata paricarata || saparaśabdaḥ kaṇḍvādiḥ || kīdṛśam | adābhyaṃ kaiścidapyahiṃsyam || 'dabheściti vaktavyam' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 124. 3) iti ṇyat || gṛhapatiṃ gṛhasya svāminaṃ yajamānarūpam || 'patyāvaiśvarye' iti pūrvapadaprakṛtisvaraḥ ||

adābhyena śociṣāgne rakṣastvaṃ daha | gopā ṛtasya dīdihi || 7 || adābhyena | śociṣā | agne | rakṣaḥ | tvam | daha | gopāḥ | ṛtasya | dīdihi || 7 || he agne tvam adābhyena ahiṃsyena śociṣā tejasā rakṣaḥ jātāvekavacanam | sarvān rākṣasān daha vināśaya | kiṃca ṛtasya yajñasya gopāḥ gopāyitā san dīdihi dīpyasva ||
sa tvamagne pratīkena pratyoṣa yātudhānyaḥ | urukṣayeṣu dīrdhat || 8 || saḥ | tvam | agne | pratīkena | prati | oṣa | yātu'dhānyaḥ | uru'kṣayeṣu | dīrdhat || 8 ||
vmatiḥ stotṛbhiḥ kriyamāṇā stutiḥ vmā mām vupa vasthita saṃyojayati ||
vvāśvā vputramiva yathā vāśvā śabdāyamānā dhenuḥ vpriyaṃ putraṃ vasaṃ saṃgacchati tadvat ||
ahaṃ tadyaiva vandhuraṃ paryaicāmi hṛdā matim | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 5 || aham | tadya'iva | vandhuram | pāryai | acchāmi | hṛdā | matim | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti||5||
tasthānaṃ rathaṃ vā sādhu- karoti tadvat vahaṃ vmatiṃ stutiṃ vhṛdā ātmīyena manasā vparyaicāmi |
nahi me akṣipaccācchāntsuḥ paśvaṃ kuṣṭyaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 6 || nahi | me | akṣipat | cana | acchāntsuḥ | paśva | kuṣṭyaḥ | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti||6||
vpañca vkuṣṭyaḥ api niṣādapañcamāścatvāro varṇāḥ pañca janāḥ |
vme madīyama vakṣipat cakṣuḥpatanaṃ dṛṣṭisaṃcāraṃ vnahi vacchāntsuḥ na hyapavṛṇvanti² |
‘na hi druṣṭerviparilopo vidyate’ (śa. brā. 14. 7. 1. 23) iti hi śruteḥ |
‘curādīnām’ iti vā ṇyantatvādatra ṇyabhāve luhi hallantalakṣaṇā vṛddhiḥ (pā. sū. 7. 2. 3) ||
nahi me rodasī ubhe anyaṃ pakṣaṃ cana prati | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 7 || nahi | me | rodasī iti | ubhe iti | anyam | pakṣam | cana | prati | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 7 ||
vubhe vrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau vme madīyama vanyaṃ vpakṣaṃ vcana pakṣamapi vprati samāne na bhavataḥ||
abhi dyāṃ mahinā bhuvamabhīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahīm | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 8 || abhi | dyām | mahinā | bhuvam | abhi | imām | pṛthivīm | mahīm | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 8 ||
vmahinā mahinnātmīyena vdyāṃ dyulokam vabhi vbhuvam abhivavāmi |
tathā vmahīṃ mahatīm vimāṃ vpṛthivīṃ svamahimnā vabhi bhavāmi ||
hantāhaṃ pṛthivīmimāṃ ni dadhāniha veha vā | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 9 || hanta | aham | pṛthivīm | imām | ni | dadhāni | iha | vā | iha | vā | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 9 ||

vhanta iti saṃbhāvanāyāmanujñāyāṃ vā | saṃbhāvanāyyetadanujānāmi vā | kiṃ tat | vaham vimāṃ vpṛthivīm viha vvā antarikṣe vni vdadhāni | viha vvā dyuloke iti hastena nirdiśati || dadhāte- rloṭi⁴ merniḥ ||

oṣamitpṛthivīmahaṃ jaghnānīha veha vā | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 10 || oṣam | it | pṛthivīm | aham | jaghnāni | iha | vā | iha | vā | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 10 || ahaṃ pṛthivīm abhilakṣya oṣaṃ svatajasā tāpakamādityam iha vā antarikṣe iha vā dyuloke jaghnāni bhṛśaṃ yāpayāni | hat iti pūraṇa: || hantergartyarthasya yaṅlugantasya loṭi jhapo lugabhāvaśchāndasa: ||

divi me anyaḥ pakṣo'dho anyamacīkṛṣam | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 11 || divi | me | anyaḥ | pakṣaḥ | adhaḥ | anyam | acīkṛṣam | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 11 || me madīya: anya: pakṣa: divi dyuloke sthāpita: | adha: || ' pvāṃgharā varāṇāmasi' (pā. sū. 5. 3. 39 ) ityādināsipratyaya: | prakṛterādeśaśca || adhastātpṛthivyām amyaṃ pakṣam acīkṛṣam akākṣam || 'kṛṣa vilekhane' | ṇyantasya luṅi caṅi 'niśya chandasi' (pā. sū. 7. 4. 8 ) ityukārādeśa: || vilekhanaṃ nāmotpādanam | udapādayam | āsthāpayamityartha: ||

ahamasmi mahāmaho'bhinabhyamudīṣitaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 12 || aham | asmi | mahā'maha: | abhi'nabhyam | ut'īṣita: | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 12 || abhinabhyaṃ nābhau madhyasthāne bhava nabhyamantarikṣam | 'ugavādibhyo yat' (pā. sū. 5. 1. 2 ) iti yatpratyaya: | tatraiva pāṭhādbhādeśaśca | 'lakṣaṇenābhipatī ābhimukhye' (pā. sū. 2. 1. 14) ityanyacībhāva: | samāsasvara: | antarikṣamabhi uddīpita: udgata: sūryātmā ahaṃ mahāmaha: asmi | mahatāmapi mahānasmi | yadvā | mahat prabhūtaṃ mahastejo yasya | prabhūtatejasko'smi || 'ātmahata:°' (pā. sū. 6. 1. 46 ) ityātvam ||

gṛho yāmya̭ṃkṛto devebhyo havyavāhanaḥ | kuvitsomasyāpāmiti || 13 || gṛha: | yāmi | aram'kṛta: | devebhya: | havya'vāhana: | kuvit | somasya | apām | iti || 13 || gṛha: haviṣāṃ grahītā araṃkṛta: yajamānairalaṃ kṛto'haṃ devebhya: indrādibhya: havyavāhana: haviṣāṃ voḍhā prāpayitā agnyātmā san yāmi havīṃṣi prāpayāmi || 'yā prāpaṇe' | laṭ | 'havye'- nantaḥpādam' iti vahemyuṃṭ | jiravādādyudāttaḥ | samāse kuduttarapadaprakṛtisvara: || iti yasmāt kuvit bahuvāraṃ somasya somam apāṃ pītavānasmi | tasmādetāmyakāpamitīndra: svātmānamevā- stāvīt || || 27 ||
iti śrīmadrājādhirājaparameśvaravaidikamārgapravartakaśrīvīrabukkabhūpālasāmrājyadhuraṃdhareṇa sāyaṇācāryeṇa viracite mādhavīye vedārthaprakāśa ṛksaṃhitābhāṣye'ṣṭamāṣṭake ṣaṣṭho'dhyāya: |
yasya niḥśvasitaṃ vedā yo vedebhyo'khilaṃ jagat |
'tadita' iti navarcamaṣṭamaṃ sūktamatharvaṇaḥ putrasya gṛhadisyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |
sūtritaṃ ca—'tadidāseti ca purastātsūktasya śaṃset' (āśva. śrau. 7. 3) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'eteṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ kayā śubhā tadidāseti madhyaṃdinaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 9. 8) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'rāśi- marāyayośca kayāśubhīyatadidāsīye' (āśva. śrau. 9. 8) iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake śaunakena sūtritaṃ—'tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ tāṃ su te kīrtiṃ maghavan mahiṣvā' (ai. ā. 5. 1. 6) iti ||
tadidā̭sa॒ bhuva̭neṣu॒ jyeṣṭha॒ṃ yato̭ ja॒jña u॒grastvḙṣanṛ॒mṇaḥ |
sa॒dyo ja̭jñā॒no ni ri̭ṇāti॒ śatrū॒nanu॒ yaṃ viśvḙ ma॒dantyu॒rmāḥ ||
tat | it | āsa | bhuvaneṣu | jyeṣṭham | yataḥ | jajñe | ugraḥ | tveṣanṛmṇaḥ | sadyaḥ | jajñānaḥ | ni | riṇāti | śatrūn | anu | yam | viśve | madanti | ūrmāḥ || 1 ||
satsu pṛthivyādiṣu lokeṣu madhye jagatkāraṇaṃ brahmaiva 'jyeṣṭhaṃ praśastatamam 'āsa babhūva |
asterliṭi 'chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvāt 'asterbhūḥ' (pā. sū. 2. 4. 52) iti bhūbhāvābhāvaḥ |
vṛddhaṃ tadeva brahma svaprakāśatayā āsa didīpe |
'yataḥ upādānabhūtāt yasmāt brahmaṇaḥ 'ugraḥ uddūrṇaḥ 'tveṣanṛmṇaḥ pradīptabalaḥ sūryātmaka indraḥ 'jajñe jāto babhūva |
śrūyate hi—'cakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata' (ṛ. saṃ. 10. 90. 13) iti |
'jani kartuḥ prakṛtiḥ' (pā. sū. 1. 4. 30) iti prakṛterādānasaṃjñāyāṃ yata iti pañcamī |
sa ca 'jajñānaḥ jāyamāna eva 'sadyaḥ śīghraṃ 'śatrūn jñātayitṛn mandehādīn rākṣasān 'ni 'riṇāti nihinasti |
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ—'sadyo hyepa jātaḥ pāpmānamapāhata' (ai. ā. 1. 3. 4) iti ||
sarve prāṇinaḥ 'yaṃ sūryātmakamudyantamindramulakṣya madarthamudagāt madarthamudagāditi 'madanti hṛṣyanti ||
brāhmaṇa—' bhūtāni vai viśva umāsta enamanu madamyudagādugāditi ' (ai. ā. 1. 2. 4) iti |
taittirīyakaṃ ca—' tasmātsarvaṃ eva manyate māṃ pratyudagāditi ' (tai. saṃ. 6. 5. 4. 2) iti |
yaṃ stutyādibhirmāṃcantamanu paścāt sarve prāṇino'bhīṣṭaprāptyā hṛṣyanti |
' anullakṣaṇe ' (pā. sū. 1.4.84) ityanoḥ karmapravacanīyatvāt karmapravacanīyayukta iti dvitīyā |
vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūyaujāḥ śatrurdāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti |
avyanacca vyanacca sastri saṃ tai navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu ||
vavṛdhānaḥ | śavasā | bhūya'ojāḥ | śatruḥ | dāsāya | bhiyasam | dadhāti | avi'anat | ca | tri'anat | ca | sastri | sam | te | navanta | pra'bhṛtā | madeṣu || 2 ||
ᵥśavasā balena ᵥvavṛdhānaḥ vardhamānaḥ ata eva ᵥbhūyaujāḥ bahubalaḥ ᵥśatruḥ śātayitendraḥ ᵥdāsāya upakṣayakāriṇe śatrave ᵥbhiyasaṃ bhītiṃ ᵥdadhāti vidadhāti |
tadubhayamapi ᵥsastri saṃsthātaminadreṇa samyak śodhitaṃ bhavati ||
snāteḥ ' ādagamahana ' iti vyatyayena karmaṇi kinpratyayaḥ||
' na lokāvyaya ' iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ pratiṣedhaḥ ||
he indra ᵥte tava ᵥmadeṣu harṣeṣu haviṣā stutyā ca jāteṣu2 ᵥprabhṛtā prabhṛtāni prakarṣeṇa dhṛtāni poṣitāni vā sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni ᵥsaṃ ᵥnacanta saṃgacchante |
tve kratumapi vṛñjanti viśve dviyadete trirbhavantyūmāḥ |
svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā samadaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ ||
tve iti | kratum | api | vṛñjanti | viśve | dviḥ | yat | ete | triḥ | bhavanti | ūmāḥ | svādoḥ | svādīyaḥ | svādunā | sṛja | sam | adaḥ | su | madhu | madhunā | abhi | yodhīḥ || 3 ||
ᵥviśve sarve yajamānāḥ ᵥkratum anuṣṭheyaṃ karma ᵥvṛñjanti samāpayanti |
sarvāṇi pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ manāṃsi sarve yajñakratavaśca vyāse tvayyeva yajamānaiḥ parisamāpyanta ityarthaḥ |
tathā ca brāhmaṇa—' tvayīmāni sarvāṇi bhūtāni sarvāṇi manāṃsi sarve kratavo'pi vṛñjantītyeva tadāha ' (ai. ā. 1. 3. 4) iti |
īdṛśā yajamānāḥ pūrvamekākinaḥ santaḥ paścāt ᵥdviḥ dvivāraṃ kṣīrapeṇa puṃrūpeṇa ca jātāḥ santaḥ punarapyena sārdhaṃ ᵥtriḥ trivāraṃ jambhabhājaḥ ᵥbhavanti |
' ardho vā eṣa ātmano yatpatnī ' (tai. brā. 3. 3. 3) iti śruteḥ |
yata evamete'bhivṛddhā bhavanti tato'vagamyate tvayyevānuṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ karmaṃ parisamāpayantīti |
tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ— 'dvau vai santau mithunau prajāyete prajāyai' ( ai. ā. 1. 3. 4) iti |
he indra tvaṃ svādoḥ priyāt gṛhanāderapi svādīyaḥ svādutaraṃ priyataramapatyaṃ svādunā svādubhūtena mithunena mātāpitrātmakena saṃ sṛja saṃyojaya |
adaḥ tadapatyaṃ madhu madhuraṃ madhunā madahetunā mithunāntareṇa pautreṇa vā su suṣṭhu abhi yodhīḥ abhiyodhaya |
'mithunaṃ vai svādu prajā svādu' (ai. ā. 1.3.4) ityādi brāhmaṇamatrānusadheyam ||
iti ciddhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ mademade anumadanti viprāḥ |
ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiramā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhanyātudhānā durevāḥ ||
iti | cit | hi | tvā | dhanā | jayantam | mademade | anumadanti | viprāḥ | ojīyaḥ | dhṛṣṇo iti | sthiram | ā | tanuṣva | mā | tvā | dabhan | yātudhānāḥ | duḥevāḥ || 4 ||
iti ciddhi evameva khalu he indra mademade somapānajanye harṣe sati dhanā śatrudhanāni jayantaṃ jayena prāpnuvantaṃ tvām anu paścāt |
balavattaram ata eva sthiraṃ dṛḍhaṃ dhanam ā tanuṣva abhito'smadarthaṃ vistāraya |
tvā tvāṃ ca mā dabhan mā hiṃsantu durevāḥ durgatayaḥ yātudhānāḥ rākṣasāḥ ||
tvayā vayaṃ śāśahre raṇeṣṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri |
codayāmi tu āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ teṃ śikṣāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi ||
tvayā | vayam | śāśahre | raṇeṣṣu | pra'paśyantaḥ | yudhenyāni | bhūri | codayāmi | te | āyudhā | vacaḥ'bhiḥ | sam | te | śikṣāmi | brahmaṇā | vayāṃsi || 5 ||
he indra tvayā anugṛhītāḥ vayaṃ raṇeṣṣu saṃgrāmeṣu śāśahre bhṛśaṃ śatrūnū śātayāmaḥ ||
api ca te tava āyudhā āyudhāni āyodhanasādhanāni vajrādīni |
vacobhiḥ stutibhiḥ codayāmi śatrūn prati prerayāmi |
te tvadarthaṃ brahmaṇā mantreṇa stutirūpeṇa sahitāni vayāṃsi ||

‘hiraṇyagarbha:’ iti daśacaṃ navamaṃ sūktaṃ prajāpatiputrasya hiraṇyagarbhasyāsyarṣi traiṣṭubham|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘hiraṇyagarbho daśa hiraṇyagarbha: prājāpatya: kāyam’ iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘hiraṇyagarbha: samavartatāgra iti ṣaṭ prājāpatyā:|
varuṇapraghāseṣu kāyasya haviyo hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ityeṣā yājyā|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘kayā naścitra ā bhuvaddhiraṇyagarbha: samavartatāgra iti pratiprasthātā vājine tṛtīya:|
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
hiraṇya'garbhaḥ | saḥ | avartata | agre | bhūtasya | jātaḥ | patiḥ | ekaḥ | āsīt | saḥ | dādhāra | pṛthivīm | dyām | uta | imām | kasmai | devāya | haviṣā | vidhema ||1||
tathā ca taittirīyakaṃ— ‘prajāpatirvai hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prajāpateranupatvāt ’ (tai. saṃ. 5. 5. 1. 2) iti |
yadvā hiraṇmayo'ṇḍo garbhadadhastvodare vartate so'sau sūtrātmā hiraṇyagarbha ityucyate |
yadyapi paramātmaiva hiraṇyagarbhaḥ tathāpi tadupādhi- bhūtānāṃ viyadādīnāṃ brahmaṇa utpattestadupahito'pyutpanna ityucyate |
sa ca jātaḥ jātamātra eva ekaḥ advitīyaḥ san bhūtasya vikārajātasya brahmāṇḍādeḥ sarvasya jagataḥ patiḥ īśvaraḥ āsīt |
na kevalaṃ patirāsīdeva tarhi saḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ pṛthivīṃ vistīrṇāṃ dyāṃ divam uta api ca imām asamābhirdṛśyamānāṃ purovartinīmimāṃ bhūmim |
antarikṣaṃ divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca dādhāra dhārayati ||
athavā indreṇa pṛṣṭaḥ prajāpatirdīyaṃ mahattvaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāyāhaṃ kaḥ kīdṛśaḥ syāmityuktavān |
sa indraḥ pratyuce yadīdaṃ tavītyahaṃ kaḥ syāmiti tadeva tvaṃ bhaveti |
‘indro vai vṛtraṃ hatvā sarvāṃ vijitī- viṃjilābravīt ’ (ai. brā. 3. 21) ityādikaṃ brāhmaṇamanusandheyam ||
yadāsau kiṃśabdastadā sarva- nāmatvān maibhāvaḥ siddhaḥ |
kaṃ prajāpatiṃ devāya devaṃ dānādiguṇayuktaṃ haviṣā prājāpatyasya paśorvā rūpeṇakapālāmakena? puroḍāśena vā vidhema vayamṛtvijaḥ paricarema |
ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ |
yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
yaḥ | ātma'dāḥ | bala'dāḥ | yasya | viśve | upa'āsate | pra'śiṣam | yasya | devāḥ | yasya | chāyā | amṛtam | yasya | mṛtyuḥ | kasmai | devāya | haviṣā | vidhema || 2 ||
ātmāno hi sarve tasmāt paramātmana utpadyante |
baladāḥ: balasya ca dātā śodhayitā vā |
yasya ca praśiṣaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ śāsana- ājñāṃ viśve sarve prāṇinaḥ upāsate prārthayante sevante vā |
nadapi yasya prajāpateḥ chāyā chāyeva varti bhavati|
tasmai kasmai devāya ityādidaṃ samānaṃ pūrveṇa haviṣā puroḍāśāgmaneti tu viśeṣaḥ||
yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva |
ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
yaḥ | prāṇataḥ | nimiṣataḥ | mahitvā | ekaḥ | it | rājā | jagataḥ | babhūva | yaḥ | īśe | asya | dvipadaḥ | catuṣpadaḥ | kasmai | devāya | haviṣā | vidhema || 3 ||
yaḥ hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prāṇataḥ pradhvasataḥ| 'ana prāṇane'| ādādikaḥ| 'śataranumaḥ' iti vibhakterudāttatvam| nimiṣataḥ akṣipakṣmacalanaṃ kurvataḥ| atrāpi pūrvavadvibhaktirudāttā| jagataḥ jaṅgamasya

yena॒ dyauru॒grā pṛ̭thi॒vī ca̭ dṛ॒ḻhā yena॒ sva̭: sta॒bhita̭ṃ yena॒ nāka̭: | yo a॒ntari̭kṣe॒ raja̭so vi॒māna̭: kasmai̭ de॒vāya̭ ha॒viṣā̭ vidhema || 5 || yena̭ | dyau: | u॒grā | pṛ̭thi॒vī | ca̭ | dṛ॒ḻhā | yena̭ | sva̭: | iti̭ sva: | sta॒bhitam | yena̭ | nāka̭: | ya: | a॒ntari̭kṣe | raja̭sa: | vi॒māna̭: | kasmai̭ | de॒vāya̭ | ha॒viṣā̭ | vi॒dhema̭ || 5 || ^yena prajāpatinā ^dyau: antarikṣam ^ugrā uddūrṇa viśeṣeṇāhanarūpaṃ vā | ^pṛthivī bhūmi: ^ca ^dṛḻhā yena sthirīkṛtā | ^sva: svargaśca ^yena ^stabhitaṃ stabdhaṃ kṛtam | yathādho na patati tathopari avasthāpitamityartha: | ^'prasitaskabhitastambhita' iti nipātyate | tathā ^nāka: ādityaśca ^yena antarikṣe stabhita: | ^ya: ca ^antarikṣe ^rajasa: udakasya ^vimāna: nirmātā | tasmai ^kasmai ityādi gatam | || 3 ||

yaṃ kra̭nda॒sī arva̭sā tasta॒bhāne॒ abhyai̭kṣetā॒ṃ mana̭sā reja̭māne | yatrādhi॒ sūra̭ u॒dito॒ vibhā̭ti kasmai̭ de॒vāya̭ ha॒viṣā̭ vidhema || 6 || yam | kra̭nda॒sī iti̭ | arva̭sā | tasta॒bhāne॒ iti̭ | a॒bhi | ai̭kṣetām | mana̭sā | reja̭māne iti̭ | yatra̭ | adhi̭ | sūra̭: | u॒t | i॒ta: | vi॒bhā̭ti | kasmai̭ | de॒vāya̭ | ha॒viṣā̭ | vi॒dhema̭ || 6 || kranditavān roditavānanayo: prajāpatiriti ^krandasī dyāvāpṛthivyau | śrūyate hi—'yadaro- dīttadanayo rodasvam' (tai. brā. 2. 2. 9. 4) iti | ^avasā rakṣaṇena hetunā lokasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ^tastabhāne prajāpatinā sṛṣṭe labdhasthairye satyau ^yaṃ prajāpatiṃ ^manasā buddhayā ^abhyaikṣetām āvayo- rmahattvamanena ityabhyapaśyetām | ^'īkṣa darśane' | laṅi adāditvādādyudātta: | kīdṛśyau dyāvā- pṛthivyau | ^rejamāne rājamāne dīpyamāne | ākārasya vyatyayenaitvam | anupadadeśālasārvadhātukānu- dāttatve dhātusvara: | yadvā | liṭa: kānac | ^'phaṇāṃ ca sasānām' (pā. sū. 6. 4. 125) ityetvābhyāsalopau | ^'chandasyubhayathā' iti sārvadhātukatvācchap | ata eva ^'abhyastānāmādi: ' ityādyudāttatvam | ^yatrādhi yasminnādhārabhūte prajāpatau ^sūra: sūrya: ^udita: udayaṃ prāpta: san ^vibhāti prakāśate | utpūrvādete: karmaṇi niṣṭhā | ^'gatiranantara:' iti gate: prakṛtisvaratvam | tasmai ^kasmai ityādi sujñānam |

āpo̭ ha॒ yadbṛ̭ha॒tīrviśva̭māya॒n garbha̭ṃ dadhā̭nā॒ jana̭yantī॒ragnim | tataṷ de॒vānā॒ṃ sama̭vartatāsu॒reka: kasmai̭ de॒vāya̭ ha॒viṣā̭ vidhema || 7 || āpa̭: | ha | yat | bṛ̭ha॒tī: | viśva̭m | ā | aya̭n | garbha̭m | dadhā̭nā: | ja॒na॒yantī̭: | a॒gnim | tata:̭ | de॒vānā̭m | sam | a॒rva॒ta | asṷ: | eka:̭ | kasmai̭ | de॒vāya̭ | ha॒viṣā̭ | vi॒dhema̭ || 7 || ^bṛhatī: bṛhatyo mahatya: | jasi ^'vā chandasi' iti pūrvasavarṇadīrgha: | ^'brahmamahatopa- saṃkhyānam' iti ṅīpa udāttatvam | ^agnim upalakṣaṇametat | agnyupalakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ viyadādi-

bhūtajātaṃ ᵥjanayantīḥ janayantyaḥ tadarthaṃ ᵥgarbhaṃ hiraṇyamāṇḍasya garbhabhūtaṃ prajāpatiṃ ᵥdadhānāḥ dhārayantyaḥ ᵥāpo ᵥha āpa eva ᵥviśvamāyan sarvaṃ jagat vyāptuvan ᵥyat ᵥyasmāt ᵥtataḥ tasmāddhetoḥ ᵥdevānāṃ devādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇinām ᵥasuḥ prāṇabhūtaḥ ᵥekaḥ prajāpatiḥ ᵥsamavartata samajāyata |
yat yaṃ garbhaṃ dadhānā āpo viśvātmanāvasthitāḥ tato garbhabhūtātprajāpaterdevādīnāṃ prāṇātmako vāyurajāyata |
uttalakṣaṇā yā āpo viśvamāvṛtya sthitāḥ 2 tatastābhyo'nyaḥ sakāśādeko'dvitīyo'suḥ prāṇātmakaḥ prajāpatiḥ samavartata niśvakrāma |
yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsītkasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
yaḥ | cit | āpaḥ | | mahinā | pari'apaśyat | dakṣam | dadhānāḥ | janayantīḥ | yajñam | yaḥ | deveṣu | adhi | devaḥ | ekaḥ | āsīt | kasmai | devāya | haviṣā | vidhema || 8 ||
ᵥyajñaṃ yajñopalakṣitaṃ vikārajātaṃ ᵥjanayantīḥ utpādayantīḥ tadarthaṃ ᵥdakṣaṃ prapañcātmanā vardhiṣṇuṃ prajāpatimātmani ᵥdadhānāḥ dhārayitrīḥ |
svamāhātmyena ᵥyaścit yaśca prajāpatiḥ ᵥparyapaśyat parito dṛṣṭavān ᵥyaḥ ca ᵥdeveṣvadhi deveṣu madhye ᵥdevaḥ teṣāmapīśvaraḥ san ᵥekaḥ advitīyaḥ ᵥāsīt bhavati |
mā nau hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā jujāna |
yaścāpaścandrā bṛhatīrjujāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
mā | naḥ | hiṃsīt | janitā | yaḥ | pṛthivyāḥ | yaḥ | vā | divam | satya'dharmā | jujāna | yaḥ | ca | apaḥ | candrāḥ | bṛhatīḥ | jujāna | kasmai | devāya | haviṣā | vidhema || 9 ||
sa prajāpatiḥ ᵥnaḥ asmān ᵥmā ᵥhiṃsīn mā bādhatām |
ᵥyaḥ ᵥpṛthivyāḥ bhūmeḥ ᵥjanitā janayitā sraṣṭā |
ᵥyo ᵥvā yaśca ᵥsatyadharmā satyamitathaṃ dharmaṃ jagato dhāraṇaṃ yasya sa tādṛśaḥ prajāpatiḥ ᵥdivam antarikṣopalakṣitān sarvān lokān ᵥjajāna janayāmāsa |
tato liṭi 'amantre' (pā. sū. 3. 1. 35) iti niṣedhādāmpratyayābhāve tipo ṇili vṛddhau |
ᵥyaśca ᵥbṛhatīḥ mahatīḥ ᵥcandrāḥ āhlādinīḥ ᵥapaḥ udakāni ᵥjajāna janayāmāsa |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'prājāpatya' iḻādadhaḥ prajāpate na tvadetānyanyaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 2. 14) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— 'apo'bhyavahareyuḥ prajāpate na tvadetānyanyaḥ' 1. ta-bha1.4.7- 'yat...yadvā' nāsti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'teṣāṃ purastātpattaja bhājyāhutīrjuhuyādatha āyuṃṣi pavasa iti tisṛbhiḥ prajāpate na tvadetānyanya iti ca' ( āśva. gṛ. 1. 4. 4 ) iti ||
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvo jātāni pari tā babhūva |
yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvo jātāni pari tā babhūva |
yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
he prajāpate tvat tvatto'nyaḥ kaścit etāni idānīṃ vartamānāni viśvā vidhāni sarvāṇi ||
jātāni prathamavikārabhāñji tā tāni sarvāṇi bhūta- jātāni na pari babhūva na parigṛhnāti |
vayaṃ ca yatkāmāḥ yatphalaṃ kāmayamānāḥ te tubhyaṃ juhumaḥ havīṃṣi prayacchāmaḥ tatphalaṃ naḥ asmākam astu bhavatu |
tathā vayaṃ ca rayīṇāṃ dhanānāṃ patayaḥ īśvarāḥ syāma bhavema ||
' vasuṃ na ' ityaṣṭarcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktaṃ vasiṣṭhaputrasya citramahasa ārṣamāgneyam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—' vasuṃ nāṣṭau citramahasā vāsiṣṭha āgneyaṃ jāgatamāyāṃ pañcamī charte ' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—' vasuṃ na citra- mahasamiti jāgatam ' ( āśva. śrau. 4. 13 ) iti ||
vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithiṃmadriṣeṇyam |
sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnihotāṃ gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam ||
vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithiṃmadriṣeṇyam |
sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnihotāṃ gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam ||
vasuṃ | na | citra | mahasam | gṛṇīṣe | vāmam | śevam | atithim | adriṣeṇyam | saḥ | rāsate | śurudhaḥ | viśvadhāyasaḥ | agniḥ | hotā | gṛhapatiḥ | suvīryam || 1 ||
vasuṃ na vāsakaṃ sūryabhiva citramahasaṃ cāyanīyatejaskamagniṃ gṛṇīṣe guṇe staumi ||
vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ śevaṃ sukhakaram atithim atithivatpūjyaṃ yadvā havirvahanāya satatagāminam adriṣeṇyaṃ dveṣyarahitam ||
saḥ agniḥ śurudhaḥ śokasya rodhayitrīrnivārayitrīḥ viśvadhāyasaḥ kṣīrapradānādinā viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagaddhāra- yantīrgāḥ suvīryaṃ śobhanavīryaṃ ca rāsate yajamānebhyo dadāti ||
' ṇit ' ityanuvṛtteḥ ' āto yukciṇ ' ( pā. sū. 7.3.33 ) iti yuk |
hotā devānāmāhvātā homaniṣpādako vā gṛhapatiḥ yajamānagṛhāṇā-
śobhanaṃ vīryaṃ yasyeti bahuvrīhau ‘vīravīryaṃ ca’ ityuttarapadānudāttatvam ||
juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvān vayunāni sukrato |
ghṛtanirṇigbrahmaṇe gātumeraya tarva devā aṃjanayannanu vratam ||
juṣāṇaḥ | agne | prati | harya | me | varcaḥ | viśvāni | vidvān | vayunāni | sukrato iti su'krato | ghṛta'nirṇig | brahmaṇe | gātum | ā | īraya | tarva | devāḥ | aṃjanayan | anu | vratam ||2||
he agne juṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇastvaṃ me mama vacaḥ vacanaṃ stotraṃ prati harya kāmayasva |
tathā he sukrato śobhanakarman śobhanaprajña vā tvaṃ viśvāni sarvāṇi vayunāni |
he ghṛtanirṇig ghṛtenājyena nirṇijyamāna puṣyamāṇa- śarīra |
dīptarūpāme brahmaṇe brāhmaṇāya yajamānāya gātuṃ gātavyaṃ jñātavyaṃ vā yajñam erya āgamaya |
tava ghṛtaṃ tvadīyaṃ yajñakarma anu paścāt devāḥ indrādayaḥ sarve aṃjanayan |
sapta dhāmāni pariyanmartyo dāśadvāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva |
suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yasta ānaṭ samidhā taṃ jupasva ||
sapta | dhāmāni | pari'yana | amartyaḥ | dāśat | dāśuṣe | su'kṛte | māmahasva | su'vīreṇa | rayiṇā | agne | su'ābhuvā | yaḥ | te | ānaṭ | sam'idhā | tam | jupasva ||3||

he agne sapta saptasaṃkhyākāni dhāmāni sthānāni pṛthivyādilokātmakāni pariyan parito gacchan amartyaḥ maraṇadharmarahitastvaṃ yo yajamānaḥ puroḍāśādīni havīṃṣi dāśat prayacchati tasmai dāśuṣe dattavate sukṛte suṣṭhu yāgaṃ kṛtavate māmahasva |
‘sukarmapāpa’ (pā. sū. 3. 2. 89) ityādinā suparvātkṛjo bhūte kāle kvip ||
yaḥ ca yajamānaḥ samidhā samindhanasādhanenedhamena ha agne te tvām ānaṭ prāpnoti ||
tādṛśena svābhuvā suṣṭhu ā samantādbhuṅguṇā vardhiṣṇunā rayiṇā dhanena dātavyena sārdhaṃ jupasva ||
1. ga-ta4.5-bhara-iha tu | 2. ga-ta-bha- ‘jñātavyaṃ’ nāsti | 3. ga-ta4.5-bhara-carupuroḍā- śādīni | 4. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ma-‘vardhiṣṇunā’ nāsti | 5. ga-ta4.5-bhara-jupasva sevasva |

yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḻate sapta vājinam | śṛṇvantaṃmagniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamukṣaṇaṃ pṛṇantaṃ devaṃ pṛṇate suvīryam || 4 || yajñasya | ketum | prathamam | puraḥ'hitam | haviṣmantaḥ | īḻate | sapta | vājinam | śṛṇvantam | agnim | ghṛtapṛṣṭham | ukṣaṇam | pṛṇantam | devam | pṛṇate | suvīryam || 4 ||
yajñasya yāgasya ketuṃ prajñāpakaṃ prathamaṃ sarveṣu deveṣu mukhyaṃ prathamasthānaṃ vā purohitaṃ purato hitakāriṇam |
‘taddhitaścāsarva- vibhaktiḥ’ (pā. sū. 1. 1. 38) ityavyayasaṃjñāyāṃ ‘puro'vyayam’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 67) iti gatisaṃjñā |

vājinaṃ balavantamaśvavantaṃ vā śṛṇvantam asmatstutīḥ śrotreṇa jānantaṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ dīptapṛṣṭhaṃ dīptāṅgam ukṣaṇaṃ yāgadvāreṇa vṛṣṭeḥ saṃbhaktāraṃ yadvā secanasamarthaṃ yuvānaṃ pṛṇate havirbhiḥ prāṇayitre yajamānāya |
havirbhiḥ prīṇayantaṃ yajamānaṃ pṛṇantaṃ dhanaiḥ prīṇayantam |
havīṃṣi dadate yajamānāya pṛṇantaṃ dhanāni prayacchantam |
suvīryaṃ śobhanavīryopetaṃ devaṃ dyotamānaṃ dānādiguṇayuktaṃ vā evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭam agniṃ haviṣmantaḥ havirbhiryuktāḥ sapta hotṛpramukha vaṣaṭkārtāraḥ īḻate stuvanti |

tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa huyamāno amṛtāya matsava | tvāṃ marjayanra maruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhirbhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ || 5 || tvam | dūtaḥ | prathamaḥ | vareṇyaḥ | saḥ | huyamānaḥ | amṛtāya | matsava | tvām | marjayanra | marutaḥ | dāśuṣaḥ | gṛhe | tvāṃ | stomebhiḥ | bhṛgavaḥ | vi | rurucuḥ ||5||
he agne tvaṃ dūtaḥ devānāṃ dūtakarmaṇi niyuktaḥ prathamaḥ mukhyaḥ prathitaḥ prakhyāto vā vareṇyaḥ saṃbhajanīyaścāsi |
saḥ tvam amṛtāya amaraṇāya tadarthaṃ no'smābhiḥ huyamānaḥ haviṣā tarpyamāṇaṃ vā san matsava tṛpyasva |
api ca tvāṃ madhyamasthāne vaiśvarūpeṇa vartamānaṃ marutaḥ tatratyā devagaṇāḥ marjayanra mārjayanti alaṃkurvanti |
tathā dāśuṣaḥ havīṃṣi dattavato yajamānasya gṛhe stomebhiḥ stomaiḥ stotraiḥ bhṛgavaḥ bhṛgugotrā ṛṣayastvāṃ vi rurucuḥ viśeṣeṇa dīpayanti |
bhṛguśabdāduttarasya taddhitasya ‘atribhṛgukutsa’ (pā. sū. 2.4.65) ityādinā bahuṣu luk |

iṣe duhantasudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato | agne ghṛtasnustrikṛtāni dīrghatitiyaṃ pariyantasukratayase || 6 || iṣam | duhan | sudughām | viśva'dhāyasam | yajña'priye | yajamānāya | sukrato iti sukrato | agne | ghṛta'snuḥ | triḥ | ṛtāni | dīrghat | vṛtiḥ | yajñam | pari'yan | sukratu'ayase ||6||

he sukṛto sukarman śobhanaprajña vā agne yajñapriye yajñairhavirbhirdevān prīṇayitre yajamānāya viśvadhāyasaṃ viśvasya dhārayitrīṃ sudughāṃ dogdhuṃ suśakāṃ yajñarūpiṇīṃ gām iṣam iṣyamāṇaṃ yāgaphalarūpaṃ payaḥ duhan kṣārayan tathā ghṛtasnuḥ ghṛtenājyena prasnātaḥ |
ghṛto dīptaḥ snuḥ sānuḥ samucchrito jvālāsamūho yasya sa tathoktaḥ |
īdṛśastvaṃ triḥ trivāramāvṛttāni ṛtāni satyabhūtāni pṛthivyādīni trīṇi sthānāni |
yadvā gārhapatyādīni sthānāni dīyat dīpayan vartiḥ sarvaṃ yajñagṛhaṃ sarvamanuṣṭhīyamānaṃ yāgaṃ ca pariyan parito gacchan tattadyajñagṛhaṃ taṃ taṃ yajñaṃ ca prāpnuvan sukṛtyase |
sa yathā samyaganuṣṭhāne pravartate evaṃ tvamapi svayameva yāgasya samyagniṣpatyarthaṃ pravartasa ityarthaḥ |
tvāmidupaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ |
tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhurājyamagne nimṛjanto adhvare |
tvām | it | asyāḥ | upasaḥ | vi'uṣṭiṣu | dūtam | kṛṇvānāḥ | ayajanta | mānuṣāḥ | tvām | devāḥ | mahayāyyāya | vāvṛdhuḥ | ājyam | agne | ni'mṛjantaḥ | adhvare || 7 ||
asyāḥ idānīṃ dṛśyamānāyāḥ upasaḥ vyuṣṭiṣu vivāsaneṣu prabhāteṣu satsu he agne tvāmit tvāmeva devānāṃ dūtaṃ kṛṇvānāḥ kurvāṇāḥ mānuṣāḥ manuṣyāḥ ayajanta yajanti |
tathā devāḥ api tvāṃ mahayāyyāya pūjāyai |
kiṃ kurvantaḥ ? adhvare dhvaro hiṃsānimittaḥ pratyavāyaḥ |
ājyopalakṣitaṃ sarvaṃ haviḥ nimṛjantaḥ tvayi nimārjantaḥ |
ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ |
rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ |
ni | tvā | vasiṣṭhāḥ | ahvanta | vājinam | gṛṇantaḥ | agne | vidatheṣu | vedhasaḥ | rāyaḥ | poṣam | yajamāneṣu | dhāraya | yūyam | pāta | svastibhiḥ | sadā | naḥ || 8 ||
he agne vidatheṣu vidantyasmin yaṣṭavyāna devāniti vidatho yajñaḥ |
teṣu vedhasaḥ karmaṇāṃ vidhātāraḥ gṛṇantaḥ stuvantaḥ vasiṣṭhāḥ vasiṣṭhaputrā ṛṣayaḥ vājinam annavantaṃ balavantaṃ vā tvāṃ ni ahvanta nitarāmāhvayan |
sa tvaṃ yajamāneṣu asmāsu rāyaḥ dhanasya poṣaṃ puṣṭiṃ dhāraya avasthāpaya |
‘ayaṃ venaḥ’ ityṛcamekādaśaṃ sūktaṃ bhārgavasya venasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubham |
tathā cānu- kāntam—‘ayaṃ veno vainyam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ṛkte drapsasyāyaṃ venaścodayatpṛśmigarbhāḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti |

ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśmigarbhā jyotirjarāyu rajaso vimānai | imapāṃ sa~game sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhīṃ rihanti || 1 || ayam | venaḥ | codayat | pṛśmi'garbhāḥ | jyotiḥ'jarāyuḥ | rajasaḥ | vi'mānai | imam | apām | sam'game | sūryasya | śiśum | na | viprāḥ | mati'bhiḥ | rihanti ||1||
udakasya nirmāyante'ntarikṣe sthitaḥ san ayaṃ venaḥ pṛśmigarbhāḥ |
pṛśmayaḥ saso'jjvalavarṇāḥ sūrya raśmayaḥ teṣāṃ garbhabhūtā antarikṣasthā apaḥ codayan |
apām udakānāmāntarikṣāṇāṃ sūryasya ca saṃgame saṃgamane'ntarikṣe sthitam imaṃ venaṃ viprāḥ medhāvinaḥ stotāraḥ matibhiḥ stutibhiḥ rihanti |
yathā bālaṃ putraṃ mātāpitrādyā bāndhavāḥ stutipaderupalālayanti tadvat ||
sūyate hi—‘samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajigāti’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti ||

samudrādūrmimudiyarti veno nabhojāḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ haryatasya darśi | ṛtasya sānāvadhi viṣṭapi āṭ samānaṃ yonirmabhyanūpata trāḥ || 2 || samudrāt | ūrmim | ut | iyarti | venaḥ | nabhaḥ'jāḥ | pṛṣṭham | haryatasya | darśi | ṛtasya | sānau | adhi | viṣṭapi | āṭ | samānam | yonim | abhi | anuṣata | trāḥ ||2||

samudravantyasmādāpa iti samudramantarikṣam | tasmāt ūrmi jalasamūham ayaṃ venaḥ udiyarti udgamayati | ardhaḥ pātayatītyarthaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ | nabhojāḥ | nabhasyākāśe - - - | imaṃ venamabhi śabdayante || ‘nu stutau’ | kuṭādiḥ | chāndaso luk ||

samānaṃ pūrvīrabhi vāvaśānāstiṣṭhan vṛtsasya mātaraḥ sanīḻāḥ | ṛtasya sānau adhi cakramāṇā rihanti madhvo amṛtasya vāṇīḥ || 3 || samānam | pūrvīḥ | abhi | vāvaśānāḥ | tiṣṭhan | vṛtsasya | mātaraḥ | sa'nīḻāḥ | ṛtasya | sānau | adhi | cakramāṇāḥ | rihanti | madhvaḥ | amṛtasya | vāṇīḥ || 3 ||
^pūrvā: bahvya: ^samānaṃ venasyātmanaśca sādhāraṇaṃ sthānaṃ prāpya ^abhi ^vāvaśānā: abhita: śabdayamānā: |
^vatsasya vatsasthānīyasya vaidyutāgne: ^mātara: mātṛbhūtā: ^sanīḻā: samānanilayā evaṃvidhā āntarikṣā āpa: ^tiṣṭhan tiṣṭhanti |
api ca ^ṛtasya udakasya ^sānāvidhi sānau^ samucchrite'ntarikṣasthāne ^cakramāṇā: pravartamānā: ^madhva: madhurasya ^amṛtasya udakasya ^vāṇī: vācya: śabdā: ^rihanti imaṃ venamarcanti |
jñānanto rūpamaṃkṛpanta vipro mṛgasya ghoṣaṃ mahiṣasya hi gmana |
ṛtena yanto adhi sindhusthavirdṛndharvo amṛtāni nāma ||
jñānantaḥ | rūpam | akṛpanta | viprā: | mṛgasya | ghoṣam | mahiṣasya | hi | gmana | ṛtena | yantaḥ | adhi | sindhum | asthu: | vidat | gandharva: | amṛtāni | nāma || 4 ||
mahatāṃ venasya ^ghoṣaṃ garjitalakṣaṇaṃ meghasthaṃ śabdaṃ ^hi yasmāt ^gmana abhigacchanti atastadīyaṃ rūpaṃ jānantītyartha: |
gameśchāndase laṅi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo luk |
api ca ^ṛtena satyabhūtena stotreṇa yajñena vā ^yantaḥ taṃ venaṃ gacchantaḥ prāpnuvanto janā: ^sindhuṃ syandanaśīlaṃ jalasamūham ^adhi ^asthu: adhitiṣṭhanti |
tatra kiṃ kāraṇamiti cet yato'yaṃ ^gandharva: gavāmudakānāṃ dhartā vena: ^amṛtāni amaraṇahetubhūtāni ^nāma |
apsarā jāramupasiṣmiyāṇā yoṣā bibharti parame vyoman |
caratpriyasya yoniṣu priya: sansīdatpakṣe hiraṇyaye sa vena: ||
apsarā: | jāram | upa'siṣmiyāṇā | yoṣā | bibharti | parame | vi'oman | carat | priyasya | yoniṣu | priya: | san | sīdat | pakṣe | hiraṇyaye | sa: | vena: || 5 ||
^apsarā: apāṃ sārathiyapsu krīḍārthaṃ sarantī vā ^upasiṣmiyāṇā kāntasamīpamupagamye- baddhasantī |
yathā kācitpavatī yoṣijāramupagamyedhaddhasantī taṃ nirjane sthale puṣṇāti tadvadanena venena vidyudramata ityartha: |
^sa: ca ^vena: ^priya: asyā anukūlatama: ^san ^hiraṇyaye hiraṇmaye hiraṇmayavajrasvare hitaramaṇīyarūpe vā ^pakṣe ātmana: pakṣabhūte meghe ^sīdat sīdati |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘nāke suparṇamupa yatpatantamiti samāpta praṇavenopaviśet’ (āśva. śrau. 4. 7) iti |

nāke supaṇa̭mu॒pa yatpata̭ntaṃ hṛdā vena̭nto abhya̭cakṣata tvā | hira̭ṇyapakṣaṃ varṷṇasya dū॒taṃ yama̭sya yo॒nau śakṷnaṃ bhura॒ṇyam || 6 || nāke | su'parṇam | upa | yat | patantam | hṛdā | venantaḥ | abhi | acakṣata | tvā | hiraṇya'pakṣam | varuṇasya | dūtam | yamasya | yonau | śakunam | bhuraṇyam || 6 ||
he vena tvā tvāṃ hṛdā hṛdayena manasā venantaḥ kāmayamānāḥ stotāraḥ nāke antarikṣe yat yadā abhyacakṣata abhipaśyanti tadānīṃ tvam upa āgacchasīti śeṣaḥ |

suparṇaṃ śobhanapatanaṃ patantam antarikṣe gacchantaṃ hiraṇyapakṣaṃ hiraṇmayābhyāṃ pakṣābhyāmupetaṃ varuṇasya jalābhimānino devasya dūtaṃ cāraṃ yamasya niyāmakasya vaivasvatāgre yonau sthāne'ntarikṣe śakunaṃ pakṣirūpeṇa vartamānaṃ bhuraṇyaṃ bhartāram |

ū॒rdhvo ga̭ndha॒rvo adhi॒ nākḙ asthā॒tpratya̭ṅ citrā bibhra̭dasyāyṷdhāni | vasā̭no a॒tkaṃ su॒rabhiṃ dṛ॒śe kaṃ sva॒rṇaṃ nāma̭ janata pri॒yāṇi̭ || 7 || ūrdhvaḥ | gandharvaḥ | adhi | nāke | asthāt | pratyaṅ | citrā | bibhrat | asya | āyudhāni | vasānaḥ | atkam | surabhim | dṛśe | kam | svaḥ | na | nāma | janata | priyāṇi || 7 ||
ūrdhvaḥ uparideśe vartamānaḥ gandharvaḥ gavāmudakānāṃ dhartā ||
gavi gan dhṛjo vaḥ iti gośabdopapadāt dhṛñ dhāraṇe ityasmādvapratyaya upapadasya ganbhāvaśca ||
īdṛśo venaḥ pratyaṅ asma- pratyaṅmukhaḥ san nāke adhi antarikṣe asthāt tiṣṭhati |
asya ātmanaḥ svabhūtāni citrā citrāṇi cāyanīyānyāścaryabhūtāni vā āyudhāni bibhrat dhārayan ||
tathā surabhiṃ śobhanam atkam āramīyaṃ vyāsaṃ rūpaṃ vasānaḥ sarvatrācchādayan |
dṛśe viśve ca iti kepratyayānto nipātyate ||
sa yathātmīyaṃ rūpaṃ darśanāya sarvatrācchādayati tadvat |
tadanantaraṃ nāma nāmāni namanaśīlāgyudakāni priyāṇi sarveṣāmanukūlāni janata janayati |

pravagyai'bhiṣṭuve drapsaḥ samudram ityeṣā | sūtritaṃ ca— drapsaḥ samudramabhi yajigāti sakhe sakhāyamabhyā vavṛtasva ( ādha. śrau. 4. 7 ) iti || drapsaḥ sa̭mu॒drama॒bhi ya̭jigāti paśya̭n gṛdhra̭sya cakṣa̭sā vi॒dharma̭n | bhānuḥ śu॒kreṇa॒ śoci̭ṣā ca॒kāna॒stṛtī̭ye ca॒kre ra॒jasi pri॒yāṇi̭ || 8 || drapsaḥ | samudram | abhi | yat | jigāti | paśyan | gṛdhrasya | cakṣasā | vi'dharman | bhānuḥ | śukreṇa | śociṣā | cakānaḥ | tṛtīye | cakre | rajasi | priyāṇi || 8 ||
vidharman vidharmaṇi vidhāreke ᐁntarikṣe sthitaḥ ᐁdrapsaḥ dravaṇaśīlaḥ |

ᐁgṛdhasya gṛdho rasānabhikāṅkṣataḥ sūryasya ᐁcakṣasā tejasā ᐁpaśyan prakāśamāno venaḥ ᐁyat yadā ᐁsamudraṃ samundanaśīlaṃ megham ᐁabhi ᐁjigāti abhigacchati tadānīṃ ᐁbhānuḥ sūryaḥ ᐁśukena śubhreṇa ᐁśociṣā tejasā ᐁtṛtīyye ᐁrajasi loke ᐁcakānaḥ dīpyamānaḥ ᐁpriyāṇi sarveṣāmabhīṣṭānyukāni ᐁcakre karoti |
‘imaṃ no agne’ iti navarcaṃ dvādaśaṃ sūktam |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘imaṃ no navainnyuttamā nihatro'bhivaruṇasomānāmādyāmeyī tisra- ścāmerāmastavaḥ śiṣṭā yathānipātaṃ saptamī jagatī’ iti |
imaṃ nau agne upa yajmahei pañcayāmaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantum |
asau hanyavāḻuta naḥ purogā jyo geva dīrghaṃ tama āśayiṣṭhāḥ |
imam | naḥ | agne | upa | yajmahei | ā | ihi | pañcayāmam | trivṛtam | saptatantum | asau | hanyavāṭ | uta | naḥ | puraḥ'gāḥ | jyok | eva | dīrgham | tamaḥ | ā | āśayiṣṭhāḥ || 1 ||
ātṛṣu havirvahaneṣu mṛteṣu maraṇabhītyā kṛtapalāyanaṃ guhāyāṃ nigūḍhamagnimabhyādhāḥ |
he ᐁagne ᐁnaḥ asmākam ᐁimaṃ ᐁyajñam ᐁupa ᐁehi upāgaccha |
dhānākarambhādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ havirbhiḥ pañcabhiḥ prayājairvā prāptam |
ᐁtrivṛtaṃ pākayajñahaviryajñasomayajñabhedena savanatrayātmanā vā triguṇaṃ ᐁsaptatantuṃ sasa tantavastanitāraḥ karmaṇāṃ vistārayitāro hotrādyāḥ sasa vaṣaṭkartāro yasya |
agniṣṭomo'syagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ polakṣī vājapeyo'tirātro'soyāṃha iti saptadhā vistīryamāṇam |
īdṛśaṃ yajñamupagatya cānantaraṃ ᐁnaḥ asmākaṃ ᐁhavyavāṭ havyānāṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhā ᐁasaḥ bhava |
ᐁuta api ca ᐁnaḥ asmākaṃ ᐁpurogāḥ purato gantā bhava |
ᐁjyok cirakālam ᐁeva asmān parityajya ᐁdīrghaṃ ᐁtamaḥ mahadandhakāraṃ guhāyām ᐁāśayiṣṭhāḥ |
adaivāhevaḥ pracetā guhā yan prapaśyamāno amṛtatvamemi |
adaivāt | devaḥ | ᐁpracetāḥ | guhā | yan | ᐁprapaśyamānaḥ | ᐁamṛtatvam | emi | śivam | yat | santam | aśivaḥ | jarhāmi | svāt | sukhyāt | araṇīm | nābhim | emi || 2 ||
ᐁpracetā devānāṃ prayācanena hetunā ᐁyan nirgacchan ᐁdevaḥ devanaśīlo'haṃ ᐁprapaśyamānaḥ devairmadarthaṃ kalpitaṃ prayājānuyājādilakṣaṇaṃ havirbhāgaṃ prapaśyamāno nirīkṣamāṇaḥ san ᐁamṛtatvamemi |
nigūḍha: punardaivairvirvahanāya prārthyamānastadaitena haviṣā ahaṃ devatvaṃ prāptavānasmītyarthaḥ |

yadyapyahaṃ guhāto nirgatya prakāśamānaḥ san śobhanaṃ yajñaṃ nivartayāmi tathāpi aśivaṃ śobhanaṃ santaṃ bhavantaṃ yajñam aśivaḥ aśobhanarūpo'prakāśamānaḥ san yat yasmin samāsākāle jahāmi parityajāmi tadānīṃ nābhi nahanaśīlāṃ bandhanaśīlām araṇīm aśvathameva svātsvasyāt ātmīyāt sakhitvāccira- kālamaśvarūpo'haṃ tatra nyavātsamiti snehavaśāt emi prāpnomi |
paryanyasyā atithiṃ vayāyāṃ ṛtasya dhāma vi mime puruṇi |
paryanyaḥ | anyasyāḥ | atithim | vayāyāḥ | ṛtasya | dhāma | vi | mime | puruṇi | śaṃsāmi | pitre | asurāya | śevam | ayajñiyāt | yajñiyam | bhāgam | emi || 3 ||

mama sthānabhūtā yā pṛthivī tataḥ anyasyāḥ vayāyāḥ gantavyāyāḥ divaḥ saṃbandhanam atithiṃ satataṃ gāminaṃ sūryaṃ paśyan jānan sūryasya gatimanusṛtya vasantādikāle ṛtasya yajñasya dhāma dhāmāni śarīrāṇi puruṇi bahūni vi mime nirmime niṣpādayāmi |
tataḥ pitre pitṛ- bhūtāya dyulokavartine devajanāya asurāya śatrukṣepaṇakuśalāya śevaṃ sukhamuddiśya hotā bhūtvā ahaṃ ukthāni śaṃsāmi |
yata evaṃ tasmātkāraṇāt ayajñiyāt yajñārhapradeśācchirgatya yajñiyaṃ yajñārhaṃ vedilakṣaṇaṃ bhūbhāgaṃ havilakṣaṇaṃ vā emi prāpnomi |
yajñaśabdadādarthye 'yajñvigbhyāṃ ghañjau' ( pā. sū. 5. 1. 71 ) iti ghapratyayaḥ |
bahī: samā akaramantaresminnindraṃ vṛṇānaḥ pitaraṃ jahāmi |
agniḥ somo varuṇaste cyavante paryāvardvāṣṭaṃ tadavāmyāyan ||
bahīḥ | samāḥ | akaram | antaḥ | asmin | indram | vṛṇānaḥ | pitaram | jahāmi | agniḥ | somaḥ | varuṇaḥ | te | cyavante | pari'ārvat | rāṣṭram | tat | avāmi | ā'ayan ||4||
asmin vedilakṣaṇasthāne bahīḥ samāḥ bahūn saṃvatsarān akaram akārpam |
tatra indraṃ vṛṇānaḥ saṃbhajamānaḥ pitaram utpādakamaraṇyātmakaṃ jahāmi parityajāmi |
yadā tvahaṃ devebhyo nirgatya guhāyāṃ nigūḍhaḥ tadā te devāḥ agniḥ somo varuṇaḥ ca cyavante |
āyana punarāgacchamahaṃ yadrāṣṭramasurairapahṛtaṃ paryāvart paryāvartamānaṃ madabhimukhaṃ punarāvartamānaṃ tat rāṣṭraṃ rājyaṃ yajñabhūmim avāmi asurebhyo rakṣāmi |
upasṛṣṭādvṛtteḥ 'anyebhyo'pi dṛśyante' ( pā. sū. 3. 2. 75 ) iti vic |
'rātsyasya' ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 24 ) iti niyamāt 'saṃyogāmtasya' ( pā. sū. 8. 2. 23 ) iti lopābhāvaḥ |
nirmāyā ''tye asurā abhūvan tvaṃ ca mā varuṇa kāmayāse |
ni:'māyā:| oṃ iti| tye| asurā:| abhūvan| tvam| ca| mā| varuṇa| kāmayāse| ṛtena| rājana| anṛtam| vi'viśvan| mama| rāṣṭrasya| adhi'patyam| ā| ihi ||5||
āsurya: sarvā māyā mayā dagdhā āsannityartha:|
anena yuktatvāt kāmayāse iti tiṅ‌vibhakte: ‘nipātairyadyadihanta’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 30) iti nighātāpratiṣedha:||

he varuṇa tvaṃ cet 7mā 7kāmayāse tarhi he 7rājana īśvara 7ṛtena satyenāsmadīyena karmaṇā 7anṛtam asatyabhūtaṃ māyāmayamasuraṃ caritraṃ 7vividhan pṛthakurvan apasārayan 7mama 7rāṣṭrasya mayā yatsādhitaṃ rājyaṃ tasya 7adhipatyam adhipatitvamīśvaratvam 7gṛhi prāmuhi ||
hanāṃva vutraṃ nirehiṃ soma haviṣṭā sante haviṣā yajāma ||
idam| sva:| idam| it| āsa| vāmam| ayam| pra'kāśa:| uru| antarikṣam| hanāṃva| vutram| ni:'ehiṃ| soma| havi:| tvā| mantam| haviṣā| yajāma || 6 ||
he soma 7idaṃ 7sva: ayaṃ dyuloka: yadvāyaṃ śobhanāruṇa: sūrya: 7idamin idameva 7vāmaṃ vananīyam 7āsa babhūva|
7ayaṃ ca 7prakāśa: prakāśasyādhārabhūta: 7uru vistīrṇamidam 7antarikṣaṃ he soma etasveva paśya|
7havi: 7santaṃ latārūpeṇa havirbhavantaṃ devatātmānaṃ tvāṃ 7haviṣā carupuroḍāśādinā vayaṃ 7yajāma ||
kavi: kavitvā divi rūpamāsaṃjadaprabhūtī varuṇo nirapa: sṛjat|
kṣemaṃ kṛṇvānā janayo na sindhvastā asya varṇaṃ śurcayo bharibhrati ||
kavi:| kavitvā| divi| rūpam| ā| asaṃjat| apra'bhūtī| varuṇa:| ni:| apa:| sṛjat| kṣemam| kṛṇvānā:| janaya:| na| sindhva:| tā:| asya| varṇam| śurcaya:| bharibhrati || 7 ||
krāntadarśanena 7divi dyuloke 7rūpam ātmīyaṃ teja: 7āsaṃjat āsaktaṃ karoti||

varuṇana visṛṣṭāstā āpa: 7sindhava: syandanaśīlā nadyo bhūtvā 7janayo 7na jāyā iva yathā jāyā: patyu: kṣemakāriṇyo bhavanti tathā 7kṣemaṃ kurvāṇā jagato rakṣaṇaṃ kurvāṇā: 7śucaya: śuddhā dīpyamānā vā 7asya varuṇasya 7varṇaṃ śuklaṃ bhāsvararūpaṃ 7bharibhrati|

tā asya jyeṣṭhamindriyaṃ saṃcante tā īmā kṣeti svadhayā madantīḥ | tā ī viśo na rājānaṃ vṛṇānā bībhatsuvo arpa vṛtrādatiṣṭhan || 8 || tāḥ | asya | jyeṣṭham | indriyam | saṃcante | tāḥ | īm | ā | kṣeti | svadhayā | madantīḥ | tāḥ | īm | viśaḥ | na | rājānam | vṛṇānāḥ | bībhatsuvaḥ | arpa | vṛtrāt | atiṣṭhan ||8||
ᵥtāḥ pūrvoktā vṛṣṭā āpaḥ ᵥasya varuṇasya ᵥjyeṣṭhaṃ vṛddhatamam ᵥindriyaṃ vīryaṃ ᵥsaṃcante samavayanti saṃbhajante |
'āpāṃ varuṇasya patnaya āsan' (tai. saṃ. 5.5.4.1) iti śruteḥ |
ᵥtāḥ apaḥ ᵥīm ayaṃ varuṇaḥ ᵥā kṣeti abhigacchati |
ᵥtāḥ ca ᵥīm enaṃ varuṇa ᵥviśo ᵥna viśaḥ prajā yathā ᵥrājānaṃ svāminaṃ saṃbhajante tathā ᵥvṛṇānāḥ saṃbhajamānāḥ ᵥbībhatsuvaḥ bhayena kampamānāḥ |
tasmin hate sati tasmāt ᵥvṛtrāt ᵥapa ᵥatiṣṭhan |
'badha bandhane' ityasmād dhātoḥ 'māntrabhradānśāntyaḥ' (pā. sū. 3.1.6) iti san abhyāsasya ca dīrghaḥ |

bībhatsūnāṃ sayujaṃ haṃsamāhurpāṃ divyānāṃ sukhye carantam | anuṣṭubhamanu carcyamāṇamindraṃ ni cikyuḥ kavayo manīṣā || 9 || bībhatsūnām | sayujam | haṃsam | āhuḥ | apām | divyānām | sukhye | carantam | anuṣṭubham | anu | carcyamāṇam | indram | ni | cikyuḥ | kavayaḥ | manīṣā || 9 ||
ᵥdivyānāṃ divi bhavānāmāntarikṣāṇām ᵥapām ᵥsakhye sakhitve ᵥcarantaṃ vartamānam |
evaṃ guṇaviśiṣṭam ᵥindraṃ ᵥkavayaḥ krāntadarśina ṛṣayaḥ ᵥmanīṣā manīṣayā stutyā ᵥni ᵥcikyuḥ pūjayanti |
'cāya pūjāniśāmanayoḥ' ityasmācchāndase liṭi 'cāyaḥ kī' (pā. sū. 6.1.35) iti prakṛteḥ kībhāvaḥ |
tena hopā tādātmyamanubhavantī sarvajagadrūpeṇa sarvasyādhiṣṭhānatvena cāhameva sarvaṃ bhavāmīti svātmānaṃ stauti |
tathā cānukāntam—'ahamaṣṭau vāgāmbhṛṇī sutātmānaṃ dvitīyā jagatya' iti |

ahaṃ rudrebhirvasubhiścarāmyahaṃ vādibhyaruta viśvadevaiḥ | ahaṃ mitrāvaruṇābhā bibharmyahamindrāgnī ahamaśvinobhā || 1 || aham | rudrebhiḥ | vasu'bhiḥ | carāmi | aham | ādityaiḥ | uta | viśva'devaiḥ | aham | mitrāvaruṇā | ubhā | bibharmi | aham | indrāgnī iti | aham | aśvinau | ubhā || 1 ||
▼ahaṃ sūktasya draṣṭrī vāgāmbhṛṇī yadbrahma jagatkāraṇaṃ tadrūpā bhavantī ▼rudrebhiḥ rudrairekādaśabhiḥ |
mayi hi sarvaṃ jagacchuklau rajatamivādhyastaṃ sadrūpyate |
tādṛśyā māyayā ādhāratvenāsaṅgasyāpi brahmaṇa uktasya sarvasyotpattiḥ ||

ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye' yajamānāya sunvate || 2 || aham | somam | āhanasam | bibharmi | aham | tvaṣṭāram | uta | pūṣaṇam | bhagam | aham | dadhāmi | draviṇam | haviṣmate | su'prāvye | yajamānāya | sunvate || 2 ||
▼āhanasam āhantavyamabhipotavyaṃ ▼somaṃ yadvā śatrūṇāmāhantāraṃ divi vartamānaṃ devatātmānaṃ somam ▼aham eva bibharmi |
tathā ▼tvaṣṭāram uta api ca ▼pūṣaṇaṃ bhagaṃ ca ▼aham eva bibharmi |
tathā ▼haviṣmate havirbhiryakāya ▼suprāvye śobhanaṃ havirdevānāṃ prāpayitre tarpayitre ||
caturthyekavacane yaṇi 'udāttasvari- tayoryaṇaḥ svarito'nudāttasya' iti supaḥ svaritatvam ||
etacca brahmaṇaḥ phaladātṛtvaṃ 'phalamata upapatteḥ' (ve. sū. 3. 2. 38) ityadhi- karaṇe bhagavatā bhāṣyakāreṇa samarthitam ||

ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām | tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm || 3 || aham | rāṣṭrī | sam'gamanī | vasūnām | cikituṣī | prathamā | yajñiyānām | tām | mā | devāḥ | vi | adadhuḥ | puru'trā | bhūri'sthātrām | bhūri | āveśayantīm ||3||
▼cikituṣī yatsākṣātkartavyaṃ paraṃ brahma tajjñātavatī svāmatayā 1. ta 4. 5-yojyaṃ |
bhata eva yaścimānāṃ yajñānāṃ prathamā mukhyā|

yā evaṃguṇaviśiṣṭāṃ tāṃ māṃ bhūristhātrāṃ bahubhāvena prapañcātmanāvatiṣṭhamānāṃ bhūri bhūriṇi bahuni bhūtajātāni āveśayantī jīva- bhāvenātmānaṃ praveśayantīmīdṛśīṃ māṃ puhatrā bahuṣu deśeṣu vyadadhuḥ devāḥ vidadhati kurvanti|
mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam |
amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi ||
mayā | saḥ | annam | atti | yaḥ | vi'paśyati | yaḥ | prāṇiti | yaḥ | īm | śṛṇoti | uktam | amantavaḥ | mām | te | upa | kṣiyanti | śrudhi | śruta | śraddhivam | te | vadāmi || 4 ||
yaḥ annamatti saḥ bhoktṛśaktirūpayā mayā evānnamatti|
yaḥ ca prāṇiti śvāsocchvāsarūpaṃ vyāpāraṃ karoti so'pi mayaiva|
ya īdṛśīmantaryāmirūpeṇa sthitāṃ māṃ na jānanti te amantavaḥ amanyamānā ajānantaḥ upa kṣiyanti|
śradantaroupasargavadvṛttirityate ( pā.sū. 1. 4.57.2 ) iti śracchabdasyopasargavadvartamānatvāt ‘upasarge ghoḥ kiḥ ’ iti kipratyayaḥ |
īdṛśaṃ brahmātmakaṃ vastu te tubhyaṃ vadāmi upadiśāmi ||
ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ |
yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām ||
aham | eva | svayam | idam | vadāmi | juṣṭam | devebhiḥ | uta | mānuṣebhiḥ | yam | kāmaye | tam | tam | ugram | kṛṇomi | tam | brahmāṇam | tam | ṛṣim | tam | sumedhām ||5||
ahaṃ svayam eva idaṃ vastu brahmātmakaṃ vadāmi upadiśāmi |
uta api ca mānuṣebhiḥ manuṣyairapi juṣṭam |
īdṛgavasvātmikāhaṃ yaṃ kāmaye yaṃ puruṣaṃ rakṣitumahaṃ vāñchāmi taṃtaṃ puruṣam ugraṃ kṛṇomi |
tam eva sumedhāṃ śobhanaprajñaṃ ca karomi ||
ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u |
ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa ||
aham | rudrāya | dhanuḥ | ā | tanomi | brahma'dviṣe | śarave | hantavai | ū~ iti | aham | janāya | sam'adam | kṛṇomi | aham | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | ā | viveśa || 6 ||
mahādevasya ᵥdhanuḥ cāpam ᵥaham ᵥā ᵥtanomi |
ᵥbrahmadviṣe brāhmaṇānāṃ dveṣṭāraṃ ᵥśarave bāhaṃ hiṃsakaṃ tripura- nivāsinamasuraṃ ᵥhantavai hantuṃ hiṃsitum ||
stotṛ- janāthaṃ śatrubhiḥ saha saṃgrāmamahameva ᵥkṛṇomi karomi |
tathā ᵥdyāvāpṛthivī divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāntaryāmitayā ᵥaham eva ᵥā ᵥviveśa praviṣṭavatī ||

ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhan‌mam yonir‌apsu ᵥntaḥ samudre | tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi || 7|| aham | suve | pitaram | asya | mūrdhan‌ | marma | yoniḥ | ap'su | antariti | samudre | tataḥ | vi | tiṣṭhe | bhuvanā | anu | viśvā | uta | amūm | dyām | varṣmaṇā | upa | spṛśāmi ||7||
‘dyauḥ 1 pitā’ (tai. brā. 2.7.5.4) iti śruteḥ pitā dyauḥ |
ᵥpitaraṃ divam ᵥahaṃ ᵥsuve prasuve janayāmi |
kāraṇabhūte tasmin hi viyādādikāryajātaṃ sarvaṃ vartate tantuṣu paṭa iva |
tasmin ᵥapsu vyāpan‌śīlāsu dhīvṛttiṣu ᵥantaḥ madhye yad‌brahma caitanyaṃ tanmama kāraṇamityarthaḥ |
yata iṃdambhūtā ahamasmi ᵥtataḥ hetoḥ ᵥviśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni ᵥanu praviśya ᵥvi ᵥtiṣṭhe |
ᵥuta api ca ᵥamūṃ ᵥdyāṃ viprakṛṣṭadeśe'vasthitaṃ svargalokam |
etadupalakṣitaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vikārajātaṃ ᵥvarṣmaṇā kāraṇabhūtena māyātmakena madīyena dehena ᵥupa ᵥspṛśāmi |
asya bhūlokasya3 mūrdhan‌ mūrdhanyuparyahaṃ pitaramākāśaṃ suve |
samudre jaladhāvapsūdakeṣvantarmadhye mama yoniḥ kāraṇabhūto'mbhunākhya ṛṣivartate |
samudre'ntarikṣe'psvammayeṣu devaśarīreṣu mama kāraṇabhūtaṃ brahma caitanyaṃ vartate |
tato'haṃ kāraṇatmikā satī sarvāṇi bhuvanāni vyāpnomi |

ahameva vāta̭iva pra vāmyāra̭bhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā | puro divā pura enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ ba̭bhūva || 8|| aham | eva | vātaḥ'iva | pra | vāmi | ā'rabhamāṇā | bhuvanāni | viśvā | puraḥ | divā | puraḥ | enā | pṛthivyā | etāvatī | mahinā | sam | babhūva || 8||
ᵥviśvā viśvāni ᵥbhuvanāni bhūtajātāni kāryāṇi ᵥārabhamāṇā kāraṇarūpeṇotpā- dayantī ᵥahameva pareṇānadhiṣṭhitā svayameva ᵥpra ᵥvāmi pravarteṃ |
ᵥvātaiva yathā vātaḥ pareṇāpreritaḥ san svecchayaiva pravāti tadvat |
para iti sakārāntaṃ parastādityarthe vartate yathā adha ityadhastādarthe |
etadupalakṣitāt sarvasmāt vikārajātāt parasnādūrttamānā sañjodāsīnakūṭasthabrahmacaitanyarūpāṃha ^mahinā mahimnā ^etāvatī ^saṃ ^babhūva|
‘na tam’ ityaṣṭarcaṃ sūktaṃ śilūpaputrasya kulamalabarhiṣasyārṣa vāmadevaputrasyāhomuḍnāmno vā|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘na taṃ śelūpaḥ^2 kulamala- barhiṣo^3 vāmadevyo vāhomugvaiśvadevamupariṣṭādhaṃtamanyā triṣṭup’ iti|

na ta̭ṃho na dṷritaṃ de॒vāso aṣṭa॒ martya̭m| sajo̭ṣaso yama̭rya॒mā mi॒tro narya̭nti varṷṇo a॒ti dvi॒paḥ || 1 || na | tam | aṃhaḥ | na | duḥ'itam | devāsaḥ | aṣṭa | martyam | sajopasaḥ | yam | aryamā | mitraḥ | naryanti | varuṇaḥ | ati | dviṣaḥ || 1 ||
^taṃ ^martyaṃ manuṣyam ^aṃhaḥ pāpaṃ ^duritaṃ tatphalarūpaṃ durgamanaṃ ca ^na ^aṣṭa na prāpnoti ||
aśeṣchāndase luṅi ‘jhalo jhali’ iti sicco lopaḥ|
arīñjicchantīti ^aryamā pramītenyāyako devaḥ ^mitraḥ pāvānāṃ nivārayitā devaḥ ^varuṇaḥ |
ete trayo devāḥ ^sajopasaḥ saṃgatāḥ samānaṃ prīyamāṇā vā bhavantaḥ ^dvipaḥ dveṣṭṛn śatrūnatikramya ^yaṃ stotāraṃ ^nayanti abhimataṃ deśaṃ prāpayanti taṃ nāṣṭetyanvayaḥ ||

tadvi va॒yaṃ vṛ̭ṇīmahe varṷṇaṃ mi॒trārtha̭man | yenā̭ ni॒raha̭so yu॒yaṃ pātha̭ ne॒thā ca ma̭rtya॒mati̭ dvi॒paḥ || 2 || tat | hi | vayam | vṛṇīmahe | varuṇam | mitram | aryamanam | yena | niḥ | aṃhasaḥ | yuyam | pātha | netha | ca | martyam | ati | dviṣaḥ || 2 ||
‘satiśiṣṭo'pi vikaraṇasya svaro lasārvadhātukasvaraṃ na bādhate’ (pā. ma. 6. 1. 156. 11) iti vacanāttiṅa eva svaraḥ śiṣyate |
he varuṇa he mitra he aryamana ^yena rakṣaṇena ^martyaṃ stotāram ^aṃhasaḥ pāpāt ^yūyaṃ ^niḥ ^pātha niḥśeṣeṇa rakṣatha ||
yena ca’ rakṣaṇena martyaṃ manuṣyaṃ stotāraṃ ^dvipaḥ ^ati ^netha atītya nayatha abhīṣṭaṃ prāpayatha tadvṛṇīmaha ityanvayaḥ ||
1. ta1.2.6.7-bhara-enādeśaḥ| supāṃ sulugite tṛtīyāyā ajādeśaḥ| 2. ta4.5-bhūtajātāt| 3. ta7-anu-śailūṣiḥ| 4. anu-kulamula| 5. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha- ‘ca’ nāsti| kra. 4-49

te nūnaṃ no'yamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā | nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇyati dviṣaḥ || 3 || te | nūnam | naḥ | ayam | ūtaye | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | nayiṣṭhāḥ | ū~ iti | naḥ | neṣāṇi | parṣiṣṭhāḥ | ū~ iti | naḥ | parṣaṇi | ati | dviṣaḥ ||3|| vayaṃ vvaruṇo vmitraḥ ca varyamā ca devāḥ vnaḥ asmākam vūtaye rakṣaṇāya vnūnam avaśyaṃ bhavantu | vneṣāṇi netavye viṣaye he varuṇodayaḥ yūyaṃ vnaḥ asmān vnayiṣṭhāḥ nayata || vacanavyatyayaḥ | yadvā | pratyekaḥbhiprāyeṇaikavacanam | chāndaso luṅ || uśabdaḥ samuccaye padapūraṇārtho vā | vparṣaṇi pārayitavye viṣaye vnaḥ asmān vdvipaḥ vati vparṣiṣṭhāḥ atipārayatha || nayiṣṭhā itivatprakriyā ||

yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pariṃ pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā | yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo'ti dviṣaḥ || 4 || yūyam | viśvam | pāri | pātha | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | yuṣmākam | śarmaṇi | priye | syāma | su'praṇītayaḥ | ati | dviṣaḥ || 4 || ha devā varuṇodayaḥ vyūyaṃ vviśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagat vpari vpātha parito rakṣatha | he vsupraṇītayaḥ śobhanapraṇayanā mitrādayaḥ vyuṣmākaṃ yuṣmadīye yuṣmābhirdatte vpriye anukūle vedye vśarmaṇi sukhe dharyaṃ vsyāma bhavema | vdvipaḥ dveṣṭra vati krāmema ||

ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā | ugraṃ marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendramagniṃ svastaye'ti dviṣaḥ || 5 || ādityāsaḥ | ati | sridhaḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | ugram | marudbhiḥ | rudram | huvema | indram | agnim | svastaye | ati | dviṣaḥ || 5 || vādityāmāḥ aditaḥ putrā varuṇadayo devāḥ vsridhaḥ hiṃsakān śatrūnasmān vati nayantu | vmarudbhiḥ putraiḥ sahitam vugram ugraṃtejasaṃ vrudram vindramagniṃ ca vsvastaye kṣemāya vhuvema āhvayemahi || hyaterāśīrliṅi 'yahule chandasi' iti saṃprasāraṇam | liṅyāśiṣyaṅ || āhūtāste asmān vdvipaḥ dveṣṭra vati nayantu ||

netāra ū pu ṇastiro varuṇo mitro aryamā | ati viśvāni duritā rājānaścarṣaṇīnāmati dviṣaḥ || 6 || netāraḥ | ū~ iti | su | naḥ | tiraḥ | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | ati | viśvāni | duḥ'itā | rājānaḥ | carṣaṇīnām | ati | dviṣaḥ || 6 || vnetāraḥ nayanakuśalāḥ || nayateḥ sādhukāriṇi tṛn || varuṇadayo devāḥ vnaḥ asmākaṃ pāpāni vsu2 suṣṭhu vtiraḥ tirodhānamadarśanaṃ nayantu | vu iti pūraṇaḥ | vcarṣaṇīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vrājānaḥ
svāmino varuṇādayo devāḥ 7 viśvāni sarvāṇi 7 duritā duritāni durgamanāni pāpaphalarūpāṇyasmān 7 ati nayantu |

śunam'asmabhyamūtaye varṷṇo mi॒tro arya॒mā | śarma̭ yacchantu sapratha॒ āti̭tyāso yadīmahe ati dviṣaḥ || 7 || śunam | asmabhyam | ūtaye | varuṇaḥ | mitraḥ | aryamā | śarma | yacchantu | saprathaḥ | ādityāsaḥ | yat | īmahe | ati | dviṣaḥ || 7 || varuṇādayo devāḥ 7 ūtaye rakṣāye 7 śunaṃ sukham 7 asmabhyaṃ stotṛbhyaḥ prayacchantu | tathā 7 ādityāsaḥ aditaḥ putrāste 7 saprathaḥ sarvataḥ pṛthu vistīrṇaṃ 7 śarma sukhaṃ ca 7 yacchantu asmabhyaṃ dadatu | 7 yat śarma vayam 7 īmahe yācāmahe | 7 dvipaḥ ca 7 ati nayantu ||

yathā̭ ha॒ tyadva̭savo gauryai ci॒tpadi̭ pi॒tāma̭śvatā yajatrāḥ | e॒vo ṣva̭sma॒yuma̭śvatā vya̭haḥ pra tā॒ryamḙ pra॒tara॒ṃ na āyuḥ || 8 || yathā | ha | tyat | vasavaḥ | gauryai | cit | padi | sitām | amuñcata | yajatrāḥ | eva iti | su | asmat | muñcata | vi | ahaḥ | pra | tāri | agre | pra'taram | naḥ | āyuḥ ||8|| he 7 vasavaḥ vāsakāḥ he 7 yajatrāḥ yāgāhā~ mitrādayo devāḥ || 'aminakṣi' ( u. sū. 3.105 ) ityādinā yajeratrapratyayaḥ || 7 yat te prasiddhā yūyam || 'supāṃ suluk' iti vibhakterluk || 7 yathā 7 ha yathā khalu 7 padi pādaṃ 7 sitāṃ baddhām | 'padan' ityādinā pādaśabdasya padādeśaḥ | 'adidaṃ- padādi' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 171 ) ityādinā masyamā udāttatvam | 'pijū bandhane' ityasmā- jjihvā || īdṛśīṃ 7 gauryai gaurī varṇasaumakrayaṇīṃ gām || 'pitrorādibhyaśca' ( pā. sū. 4. 1. 41 ) iti ṅīp | 'ami pūrvaḥ' ( pā. sū. 6. 1. 107 ) ityatra 'vā chandasi' ( pā. sū. 6.1.106 ) ityanuvartanātpūrvasya pūrvarūpasya pūrvasavarṇadīrghasya cābhāve yaṇ | 'udāttasvaritayoryaṇaḥ' iti parasyānudāttasya svaritatvam || īdṛśīṃ gām 7 amuñcata yathā khalu yūyaṃ viśvāsvargadhrvāṃmocitavantaḥ 7 evo evameva 7 asmat asmattaḥ 7 ahaḥ pāpaṃ suṣṭhu 7 tri 7 muñcata viśleṣayata | he 7 agne 7 naḥ asmākam 7 āyuḥ 7 prataraṃ 7 pra 7 tāri | prakarṣeṇa tvayā pravardhatām | prapūrvastiratirvardhanārthaḥ || praśabdāttarapi 'amu ca chandasi' ( pā. sū. 5. 4. 12 ) ityamupratyayaḥ || || 13 ||
tathā cānukrāntaṃ- 'rātrī kuśikaḥ saubharo rātrīrvā bhāradvājī rātristvaṃ gāyatrīm' iti |
tathā cāruṇyake śrūyate- 'sa yadyeṣāṃ kiṃcitpaśyeduṣoṣya pāyasaṃ sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvā rātrīsūktena pratyṛcaṃ hutvā' ( ai. ā. 3. 2. 4 ) iti ||
rātrī̭ vya̭khya॒dāya̭tī pu॒rutrā̭ de॒vyakṣa̭raiḥ | vi॒śvā a॒dhi śriyo̭'dhita || 1 || rātrī | vi | akhyat | ā'yatī | purutrā | devī | akṣaraiḥ | viśvāḥ | adhi | śriyaḥ | adhita || 1 ||
vrātrī iyaṃ rātri- devatā vhyasyat viṣṭe viśeṣeṇa paśyati |
api caipā vviśvāḥ sarvāḥ vśriyaḥ śobhāḥ vadhi vadhina adhidhārayati |

cākre tena̭ ṛṣayaḥ manuṣyā yajñe jāte pitaraḥ naḥ purāṇe | paśyan manye manasā cakṣasā tān ya imaṃ yajñamaryajanta pūrvai || 6 || cākre | tena̭ | ṛṣayaḥ | manuṣyāḥ | yajñe | jāte | pitaraḥ | naḥ | purāṇe | paśyan | manye | manasā | cakṣasā | tān | ye | imam | yajñam | aryajanta | pūrvai || 6 || purāṇe ciraṃtane asmin yajñe jāte viśvasṛḍvaiḥ samyaganuṣṭhite sati tena yajñena ṛṣayo manuṣyāḥ naḥ asmākaṃ pitaraḥ pūrvapuruṣāśca cākre akalpayanta | asṛjyanta | imam
idaṃ yat ye pūrve sādhyā devāḥ prajāpateḥ prāṇabhūtāḥ ayajanta agvatiṣṭhan tān devān prāṇāramanā sarvatra vartamānān vakṣasā darśanahetunā manasā paśyan jānan manye |
sahastomāḥ sahachandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramāḥ ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ |
pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālaibhire rathyo na raśmīn ||
saha'stomāḥ | saha'chandasaḥ | ā'vṛtaḥ | saha'pramāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ | sapta | daivyāḥ | pūrveṣām | panthām | anu'dṛśya | dhīrāḥ | anu'ālaibhire | rathyaḥ | na | raśmīn || 7 ||
stomaiḥ trivṛtpañcadaśādibhiḥ saha vartamānāḥ sahastomāḥ sahachandasaḥ gāyatryādibhiḥ chandobhiḥ saha vartamānāḥ āvṛtaḥ āvartamānāḥ sahapramāḥ pramitiḥ pramā yajñasyettāparijñānam |
tena saha vartamānāḥ daivyāḥ devasya prajāpateḥ sambandhinaḥ yadvā
tādṛśān vidvān sarvān amitrān śatrūn apa nudasva asmatto'pagamaya |
tathā he abhibhūte śatrūṇāmabhibhavitarindra apācaḥ apamukhamanvataḥ pṛṣṭhabhāge vartamānān sarvān śatrūn apa nudasva |
tathā he śūra śauryavacchindra adharācaḥ adharadeśamabhobhāgamanvataśca adhastanānnapi śatrūn apa nudasva |
uroṃ vistīrṇe tava sambandhini tvayā datte śarman śarmaṇi gṛhe sukhe vā yathā vayaṃ madema nirupadravāḥ santo hṛṣyema tathā tvaṃ sarvatra vartamānānasmadīyān śatrūn vināśayetyarthaḥ ||

kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavai cidyathā dāntyanupūrvam triyūrya | ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo namovṛkti na jagmuḥ || 2 || kuvit | aṅga | yava'mantaḥ | yavam | cit | yathā | dānti | anupūrvam | vi'yūrya | iha'iha | eṣām | kṛṇuhi | bhojanāni | ye | barhiṣaḥ | namaḥ'vṛktim | na | jagmuḥ || 2 ||
aṅga he indra yavamantaḥ yavādidhānyayuktāḥ karṣakāḥ yavaṃ cit |
yavagodhūmādīn anupūrva yo yo dhānyaviśeṣaḥ prathamaṃ pacyate tenānupūrvyeṇa vidyuya pṛthakkṛtya yathā kuvit bahulaṃ dānti lunanti |
vipūrvāt yauterlapi ‘yulluvordīrgha- śchandasi’ (pā. sū. 6.4.58) iti dīrghaḥ |
evam iheha asminnasmin deśe sarvasmin eṣāṃ yajamānānāṃ bhojanāni |
yasmin1 yasmin deśe yaddhanamapekṣitaṃ tadanuguṇaṃ prayacchetyarthaḥ ||

nahi sthūryatuthā yātamāsti nota śravau vivide saṃgameṣu | guyyantu indraṃ surayāya viprāṃ aśvayanto vṛṣaṇaṃ vājaryantaḥ || 3 || nahi | sthūr | ṛtu'thā | yātam | asti | na | uta | śravaḥ | vivide | sam'gameṣu | guyyantaḥ | indram | surayāya | viprāḥ | aśva'yantaḥ | vṛṣaṇam | vājaryantaḥ || 3 ||
ṛtuthā ṛtau yasmin kāle prāptavyaṃ tadyogakāle sthuri anaḥ yātaṃ taṃ deśaṃ prāptaṃ nahi asti na hi bhavati |
ekena dhuryeṇa yuktaḥ śakaṭaḥ śīghraṃ gantavyaṃ na prāpnotītyarthaḥ |
uta api ca saṃgameṣu saṃgrāmeṣu śravaḥ annaṃ yaśo vā na vivide na labhate |
vṛṣaṇaṃ varṣitāraṃ tam indraṃ guyyantaḥ gā icchantaḥ viprāḥ medhāvino vayaṃ surayāya sakhikrarmaṇe āhvayāma iti śeṣaḥ |
aśvayantaḥ aśvānapyātmana icchantaḥ vājaryantaḥ annakāmā2 balakāmāśca3 ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘yuvaṃ surāmamvineti grahāṇāṃ puronuvākyā’ (āśva. śrau. 3.9) iti ||

he 'aśvinā aśvinau he 'śubhaspatī udakasya śobhanālaṃkārasya vā patī pālayitārau 'surāmaṃ suṣṭhu ramaṇasādhanamidaṃ haviḥ 'vipipānā viśeṣeṇa pītavantau 'yuvaṃ yuvāṃ 'sacā santau saṃgatau 'āsure asuraputre 'namucau etatsaṃjñe asure hantavye sati 'karmasu yodhanakarmasu 'indram 'āvatam arakṣa- tam ||
śubhaspatī iti ‘subāmantrita’ iti ṣaṣṭhyantasya parāṅgavadbhāvāt ṣaṣṭhyāmantritasamudāyasyāṣṭamikaṃ sarvānudāttatvam ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘putramiva pitarāvaśvinobheti yājyā’ ( āśva. śrau. 3.9) iti ||

putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ | yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak || 5 || putram'iva | pitarau | aśvinā | ubhā | indra | āvathuḥ | kāvyaiḥ | daṃsanābhiḥ | yat | surāmam | vi | apibaḥ | śacībhiḥ | sarasvatī | tvā | maghavan | abhiṣṇak ||5|| he 'indra tvāṃ 'pitarau mātāpitarau 'putramiva || ‘pitā mātrā’ (pā. sū. 1.2.70) iti pituḥ śeṣaḥ | 'ubhā ubhau aśvinau 'kāvyaiḥ praśastaiḥ 'daṃsanābhiḥ ātmīyaiḥ karmabhiḥ 'āvathuḥ | madhyamo vyatyayena | āvathuḥ arakṣataḥ | tvaṃ ca 'surāmaṃ sukhena ramaṇasādhanaṃ haviḥ 'yat yadā 'śacībhiḥ śaktibhiḥ sārdhaṃ 'vyapibaḥ viśeṣeṇa pītavānasi tadā he 'maghavan dhanavannaindra 'sarasvatī devī 'tvā tvām 'abhiṣṇak upāsevata | bhiṣṇak upasevāyām | kaṇṇvādiḥ | chāndaso yagabhāvaḥ | laṅi ‘bahulaṃ chandasi’ iti śapo luk | ‘halaṅyābhyaḥ’ iti lopaḥ ||

indraḥ sutrāmā svavā~ avobhiḥ sumuḻīko mavatu viśvavedāḥ | bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma || 6 || indraḥ | su'trāmā | sva'vān | avaḥ'bhiḥ | su'muḻīkaḥ | bhavatu | viśva'vedāḥ | bādhatām | dveṣaḥ | abhayam | kṛṇotu | su'vīryasya | patayaḥ | syāma || 6 ||

tasye vayaṃ sumato yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma | sa sutrāmā svavā~ indro asme ārāccit dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu || 7 || tasya | vayam | su'matau | yajñiyasya | api | bhadre | saumanase | syāma | saḥ | su'trāmā | sva'vān | indraḥ | asme iti | ārāt | cit | dveṣaḥ | sanutaḥ | yuyotu ||7||
suṣṭhu trātā dhanavān sarvasya veditā indro rakṣaṇaiḥ suṣṭhu sukhayitā bhavatu śatrūṃśca hinastu bhayarāhityaṃ ca karotva- smākam|
ato vayaṃ śobhanavīyaupitasya dhanasya svāmino bhavemeti ||
tasya yajñārhasya indrasyānugrahabuddhau bhajanīye saumanasye ca vayaṃ viṣayabhūtā bhavema|
suṣṭhu trātā dhanavān sa indro'- smatto dūradeśe dveṣantardhānaṃ yojayatviti ||
‘ījānam’ iti saptacaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ nṛmedhaputrasya śakapūtasya mitrāvaruṇadevatākam|
tathā cānukrāntam—‘ījānaṃ śakapūto nāmedho maitrāvaruṇaṃ nyaṅkusāriṇyādyā liṅgoktadevatāntyā’ mahāsatobṛhatyupāyopāntye’ prastārapaṅktī śeṣā virāḍrūpāḥ’ iti|
ījānam | it | dyauḥ | garta'vasuḥ | ījānam | bhūrbhiḥ | abhi | pra'bhūpaṇi | ījānam | devau | aśvinau | abhi | sumnaiḥ | avardhatām || 1 ||
gartamudhataṃ stotṛbhyo dānāya haste ghṛtaṃ vasu dhanaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathoktā ||
īdṛśī ‘dyauḥ dyulokābhimānīnī devatā ‘ījānam’ ita yajñaiḥ iṣṭavantameva puruṣamabhivardhayati |
tathā ‘bhūmiḥ ca ‘prabhūpaṇi prabhavane yadvā prakṛṣṭa- bhūpaṇe alaṃkāre nimittabhūte sati ‘ījānam abhivardhayati |
api ca ‘devau dānādiguṇayuktau ‘aśvinī ‘ījānam iṣṭavantaṃ puruṣaṃ ‘sumnaiḥ dhanaiḥ ‘abhi ‘avardhatām abhivardhayataḥ |
tā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī sumnaiṣittvatāṃ yajāmasi|
tā | vām | mitrāvaruṇā | dhārayatkṣitī iti dhārayat'kṣitī | su'sumnā | iṣittvatā | yajāmasi | yuvoḥ | ṛṇāyā | sustaiḥ | abhi | syāma | rakṣasaḥ || 2 ||
havīṃṣi dhārayantaḥ kṣitayo manuṣyā yayoḥ svabhūtāstathāvidhau |
‘susumnā suṣṭhusumnau sudhanī susukhī vā ‘tā tau ‘vāṃ yuvām ‘iṣittvatā iṣitatvena |
yuvāṃ deveṣu madhye prāsamyau tato hetoḥ ॰yajāmasi havirbhiryajāmaḥ |

ardhā ci̭nu॒ yadi̭rdhi॒pāma̭he vā॒mubhi̭ pri॒yaṃ rekṇa̭: pa॒tyamā̭nāḥ | da॒dvā~ vā॒ yatpṷṣyati rekṇa̭: sa॒mvā~na̭kirasya ma॒ghāni̭ || 3 || ardha | cit | nu | yat | dirdhipāmahe | vām | abhi | priyam | rekṇaḥ | patyamānāḥ | dadvān | vā | yat | puṣyati | rekṇaḥ | sam | ū~ iti | āran | nakiḥ | asya | maghāni ||3||
he mitrāvaruṇau ॰vāṃ yuvābhyāṃ yuvayorartha ॰yat yadā ॰didhipāmahe havīṃṣi dhārayāmaḥ |
havīṃṣi dattvāṃśa ॰yat yo yajamānaḥ ॰rekṇaḥ dhanaṃ ॰puṣyati vardhayati ॰asya dattavato yajamānasya ॰maghāni dhanāni ॰nakiḥ ॰sam ॰āran naivāpa- gacchanti |

asā̭va॒nyo a̭su॒ra sūya̭t dhyaustvaṃ vi॒śveṣā̭ṃ varṷṇāsi॒ rājā̭ | mu॒rdhā ra̭tha॒sya cā॒kunai̭tā॒vṛtai̭na॒sānta̭ka॒dhruka॒ || 4 || asau | anyaḥ | ॰asura | sūyat | dyauḥ | tvam | viśveṣām | varuṇa | asi | rājā | murdhā | rathasya | ॰cākan | na | etāvatā | enasā | antakadhruka || 4 ||
tān dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ svodayena prayacchatī- tyasuraḥ |
varuṇāpekṣayā ॰anyam ॰asau amuṃ nabhasi dṛśyamānaṃ tvāṃ ॰sūyata asūta ||
he ॰varuṇa ॰tvaṃ ca ॰viśveṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ ॰rājā ॰asi īśvaro bhavasi |
rathasya raṃhaṇa- śīlasya yajñasya mūrdhā na mūrdheva pradhānaḥ |
yata evamataḥ kāraṇāt ॰antakadhruka antakasya hananaśīlasya rākṣasāderyamasyaiva vā droghdhā |
īdṛśaḥ sa yajñaḥ ॰etāvatā ॰enasā ityaparimāṇenapi pāpmanāpi ॰na yujyate ||
a॒smintsa॒vḙta॒cchaka̭pū॒ta e॒no hi॒te mi॒tre ni॒rgatā̭n hanti॒ vīrā̭n |

karmāsyāyāṃ hrasvo nucca vā' (u. sū. 4. 207) ityaprāpteḥ asun tasya nuḍāgamo dhātorhrasvaśca |
