dhurvyadaṃ dhurvyavohandeśe sīdantaṃ vanyadaṃ vanepuṣpāneṣu krīḍārthaṃ niṣīdantam |
he mitrā- varuṇau yuvābhyāṃ nṛmedhaḥ mama pitā aṃhasaḥ pāpāt tatre rarakṣe rakṣito babhūva |
nṛmedhasya putraḥ śakapūto'haṃ pāpāt yuvābhyāṃ tatre rakṣito'smi |
sumedhaḥ anyo'pi suyajño yajamānaḥ aṃhasaḥ pāpāt tatre yuvābhyāmevārakṣayata |
'pro pu' iti saptarcaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktaṃ pijavanaputrasya sudāsa ārṣamaindram |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'pro pu sudāḥ paijavanaḥ śākkaramahāpāṅktāvādyau tṛcāvanyau triṣṭup' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yathāśiraṃ pro vvasmai purorathamiti tṛcāvāticchandasau' (āśva. śrau. 6. 2) iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritaṃ ca—'pro vvasmai purorathamityanurūpaḥ' (ai. ā. 5. 1. 1) iti ||
abhīkeṃ cidu lokakṛtsaṃge samatsu vṛtrahāsmākeṃ bodhi coditā nabha̭ntāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanva̭su ||

pro iti | su | asmai | puraḥ'ratham | indrāya | śūpam | arcata | abhīkeṃ | cit | ū~ iti | loka'kṛt | sam'ge | samatsu | vṛtra'hā | asmākam | bodhi | coditā | nabhantām | anyakeṣām | jyākāḥ | adhi | dhanvasu ||1||
rathasyāgrato vartamānaṃ rūpaṃ balaṃ su pro arcata |
pra u iti nipātasamudāyaḥ pro iti |

abhīkeṃ cittu abhyarṇe'pi nikaṭaṃ prāpte'pi keśākeśayavasthāyāmapi loka- kṛt sthitikṛt palāyitāṃ sthiratvā ca vṛtrahā vṛtrāṇāmāvarakāṇāṃ hantā evaṃvidhaḥ sa indraḥ asmākaṃ stotṛṇāṃ coditā dhanānāṃ preritā san bodhi |
api ca vaanyakeṣāṃ kutsitānāmyeṣāṃ śatrūṇām vaadhi vadhanvasu dhanu:ṣvadhiropitā vajyākā: kutsitā jyā vanabhantāṃ hiṃsantāṃ naśyantu |
aśatrṷrindra jajñiṣe viśvaṃ puṣyasi vāryaṃ taṃ tvā pari̭ ṣvajāmahe nabhantāmanyeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

tvam | sindhūn | ar‌va | asṛja: | adharāca: | ahan | ahim | aśatru: | indra | jajñiṣe | viśvam | puṣyasi | vāryam | tam | tvā | pari̭ | svajāmahe | nabhantām | anyeṣām | jyākā: | adhi | dhanvasu || 2 ||
he vaindra vatvaṃ vasindhūn syandanaśīlān jalapūrān vaadharāca: adharamadhomukhamannato gantṛn vaavāsṛja: meghādbhiragamaya: |
yatastvam vaahim antarikṣe gataṃ megham vaahan‌ hatavānasi |
ahimāgatya hantāraṃ sarvasya jagata āvarakaṃ vṛtramasuramahan hatavānasi |
ato he vaindra tvam vaaśatru: śatrurahita: vajajñiṣe jāyase |
na santi śatravo'syeti bahuvrīhau ‘nañsubhyām’ ityuttarapadāntodātta- tvam |
tathā vaviśvaṃ sarvaṃ vavāryaṃ varaṇīyaṃ saṃbhajanīyaṃ dhanaṃ vapuṣyasi vardhayasi |
vataṃ tādṛśaṃ vatvā tvāṃ vapari vaṣvajāmahe havirbhi: stutibhiścāliṅganaṃ kurma: |
vi ṣu viśvā arātayo'ryo na̭śanta no dhiya: |
astā̭si śatrave vadhaṃ yo ne indra jighāṃsati yā te rati̭rdivasṷ nabhantāmanyeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||

‘mantre vṛṣepacamanavidabhūvīrā udāttaḥ’ iti ktina udāttatvam | sā rāti: vasu dhanaṃ dadi: asmabhyaṃ dātā bhavatu | ‘ādagamahana’ iti dadāte: kipratyaya: | ‘na lokādhyaya’ iti vasuśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyabhāva: | siddhamanyat || yo ne indrābhito janau vṛkāyurādideśati | adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi vibādho asi sāsahirnamantāmanyakeṣāṃ jyākā adhi dhanvasu ||4|| ya: | na: | indra | abhita: | janaṃ: | vṛka'yu: | ā'dideśati | adha:'padam | tam | īm | kṛdhi | vi'bādha: | asi | sasahi: | namantām | anyakeṣām | jyākā: | adhi | dhanva'su || 4 || he indra ya: jana: vṛkāyu: | vṛko hiṃsako'raṇyaśvāsteno vā | sa ivācaran na: asmān abhita: sarvata: ādideśati abhilakṣya āyudhānyatisṛjati | diśaterlyaḍāgama: | chāndasa: śapa: ślu: | ‘nāmyastasyāci piti’ ityatra ‘bahulaṃ chandasīti vaktavyam’ iti vacanāt pratiṣedhābhāve laghūpadhaguṇa: | ‘abhyastānāmādi:’ ityādyudāttatvam | tamīṃ tamimaṃ janam adhaspadaṃ pādasthā- dhastādvartamānaṃ kṛdhi kuru | karoteśchāndaso vikaraṇasya luk | ‘śraśruṇupkṛvṛbhya:’ iti herdhi:| yatastvaṃ vibādha: viśeṣeṇa bādhitā śatrūṇāṃ sāsahi: abhibhavitā ca asi | siddha: śeṣa: || yo ne indrābhidarsati sanābhiyaśca niṣṭyartha: | atra tasya balaṃ tira mahītra dyauradha tmanā dhopayāmasi dhopayāmaḥ| ananuṣṭhānena vimohayāmaḥ| 'yupa vimohane'| kiṃ tarhi| mantraścayaṃ mantreṇa smārthaṃ śrutau vidhivākye pratipādyaṃ yuṣmadviṣayaṃ karma tat carāmasi ācarāmaḥ| anutiṣṭhāmaḥ| api ca pakṣebhiḥ pakṣeḥ pakṣasthānīyaiḥ stutaścaiḥ| apikṣebhiḥ| apikṣo nāma bāhormadhyabhāgaḥ| yajñasya apikakṣabhūtairvidhibhiḥ| atra asmin yajñe'bhitaḥ sarvato yuṣmān saṃ rabhāmahe samyagava- lambhāmahe || || 22 ||

yasminvṛkṣe supalāśe devaiḥ saṃpibate yamaḥ | atrā no viśvapatiḥ pitā purāṇāṃ anu venati || 1 || yasmin | vṛkṣe | su'palāśe | devaiḥ | sam'pibate | yamaḥ | atra | naḥ | viśvapatiḥ | pitā | purāṇāṃ | anu | venati || 1 ||
tādṛśasya vṛkṣasya mūlaṃ yathauvyajanitaśramāpanodanena sukhakaraṃ bhavati tadvat sukhakare yasmin sthāne devaiḥ parijanabhūtaiḥ yamaḥ niyantā vaivasvataḥ saṃpibate saha bhuṅkte|
mama naciketaso janako vājaśravasaḥ atra asmin yamasya sthāne purāṇān purātanān atra cirakālaṃ nivasataḥ pitṛn anu teṣāṃ paścāt tatsamīpe nivasatvayamiti venati māṃ kāmayate|
naciketā nāma kumāro vājaśravasena pitrā yamalokaṃ prasthāpitaḥ san yamaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasādya punarapīmaṃ lokamājagāma|
supalāśe vṛkṣa iva yasmin śobhane sthāne yama ādityo devaiḥ|
atra asmin sthāne sthito viśvapatirviśvāṃ prajānāṃ prakāśanapravarṣaṇādinā pālayitā prāṇā- tmanā sarveṣāṃ janakaḥ sa ādityaḥ purāṇāṃścirantanān stotṛn no'smānapi venati anugrāhyatvena kāmayate|
atra sthāne sthitān no'smākaṃ purāṇān pūrvapurupānanu venati anukrameṇa kāmayate||

idaṃ yamasya sādanaṃ devamānaṃ yaducyate | iyamasya dhmayate nāḻīrayaṃ gībhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ || 7 || idam | yamasya | sādanam | devamānam | yat | ucyate | iyam | asya | dhmayate | nāḻīḥ | ayam | gīḥbhiḥ | pariṣkṛtaḥ || 7 ||

munayaḥ | vāta'raśanāḥ | piṅgā | vasate | malā | vātasya | anu | dhrājim | yanti | yat | devāsaḥ | avikṣata || 2 || ᵥvātaśanāḥ vātaraśanasya putrāḥ ᵥmunayaḥ atīndriyārthadarśino jūtavātajūtiprabhṛtayaḥ ᵥpiṅgā piṅgāni kapilavarṇāni ᵥmalā malināni valkalarūpāṇi vāsāṃsi ᵥvasate ācchādayanti | ‘vasa ācchādane’ | ādādikaḥ | īdṛśāste ᵥyat yadā ᵥdevāsaḥ devāḥ tapaso mahimnā dīpyamānāḥ santaḥ ᵥavikṣata devatārūpaṃ prāviśan | viśeṣuṅi śala igupadhādaniṭaḥ ksaḥ | vyatyayenātmane- padam | tadā te ᵥvātasya vāyoḥ ᵥbhrājiṃ gatim ᵥanu ᵥyanti anugacchanti | prāṇopāsanayā prāṇa- rūpiṇo vāyubhāvaṃ prapannā ityarthaḥ ||

unmaditā mauneyena vātā~ ā tasthimā vayam | śarīredasmākaṃ yūyaṃ martāso abhi paśyatha || 3 || ut'maditāḥ | mauneyena | vātān | ā | tasthima | vayam | śarīrā | it | asmākam | yūyam | martāsaḥ | abhi | paśyatha || 3 || ᵥmauneyena munibhāvena laukikasarvavyavahāravisarjanena ᵥunmaditāḥ unmattā unmattavadā- carantaḥ | yadvā | utkṛṣṭaṃ madaṃ harṣaṃ prāptāḥ | ᵥvayaṃ ᵥvātān vāyūnasmābhihapāsyamānān ᵥā ᵥtasthima āsthitavantaḥ | he ᵥmartāsaḥ manuṣyāḥ ᵥasmākaṃ ᵥśarīret śarīrāṇyaiva ᵥyūyaṃ kevalam ᵥabhi ᵥpaśyatha | nāsmān | yato vayaṃ nirūpeṇa vāyunā sāyujyaṃ prāptāḥ ||

antarikṣeṇa patati viśvā rūpāvacākaśat | munirdevasyadevasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ || 4 || antarikṣeṇa | patati | viśvā | rūpā | ava'cākaśat | muniḥ | devasya'devasya | saukṛtyāya | sakhā | hitaḥ || 4 || ᵥmuniḥ asyarco draṣṭā vṛṣāṇaka ṛṣirvātaspatāṃ sūryātmatāṃ vā tattadupāsanayā prāptaḥ san ᵥanta- rikṣaṇa ākāśena ᵥpatati gacchati | kiṃ kurvan | ᵥviśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi rūpāṇi rūpyamāṇāni padārtha- jātāni ᵥavacākaśat abhipaśyan svatejasā darśayan | tathā ᵥdevasyadevasya | ‘nityavīpsayoḥ’ iti dvivacanam | ‘anudāttaṃ ca’ iti parasyāgreḍitasyānudāttatvam | sarvasyāpi devasya ᵥsakhā sakhibhūtaḥ ata eva ᵥsaukṛtyāya | suṣṭhu devānuddiśya kriyamāṇaṃ yāgātmakaṃ karma sukṛtam | tasya bhāvāya samyaganuṣṭhāpanāya ᵥhitaḥ nihitaḥ sthāpito bhavati ||

vātasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhātho devairṣito muniḥ | ubhau samudrāvā kṣeti yaśca pūrva utārparaḥ || 5 || vātasya | aśvaḥ | vāyoḥ | sakhā | atho iti | deva'īṣitaḥ | muniḥ | ubhau | samudrau | ā | kṣeti | yaḥ | ca | pūrvaḥ | uta | arparaḥ || 5 ||
ata eva ^vāyo: ^sakhā mitrabhūta: ^atho api ca ^deveṣita: devena dyotamānena vāyunā sūryeṇa vā iṣita: prāpta:|
īdṛśo ^muni: karikākhya ṛṣiruktaprakāreṇa vāyurūpa: sūryarūpo vā san ^ubhau ^samudrau udadhī ^ā ^kṣeti abhigacchati|

apsarasāṃ gandharvāṇāṃ mṛgāṇāṃ caraṇe caran| keśī ketasya vidvāntasakhā svādumadintama: || 6 || apsarasāṃ| gandharvāṇāṃ| mṛgāṇāṃ| caraṇe| caran| keśī| ketasya| vidvān| sakhā| svādu| madintama: || 6 ||

^apsarasāṃ devastrīṇāṃ ^gandharvāṇāṃ ^caraṇaṃ saṃcārabhūte divyantarikṣe ca tathā ^mṛgāṇāṃ siṃhā- dīnāṃ saṃcārasthale pṛthivyāṃ ^caran vyāpya saṃcaran ^keśī abhirvāyu: sūryo vā ^ketasya jñātavyasya sarvasyārthajātasya ^vidvān yadvā jñātavyasyāsyapreratasya ^sakhā vidvān aviśeṣāt sarvaṃ jānan ^svādu: svādayitā racayitā sarvasya rasyotpādaka: ata eva ^madintama: mādayitṛtamo bhavati|

vāyurasmā upāmanthatpinaṣṭi smā kunanmā| keśī viṣasya pātreṇa yadrudreṇāpibatsaha || 7 || vāyu:| asmai| upa| amanyat| pinaṣṭi| sma| kunanmā| keśī| viṣasya| pātreṇa| yat| rudreṇa| arpibat| saha || 7 ||
‘rudro vā eṣa yadagni:’ (tai. saṃ. 5.4.3.1) iti śravaṇādrudro vaidyutāgni:|
viṣamudakaṃ ^pātreṇa pānasādhanena raśmijālena ^yat yadā ^apibat pibati tadā ^asmai keśine ^vāyu: ^upāmanthat|
yadāpibat pītavān bhavati tadā sūryamaṇḍale ghanībhūtasya tadudakaṃ vāyurūpa- makṣāti|
tathā ^kunanmā kutsitamapi bhṛśaṃ namayitrī svayaṃ namayitu- maśakyā svatantrā mādhyamika vāk ^pinaṣṭi ^sma|
kupūrvāñjhamyate: pacādyaci ‘yaḍo'ci ca’ iti yaho luk|
‘uta devā:’ iti saptacaṃ navamaṃ sūktānuṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ bharadvājakaśyapagotamātriviśvāmitra- jamadagnivasiṣṭhā iti kramena pratyṛcamṛṣaya:|
tathā cānukrāntam—‘uta devā: saptarṣaya ekarcā vaiśva- devam’ iti|
uta devā avahitaṃ devā unnayathā puna:|

uta | devāḥ | ava'hitam | devāḥ | ut | nayatha | punariti | uta | ārgaḥ | cukṛṣam | devāḥ | devāḥ | jīvayatha | punariti || 1 || 'uta' api ca he 'devāḥ' 'avahitam' 'unnayatha' | 'uta api ca he 'devāḥ' 'bhāgaḥ aparādhaṃ 'cakuṣaṃ kṛtavantaṃ māṃ tasmādagaso rakṣata | he 'devāḥ' rakṣitvā ca 'punaḥ paścāt 'jīvayatha cirajīvinaṃ kuruta ||

dvātribhau vātau vāta ā sindhorā parāvataḥ | dakṣaṃ te anya ā vātu parānyo vātu yadrapaḥ || 2 || dvau | imau | vātau | vātaḥ | ā | sindhoḥ | ā | purā'vartaḥ | dakṣam | te | anyaḥ | ā | vātu | parā | anyaḥ | vātu | yat | rapaḥ || 2 || 'imau dṛśyamānau 'dvau 'vātau purovātaḥ paścādvātaśca 'ā 'sindhoḥ ā samudrāt | maryādāthā- mākāraḥ | yadvā 'ā 'parāvataḥ samudrādapi yo dūradeśaḥ taṃ deśamavadhīkṛtya 'vātaḥ gacchataḥ | 'vā gatigandhanayoḥ' | ādādikaḥ | tayorvātayoḥ 'anyaḥ eko he stotaḥ 'te tava 'dakṣaṃ balam 'ā 'vātu āgamayatu | 'anyaḥ ca tvadīyaṃ 'yadrapaḥ pāpaṃ tat 'parā 'vātu parāgamayatu ||

ā vāta vāhi bheṣajaṃ vi vāta vāhi yadrapaḥ | tvaṃ hi viśvabheṣajo devānāṃ dūta īyase || 3 || ā | vāta | vāhi | bheṣajam | vi | vāta | vāhi | yat | rapaḥ | tvam | hi | viśvabheṣajaḥ | devānām | dūtaḥ | īyase || 3 || he 'vāta 'bheṣajaṃ sukhaṃ vyādhyupaśamanamauṣadhaṃ vā 'ā 'vāhi āgamaya | he 'vāta 'yadrapaḥ asmadīyaṃ pāpaṃ tat 'vi 'vāhi vigamaya | asmatto viśleṣaya | 'tvaṃ 'hi khalu 'devānāṃ 'dūtaḥ 'viśvabheṣajaḥ | viśvāni bheṣajāni yasmin | 'bahuvrīhau viśvaṃ saṃjñāyām' iti pūrvapadantodāttatvam | īyase san 'īyase satataṃ gacchasi || 'iṅ gatau' | daivādikaḥ | iyano mitvāt 'mityādirnityam' ityādyudāttatvam | 'hi ca' iti nighātapratiṣedhaḥ ||

ā tvāgamaṃ śaṃtātibhiratho ariṣṭātibhiḥ | dakṣaṃ te bhadramābhārṣaṃ parā yakṣmaṃ suvāmi te || 4 || ā | tvā | agamam | śaṃtātibhiḥ | atho | iti | ariṣṭātibhiḥ | dakṣam | te | bhadram | ā | abhārṣam | parā | yakṣmam | suvāmi | te || 4 || 1. ga-utāpi ca he devāḥ avahitamadhonihitaṃ punaśconnayatha dāridryapīḍitamādyaṃ kudhaḥ; ta1.3.4. 5.6.8- 'uta ... ... unnayatha' nāsti; ta7-utāpi ca he devā yūyaṃ avahitaṃ dāridryeṇāyaḥ pātitaṃ māṃ paśyateti śeṣaḥ | he devāḥ māṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ paścāt unnayatha uddharata utkṛṣṭaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayatetyarthaḥ; bha-utāpi ca he devā avahitaṃ |
he stotaḥ ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥśaṃtātibhiḥ sukhakaraiḥ ᵥatho api ca ᵥariṣṭatātibhiḥ ahiṃsākaraiśca rakṣaṇaiḥ ᵥā ᵥagamam āgatavānasmi |
api ca ᵥbhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ ᵥte tava ᵥdakṣaṃ balam ᵥābhāryam āhāryaṃ vāyusakāśādupaiṣyam |
tathā ᵥte tava ᵥyakṣaṃ rogaṃ ca ᵥparā ᵥsuvāmi vināśayāmi ||
trāyantām | iha | devāḥ | trāyatām | marutām | guṇaḥ | trāyantām | viśvā | bhūtāni | yathā | ayam | arapāḥ | asat || 5 ||
ᵥiha asmin deśe sarve ᵥdevāḥ ᵥtrāyantām asmān pālayantām |
tathā ᵥmarutāṃ ᵥgaṇaḥ saṃghaḥ sa ᵥtrāyatām |
ᵥviśvā viśvāni sarvāṇyanyāni ca ᵥbhūtāni bhūtajātāni ᵥtrāyantām asmān rakṣantu |
ᵥyathāyam asmadīyaḥ śarīrādiḥ ᵥarapāḥ ᵥasat pāparahito bhavati tathetyarthaḥ |
āpaḥ | it | vai | oṃ iti | bheṣajīḥ | āpaḥ | amīva'cātanīḥ | āpaḥ | sarvasya | bheṣajīḥ | tāḥ | te | kṛṇvantu | bheṣajam || 6 ||
ᵥāpa ᵥidvai āpa eva khalu ᵥbheṣajīḥ bheṣajabhūtāḥ |
yata evamataḥ kāraṇāt ᵥāpaḥ ᵥamīvacātanīḥ amīvacātanyaḥ rogāṇāṃ nāśa- yinyo bhavanti |
kiṃca ᵥāpaḥ ᵥsarvasya prāṇijātasya ᵥbheṣajīḥ bheṣajabhūtā bhavanti na katipayasya |
ᵥtāḥ tathāvidhā āpaḥ ᵥte tava ᵥbheṣajaṃ ᵥkṛṇvantu kurvantu ||
hastābhyām | daśa'śākhābhyām | jihvā | vācaḥ | puraḥ'gavī | anāmayitnu'bhyām | tvā | tābhyām | tvā | upa | spṛśāmasi || 7 ||
ᵥdaśaśākhābhyāṃ daśāṅgulayaḥ śākhābhūtā yayoḥ tābhyāṃ prajāpateḥ ᵥhastābhyāṃ sṛjyamānā ᵥjihvā rasanā ᵥvācaḥ śabdasya ᵥpurogavī purato gantrī jātā |
vanāmayitṛbhyāṃ vsabhyagārogyahetṛbhyāṃ vtābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ he stotaḥ vtvā tvām vupa vspṛśāmasi upaspṛśāmaḥ|
‘tava tya’ iti ṣaṭṭcaṃ daśamaṃ sūktamurunagnaḥ putrasyājñasyetyasya jāgatamaindram|
tathā cānu- krāntaṃ—‘tava tya ṣaḻtrya aurvo jāgatam’ iti|
tava tya indra sakhyepu vahvaya ṛtaṃ manvānā vyadadirvalam|
yatrā daśasyanupasau riṇannapaḥ kutsāya manmanbrahmaśca duṃsayaḥ|
tava | tye | indra | sakhyepu | vahvayaḥ | ṛtam | manvānāḥ | vi | adadiḥ | valam | yatra | daśasyan | upasaḥ | riṇan | apaḥ | kutsāya | manman | ahnāḥ | ca | duṃsayaḥ|| 1||

he vindra vtava vsakhyepu sakhitveṣu satsu vtye te prasiddhāḥ vvahvayaḥ voḍhāro haviṣāṃ stutīnāṃ vā ata eva vṛtaṃ yajñaṃ vmanvānāḥ avabudhyamānāḥ aṅgirasaḥ vvalaṃ gavāmapahartārametatsajñakamasuraṃ vvyadadirḥ atyarthaṃ vyadārayan|

api ca vyatra yasmin kāle vmanman manmani stotre sati vkutsāya maharṣaye vupasaḥ upaḥkālān vṛtreṇāvṛtatvāt pūrvamasatprāyāstadapanodanena vdaśasyan prayacchan tathā vapaḥ vṛtreṇāvṛtyānudakāni ca vriṇan tasmādbhirgamayan vartase|
tadānīm vahnāḥ ahervṛtrasya vca vduṃsayaḥ karmāṇi vitathānyāsannityarthaḥ|
avāsṛjaḥ prasvaḥ śvaśrayau girīnudāja ustrā arpivo madhu priyam|
avadhayo vuninau asya daṃsasā śuśoca sūrya ṛtajātayā girā|
ava | asṛjaḥ | prasvaḥ | śvaśrayaḥ | girīn | ut | ājaḥ | ustrāḥ | arpivaḥ | madhu | priyam | avadhayaḥ | vuninau | asya | daṃsasā | śuśoca | sūryaḥ | ṛta'jātayā | girā|| 2||
tathā vgirīn parvatān balena gomato bilasya pidhanāya nihitān vśvaśrayaḥ agamayaḥ|
‘samānavākye nighātayuṣmadasmadādeśā vaktavyāḥ’ (pā. sū. 8. 1. 18. 5) iti vacanāt pūrva- padasyāsamānavākyagatatvenāsya ‘tiṅaṅatiṅaḥ’ iti nighātābhāvaḥ|
tathā valāsureṇa bile nihitā vustrāḥ gāḥ parvatabhedanānantaram vudājaḥ udagamayaḥ|
tataḥ payodadhyājyādikaṃ vpriyam anukūlaṃ vmadhu madhuraṃ haviḥ varpivaḥ pītavānasi|
śrayaṇasādhanāsu tāsu goṣvāgatāsu yajamānaiḥ priyaabhīṣṭaṃ madhu somātmakampibaḥ pibasi|
tadarthaṃ jātaṃ janma yasyāḥ tayā vgirā vedātmikayā vācā stūyamānasya vbhasya indrasya vdaṃsasā karmaṇā
āvṛṇvato vṛtrāderapi nodanātmakena sūryaḥ śuśoca nabhasi pradīpe |
'ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇe divi deva īyate' (tai. brā. 3. 12. 9. 1) ityādidaṃ taittarīyakamatrānusaṃdheyam ||
vi sūryo madhye amucadrathaṃ divo vidahāsārya pratimānamāryaḥ |
dṛḻahāni piprorsurasya māyina indro vyāsyaccakṛvā~ ṛjiśdhanā ||

vi | sūryaḥ | madhye | amucat | ratham | divaḥ | vidat | dāsāya | pratimānam | artheḥ | dṛḻahāni | piproḥ | asurasya | māyinaḥ | indraḥ | vi | āyat | cakṛvān | ṛjiśdhanā ||3|| divaḥ dyulokasya madhye sūryaḥ ādityaḥ ratha prasthānāya vi amucat vimuktavān | muceluṅi lditva
vimbā vibhunā vyāsena vibhindatā vidārayatā evaṃvidhenāpi parakīyabalena ayudhasenaḥ aprahatasenaḥ |
vimbā vibhuvyāṃso vibhindatā śatrubalāni vidārayatā vajreṇa |
vṛtrahā vṛtraṃ hatavān evaṃvidha indraḥ dāśat dāśati |
tathā tujyāni preryāṇi śatrubalāni tejate tanukuroti alpīkaroti |
śatrūn prati preryāṇyāyudhāni tejate niśyati tīkṣṇīkaroti |
īdṛśasya indrasya abhibhvaḥ abhito hisakāt vajrāt sarvaṃ śatrujātama abhibhet bhītiṃ prāpnot |
evamasurevindreṇa nirasteṣu śundhvyaḥ śodhayitādityaḥ prākrāmat jagatprakāśanāya gantuṃ prakrāntavān |
uṣāḥ uṣodevatā ca bhanaḥ svakīyaṃ śakaṭaṃ ratham ajahāt gantuṃ paryatyajat |
etā tyā te śrutyāni kevalā yadeka ekamakṛṇorayajñam |
māsāṃ vidhānamadhā adhi dyavi tvayā vibhinnaṃ bharati pradhi pitā ||
etā | tyā | te | śrutyāni | kevalā | yat | ekaḥ | ekam | akṛṇoḥ | ayajñam | māsām | tridhānam | adhāḥ | adhi | dyavi | tvayā | vi'bhinnam | bharati | pra'dhim | pitā || 6 ||
he indra syā tāni te tava tvadīyāni vīryakarmāṇi etā etāmyeva kevalā kevalāni śrutyāni śrotavyāni stutyarhāṇi |
ekaḥ asahāyasvam ekaṃ pradhānabhūtam ayajñaṃ yajñarahitamasuram akṛṇoḥ ahiṃsīriti yat etadekaṃ karma |
māsānāṃ vidhānaṃ vidhātāraṃ kartāraṃ sūryam adhi dyavi dyulaॉka upari adhāḥ adhārayaḥ |
vipūvān dadhāteḥ 'kṛtya- lyuṭo bahulam' iti kartari lyuṭ |
tathā pitā pālako dyulaॉkaḥ vibhinnaṃ vidāritaṃ vṛtrādvibhaktaṃ pradhi rathacakrasya pārśvam |
īdṛśaṃ sūryarathasambandhinaṃ pradhimanye- dhārayitumaśakyaṃ svayā eva bharati dhārayati |
etadabhṛtīni tvayā kṛtāni karmāṇi pareṣāmāsādhāraṇāni sarvadā stotavyānītyarthaḥ |
sa ca pūrveṇa ṛcena savitāraṃ stutavān uttareṇa svātmānam |
ataḥ prathamaṛcasya savitā devatā dvitīyasya gandharvaḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—' sūrya raśmirdevagandharvo viśvāvasurāmānastaut pūrvārdhe' iti |
tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvāntsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ ||
sūrya'raśmiḥ | harikeśaḥ | purastāt | savitā | jyotiḥ | ut | ayān | arjasam | tasya | pūṣā | pra'save | yāti | vidvān | sam'paśyan | viśvā | bhuvanāni | gopāḥ || 1 ||
upasaḥ prādurbhāvānantaraṃ sūryasyodayāt pūrvaṃ yaḥ kālastasya kālasyābhimānī devaḥ savitetyucyate |

ᵥsūryaraśmiḥ sūryasya sarvasya prerakasyādityasya raśmireva raśmiryasya sa tathoktaḥ ᵥhari- keśaḥ harayo haraṇaśīlā haritavarṇā vā keśāḥ keśasthānīyāḥ prakāśamānā vā dīsayo yasya īdṛśaḥ ᵥsavitā sarvasya prerako devaḥ ᵥpurastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi ᵥajasram anavarataṃ ᵥjyotiḥ tejaḥ ᵥudayān udyāti udyamayati ||
ᵥtasya savituḥ ᵥprasave preraṇe'nujñāyāṃ satyāṃ ᵥvidvān jānan ᵥgopāḥ gopāyitā rakṣitā ᵥpūṣā poṣako deva ādityaḥ ᵥyāti nabhasi gacchati |
ᵥviśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi ᵥbhuvanāni bhūta- jātāni ᵥsaṃpaśyan samyak prakāśayan ||
nucakṣā eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivātrodasī antarikṣam |
sa viśvācīrbhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum ||
nucakṣāḥ | eṣaḥ | divaḥ | madhye | āste | āpapri'vān | rodasī iti | antarikṣam | saḥ | viśvācīḥ | abhi | caṣṭe | ghṛtācīḥ | antarā | pūrvam | aparam | ca | ketum || 2 ||
ᵥnucakṣāḥ nūnaṃ manuṣyān paśyan yadvā nṛbhirnṛbhiḥ raśmibhiḥ prakāśamānaḥ ᵥeṣaḥ savitā ᵥdivaḥ dyulokasya ᵥmadhye ᵥāste niṣīdati |
ᵥrodasī dyāvāpṛthivyau ᵥantarikṣaṃ ca ᵥāpapridvān svatejasā āpūrayan ||
ᵥsaḥ devaḥ ᵥviśvācīḥ viśvamañcantīḥ sarvavyāpinīḥ prācyādi- mahādiśaḥ ᵥabhi ᵥcaṣṭe prakāśayati |
tathā ᵥghṛtācīḥ ghṛtaṃ dīptaṃ rūpamañcantīḥ āgneyyādidiśaśca prakāśayati ||
udāttanivṛttisvareṇa ṅīpa udāttatve prāpte ‘cau’ iti pūrvasyāca udāttatvam ||
tathā ᵥpūrvaṃ pūrvabhāgaṃ ᵥketuṃ prajñāpanīyam ᵥaparaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāgaṃ ᵥca ᵥantarā antarālaṃ ca abhi caṣṭe prakāśayati ||
rāyo budhnaḥ saṃgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpābhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ |
deveva savitā satyadharmeṃndro na tasthau samare dhanānām ||
rāyaḥ | budhnaḥ | sam'gamanaḥ | vasūnām | viśvā | rūpā | abhi | caṣṭe | śacībhiḥ | devaḥ'iva | savitā | satyadharmā | indraḥ | na | tasthau | sam'are | dhanānām || 3 ||
ᵥrāyaḥ dhanasya ᵥbudhnaḥ bandhako mūlabhūto vā ||
tathā ᵥvasūnāṃ dhanānāṃ ᵥsaṃgamanaḥ saṃgamayitā prāpayitā īdṛśaḥ savitā ᵥśacībhiḥ dīptibhiḥ ᵥviśvā ᵥrūpā sarvāṇi rūpāṇi nirūpaṇīyāni padārthajātāni ᵥabhi ᵥcaṣṭe abhipaśyati |
api ca ᵥdevahva ayaṃ ᵥsavitā sāvako devaḥ ᵥsatyadharmā satyavaditathaṃ dharmaṃ dhāraṇaṃ dhāraṇa- hetubhūtaṃ karma vā yasya tādṛśo bhavati |
tathā ᵥindro ᵥna indra iva ᵥdhanānāṃ ᵥsamare saṃgrāme samyak- prāpaṇe ᵥtasthau |

viśvāvasuṃ soma gandharvamāpo dadṛśuṣīstadṛtenā vyāyan | tadanvavaidindro rarahāṇa āsāṃ pari sūryasya paridhī~rapaśyat || 4 || viś‍va'vasum | soma | gandharvam | āpaḥ | dadṛśuṣīḥ | tat | ṛtena | vi | āyan | tat | anu'avait | indraḥ | rarahāṇaḥ | āsām | pari | sūryasya | pari'dhīn | apaśyat || 4 ||
he 'soma tvayā sahitaṃ 'gandharvaṃ gītarūpāṃ gāṃ śabdaṃ dhārayantaṃ 'viśvāvasum etasaṃjñaṃ mām |
buddhvā ca kutra yajñaḥ pravṛtta iti 'sūryasya 'paridhīn parito dhīyamānān prācyādidigbhāgān 'pari 'apaśyat parito dṛṣṭavān ||

viśvāvasurbhi tannau gṛṇātu divyo gandharvo rajaso vimānaḥ | yadvā dhā satyamuta yanna vidma dhiyau hinvāno dhiya ihau avyāḥ || 5 || viś‍va'vasuḥ | abhi | tat | naḥ | gṛṇātu | divyaḥ | gandharvaḥ | rajasaḥ | vi'mānaḥ | yat | vā | gha | satyam | uta | yat | na | vidma | dhiyaḥ | hinvānaḥ | dhiyaḥ | it | naḥ | avyāḥ || 5 ||
dhiyaḥ stutīrhinvānaḥ prāpnuvan 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'dhiya it karmāṇyaiva buddhīreva vā 'avyāḥ rakṣa ||

sasminvindaccaraṇe nudīnāmprāviṇuduhuro aśmavrajānām | prāsāṃ gandharvo amṛtāni vocadindro dakṣaṃ pari jānādahīnām || 6 || sasmin | avindat | caraṇe | nadīnām | arpa | avṛṇot | duraḥ | aśma'vrajānām | pra | āsām | gandharvaḥ | amṛtāni | vocat | indraḥ | dakṣam | pari | jānāt | ahīnām || 6 ||

'sasmin añjiḥ saṃsthātaṃ prakarṣeṇa sarvasya jagataḥ snāpayitāraṃ megham | ‘ṇvā śauce’ | ‘ādagamahana’ iti kinpratyayaḥ | liṅgavyatyāsāt dvivacanam | 'nadīnāṃ śabdakāriṇīnāmapāṃ 'caraṇe saṃcāraṇasthāne 'ntarikṣe 'avindat | indro'labhata | labdhvā ca 'aśmavrajānām | aśma vyāpto meghaḥ | tatra vrajantīnām | yadvā | megho vrajo goṣṭhaṃ nivāsasthānaṃ yāsāṃ tādṛśīnām | apāṃ
ajhamasu śilāsu vrajantīnāṃ gacchantīnāṃ vyāptagamanānāṃ vā nadīnāṃ gaṅgāyamunādīnāṃ caraṇe saṃcaraṇe nimittabhūte sati tadarthamindraḥ sarrsina meghamavindat alabhata |
labdhvā cāntargatānāmapāṃ nirgamasādhanāni meghasya duro dvārāṇi apāvṛṇot apāvṛtavān |
tathā ^āsāṃ nadīnām ^amṛtāni amaraṇasādhakāni ^udakāni ^gandharvaḥ gorvajrasya dhatāṃ viśvāvasu rūpeṇa vartamānaḥ ^indraḥ ^pra ^vocat prabravīti |
tādṛśaṃ megham ^ahīnāṃ meghānāṃ madhye ^pari ^jānāt paritaḥ sarvato jānāti |
atha tisraḥ satobṛhatyaḥ 'ayujau jāgatau' (anu. 8. 4) iti lakṣaṇopetāḥ |
tathā cānukrāntam—'agne tavāgniḥ pāvaka āgneyaṃ viṣṭārapaṅktistisraḥ satobṛhatya upariṣṭājjyotiḥ' iti |
agne tava śravo vayo mahiṃ ājante arcayo vibhāvaso |
bṛhaddāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||
agne | tava | śravaḥ | | vayaḥ | | mahi | | ājante | arcayaḥ | vibhāvaso | bṛhaddāno iti bṛhat'bhāno | śavasā | vājam | ukthyam | dadhāsi | dāśuṣe | kave ||1||
saiva vasu dhanaṃ yasya tādṛśe ^arcayaḥ dīptayaḥ ^mahi mahat bahulaṃ ^ājante dīpyante |
he ^bṛhaddāno prauḍhadīpte ^kave krāntadarśina'gne evaṃmahānubhāvastvaṃ ^śavasā balena upetam ^ukthyaṃ praśastam |
tadyogyaṃ ^vājam annaṃ ^dāśuṣe havīṃṣi dattavate yajamānāya ^dadhāsi dadāsi prayacchasi ||
putro mātrā vicaranupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||
pāvaka'varccāḥ | śukra'varccāḥ | anūna'varccāḥ | ut | iyarṣi | bhānunā | putraḥ | mātrā | vi'caran | upa | avasi | pṛṇakṣi | rodasī iti | ubhe iti || 2 ||
sa tvaṃ ^putraḥ san ^mātarā mātṛbhūte araṇyau ^vicaran dhāvasāne viśeṣeṇa prāpnuvan ^upāvasi upagatān yajamānān rakṣasi |
haviṣā dyulokaṃ vṛṣṭyai lokaṃ ca pūrayasītyarthaḥ |
ubhe rodasī dyāvāpṛthivyo pṛṇakṣi tejasā pūrayasi |
dhūmenāmuṃ lokaṃ pūrayati vṛṣṭyai iti vājasaneyakaṃ |

ūrjā napājātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ | tve iṣaḥ saṃ dadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ || 3 || ūrjaḥ | napāt | jāta'vedaḥ | suśasti'bhiḥ | mandasva | dhīti'bhiḥ | hitaḥ | tve iti | iṣaḥ | sam | dadhuḥ | bhūri'varpasaḥ | citra'ūtayaḥ | vāma'jātāḥ || 3 ||
he ūrjaḥ napāt ūrjaḥ annasya pārthivasyāraṇyādeḥ putra he jātavedaḥ jātānāṃ veditaragne suśastibhiḥ asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaiḥ mandasva modasva |
tathā dhītibhiḥ karmabhirasmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaiḥ agnihotrādibhiḥ hitaḥ suhitaḥ tṛpto bhava |
bahuvidha-rūpāḥ citrotayaḥ citrā vicitrotistṛstiyāsāṃ tāstathoktāḥ vāmajātāḥ vāmaṃ vananīyaṃ jātaṃ janma yāsāṃ tādṛśīḥ iṣaḥ annāni havirlakṣaṇāni tve tvayyeva saṃ dadhuḥ saṃdadhati |
tadānīṃ citrotaya ityasya vicitrarakṣā iti yojyam ||

irajyane prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya | sa darśitasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum || 4 || irajyan | agne | prathayasva | jantu'bhiḥ | asme iti | rāyaḥ | amartya | saḥ | darśitasya | vapuṣaḥ | vi | rājasi | pṛṇakṣi | sānasim | kratum || 4 ||
he agne jantubhiḥ jātaiḥ śatrubhiḥ saha irajyan īrṣyan spardhāṃ kurvan |
he amartya maraṇarahita agne asme asmākam |
śaso vā vyatyayena 'uḍiḍam' iti tribhaktyudāttatvaṃ na kriyate |
saḥ tvaṃ darśitasya darśanīyasya vapuṣaḥ tejomayasya śarīrasya vi rājasi |
darśanīyena rūpeṇa vi rājasi viśeṣeṇa īśiṣe |
ata eva sānasiṃ saṃbhajanīyaṃ kratuṃ karma pṛṇakṣi asmābhiḥ saṃpardhayasi |

iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ | rāti vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim || 5 || iṣkartāram | adhvarasya | pra'cetasam | kṣayantam | rādhasaḥ | mahaḥ | rāti | vāmasya | su'bhagām | mahīm | iṣam | dadhāsi | sānasim | rayim || 5 ||
adhvarasya yajñasya niṣkartāraṃ saṃskartāraṃ pracetasaṃ prakṛṣṭajñānaṃ mahaḥ mahataḥ rādhasaḥ dhanasya kṣayantaṃ īśvaram |
sa tvaṃ subhagāṃ saubhāgyapetāṃ mahīṃ mahatīm iṣam annaṃ sānasiṃ saṃbhaktavyaṃ rayiṃ dhanaṃ ca dadhāsi stotṛbhyo dadāsi ||

ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ | śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā || 6 || ṛta'vānam | mahiṣam | viśva'darśatamam | agnim | sumnāya | dadhire | puraḥ | janāḥ | śrut'karṇam | saprathaḥ'tamam | tvā | girā | daivyam | mānuṣā | yugā || 6 ||
mahiṣaṃ mahantaṃ pūjyaṃ vā viśvadarśataṃ viśvaiḥ sarvairdarśanīyam |
īdṛśam agniṃ sumnāya sukhārthaṃ janāḥ ṛtvijyajamāna- rūpāḥ puraḥ dadhire puro dadhate |
yadvā puraḥ purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi āhavanīyarūpeṇa dhārayanti |

api ca he agne śrutkarṇaṃ śrut stutīḥ samyak śṛṇvan karṇaḥ śrotrendriyaṃ yasya tādṛśaṃ saprathastamam atiśayena prakhyātaṃ yadvā sarvato vistārya- māṇaṃ daivyaṃ devānāṃ havirvoḍhṛtvena saṃbandhanam īdṛśaṃ tvā tvāṃ mānuṣā mānuṣāṇi manorathyāni yugā yugāni yugāni patnīyajamānarūpāṇi girā stutyā stuvantīti śeṣaḥ ||
‘agne’ iti ṣaṭ ca trayodaśaṃ sūktaṃ tāpasaguṇaviśiṣṭasyāgnerārṣaṃ vaiśvadevamānuṣṭubham |

agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ sumanā bhava | pra nau yaccha viśaspate dhanadā asi nustvam || 1 || agne | acchā | vada | iha | naḥ | pratyaṅ | naḥ | su'manāḥ | bhava | pra | naḥ | yaccha | viśaḥ | pate | dhana'dāḥ | asi | naḥ | tvam || 1 ||
he agne iha asmin deśe naḥ asmān acchā vada ābhimukhyena priyaṃ brūhi |
tathā pratyaṅ naḥ asmān pratyañcaṃ sumanāḥ śobhanamanasko bhava |
he viśaspate yajamānalakṣaṇāyāḥ prajāyāḥ pālayitaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ pra yaccha dhanāni pradehi yataḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ dhanadāḥ asi dhanānāṃ dātā bhavasi ||

pra nau yacchatvaryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ | pra devāḥ prota sūnṛtā rāyo devī dadātu naḥ || 2 || pra | naḥ | yacchatu | aryamā | pra | bhagaḥ | pra | bṛhaspatiḥ | pra | devāḥ | pra | uta | sūnṛtā | rāyaḥ | devī | dadātu | naḥ || 2 ||
aryamā arīṇāṃ niyantā aryāṇāṃ nirmātā vaitarasaṃjño devaḥ naḥ asmabhyaṃ pra yacchatu dhanam |
tathā bhagaḥ etatsaṃjñako devaśca pra yacchatu |
uta api ca sūnṛtā priyasatyāvācā devī devanaśīlā sarasvatī rāyaḥ dhanāni naḥ asmabhyaṃ pra dadātu ||

somaṃ rājānamarvase'gniṃ gīrbhirhavāmahe | ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryyaṃ brahmaṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim || 3 || somam | rājānam | arvase | agnim | gīḥ'bhiḥ | havāmahe | ādityān | viṣṇum | sūryyam | brahmaṇam | ca | bṛhaspatim || 3 ||
▼rājānaṃ rājamānamīśvaraṃ vā ▼somam ▼agniṃ ca ▼gīrbhiḥ stutibhiḥ ▼avase rakṣaṇārthaṃ ▼havāmahe āhvayāmahe |
tathā ▼ādityān aditaḥ putrān mitrādīn ▼viṣṇuṃ ▼sūryyaṃ ▼brahmaṇaṃ prajāpatiṃ ▼bṛhaspatiṃ ▼ca rakṣaṇārthamāhvayāmahe ||

indravāyū bṛhaspatīṃ suhave havāmahe | yathā naḥ sarva ijñataḥ saṅgatyāṃ sumanā asat || 4 || indravāyū iti | bṛhaspatim | su'havā | iha | havāmahe | yathā | naḥ | sarvaḥ | it | janaḥ | sam'gatyām | su'manāḥ | asat || 4 ||
'ubhayatra vāyoḥ pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' (pā. sū. 6. 3. 26. 1) ityānaṅaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ |
'nottarapade'nudāttādau' iti 'devatādvandve ca' iti prāptasyobhayapadaprakṛti- svarasya niṣedhaḥ |
▼suhavā suhavau suhavānau indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ ca ▼iha asmin karmaṇi ▼havāmahe āhvayāmahe |
▼yathā ▼naḥ asmākaṃ ▼sarva ▼it sarva eva ▼janaḥ ▼saṅgatyāṃ saṃgamane dhanasya prāptau ▼sumanāḥ ▼asat śobhana- manasko bhavet tathā āhvayāmahe ityarthaḥ |

aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya | vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam || 5 || aryamaṇam | bṛhaspatim | indram | dānāya | codaya | vātam | viṣṇum | sarasvatīm | savitāram | ca | vājinam || 5 ||
he stotaḥ aryamādīn devān ▼dānāya dhanapradānāya ▼codaya stutyā preraya |
tathā ▼vātaṃ vāyuṃ ▼viṣṇuṃ ▼sarasvatīṃ ▼vājinaṃ annavantaṃ balavantaṃ vā ▼savitāraṃ ▼ca dānāya preraya ||

tvaṃ nau agne agnibhirbrahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya | tvaṃ nau devatātaye rāyo dānāya codaya || 6 || tvam | naḥ | agne | agni'bhiḥ | brahma | yajñam | ca | vardhaya | tvam | naḥ | deva'tātaye | rāyaḥ | dānāya | codaya || 6 ||
tathā cānukrāntam—'ayamagne dvṛcāḥ śāṅga jaritā droṇaḥ sārisuktaḥ stambamitraścāgne- yamāye jagatyau catasraśca triṣṭubhaḥ' iti |
ayamagne jaritā tve abhūdapi sahasaḥ sūno nahyanyadasyāpyam |
bhadraṃ hi śarma trirūpamasti ta āre hiṃsānāmarpa dvidhumā kṛdhi ||
ayam | agne | jaritā | tve iti | abhūt | api | sahasaḥ | sūno iti | nahi | anyat | asti | āpyam | bhadram | hi | śarma | tri'rūpam | asti | te | āre | hiṃsānām | arpa | dvidhum | ā | kṛdhi || 1 ||
he sahasaḥ sūno balasya putra tvattaḥ anyat āpyam āptavyaṃ nahi asti na khalu vidyate |
bhadraṃ kalyāṇaṃ trirūpaṃ duḥkhatrayasya nivārakaṃ śarma sukhaṃ hi yasmāt te tava asti vidyate |
athavā śobhanaṃ trirūpaṃ tribhūmikaṃ gṛhaṃ tavāsti hi |
ataḥ hiṃsānāṃ hiṃsyamānānāsmākam āre dūre didhuṃ dīpyamānāmāramīyāṃ jvālām apa ā kṛdhi apākuru nivāraya |
pravattai agne janimā pitūtaḥ sācīva viśvā bhuvanā nyañjase |
pra sasruṣaḥ pra sanipanta no dhiyaḥ puraścaranti paśupāiva tmanā ||
pra'vat | te | agne | janimā | pituḥ'yanaḥ | sācīva | viśvā | bhuvanā | ni | añjase | pra | sasruṣaḥ | pra | sanipanta | naḥ | dhiyaḥ | puraḥ | caranti | paśupaḥ'iva | tmanā || 2 ||
he agne pitūtaḥ pitumaṃ bhakṣyamicchan te tava janima janma prādurbhavataṃ pravat prakṛṣṭa- mutkṛṣṭaṃ bhavati |
sa tvaṃ sācīva saciva iva viśvā viśvāni vyāsāni bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni nyañjase2 prasādhayasi |
sasruṣaḥ sarpaṇaśīlāḥ naḥ asmākaṃ dhiyaḥ stutayaḥ tādṛśaṃ tvāṃ pra sanipanta prakarṣeṇa saṃbhajante |
sarpaṇaśīlā aśvā yathāji prakarṣeṇa saṃbhajante tathā asmadīyā dhiya ityarthaḥ |
anantaraṃ puraḥ tava purastāt tmanā ātmanā svayameva caranti vyāpya vartante |
paśupāiva yathā paśūnāṃ pālakā gopālāḥ pālayitavyānāṃ purastāt saṃcaranti tadvat ||
uta vā u pariṃ vṛṇakṣi bapsadhorama ulapasya svadhāvaḥ |
uta khilyā urvarāṇāṃ bhavanti mā tai heti tarvipīṃ cukudhāma ||
uta | vai | oṃ iti | pari̭ | vṛ॒ṇakṣi | ba॒psat | ba॒hoḥ | a̭gne | u॒lapasya | sva॒dhā'vaḥ | uta | khi॒lyāḥ | ṷrdharā̭ṇām | bha॒vanti | mā | tḙ | he॒tim | tā॒rvī̭m | cu॒ku॒dhām || 3 ||
he Vsvadhāvaḥ dīptiman Vagne Vbapsat vahan |
sarvaṃ vanam Vuta Vvai api khalu Vpari Vvṛṇakṣi parivarjayasi vināśayasi |
tāsāṃ saṃbandhanaḥ pradeśāḥ Vkhilyāḥ khilyāḥ prāṇibhirgantuṃ yogyāḥ Vbhavanti |

utte śuṣmā jihatāmucai arciruccai agne śaśamānasya vājāḥ | ucchvasva ni nem vardhamāna ā tvādha viśve vasavaḥ sadantu || 6 || ut | te | śuṣmāḥ | jihatām | ut | te | arciḥ | ut | te | agne | śaśamānasya | vājāḥ | ut | śvasva | ni | nama | vardhamānaḥ | ā | tvā | adya | viśve | vasavaḥ | sadantu ||6||

he agne te tava śuṣmāḥ śoṣakā jvālāḥ ut jihatām uccalantu | tathā te tava arciḥ dīmiśra uccalatu | śaśamānasya stūyamānasya | yadvā | 'śaśa plutagatau' | asmāttācchīlika- śrānaś | tasya sārvadhātukatve sati lasārvadhātukatvābhāvāt 'citaḥ' ityantodāttatvameva śiṣyate | śaśamānasya sarvaṃ vanamākramya śīghraṃ gacchataḥ | tava vājāḥ vegāḥ he agne ujjihatām | sa tvaṃ vardhamānaḥ san ucchvasva vana ucchvasva | 'śvaci gatau' | bhauvādikaḥ | i
puṇḍarīkāṇi padmāni ca teṣu hṛdeṣu jāyantām |
tatastasya jaladheḥ ime asminviśvāsapradeśe gṛhāḥ āśrayabhūtā bhavantu |

he ▼maghavan ▼tvāvṛdhaḥ tvayā vardhitaḥ ▼dāśvadhvaraḥ dattayajño yajamānaḥ ▼nṛbhiḥ netṛbhirṛtvigbhirvā ▼dhanā dhanāni ▼vājam annaṃ ca ▼makṣu śīghraṃ ▼bharate saṃpādayati ||
tvaṃ śardhāya mahinā gṛṇāna uru kṛdhi maghavañchṛdhi rāyaḥ |
tvaṃ nau mitro varuṇo na māyī pitvo na dasma dayase vibhaktā ||
tvam | śardhāya | mahinā | gṛṇānaḥ | uru | kṛdhi | maghavan | śṛdhi | rāyaḥ | tvam | naḥ | mitraḥ | varuṇaḥ | na | māyī | pitvaḥ | na | dasma | dayase | vi'bhaktā ||5||
he indra ▼tvaṃ ▼mahinā mahatā stotreṇa ▼gṛṇānaḥ stūyamānaḥ san ▼śardhāya śardha balam ▼uru ▼kṛdhi vistīrṇaṃ kuru |
he ▼dasma darśanīyendra ▼vibhaktā viśeṣeṇa dhanānāṃ bhājayitā ▼tvaṃ ▼mitro ▼varuṇo ▼na mitravaruṇavacca ▼māyī prajñāyuktaḥ san ▼naḥ asmabhyam |
‘supvāṇāsaḥ’ iti pañcaviṃśa sūktaṃ venaputrasya pṛthorāpa traiṣṭubhamaindram |
supvāṇāsa indra stumasi tvā sasrāṃsaśca tuvinṛmṇa vājam |
ā nau bhara suvṛtaṃ yasya cākanmanā tanā sanuyāma tvotāḥ ||
su'pvāṇāsaḥ | indra | stumasi | tvā | sasa'trāṃsaḥ | ca | tuvi'nṛmṇa | vājam | ā | naḥ | bhara | su'vṛtam | yasya | cākan | tmanā | tanā | sanuyāma | tvā'ūtāḥ ||1||
he ▼tuvinṛmṇa bahubala bahudhana vā ▼vājaṃ carupuroḍāśādilakṣaṇamannaṃ ▼sasatrāṃsaḥ saṃbhaktavantaḥ ▼ca vayaṃ tvāṃ stumaḥ |
yata eva- mato hetoḥ ▼naḥ asmabhyaṃ ▼suvṛtaṃ suṣṭhu prāptavyaṃ śobhanaṃ dhanam ▼ā ▼bhara āhara prayaccha |
vistṛtāni dhanāni ▼tmanā ātmanā svayamevānyanirapekṣayaiva ▼sanuyāma tava prasādāllabhāmahe ||
ṛṣvastvamindra śūra jāto dāsīrvinaḥ sūryeṇa sahyāḥ |
guhā hitaṃ guhaṃ gūḻahampsu bibhramāsi prasvaṇe na somam ||
ṛṣvaḥ | tvam | indra | śūra | jātaḥ | dāsīḥ | viśaḥ | sūryeṇa | sahyāḥ | guhā | hitam | guham | gūḻaham | apsu | bibhramāsi | prasvaṇe | na | somam || 2 ||
he ᵥśūra śauryavan ᵥindra ᵥṛtvaḥ mahān darśanīyo vā ᵥtvaṃ ᵥjātaḥ jātamātra eva ᵥdāsīḥ |
tatsambandhino ᵥviśaḥ prajāḥ ᵥsūryeṇa sūryātmanā ᵥsahyāḥ abhyabhavaḥ |
tathā ᵥguhā guhāyāṃ ᵥhitaṃ nihitamata eva ᵥguhyam adṛśyaṃ valākhyamasuram ᵥapsu udakeṣu ᵥgūḍhaṃ nigūḍhaṃ kuyavākhyaṃ ca tvamabhi
śrudhī havamindra śūra pṛthvyā uta stavase venasyārkaiḥ |
ā yaste yoniṃ ghṛtavantamsvārūrmirna nimnairdravayanta vakāḥ ||
śrudhi | havam | indra | śūra | pṛthvyāḥ | uta | stavase | venasya | arkaiḥ | ā | yaḥ | te | yonim | ghṛta'vantam | astvāḥ | ūrmiḥ | na | nimnaiḥ | dravayanta | vakāḥ ||5||
he śūra indra pṛthvyāḥ pṛthvyarpairamaṃ havam āhvānaṃ śrudhi śṛṇu |
uta api ca venasya venaputrasya mama arkaiḥ mantraiḥ stavase stūyase |
yaḥ stotā ghṛtavantam udakavantaṃ te tava yoniṃ nivāsabhūmim ā astvāḥ abhyasvāpīt abhyaṣṭaut |
’ asmālluṅi tipi ‘bahula̭ chandasi’ itīḍabhāve halḍyādilope ca ‘rāstasya’ iti salopaḥ |
yajñagṛhaṃ prāpya te tvāṃ yo'bhiṣṭauti tasya venasya arkairityanvayaḥ |
anye'pi sarve stotāraḥ nimnaiḥ pravarṇaimārgeḥ ūrminaṃ udakasaṃgha iva dravayanta |
’ iti pañcarcamekaviṃśaṃ sūktaṃ hiraṇyastūpaputrasyārcata ārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ savitadeva- tyam |
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘savitārcana̭ hairaṇyastūpaḥ sā tritram’ iti |
savitā | yantraiḥ | pṛthivīm | aramṇāt | askambhane | savitā | dyām | ahat | aśmam'iva | adhukṣat | dhunim | antarikṣam | anṛtaiṃ | baddham | savitā | samudram || 1 ||
savitā sarvasya prasavitā prerako madhyamasthāno devaḥ so'yaṃ yantraiḥ yamanasādhanairvṛṣṭipradānādi- bhirupāyairvāyavīyaiḥ pārśvīṃ pṛthivīṃ prathitāṃ bhūmim aramṇāt aramayat |
tadrahite sthale dyāṃ dyuloka- mapi ahat dṛḍhīkṛtavān |

aśmamiva dhuniṃ kampayitavyaṃ kampayitāraṃ vā antarikṣam antarā kṣāntaṃ madhyamasthānagatam atṛtaṃ kenāpya- hiṃsitaiśvaramāṇe vā nabhasi vāyavīyaiḥ pāśaiḥ baddhaṃ samudraṃ meghamayameva savitā adhukṣat uda- kāni dogdhi |
atṛteṃ'tarikṣe baddhaṃ samudritāraṃ dhuniṃ kampanīyaṃ meghamaśmamivādhukṣat |
yathā śikṣakaḥ sādī aśvaṃ kleśayatyevaṃ varṣaṇāya meghaṃ kleśayatītyarthaḥ |

atra niruktaṃ—‘savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīmaramayadanāra- mbhaṇe'ntarikṣe savitā ghārmadahadamaśmamivādhukṣadunirantarikṣe meghaṃ baddhamatṛteṃ baddhamatṛtaṃ iti vārvaramāṇa iti vā savitā samudritāram’ (niru. 10. 32) iti ||
yatrā samudraḥ skaṃbhito vyaun‌dapāṃ napātasavitā tasya veda |
ato bhūrata ā utthitaṃ rajo'to dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
yatra | samudraḥ | skaṃbhitaḥ | vi | aunat | apām | napāt | savitā | tasya | veda | ataḥ | bhūḥ | ataḥ | ā | utthitam | rajaḥ | ataḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī iti | aprathetām ||2||
^yatra yasminnantarikṣe ^samudraḥ samudranaśīlo meghaḥ ^skaṃbhitaḥ stambhito vāyupāścairbaddhaḥ san ^vyaun‌t viśeṣeṇa bhūmimunnatti udakaiḥ kledayati |
he ^apāṃ ^napāta madhyamasyāna vaiśvānare tava sambandhī ^savitā prerako devaḥ ^tasya tasthānaṃ ^veda vetti jānāti |
^ataḥ eva ^utthitam ūrdhvamavasthitaṃ ^rajaḥ antarikṣaṃ ca ^āḥ āsīt ajāyata |
śobhanamanaskā duhānā dogdhī bahupayaskā vāścaiva hambhāravāramakaṃ śabdaṃ kurvatī gauryathā'mīyaṃ vatsam abhigacchati |
patiriva yathā bhartā jāyāṃ svabhāyāṃ śīghramibhagacchati evameva savitā naḥ asmān ni abhi etu nitarāmabhigacchatu |
divaḥ dyulokasya dhartā dhārayitā avasthāpayitā vā ata eva viśvavāraḥ sarvairvarṇīyaḥ ||
hiraṇyastūpaḥ savitaryathā tvāṅgiraso juhe vāje asmin |
evā tvārcannarvase vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ prati jāgrāham ||
hiraṇya'stūpaḥ | savitaḥ | yathā | tvā | āṅgirasaḥ | juhe | vāje | asmin | eva | tvā | arcan | arbase | vandamānaḥ | somasya'iva | aṃśum | prati | jāgra | aham ||5||

he savitaḥ preraka tvā tvām āṅgirasaḥ āṅgirasaḥ putraḥ hiraṇyastūpaḥ mama pitā asmin vāje anne nimittabhūte sati yathā juhe āhūtavān eva evam arcan etadaṃjño'haṃ tvā tvām avase avanāya rakṣaṇārthaṃ vandamānaḥ stuvan āhvayāmīti śeṣaḥ |
āhvaya ca soma- syevāṃśuṃ yathā somalatāṃ prati yajamānā jāgrati yāgaparyantaṃ tadakṣaṇe prabuddhā vartante tathā ahaṃ tvatpari- cayāṃ prati jāgara jāgarti |
atra niruktaṃ—‘hiraṇyastūpo hiraṇyayastūpo hiraṇyamayaḥ stūpo'syeti vā |
savitaryathā tvāṅgiraso juhe vāje'sminnavaṃ tvārcannavanāya vandamānaḥ somasyevāṃśuṃ pratijāgartyaham’ (niru. 10. 35) iti ||
‘samiddhaḥ’ iti pañca ca dvāviṃśaṃ sūktaṃ vasiṣṭhaputrasya mṛḻīkasyārṣamāgneyam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘samiddho mṛḻīko vāsiṣṭha āgneyaṃ bārhatamantye upariṣṭājjyotipī jagatyupānyā vā’ iti |
ādityai rudrairvasubhir ā gaṃhi mṛḻīkāya na ā gaṃhi ||
sama'iddhaḥ | cit | sam | idhyase | devebhyaḥ | havya'vāhana | ādityaiḥ | rudraiḥ | vasu'bhiḥ | naḥ | ā | gahi | mṛḻīkāya | naḥ | ā | gahi || 1 ||
he havyavāhana havyānāṃ haviṣāṃ voḍharame samiddhaścit saṃdīpto'pi devebhyaḥ yāgārthaṃ samidhyase |
sa tvam ādityaiḥ ādityādibhistribhirgaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ naḥ asmān ā gahi āgaccha |
tathā naḥ asmākaṃ mṛḻīkāya sukhāya tadarthamapi ā gahi |

1. ga-ta-bha-sati tvā tvāṃ | 2. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ma- ‘evamarcan’ nāsti | 3. ta1.2.3.4. 5.6.8-ma- ‘hiraṇyamayastūposyeti | 4. ta1.2.3-ma- ‘vā’ nāsti | 5. ga-juhe hyatra; ta1.2.3. 6.8-ma-juhe hyata | 6. ta-bha-vājene evaṃ | 7. anu.-vāsiṣṭho mṛḻīkaḥ | kra. 4-53
imam | yajñam | idam | varcaḥ | jujuṣāṇaḥ | upa'ārgahi | marttaḥ | tvā | sama'idhāna | havāmahe | mṛḻīkārya | hvayāmahe || 2 ||
he agne 'imam asmābhiḥ kriyamāṇaṃ purovartinaṃ 'yajñamidaṃ 'vacaḥ stotraṃ ca 'jujuṣāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ 'upāgāhi upāgaccha |
he 'samidhāna samidhyamāna 'marttaḥ marttā manuṣyāḥ 'tvā tvāṃ 'havāmahe āhvayāmahe |

tvāmu jātavedasaṃ triśvavāraṃ gṛṇe dhiyā | agne devā~ ā vaha naḥ priyavratān mṛḻīkārya priyavratān || 3 || tvām | ū~ itiṃ | jāta'vedasam | viśva'vāram | gṛṇe | dhiyā | agne | devān | ā | vaha | naḥ | priya'vratān | mṛḻīkārya | priya'vratān || 3 ||
he 'agne 'triśvavāraṃ viśvaiḥ sarvairvarṇīyaṃ 'jātavedasaṃ 'jātānāṃ vedināraṃ jātaprajñaṃ jātadhanaṃ vā 'tvāmu tvāmeva 'dhiyā stutyā 'gṛṇe staumi |
'priyavratān priyāṇi vratāni karmāṇi yeṣāṃ tādṛśān 'devān 'naḥ asmadartham 'ā 'vaha 'ānaya |

agnirdevo devānāṃbhavatpurohito'gniṃ manuṣyā 'ṛṣayaḥ samīdhire | agniṃ muho dhanasātāvahaṃ huve mṛḻīkaṃ dhanasātaye || 4 || agniḥ | devaḥ | devānām | abhavat | puraḥ'hitaḥ | 'agnim | manuṣyāḥ | ṛṣayaḥ | sam | īdhire | agnim | muhaḥ | dhana'sātau | aham | huve | mṛḻīkam | dhana'sātaye || 4 ||
yata evamataḥ kāraṇāt tameva 'agnim 'ṛṣayaḥ atīndriyārthadarśino 'manuṣyāḥ mānavā yajamānāḥ 'samīdhire saṃdīpayanti |
api ca tam 'agniṃ 'mahaḥ mahataḥ 'dhanasātau dhanasya saṃbhajane nimittabhūte 'ahaṃ 'huve āhvaye |
'dhanasātaye dhanalābhārthaṃ 'mṛḻīkaṃ sukhametatsaṃjñaṃ vā māṃ so'gniḥ karotvityarthaḥ ||

agniratriṃ bharadvājaṃ gaviṣṭhiraṃ prāvannaḥ kaṇvaṃ trasadasyumāhave | agniṃ vasiṣṭho havate purohito mṛḻīkārya purohitaḥ || 5 || agniḥ | atrim | bharadvājam | gaviṣṭhiram | pra | āvat | naḥ | kaṇvam | trasadasyum | ā'have | agnim | vasiṣṭhaḥ | havate | puraḥ'hitaḥ | mṛḻīkārya | puraḥ'hitaḥ || 5 ||
'purohitaḥ purohitavatkārī mama pitā 'vasiṣṭhaḥ ṛṣiḥ 'agniṃ 'havate stuti- bhirāhvayati |
sa cāhūtaḥ 'mṛḻīkāya sukhārthametatsaṃjñāya vā mahyaṃ 'purohitaḥ purodhāḥ devānāṃ puraḥsthāpa- yitā bhavatu ||
tathā cānukramyate—‘śraddhayā śraddhā kāmāyanī śrāddhamānuṣṭubhaṃ tu’ iti |

śraddhayāgniḥ samidhyate śraddhayā hūyate haviḥ | śraddhāṃ bhagasya mūrdhani vacasā vedayāmasi || 1 || śraddhayā | agniḥ | sam | idhyate | śraddhayā | hūyate | haviḥ | śraddhām | bhagasya | mūrdhani | vacasā | ā | vedayāmasi || 1 ||
tayā śraddhayā agniḥ gārhapatyādiḥ samidhyate saṃdīpyate |
yadā hi puruṣe śraddhāgnigocara ādaratiśayo jāyate tadaiva puruṣo'gnīn prajvālayati nānyadā |
'devā 'yajamānā: manuṣyāśca 'vāyugopā: vāyugopā rakṣitā yeṣāṃ te' tādṛśā: santaḥ 'śraddhāṃ devīṃ 'upāsate prārthayante |
tathāvidhayā 'ākūtyā saṃkalparūpayā kriyayā 'śraddhām eva paricaranti sarve janā: |
yata: kāraṇāt 'śraddhayā hetubhūtayā 'vasu dhanaṃ 'vindate labhate śraddhāvānna: |
śraddhāṃ sūryasya nimnuci śraddhe śraddhāpayeha na: ||
śraddhām | prāta: | havāmahe | śraddhām | madhyaṃdinam | pari | śraddhām | sūryasya | ni'muci | śraddhe | śrat | dhāpaya | iha | na: || 5 ||
'sūryasya sarvasya prerakasyādityasya 'nimnuci astamayavelāyāṃ sāyaṃsamaye'pi tāmeva 'śraddhām āhvayāmahe |
īdṛmūpe he 'śraddhe 'na: asmān 'iha' loke karmaṇi vā 'śraddhāpaya śraddhāvata: kuru ||
tatra 'śāsa itthā' iti pañcacaṃ prathamaṃ sūktaṃ bharadvāja- putrasya śāsanānna ārṣamānuṣṭubhamaindram |
na yasya hanyate sakhā na jīryate kadā cana ||
śāsa: | itthā | mahān | asi | amitra'khāda: | adbhuta: | na | yasya | hanyate | sakhā | na | jīryate | kadā | cana || 1 ||
he indra tvaṃ 'mahā~ asi sarvebhyo'dhiko bhavasi |
'amitrakhāda: amitrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ' khāditā vināśayitā ata eva 'adbhuta: āścaryabhūtaśca bhavasi |
'yasya indrasya 'sakhā mitrabhūta: puruṣa: 'kadā 'cana kadācidapi 'na 'hanyate na hiṃsyate 'na 'jīryate na ca śatrubhi: parājito bhavati sa tvaṃ mahā~ asītyanvaya: ||
vṛṣṇendra: pura etu na: somapā abhayaṃkara: ||
svasti'dā: | viśa: | pati: | vṛtra'hā | vi'mṛdha: | vaśī | vṛṣā | indra: | pura: | etu | na: | soma'pā: | abhayam'kara: || 2 ||
1. ga-tambara.7.8—'te 'nāsti; bha1.4-tā | 2. bhara-havāmahe āhvayāmahe | 3. ga-ihāsmin | 4. ga-śatrūṇāṃ khāda: |

^svastidāḥ svasteravināśasya dātā ^viśaspatiḥ sarvasyāḥ prajāyāḥ pālayitā ^vṛtrahā vṛtrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantā ^vimṛdhaḥ saṃgrāmakārī ^vaśī^1 vaśīkartā ^vṛṣā varṣitā kāmānāṃ ^somapāḥ somasya pātā evaṃvidhaḥ ^indraḥ ^abhayaṃkaraḥ abhayasya bhayarāhityasya kartāṃ san ^naḥ asmākaṃ ^pura ^etu purato gacchatu ||
vi rakṣo vi mṛdho jahi vi vṛtrasya hanū ruja |
vi | rakṣaḥ | vi | mṛdhaḥ | jahi | vi | vṛtrasya | hanū iti | ruja | vi | ma॒nyum | indra | vṛtra॒'han | a॒mitra̭sya | a॒bhi॒dāsa̭taḥ || 3 ||
dvitīye paryāye praśāstuḥ śasa idaṃ sūktam|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘īṅkhayantīrahaṃ dāṃ pātā sutam’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 4) iti|

īṅkhayantīrapsuyuva indraṃ jñātamupāsate| bhejānāsaḥ suvīryam || 1 || īṅkhayantīḥ | apsuyuvaḥ | indram | jñātam | upa | āsate | bhejānāsaḥ | suvīryam || 1 || vīṅkhayantīḥ gacchantyaḥ stutyādibhirendraṃ prāpnuvatyaḥ vapsuyuvaḥ apaḥ karma ātmana icchantya indramātaro'sya sūktasya draṣṭavyaḥ vjātaṃ prādurbhūtam vindram vupāsate paricaranti | vsuvīryaṃ śobhana- vīryopetaṃ dhanaṃ ca vbhejānāsaḥ | tasmādindrāt saṃbhaktavatyo bhavanti||

tvamindra balādadhi sahaso jñāta ojasaḥ | tvaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedāsi || 2 || tvam | indra | balāt | adhi | sahasaḥ | jñātaḥ | ojasaḥ | tvam | vṛṣan | vṛṣā | ita | asi || 2 || he vindra vtvaṃ vsahasaḥ pareṣābhibhāvukāt vbalāt vadhi vjātaḥ asi| adhiḥ pañcamyarthānu- vādakaḥ | vṛtrādivadhahetubhūtādvalāttostvaṃ prakhyāto bhavasītyarthaḥ | api ca vojasaḥ | ojo nāma balahetu hṛdayagataṃ dhairyam | tasmādapi tvaṃ jāto'si | he vvṛṣan varṣitaḥ vtvaṃ vvṛṣedāsi kāmānāṃ varṣitaiva bhavasi||

tvamindrāsi vṛtrahā vyantarikṣamatiraḥ | uda dyāmatastamnā ojasā || 3 || tvam | indra | asi | vṛtrahā | vi | antarikṣam | atiraḥ | ut | dyām | astabhnāḥ | ojasā || 3 || he vindra vtvaṃ vvṛtrahā vasi | śatrūṇāṃ hantā bhavasi | vantarikṣaṃ madhyasthānaṃ ca vvi vatiraḥ | āvarakāpanodanena prāvardhayaḥ | vyāṃ dyulokaṃ ca vojasā balena vut vastambhāḥ | ūrdhva- mastambhīḥ | yathādho na patati tathoparyavasthāpitavānityarthaḥ||

tvamindra sujoṣasamarka bibharṣi bāhvoḥ | vajraṃ śiśāna ojasā || 4 || tvam | indra | saḥ | joṣasam | arkam | bibharṣi | bāhvoḥ | vajram | śiśānaḥ | ojasā ||4|| he vindra vtvaṃ vsajoṣasaṃ saha prīyamāṇam varkaṃ stutyaṃ vvajram ātmīyamāyudham vojasā balena vśiśānaḥ niśyantīkṣṇīkurvan vbāhvoḥ hastayoḥ vbibharṣi dhārayasi śatrūṇāṃ vadhārtham||
tvamindrābhibhūrasi viśvā jātānyojasā | sa viśvā bhuva ābhavaḥ || 5 || tvam | indra | abhi'bhūḥ | asi | viśvā | jātāni | ojasā | saḥ | viśvāḥ | bhuvaḥ | ā | abhavaḥ || 5 ||
sūtritaṃ ca īṅkhayantīrapsuyuva iti brāhmaṇācchaṃsyāvapeta (ai. ā. 5. 1. 1) iti; ta1.2.3.6.7.8-ma1.4.5.8-sūtritaṃ ca; ta4.5-bha2-etatsūktaṃ sūtritaṃ ca|
he indra tvaṃ viśvā sarvāṇi jātāni janimanti bhūtāni ojasā balena abhibhū- rasi abhibhavitā bhavasi |
tathā saḥ tādṛśastvaṃ viśvā bhuvaḥ sarvāṃ bhūmīḥ prāptvāni sarvāṇyapi sthānāni ābhavaḥ abhitaḥ prāptoḥ |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘somo yamī bhāvavṛttamānuṣṭubhaṃ tu’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘soma ekebhya uruṇasāvasutṛpā udumbalo’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 10) iti ||

som ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate | yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tā~ścidevārvi gacchatāt || 1 || somaḥ | ekebhyaḥ | pavate | ghṛtam | ekai | upa | āsate | yebhyaḥ | madhu | pradhāvati | tān | cit | eva | api | gacchatāt || 1 ||
śrūyate hi—‘yatsāmāni soma ebhyaḥ pavate’ (tai. ā. 2. 10) iti |
eke anye pitaraḥ ghṛtam ājyam upāsate upagacchanti |
upabhogārthaṃ madhu kṣaudraṃ pradhāvati pravāharūpeṇa śīghraṃ gacchati |
ya ātharvaṇān mantrān brahmajñārthamadhīyate teṣāṃ pitṝn madhukulyā pravahati |
tāṃścideva tān pūrvoktān sarvānaiva he preta tvaṃ api gacchatāt apigaccha prāpnuhi ||

tapa̭sā ye anādhṛ॒ṣyāstapa̭sā ye svaryu॒yaḥ | tapo̭ ye ca̭krire ma॒hastā~ści̭de॒vārvi gacchatāt || 2 || tapasā | ye | anādhṛṣyāḥ | tapasā | ye | svaḥ | yuyuḥ | tapaḥ | ye | cakrire | mahaḥ | tān | cit | eva | api | gacchatāt || 2 ||
ye janāḥ tapasā kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādinā yuktāḥ santaḥ anādhṛṣyāḥ pāpairpradhṛṣyā bhavanti |
ye ca tapasā yāgādirūpeṇa sādhanena svaryuyaḥ svargaṃ yānti prāpnuvanti |
ye ca mahaḥ mahat tapaḥ anyairduṣkaraṃ rājasūyāśvamedhādikaṃ hiraṇyagarbhopāsanaṃ vā cakrire kurvanti eteṣu pravartante teṣu lokeṣu |
tāṃścit tāneva tapasvino he preta apigaccha ||

ye yudhya̭nte pradha̭neṣu śū॒rāso̭ ye ta̭nu॒tyaja̭ḥ | ye vā̭ sa॒hasra̭dakṣiṇā॒stā~ści̭de॒vārvi gacchatāt || 3 || ye | yudhyante | pradhaneṣu | śūrāsaḥ | ye | tanutyajaḥ | ye | vā | sahasradakṣiṇāḥ | tān | cit | eva | api | gacchatāt || 3 ||
teṣu śūrasaḥ śauryavantaḥ ye yudhyante śatrūn saṃpraharanti |
ye ca tanūtyajaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ tatra tyaktāro bhavanti |
ye vā ye ca sahasradakṣiṇāḥ sahasradakṣiṇān kratūn anuṣṭhitavantaḥ |
yeṣuttameṣu lokeṣu te nivasanti taṃ lokaṃ prāpnuhītyarthaḥ ||
ye | cit | pūrvai | ṛta'sāpaḥ | ṛta'vānaḥ | ṛta'vṛdhaḥ | pitṛn | tarpasvataḥ | yam | tān | cit | eva | api | gacchatāt || 4 ||

ye cit ye ca pūrvai pūrvapuruṣāḥ ṛtasāpaḥ ṛtaṃ satyaṃ yajñaṃ vā spṛśantaḥ ata eva ṛtā- vānaḥ ṛtena yuktāḥ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ṛtasya vardhakāśca bhavanti tapasvataḥ tapasā yuktān tān eva pitṛn he yama niyata tvamapigaccha ||
ṛṣīn tarpasvato yama taporjā arpi gacchatāt ||
sahasra'nīthāḥ | kavayaḥ | ye | gopāyanti | sūryam | ṛṣīn | tarpasvataḥ | yam | tapaḥ'jāḥ | api | gacchatāt || 5 ||
sahasranīthāḥ sahasranayanāḥ kavayaḥ krāntadarśinaḥ ye sūryam amumādityaṃ gopāyanti rakṣanti tapasvataḥ tapasā yuktān tapojān tapasaḥ sakāśādevotpannān tān ṛṣīn he yama niyata svamapigaccha ||
‘arāyi’ iti pañcarcaṃ caturthaṃ sūktaṃ bharadvājaputrasya śirimbiṭhasyārṣyānuṣṭubham |
anukramyate hi—‘arāyi śirimbiṭho bhāradvājo'lakṣmīghnaṃ dvitīyātṛtīyaye brāhmaṇa- spatye antyā vaiśvadevī’ iti |
arāyi kāṇe vikaṭe giriṃ gaccha sadānve |
arāyi | kāṇe | vi'kaṭe | girim | gaccha | sadānve | śirimbiṭhasya | satva'bhiḥ | tobhiḥ | tvā | cātayāmasi || 1 ||

he arāyi adāyini dānavirodhini he kāṇe kutsitaśabdakāriṇi kutsitadarśane vā he vikaṭe vikṛtagamane vikṛtāṅgi vā he sadānve sadānuve sarvadākrośakāriṇi durbhikṣādidevate giriṃ parvataṃ nirjanaṃ deśaṃ gaccha |
tasya sattvabhiḥ antarvartamānairūdakaiḥ tebhiḥ taiḥ tvā tvāṃ cātayāmasi cātayāmaḥ vināśayāmaḥ |
śirimbaṭhasyaitatsaṃjñakasya bharadvājaputrasya tebhistaiḥ anuṣṭhitaiḥ sattvabhiḥ karmabhirhe alakṣima tvāṃ vināśayāmaḥ |
catto iti | itaḥ | cattā | amṛtaḥ | sarvāṃ | bhrūṇāni | āruṣīṃ | arāyyam | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | tīkṣṇa'śṛṅga | ut'ṛṣan | ihi || 2 ||
sālakṣmīḥ itaḥ asmāllokāt cattaḥ caitvāsmābhirnāśitaiva amṛtaḥ amuṣmādapi lokāt cattā hiṃsitā bhavatu |

yālakṣmīḥ sarvāṃ sarvāṇi bhrūṇāni garbhajātāni sarvāṃsāmoṣadhīnāmaṅkurāṇi yā durbhikṣādhidevatā āruṣī āhantrī bhavati arāyyam adātrīṃ dānavirodhinoṃ tāṃ he brahmaṇaspate mantrasya pālayitardeva he tīkṣṇabhṛṅga tīkṣṇatejaska udapan asmātsthānādudramayan ihi gaccha ||
ado yadāru plavate sindhoḥ pāre apūruṣam |
tadā rabhasva durhaṇo tena gaccha parastaram ||
adaḥ | yat | dāru | plavate | sindhoḥ | pāre | apūruṣam | tat | ā | rabhasva | durhaṇo iti | duḥ'hano | tena | gaccha | paraḥ'taram || 3 ||

adaḥ viprakṛṣṭadeśe vartamānam apūruṣaṃ nirmātrā puruṣeṇa rahitaṃ yadāru dārumayaṃ puruṣottamalyaṃ devatāśarīraṃ sindhoḥ pāre samudratīre plavate jalasyopari vartate tat dāru he durhaṇo duḥkhena hananīya kenāpi hantumaśakya he stotaḥ ā rabhasva ālambasva |
tena dārumayena devenopāsyamānena parastaram atiśayena taraṇīyamutkṛṣṭaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ gaccha |

he durhaṇo duḥkhena hananīye duṣṭahanayukte vā he alakṣima sindhoḥ pāre samudratīraprānte'pūruṣaṃ puruṣarjanairviyukta-mado'smatto dūre deśe vartamānaṃ yadāru dārumayī nauḥ plavate tadāru ā rabhasva parigṛhaṇa |
gṛhītvā ca tena dāruṇā parastaramatiśayena taraṇīyaṃ brahmaṇaspatinā preritā satī dvīpāntaraṃ gaccha ||
sūtritaṃ ca—'kapjharo yadvā prācīra-jaganteti caite' (āśva. śrau. 8. 3) iti ||
yat | hu | prācīḥ | arjaganta | uraḥ | maṇḍūra'dhāṇikīḥ | hutāḥ | indrasya | śatravaḥ | sarve | bubuda'yāśavaḥ || 4 ||
he maṇḍūradhāṇikīḥ maṇḍūravat kutsitaśabdakāriṇyo mandanasya dhanasya dhārayiṣyo vālakṣbhyaḥ uraḥ urvī hiṃsārthaḥ |
yūyaṃ ᵛprācī: prakarṣeṇā'nya: prakṛṣṭagamanā: satyo ᵛyaddha yadā khalu ᵛajaganta agacchata ||
ata eva hrasvā- bhāvādamunāsikalopo na bhavati ||
buddhudadyātāro vyāpanśīlāśca santa: ᵛhutā: naṣṭā āsan ||

parīme gāmanepat paryyagrimahaṣata | deveṣvakrat śrava: ka imā~ ā dadharṣati || 5 || parīṃ | ime | gām | anepat | parīṃ | agnim | ahaṣata | deveṣu | akrata | śrava: | ka: | imān | ā | dadharṣati || 5 ||
paṇibhirapahatā: sarvāṃ devagavī: ᵛpari ᵛanepat paryyanayan |
tata: ᵛagniṃ ca ᵛpari ᵛahaṣata parito vyaharan |
yāgārthaṃ tatra tatra gārhapatyādirūpeṇa sthāpitavanta ityartha: |
evaṃ kṛtvā ᵛdeveṣu yaṣṭavyeṣbindrādiṣu ᵛśrava: annam ᵛakrata akṛpata |
ᵛka: śatrurasurādi: ᵛimān viśvān devān ᵛā ᵛdadharṣati abhi- bhavituṃ śaknoti |
‘agniṃ hinvantu na:’ iti pañcacaṃ pañcamaṃ sūktamabhipūtrasya ketunāmna ārṣaṃ gāyatramāpreyam |
tathā cānukrāntam—‘agni keturāpreya āpreyaṃ gāyatram’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘agni hinvantu na: prāgnaye vācamiti sūkte’ (āśva.śrau.4.13) iti ||
agniṃ hinvantu no dhiya: sarsimāśumavājiṣu | tenaṃ jeṣma dhanaṃdhanam || 1 || agnim | hinvantu | na: | dhiya: | sarsim | āśum'iva | ājiṣu | tena | jeṣma | dhanam'dhanam || 1 ||
ᵛna: asmākaṃ ᵛdhiya: karmāṇi stutayo vā ᵛagni ᵛhinvantu prerayantu |
ᵛājiṣu saṃgrāmeṣu ᵛāśumiva yathā āśuṃ śīghra- gāminaṃ ᵛsarsi sarpaṇaśīlamaśvaṃ yodhdāra: prerayanti tadvat |
ᵛtena agninā ᵛdhanadhanaṃ sarvaṃ dhanaṃ ᵛjeṣma vayaṃ jayema ||
yayā gā ākarāmahe senāyāgne tavotyā | tāṃ nau hinva maghattaye || 2 || yayā | gā: | ā'karāmahe | senāyā | agne | tava | ūtyā | tām | na: | hinva | maghattaye ||2||
he ᵛagne ᵛsenayā 'nena saha vartamānayā senarūpayā vā ᵛyayā ᵛtava ᵛūtyā rakṣayā ᵛgā: ᵛākarāmahe ābhimukhyena kurmahe |
ᵛtām ūtiṃ ᵛna: asmān ᵛhinva gamaya |
ābhilavikepuktheyeṣu praśāsta: śastre ‘āgne sthūram’ iti tṛco vaikalpiko'nurūpa: |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā te vatso mano yamadagne sthūraṃ rathi bhara’ (āśva. śrau. 7. 8) iti ||
āgne sthūraṃ rathiṃ bhara pṛthuṃ gomantamāśrvinam |
ā | agne | sthuram | rayim | bhara | pṛthum | go'mantam | aśvinam | addhi | kham | vartaya | puṇam || 3 ||
he 'gne 'sthuraṃ sthūlaṃ vṛddhaṃ 'pṛthuṃ vistīrṇaṃ 'gomantaṃ gobhiryuktam 'aśvinam aśvairupetaṃ 'rathiṃ dhanam 'ā 'bhara asmabhyamāhara |
agne nakṣatramajaramā sūrya rohayo divi | dadhajjyotirjanaibhyaḥ || 4 || agne | nakṣatram | ajaram | ā | sūryam | rohayaḥ | divi | dadhat | jyotiḥ | janaibhyaḥ ||4||

yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīklṛpāti || 2 || yajñam | ca | naḥ | tanvam | ca | prajāṃm | ca | ādityaiḥ | indraḥ | saha | cīklṛpāti ||2|| naḥ asmākaṃ yajñaṃ jyotiṣṭomādikaṃ yāgaṃ tanvaṃ śarīraṃ ca prajāṃ putrādikāṃ ca ādityaiḥ aditiputrairnyadaivaiḥ saha vartamānaḥ indraḥ cīklṛpāti kalpayatu | yajñādikaṃ svavyāpārasamarthaṃ karotu ||

ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhismākaṃ bhūtvavitā tūnūnām || 3 || ādityaiḥ | indraḥ | sagaṇaḥ | marudbhiḥ | asmākam | bhūtu | avitā | tūnūnām || 3 || ādityaiḥ aditiputrairmitrādibhiḥ marudbhiḥ ca sagaṇaḥ sahitaḥ indraḥ asmākaṃ tūnūnāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ tanayānāṃ vā avitā bhūtu rakṣitā bhavatu ||

hatvārya devā asurān yadāyan devā devatvamabhirakṣamāṇāḥ || 4 || hatvārya | devāḥ | asurān | yat | āyan | devāḥ | devatvam | abhirakṣamāṇāḥ ||4|| devāḥ indrādayaḥ asurān kṣaptṛn vṛtrādīn hatvāya hatvā vināśaya yat yadā āyan āgacchan svakīyaṃ sthānaṃ prāpnuvan tadānīṃ te devāḥ devatvam ātmīyamamṛtatvam abhirakṣamāṇāḥ abhitaḥ sarvato rakṣanto'bhūvan | bādhakābhāvāt sarvatra pratyāpitavanta ityarthaḥ ||

pratyaścamarkamanayañchacībhirāta itsvadhāmiṣirāṃ paryapaśyan || 5 || pratyaścam | arkam | anayan | śacībhiḥ | āt | it | svadhām | iṣirām | pari | apaśyan ||5|| śacībhiḥ karmabhiḥ paricaraṇāramakaiḥ sārdham arkam arcanasādhanaṃ stotraṃ pratyaścam indrādīn pratyañcat anayan stotāraḥ prāpayan | yadaivam ādit anantarameva iṣirāṃ gamanaśīlāṃ svadhāṃ vṛṣṭyudakaṃ paryapaśyan sarve janāḥ paritaḥ paśyanti | yadvā | iṣirāmeśaṇīyāṃ svadhām | ajñānāmaitat | havilakṣaṇamannaṃ sarve devāḥ paripaśyanti || ||5||
‘sūryeḥ’ iti pañcarcaṃ saptamaṃ sūktaṃ sūryaputrasya cakṣuḥsaṃjñasyārṣaṃ sūryadevatyaṃ gāyatram |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘sūryo naścakṣuḥ sauryaḥ sauryaṃ gāyatram’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘sūryo no diva udu tyaṃ jātavedasamiti nava’ (āśva. śrau. 6. 5) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘sūryo no divaspātu namo mahadbhyo namo arbhakebhyaḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 1. 4) iti ||

sūryo no divaspātu vāto antarikṣāt | agniḥ pārthivebhyaḥ || 1 || sūryeḥ | naḥ | divaḥ | pātu | vātaḥ | antarikṣāt | agniḥ | naḥ | pārthivebhyaḥ || 1 || sūryaḥ sarvasya prerakaḥ śobhanīyo vā devaḥ divaḥ dyulokāt dyulokavartino janāt naḥ asmān pātu rakṣatu | vātaḥ vāyuśca antarikṣāt madhyamasthānagatādādhakādasmān rakṣatu | tathā pṛthivīsthānaḥ agniḥ ca pārthivebhyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ vartamānebhyaḥ śatrubhyaḥ naḥ asmān rakṣatu ||
joṣā savituryasya te haraḥ śataṃ suvā~ arhati | pāhi nau dyutaḥ patantyāḥ ||2|| joṣa | savitaḥ | yasya | te | haraḥ | śatam | suvān | arhati | pāhi | naḥ | dyutaḥ | patantyāḥ || 2 ||
he savitaḥ sarvasya preraka sūrya jopa asmātstutyādikaṃ sevasva |
yasya te tava haraḥ rasahaṇaśīlaṃ tejaḥ śataṃ savān bahūn yajñān prati arhati yogyaṃ bhavati |
sa tvaṃ naḥ asmān patantyāḥ niyatantyāḥ śatrubhirasmāsu kṣipyamāṇāyāḥ dyutaḥ |
cakṣurno devaḥ savitā cakṣurna uta parvata: | cakṣurdhātā dadhātu naḥ || 3 || cakṣuḥ | naḥ | devaḥ | savitā | cakṣuḥ | naḥ | uta | parvata: | cakṣuḥ | dhātā | dadhātu | naḥ || 3 ||
savitā preraka devaḥ naḥ asmākaṃ cakṣuḥ prakāśakaminidrayamindriyā

udasau sūryo agādudayaṃ māmako bhagaḥ | ahaṃ tadvidvā patimubhayasākṣi viprāsahiḥ || 1 || ut | asau | sūryaḥ | agāt | ut | ayam | māmakaḥ | bhagaḥ | aham | tat | vidvā | patim | abhi | asākṣi | viḍasamahiḥ || 1 || vasau dyulokasthaḥ vsūryaḥ vut vagāt udayaṃ prāptavān | vmāmakaḥ madīyaḥ vbhagaḥ bhajanīyaḥ vayam indraśca sūryātmanodagāt | yadvā māmako bhago madīyamidaṃ saubhāgyamudagāt | vtat udyataṃ sūryasya tejaḥ | vvidvā jñātavatī yadvā vpatiṃ bhartāraṃ vidvā labdhavatī vahaṃ vvipāsahiḥ viśeṣeṇā- bhibhavitrī satī vabhyamākṣi abhyabhūvam | sapatnīriti śeṣaḥ | sahaterabhibhavārthasya luṅayetadrūpam | yadvā | viprāsahiḥ sapatnīnāmabhibhavitrī satī patimbhyasākṣi | bhartāramapyabhyabhūvam | yathā mayyeva vaśīkṛtaściraṃ vartate' tathākārya
ata eva kāraṇādaham 7asapatnā 7kila śatrurahitā khalu 7abhavam abhūvam |
asapatnā | sapatnaghnī | jayantī | abhi'bhūrvarī | ā | āvṛkṣam | anyāsāṃ | varcaḥ | rādhaḥ | astheyasām'iva || 5 ||
tīvrasya | abhi'veyasaḥ | asya | pāhi | sarva'rayā | vi | harī iti | iha | muñca | indra | mā | tvā | yajamānāsaḥ | anye | ni | roraman | tubhyam | ime | sutāsaḥ || 1 ||
abhigataṃ carupuroḍāśādyannaṃ yasya tādṛśasya asya somasya |
ihaśaṃ somaṃ he indra pāhi piba |
tadarthaṃ sarvatrathā saraṇaśīlarathau harī aśvau iha asmin yajñagṛhe vi muñca rathādvisṛja |
he indra asmat anye yajamānāsaḥ yaja- mānāḥ tvā tvāṃ mā ni roraman nitarāṃ mā ramayantu |
tataḥ tubhyaṃ tvadarthameva sutāsaḥ sutā abhiṣutāḥ ime pratyakṣeṇopalabhyamānāḥ somā vartante ||
tubhyaṃ sutāstubhyaṃ sotvāsutvāṃ giraḥ śrāvyā ā hyanti |
indramadya sarvaṃ juṣāṇe viśvasya vidvān iha pāhi somam ||

tubhyaṃ sutāḥ | tubhyam ū iti | sotvāsaḥ | tvām | giraḥ | śrāvyāḥ | ā | hyanti | indra | idam | adya | sarvam | juṣāṇaḥ | viśvasya | vidvān | iha | pāhi | somam ||2|| he indra tubhyaṃ tvadarthameva sutāḥ abhiṣutāḥ sarve somāḥ sotvāsaḥ itaḥparamabhipotavyāśca tubhyamu tvadarthameva | sunoteḥ 'kṛtyārthe tavaikena' iti tvanpratyayaḥ | śrāvyāḥ śu āśu śīghramatantyaḥ pravartamānāḥ giraḥ stutirūpā vācaśca tvām eva ā hyanti ākrośayanti | he indra adya asmin kāle idaṃ savanaṃ prātaḥsavanādikaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sevamānaḥ viśvasya sarvasya vidvān jñātā tvam iha asmin yajñe somaṃ pāhi piba ||
ya uśatā manasā somamasmai sarvahṛdā devakāmaḥ sunoti |
na gā indrastasya parā dadāti praśastamicārumasmai kṛṇoti ||

yaḥ uśatā kāmayamānena sarvahṛdā | sarvamavikalaṃ hṛdayaṃ yasya | yadvā | sarveṣāmṛtvijāṃ hṛdayena | sāmarthyanmatvartho lakṣyate | hṛdayavatā manasā asmai indrāya devakāmaḥ devamindraṃ kāmaya- māno yajamānaḥ somaṃ sunoti abhiṣuṇoti | indrastasya yajamānasya gāḥ na parā dadāti | parādānaṃ vināśaḥ | na vināśayati | asmai yajamānāya cāruṃ śobhanamata eva praśastam | ita ityavadhāraṇe | praśaṃsanīyameva dhanaṃ kṛṇoti karoti ||
anuspaṣṭo bhavatyeṣu asya yo asmai revānna sunoti somam |
niraratnau maghavā taṃ dadhāti brahmadviṣo hantyananudiṣṭaḥ ||
anuspaṣṭaḥ | bhavati | eṣa | asya | yaḥ | asmai | revān | na | sunoti | somam | niḥ | aratnau | maghavā | tam | dadhāti | brahmadviṣaḥ | hanti | ananudiṣṭaḥ || 4 ||
vasya yajamānasya vepa: indra: vanuspaṣṭa: dṛṣṭigocaro bhavati vya: vrevān dhanavān vasmai indrāya vsomaṃ vsunoti abhipuṇoti |

vmaghavā dhanopeta indra: vtaṃ yajamānam vagnau haste vni: vdadhāti bhayābhikṛṣya dhārayati rakṣitā san śrutvā ca vananudiṣṭa: tenānukto'prārthita eva san vbrahma- dviṣa: brāhmaṇadveṣan śatrūn vhanti hinasti ||
śunāsīrīye parvaṇi 'indrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālam' ityasya 'aśvāyantaḥ' ityeṣā yājyā |
indro vā śuna iti vaikalyakasyāpi haviṣa iyameva yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'adhā- yanto gavyanto vājayantaḥ śunaṃ huvema maghavānamindram' ( āśva. śrau. 2. 20 ) iti ||
aśvāyanto gavyanto vājayanto havāmahe tvopagantavā u |
ābhūpantaste sumatau navāyāṃ vayamindra tvā śunaṃ huvema ||
aśva'yantaḥ | gavyantaḥ | vājayantaḥ | havāmahe | tvā | upa'gantave | oṃ iti | ā'bhūpantaḥ | te | su'matau | navāyām | vayam | indra | tvā | śunam | huvema || 5 ||
ṇici 'vo vidhūnane' ( pā. sū. 7. 3. 38 ) iti jugāgama: |
asmācchataryupadeśālasārvadhātukasvarenānudāttatvaṃ śapaśca pipvādanudāttatve tato ṇica eva svara: śiṣyate |
evaṃbhūtā vayaṃ he indra tvām vupagantavai upagantuṃ prāptuṃ vhavāmahe āhvayāmahe |
gatisamāse 'tave cāntaśca yugapat' iti gate: prakṛtisvaratvamuttarapadasyāntodāttatvam |
he vindra vte tava vnavāyām abhinavāyām praśastāyāṃ vsumatau śobhanabuddhau vābhūpantaḥ: ā samantādbhajavanto vartamānā: |
ā samantādūpayantaḥ'urkurvantastvā'nugrahabuddhau vartamānā: vvayaṃ vśunaṃ sukhakaraṃ tvāṃ vhuvema āhvayema ||
tathā cānukāntaṃ—'muñcāmi prājāpatyo yakṣmanāśano rājyakṣmamantyānuṣṭup' iti |
sūyate hi—' vyādhitasyāturasya yakṣmagṛhītasya vā palāhutiścarmuñcāmi svā haviṣā jīvanāya kamisyatena' ( ādha. gṛ. 3.6. 4-5 ) iti ||
muñcāmi tvā haviṣā jīvanāya karmajñātayakṣmāduta rājyakṣmāt |
grāhirjagrāha yadi vaitadenaṃ tasyā indrāgnī pra mumuktamenam ||

yadi kṣitāyuryadi vā paraito yadi mṛtyorantikaṃ nīta eva | tamā harāmi nirṛterupasthādaspārmena śataśāradāya || 2 || yadi | kṣita'āyu: | yadi | vā | parā'ita: | yadi | mṛtyo: | antikam | ni'ita: | eva | tam | ā | harāmi | niḥ'ṛte: | upa'sthāt | aspārm | enam | śata'śāradāya ||2||

yadi sa rogagrasta: kṣitāyu: kṣīṇāyurbhavati yadi vā pareta: asmāllokāt parāgato bhavati yadi ca mṛtyo: vaivastasya antikaṃ niruktaṃ nīta: nitarāṃ prāpta: eva bhavati evaṃbhūtam api taṃ puruṣaṃ nirṛte: pāpadevatāyā āyu: kṣayakāriṇyā: upasthāt upasthānāt ā harāmi ānāyayāmi āvartayāmi |
āhamya ca enaṃ śataśāradāya śatamaṃvatsarajīvanārtham aspārpaṃ prabalaṃ karomi |

sahasrākṣaṃ śataśāradena śatāyuṣā haviṣāhārṣamenam | śataṃ yathemaṃ śarado nayātīndro viśvasya duritasya pāram || 3 || sahasra'akṣam | śata'śāradena | śata'āyuṣā | haviṣā | ā | ahārṣam | enam | śatam | yathā | imam | śarada: | nayāti | indra: | viśvasya | du:'itasya | pāram || 3 ||
sahasramakṣīṇi cakṣūṃṣi yasya haviṣā phalatvena vidyante tat sahasrākṣam ||
ata eva śatāyuṣā śatasaṃvatsaraparimitamāyurjīvanaṃ phalabhūtaṃ yasya tādṛśena haviṣā |
tena śataśāradena śaradāṃ saṃvatsaraṇāṃ śatasya dātṛttvena sambandhinā kartrī śatāyuṣā haviṣā karaṇabhūtena |
yathā yena prakāreṇa imaṃ puruṣaṃ śataṃ śarada: saṃvatsarān |
etāvataṃ kālam indro viśvasya sarvasya duritasya du:khasya pāram avasānaṃ du:kharāhityaṃ nayāti nayet tatāhāryamityartha: ||
śataṃ jīva śaradau vardhamāna: śataṃ hemantāñchatamu vamantān |
śatamitndrāgnī savitā bṛhaspati: śatāyuṣā haviṣemaṃ punardyu: ||
śatam | jīva | śarada: | vardhamāna: | śatam | hemantān | śatam | oṃ iti | vasantān | śatam | indrāgnī iti | suśritā | bṛhaspati: | śata'āyuṣā | haviṣā | imam | puna: | du: ||4||
he yakṣmādvimukta vardhamāna: aharaharabhivṛddhiṃ prāpnuvastvaṃ śataṃ śarada: śatasaṃkhyākān śaradatūn jīva prāṇān dhāraya |
śataṃ hemantān hemantūṃśca jīva śataṃ vasantān ca |

api ca indrāgnī indrāścāmiśra savitā prerako devaśca bṛhaspati: bṛhatāṃ devānāṃ pālayitā devaśca śatāyuṣā śatasaṃvatsaraparimitasyāyuṣo hetubhūtena haviṣā tapyamānā: sannta: imaṃ janaṃ punardu: punarasmabhyaṃ prādu: ||
sarvāṅga sarvaṃ te cakṣu: sarvamāyuśca te'vidam ||
ā | ahāṣaṃ | tvā | avidam | tvā | puna: | ā | agā: | puna:'nava | sarva'aṅga | sarvam | te | cakṣu: | sarvam | āyu: | ca | te | avidam ||5||
he vyādhigṛhīta tvā tvām āhāṣaṃ mṛtyo: sakāśādāhṛtavānasmi |
ata eva tvā tvām avidam alapsi |
he sarvāṅga sarvarivakalairaṅgairupena te tava sarvaṃ cakṣu: |
te tava āyu: jīvanaṃ ca sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇamavidam ||
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘brahmaṇā ṣaḍ brāhmo rakṣohā garbhasaṃstrāve prāyaścittamānuṣṭubhaṃ hi’ iti |
brahmaṇā | agni: | saṃvivāna: | rakṣa:'hā | bādhatām | ita: | amīvā | ya: | te | garbham | du:'nāmā | yonim | ā'śaye || 1 ||
brahmaṇā mantreṇa saha saṃvidāna: aikamatyaṃ prāpta: rakṣohā rakṣasāṃ hantā agni: ita: asmātsthānāt rākṣasādikaṃ bādhatāṃ hinastu |
ya: rākṣasa: amīvā rogarūpa: san te tava garbham āśaye āśete |
tadrūpa: san yaśca te tava yoniṃ retasa ādhānaṃ garbhasthānamāśete3 taṃ bādhatāmityanvaya:||
ya: | te | garbham | amīvā | du:'nāmā | yonim | ā'śaye | agni: | tam | brahmaṇā | saha | ni: | kravya'adam | anīnaśat || 2 ||
1. ga-ta1.6-punarabhinavamutpanna; tara.3-punarabhivamutpanna; ta7-punarabhimamutpanna; bha1.4.8-punara- bhivamutpanna; bhara-punarabhivamutpanna |

gata: pūrvo'rdharca:| ta kravyādaṃ māṃsāśinaṃ rākṣasādikaṃ brahmaṇā sahita: agni: niḥśeṣeṇa anīnaśat nāśayatu || yaste hanti putaryantaṃ niṣṭastanuṃ ya: sarīsṛpam | jātaṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmāsi || 3 || ya: | te | hanti | putaryantam | ni'stanum | ya: | sarīsṛpam | jātam | ya: | te | jighāṃsati | tam | ita: | nāśayāmāsi || 3 || he yoṣit te tava garbhāśaye patayantaṃ patantaṃ retorūpeṇa gacchantaṃ tadanantaraṃ tatra nipastanuṃ nipīdantaṃ ca garbhaṃ ya: rākṣasādi: hanti hinasti tato māsatrayādūrdhvaṃ prāptasarvāvayavaṃ sarīsṛpaṃ sarpaṇaśīlaṃ ca garbhaṃ ya: hanti jātaṃ daśasu māserūpannaṃ te tava śiśuṃ ya: rākṣasādi: jighāṃsati hantumicchati tamita: sthānāt nāśayāmasi nāśayāma: || yaste ūrū viharatyantarā darpatī śaye | yoniṃ yo antarāreliha tamito nāśayāmāsi || 4 || ya: | te | ūrū iti | vi'harati | antarā | darpatī iti dampatī | śaye | yonim | ya: | an: | ā'reliha | tam | ita: | nāśayāmāsi || 4 || he yoṣit te tava ūrū pādamūlau ya: rākṣasādi: viharati garbhaghātāya viśliṣṭau karoti daṃpatī antarā jāyāpatyomaṃdhye garbhahananāthaṃ yaśca śaye śete ya: ca yonim antaḥ praviśya āreliha niṣiktaṃ reto jihvayā āsvādayati || bhakṣayatītyartha: | ‘liha āsvādane’ | ādādika: | kapilakādistvālhatvavikalpa: || yastvā bhrātā patirbhūtvā jāro bhūtvā nipadyate | prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmāsi || 5 || ya: | tvā | bhrātā | pati: | bhūtvā | jāra: | bhūtvā | ni'padyate | pra'jām | ya: | te | jighāṃsati | tam | ita: | nāśayāmāsi || 5 || he yoṣit ya: rākṣasa: bhrātā bhrātṛrūpo bhūtvā pati: bhartṛrūpo vā bhūtvā tvāṃ nipadyate abhigacchati | athavā jāra: upapatirūpo vā bhūtvā abhigacchati | evaṃbhūta: ya: rākṣasādi: te tava prajāṃ jighāṃsati hantumicchati | spaṣṭamanyat || yastvā svamena tamasā mohayitvā nipadyate | prajāṃ yaste jighāṃsati tamito nāśayāmāsi || 6 || ya: | tvā | svamena | tamasā | mohayitvā | ni'padyate | pra'jām | ya: | te | jighāṃsati | tam | ita: | nāśayāmāsi || 6 || 1. ta-bha-anīnaśat nāśayat | 2. ta4.5-yonijātaṃ | 3. ta-bha-nāśayāma |
he yoṣit ᵥyaḥ rākṣasādiḥ ᵥsvapnena svamāvasthayā ᵥtamasā nidrayā ᵥtvā tvāṃ ᵥmohayitvā mūḍhatāṃ prāpaya ᵥnipadyate garbhaghātāya gacchati |
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘akṣmībhyāṃ vivahā kāyapo yakṣmaghnam’ iti |
yakṣmaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ mastiṣkājjihvāyā vi vṛhāmi te ||
akṣmībhyām | te | nāsikābhyām | karṇābhyām | chubukāt | adhi | yakṣmam | śīrṣaṇyam | mastiṣkāt | jihvāyāḥ | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 1 ||
he yakṣmagṛhīta ᵥte tava ᵥakṣmībhyāṃ cakṣubhyāṃ yakṣmarogaṃ ᵥvi ᵥvṛhāmi uddhārayāmi |
tathā ᵥnāsikābhyāṃ ghrāṇendriyācca ᵥkarṇābhyāṃ śrotrābhyāṃ ca ᵥchubukāt chubukādoṣasyādhaḥpradeśācca |
‘ye ca taddhite’ (pā. sū. 6. 1. 61) iti śirasaḥ śīrṣaādeśaḥ |
īdṛśaṃ ᵥyakṣmaṃ rogaṃ ᵥte tava ᵥmastiṣkāt |
tasmāt ᵥjihvāyāḥ rasanāyāśca sakāśādvi vṛhāmi uddhārayāmi |
yakṣmaṃ doṣaṇyaṃ 'aṃsābhyāṃ bāhubhyāṃ vi vṛhāmi te ||
grīvābhyaḥ | te | uṣṇahābhyaḥ | kīkasābhyaḥ | anukyāt | yakṣmam | doṣaṇyam | aṃsābhyām | bāhu'bhyām | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 2 ||
he vyādhigṛhīta ᵥuṣṇahābhyaḥ ūrdhvābhimukhaṃ snigdhābhya usnātābhyo5 vā snāyubhyaḥ ᵥgrīvābhyaḥ galagatābhyo dhamanībhyaḥ ᵥte tava ᵥyakṣmaṃ ᵥvi ᵥvṛhāmi |
tathā ᵥkīkasābhyaḥ asthibhyaḥ ᵥanukyāt asthisaṃdheśca yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi |
tamapi6 yakṣmaṃ rogaṃ ᵥte tava ᵥaṃsābhyāṃ ᵥbāhubhyāṃ ca vi vṛhāmi |
yakṣmaṃ matasnābhyāṃ yukaḥ plāśabhyo vi vṛhāmi te ||

āntrebhya: | te | gudābhya: | vaniṣṭho: | hṛdayāt | adhi | yakṣmam | matasnābhyām | yakka: | plīśabhya: | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 3 ||
he yakṣmābhibhūta va te tava va āntrebhya: |
tatsaṃbandhibhya: snāyubhya: va gudābhya: yābhirnāḍībhirannarasa: samānavāyunā dhātuṣu nīyate tābhyo nāḍībhya: sakāśāt yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi |
tathā va vaniṣṭho: sthavirāntrāt va hṛdayādhi hṛdayapuṇḍarīkācca yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi |
api ca va te tava va matasnābhyām |
va plīśabhya: anyebhyo'pi klomaplīhādisaṃjñebhyaśca māṃsebhyaśca yakṣmaṃ rogaṃ va vi va vṛhāmi utkṣiṇāmi ||

ūrubhyāṃ te aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ pārṣṇibhyāṃ prapadābhyām | yakṣmaṃ śroṇibhyāṃ bhaṃsadādbhaṃsaso vi vṛhāmi te || 4 || ūrubhyām | te | aṣṭhīvat'bhyām | pārṣṇi'bhyām | prapadābhyām | yakṣmam | śroṇi'bhyām | bhaṃsadāt | bhaṃsasa: | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 4 ||
he rugṇa va te tava va urubhyām va aṣṭhīvadbhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ ca yakṣmaṃ va vi vṛhāmi |
tathā va pārṣṇibhyāṃ pādasyāparabhāgābhyāṃ va prapadābhyāṃ pādāgrābhyāṃ ca yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi |
api ca va śroṇibhyāṃ jaghanābhyāṃ ca yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi |
tatsaṃbandhāt va bhaṃsasa: bhāsamānāt pāyo: va te tava yakṣmaṃ vi vṛhāmi ||

mehanādvanūṃkaraṇāllomabhyaste nakhebhya: | yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanustamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te || 5 || mehanāt | vanūṃkaraṇāt | loma'bhya: | te | nakhebhya: | yakṣmam | sarvasmāt | ātmana: | tam | idam | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 5 ||
tasmāt va meha- nāt medāt va te tava va lomabhya: va nakhebhya: ca yakṣmaṃ va vi vṛhāmi |
va idam idānīṃ va taṃ yakṣmaṃ va sarvasmādātmana: kṛtsnādeva va te tava śarīrāt vi vṛhāmi ||

aṅgādaṅgāllomnolomno jātaṃ parvaṇiparvaṇi | yakṣmaṃ sarvasmādātmanustamidaṃ vi vṛhāmi te || 6 || aṅgāt'aṅgāt | lomna:'lomna: | jātam | parvaṇi'parvaṇi | yakṣmam | sarvasmāt | ātmana: | tam | idam | vi | vṛhāmi | te || 6 ||
va aṅgādaṅgāt sarvebhyo'vayavebhya: va lomnolomna: sarvebhyo lomabhyaśca va parvaṇiparvaṇi avayavānāṃ saṃdhau4 va jātam utpannaṃ va yakṣmaṃ va vi vṛhāmi |

‘apehi’ iti pañcarcaṃ trayodaśaṃ sūktamāṅgirasasya pracetasa ārṣam|
tathā cānukrāntam—‘apehi pañca pracetā duḥsvamaṃ paṅktyantaṃ triṣṭummadhyam’ iti|
puro nirṛtyā ā cakṣva bahudhā jīvato manaḥ||

apakramya ca vparaḥ parastādvikṛṣṭe deśe vcara yathecchaṃ vartasva|

vjīvataḥ mama vmanaḥ vbahudhā bahuprakāraṃ bhavati|
bhadraṃ vai varaṃ vṛṇate bhadraṃ yuñjanti dakṣiṇam|

vvaivasvate vivasvataḥ putre yame vipaye vbhadraṃ śobhanameva vcakṣuḥ darśanamahaṃ prārthaye|
vbahutrā bahuṣu hi vipayeṣu vjīvataḥ mama vmanaḥ vartate||

vyat duṣkṛtam vāśā āśaṃsanenābhilāṣeṇa vjāgrataḥ jāgaraṇāvasthāyāṃ vartamānā vayam vupārima upagatavantaḥ sma vyat ca svapantaḥ svaprāvasthāyāṃ prāptā upagatavantaḥ sma|
tathā vniḥśasā niḥśaṃsanena nirgatābhilāṣeṇa vabhiśasā abhigatābhilāṣeṇa ca kāraṇenāvasthādvaye yaduṣkṛtamupā- gacchema|
tāni vviśvāni sarvāṇi vajuṣṭāni asevyāmyapriyāṇi vā vduṣkṛtāni duṣkarmāṇi vagniḥ vasmat vāre asmatto dūradeśe vapa vdhātu apakṛṣya sthāpayatu||

yadindra brahmaṇaspate'bhidrohaṃ carāmasi | pracetā na āṅgiraso dviṣatāṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||4|| yat | indra | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | abhi'droham | carāmasi | pra'cetāḥ | naḥ | āṅgirasaḥ | dviṣatām | pātu | aṃhasaḥ | || 4 ||
he indra he brahmaṇaspate yuvayorviṣaye yat abhidroham abhito drohakaṃ pāpaṃ duḥsvamakāraṇaṃ carāmasi ācarāmaḥ kurmaḥ tasmādabhidrohādasmāt rakṣatamiti śeṣaḥ |
api ca āṅgirasaḥ aṅgirobhiḥ stotṛbhiḥ sabāndhavaḥ pracetāḥ prakṛṣṭajñāno varuṇaśca dviṣatāṃ dveṣaṇām aṃhasaḥ tatkartṛkā- dasmadvipayātpāpāt naḥ asmān pātu rakṣatu |

ajaiṣmyāsanāṃ cābhumānāṃso vayam | jāgratsvapnaḥ saṃkalpaḥ pāpo yaṃ dvipmastaṃ sa ṛcchatu yo no dveṣṭi taṃṛcchatu ||5|| ajaiṣma | adya | asanām | ca | abhūma | anāgasaḥ | vayam | jāgrat'svapnaḥ | sam'kalpaḥ | pāpaḥ | yam | dviṣmaḥ | tam | saḥ | ṛcchatu | yaḥ | naḥ | dveṣṭi | tam | ṛcchatu || 5 ||
tadanantaram asanāma ca saṃbhaktavyāni ca samabhajāma |
jāgratsvapnāvasthayoḥ sambandhī pāpaḥ pāpaphalarūpaḥ saḥ saṃkalpaḥ duḥsvapnādhyavasāyaḥ yaṃ śatruṃ vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ tam ṛcchatu prāpnotu |
yaḥ ca naḥ asmān dveṣṭi tamṛcchatu prāpnotu ||
‘devāḥ’ iti pañca caturdaśaṃ sūktaṃ nirṛtiputrasya kapotākhyasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vaiśvadevam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘devā nairṛtaḥ kapotaḥ kapotapahatau prāyaścittaṃ vaiśvadevam’ iti |
kapoto yadi gṛhaṃ praviśet tadānena sūktena hotavyam |
sūyate hi—‘kapotaścedagāramupahandyādupatadvā devāḥ kapota iti pratyacaṃ juhuyājapedvā’ (āśva. gṛ. 3. 7. 7) iti ||

devāḥ kapota iṣito yadicchanduto nirṛtyā idamājagāma | tasmā arcāma kṛṇvān niṣkṛtiṃ śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||1|| devāḥ | kapotaḥ | iṣitaḥ | yat | icchan | dutaḥ | niḥ'ṛtyā | idam | ā'jagāma | tasmai | arcāma | kṛṇvān | niḥ'kṛtim | śam | naḥ | astu | dvi'pade | śam | catuḥ'pade ||1||
he devāḥ iṣitaḥ prāptaḥ nirṛtyāḥ pāpadevatāyāḥ dūtaḥ anucaraḥ kapotaḥ yat bādhanam icchan abhilapan idam asmadīyaṃ gṛham ājagāma prāpnot tasmai bādhanāya tadbādhananivṛttyartham arcāma |
tataḥ niṣkṛtiṃ kapotapraveśajanyasya doṣasya pariharti kṛṇvān |
ataḥ naḥ asmākaṃ dvipade putrāya śaṃ sukham astu catuṣpade gavāśva- : prabhṛtaye ca śaṃ sukhamastu ||
śivaḥ kapota iṣito nau astvanāgā devāḥ śakuno gṛheṣu |
agnihiṃ vipro jupatāṃ havirnaḥ pari hetiḥ pikṣaṇī nau vṛṇaktu ||
śivaḥ | kapotaḥ | iṣitaḥ | naḥ | astu | anāgāḥ | devāḥ | śakunaḥ | gṛheṣu | agniḥ | hi | vipraḥ | jupatām | haviḥ | naḥ | pari | hetiḥ | pikṣaṇī | naḥ | vṛṇaktu || 2 ||
he devāḥ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vgṛheṣu viṣitaḥ gataḥ kapotākhyaḥ vśakunaḥ pakṣī vśivaḥ sukhakaraḥ vanāgāḥ apāpahetuśca vastu |

vhi yasmāt vvipraḥ medhāvī vagniḥ vnaḥ asmākaṃ vhaviḥ yuṣmabhyaṃ parikalpitaṃ vjupatāṃ jupate ato yuṣmatprasādāt vpikṣaṇī pakṣopetā vhetiḥ hananahetuḥ kapotaḥ vnaḥ asmān vpari vvṛṇaktu asmān parityajatu |
hetiḥ pikṣaṇī na dabhātyaramānāṣṭyāṃ padaṃ kṛṇute agnidhāne |
śaṃ no gobhyaśca puruṣebhyaścāstu mā nau hiṃsīdiha devāḥ kapotaḥ ||
hetiḥ | pikṣaṇī | na | dabhāti | asmān | āṣṭyām | padam | kṛṇute | agnidhāne | śam | naḥ | gobhyaḥ | ca | puruṣebhyaḥ | ca | astu | mā | naḥ | hiṃsīt | iha | devāḥ | kapotaḥ || 3 ||
vpikṣaṇī pakṣopetā vhetiḥ hananahetuḥ kapotaḥ vasmān vna vdabhāti na hinastu |
vāṣṭyāṃ vyāptāyāmaraṇyānyām vagnidhāne agnirnīyate'sminnityagnihite pradeśe vpadaṃ sthānaṃ vkṛṇute karoti |
agnidhāne yatra pacanāgnirnīyate tasmin pradeśe padaṃ pādanidhānaṃ kṛṇute karoti |
api ca vnaḥ asmākaṃ vgobhyaśca vpuruṣebhyaśca vśaṃ sukhaṃ śaṃsanīyānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ śāntirvā vastu bhavatu |
he devāḥ viha asmin gṛhe vkapotaḥ vnaḥ asmān vmā vhiṃsīt |
yasya dūtaḥ prahita eṣa etattasmai yamāya namo astu mṛtyave ||
yat | ulūkaḥ | vadati | mogham | etat | yat | kapotaḥ | padam | agnau | kṛṇoti | yasya | dūtaḥ | prahitaḥ | eṣaḥ | etat | tasmai | yamāya | namaḥ | astu | mṛtyave || 4 ||
vulūkaḥ ghūkasaṃjñaḥ pakṣī vyat aśobhanaṃ vvadati bravīti ātmīyena śabdena sūcayati vetat vmoghaṃ niṣphalamastu |
vkapotaḥ vca vagnau agnimati gṛhamadhye vyat vpadaṃ kṛṇoti karoti etadapi moghaṃ nirvīryamastu |
vprahitaḥ preṣitaḥ veṣaḥ kapotaḥ vyasya svāminaḥ vdūtaḥ anucaro bhavati vtasmai nāma vmṛtyave mārayitre vyamāya vetat vnamaḥ praṇāmaḥ vastu bhavatu ||
