ṛcā kapota̭ṃ nudata pra॒ṇoda̭mi॒ṣaṃ ma̭danta॒ḥ pari̭ gāṃ na̭yadhvam |
saṃyo॒paya̭nto du॒ri॒tāni॒ viśvā̭ hi॒tvā na॒ ūrjaṃ pra pa̭tātpati̭ṣṭhaḥ ||
ṛcā | kapota̭m | nu॒da॒ta | pra॒'noda̭m | i॒ṣam | ma॒danta̭ḥ | pari̭ | gām | na॒ya॒dhva॒m | sam | yo॒paya̭ntaḥ | du॒ḥi॒tāni̭ | viśvā̭ | hi॒tvā | naḥ | ūrja̭m | pra | pa॒tāt | pa॒ti॒ṣṭhaḥ ||5||
he devā: ᵥṛcā mantreṇa stūyamānā: santo yūyaṃ ᵥpraṇodaṃ prakarṣeṇa nodanīyaṃ bahiṣkartavyaṃ ᵥkapotaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ ᵥnudata asmādgṛhāt prerayata nirgamayata |
tathā ᵥmadantaḥ asmābhirdattairhavirbhirmādyantaḥ ᵥiṣam annaṃ ᵥgāṃ ca ᵥpari ᵥ
vahaṃ vsapatnahā sapatnānāṃ śatrūṇāṃ hantā vasmi bhavāmi |
vindraiva indro yathā kenāpya- hiṃsito bhavati tathāmapi variṣṭaḥ ahisitaḥ vakṣataḥ agraṇaśca bhavāmi |
vime dṛśyamānāḥ vsarve vsapatnāḥ vme mama vpadoḥ pādayoḥ vadhaḥ adhastāt vabhihitāḥ ākrāntā bhavantu ||
atra | eva | vaḥ | api | nahāmi | ubhe iti | ātnī ivetyātnīiva | jyā | vācaḥ | pate | ni | sedha | imān | yathā | mat | adharam | vadān || 3 ||
he sapatnāḥ yatra deśe yūyaṃ nivasaca vatraiva asminneva deśe vvaḥ yuṣmān vapi vnahāmi apinaddhān pāśairbaddhān karomi vubhayā mauryā vubhe vātnīiva |
yathā dve dhanuṣaḥ koṭī dṛḍhaṃ badhyate ta
‘tubhyedam’ iti caturṛcaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ sūktaṃ viśvāmitrajamadagnyorārṣaṃ jagatamaindram|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ— ‘tubhyedaṃ catuṣkaṃ viśvāmitrajamadagnī jāgataṃ tṛtīyā liṅgoktadevatā vā’ iti|
pakṣe indra eva devatā anye tu nipātabhāja iti vāśabdasyārthaḥ|
tubhyedamindra pari ṣicyate madhu tvaṃ sutasya kalaśasya rājasi|
tvaṃ rayiṃ puruvīraṃm naskṛdhi tvaṃ tarpaḥ paritapyājayaḥ svaḥ||
tubhyam| idam| indra| pari| ṣicyate| madhu| tvam| sutasya| kalaśasya| rājasi| tvam| rayim| puru'vīram| ū~ iti| naḥ| kṛdhi| tvam| tarpaḥ| pari'tapya| ajayaḥ| svaḥ|| 1||
he indra idaṃ madhu somalakṣaṇaṃ tubhyaṃ tvadartha
he ᵥdhāta: he etarsaṃjñaka deva he ᵥvidhātaḥ etarsaṃjñaka deva yuvābhyāmanujñāta: ᵥkalaśān kalaśasthān hutaśiṣṭān somān ᵥabhakṣyaṃ bhakṣitavānasmi ||
prasūtau bhakṣamakaraṃ curāvapi stomaṃ cemaṃ prathama: surinmuṃje |
sute sātena yadāgamaṃ vāṃ prati viśvāmitrajamadagnī damai ||
pra'sūtaḥ | bhakṣama | akaram | curau | api | stomam | ca | imam | prathamaḥ | suriḥ | ut | muṃje | sute | sātena | yadai | ā | agamam | vām | prati | viśvāmitrajamadagnī iti | damai || 4 ||
he indra ᵥprasūta: tvayā prerito'haṃ ᵥcarau caraṇīye caraṇā vā yukte yajñe ᵥbhakṣama ᵥapi bhakṣaṇīyaṃ havirvā haviṣya ᵥakaraṃ tvadarthamakāryam |
ᵥprathama: mukhya: ᵥsuri: stotāham ᵥimaṃ ᵥstomāṃ stotraṃ ᵥca tvadartham ᵥunmuṃje unmārjama saṃskaromi |
idānīmindra: antarāramarūpa: san sūktasya draṣṭārāvapi saṃtrodhya brūte |

he ᵥviśvāmitrajamadagnī ᵥvāṃ yuvāṃ ᵥprati ᵥdame yajñagṛhe ᵥsute abhiṣute some sati ᵥsātena saṃbhaktavyena dhanena sārdhaṃ ᵥyadi yadā yasmin kāle'ham ᵥāgamam āgacchāmi tadā yuvāṃ stotraṃ kurutamityartha: ||
‘vātasya’ iti caturṛcaṃ saptadaśaṃ sūktaṃ vātagotrasyānilākhyasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ vāyudevatākam |
vātasya nu mahimānaṃ rathasya rujanaiti stanayansya ghoṣa: |
vātasya | nu | mahimānam | rathasya | rujan | eti | stanayan | asya | ghoṣaḥ | divi'spṛk | yāti | aruṇāni | kṛṇvan | uta iti | eti | pṛthivyā | reṇum | asyan || 1 ||
ᵥvātasya vāyo: ᵥrathasya raṃhaṇaśīlasya ᵥmahimānaṃ māhātmyaṃ ᵥnu kṣipraṃ prabravīmi |
ᵥasya vāyo: ᵥghoṣa: śabda: ᵥstanayan girigahrādiṣu trividhaṃ śabdamutpādayan ᵥrujan sarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgama- jātaṃ bhajan ᵥeti gacchati |
sa ca vāyu: ᵥdivispṛk divamākāśaṃ spṛśan vyāpnuvan ᵥaruṇāni aruṇavarṇāni vikṛturūpāṇi digantarāṇi ᵥkṛṇvan kurvan ᵥyāti prāpnoti |
ᵥuto api ca ᵥpṛthivyā bhūme: ᵥreṇuṃ pāṃsuma ᵥasyan gṛhṇatvā sarvatra vikṣipan ᵥeti gacchati |
saṃ prerete anu vātasya viṣṭhā ainaṃ gacchanti samanaṃ na yoṣā: |
tābhi: sayuksarathaṃ deva īyate'sya viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā ||
sam | pra | īrate | anu | vātasya | vi'sthā: | ā | enam | gacchanti | samanam | na | yoṣā: | tābhiḥ | sa'yuk | saratham | devaḥ | īyate | asya | viśvasya | bhuvanasya | rājā || 2 ||
ᵥviṣṭhā: viśeṣeṇasthitā: parvatādyā: ᵥvātasya vāyorguṇaṃ ᵥsaṃ ᵥprerate saṃpragacchanti |
ᵥsamanaṃ ᵥna saṃgrāmamiva ᵥetra vāyuṃ ᵥyoṣā: aśvayoṣito vaḍavā: ᵥā gacchanti |
ᵥtābhi: vaḍavābhi: ᵥsvayuk svayameva yujyamānaṃ ᵥsarathaṃ samāna-
mekaṃ rathamāhva vdeva: dīpyamāna: vāyu: vīyate gaccha.te |
vasya vviśvasya sarvasya vbhuvanasya dvitīyavikārabhājo bhūtajātasya vrājā svāmī bhavati |
samanaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ yoṣā: kāminya iva evaṃ vāyuṃ tarugulmādirūpā: striyo'bhigacchanti |
tābhi: sarathaṃ saharathaṃ deva īyata iti ||
antarikṣe pṛthiviryemāno na ni viśate katamaccanāha: |
apāṃ sakhā prathamajā ṛtāvā ke svijjātaḥ kuta ā babhūva ||
antarikṣe | pṛthiva'bhi: | īyamāna: | na | ni | viśane | katamat | cana | ahuriti | apāṃ | sakhā | prathamajā: | ṛta'vā | ka | svit | jātaḥ | kutaḥ | ā | babhūva ||3||
vantarikṣe nabhasi vidyamānai: vpathivibhi: mārgai: vīyamāna: gacchan vāyu: vkatamaccanāha: eka- mapi dinaṃ vni vviśate nopaviśati |

vprathamajā: sarvebhya: prāṇibhya: pūrvotpanna eva vṛtāvā satyavān yajñavān vā evaṃbhūto vāyu: vka vsvin kutra khalu deśe vjātaḥ utpanna: vkuta: kasmācca deśāniṣkramya vā vbabhūva idaṃ sarvaṃ jagadgrāpnot |
sarvadā sarvatra vartamānatvādasyotpattirvyāptiprakāraśca na kenāpi jñātuṃ śakyata ityartha: ||
ātmā devānāṃ bhuvanasya garbho yathāvaśaṃ carati deva eṣa: |
ghoṣā idastasya śṛṇvire na rūpaṃ tasmai vātāya haviṣā vidhema ||
ātmā | devānām | bhuvanasya | garbha: | yathā'vaśam | carati | deva: | eṣa: | ghoṣā: | it | asya | śṛṇvire | na | rūpam | tasmai | vātāya | haviṣā | vidhema || 4 ||

ayaṃ vāyu: vdevānām indrādīnāmapi vātmā jīvarūpeṇa tepvavasthānāt vbhuvanasya api bhūtajātasya vgarbha: garbhatvārūpeṇānantarvartamāna: veṣa: īdṛśa: vdeva: vyathāvaśaṃ yathākāmaṃ yathecchaṃ vcarati vartate |
anivāritagati: san kvacicchīghraṃ gacchati kvacicchanairgacchati kutaściccharīrāniṣkrāmati anyacca śarīraṃ praviśatītyevaṃ yathecchaṃ vartata ityartha: |
vasya vāyorāgacchata: vghoṣā vit śabdā eva vśṛṇvire śrūyante |
vrūpaṃ svarūpaṃ tu vna dṛśyate nīrūpatvāt |
vtasmai vātāya vāyave vhaviṣā carupuroḍāśādilakṣaṇena vvidhema paricarema ||
‘mayobhū:’ iti caturṛcamaṣṭādaśaṃ sūktaṃ kakṣīvattotrasya śabarasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ godaivatyam |
anukrāntaṃ ca—‘mayobhū: śabara: kākṣīvato ganyam’ iti |
ghāsāya vanaṃ pratiṣṭhamānā gā ādito dvābhyāmabhimantraṇīyā: |
sutritaṃ ca—‘gā: pratiṣṭhamānā anumantrayeta mayobhūrvāto abhi vāttvā iti dvābhyām’ (āśva. gṛ. 2.10.5) iti ||
maya:'bhū: | vāta: | abhi | vāt | tvā | ūrjasvatī: | oṣadhī: | ā | riṃśantām | pīvasvatī: | jīva'dhanvā: | pibantu | ava | sāya | paddhatai | rudra | mṛḻa || 1 ||
vvāta: vāyu: vmayobhū: sukhasya bhāvayitā san vustrā: gā: vabhi vvātu abhigacchatu |
tāśca gāva: vūrjasvatī: rasavatī: voṣadhī: balavanti vtṛṇāni vā vriśantām abhita: svādayantu |
tathā vpīvasvatī: pravṛddhā: vjīvadhanyā: jīvānāṃ prīṇayitrīrapaśva vpibantu |
he vrudra jvarādirogasya prekṣaṇena saṃhartadeva vpaddhate pādyuktāya vavasāya agnāya gorūpāya vmṛḻa upadayāṃ kuru |

yā: sarūpā virūpā ekarūpā yāsāmgiriṣṭhyā nāmāni veda | yā aṅgirasastarpaseha cakrutābhya: parjanya mahi śarma yaccha || 2 || yā: | sa'rūpā: | vi'rūpā: | eka'rūpā: | yāsām | agni: | itthā | nāmāni | veda | yā: | aṅgirasa: | tarpasā | iha | cakru: | tābhya: | parjanya | mahi | śarma | yaccha || 2 ||

vyā: gāva: vsarūpā: samānarūpā yāśca vvirūpā: vibhinnarūpā yāśca vekarūpā: ekenaiva varṇenopetā: vyāsāṃ ca gavāṃ vnāmāni īṃḍe rante'dita ityādīni viṣṭayā yāgena hetunā vagni: vveda jānāti vyā: ca gā: vaṅgirasa: ṛpaya: vtapasā paśuprāptisādhanena citrayāgādilakṣaṇena viha asmiṃlloke vcakru: kṛtavantaḥ vtābhya: sarvābhyo gobhyo he vparjanya vmahi mahat vśarma sukhaṃ vyaccha pradehi ||
‘yā deveṣu’ iti dvābhyāṃ sāyaṃ gṛhamāgacchantīrgā anumantrayeta |
sūyate hi—‘yā deveṣu tanvamairayanteti ca sūktaśepam |

yā deveṣu tanvaṃ 1mairayanta yāsāṃ somo viśvā rūpāṇi veda | tā asmabhyaṃ paryasā pinvamānā: prajāvatīrindra goṣṭhe rirīhi || 3 || yā: | deveṣu | tanvam | airayanta | yāsām | soma: | viśvā | rūpāṇi | veda | tā: | asmabhyam | paryasā | pinvamānā: | prajāvatī: | indra | go'sthe | rirīhi || 3 ||

vyā: gāva: vdeveṣu yajñeṣu vtanvam ātmīyaṃ śarīram vairayanta havīrūpeṇa prerayanti vyāsāṃ ca gavāṃ vviśvā sarvāṇi vrūpāṇi rūpyamāṇāni kṣīrādīni śrayaṇadravyāṇi vsoma: vveda jānāti vasmabhyam asmadarthaṃ vpayasā kṣīreṇa vpinvamānā: vardhamānā ata eva vprajāvatī: prajābhirvatsai- rupetā: vtā: gā: he vindra vgoṣṭhe asmadīye vrirīhi gamaya ||

prajāpatirhyametā rarāṇo viśvairdevai: pitṛbhi: saṃvidvāna: | śivā: satīrūpa no goṣṭhamākustāsau vayaṃ prajayā saṃ sadema || 4 || prajā'pati: | mahyam | etā: | rarāṇa: | viśvai: | devai: | pitṛbhi: | sam'vidvāna: | śivā: | satī: | upa | na: | go'stham | ā | akṛtyaka: | tāsām | vayam | pra'jayā | sam | sadema || 4 ||
prajāpatiḥ vidhātā mahaṃ stotre etāḥ gāḥ rarāṇaḥ prayacchan |
vidhaiḥ savaiḥ devaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ ca saṃcidvānaḥ aikamatyaṃ gataḥ san śivāḥ satīḥ kalyāṇīrbhavantīrgāḥ naḥ asmākaṃ goṣṭhaṃ vrajam upa goṣṭhasamīpe akaḥ karotu |
tāsāṃ gatrāṃ prajayā saṃtānane vayaṃ saṃ sadama saṃgacchemahi ||
‘vibhrāṭ’ iti caturṛcamekonaviṃśa sūkaṃ sūryaputrasya vibhrāṭsaṃjñakasyārṣa sūryadevatyam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘vibhrāḍ‌vibhrāṭ sauryaḥ sauryaṃ jāgatamāsapaṅktyantam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘vibhrāḍ‌bṛhatpipatu somyaṃ madhu namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakrasa iti stotriyānurūpau’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 6) iti |
sūyate hi—‘vibhrāḍ‌ bṛhatpipatu somyaṃ madhviti yājyā tasya gavāṃ śatānām’ (āśva. śrau. 9. 9) iti ||

vibhrāḍ bṛhatpipatu somyaṃ madhvyāyuradhadyajñapatau vihutam | vārṭajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati || 1 || tri'āṭ | bṛhat | pipatu | somyam | madhu | āyuḥ | dadhat | yajña'patau | avi'hutam | vārṭa'jūtaḥ | yaḥ | abhi'rakṣati | tmanā | prajāḥ | pupoṣa | purudhā | vi | rājati ||1||
vibhrāṭ vibhājamāno viśeṣeṇa dīpyamānaḥ sūryaḥ bṛhat mahat parivṛḍhaṃ somyaṃ somamayaṃ madhu pibatu |
yajñapatau yajamāne avihutam akuṭilam āyuḥ dadhat kurvan |
yaḥ sūryaḥ vātajūtaḥ vātena mahāvāyunā preryamāṇaḥ san tmanā ātmanā svayameva abhirakṣati sarvaṃ jagadabhipaśyan pālayati |
sa sūryaḥ prajāḥ pupoṣa vṛṣṭyādipradānena poṣayati purudhā bahudhā vi rājati viśeṣeṇa dīpyate ca ||

vibhrāḍ bṛhatsubhṛtaṃ vājasātamuṃ dharman divo dharuṇeṃ satyamarpitam | amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhaṃtamaṃ jyotirjajñe asurahā sapatnahā || 2 || tri'āṭ | bṛhat | su'bhṛtam | vāja'sātam | dharman | divaḥ | dharuṇeṃ | satyam | arpitam | amitra'hā | vṛtra'hā | dasyuha'tamam | jyotiḥ | jajñe | asura'hā | sapatna'hā || 2 ||

vibhrāṭ vibhājamānaṃ bṛhat prauḍhaṃ subhṛtaṃ supuṣṭaṃ vājasātam vājasthānasya balasya vā dātutamaṃ dharman dharmaṇi vāyunā dhāritavye divaḥ dyulokasya dharuṇeṃ dhārake sūryamaṇḍale arpitaṃ nikṣiptaṃ satyam avinaśvaram amitrahā amitrāṇāmapriyāṇāṃ hantu vṛtrahā vṛtrāṇāmāvṛṇvatāṃ hantu dasyuhaṃtamaṃ dasyunāmupakṣapayitṝṇāṃ hantṛtamam asurahā asurāṇāṃ kṣepṝṇāṃ ghātakaṃ sapatnahā sapatnānāṃ sahajaśatrūṇāmapi ghātakamīdṛgbhūtaṃ jyotiḥ sauraṃ tejaḥ jajñe prādurbhavati ||
idaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotiruttamaṃ viśvajiddhanajiducyate bṛhat |
viśvabhrāḍ bhrājo mahi sūryo dṛśa uru paprathe saha ojo acyutam ||
idam | śreṣṭham | jyoti̭ṣām | jyotiḥ | utta̭mam | viśva̭jit | dhana̭jit | ucyate | bṛhat | viśva̭'āṭ | bhrājaḥ | mahi | sūryaḥ | dṛśe | uru | paprathe | sahaḥ | ojaḥ | acyutam ||3||
śreṣṭhaṃ praśastatamaṃ jyotiṣām anyeṣāṃ grahaṇakṣatrādīnāmapi jyotiḥ prakāśa- kamata eva uttamam utkṛṣṭaṃ viśvajit viśvasya sarvasya jetṛ dhanajit dhanasya ca jetṛ bṛhat prabhūtam ucyate |
api ca viśvaāṭ viśvasya prakāśayitā āājaḥ ājamānaḥ mahi mahān sūryaḥ dṛśe darśanāya uru vistīrṇaṃ sahaḥ tamaso'bhibhavitṛ acyutaṃ cyutirahitamavināśam ojaḥ tejorūpaṃ balaṃ paprathe vistārayati ||
vi'bhrājan | jyotiṣā | svaḥ | argacchaḥ | rocanam | divaḥ | yena | imā | viśvā | bhuvanāni | ā'bhṛtā | viśvakarmaṇā | viśvadevya'vatā || 4 ||
he sūrya jyotiṣā tejasā svaḥ sarvaṃ jagat vibhrājan vibhrājayan divaḥ saṃbandhi rocanaṃ rocamānaṃ sthānam agacchaḥ prāptaḥ |
tadvā yena saureṇa tejasā imā imāni paridṛśyamānāni viśvā sarvāṇi bhuvanāni udakāni bhaumāni ābhṛtā gharmakāla ābhṛtāni bhavanti |
‘tvaṃ tyam’ iti caturṛcaṃ viṃśaṃ sūktaṃ bhṛguputrasyeṣṭasyārṣaṃ gāyatramaindram |
anukrāntaṃ ca— ‘tvaṃ tyamito bhārgavo gāyatram’ iti |
tvam | tyam | itaḥ | ratham | indra | pra | āvaḥ | suta'vataḥ | arṇoḥ | sominaḥ | harvam ||1||
he indra sutāvataḥ sutenābhiputena somena yuktasya itaḥ iṣṭasya |
etatsaṃjasyaiḥ tvaṃ taṃ prasiddhaṃ rathaṃ prāvaḥ prārakṣaḥ |
sominaḥ somayuktasya mama havam āhvānam arṇoḥ śṛṇu ||
tvaṃ mu॒khasya̭ dodha̭taḥ śi॒ro'va̭ tva॒co bhḙra |
tvam | mukhasya | dodhataḥ | śiraḥ | ava | tvacaḥ | bhara | argacchaḥ | sominaḥ | gṛham || 2 ||
he indra tvaṃ mukhasya yajñasya dodhataḥ kampamānasya devebhyaḥ palāyamānasya śiraḥ pravargya- rūpaṃ tvacaḥ tvagupalakṣitāccharīrāt ava bhara |
devebhyo niṣkrā- ntasya puruṣākārasya dhanvinī yajñasya śira indro vajrarūpeṇa jyāghātadvārā purā ciccheda |
śrūyate hi—‘tasyendro vajrarūpeṇa dhanurjyāmicchinadudrasya tveva dhanurādiḥ śira upipepa sa pravargyo'bhavat’ (tai. ā. 1. 5. 2) iti |
sa tvaṃ sominaḥ somavato mama gṛham agacchaḥ āgaccha ||

tvaṃ tyamindra martyamāstrabudhāya venyam | suhuḥ śradhnā manusyavai || 3 || tvam | tyam | indra | martyam | āstrabudhāya | venyam | suhuḥ | śradhnāḥ | manusyavai || 3 || he indra tvaṃ tyaṃ tyaṃ taṃ martyaṃ manuṣyaṃ venyaṃ venasya putraṃ pṛthum āstrabudhāya | āstrabudho nāma kaścit | tasya putrāya manasyave mananīyaṃ stotramicchate suhuḥ śaśvat śradhnāḥ ahiṃsīḥ | vaśamanaya ityarthaḥ ||

tvaṃ tyamindra sūryyaṃ paścā santaṃ puraskṛdhi | devānāṃ cittiro vaśam ||4|| tvam | tyam | indra | sūryyam | paścā | santam | puraḥ | kṛdhi | devānām | cit | tiraḥ | vaśam ||4|| he indra tvaṃ tyaṃ tyaṃ sūryyaṃ sāyaṃ samaye paścā paścāt santaṃ bhavantaṃ puraḥ paredyuḥ prātaḥkāle purastāt kṛdhi karoṣi | lakāravyatyayaḥ | kīdṛśam | devānāṃ cit devānāmpi tiraḥ tirohitaṃ nairāpi ka gata iti durvijñātaṃ vaśaṃ kāntam || 29 ||
tathā cānukrāntam—‘ā yāhi saṃvarta upasthaṃ dvaipadam’ iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—‘ā yāhi vanasemā nu kaṃ babhure ka iti dvipadā-sūktāni’ (ādha. śrau. 8. 7) iti |
tathaiva pañcamāraṇyake sūtritam—‘ā yāhi vanasā saheti nava samāmnātāḥ’ (ai. ā. 5. 2. 2) iti ||

ā yāhi vanasā maha gāveḥ sacanta vartani yadūrdhabhiḥ || 1 || ā | yāhi | vanasā | maha | gāveḥ | sacanta | vartanim | yat | ūrdhabhiḥ || 1 || he upaḥ vanasā vananīyena tejasā dhanena vā sārdham ā yāhi āgaccha | gāveḥ upayo vāhanabhūtāḥ vartaniṃ rathaṃ sacanta sevante | anastena rathenāyāhītyarthaḥ | yat yā gāvaḥ ūrdhabhiḥ upalakṣitāḥ prabhṛtāḥ | pīnā ityarthaḥ | tā gāva iti saṃbandhaḥ ||

ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā mahiṣṭho jāryyanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ || 2 || ā | yāhi | vasvyā | dhiyā | mahiṣṭhaḥ | jāryyan'makhaḥ | sudānubhiḥ || 2 || he upaḥ vasvyā praśastayā dhiyā anugrahabuddhayā karmaṇā stutyā vā sārdham ā yāhi āgaccha | sa coṣaḥkālaḥ sudānubhiḥ śobhanānnairdānabhiḥ puruṣaiḥ mahiṣṭhaḥ dhanānāṃ dātratamaḥ | ata eva jāryyanmakhaḥ mamāpayajñaśca bhavati ||

pitṛbhṛto na tantumitsudānavaḥ prati daṣmo yajāmasi || 3 || pitṛ'bhṛtaḥ | na | tantum | it | sudānavaḥ | prati | daṣmaḥ | yajāmasi || 3 || pitṛbhṛto na annasya bhartāra iva sudānavaḥ śobhanādānā vayaṃ tantumittantuṃ vistīrṇameva prati daṣmaḥ | upamaṃ kyupāyanarūpeṇa dhārayāmaḥ | tena ca yajñena tāmupasaṃ yajāmasi ||
1. ta-bha-ahiṃsīt | 2. ta1.2.3.6.8-bhara-taṃtaṃ te | 3. ta7-tyaṃ taṃ | 4. ga-ta-bha1.4.8-taṃtaṃ; bhara-taṃ taṃ | 5. ga-vistīrṇaṃ yajñameva |
daśame'hani prātaranuvāka upasthe kratau 'upo bhadebhiḥ' ityasyāḥ sthāne 'upā apa svasuḥ' ityeṣā'|
sūtritaṃ ca—'upā apa svasutama iti' paccho dvipadāṃ trirupasthe' (āśva. śrau. 8. 12) iti ||
upā ap svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartani sujātā || 4 || upāḥ | ap | svasuḥ | tamaḥ | sam | vartayati | vartanim | su'jātā || 4 ||
iyam upāḥ svasuḥ bhaginyā rātreḥ saṃbandhi tamaḥ andhakāram apa saṃ vartayati |
'sujātā sujātatvādātmanaḥ suprajātatvaṃ ca vartaniṃ rathaṃ prāpayati||
'ā tvā' iti ṣaḍcaṃ dvāviṃśaṃ sūktāṅgirasasya dhruvasyārthamānuṣṭubham |
tathā cānukrāntam—'ā tvā ṣaḍ dhruvo rājñaḥ stutisvānuṣṭubhaṃ tu' iti |
rājño yuddhāya saṃhanahe'nena sūktenābhimantraṇaṃ purodhasā kartavyam |
sūtritaṃ ca—'ā tvāhāryamantare- dhīti paścādrathasyāvasthāpya' (āśva. gṛ. 3. 12. 2) iti ||

ā tvāhāryamantaredhi dhruvastiṣṭhāvicācalaḥ | viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhi bhraśat || 1 || ā | tvā | ahārpam | antaḥ | edhi | dhruvaḥ | tiṣṭha | avi'acalaḥ | viśaḥ | tvā | sarvāḥ | vāñchantu | mā | tvat | rāṣṭram | adhi | bhraśat || 1 ||
he rājan tvā tvām ā ahārpam asmadrāṣṭrasya svāmitvenānaipam |
sa tvam antaḥ asmāsu madhye edhi svāmī bhava |
dhruvaḥ nityaḥ san avicācalaḥ atiśayena calanarahitaḥ eva san tiṣṭha rāṣṭramadhi tiṣṭha |
sarvāḥ ca viśaḥ prajāḥ tvā tvāṃ vāñchantu |
tvat tvataḥ sakāśāt rāṣṭraṃ rājyaṃ mā adhi bhraśat mā bhraśyatu |

ihaivaidhi māpa cyoṣṭhāḥ parvata ivāvicācalaḥ | indraiveha dhruvastiṣṭheha rāṣṭramu dhāraya || 2 || iha | eva | edhi | mā | apa | cyoṣṭhāḥ | parvataḥ | iva | avi'acalaḥ | indraḥ | iva | iha | dhruvaḥ | tiṣṭha | iha | rāṣṭram | ū~ iti | dhāraya || 2 ||
he rājan iha asmin eva rājye edhi svāmitvena sarvadā vartamāno bhava |
parvataiva yathā parvato naiścalyenāvatiṣṭhate evam avicācalaḥ calanarahito bhava |
indraiva yathā svarge indraḥ evam iha loke tvaṃ dhruvastiṣṭha sthiro bhava |
rāṣṭramu rāṣṭraṃ ca iha loke dhāraya |
tasmai॒ somo॒ adhi̭ bra॒vattasmā̭ u bra॒hmaṇa॒spati̭ḥ ||
i॒mam | indra̭: | a॒dī॒dha॒ra॒t | dhru॒vam | dhru॒veṇa̭ | ha॒viṣā̭ | tasmai̭ | so॒ma: | adhi̭ | bra॒vat | tasmai̭ | ū॒ṃ iti̭ | bra॒hmaṇa̭: | pa॒ti: | || 3 ||
imam abhiṣiktaṃ dhruveṇa sthireṇa haviṣā tarpyamāṇaḥ indraḥ dhruvaṃ sthiram adīdharat dhārayatu |
somaḥ ca tasmai rājñe adhi bravat adhivaktu |
tasmā u tasmā eva brahmaṇaspatiḥ mantrasya pālako devaścādhivaktu ||
dhru॒vā dyaurdhru॒vā pṛ̭thi॒vī dhru॒vāsa॒ḥ parva̭tā i॒me |
dhru॒vaṃ vi॒śvamida॒ṃ jaga̭d dhru॒vo rājā॒ viśāma॒yam ||
dhru॒vā | dyau: | dhru॒vā | pṛ॒thi॒vī | dhru॒vāsa̭: | parva̭tā: | i॒me | dhru॒vam | vi॒śvam | i॒dam | jaga̭t | dhru॒va: | rājā̭ | vi॒śām | a॒yam || 4 ||
ime dṛśyamānāḥ parvatāḥ mahīdharāśca dhruvāsaḥ sthirāḥ |
idaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ jagat dhruvaṃ sthiraṃ bhavati |
evameva ayaṃ viśām prajānāṃ rājā svāmī san dhruvaḥ sthiro bhavatu ||
dhru॒vaṃ te॒ rājā॒ varṷṇo dhru॒vaṃ de॒vo bṛha॒spati̭: |
dhru॒vaṃ ta indra̭ścā॒gniśca̭ rā॒ṣṭraṃ dhā̭rayatāṃ dhru॒vam ||
dhru॒vam | te॒ | rājā̭ | varṷṇa: | dhru॒vam | de॒va: | bṛ॒ha॒spati̭: | dhru॒vam | te॒ | indra̭: | ca | a॒gni: | ca | rā॒ṣṭram | dhā॒ra॒ya॒tām | dhru॒vam || 5 ||
he rājan te tava rāṣṭraṃ rājā rājamānaḥ varuṇaḥ dhruvaṃ sthiraṃ dhārayatu |
indraśca agniśca ubhāvapi te tava rāṣṭraṃ dhruvaṃ sthiraṃ dhārayatām |
dhru॒vam | dhru॒veṇa̭ | ha॒viṣā̭ | a॒bhi | somḙm | mṛ॒śā॒ma॒si | atho̭ | iti̭ | te॒ | indra̭: | ke॒valī̭: | vi॒śa: | ba॒li॒'hṛta̭: | ka॒ra॒t || 6 ||
dhruveṇa sthireṇa haviṣā puroḍāśādinā¹ yuktaṃ dhruvaṃ sthiraṃ somam abhi mṛśāmasi abhimṛśāmaḥ |
atho athāntarameva indraḥ viśaḥ prajāḥ ta tavaiva kevalīḥ asādhāraṇāḥ satīḥ balihṛtaḥ karasya² pradātrīḥ karat karotu ||
purohita idaṃ sūktaṃ rājānaṃ yuddhāya kṛtasaṃnāhaṃ vācayīta |
sūyate hi—‘athainaṃ sārayamāṇamupārahmābhīvartaṃ vācayati’ (āśva. gṛ. 3. 12. 12) iti ||
abhīvartena | haviṣā | yena | indraḥ | abhi'vāvṛte | tena | asmān | brahmaṇaḥ | pate | abhi | rāṣṭrāya | vartaya || 1 ||
īdṛśena yena haviṣā sādhanena indraḥ abhivāvṛte sarvamabhijāgama tena haviṣpavataḥ asmān he brahmaṇaspate rāṣṭrāya rājyaṃ prāptum abhi vartaya abhigamaya ||
abhi pṛttanyantaṃ tiṣṭhābhi yo na irasryati ||
abhi'vṛtya | sa'patnān | abhi | yāḥ | naḥ | arātayaḥ | abhi | pṛttanyantam | tiṣṭha | abhi | yaḥ | naḥ | irasryati || 2 ||
he rājan sapatnān śatrūn abhivṛtya abhino gamayitvā naḥ asmākaṃ yāḥ arātayaḥ adānaśīlāḥ prajāḥ santi tā api abhi tiṣṭha abhibhava |
pṛttanyantaṃ pṛtanāḥ senā ātmana icchantaṃ yuyutsuṃ ca abhi tiṣṭha ||
yaḥ ca naḥ asamyam irasryati īrṣyati |
abhi tvā devaḥ savitābhi somo abhīvṛtat |
abhi | tvā | devaḥ | savitā | abhi | somaḥ | abhīvṛtat | abhi | tvā | viśvā | bhūtāni | abhi'vṛtaḥ | yathā | asasi || 3 ||
he rājan devaḥ dānādiguṇayuktaḥ savitā tvā tvām abhi avīvṛtat abhivartayatu |
viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇyapi bhūtāni pṛthivyādīni tvām abhi vartayantu |
yathā yena prakāreṇa tvam abhīvartaḥ asasi abhitaḥ sarvatra vartamāno bhavasi ||
yena̭ | indra̭: | ha॒viṣā̭ | kṛ॒vī | a̭bhavat | dyumnī | u॒ta'tamaḥ | i॒dam | tat | a॒kri | de॒vā: | a̭sapatna: | kil | a̭bhavam || 4 ||
tadvān ata eva ^uttama: utkṛṣṭamaścābhavat ^tat ^idaṃ havi: he ^devā: ^akri akāri |
a̭sapatna: | sa̭patna॒hā | a̭bhirā॒ṣṭra: | vi॒pāsa̭hi: | yathā̭ha॒meṣā̭ | bhū॒tānā̭m | vi॒rāja̭ni | ja॒nasya̭ ca || 5 || a̭sapatna: | sa̭patna॒hā | a̭bhirā॒ṣṭra: | vi॒pāsa̭hi: | yathā
^vgrāvāṇaḥ dikṣvavasthitāḥ pāpāṇāḥ ^vsajopasaḥ saha prīyamāṇāḥ saṃgatāḥ santo vā ^vupareṣu|
uparo nāmābhivavāya catuṇāṃ grāvṇāṃ madhye sthāpito vistṛtaḥ pāpāṇaḥ|
grāvāṇaḥ savitā nu vo devaḥ sunvatu dharmaṇā |
grāvāṇaḥ | savitā | nu | vaḥ | devaḥ | sunvatu | dharmaṇā | yajamānāya | sunvate || 4 ||
^vdevaḥ dānādiguṇayuktaḥ ^vsavitā he ^vgrāvāṇaḥ ^vvaḥ yuṣmān ^vdharmeṇa ātmīyena dhāraṇena ^vnu kṣipraṃ ^vsunvatu abhipave prerayatu|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘pra sūnavaḥ sūnurābhaṃva āgneyānuṣṭubhaṃ dvitīyā gāyatryābharvī’ iti|
kṣāma ye viśvadhāyaso'śnan dhenuṃ na mātaram ||
pra | sūnavaḥ | ṛbhuṇām | bṛhat | navanta | vṛtanā | kṣāma | ye | viśvadhāyasaḥ | aśnan | dhenum | na | mātaram || 1 ||

^vsūnavaḥ etatsaṃjñāḥ ^vṛbhuṇām| ṛbhurvibhvā vāja iti trayāṇāmapi prathamena vyapadeśaḥ| teṣāṃ putrāḥ ^vbṛhat prabhūtaṃ ^vvṛtanā | saṃgrāmanāmaitat| vṛtanaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ ^vpra ^vnavanta | navantirgatikarmā| pragacchanti| prakaryeṇa gacchanti| prakṛṣṭagamanena jayo lakṣyate| tatra śatrūñjayantītyarthaḥ| sūnunāmapirā- samānameva parokṣeṇa niradiśan| ekasminnapi pūjāthaṃ bahuvacanam| ^vye ṛbhavaḥ ^vviśvadhāyasaḥ viśvasya dhārakāḥ ^vkṣāma bhūmim ^vaśnan vyāpyanuvan| ‘annā vyāptau’| vyatyayena kṣā| ^vdhenuṃ ^vna | dhenuḥ prīṇayitrī gauḥ| tāmiva tepāmṛbhūṇāmityanvayaḥ| yadvā| sūryyaraśmayo'pyabhava ucyante| ya uru bhāsamānāḥ sūryyaraśmayo viśvadhāyasaṃ viśvaṃ sarvaṃ rasaṃ dhayantaḥ3 pibantaḥ| yadvā| vṛṣthādipradānena sarvasya dhārakāḥ| evaṃbhūtāḥ santaḥ kṣāma bhūmimaśnan abhuñjata tadīyaṃ sarvaṃ rasamapiban| tatra dṛṣṭāntaḥ| ^vmātaraṃ jananīṃ dhenuṃ payasvinoṃ gāṃ yathā vatsamaḥ pibati tathā| ya ṛbhavo'śnanti tepāmṛbhūṇāmityanvayaḥ ||
sūtritaṃ ca—‘preṣitā'bhipraṇayanīyāḥ pratipadyate pra devaṃ devyā dhiyeti tisraḥ’ (āśva. śrau. 2. 17) iti ||
pra devaṃ devyā dhiyā bharatā jātavedasam |

ayamu pya pra devayurhotā yajñāya nīyate | ratho na yorbhīvṛto ghṛṇīvāśvatita tmanā || 3 || ayam | oṃ iti | syaḥ | pra | devayuḥ | hotā | yajñāya | nīyate | ratheḥ | na | yoḥ | abhi'vṛtaḥ | ghṛṇi'vān | cetati | tmanā || 3 ||

api ca ॰rathaḥ raṃhaṇaśīlaḥ sūryo rathavān vā ||
sa yathā ॰ghṛṇīvān dīptimān taddhītaḥ ॰yoḥ miśrayitā haviṣā devaiḥ saṃgamayitā ||

ayamuruṣyatyamṛtādiva janmanḥ | sahasaśrita sahīyān devo jīvātave kṛtaḥ ||4|| ayam | agniḥ | uruṣyati | amṛtāt'iva | janmanḥ | sahasaḥ | cit | sahīyān | devaḥ | jīvātave | kṛtaḥ || 4 ||

'pataṅgama' iti tṛcaṃ ṣaḍviṃśaṃ sūktaṃ prajāpatiputrasya pataṅgasyārṣam |
anukrāntaṃ ca—'pataṅgaṃ tṛcaṃ pataṅgaḥ prājāpatyo māyā- bhedaṃ jagatyādi' iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pataṅgamaktamasurasya māyayā yo naḥ sanutyaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti ||

pataṅgamaktamasurasya māyayā hṛdā paśyanti manasā vipaścitaḥ | samudre antaḥ kavayo vi cakṣate marīcīnāṃ padamicchanti vedhasaḥ || 1 || pataṅgama | aktam | asurasya | māyayā | hṛdā | paśyanti | manasā | vipaḥ'citaḥ | samudre | antaḥ | kavayaḥ | vi | cakṣate | marīcīnām | padam | icchanti | vedhasaḥ || 1 ||
^asurasya asanakuśalasya^ sarvopādhivihīnasya parabrahmaṇaḥ saṃbandhanayā ^māyayā triguṇātmikayā ^aktaṃ vyaktamabhivyaktam|
ya evaṃ ^vedhasaḥ ^vidhātāra uktaprakāreṇa sūryopāsanasya kartāraste ^marīcīnāṃ raśmīnāṃ ^padaṃ sthānaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam ^icchanti abhilapanti|
māyāktaṃ jīvarūpeṇābhivyaktamātmānaṃ vipaścito vedāntābhisā hṛtsthenāntarmukhena manasā pataṅgam|
api ca te kavayaḥ krāntadarśino vedāntābhijñāḥ samudre|
ato ^hṛṣyatiriktasya sarvasya mithyātvādbheso vidhātāraste marīcīnāṃ vṛttijñānānāṃ padamadhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ saccitsukhātmakaṃ yatparaṃ brahma tadevacchanti|
sūtritaṃ ca— 'yadvāvadantyavi- cetanāni pataṅgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti' (āśva. śrau. 3. 8) iti||
pataṅgo vācaṃ manasā bibharti tāṃ gandharvo'vadadgarbhe antaḥ|
tāṃ dyotamānāṃ svaryaṃ manīpāmṛtasya pade kavayo ni pānti ||
pataṅgaḥ| vācam| manasā| bibharti| tām| gandharvaḥ| avadat| garbhe| antariti| tām| dyotamānām| svaryam| manīpām| ṛtasya| pade| kavayaḥ| ni| pānti || 2 ||
śrūyate hi— 'ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇe divi deva īyate yajurveda tiṣṭhati madhye ahaḥ sāmavedenāstamaye mahīyate vaidairaśūnyastribhiriti sūryaḥ' (tai. brā. 3.12.9.1) iti|
'mārutastūrṇisa caranmandraṃ janayati svaram' (pā. śi. 7) iti smaraṇāt|
^dyotamānāṃ ^svaryaṃ svargamayitrīṃ svargāṃya hitāṃ vā ^manīṣāṃ manasa īśitrīṃ ^tāṃ trayīrūpāṃ vācam ^ṛtasya yajñasya satyabhūtasya sūryasya vā ^pade sthāne ^kavayaḥ medhāvina ṛṣayaḥ ^ni ^pānti|
kāni kāni sraṣṭavyānīti paryā- locanena manasā sakalārthapratipādakaṃ vedaṃ parāmṛṣṭavānityarthaḥ|
smaryate hi— 'vedaśabdebhya evādau nirmame sa maheśvaraḥ' iti|
garbhe hiraṇmaye brahmāṇḍe'ntarvartamāno gandharvo hiraṇyagarbharatāṃ vācamavadat prathamamuccāritavān|
dyotamānādiguṇaviśiṣṭāṃ tāṃ vācaṃ kavayaḥ krāntadarśino devā ṛtasya satyasya brahmaṇaḥ pade sthāne ni pānti nibhṛtaṃ rakṣanti||
sūtritaṃ ca— 'apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānaṃ svake dapsasya' (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti||
apaśyaṃ gopāṃmanupadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam |
sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ||
apaśyam | gopāṃm | anidyamānam | ā | ca | parā | ca | pathibhiḥ | carantam | saḥ | sadhrīcīḥ | saḥ | viṣūcīḥ | vasānaḥ | ā | varīvarti | bhuvaneṣu | antaḥ || 3 ||
4pathibhiḥ ākāśamārgaiḥ pūrvāhṇe 5ā carantam asmānabhilakṣya gacchantaṃ sāyaṃsamaye 6parā carantaṃ parāṅmukhaṃ gacchantam |

ime lokā rathāḥ | tān somaharaṇasamaye śīghraṃ tarītāram | śrūyate hi—‘epa hīmāllokānsadya- starati’ (ai. brā. 4. 20) iti || taratestuci ‘prasitastambhita0’ ityādivāḍāgamo nipātyate (pā. sū. 7. 2. 34) || \ariṣṭanemim\ ahisitaratham | yadvā | nemirnamanaśīlamāyudham | ahisi- tāyudham | athavā | upacārājjanake janyaśabdaḥ | ariṣṭanemermama janakam | \pṛtanāṃ\ pṛtanānāṃ śatru- senānāṃ prājitāraṃ pragamayitāraṃ jetāraṃ vā | ‘aja gatikṣepaṇayoḥ |’ asmātkip | \valādāvadhātuke\ vikalpa iṣyate’ (kā. 2. 4. 56. 2) iti vacanādbhāvābhāvaḥ | jayetervā ḍapratyayaḥ | \āśu\ śīghragāminam ||

\yaḥ\ \cit\ yo'pi tākṣyaḥ \sadyaḥ\ śīghraṃ \śavasā\ ātmīyena balena \apaḥ\ udakāni amṛta- lakṣaṇāni \tatāna\ vistāritavān \sūryaiva\ yathā sūryaḥ sarvasya preraka ādityaḥ \jyotiṣā\ ātmīyena tejasā varṣatau apo vistārayati tadvat |
\asya\ tākṣyasya \raṃhiḥ\ gatiḥ \sahasrasāḥ\ sahasrasaṅkhyasya dhanasya dātrī saṃbhaktrī vā bhavati |
tathā \śatasāḥ\ śatasya ca dātrī saṃbhaktrī vā bhavati ||
\na\ \sma\ na khalvīdṛśīṃ tākṣyasya \te\ gatiṃ \varante\ ke cana vārayanti |
sā yathā durnivārā tathaiva kaiścidapi vārayitumaśakyetyarthaḥ |
atra niruktaṃ—‘sadyo'pi yaḥ śavasā tanotyapaḥ sūryaiva jyotiṣā pañca manuṣyājātāni sahasasāni śatasānistha sā gatirna smaina vārayanti prayuvatīmiva śaramīmiṣam’ (niru. 10 29) iti ||
uśīnaraputraḥ śibi- rnāma rājā prathamāyā ṛṣiḥ|
tathā cānukrāntam—‘uttiṣṭhatarccāḥ śibirauśīnaraḥ kāśirājaḥ pratardano rauhidaśvo vasumanā ādyānuṣṭup’ iti|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘hotarvedasvetyukta uttiṣṭhatāva paśyatetyāha’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 13) iti||
ut| tiṣṭhata| atra| paśyata| indrasya| bhāgam| ṛtviyam| yadi| śrātaḥ| juhotana| yadi| aśrātaḥ| mamattana || 1 ||
utthāya ṛtviyam ṛtau vasantādikāle bhavam indrasya bhāgaṃ bhajanīyaṃ dadhigharmaṃ pacyamānam ava paśyata nirīkṣadhvam||
‘siti ca’ (pā. sū. 1. 4. 16) iti padasaṃjñayā asaṃjñāyā bādhādaurguṇābhāvaḥ|
yadi sa bhāgaḥ śrātaḥ pakṣastarhi juhotana|
sūtritaṃ ca—‘śrātaṃ havirityuktaḥ śrātaṃ havirityanvāha’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 13) iti||
śrātaṃ haviro ṣpindra pra yāhi jagāma sūro adhvano virmadhyam|
pari tvāste nidhibhiḥ sakhāyaḥ kulapā na vājapatiṃ carantam ||

he indra haviḥ dadhigharmākhyaṃ tvadīyaṃ śrātaṃ pakvam|
o ā u su suṣṭhu pra yāhi prakarṣeṇa śīghra- māgaccha|
sūraḥ sūryaḥ adhvanaḥ gantavyasya mārgasya vimadhyaṃ vikalamadhyabhīpadūnaṃ madhyabhāgaṃ jagāma gatavān|
sakhāyaḥ samānasthānā ṛtvijaśca nidhibhiḥ nihitaiḥ abhindyāsāditaiḥ somaiḥ sādhaṃ tvā tvāṃ pari āsate paryupāsate|
kulapā na kulasya vaṃśasya rakṣakāḥ putrā yathā vājapatim|
sūyate hi—‘śrātaṃ manya udhani śrāta- masāviti yajati’ (āśva. śrau. 5. 13) iti||

śrātaṃ manyu ūdhani śrātamagnau suśrātaṃ manye tadṛtaṃ navīyaḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya sarvasya dadhnaḥ pibeṃdra vajrin puruhūta juṣāṇaḥ || 3 || śrātam | manye | ūdhani | śrātam | agnau | suśrātam | manye | tat | ṛtam | navīyaḥ | mādhyaṃdinasya | sarvasya | dadhnaḥ | piba | indra | vajrin | puruhūta | juṣāṇaḥ || 3 ||
ata etaddhaviḥ 1ṛtaṃ satyabhūtaṃ 2navīyaḥ navataraṃ pratyagrataraṃ bhavati |
he 3vajrin vajravan he 4puruhūta bahumaṃkṛta 5indra 6juṣāṇaḥ prīyamāṇastvaṃ 7mādhyaṃdinasya madhyaṃdine bhavasya 8savanasya somasya saṃbandhin 9dadhnaḥ |
'pra sasāhiṣe' iti tucamekonatriṃśaṃ sūktamindraputrasya jayasyārṣaṃ traiṣṭubhamaindram |

darśa indrasya havipaḥ 'pra sasāhiṣe' ityeṣā yājyā |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūn mahā indro ya ojasā' (āśva. śrau. 1.6) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūn svastaye vājibhiśca praṇetaḥ' (āśva. śrau. 3. 7) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca—'pra sasāhiṣe puruhūta śatrūn bhuvasvamindra brahmaṇa mahān' (āśva. śrau. 4.11) iti ||

gameścāndase liṭi’ kādiniyamaprāptasyeṭa: ‘upadeśe'tvata:’ (pā. sū. 7.2.62) iti pratiṣedha: ||

tapurmūrdhā tapattu rakṣaso ye brahmadviṣaḥ śareve hantavā u | kṣipadaśastirmapa durmatiṃ hanthā karayarjamānāya śaṃ yoḥ || 3 || tapuḥ'mūrdhā | tapattu | rakṣasaḥ | ye | brahma'dviṣaḥ | śareve | hantavai | oṃ iti | kṣipat | arśastim | apa | duḥ'matim | han | atha | karata | yajamānāya | śam | yoḥ ||3||
tapurmūrdhā tāpakaśirasko bṛhaspatiḥ rakṣasaḥ ye brahmadviṣaḥ brāhmaṇadveṣiṇo rākṣasāḥ tān rākṣasān tapattu tāpayatu |
śareve śaṃ hiṃsakaṃ rakṣasāmadhipatiṃ hantavai hantum |
tathā cānukrāntam—'apaśyaṃ prajāvān prājāpatyo'nṛcaṃ yajamānapatnīhotrāśriḥ' iti |
sūyate hi—'apaśyaṃ' tvetyetasyācayā yajamānamīkṣate dvitīyayā patnīṃ tṛtīyayātmānam' (āśva. śrau. 4. 6) iti ||

apaśyaṃ tvā manasā cekitānaṃ tapaso jātaṃ tapaso vibhūtam | iha prajāmiha rayiṃ rarāṇaḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāma || 1 || apaśyam | tvā | manasā | cekitānam | tapasaḥ | jātam | tapasaḥ | vi'bhūtam | iha | pra'jām | iha | rayim | rarāṇaḥ | pra | jāyasva | pra'jayā | putra'kāma || 1 ||
he yajamāna tvā tvāṃ manasā buddhyā apaśyam adarśam |
cekitānaṃ karmāṇi bhṛśaṃ jānantaṃ tapasaḥ dīkṣārūpādnātat jātaṃ punarutpannaṃ yadvā janmāntarānuṣṭhitātsukṛtādutpannaṃ tapasaḥ anuṣṭhīyamānāccājñādvetoḥ vibhūtaṃ vyāptaṃ sarvatra prakhyātam |
he putrakāma putrān kāmayamāna sa tvam iha asmiṃlloke prajāṃ putrapautrādirūpāṃ rarāṇaḥ ramayan rayiṃ dhanam iha asmiṃlloke ramayan prajayā prajanena pra jāyasva putrādirūpeṇotpadyasva' |

apaśyaṃ tvā manasā dīdhyānāṃ svāyāṃ tanū ṛtvye nārthamānām | upa māmuccā yuvatirbabhūyāḥ pra jāyasva prajayā putrakāme || 2 || apaśyam | tvā | manasā | dīdhyānām | svāyām | tanū iti | ṛtvye | nārthamānām | upa | mām | uccā | yuvatiḥ | babhūyāḥ | pra | jāyasva | pra'jayā | putra'kāme || 2 ||
he parin dīdhyānāṃ dīpyamānāṃ svāyām ātmīyāyāṃ tanū tanvāṃ śarīre ṛtvye |
ṛtu- kāle bhavaṃ garbhadhāraṇarūpaṃ karma ṛtviyam |
tasminnimittabhūte nādhamānāṃ bharturupagamanaṃ yācamānāṃ tvā tvāṃ manasā apaśyam adrākṣam |
he putrakāme putrān kāmayamāne mām upa matsamapi
4. ta1.2.3.6.7.8-bha-jāyasva prajā utpādaya; ta4.5-jāyasva prajā utpādayasva |
prāpya sā svam ᵥuccā uccairbhūtaṃ ᵥyuvatiḥ taruṇī ᵥbabhūyāḥ|
yuvatirbhūtvā ca ᵥprajayā prajanena ᵥpra ᵥjāyasva putrān prasūsva|
ahaṃ prajā aṃjanayaṃ pṛthivyāmahaṃ janibhyo aparīṣu putrān ||
aham| garbham| adadhām| oṣadhīṣu| aham| viśveṣu| bhuvaneṣu| antaḥ| aham| pra'jāḥ| ajanayam| pṛthivyām| aham| jani'bhyaḥ| aparīṣu| putrān || 3 ||
ᵥahaṃ hotā ᵥopadhīṣu śālyādiṣu phalāthaṃ ᵥgarbhamadadhāṃ dhārayāmi|
ᵥviśveṣu sarveṣvanyeṣvapi ᵥbhuvaneṣu bhūtajāteṣu ᵥantaḥ madhye ᵥaham eva garbha dhārayāmi|
tathā ᵥpṛthivyāṃ bhūyyāṃ ᵥprajāḥ sarvān manuṣyān ᵥaham ᵥajanayaṃ janayāmi|
ᵥjanibhyaḥ jāyābhyaḥ ᵥaparīṣu anyāsvapi ᵥstrīṣu ᵥputrān ᵥaham ajanayaṃ janayāmi|
garbhāṇāṃ kartā tvaṣṭā nāmarpiḥ prajāpatiputro viṣṇurvā|
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'viṣṇustvaṣṭā garbhakartā viṣṇurvā prājāpatyo garbhāthāśīrliṅgodaivatamānuṣṭubham' iti|
ā siñcatu prajāpatirdhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||
viṣṇuḥ| yonim| kalpayatu| tvaṣṭā| rūpāṇi| piṃśatu| ā| siñcatu| prajā'patiḥ| dhātā| garbham| dadhātu| te || 1 ||
ᵥviṣṇuḥ vyāpakaḥ devaḥ ᵥyoniṃ garbhādhānasthānaṃ ᵥkalpayatu karotu|
ᵥtvaṣṭā tanukartā etatsaṃjako devaśca ᵥrūpāṇi nirūpakāṇi strīpuṃsatvābhivyañkāni cihnāni ᵥpiṃśatu avayavīkarotu ||
evaṃ praklaptāyāṃ yonyāṃ ᵥprajāpatiḥ retaḥ ᵥā ᵥsiñcatu niṣiñcatu|
ᵥdhātā dhārako devo he jāye ᵥte tava ᵥgarbhaṃ garbharūpeṇa pariṇataṃ tadetaḥ ᵥdadhātu|
garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati|
garbhaṃ te aśvinau devāvā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
garbham| dhehi| sinīvāli| garbham| dhehi| sarasvati| garbham| te| aśvinau| devau| ā| dhattām| puṣkara'srajā || 2 ||
he ᵥsinīvāli etatsaṃjye devi ᵥgarbhaṃ ᵥdhehi|
he ᵥsarasvati tvaṃ ca niṣikaṃ ᵥgarbha dhāraya|
he jāye ᵥpuṣkarasrajā puṣkaramālinau svarṇakamalābharaṇī ᵥaśvinī ᵥdevau ᵥte tava ᵥgarbham ᵥā ᵥdhattāṃ prakṣipatām|
taṃ te garbhaṃ havāmahe daśame māsi sūtave ||
hiraṇyayī iti̭ | ara॒ṇī iti̭ | yam | ni:'manyataḥ | aśvinau | tam | te | garbham | havāmahe | daśame | māsi | sūtave || 3 ||
'hiraṇyayī hiraṇmayau 'araṇī 'yaṃ garbhamuddiśya 'aśvinā aśvinau devau 'nirmanthataḥ nirmathita- ghanto he jāye 'te tubhyaṃ tvadarthaṃ 'taṃ 'garbhaṃ 'havāmahe āhvayāmahe |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—'mahi satyadhṛtivāriṇarādityaṃ svastyayanaṃ gāyatraṃ vā 'iti |
sūyate hi—'mahi trīṇāmityanumantryaivamatisṛṣṭasya na kutaścidbhayaṃ bhavatīti vijñāyate ' (āśva. gṛ. 3. 10. 7-8) iti ||
mahiṃ trīṇāmavo̭'stu du॒kṣaṃ mi॒trasyāryamṇaḥ | du॒rādharṣaṃ varṷṇasya || 1 || mahiṃ | trīṇām | ava̭: | a॒stu | du॒kṣam | mi॒trasya̭ | aryamṇaḥ | duḥ'ādharṣam | varṷṇasya || 1 ||
'trīṇāṃ trayāṇāṃ 'mitrasya 'aryamṇaḥ 'varuṇasya ca 'dukṣaṃ dīṃsamata eva 'durādharṣam anyai- rdharṣituṃ bādhitumaśakyaṃ 'mahi mahat 'avaḥ rakṣaṇamasmākam 'astu |
nahi tḙṣāma॒mā ca॒na nādhva̭su vāra॒ṇepṷ | īśḙ ri॒puragha̭śaṃsaḥ || 2 || nahi | tḙṣām | a॒mā | ca॒na | na | adhva̭su | vāra॒ṇepṷ | īśḙ | ri॒puḥ | agha̭śaṃsaḥ || 2 ||
'amā 'cana gṛheṣvapi 'teṣāṃ varuṇamitrāryamṇāṃ tadanugṛhītānāṃ stotṛṇāṃ vā 'aghaśaṃsaḥ aghamanarthamāśaṃsamānaḥ 'ripuḥ śatruḥ 'nahi 'īśe na' khalu' hiṃsitumīṣṭe ||
tathā 'adhvasu mārgeṣu 'vāraṇepu yatra puruṣā nivāryante teṣu ca sthāneṣu śatrurni vārayituṃ 'na īṣṭe ||
yasmai̭ pu॒trāso̭ adi̭teḥ pra jī॒vasḙ ma॒rtyāya̭ | jyo॒tiryaccha̭ntyarja॒sam || 3 || yasmai̭ | pu॒trāsa̭ḥ | adi̭teḥ | pra | jī॒vasḙ | ma॒rtyāya̭ | jyo॒tiḥ | yaccha̭nti | arja॒sam || 3 ||
'aditeḥ adīnāyā devamātuḥ 'putrāsaḥ putrā mitrādayaḥ 'yasmai 'martyāya manuṣyāya stotre 'ajasam avicchinnaṃ 'jyotiḥ tejaḥ 'jīvase jīvituṃ 'pra 'yacchanti tasya śatrurneśvara ityarthaḥ ||
'vāta : ' iti tṛcaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ sūktaṃ vātagotrasyolasyārṣaṃ gāyatraṃ vāyudevatākam |
tathā cānu- krāntaṃ—'vāto vātāyana ulo vāyavyam 'iti |
vāta॒ ā vā̭tu bhe॒ṣaja॒ṃ śaṃ bhu॒ mayo॒bhu no॒ hṛdḙ | pra ṇa॒ āyṷṣi॒ tāri̭ṣat || 1 || vāta̭: | ā | vā॒tu | bhe॒ṣaja̭m | śam'bhu | mayaḥ'bhu | naḥ | hṛdḙ | pra | ṇaḥ | āyṷṣi | tāri̭ṣat || 1 ||
'vāta: vāyuḥ 'naḥ asmākaṃ 'hṛde hṛdayāya 'bheṣajam auṣadhamudakaṃ vā 'ā 'vātu āgamayatu |
kīdṛgbhūtam ? 'śaṃbhu rogaśamanasya bhāvayitṛ 'mayobhu sukhasya ca bhāvayitṛ |
uta vāta pitāsi na uta bhrāta naḥ sakhā | sa nau jīvātave kṛdhi ||2|| uta | vāta | pitā | asi | naḥ | uta | bhrātā | uta | naḥ | sakhā | saḥ | naḥ | jīvātave | kṛdhi || 2 ||
uta api ca he vāta tvaṃ naḥ asmākaṃ pitā asi utpādako bhavasi |
uta api ca naḥ asmākaṃ sakhā samānakhyāno mitrabhūtaśca bhavasi |
saḥ tvaṃ naḥ asmān jīvātave jīvanahetave yāgāya kṛdhi kuru |
yadado vāta te gṛhe'mṛtasya nidhirhitaḥ | tato no dehi jīvasai ||3|| yat | adaḥ | vāta | te | gṛhe | amṛtasya | ni'dhiḥ | hitaḥ | tataḥ | naḥ | dehi | jīvasai ||3||
he vāta vāyo te tava gṛhe sthāne yadadaḥ yo'sau amṛtasya amarasya nidhiḥ nikṣepaḥ hitaḥ sthāpito vartate tataḥ tasmāddeharāhyādāmṛtatvaṃ jīvase naḥ asmākaṃ jīvanāya dehi prayaccha ||
‘prāgne’ iti pañcarcaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ sūktamagneḥ putrasya vatsyasyārṣaṃ gāyatramāgneyam |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ — ‘prāgne pañcāgneyo vatsa āgneyaṃ tu’ iti |
sūyate hi— ‘prāgne vācamitima sūkta imāṃ me agne samidham’ (ādha. śrau. 4. 13) iti |
sūtritaṃ ca— ‘maruto yasya hi prāgne vācamityāgnimārutam’ (āśva. śrau. 8. 11) iti ||
prāgne vācamīraya vṛṣāya kṣitīnām | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||1|| pra | agnaye | vācam | īraya | vṛṣāya | kṣitīnām | saḥ | naḥ | parṣat | ati | dviṣaḥ ||1||
he stotaḥ agnaye stutirūpāṃ vācaṃ pra īraya uccāraya |
kṣitīnāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ yajamānānāṃ vṛṣāya kāmānāṃ varṣitre |
saḥ agniḥ naḥ asmān dviṣaḥ dveṣṭṛn ati parṣat atipārayet ||
yaḥ parasyāḥ parāvatastiro dhanvātirocate | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||2|| yaḥ | parasyāḥ | parā'vataḥ | tiraḥ | dhanva | atirocate | saḥ | naḥ | parṣat | ati | dviṣaḥ ||2||
yaḥ agniḥ parasyāḥ parāvataḥ atiśayitādūradeśāt tiraḥ prāptamaitat prāptasambandha dhanva marubhūmiṃ jalavarjitaṃ deśam atirocate atikramya prajvalati |
yo rakṣāṃsi nijūrvati vṛṣā śukreṇa śociṣā | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||3|| yaḥ | rakṣāṃsi | ni'jūrvati | vṛṣā | śukreṇa | śociṣā | saḥ | naḥ | parṣat | ati | dviṣaḥ ||3||
vṛṣā varṣitā yaḥ agniḥ śukreṇa nirmalena śubhravarṇena vā śociṣā tejasā rakṣāṃsi yajñasya hantuṇi nijūrvati nihinasti |
yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṃ ca paśyati | sa naḥ parṣadati dviṣaḥ ||4|| yaḥ | viśvā | abhi | vi'paśyati | bhuvanā | sam | ca | paśyati | saḥ | naḥ | parṣat | ati | dviṣaḥ ||4||
ya: agni: sūryarūpeṇa viśvā viśvāni sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni abhi abhimukhaṃ vipaśyati viśeṣeṇa tejasā prekṣate|
bhuvanā bhuvanāni bhūtajātāni saṃ paśyati ca samyagjānāti ca|

yo asya pāre rajasa: śukro agnirajāyata | sa na: parṣadati dviṣa: || 5 || ya: | asya | pāre | rajasa: | śukra: | agni: | ajāyata | sa: | na: | parṣat | ati | dviṣa: ||5|| asya rajasa: lokasyāntarikṣasya pāre uparideśe śukra: śubhravarṇa: ya: agni: vidyu- dātmanā sūryātmanā vā ajāyata prādurbhavati sa: na: asmān dviṣa: dveṣṭṛn ati parṣat atipārayatu || 45 ||
‘pra nūnam’ iti tṛcaṃ saptatriṃśaṃ sūktamabhipatrasya iyenasyārṣaṃ gāyatram |
tathā cānukrāntaṃ—‘pra nūnaṃ tṛcamābheya: iyeno jātavedasyam’ iti |

pra nūnaṃ jātavedasamarthaṃ hinota vājinam | idaṃ nau barhirāsadai || 1 || pra | nūnam | jātavedasam | aśvam | hinota | vājinam | idam | na: | barhi: | ā | sadai ||1|| jātavedasaṃ jātānāṃ veditāraṃ jātadhanādikaṃ vā aśvaṃ karmabhirvyāpnuvantaṃ vājinam annavantaṃ he ṛtvigyajamānā: nūnam avaśyaṃ pra hinota pravadharyata | yadvā | aśvamiva stutibhi: prerayata | ‘hi gatau vṛddhau ca’ | asmāloṭi taśabdasya ‘tasanasanathanāśca’ iti tabādeśa: | kimartham | na: asmākam idaṃ barhi: āstīrṇam āsade āsattu prāptam | barhirāsīdatvityartha: || sadai: ‘kṛtyārthe tavaikena’ iti kenpratyaya: ||

asya pra jātavedaso vipravīrasya mīḻahuṣa: | mahīmiyarmi suṣṭutim || 2 || asya | pra | jātavedasa: | vipra'vīrasya | mīḻahuṣa: | mahīm | iyarmi | su'stutim || 2 || jātavedasa: jātānāṃ veditu: vipravīrasya | viprā medhāvino yajamānā vīrā: putrā yasya | tādṛśasya mīḻahuṣa: sektu: asya agne: mahīṃ mahatīṃ suṣṭutiṃ śobhanāṃ stutiṃ pra iyarmi prerayāmi || ‘ṛ gatau’ | jauhotyādika: | ‘artipiparyośca’ ityabhyāsasyetvam ||

yā rucau jātavedaso devatrā havyavāhanī: | tābhinoṃ yajñaminvatu || 3 || yā: | ruca: | jātavedasa: | deva'trā | havya'vāhanī: | tābhi: | na: | yajñam | invatu ||3|| jātavedasa: agne: yā: ruca: rocamānā: kālīkarālīprabhṛtaya: sapta jihvā: devatrā devān prati | ‘devamanuṣyapuruṣāpuruṣamartyebhya:’ (pā.sū. 5.4.56) ityādinā dvitīyārthe trāpratyaya: || havya- vāhanī: havyānāṃ haviṣāṃ voḍhva: prāpayitavyo bhavanti || ‘vā chandasi’ iti jasi pūrvasavarṇadīrgha: || tābhi: jihvābhi: na: asmākaṃ yajñaṃ yāgasādhanaṃ havi: invatu devān prāpayatu’ | ‘ivi vyāsau’ | idittvāllum || || 46 ||
tathā cānukrāntam—‘āyaṃ gau: sārparājñyāmdaivataṃ sauryaṃ vā’ iti |

etatsūtaṃ śaṃsanīyam| sūtritaṃ ca—'āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirkramīdityupāṃśu tiktaḥ parācīḥ śastvā' (ābha. śrau. 8. 13) iti || āyaṃ gauḥ pṛśnirkramīdasadanmātaraṃ puraḥ | pitaraṃ ca prayantsvaḥ || 1 || ā | ayam | gauḥ | pṛśniḥ | akramīt | asadat | mātaram | puraḥ | pitaram | ca | prayan | svaḥ | iti svaḥ || 1 ||
gauḥ gamanaśīlaḥ pṛśniḥ prāptavarṇaḥ prāptatejāḥ atha sūryaḥ ā akramīt ākrāntavān |
ākramya ca puraḥ purastāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi mātaraṃ sarvasya bhūtajātasya nirmātrīṃ pṛthivīm asadat āsīditi prāpnoti |
sata: pitaraṃ pālakaṃ dyulokaṃ ca śabdādantarikṣaṃ ca prayan prakarṣeṇa śīghraṃ gacchan svaḥ svaraṇaḥ śobhana- gamano bhavati |
antaścarati rocanāsya prāṇādapānatī | vyakhyanmahiṣo divam || 2 || antar | carati | rocanā | asya | prāṇāt | apa | anatī | vi | akhyat | mahiṣaḥ | divam || 2 ||
asya sūryasya rocanā rocamānā dīptiḥ antaḥ śarīramadhye mukhyaprāṇātmanā carati vartate |
antarvātāpṛthivyormadhye asya sūryasya rocanā rocamānā dīptiḥ carati gacchati ||
ata eva mahiṣaḥ mahān sūryo divam antarikṣamudayastamayayormadhye vyakhyat vicaṣṭe |
triṃśaddhāma vi rājati vākpataṅgāya dhīyate | prati vastoraha dyubhiḥ || 3 || triṃśat | dhāma | vi | rājati | vāk | pataṅgāya | dhīyate | prati | vastoḥ | aha | dyubhiḥ || 3 ||

triṃśaddhāma dhāmāni sthānāni | vacanavyatyayaḥ | vastoḥ vāsarasyāhorātrasyāvayavabhūtāni | ahaśabdo'vadhāraṇe | dyubhiḥ sūryasya dīptibhireva vi rājati virājante viśeṣeṇa dīpyante | dhyatha- yenaikavacanam | muhūrtānyatra dhāmānyucyante | pañcadaśa rātreḥ pañcadaśāhaḥ | pataṅgāya | patati gacchatīti pataṅgaḥ sūryaḥ | tasmai stutirūpā vāk prati dhīyate pratimukhaṃ kriyate | yadvā | vastorahani triṃśaddhāmāni | ghaṭikābhiprāyemetat | triṃśaddhaṭikāḥ | atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā | etāvantaṃ kālaṃ dyubhiḥ dīptibhirasau sūryo vi rājati | viśeṣeṇa dīpyate | tasmiṃśca samaye vāk ayīrūpā tasmai sūryarūpāya pataṅgāya prati dhīyate pratimukhaṃ dhāryate | sūrya sevata ityarthaḥ | śrūyate hi—'agnibhaḥ
pūrvāhne divi deva īyate yajurvede tiṣṭhati madhye ahaḥ' (tai. brā. 3. 12. 9. 1) ityādi |
yadā svidaṃ sūktaṃ sārvarājñyā ātmastutiḥ tadā sūryātmanā stūyata ityavagantavyam ||
tathā cānukrāntam—'ṛtaṃ māghu- cchandaso'ghamarṣaṇo bhāvavṛttamānuṣṭubhaṃ tu' iti |
ṛtaṃ mānasaṃ yathārthasaṃkalpanaṃ satyaṃ vācikaṃ yathārthabhāṣaṇam |
abhīddhādabhitaḥ prakāśamānāt paramātmano māyādhiṣṭhānarūpādupādānabhūtādṛtaṃ satyaṃ cājāyata ||
samudraśabdo'ntari- kṣadyoḥ sādhāraṇa ityabhimatārthasya prakāśanāyārṇaśabdena viśeṣyate |
śrūyate hi— 'sarve nimeṣā jajñire viśutaḥ purupādhi kalā muhūrtāḥ kāṣṭhāśca' (tai. ā. 10. 1. 2) iti |
sa veśvaro'horātrāṇyetadupalakṣitāni sarvāṇi bhūtajātāni vidadhat kurvan sṛjan ||
mipato' nimiṣādiyuktasya viśvasya sarvasya prāṇijātasya vaśī svāmī bhūtvā vartate ||

4. ta3.4.5.8-bha4.5.7.8-'mipato ... vartate' nāsti; bha2-viśvasya trailokyasya miṣataḥ jāyamānaḥ vaśī svāmī; ta1.2.6.7-sa tādṛśo dhātā parameśvaraḥ sūryādidevān pṛthivyādi- lokāṃśca yathāpūrva atītasṛṣṭau yasya yādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ tādṛśamatikramya akalpayat |
taitrīupaniṣade bṛhadāraṇyake mādhavīyavyākhyāpaktiḥ; ta3.4.5.8-pustakayeṣu tṛtīya- mantrasya bhāṣyaṃ nāsti |

kvacit likhitapustakasthamaśuddhaṃ pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā mudritapustakādhāreṇa likhitapustakādhāreṇa vā śuddhaḥ pāṭho mayā svīkṛtaḥ|
e. bī. kīthamamahāśayaiḥ kāśmīrakhilagranthavimarśasamaye trayaḥ śuddhāḥ pāṭhāḥ saṃsūcitāste'tra svīkṛtāḥ|
lekhanasaṃkṣepasiddhayarthaṃ kāniciccihnāni prayuktāni tāni saṃkṣepavivaraṇe pradarśitāni|
ṭippaṇīlekhane tāvadayaṃ kramaḥ svīkṛtaḥ - (1) adhyāyasyānukramaṇī adhyāyasyādau dattā|
(2) ṛgvedasaṃhitāyāṃ khilaṃ yatra paṭhanīyaṃ tasya sthānasya nirdeśaḥ|
(3) yeṣu yeṣu grantheṣu khilaṃ pūrṇatayāṃśato vā mudritaṃ teṣāṃ nāmanirdeśaḥ|
(4) yeṣu yeṣu vaidikagrantheṣvitaragrantheṣu ca khilaṃ pūrṇatvenāṃśato vā mantrakramabhedena pāṭhabhedena vāgataṃ teṣāṃ nāmādinirdeśaḥ|
yatra svīkṛtapāṭhasyādhāro na pradarśitaḥ pāṭhabhedasyādhāraścālpaḥ tatra svīkṛtapāṭhādhārasya balīyastvānirdeśo na kṛta iti mantavyam|
(6) mudritakhilapustakeṣu itaragrantheṣu ca vidyamānā adhikā mantrāḥ|
khilasūktānāṃ nirmāṇakālasteṣāṃ ṛgvedasaṃhitayā bāṣkalādiśākhābhiḥ saṃbandhaścaitasmin viṣaye śephṭeloviṭjhamahāśayaiḥ jarmanabhāṣāyāṃ likhite svīye pustake nibandheṣu ca bahu prapañcitam|
śephṭeloviṭjhamahāśayairmudritaṃ kāśmīrakhilagranthamanusṛtya mayātra khilāni saṃgṛhītānīti pūrvamevoktam|
itarāṇi mudritakhilapustakāni anye saṃskṛtagranthāśca khilapāṭhanirdhāraṇe mayopayuktāsteṣāṃ kartāro'pi dhanyavādārhāḥ|
aundhanagarasthāḥ paṃḍita- sātavalekaramahodayāḥ svasaṃpāditaṛgvedaśākalyasaṃhitāpustakadvayamupayogārthaṃ datvā māmupakṛtavanto'- taste viśeṣato dhanyavādārhāḥ|
tathā ca tañjora-tirupanatī-aḍyāra-ityādinagarasthagranthālayagatāni bahūni likhitakhilapustakāni mayā dṛṣṭāni|
āṅgala- jarmanabhāṣayorlikhitāḥ kecana granthā nibandhaśca mayāsya granthasya racanārthamavalokitāsteṣāṃ kartāro'pi dhanyavādārhāḥ|
ante cāsmin khilamudraṇaviṣaye yairvaidvadbhiḥ saṃsūcanena mudritapustakapradānenānya- prakāreṇa vā sāhāyyamāracitaṃ tebhyo'pi dhanyavādān vitarati vidvadvaśaṃvadaḥ ciṃ. ga. kāśīkaraḥ
